dkar chag mchod brjod/ (1)gleng gzhi/ (4)chos 'khor bskor pa'i lo rgyus/ (15)chos ldan gyi bya ba byas tshul gyi rnam thar/ (31)bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyor byas tshul/ (520)sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshul/ (535)gsang ba'i rtogs brjod man+da ra ba'i phreng ba de kho na nyid snang ba 'phags ma'i zhal lung / (645)

dkar chag mchod brjod/ (1)gleng gzhi/ (4)chos 'khor bskor pa'i lo rgyus/ (15)chos ldan gyi bya ba byas tshul gyi rnam thar/ (31)bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyor byas tshul/ (520)sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshul/ (535)gsang ba'i rtogs brjod man+da ra ba'i phreng ba de kho na nyid snang ba 'phags ma'i zhal lung / (645)

mchod brjod/rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs mnga' bdag thub dbang rje/ /thun mong ma yin gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /bskal pa dpag med sngon nas sangs rgyas te/ /gang 'dul sgur bzhengs chos 'khor skor la 'dud/ /chos dbyengs zhing na chos sku kun bzang gi /sgu ru bzhengs nas rdzogs rim mthar thug don/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen khregs chod thod rgal sogs/ /dpag med chos 'khor skor la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'og min zhing na longs sku rdo rje 'chang / /sgu ru bzhengs nas gsang sngags bla med kyi/ /smin byed dbang bzhi grol byed bskyed rdzogs sogs/ /tshad med chos 'khor skor la gus phyag bgyi/ /mi mjed zhing 'dir sprul sku thu ba dbang gi /sku ru bzhengs nas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs/ /grangs med chos 'khor skor la lan brgyar 'dud/ /sku gsum dbyer med o rgyan rin po che/ /bod du phebs nas lha srin sde brgyad btul/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas mdo sngags bstan pa btsugs/ /skye 'gro yongs la bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /o rgyan slar yang bstan pa'i 1

mchod brjod/rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs mnga' bdag thub dbang rje/ /thun mong ma yin gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /bskal pa dpag med sngon nas sangs rgyas te/ /gang 'dul sgur bzhengs chos 'khor skor la 'dud/ /chos dbyengs zhing na chos sku kun bzang gi /sgu ru bzhengs nas rdzogs rim mthar thug don/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen khregs chod thod rgal sogs/ /dpag med chos 'khor skor la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'og min zhing na longs sku rdo rje 'chang / /sgu ru bzhengs nas gsang sngags bla med kyi/ /smin byed dbang bzhi grol byed bskyed rdzogs sogs/ /tshad med chos 'khor skor la gus phyag bgyi/ /mi mjed zhing 'dir sprul sku thu ba dbang gi /sku ru bzhengs nas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs/ /grangs med chos 'khor skor la lan brgyar 'dud/ /sku gsum dbyer med o rgyan rin po che/ /bod du phebs nas lha srin sde brgyad btul/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas mdo sngags bstan pa btsugs/ /skye 'gro yongs la bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /o rgyan slar yang bstan pa'i 1

gsal byed du/ /mnyam med jo bo'i skur sprul bod la phebs/ /bod khams mdo sngags chos kyis dkar bor btang / /'phags yul las kyang ches cher gsal ba byung / /jo bo slar yang snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i skur sprul bod la phebs/ /mdo sngags yongs rdzogs mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad la rjes yi rang / /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang thub dbang nas/ /legs 'ongs mdo sngags yongs rdzogs zab rgya'i chos/ /ma sbas lhug par ston mdzad chos kyi rgyal/ /rang la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che/ /gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag rnams/ /stsol mkhas bla ma bcu phrag bco brgyad kyi/ /bka' chos tshig bzhi tsam re gnang ba yi/ /sku drin gzhal dgos byung na su yis 'khor/ /'on kyang sku drin cha shas tsam re yang / /'khor phyir bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag gi rnam thar mgur dbyangs thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar byin gyes rlobs/ /rang nyid lo gcig thog nas nga drug bar/ /chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba byas tshul gyi/ /rnam thar slob ma mang pos bskul pa'i ngor /sngon chad rgyas pa byas nas bshad tshar song / /da ni lnga bcu nga bdun thog nas bzung / /bdun cu rtsa gcig bar du chos ldan 2

gsal byed du/ /mnyam med jo bo'i skur sprul bod la phebs/ /bod khams mdo sngags chos kyis dkar bor btang / /'phags yul las kyang ches cher gsal ba byung / /jo bo slar yang snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i skur sprul bod la phebs/ /mdo sngags yongs rdzogs mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad la rjes yi rang / /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang thub dbang nas/ /legs 'ongs mdo sngags yongs rdzogs zab rgya'i chos/ /ma sbas lhug par ston mdzad chos kyi rgyal/ /rang la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che/ /gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag rnams/ /stsol mkhas bla ma bcu phrag bco brgyad kyi/ /bka' chos tshig bzhi tsam re gnang ba yi/ /sku drin gzhal dgos byung na su yis 'khor/ /'on kyang sku drin cha shas tsam re yang / /'khor phyir bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag gi rnam thar mgur dbyangs thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar byin gyes rlobs/ /rang nyid lo gcig thog nas nga drug bar/ /chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba byas tshul gyi/ /rnam thar slob ma mang pos bskul pa'i ngor /sngon chad rgyas pa byas nas bshad tshar song / /da ni lnga bcu nga bdun thog nas bzung / /bdun cu rtsa gcig bar du chos ldan 2
gyi/ /bya ba byas tshul rnam thar bshad par bya/ /skal bzang slob ma rnams kyis dga' bas nyon/ /
gyi/ /bya ba byas tshul rnam thar bshad par bya/ /skal bzang slob ma rnams kyis dga' bas nyon/ /

gleng gzhi/de yang sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar ba rang nyid reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi rong 'brog gnyis kyi so mtshams/ kha lhor lta dgun dus nyi 'od 'khyil zhing / dbyar sos dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs pa/ rong 'brog pa gnyis kyi za ma mod cing / chu me shing la sogs mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i sa phun sum tshogs pa 'brong lung dben pa'i nags khrod nyams dga' ru bsdad nas/'khor 'das kyi ltad mo mthong phyir mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin dang zab mo snang ba la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mo brgya phrag 'byed pa la brtson bzhin yod pa'i gnas skabs su/ dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu tshangs dbyangs kyi nub gcig gi rmi lam la/ ngas skya ser pho mo mang po la gser dngul g.yu byur mu tig sogs rin po che sna tshogs gnang ba dang / ma gnang ba yang mang po 'dug pa'i khrod du kho rang yang bsdad nas/ bdag dang 'di tsho la yang gnang dgos zhes yang yang zhus pas/ sngar 4

gleng gzhi/de yang sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar ba rang nyid reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi rong 'brog gnyis kyi so mtshams/ kha lhor lta dgun dus nyi 'od 'khyil zhing / dbyar sos dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs pa/ rong 'brog pa gnyis kyi za ma mod cing / chu me shing la sogs mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i sa phun sum tshogs pa 'brong lung dben pa'i nags khrod nyams dga' ru bsdad nas/'khor 'das kyi ltad mo mthong phyir mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin dang zab mo snang ba la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mo brgya phrag 'byed pa la brtson bzhin yod pa'i gnas skabs su/ dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu tshangs dbyangs kyi nub gcig gi rmi lam la/ ngas skya ser pho mo mang po la gser dngul g.yu byur mu tig sogs rin po che sna tshogs gnang ba dang / ma gnang ba yang mang po 'dug pa'i khrod du kho rang yang bsdad nas/ bdag dang 'di tsho la yang gnang dgos zhes yang yang zhus pas/ sngar 4

gyi de bas kyang mang ba'i nor bu la sogs pa'i rin po che rtsa can mang po gnang bas kun gyi yid tshims te/ gcig gis gcig gi rin po che la lta zhing dga' bzhin spro bzhin gyes pa zhig rmis pas rkyen byas/ kho rang gi sems la khong gi sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar zhus nas/ de'i nang du rang dang phyis kyi grwa bu slob yon bdag dad can rnams kyang jebs pa zhig byas na skal ba re bzang snyam/ nyin zhig gnas chen der tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i skal ldan snying gi bu chen grub dbang pad+ma rang grol gyi sprul sku/ dge rgan dge legs/ pad+ma kun grol/ a lags mkha' 'gro/ dbon po dkar dris/ mtshams pa kun dga'/dge slong ban tho/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ gnas brtan/ skal bzang chos 'phel la sogs pa'i las ldan gyi grwa bu slob mang po 'tshogs yod pa'i dbus su 'ongs nas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas bcas lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas zhu ba/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ sngar bu chen mang pos zhus nas sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar gsungs pa bka' drin che/ da yang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po ni/ mgon khyed sku tshe smad kyi rnam par thar pa yang thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas rgyas par gsung du gsol zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su 5

gyi de bas kyang mang ba'i nor bu la sogs pa'i rin po che rtsa can mang po gnang bas kun gyi yid tshims te/ gcig gis gcig gi rin po che la lta zhing dga' bzhin spro bzhin gyes pa zhig rmis pas rkyen byas/ kho rang gi sems la khong gi sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar zhus nas/ de'i nang du rang dang phyis kyi grwa bu slob yon bdag dad can rnams kyang jebs pa zhig byas na skal ba re bzang snyam/ nyin zhig gnas chen der tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i skal ldan snying gi bu chen grub dbang pad+ma rang grol gyi sprul sku/ dge rgan dge legs/ pad+ma kun grol/ a lags mkha' 'gro/ dbon po dkar dris/ mtshams pa kun dga'/dge slong ban tho/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ gnas brtan/ skal bzang chos 'phel la sogs pa'i las ldan gyi grwa bu slob mang po 'tshogs yod pa'i dbus su 'ongs nas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas bcas lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas zhu ba/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ sngar bu chen mang pos zhus nas sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar gsungs pa bka' drin che/ da yang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po ni/ mgon khyed sku tshe smad kyi rnam par thar pa yang thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas rgyas par gsung du gsol zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su 5

phul ba /rje skyabs mgon mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus longs spyod dge tshogs mchod par 'bul/ /sngon thog med nas bsags sdig ltung bshags/ /mgon khyed kyi mdzad par rjes yi rang /yid gang 'dod chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /sku mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge gang bsags bzhed don 'grub phyir bsngo/ /rje mkhyen pa'i gter khyed brtse bas dgongs/ /sngon bsod nams bsags pas sku tshe 'dir/ /chung gzhon nas chos dang bla mar mjal/ /dpe me 'obs lta bu'i 'khor ba la/ /thugs skyo shas nges 'byung gting nas skyes/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs pa'i/ /dgra gnyen kun drin can pha mar mthong / /lam rim gnyis brtan pa thob pa'i mthus/ /phyi snod bcud lha yi 'khor lor shar/ /nang rig pa sems la slob gnyer byas/ /phyi'i snang ba brda' dang dpe char shar/ /chos thams cad stong nyid 'od gsal du/ /bzo mkhas shing slob pa'i bzo rig mkhan/ /chos ye shes lnga yi sman sbyor gyis/ /nad dug lnga sel ba'i sman pa mchog /sgra legs nyes thams cad grags stong du/ /go mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i sgra mkhan pa/ /chos kun gyi rang bzhin bdag med du/ /mngon sum du phebs pa'i 6

phul ba /rje skyabs mgon mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus longs spyod dge tshogs mchod par 'bul/ /sngon thog med nas bsags sdig ltung bshags/ /mgon khyed kyi mdzad par rjes yi rang /yid gang 'dod chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /sku mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge gang bsags bzhed don 'grub phyir bsngo/ /rje mkhyen pa'i gter khyed brtse bas dgongs/ /sngon bsod nams bsags pas sku tshe 'dir/ /chung gzhon nas chos dang bla mar mjal/ /dpe me 'obs lta bu'i 'khor ba la/ /thugs skyo shas nges 'byung gting nas skyes/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs pa'i/ /dgra gnyen kun drin can pha mar mthong / /lam rim gnyis brtan pa thob pa'i mthus/ /phyi snod bcud lha yi 'khor lor shar/ /nang rig pa sems la slob gnyer byas/ /phyi'i snang ba brda' dang dpe char shar/ /chos thams cad stong nyid 'od gsal du/ /bzo mkhas shing slob pa'i bzo rig mkhan/ /chos ye shes lnga yi sman sbyor gyis/ /nad dug lnga sel ba'i sman pa mchog /sgra legs nyes thams cad grags stong du/ /go mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i sgra mkhan pa/ /chos kun gyi rang bzhin bdag med du/ /mngon sum du phebs pa'i 6

tshad ma mkhan/ /nang sde snod rnam gsum don kun rig /rje snying po don gye paṇ+ḍi ta/ /phyi snang ba thams cad dper bzhag nas/ /don rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mgur du bzhengs/ /mgur kho na stong phrag mang po blangs/ /gzhan legs bshad brtsams pa bsam mi khyab/ /las skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /spyan mngon shes dzu 'phrul cir yang bstan/ /mgon khyed kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar che/ /dus da dung sku tshe smad 'di yi/ /phyi nang dang gsang ba'i rnam thar kun/ /yang sba gsang med par bstan du gsol/ /mgon khyed kyi rnam thar gsung bzhin du/ /rang tshe rabs kun tu sgrub par smon/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du bdag gis 'di skad smras/'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu kun cung zad tsam zhig gsan par zhu/deng sang bskal pa snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ sngon byon sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi rnam thar dang gsung la yang lta mkhan tsam yang med pa'i dus 'dir/ so skyes bdag lta bu'i rnam thar la su zhig gis blta/ khyed dad can bu slob rnams la sngar gyi rnam thar de gas chog da nged rnams kyi mi tshe zad tshar/ lo kha shas tsam re e sdod mi sdod red/ nga la rnam thar rtsom khom dang / khyed rnams la blta khom zhig mi snang / phyi rabs kyi gang zag dad can 7

tshad ma mkhan/ /nang sde snod rnam gsum don kun rig /rje snying po don gye paṇ+ḍi ta/ /phyi snang ba thams cad dper bzhag nas/ /don rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mgur du bzhengs/ /mgur kho na stong phrag mang po blangs/ /gzhan legs bshad brtsams pa bsam mi khyab/ /las skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /spyan mngon shes dzu 'phrul cir yang bstan/ /mgon khyed kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar che/ /dus da dung sku tshe smad 'di yi/ /phyi nang dang gsang ba'i rnam thar kun/ /yang sba gsang med par bstan du gsol/ /mgon khyed kyi rnam thar gsung bzhin du/ /rang tshe rabs kun tu sgrub par smon/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du bdag gis 'di skad smras/'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu kun cung zad tsam zhig gsan par zhu/deng sang bskal pa snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ sngon byon sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi rnam thar dang gsung la yang lta mkhan tsam yang med pa'i dus 'dir/ so skyes bdag lta bu'i rnam thar la su zhig gis blta/ khyed dad can bu slob rnams la sngar gyi rnam thar de gas chog da nged rnams kyi mi tshe zad tshar/ lo kha shas tsam re e sdod mi sdod red/ nga la rnam thar rtsom khom dang / khyed rnams la blta khom zhig mi snang / phyi rabs kyi gang zag dad can 7

'ga' re la phan thogs pa'i smon lam thobs dang / phan thogs pa 'di yang dka' mo zhig red/ da phyin chad nga'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar khyed bu chen tshos phris/ khyed rnams dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ mi rgan nga rang ma shi bar du sos dal bde bar nyal du chug ces slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/tshe dpag med mgon dzam+bha la/ /tshe lha nor lha thams cad kyis/ /tshe ldan slob ma thams cad la/ /tshe dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ /tshul khrims gtsang zhing bsam pa bzang / /dad brtson shes rab snying rje che/ /shes bya'i gnas rnams kun la mkhas/ /chos mthun dbu mdzad tshangs dbyangs dang / /dge rgan kun dga' la sogs pa'i/ /slob ma yang slob thams cad kyis/ /rnam thar zhus pa skal ba bzang / /'on kyang bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rgya bod kyi/ /mkhas grub tshad ldan rnam thar dang / /gsung la lta mkhan dkon dus 'dir/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i so skyes kyi/ /rnam thar mgur la su zhig lta/ /dad can bu slob khyed rnams la/ /tshe stod rnam thar de gas chog /da ni mi tshe zad tshar song / /lo shas e sdod mi sdod red/ /nga la rnam thar rtsom khom dang / /khyed rnams la yang blta khom med/ /phyi rabs chos mdzad pho mo la/ /phan 'dra 8

'ga' re la phan thogs pa'i smon lam thobs dang / phan thogs pa 'di yang dka' mo zhig red/ da phyin chad nga'i sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar khyed bu chen tshos phris/ khyed rnams dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ mi rgan nga rang ma shi bar du sos dal bde bar nyal du chug ces slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/tshe dpag med mgon dzam+bha la/ /tshe lha nor lha thams cad kyis/ /tshe ldan slob ma thams cad la/ /tshe dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ /tshul khrims gtsang zhing bsam pa bzang / /dad brtson shes rab snying rje che/ /shes bya'i gnas rnams kun la mkhas/ /chos mthun dbu mdzad tshangs dbyangs dang / /dge rgan kun dga' la sogs pa'i/ /slob ma yang slob thams cad kyis/ /rnam thar zhus pa skal ba bzang / /'on kyang bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rgya bod kyi/ /mkhas grub tshad ldan rnam thar dang / /gsung la lta mkhan dkon dus 'dir/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i so skyes kyi/ /rnam thar mgur la su zhig lta/ /dad can bu slob khyed rnams la/ /tshe stod rnam thar de gas chog /da ni mi tshe zad tshar song / /lo shas e sdod mi sdod red/ /nga la rnam thar rtsom khom dang / /khyed rnams la yang blta khom med/ /phyi rabs chos mdzad pho mo la/ /phan 'dra 8

thogs pa'i smon lam re/ /thobs dang thogs pa'ang dka' mo red/ /khyed rnams gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /phyin chad mdzad pa tha ma yi/ /rnam thar bu chen rnams tshos phris/ /mi rgan nga rang 'chi reg bar/ /dben par bde bar nyal du chug /ngas kyang khyed rnams thams cad la/ /'di phyir phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing khams nas/ /mngon sum mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis shog /ces smras pas/ yang kho rang yar langs te phyag du ma byas/ slar yang gsol ba/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ sngar khyed kyi sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar brtsams pas kun gyi rgyud la phan thogs chen po byung / da dung yang khyed skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i skyes bu dam pa yin pas/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi don du dgung lo brgya phrag mang por bzhugs nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad dgos/ sku tshe smad 'dir khyed kyis rjes su bzung ba'i dam pa'i rnam 'phrul sprul sku rnams dang / skal bzang las 'phro can gye slob ma bu chen yon bdag pho mo dad can mang po sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar du ma thebs par 'dug pas/ de dag rnams kyang sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar nang du cig 'jug dgos/de'i phyir ci nas kyang gsung dgos zhes nan tan chen po'i sgo 9

thogs pa'i smon lam re/ /thobs dang thogs pa'ang dka' mo red/ /khyed rnams gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /phyin chad mdzad pa tha ma yi/ /rnam thar bu chen rnams tshos phris/ /mi rgan nga rang 'chi reg bar/ /dben par bde bar nyal du chug /ngas kyang khyed rnams thams cad la/ /'di phyir phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing khams nas/ /mngon sum mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis shog /ces smras pas/ yang kho rang yar langs te phyag du ma byas/ slar yang gsol ba/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ sngar khyed kyi sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar brtsams pas kun gyi rgyud la phan thogs chen po byung / da dung yang khyed skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i skyes bu dam pa yin pas/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi don du dgung lo brgya phrag mang por bzhugs nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad dgos/ sku tshe smad 'dir khyed kyis rjes su bzung ba'i dam pa'i rnam 'phrul sprul sku rnams dang / skal bzang las 'phro can gye slob ma bu chen yon bdag pho mo dad can mang po sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar du ma thebs par 'dug pas/ de dag rnams kyang sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar nang du cig 'jug dgos/de'i phyir ci nas kyang gsung dgos zhes nan tan chen po'i sgo 9

nas yang yang bskul pa'i ngor/ 'o na de yin na ngas kyang sems la bzhag nas sos dal byas rjes su brtsams yong zhes khas blangs pas/ der 'tshogs pa rnams sems rab tu dga' nas phyag dang bcas rang rang gi gnas su song ngo / /yang de'i rjes su 'du 'dzi grong gi pha rol/ g.ya' dang spang gi 'dabs rol/ rong dang 'brog pa'i so mtshams/ mkhas grub mang po'i bzhugs gnas/ nags tshal me tog rgyas shing 'ja' sprin na bun 'khor ba/ lha dang ḍā ki 'du zhing dam pa'i lung gis zin pa'i gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil ba zhes ri bo mtho la yangs pa'i rtse mo/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i bde ba can gyi lha khang gi nye 'dabs mtshams khang 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyel ba na bdag gis sgom med 'od gsal chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin skyong zhing / nyams mgur mang po len bzhin gnas pa'i skabs shig mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i bu chen pad+ma kun grol gyi tho rangs kyi rmi lam zhig la/ ngas rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po bzhugs pa'i lha khang bzhengs grub pa zhig la mjal nas/ da dung lha khang 'di'i steng du gser gye gañjir rgyal mtshan 'khor lo ri dwags pho mo dang / phyi rol tu bar khyams lcags ri khor yug gis bskor pa 10

nas yang yang bskul pa'i ngor/ 'o na de yin na ngas kyang sems la bzhag nas sos dal byas rjes su brtsams yong zhes khas blangs pas/ der 'tshogs pa rnams sems rab tu dga' nas phyag dang bcas rang rang gi gnas su song ngo / /yang de'i rjes su 'du 'dzi grong gi pha rol/ g.ya' dang spang gi 'dabs rol/ rong dang 'brog pa'i so mtshams/ mkhas grub mang po'i bzhugs gnas/ nags tshal me tog rgyas shing 'ja' sprin na bun 'khor ba/ lha dang ḍā ki 'du zhing dam pa'i lung gis zin pa'i gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil ba zhes ri bo mtho la yangs pa'i rtse mo/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i bde ba can gyi lha khang gi nye 'dabs mtshams khang 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyel ba na bdag gis sgom med 'od gsal chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin skyong zhing / nyams mgur mang po len bzhin gnas pa'i skabs shig mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i bu chen pad+ma kun grol gyi tho rangs kyi rmi lam zhig la/ ngas rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po bzhugs pa'i lha khang bzhengs grub pa zhig la mjal nas/ da dung lha khang 'di'i steng du gser gye gañjir rgyal mtshan 'khor lo ri dwags pho mo dang / phyi rol tu bar khyams lcags ri khor yug gis bskor pa 10

zhig byung na phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'dug zhus pas/ ngas kyang de ltar byas grub pa'i snang ba zhig shar ba'i ngang la gnyid sad pa'i rkyen byas/ sngar sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar 'brong lung nas kun gyis zhus yod pa da dung zhu skyor zhig byed dgos snyam/ gnas chen der sngon gyi las dang skal bar ldan pa'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ bu chen khyung dgon sprul sku/ dgu rong sprul sku/ hor rgya'i sku skyes/ ma phyag sku skyes/ hor sprul sku/ skal ldan sprul sku/ ye shes dar rgyas/ dge 'dun nor bu/ blo bzang 'jigs med/dmag gsar sras po/ yon tan rgya mtsho sogs grwa bu slob mang po 'tshogs pa'i khrod du 'ongs nas/ rab tu gus pas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas bcas phul nas/ skyabs mgon rin po che khyed kyis 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal nas thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas/ sku tshe sman kyi rnam thar rtsom zhes 'gyur med bden pa'i zhal bzhes ltar/ da ni bstan 'gro yongs la phan phyir/ sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar de bas kyang lhag cig bka' drin skyongs zhes slar yang zhu don tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/chos dbyings zhing na chos sku kun tu bzang / /'og min zhing na longs sku rdo rje 'chang / /mi mjed zhing na sprul sku thub dbang rje/ /gdul bya'i zhing 'dir 'gro mgon zhabs dkar 11

zhig byung na phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'dug zhus pas/ ngas kyang de ltar byas grub pa'i snang ba zhig shar ba'i ngang la gnyid sad pa'i rkyen byas/ sngar sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar 'brong lung nas kun gyis zhus yod pa da dung zhu skyor zhig byed dgos snyam/ gnas chen der sngon gyi las dang skal bar ldan pa'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ bu chen khyung dgon sprul sku/ dgu rong sprul sku/ hor rgya'i sku skyes/ ma phyag sku skyes/ hor sprul sku/ skal ldan sprul sku/ ye shes dar rgyas/ dge 'dun nor bu/ blo bzang 'jigs med/dmag gsar sras po/ yon tan rgya mtsho sogs grwa bu slob mang po 'tshogs pa'i khrod du 'ongs nas/ rab tu gus pas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas bcas phul nas/ skyabs mgon rin po che khyed kyis 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal nas thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas/ sku tshe sman kyi rnam thar rtsom zhes 'gyur med bden pa'i zhal bzhes ltar/ da ni bstan 'gro yongs la phan phyir/ sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar de bas kyang lhag cig bka' drin skyongs zhes slar yang zhu don tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/chos dbyings zhing na chos sku kun tu bzang / /'og min zhing na longs sku rdo rje 'chang / /mi mjed zhing na sprul sku thub dbang rje/ /gdul bya'i zhing 'dir 'gro mgon zhabs dkar 11

pa/ /sku gsum kun 'dus khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung mthol lo bshags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad par rjes yi rang / /dpag med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs zhabs pad brtan pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /skyabs mgon mkhyen brtse'i gter khyod yud tsam dgongs/ /mgon khyod grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol nas/ /rdul bral 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi sku/ /brnyes kyang rgyal dang rgyal sras mdzad pa yi/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub la the tshom bral/ /sku yi skye ba 'di la na phra'i dus/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems dang 'bral med cing / /ya rabs skyes bu'i spyod pa ya mtshan can/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi rjes su bsnyegs/ /bstan pa'i bdag po'i gtso byas rgyal ba dang / /de sras mkhas grub du ma mngon sum du/ /rang rang sku yi bkod pa gsal byas nas/ /zhal gzigs 'od zer snang ba rgyal mtshan du/ /bskrun nas rgyal bstan gtad pa'i brda' rtags su/ /phyag tu gtad nas mnga' gsol gzengs bstod mdzad/ /snod bcud phun tshogs gcig char bsdus 'dra ba'i/ /nyams su dga' ba'i gnas khang dam pa ru/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma 12

pa/ /sku gsum kun 'dus khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung mthol lo bshags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad par rjes yi rang / /dpag med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs zhabs pad brtan pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /skyabs mgon mkhyen brtse'i gter khyod yud tsam dgongs/ /mgon khyod grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol nas/ /rdul bral 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi sku/ /brnyes kyang rgyal dang rgyal sras mdzad pa yi/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub la the tshom bral/ /sku yi skye ba 'di la na phra'i dus/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems dang 'bral med cing / /ya rabs skyes bu'i spyod pa ya mtshan can/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi rjes su bsnyegs/ /bstan pa'i bdag po'i gtso byas rgyal ba dang / /de sras mkhas grub du ma mngon sum du/ /rang rang sku yi bkod pa gsal byas nas/ /zhal gzigs 'od zer snang ba rgyal mtshan du/ /bskrun nas rgyal bstan gtad pa'i brda' rtags su/ /phyag tu gtad nas mnga' gsol gzengs bstod mdzad/ /snod bcud phun tshogs gcig char bsdus 'dra ba'i/ /nyams su dga' ba'i gnas khang dam pa ru/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma 12

rgyal sa skyong gi /tshul bzung rab tu mtho ba'i khrer bkur nas/ /dbang gzhu'i khengs pa 'phrog pa'i cod pan phul/ /glu dbyangs mkhan zhes snyan pa'i mtshan gsol te/ /bstod tshig me tog 'thor ba'i dpal 'di mtshar/ /mi zad khro ba drag po rab rgyas pa'i/ /byang gi g.yag rgod gtum pos gang sku la/ /'tshe bar sems pa'i rwa rtses gzes gyur kyang / /gnya' bar zhon nas rgyan du byas pa bzhin/ /sgrib med mkha' 'dra dag pa'i ye shes kyi/ /ut+pal bzhin du skyon bral spyan ras ni/ /dag dang ma dag khams su gzigs pa'i tshe/ /mig ldan skye bos sna tshogs gzugs la bzhin/ /snod dang bcud kyi khyad par ci mchis pa/ /ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa sa ler snang / /bka' dang bstan bcos dgongs pa'i gling bu ni/ /gzhan phan sems kyi dbugs stobs kyis sgog tshe/ /ngo mtshar gtam rgyud du ma'i sor 'phral gyis/ /mchog dman bar ba'i blor 'tsham 'gyur khugs stong / /sgogs mkhas khyed kyi 'chos skyob nyis ldan gye/ /bstan bcos 'di dag sras bcas rgyal ba yi/ /lam bzang bde blag ston pa'i 'phrul yin phyir/ /sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes grags ming don mtshungs/ /rlung sems las su rung ba'i byed las kyis/ /mkha' lding dbang po ji bzhin gshegs pa dang / /gor mo'i rdo la phyag 13

rgyal sa skyong gi /tshul bzung rab tu mtho ba'i khrer bkur nas/ /dbang gzhu'i khengs pa 'phrog pa'i cod pan phul/ /glu dbyangs mkhan zhes snyan pa'i mtshan gsol te/ /bstod tshig me tog 'thor ba'i dpal 'di mtshar/ /mi zad khro ba drag po rab rgyas pa'i/ /byang gi g.yag rgod gtum pos gang sku la/ /'tshe bar sems pa'i rwa rtses gzes gyur kyang / /gnya' bar zhon nas rgyan du byas pa bzhin/ /sgrib med mkha' 'dra dag pa'i ye shes kyi/ /ut+pal bzhin du skyon bral spyan ras ni/ /dag dang ma dag khams su gzigs pa'i tshe/ /mig ldan skye bos sna tshogs gzugs la bzhin/ /snod dang bcud kyi khyad par ci mchis pa/ /ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa sa ler snang / /bka' dang bstan bcos dgongs pa'i gling bu ni/ /gzhan phan sems kyi dbugs stobs kyis sgog tshe/ /ngo mtshar gtam rgyud du ma'i sor 'phral gyis/ /mchog dman bar ba'i blor 'tsham 'gyur khugs stong / /sgogs mkhas khyed kyi 'chos skyob nyis ldan gye/ /bstan bcos 'di dag sras bcas rgyal ba yi/ /lam bzang bde blag ston pa'i 'phrul yin phyir/ /sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes grags ming don mtshungs/ /rlung sems las su rung ba'i byed las kyis/ /mkha' lding dbang po ji bzhin gshegs pa dang / /gor mo'i rdo la phyag 13

ris bkod pa sogs/ /ya ma zung gi rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa/ /skal ldan mang por mngon sum chos su bstan/ /e ma grub pa'i spyod pa ya mtshan can/ /de 'dra mang po bstan la rjes yi rang / /da dung de 'dra'i mdzad bzang ci yang ston/ /mgon khyod sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar bzhin/ /da ni sku tshe smad 'di'i rnam thar kyang / /sba bsri med par rgyas par gsung du gsol/ /pha rjes bu yis zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o khyed rnams kyis rab tu dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas lan cig ma yin par yang yang zhu na/ ngas kyang lhag bsam dag pa'i ngos nas phyin chad rnam thar rgyas pa byas rim gyis bris yong zhes khas blangs pas/ khong rnams kyis kyang rab tu dga' ba'i ngos nas phyag du ma byas rang rang gi gnas su song / ngas kyang de'i nyi ma nas bzung rnam thar 'bri ba la yid phyogs so//14

ris bkod pa sogs/ /ya ma zung gi rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa/ /skal ldan mang por mngon sum chos su bstan/ /e ma grub pa'i spyod pa ya mtshan can/ /de 'dra mang po bstan la rjes yi rang / /da dung de 'dra'i mdzad bzang ci yang ston/ /mgon khyod sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar bzhin/ /da ni sku tshe smad 'di'i rnam thar kyang / /sba bsri med par rgyas par gsung du gsol/ /pha rjes bu yis zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o khyed rnams kyis rab tu dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas lan cig ma yin par yang yang zhu na/ ngas kyang lhag bsam dag pa'i ngos nas phyin chad rnam thar rgyas pa byas rim gyis bris yong zhes khas blangs pas/ khong rnams kyis kyang rab tu dga' ba'i ngos nas phyag du ma byas rang rang gi gnas su song / ngas kyang de'i nyi ma nas bzung rnam thar 'bri ba la yid phyogs so//14

chos 'khor bskor pa'i lo rgyus/da ni rnam thar dngos la/ thog mar dge ba ston pas 'gro la chos 'khor bskor pa'i lo rgyus bzang po dang gcig bar du dge ba sku tshe'i smad la chos ldan gyi bya ba byas tshul gyi rnam thar bzang po dang gnyis/ tha mar dge ba mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyor byas tshul bzang po dang gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad par bya ste/ de la thog mar dge ba ston pas 'gro la chos 'khor bskor pa'i lo rgyus bzang po ni/ de yang snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon/ chu nang gi zla ba/me long nang gi gzugs brnyan sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin snang bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du snang ba 'di dag thams cad kyang / don dam par mtha' bral chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings su ro gcig tu gnas shing / de bzhin du phyogs bcu dus gsum gye sangs rgyas thams cad kyang thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du chu la chu bzhag pa dang / nam mkha' la nam mkha' 'dres pa bzhin dbyer med du gnas kyang / de'i ngang las nam 15

chos 'khor bskor pa'i lo rgyus/da ni rnam thar dngos la/ thog mar dge ba ston pas 'gro la chos 'khor bskor pa'i lo rgyus bzang po dang gcig bar du dge ba sku tshe'i smad la chos ldan gyi bya ba byas tshul gyi rnam thar bzang po dang gnyis/ tha mar dge ba mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyor byas tshul bzang po dang gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad par bya ste/ de la thog mar dge ba ston pas 'gro la chos 'khor bskor pa'i lo rgyus bzang po ni/ de yang snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon/ chu nang gi zla ba/me long nang gi gzugs brnyan sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin snang bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du snang ba 'di dag thams cad kyang / don dam par mtha' bral chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings su ro gcig tu gnas shing / de bzhin du phyogs bcu dus gsum gye sangs rgyas thams cad kyang thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du chu la chu bzhag pa dang / nam mkha' la nam mkha' 'dres pa bzhin dbyer med du gnas kyang / de'i ngang las nam 15

yang ma g.yos bzhin du gang 'dul gye gzugs sgu 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar nas/ mkha' mnyam ma gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin te/ sangs rgyas la bstod pa rin chen bang mdzod las/chos rnams byis pas btags bzhin yod na ni/ /rang bzhin gnas te sus kyang bsgyur mi nus/ /chos kun gsog gsob dzun pa rmi lam bzhin/ /rtog pas btags pa rmi lam dang mtshungs shing / /rkyen la rag las nam mkha'i glog 'dra ba/ /'di 'dra 'di la sems la dbang thob rnams/ /rnam 'phrul mtha' yas grangs med ston pa la/ /ngo mtshar yid mi ches pa bya mi dgos/ /rmi lam cho 'phrul brgya stong mthong ba'i dpes/ /rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul la yang shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems la dbang thob pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa'/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis sems can thams cad la sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ ngo mtshar sku yi bkod pa cir yang bstan nas gang 'tsham gye chos gsungs nas 'gro don mdzad pa yin/ des na rgyal ba sras bcas kyi rnam 'phrul ni mtha' yas pas/ mtha' gcig tu bzung nas gu dog po bya mi dgos so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nang nas pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i 16

yang ma g.yos bzhin du gang 'dul gye gzugs sgu 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar nas/ mkha' mnyam ma gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin te/ sangs rgyas la bstod pa rin chen bang mdzod las/chos rnams byis pas btags bzhin yod na ni/ /rang bzhin gnas te sus kyang bsgyur mi nus/ /chos kun gsog gsob dzun pa rmi lam bzhin/ /rtog pas btags pa rmi lam dang mtshungs shing / /rkyen la rag las nam mkha'i glog 'dra ba/ /'di 'dra 'di la sems la dbang thob rnams/ /rnam 'phrul mtha' yas grangs med ston pa la/ /ngo mtshar yid mi ches pa bya mi dgos/ /rmi lam cho 'phrul brgya stong mthong ba'i dpes/ /rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul la yang shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems la dbang thob pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa'/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis sems can thams cad la sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ ngo mtshar sku yi bkod pa cir yang bstan nas gang 'tsham gye chos gsungs nas 'gro don mdzad pa yin/ des na rgyal ba sras bcas kyi rnam 'phrul ni mtha' yas pas/ mtha' gcig tu bzung nas gu dog po bya mi dgos so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nang nas pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i 16

mdza' bshes chen po mnyam med rgyal ba shākya thub pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po srid pa gsum na ches cher g.yo ba 'di nyid ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba bstan nas/ 'gro la gang 'dul gyi chos ston pa yin te/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ rigs kyi bu/ nga ni bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong mang po'i gong rol tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes dang / bskal pa bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de yi grangs ni sus kyang bzung med par/ /byang chub dam pa de ni ngas rnyed de/ /ngas ni rtag tu chos kyang rab 'chad do/ /gsungs/yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol tu/ 'jig rten gye khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi zhing gcig tu gyur pa der/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad do gsungs/ thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me las/ steng dang phyogs bzhi mtshams kyi zhing der ni/ /bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gzhan ma yin/ /shākya'i rgyal po nyid du mkhas pas gsungs/ /sngon tshe bskal pa dpag med grangs ldan 17

mdza' bshes chen po mnyam med rgyal ba shākya thub pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po srid pa gsum na ches cher g.yo ba 'di nyid ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba bstan nas/ 'gro la gang 'dul gyi chos ston pa yin te/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ rigs kyi bu/ nga ni bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong mang po'i gong rol tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes dang / bskal pa bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de yi grangs ni sus kyang bzung med par/ /byang chub dam pa de ni ngas rnyed de/ /ngas ni rtag tu chos kyang rab 'chad do/ /gsungs/yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol tu/ 'jig rten gye khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi zhing gcig tu gyur pa der/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad do gsungs/ thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me las/ steng dang phyogs bzhi mtshams kyi zhing der ni/ /bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gzhan ma yin/ /shākya'i rgyal po nyid du mkhas pas gsungs/ /sngon tshe bskal pa dpag med grangs ldan 17

na/ /bde ba can ltar dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /dbang po'i tog ces bya ba'i sangs rgyas 'byung / /de yang shākya'i rgyal po 'di yin te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /ces dang / chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i/ /zhing khams de ni rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i/ /spu'i khung re na'ang bye ba phrag brgyar gnas/ /sku yi rdul phran re la de 'dra ste/ /zhing de'i rdul re la yang de snyed gnas/ /rnam snang de ni rgyal ba shāka thub 'di'i/ /longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ /de yi sku dang zhing la gang gnas pa'i/ /zhing khams de kun gcig tu bsdams byas pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku re re'i zhing du gsungs/ /tshul 'dis nam mkhas ji srid khyab gyur pa/ /de snyed rgyal ba'i sku dang zhing yang gnas/ /shin tu nges pa'i don du sku dang zhing / /tshad med pha mtha' bzung bar mi nus so/ /zhes dang / rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag bcangs las/ shrī he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa'i lo rgyus rnams nas kyang / bdag cag gi ston pa thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas te/ sangs rgyas ma thag bde mchog gi rgyud rgyas par gsungs pa/ sems can bsod rnams kyi dbang gis/ res 'ga' dar la res 'ga' nub par 'gyur zhes bshad pa dang /18

na/ /bde ba can ltar dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /dbang po'i tog ces bya ba'i sangs rgyas 'byung / /de yang shākya'i rgyal po 'di yin te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /ces dang / chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i/ /zhing khams de ni rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i/ /spu'i khung re na'ang bye ba phrag brgyar gnas/ /sku yi rdul phran re la de 'dra ste/ /zhing de'i rdul re la yang de snyed gnas/ /rnam snang de ni rgyal ba shāka thub 'di'i/ /longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ /de yi sku dang zhing la gang gnas pa'i/ /zhing khams de kun gcig tu bsdams byas pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku re re'i zhing du gsungs/ /tshul 'dis nam mkhas ji srid khyab gyur pa/ /de snyed rgyal ba'i sku dang zhing yang gnas/ /shin tu nges pa'i don du sku dang zhing / /tshad med pha mtha' bzung bar mi nus so/ /zhes dang / rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag bcangs las/ shrī he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa'i lo rgyus rnams nas kyang / bdag cag gi ston pa thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas te/ sangs rgyas ma thag bde mchog gi rgyud rgyas par gsungs pa/ sems can bsod rnams kyi dbang gis/ res 'ga' dar la res 'ga' nub par 'gyur zhes bshad pa dang /18

rdzogs chen na/ kun tu bzang po rang byung gi sangs rgyas su bshad pa rnams don gcig de la mdo sde skyes rabs rnams nas thub pas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa ni drang don tsam yin gye/ nges pa'i don du ma yin te/ de lta bu'i tshul bstan pa tsam du nges so gsungs/ chos 'byung 'dzam gling tha gru yangs pa'i rgyan las/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i mtshan gyis bsnyad pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing / chos nyid 'od gsal gyi zhing khams gang du sgrib pa mtha' dag spungs pa'i yon tan bkod pa zad mi shes pa'i 'og min ye shes rol ba'i rgyan du bzhugs nas/ rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rol ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mnga' thang chen pos chos kyi sgon ma rnam par bkod de/ zhes gsungs/ 'o na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ma /ba' mnyam gye 'gro ba yongs la chos ji ltar gsungs snyam na/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa gang la gang 'dul gyi sku yi bkod pa cir yang bstan 19

rdzogs chen na/ kun tu bzang po rang byung gi sangs rgyas su bshad pa rnams don gcig de la mdo sde skyes rabs rnams nas thub pas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa ni drang don tsam yin gye/ nges pa'i don du ma yin te/ de lta bu'i tshul bstan pa tsam du nges so gsungs/ chos 'byung 'dzam gling tha gru yangs pa'i rgyan las/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i mtshan gyis bsnyad pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing / chos nyid 'od gsal gyi zhing khams gang du sgrib pa mtha' dag spungs pa'i yon tan bkod pa zad mi shes pa'i 'og min ye shes rol ba'i rgyan du bzhugs nas/ rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rol ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mnga' thang chen pos chos kyi sgon ma rnam par bkod de/ zhes gsungs/ 'o na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ma /ba' mnyam gye 'gro ba yongs la chos ji ltar gsungs snyam na/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa gang la gang 'dul gyi sku yi bkod pa cir yang bstan 19

nas/ 'das ma 'ongapo da lta dus gsum du mdo sngags kyi chos kho na gsungs pa yin te/ ye shes rol ba'i rgyud las/ thog ma'i rdo rje 'chang chen ngas/ /bskal pa kun gye sngon rol nas/ /phyi ma'i mu mtha' thug gyur pa/ /de srid bla med gsang ba'i chos rmad byung rgyal po 'gro ba la/ /gsungs so gsung ngo gsung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud gzhan las/ rdzogs ldan dang po bya ba'i rgyud/ /gsum ldan gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ /gnyis ldan gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rtsod ldan bzhi ba bla med do/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /da lta 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa rnams/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang sangs rgyas kyis da lta'i sku thog 'di la yang / thun mong gi gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor/rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung nas srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ sgu dngos dang rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'i skur bzhengs nas/ mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yin/da dung ma 'ongs pa na yang sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa mang po 20

nas/ 'das ma 'ongapo da lta dus gsum du mdo sngags kyi chos kho na gsungs pa yin te/ ye shes rol ba'i rgyud las/ thog ma'i rdo rje 'chang chen ngas/ /bskal pa kun gye sngon rol nas/ /phyi ma'i mu mtha' thug gyur pa/ /de srid bla med gsang ba'i chos rmad byung rgyal po 'gro ba la/ /gsungs so gsung ngo gsung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud gzhan las/ rdzogs ldan dang po bya ba'i rgyud/ /gsum ldan gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ /gnyis ldan gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rtsod ldan bzhi ba bla med do/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /da lta 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa rnams/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang sangs rgyas kyis da lta'i sku thog 'di la yang / thun mong gi gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor/rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung nas srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ sgu dngos dang rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'i skur bzhengs nas/ mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yin/da dung ma 'ongs pa na yang sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa mang po 20

bstan nas 'gro la chos ston pa yin te/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas che/ /sems can yongs su smin pa'i phyir/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung du yang 'dren pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas mang por ston par mdzad/ /gsungs/ dus deng sang yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs kyi skur sprul nas chos gsungs pa yin te/ rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes dang /ba tshwa can gyi chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de'i tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /ces dang / 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gye/ /sangs rgyas mi yi 'jig rten du/ /mi yi lus su yang dag 'byung / /zhes dang /mkha' 'gro ma gur gyi rgyud las/ de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su bzung dmigs nas/ /phal ba'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ re 'ga' zhi la re 'ga' khro/ /re 'ga' bgegs chen gdon mdzad cing / /skye dang ri bo thams cad do/ /zhes dang /21

bstan nas 'gro la chos ston pa yin te/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas che/ /sems can yongs su smin pa'i phyir/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung du yang 'dren pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas mang por ston par mdzad/ /gsungs/ dus deng sang yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs kyi skur sprul nas chos gsungs pa yin te/ rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes dang /ba tshwa can gyi chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de'i tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /ces dang / 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gye/ /sangs rgyas mi yi 'jig rten du/ /mi yi lus su yang dag 'byung / /zhes dang /mkha' 'gro ma gur gyi rgyud las/ de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su bzung dmigs nas/ /phal ba'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ re 'ga' zhi la re 'ga' khro/ /re 'ga' bgegs chen gdon mdzad cing / /skye dang ri bo thams cad do/ /zhes dang /21

gur las/ gang du snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /so sor snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /chang 'tshong ma dang / smad 'tshong mar snang nas kyang sems can gye don mdzad do zhes gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis yul gser ba'i rgyal po ka pi na chen po bya ba/ mthu rtsal chen po dang ldan pa zhig yod pa de 'dul ba'i phyir/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dmag gi tshogs dang bcas pa sprul nas/ zhag bdun tshun chad la 'dir ma slebs na chad pa bcad do/ /gsungs pa skrag nas myur du 'ongs nas phyag 'tshal ba dang /sangs rgyas kyis rdzu 'phrul bsdus te/ sku dngos bstan pas rgyal po de dad par gyur nas/ rab tu byung bar zhus te dge slong du gyur to/ /chos yid la byas pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gsungs/ de bzhin du mdo rgyud kun nas lan cig ma yin par yang dang yang du gsungs so/ /des na yid ches par byas nas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam 'phrul du go nas/ chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin mchod 22

gur las/ gang du snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /so sor snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /chang 'tshong ma dang / smad 'tshong mar snang nas kyang sems can gye don mdzad do zhes gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis yul gser ba'i rgyal po ka pi na chen po bya ba/ mthu rtsal chen po dang ldan pa zhig yod pa de 'dul ba'i phyir/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dmag gi tshogs dang bcas pa sprul nas/ zhag bdun tshun chad la 'dir ma slebs na chad pa bcad do/ /gsungs pa skrag nas myur du 'ongs nas phyag 'tshal ba dang /sangs rgyas kyis rdzu 'phrul bsdus te/ sku dngos bstan pas rgyal po de dad par gyur nas/ rab tu byung bar zhus te dge slong du gyur to/ /chos yid la byas pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gsungs/ de bzhin du mdo rgyud kun nas lan cig ma yin par yang dang yang du gsungs so/ /des na yid ches par byas nas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam 'phrul du go nas/ chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin mchod 22

bstod bkur na/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dus gcig la zhugs nas/ rgyud rang bzhin shugs kyis smin cing grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de yi nang nas kyang rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bdag cag gi ston pa'i rnam 'phrul tsam du ma zad/ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs su blta dgos te/ 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyi lus/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku rdzogs pa/ /'di dag ma lus rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje legs byas brtan pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das la 'jug par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das myur thob/ /khyed kyi dge ba yongs su smin/ /des na rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /lus la rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs/ /nyon cig mthong ba don yod kyi/ /phyi ma'i dus na sems dpa' che/ /dang po'i las can sems can gyis/ /rab tu 'bad de bla ma bsten/ /de tshe mthong ba don yod ces/ /byung chub sems dpa' grags pa che/ /dga' zhing mgu la rab dga' bas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni mchi ma bslangs/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ bla ma ye shes bla ma de/ /bla ma ston pa bla ma mgon/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin las/ /mchog gi gnas ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /tshe 'di yi ni phyag rgya che/ /dngos grub rnyed par the tshom med/ /sa bcu yi 23

bstod bkur na/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dus gcig la zhugs nas/ rgyud rang bzhin shugs kyis smin cing grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de yi nang nas kyang rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bdag cag gi ston pa'i rnam 'phrul tsam du ma zad/ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs su blta dgos te/ 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyi lus/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku rdzogs pa/ /'di dag ma lus rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje legs byas brtan pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das la 'jug par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan mya ngan 'das myur thob/ /khyed kyi dge ba yongs su smin/ /des na rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /lus la rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs/ /nyon cig mthong ba don yod kyi/ /phyi ma'i dus na sems dpa' che/ /dang po'i las can sems can gyis/ /rab tu 'bad de bla ma bsten/ /de tshe mthong ba don yod ces/ /byung chub sems dpa' grags pa che/ /dga' zhing mgu la rab dga' bas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni mchi ma bslangs/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ bla ma ye shes bla ma de/ /bla ma ston pa bla ma mgon/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin las/ /mchog gi gnas ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /tshe 'di yi ni phyag rgya che/ /dngos grub rnyed par the tshom med/ /sa bcu yi 23

ni dbang phyug dag /de yi bka' drin gyes ni be+e/ /de bas bla ma las lhag gzhan/ /ston pa chen po ga la yod/ /bdag gi bla ma'i bstan bcos ni/ /mdzad dam bshad pa gang yin yang / /de ni bstan bcos de tshad ma/ /de ni de nyid 'khrul ba med/ /slob dpon gsungs dang bdag gis smras/ /de la bye brag mi bya'o/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rgyud shes/ /bla mas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos gang / /de la smra dang smra ngan du/ /lha yi dbang phyug brtag mi bya/ /snyan dngags zlos gar bstan bcos la/ /smra dang smra ngan brtag bya yi/ /sngags kyi bstan bcos gtan la phab/ /ci yi phyir na brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bla ma rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor blta zhing / zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos kyang sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang khyad med par blta ba tsam du ma zad/ bla ma'i gsung go sla 'khyer bde tshegs chung don che bas sangs rgyas kyi gsung las lhag cing zab par blta dgos te/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ mdo rgyud kun las bla ma'i man ngag zab/ /man ngag nang nas gnad du dril ba zab/ /de nyid rang gis nyams su len pa zab/ /nyams len nang nas rtse gcig sgrub pa zab/ /gsungs/ bka' gdams gsung bgros thor bu las/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ gzhung bas gdams ngag gtso gsungs/24

ni dbang phyug dag /de yi bka' drin gyes ni be+e/ /de bas bla ma las lhag gzhan/ /ston pa chen po ga la yod/ /bdag gi bla ma'i bstan bcos ni/ /mdzad dam bshad pa gang yin yang / /de ni bstan bcos de tshad ma/ /de ni de nyid 'khrul ba med/ /slob dpon gsungs dang bdag gis smras/ /de la bye brag mi bya'o/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rgyud shes/ /bla mas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos gang / /de la smra dang smra ngan du/ /lha yi dbang phyug brtag mi bya/ /snyan dngags zlos gar bstan bcos la/ /smra dang smra ngan brtag bya yi/ /sngags kyi bstan bcos gtan la phab/ /ci yi phyir na brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bla ma rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor blta zhing / zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos kyang sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang khyad med par blta ba tsam du ma zad/ bla ma'i gsung go sla 'khyer bde tshegs chung don che bas sangs rgyas kyi gsung las lhag cing zab par blta dgos te/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ mdo rgyud kun las bla ma'i man ngag zab/ /man ngag nang nas gnad du dril ba zab/ /de nyid rang gis nyams su len pa zab/ /nyams len nang nas rtse gcig sgrub pa zab/ /gsungs/ bka' gdams gsung bgros thor bu las/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ gzhung bas gdams ngag gtso gsungs/24

de ci ste lags zhus pas/ sde snod gsum kha ton du 'chad shes shing / chos thams cad gye mtshan nyid la mkhas kyang / nyams su len pa'i dus na bla ma'i gdams ngag gi lag len med na chos dang gang zag so sor 'gro gsungs/ sngon rje btsun chen po te lo dang nā ro pas mdo sngags kyi bcud bsdus pa'i man ngag rnams lho brag mar pas blangs/ rje mi las rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i tshul la soms dang ha go yong / bla ma la 'gyur med kyi dad gus mos pa yod na/gang zag de'i rgyud rang bzhin shugs kyis grol bar 'gyur te/sngon paṇa chen nā ro pas rje btsun tai lo pa la dad gus kho na byas pa'i rjes su nyin gcig te lo pas mchil lham phud nas nā ro pa'i smin mtshams su brgyab pas/ nā ro pa sa la 'gyel/brgyal sangs tsa na chos rgyud sde bzhi'i tshig dang don dang bcas pa blo la byung / khyad par gtum mo a thung la sogs nā ro chos drug thugs la shar ba yin zhes mnyam med sgam po pas gsungs/ sgam po pa khong gi rnam thar las/ ra rdzi sgom skyes kyis bsgom sgyes pa dang / rgya sgom rdo rje seng ges zhal ma mthong na yang maṇ+ḍal phul/ mos gus byas pa tsam gyes bsgom byung ba dang / nam sa phen ne la sogs pa mi mang pos zhal mthong ba tsam 25

de ci ste lags zhus pas/ sde snod gsum kha ton du 'chad shes shing / chos thams cad gye mtshan nyid la mkhas kyang / nyams su len pa'i dus na bla ma'i gdams ngag gi lag len med na chos dang gang zag so sor 'gro gsungs/ sngon rje btsun chen po te lo dang nā ro pas mdo sngags kyi bcud bsdus pa'i man ngag rnams lho brag mar pas blangs/ rje mi las rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i tshul la soms dang ha go yong / bla ma la 'gyur med kyi dad gus mos pa yod na/gang zag de'i rgyud rang bzhin shugs kyis grol bar 'gyur te/sngon paṇa chen nā ro pas rje btsun tai lo pa la dad gus kho na byas pa'i rjes su nyin gcig te lo pas mchil lham phud nas nā ro pa'i smin mtshams su brgyab pas/ nā ro pa sa la 'gyel/brgyal sangs tsa na chos rgyud sde bzhi'i tshig dang don dang bcas pa blo la byung / khyad par gtum mo a thung la sogs nā ro chos drug thugs la shar ba yin zhes mnyam med sgam po pas gsungs/ sgam po pa khong gi rnam thar las/ ra rdzi sgom skyes kyis bsgom sgyes pa dang / rgya sgom rdo rje seng ges zhal ma mthong na yang maṇ+ḍal phul/ mos gus byas pa tsam gyes bsgom byung ba dang / nam sa phen ne la sogs pa mi mang pos zhal mthong ba tsam 25

gyis bsgom byung ba dpag tu med do/ /yang nyang ston dang sher sgom gnyis kyis bsgom zhur phyin pas/ sgam por ma slebs par de'i nub ri thang mtshams su nyal bsdad pas/ srod la nyang ston la phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom skyes/ tho rangs sher sgom la rtogs pa skyes/ nangs par bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin te/ snam bu bubs re phyag rten byas nas phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/mdang khyed gnyis kyi don 'grub ang gsungs/ yang 'ol kha'i mdze mo gcig rkang lag chad nas 'gro ba'i nus pa med pas/ bla ma bzhugs pa'i gangs dkar po de la bltas nas mos gus byas pas nad zhi/ ma hā mu tri bsgom skyes drod rang 'bar la song / phyis bla mas snod ldan du gzigs nas bsgom btab pas/be'u chung du btsun ma ngo mtshar can gcig tu gyur nas ban mo lnga brgya tsam gye tshogs dpon byed pa cig byung ngo gsungs/ yang grub thob gling chen ras pas/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru ba la nub cig gi tho rangs khar mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab pa'i mod la/ rtogs pa phyi grol nang grol du song bas/ rje phag mo gru ba'i zhal nas/ chu bo gaṅgā phan la dpal sa ra ha chen po rtogs pa mtho/ de'i tshun la khyod rtogs pa mtho zhes bsngags brjod gnang bar gda'/ rje rmog lcog pa'i zhal nas/ thugs rje chen 26

gyis bsgom byung ba dpag tu med do/ /yang nyang ston dang sher sgom gnyis kyis bsgom zhur phyin pas/ sgam por ma slebs par de'i nub ri thang mtshams su nyal bsdad pas/ srod la nyang ston la phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom skyes/ tho rangs sher sgom la rtogs pa skyes/ nangs par bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin te/ snam bu bubs re phyag rten byas nas phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/mdang khyed gnyis kyi don 'grub ang gsungs/ yang 'ol kha'i mdze mo gcig rkang lag chad nas 'gro ba'i nus pa med pas/ bla ma bzhugs pa'i gangs dkar po de la bltas nas mos gus byas pas nad zhi/ ma hā mu tri bsgom skyes drod rang 'bar la song / phyis bla mas snod ldan du gzigs nas bsgom btab pas/be'u chung du btsun ma ngo mtshar can gcig tu gyur nas ban mo lnga brgya tsam gye tshogs dpon byed pa cig byung ngo gsungs/ yang grub thob gling chen ras pas/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru ba la nub cig gi tho rangs khar mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab pa'i mod la/ rtogs pa phyi grol nang grol du song bas/ rje phag mo gru ba'i zhal nas/ chu bo gaṅgā phan la dpal sa ra ha chen po rtogs pa mtho/ de'i tshun la khyod rtogs pa mtho zhes bsngags brjod gnang bar gda'/ rje rmog lcog pa'i zhal nas/ thugs rje chen 26

po rang dkar na'ang dkar/ rje btsun ma dmar na yang dmar/kye rdo rje sngo na'ang sngo/ nga ni bla ma'i snang ba dang 'bral ma myong /tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas lam de da yong yong 'dra gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus na/ rgan mo bu drug yod pa zhig na re/ nga sangs rgyas de'i zhal cig blta 'dod pa yin te/ ma mthong bar mya ngan las 'das zer/ da bu kun song la sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung cig zhus la shog cig zer/ bu drug po phyin nas zhus pas gdung ma thob ste/ der khong rnams log 'ong ba'i lam kha na khye ro cig 'dug bu gcig na re/sangs rgyas kyi gdung ma rnyed byas na/ a ma yi mug nas 'chi nyen che bas/ khye 'di'i so gcig khyer la sangs rgyas kyi tshems yin zhes rdzun byas pa drag zer bas/ bu gzhan rnams na re/de yang 'thad do zer nas khyi'i so gcig bton nas dar gyis dril te/ sangs rgyas kyi tshems yin zhes a ma la byen pas/ ma de dga' nas de la mchod pa 'bul zhing gsol ba btab pas/dang po khye so las 'od byung / de nas rgan mo nam mkha' la 'phur nus pa byung skad/ de la dgongs nas chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ 'o na rang snang dag gyur na/ /rgan mos khye rus mchod byas pas/ /rgan mo mkha' la 'phur te gshegs/ /gsungs/ des 27

po rang dkar na'ang dkar/ rje btsun ma dmar na yang dmar/kye rdo rje sngo na'ang sngo/ nga ni bla ma'i snang ba dang 'bral ma myong /tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas lam de da yong yong 'dra gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus na/ rgan mo bu drug yod pa zhig na re/ nga sangs rgyas de'i zhal cig blta 'dod pa yin te/ ma mthong bar mya ngan las 'das zer/ da bu kun song la sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung cig zhus la shog cig zer/ bu drug po phyin nas zhus pas gdung ma thob ste/ der khong rnams log 'ong ba'i lam kha na khye ro cig 'dug bu gcig na re/sangs rgyas kyi gdung ma rnyed byas na/ a ma yi mug nas 'chi nyen che bas/ khye 'di'i so gcig khyer la sangs rgyas kyi tshems yin zhes rdzun byas pa drag zer bas/ bu gzhan rnams na re/de yang 'thad do zer nas khyi'i so gcig bton nas dar gyis dril te/ sangs rgyas kyi tshems yin zhes a ma la byen pas/ ma de dga' nas de la mchod pa 'bul zhing gsol ba btab pas/dang po khye so las 'od byung / de nas rgan mo nam mkha' la 'phur nus pa byung skad/ de la dgongs nas chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ 'o na rang snang dag gyur na/ /rgan mos khye rus mchod byas pas/ /rgan mo mkha' la 'phur te gshegs/ /gsungs/ des 27

na bla ma mtshan nyid dang mi ldan yang rang mos gus che na byen rlabs zhugs nas rgyud grol bar 'gyur bas bla ma la mos gus 'di shin tu gal che/ des na legs tshogs rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus kho nas grol bar 'dod pas/ gang zag gis mos gus gong du gtong ba la dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar 'di gal che ste/ rje btsun te lo'i rnam thar las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang tshe gcig lus gcig la ster ba'i nye lam gsang sngags zeg pa'i sgo ru 'jug dgos/ gsang sngags gyi lam zab mo rgyud la skye ba bla ma'i mos gus kho na la rag las/mos gus gsha' ma skye ba la/ bla ma'i yon tan mthong dgos/ de mthong ba la bla ma'i rnam thar dgos/ des na rje btsun te lo pa'i rnam thar rags bsdus shig bshad par bya'o/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir rang gi rjes 'jug slob ma yon bdag rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa'i chos mdzad skye bo pho mo ya rabs dad gus can rnams kyi dad gus dag snang gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i phyir lo rgyus cung zad tsam zhig bshad pa'o/ /smras pa/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi nang nas kyang / /pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i zas gtsang sras/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /byang chung ma thob bar du 28

na bla ma mtshan nyid dang mi ldan yang rang mos gus che na byen rlabs zhugs nas rgyud grol bar 'gyur bas bla ma la mos gus 'di shin tu gal che/ des na legs tshogs rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus kho nas grol bar 'dod pas/ gang zag gis mos gus gong du gtong ba la dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar 'di gal che ste/ rje btsun te lo'i rnam thar las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang tshe gcig lus gcig la ster ba'i nye lam gsang sngags zeg pa'i sgo ru 'jug dgos/ gsang sngags gyi lam zab mo rgyud la skye ba bla ma'i mos gus kho na la rag las/mos gus gsha' ma skye ba la/ bla ma'i yon tan mthong dgos/ de mthong ba la bla ma'i rnam thar dgos/ des na rje btsun te lo pa'i rnam thar rags bsdus shig bshad par bya'o/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir rang gi rjes 'jug slob ma yon bdag rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa'i chos mdzad skye bo pho mo ya rabs dad gus can rnams kyi dad gus dag snang gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i phyir lo rgyus cung zad tsam zhig bshad pa'o/ /smras pa/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi nang nas kyang / /pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i zas gtsang sras/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /byang chung ma thob bar du 28

'gro kun skyongs/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i rnam thar gyi/ /thog mar dge ba ston pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /gang 'dul skur bstan mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la/ /chos 'khor bskor tshul lo rgyus glu ru len/ /yon tan rtsa ba chos dang gang zag la/ /yid ches dad gus dag snang skye ba'i phyir/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab lo rgyus bzang po la/ /skal bzang skye bo pho mo dga' bas nyon/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' dang chu nang zla ba dang / /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang ba mtshar/ /snang stong gnyis med 'khor 'das chos rnams kyang / /don dam chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /dbyings su ro gcig gnas pa de bzhin du/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /chos sgu nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid du/ /dper na chu la chu bzhag nam mkha' la/ /nam mkha' 'dres bzhin dbyer med ro gcig tu/ /'dres pa'i ngang las nam yang ma g.yos bzhin/ /gang 'dul gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar/ /gang 'tsham chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yongs kyi don mdzad gsungs/ /khyad par bdag cag ston pa thugs rje can/ /thun mong ma yin gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /dpag med 29

'gro kun skyongs/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i rnam thar gyi/ /thog mar dge ba ston pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /gang 'dul skur bstan mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la/ /chos 'khor bskor tshul lo rgyus glu ru len/ /yon tan rtsa ba chos dang gang zag la/ /yid ches dad gus dag snang skye ba'i phyir/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab lo rgyus bzang po la/ /skal bzang skye bo pho mo dga' bas nyon/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' dang chu nang zla ba dang / /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang ba mtshar/ /snang stong gnyis med 'khor 'das chos rnams kyang / /don dam chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /dbyings su ro gcig gnas pa de bzhin du/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /chos sgu nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid du/ /dper na chu la chu bzhag nam mkha' la/ /nam mkha' 'dres bzhin dbyer med ro gcig tu/ /'dres pa'i ngang las nam yang ma g.yos bzhin/ /gang 'dul gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar/ /gang 'tsham chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yongs kyi don mdzad gsungs/ /khyad par bdag cag ston pa thugs rje can/ /thun mong ma yin gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /dpag med 29

bskal pa'i sngon nas sangs rgyas te/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang thub dbang sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rgya bod mkhas grub dang / /bla ma la sogs gang 'dul sku ru sprul/ /'gro don mdzad ces mdo rgyud bstan bcos nas/ /lan cig ma yin yang yang gsungs tshul rnams/ /bsams nas chos dang gang zag thams cad la/ /dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin mchod bstod bkur/ /de ltar byas na lung rtogs yon tan rnams/ /'bad dang rtsol ba chen po mi dgos par/ /rgyad la skyes nas tshe gcig 111 char byeX/ /shā 111 rtsarasangs rgyas 'gyur/ / ga mar dag ba rgyus bzang 'ad/ /mthong thos dran reg rgyud la phan thogs nas/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /30

bskal pa'i sngon nas sangs rgyas te/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang thub dbang sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rgya bod mkhas grub dang / /bla ma la sogs gang 'dul sku ru sprul/ /'gro don mdzad ces mdo rgyud bstan bcos nas/ /lan cig ma yin yang yang gsungs tshul rnams/ /bsams nas chos dang gang zag thams cad la/ /dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin mchod bstod bkur/ /de ltar byas na lung rtogs yon tan rnams/ /'bad dang rtsol ba chen po mi dgos par/ /rgyud la skyes nas tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /thog mar dge ba'i lo rgyus bzang po 'di/ /mthong thos dran reg rgyud la phan thogs nas/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / 30

chos ldan gyi bya ba byas tshul gyi rnam thar/bar du dge ba sku tshe smad la chos ldan gyi bya ba byas tshul gye rnam thar bzang po ni/ de yang sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar ba rang lo lnga bcu nga bdun thog me bya'i lo'i zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga'i snga dro nyi ma rtse shar gyi dus/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil ba'i ri rtse bde ba can gyi lha khang gi phyi rol na/ khams sangs byas bsdad yod dus rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs bod yul gangs can ljongs 'di'i lho phyogs kyi ri bo rnams kyi rtse mo na sprin dkar po zho gsar spungs 'dra yar langs pa mthong bas rkyen byas/ sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na bdag cag gi ston pa 'khor bcas dang /gzhan mkhas grub mang po byang chub shing drung sogs nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i nags khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal gyi sngo ljang ljon shing gi bsil grib tu 'khod nas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya phyes tshul dang / lha mis gtso byas 'gro ba yongs la zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul rnams yid la shar nas/31

chos ldan gyi bya ba byas tshul gyi rnam thar/bar du dge ba sku tshe smad la chos ldan gyi bya ba byas tshul gye rnam thar bzang po ni/ de yang sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar ba rang lo lnga bcu nga bdun thog me bya'i lo'i zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga'i snga dro nyi ma rtse shar gyi dus/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i gnas chen bkra shis 'khyil ba'i ri rtse bde ba can gyi lha khang gi phyi rol na/ khams sangs byas bsdad yod dus rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs bod yul gangs can ljongs 'di'i lho phyogs kyi ri bo rnams kyi rtse mo na sprin dkar po zho gsar spungs 'dra yar langs pa mthong bas rkyen byas/ sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na bdag cag gi ston pa 'khor bcas dang /gzhan mkhas grub mang po byang chub shing drung sogs nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i nags khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal gyi sngo ljang ljon shing gi bsil grib tu 'khod nas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya phyes tshul dang / lha mis gtso byas 'gro ba yongs la zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul rnams yid la shar nas/31

sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi mgur dbyangs 'og min zhing du bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di nyid blangs so//sa rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi phyogs/ /bod gangs can ri rnams mkha' la bsnyegs/ /ri re re'i rtse na sprin dkar langs/ /de mthong bas rgya gar 'phags yul dran/ /sprin dkar po lding ba'i lho phyogs na/ /yul rgya gar rdo rje gdan dbus na/ /shing byang chub ljon pa'i bsil grib na/ /sngon sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga rgya gar yul la 'gro snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dran/ /gzhan mkhas grub mang bo dran nas byung / /lha'i dbang po tshangs pa brgya byin gyes/ /chos gsung dgos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /'khor lha mis gtso byas 'gro kun la/ /sngon chos 'khor bskor tshul yid la shar/ /dus da lta bskor na dga' ba la/ /nga zhabs tog med rung zhu snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dran/ /gzhan mkhas grub mang po dran nas byung / /de'i rjes su rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ /khong mkhas grub mang po byon tshul dang / /bod chos rgyal ring la lo tsā bas/ /sngon bka' bstan bsgyur tshul yid la shar/ /dus da lta bsgyur na dga' ba la/ /ngas lo tsā zhig kyang slob snying 32

sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi mgur dbyangs 'og min zhing du bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di nyid blangs so//sa rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi phyogs/ /bod gangs can ri rnams mkha' la bsnyegs/ /ri re re'i rtse na sprin dkar langs/ /de mthong bas rgya gar 'phags yul dran/ /sprin dkar po lding ba'i lho phyogs na/ /yul rgya gar rdo rje gdan dbus na/ /shing byang chub ljon pa'i bsil grib na/ /sngon sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga rgya gar yul la 'gro snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dran/ /gzhan mkhas grub mang bo dran nas byung / /lha'i dbang po tshangs pa brgya byin gyes/ /chos gsung dgos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /'khor lha mis gtso byas 'gro kun la/ /sngon chos 'khor bskor tshul yid la shar/ /dus da lta bskor na dga' ba la/ /nga zhabs tog med rung zhu snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dran/ /gzhan mkhas grub mang po dran nas byung / /de'i rjes su rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ /khong mkhas grub mang po byon tshul dang / /bod chos rgyal ring la lo tsā bas/ /sngon bka' bstan bsgyur tshul yid la shar/ /dus da lta bsgyur na dga' ba la/ /ngas lo tsā zhig kyang slob snying 32

'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dran/ /gzhan mkhas grub mang po dran nas byung / /sngon chos rgyal lo paṇa bka' drin gyis/ /mgon thub bstan nyi ma bod la shar/ /da dus kyi dbang gis nub la nye/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /sngon byon pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /thugs mthun zhing gcig gis gcig la bstod/ /dus deng sang phal cher mi mthun sgod/ /kun thugs mthun yong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon bod la bstan pa dar dus su/ /chos phyogs ris byed mkhan med na yang / /dus deng sang phyogs ris byed mkhan mang / /chos phyogs ris med par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon rgya gar nyan thos sde ba bzhin/ /bod 'dir yang grub mtha' mang na yang / /dus deng sang phal cher nyams kyin gda'/ /kun dar zhing rgyas par byen gyis rlobs/ /rje 'gro mgon sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dang / /gzhan mkhas grub mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rang 'chi dus mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /yar 'og min gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /mgon thub bstan dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /de 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin thugs mthun zhing / /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /ces blangs nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan yid 33

'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dran/ /gzhan mkhas grub mang po dran nas byung / /sngon chos rgyal lo paṇa bka' drin gyis/ /mgon thub bstan nyi ma bod la shar/ /da dus kyi dbang gis nub la nye/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /sngon byon pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /thugs mthun zhing gcig gis gcig la bstod/ /dus deng sang phal cher mi mthun sgod/ /kun thugs mthun yong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon bod la bstan pa dar dus su/ /chos phyogs ris byed mkhan med na yang / /dus deng sang phyogs ris byed mkhan mang / /chos phyogs ris med par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon rgya gar nyan thos sde ba bzhin/ /bod 'dir yang grub mtha' mang na yang / /dus deng sang phal cher nyams kyin gda'/ /kun dar zhing rgyas par byen gyis rlobs/ /rje 'gro mgon sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dang / /gzhan mkhas grub mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rang 'chi dus mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /yar 'og min gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /mgon thub bstan dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /de 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin thugs mthun zhing / /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /ces blangs nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan yid 33

la bkod de mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ skabs shig rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung dang / jo bo byang chub chen po sogs la sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin du mjal ba'i nyams snang bzang po shar ba byung tshe sems rab tu dga' zhing spro ba byung / yang nyin gcig dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i nye gnas blo bzang shes rab dang / dge slong blo gros sogs dad can gye slob ma mang pos/ phan bde legs tshogs yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul 'di shin tu gal che bar 'dug pas/ bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/rje kun la phan pa'i nyi ma mchog /dgos 'dod stsol ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /chos kyi sgra 'byen lha yi rnga/ /ngan song 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dpon/ /thar ba'i lam ston sa mkhan mchog /nyon mongs nad sel sman gyi bla/ /ngo mtshar skyes mchog rin po che/ /brtse ba chen po'i thugs kyis dgongs/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams su/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor btsal gyur kyang / /khyed dang mtshungs pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /nam yang rnyed par dka' bar go /rnyed dka' don che yid bzhin gyi/ /nor las lhag pa'i 34

la bkod de mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ skabs shig rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung dang / jo bo byang chub chen po sogs la sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin du mjal ba'i nyams snang bzang po shar ba byung tshe sems rab tu dga' zhing spro ba byung / yang nyin gcig dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i nye gnas blo bzang shes rab dang / dge slong blo gros sogs dad can gye slob ma mang pos/ phan bde legs tshogs yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul 'di shin tu gal che bar 'dug pas/ bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/rje kun la phan pa'i nyi ma mchog /dgos 'dod stsol ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /chos kyi sgra 'byen lha yi rnga/ /ngan song 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dpon/ /thar ba'i lam ston sa mkhan mchog /nyon mongs nad sel sman gyi bla/ /ngo mtshar skyes mchog rin po che/ /brtse ba chen po'i thugs kyis dgongs/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams su/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor btsal gyur kyang / /khyed dang mtshungs pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /nam yang rnyed par dka' bar go /rnyed dka' don che yid bzhin gyi/ /nor las lhag pa'i 34

mgon khyod dang / /mjal ba skal ba bzang ngo snyam/ /bsam zhing dad pa gting nas skyes/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas/ /bla ma bsten tshul gal che gsungs/ /de phyir bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgos/ /tshul bzhin bsten tshul zhal gdams zhu/ /tshig nyung don gsal mdor bsdus shig /rab tu brtse bas gsung du gsol/ /mnyam med jo bo yab sras bzhin/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam pas bsten tshul ni/ nga'i bla ma 'di sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i dad pa dang / rang la gang 'dod kyi mdo sngags zab rgya'i chos gnang ba'i bka' drin re che snyam pa'i gus pa khyad par can bya/ sbyor bas bsten tshul ni/ bla ma la zang zing gi nor 'bul ba/ lus ngag gi zhabs tog byed pa/bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa gsum gyi sgo nas mnyes par bya dgos te/ rje rin po che'i nyams mgur las/ de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yi/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru/ /mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi btang bar/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar 35

mgon khyod dang / /mjal ba skal ba bzang ngo snyam/ /bsam zhing dad pa gting nas skyes/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas/ /bla ma bsten tshul gal che gsungs/ /de phyir bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgos/ /tshul bzhin bsten tshul zhal gdams zhu/ /tshig nyung don gsal mdor bsdus shig /rab tu brtse bas gsung du gsol/ /mnyam med jo bo yab sras bzhin/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam pas bsten tshul ni/ nga'i bla ma 'di sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i dad pa dang / rang la gang 'dod kyi mdo sngags zab rgya'i chos gnang ba'i bka' drin re che snyam pa'i gus pa khyad par can bya/ sbyor bas bsten tshul ni/ bla ma la zang zing gi nor 'bul ba/ lus ngag gi zhabs tog byed pa/bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa gsum gyi sgo nas mnyes par bya dgos te/ rje rin po che'i nyams mgur las/ de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yi/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru/ /mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi btang bar/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar 35

mdzad/ /thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin bskyangs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsten pa'i phan yon ni/ thal 'gyur las/ston pa de las yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yin/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa thob/ /ces dang / rdo rje ro langs kyi rgyud las/ gang gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /bza' btung phud kyis rtag tu mchod/ /'dir yang bza' btung 'phel ba dang / /'khor los sgyur rgyal 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/rang gi rdzas dang yo byad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes pa sus byas pa//'dis ni khams gsum 'khor ba las/ /sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sar gshegs so/ /zhes dang / dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ bka' zur ma bcag chos bsrung na/ /chos skyong srung ma mthu chen rnams/ /bu bzhin rtag tu bsrung bar byed/ /ces dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod la yang dag rtsoms/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog de thob par 'gyur/ /zhesadang / spyan snga bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum mchod pa bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod bsod nams che/ /des na mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla 36

mdzad/ /thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin bskyangs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsten pa'i phan yon ni/ thal 'gyur las/ston pa de las yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yin/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa thob/ /ces dang / rdo rje ro langs kyi rgyud las/ gang gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /bza' btung phud kyis rtag tu mchod/ /'dir yang bza' btung 'phel ba dang / /'khor los sgyur rgyal 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/rang gi rdzas dang yo byad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes pa sus byas pa//'dis ni khams gsum 'khor ba las/ /sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sar gshegs so/ /zhes dang / dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ bka' zur ma bcag chos bsrung na/ /chos skyong srung ma mthu chen rnams/ /bu bzhin rtag tu bsrung bar byed/ /ces dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod la yang dag rtsoms/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog de thob par 'gyur/ /zhesadang / spyan snga bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum mchod pa bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod bsod nams che/ /des na mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla 36
