mar bsnyen bkur gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs tshul rnams bsams nas/ dga' zhing spro ba'i sgo nas bsten par bya'o zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/phan bde legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam pa dang / /sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten par byen gyes rlobs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad snyigs dus 'dir/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzung nas/ /'gro don mdzad ces mdo rgyud rnams las gsungs/ /de phyir rang la bka' chos gnang ba yi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la sangs rgyas kyi/ /'du shes bzhag nas dad pa byed pa gces/ /bla mas rang la bka' chos gang 'dod rnams/ /gnang ba'i bka' drin dus gsum sangs rgyas las/ /lhag par bsams nas rab tu gus par bya/ /bka' drin cha shas tsam re 'khor ba'i phyir/ /rang la gang yod zang zing nor 'bul zhing / /lus ngag zhabs tog bka' bzhin sgrub pas mchod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa las/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod bsod nams che/ /bskyed rim bskal pa'i bar du bsgom pa las/ /bla ma 37

mar bsnyen bkur gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs tshul rnams bsams nas/ dga' zhing spro ba'i sgo nas bsten par bya'o zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/phan bde legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam pa dang / /sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten par byen gyes rlobs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad snyigs dus 'dir/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzung nas/ /'gro don mdzad ces mdo rgyud rnams las gsungs/ /de phyir rang la bka' chos gnang ba yi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la sangs rgyas kyi/ /'du shes bzhag nas dad pa byed pa gces/ /bla mas rang la bka' chos gang 'dod rnams/ /gnang ba'i bka' drin dus gsum sangs rgyas las/ /lhag par bsams nas rab tu gus par bya/ /bka' drin cha shas tsam re 'khor ba'i phyir/ /rang la gang yod zang zing nor 'bul zhing / /lus ngag zhabs tog bka' bzhin sgrub pas mchod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa las/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod bsod nams che/ /bskyed rim bskal pa'i bar du bsgom pa las/ /bla ma 37

dran pa bsod nams 'bum phrag lhag /bsnyen bsgrub bzlas pa sa ya byas pa las/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan cig byas pa dga'/ /yi dam lha brgya'i zhal ras mjal ba las/ /bla ma yud tsam mjal ba bsod nams che/ /rtag tu ngu dang nā ro mi la rje/ /'brom ston la sogs gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /bla ma bsam dang sbyor bas bsten nus na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma tshul bzhin du/ /bsten nas zab dang rgya che mdo sngags kyi/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa'i mthus/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces smras pas/ kun dga' zhing spro bzhin bka' drin che zhes tshig gi gtang rag phul nas/ phyag dang skor ba byas te rang rang gi gnas su song ngo / /yang de dus dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi slob ma grwa btsun 'ga' re slebs nas/ dbus gtsang gi gtam snyan bshad tshe yid spro ba'i shugs kyis nyams mgur khu byug kha yi rnar snyan zhes bya ba 'di blangs so/ /dpag bsam ljon shing gi steng du/ /rgya gar rma bya rnams slebs nas/ /gdugs bskor chos phyogs la bsgyur pas/ /nyams dga' snang ba rang spro byung / /tsan dan ljon shing gi thog 38

dran pa bsod nams 'bum phrag lhag /bsnyen bsgrub bzlas pa sa ya byas pa las/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan cig byas pa dga'/ /yi dam lha brgya'i zhal ras mjal ba las/ /bla ma yud tsam mjal ba bsod nams che/ /rtag tu ngu dang nā ro mi la rje/ /'brom ston la sogs gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /bla ma bsam dang sbyor bas bsten nus na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma tshul bzhin du/ /bsten nas zab dang rgya che mdo sngags kyi/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa'i mthus/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces smras pas/ kun dga' zhing spro bzhin bka' drin che zhes tshig gi gtang rag phul nas/ phyag dang skor ba byas te rang rang gi gnas su song ngo / /yang de dus dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi slob ma grwa btsun 'ga' re slebs nas/ dbus gtsang gi gtam snyan bshad tshe yid spro ba'i shugs kyis nyams mgur khu byug kha yi rnar snyan zhes bya ba 'di blangs so/ /dpag bsam ljon shing gi steng du/ /rgya gar rma bya rnams slebs nas/ /gdugs bskor chos phyogs la bsgyur pas/ /nyams dga' snang ba rang spro byung / /tsan dan ljon shing gi thog 38

tu/ /lho mon khu byug rnams slebs nas/ /skad snyan lhang lhang du grags pas/ /rnar snyan yid la rang babs byung / /reb gong gser mo yi ljongs 'dir/ /dbus gtsang slob ma rnams slebs nas/ /gtam snyan sna tshogs shig bshad pas/ /yid la dga' bde rang shar byung / /bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes/ /'dir gnas dpon slob kyi tshogs rnams/ /ma shi tshe ring 'dra byung na/ /dbus gtsang dag zhing du chas 'gro/ /slebs nas dam chos kyi dga' ston/ /skal bzang slob ma la 'gyed cing / /nyams dga'i glu dbyangs rang len pa'i/ /smon lam yang yang du 'debs so/ /zhes blangs pas kun dga' zhing spro ba byung / de dus bla ma la gus shing sems can la snying rje che ba'i kha rgya'i shākya bzang po dang / bya bral 'gyur med sogs skal bzang gi slob ma mang pos tshe blos gtong tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu yig tshigs bcad kyi dbyangs chung 'di phul lo/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin yongs kyi rgyan/ /'gro kun 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ /dpal ldan bla ma brtse bas dgongs/ /dper na rma chu rgyas pa'i ma rtsi shing nags tshal khyer nas 'ong / /phyogs phyogs kun tu 'phangs tsa na/ /mi rnams 'ongs nas gang 'dod len/ /rma chu gang la mi 39

tu/ /lho mon khu byug rnams slebs nas/ /skad snyan lhang lhang du grags pas/ /rnar snyan yid la rang babs byung / /reb gong gser mo yi ljongs 'dir/ /dbus gtsang slob ma rnams slebs nas/ /gtam snyan sna tshogs shig bshad pas/ /yid la dga' bde rang shar byung / /bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes/ /'dir gnas dpon slob kyi tshogs rnams/ /ma shi tshe ring 'dra byung na/ /dbus gtsang dag zhing du chas 'gro/ /slebs nas dam chos kyi dga' ston/ /skal bzang slob ma la 'gyed cing / /nyams dga'i glu dbyangs rang len pa'i/ /smon lam yang yang du 'debs so/ /zhes blangs pas kun dga' zhing spro ba byung / de dus bla ma la gus shing sems can la snying rje che ba'i kha rgya'i shākya bzang po dang / bya bral 'gyur med sogs skal bzang gi slob ma mang pos tshe blos gtong tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu yig tshigs bcad kyi dbyangs chung 'di phul lo/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin yongs kyi rgyan/ /'gro kun 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ /dpal ldan bla ma brtse bas dgongs/ /dper na rma chu rgyas pa'i ma rtsi shing nags tshal khyer nas 'ong / /phyogs phyogs kun tu 'phangs tsa na/ /mi rnams 'ongs nas gang 'dod len/ /rma chu gang la mi 39

chags par/ /rgyal khams nyul nas 'gro ba bzhin/ /mgon khyed chos bzhin mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gyis zas nor khyer nas 'ong / /phyogs phyogs sbyin par btang tsa na/ /mi rnams 'ongs nas gang 'dod len/ /mgon khyod gang la mi chags par/ /rgyal khams 'grim bzhin phebs pa mtshar/ /dper na sgyu ma mkhan po yis/ /sgyu ma'i snang ba gang la yang / /rang bzhin med par shes bzhin du/ /sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags la brten nas/ /sgyu ma'i rta dang glang chen sogs/ /sgyu ma'i rtsed mo sna tshogs pa/ /sprul nas de dag gang la yang / /chags pa med par 'gro ba ltar/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog khyod nyid kyis/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba gang la yang / /rang bzhin med par shes bzhin du/ /tshe 'di'i zas nor la brten nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten la sogs/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i 'jog pa byas/ /de dag gang la mi chags par/ /gang 'dod gnas su 'gro ba mtshar/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa'i/ /bya btang rgyal po khyed kyis ni/ /bdag cag rnams la tshe 'di blos/ /gtong tshul gdams pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ tshe 'di nyid la mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang gang yin yang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir mtshan ldan gyi bla 40

chags par/ /rgyal khams nyul nas 'gro ba bzhin/ /mgon khyed chos bzhin mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gyis zas nor khyer nas 'ong / /phyogs phyogs sbyin par btang tsa na/ /mi rnams 'ongs nas gang 'dod len/ /mgon khyod gang la mi chags par/ /rgyal khams 'grim bzhin phebs pa mtshar/ /dper na sgyu ma mkhan po yis/ /sgyu ma'i snang ba gang la yang / /rang bzhin med par shes bzhin du/ /sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags la brten nas/ /sgyu ma'i rta dang glang chen sogs/ /sgyu ma'i rtsed mo sna tshogs pa/ /sprul nas de dag gang la yang / /chags pa med par 'gro ba ltar/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog khyod nyid kyis/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba gang la yang / /rang bzhin med par shes bzhin du/ /tshe 'di'i zas nor la brten nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten la sogs/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i 'jog pa byas/ /de dag gang la mi chags par/ /gang 'dod gnas su 'gro ba mtshar/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa'i/ /bya btang rgyal po khyed kyis ni/ /bdag cag rnams la tshe 'di blos/ /gtong tshul gdams pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ tshe 'di nyid la mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang gang yin yang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir mtshan ldan gyi bla 40

ma bsten nas/ dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa la thog mar tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos gtong dgos te/rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ chos kyi nyams len sna gcig ma grub par/ /khyod nyid chos par rlom pa kye ma blun/ /chos kyi dang bo tshe 'di blos gtong ba/ /rang gi rgyud la 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /zhes dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs che thabs ma shor bar/ /gtan gyi phan bde thar par re ba de/ /rmongs pa'i zhe 'dod gzu lum nyid yin pas/ /tshe 'di blos thongs 'bad pas byang chub sgrubs/ /gsungs/ 'o na tshe 'di bya ba blos gtong dgos na/ gang dang gang blos gtong dgos snyam na/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyis/ pha yul dang / nye du dang / 'khor g.yog dang / lung 'khrid sogs gzhan don ltar snang dang / yo byad kyi sog rum dang / bza' btung gi zhen pa dang / longs spyod 'bad med du byung ba dang / mthun 'jug ngo srung dang / tshe 'di'i bsod nams 'du long dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad rnams blos gtong dgos par gsungs/ de rnams blos gtong ba'i gdams pa la/ chos rje rgya ras pa'i drag sngags gsum ni/ci yong ba shog gang ltar 'gro ba song / cis kyang dgos pa med ces bya ba gsum mo/ /chags med zhen med 'dzin med 41

ma bsten nas/ dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa la thog mar tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos gtong dgos te/rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ chos kyi nyams len sna gcig ma grub par/ /khyod nyid chos par rlom pa kye ma blun/ /chos kyi dang bo tshe 'di blos gtong ba/ /rang gi rgyud la 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /zhes dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs che thabs ma shor bar/ /gtan gyi phan bde thar par re ba de/ /rmongs pa'i zhe 'dod gzu lum nyid yin pas/ /tshe 'di blos thongs 'bad pas byang chub sgrubs/ /gsungs/ 'o na tshe 'di bya ba blos gtong dgos na/ gang dang gang blos gtong dgos snyam na/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyis/ pha yul dang / nye du dang / 'khor g.yog dang / lung 'khrid sogs gzhan don ltar snang dang / yo byad kyi sog rum dang / bza' btung gi zhen pa dang / longs spyod 'bad med du byung ba dang / mthun 'jug ngo srung dang / tshe 'di'i bsod nams 'du long dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad rnams blos gtong dgos par gsungs/ de rnams blos gtong ba'i gdams pa la/ chos rje rgya ras pa'i drag sngags gsum ni/ci yong ba shog gang ltar 'gro ba song / cis kyang dgos pa med ces bya ba gsum mo/ /chags med zhen med 'dzin med 41

gsum gyi ngang nas drag sngags gsum gyi nyams len la 'bad na/ tshe 'di blo yis thongs par 'gyur gsungs/ dam pa gong ma'i phugs nor bcu'i gtad pa bzhi ni/ blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang phugs shi la gtad/ shi phugs brag la gtad pa la zer/ bud bsnyegs thob gsum ni/mi gral nas bud/ khye gral bsnyegs/ lha gral thob pa la zer rdo rje gsum ni/ thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / khrel med rdo rje rjes la bzhag ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs la zer/ de bcu la phugs nor bcu yi tha snyad btags par gda'/ 'di bcu yid la bzhag pa tsam gyis/ 'jig rten gyi 'khrul ba 'joms/chags zhen gyi rgya mtsho bskams/ chos brgyad kyi ri bo bsnyil/nyon mongs kyi rdzong 'gyel/ las ngan gyi gru 'jig gnyen po'i thang bde ba la slebs pas phugs nor gyi mchog rang du snang gsungs pa rnams slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/mnyam med jo bo yab sras dang / /bla ma gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas//lha chos nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong tshul gyi/ /gdams pa zab mo bshad par bya/ /skal ldan snying gi slob ma rnams/ /rab tu gus pa'i yid kyis nyon/ /ci zhig yong ba shog dang gcig /gang ltar 42

gsum gyi ngang nas drag sngags gsum gyi nyams len la 'bad na/ tshe 'di blo yis thongs par 'gyur gsungs/ dam pa gong ma'i phugs nor bcu'i gtad pa bzhi ni/ blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang phugs shi la gtad/ shi phugs brag la gtad pa la zer/ bud bsnyegs thob gsum ni/mi gral nas bud/ khye gral bsnyegs/ lha gral thob pa la zer rdo rje gsum ni/ thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / khrel med rdo rje rjes la bzhag ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs la zer/ de bcu la phugs nor bcu yi tha snyad btags par gda'/ 'di bcu yid la bzhag pa tsam gyis/ 'jig rten gyi 'khrul ba 'joms/chags zhen gyi rgya mtsho bskams/ chos brgyad kyi ri bo bsnyil/nyon mongs kyi rdzong 'gyel/ las ngan gyi gru 'jig gnyen po'i thang bde ba la slebs pas phugs nor gyi mchog rang du snang gsungs pa rnams slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/mnyam med jo bo yab sras dang / /bla ma gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas//lha chos nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong tshul gyi/ /gdams pa zab mo bshad par bya/ /skal ldan snying gi slob ma rnams/ /rab tu gus pa'i yid kyis nyon/ /ci zhig yong ba shog dang gcig /gang ltar 42

'gro ba song dang gnyis/ /cis kyang dgos pa med dang gsum/ /rgya ras drag sngags gsum du grags/ /chags med zhen med 'dzin med kyi/ /ngang nas drag sngags nyams len la/ /'bad na tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /blo phugs chos la gtad dang gcig /chos phugs sprang la gtad dang gnyis/ /sprang phugs shi la gtad dang gsum/ /shi phugs brag la gtad dang bzhi/ /gtad pa bzhi zhes zer ba yin/ /mi yi gral nas bud dang gcig /khye yi gral du bsnyegs dang gnyis/ /lha yi gral de thob dang gsum/ /bud bsnyegs thob gsum bya ba lags/ /thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / /khrel med rdo rje rjes la bzhag /ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ /rdo rje gsum zhes bshad pa yin/ /de rnams phyogs gcig sdom pa la/ /phugs nor bcu yi tha snyad btags/ /'di bcu yid la bzhag tsam gyes/ /'khrul ba kun 'joms chags zhen gyi/ /mtsho bskams chos brgyad ri bo bsnyil/ /nyon mongs rdzong 'gyel las ngan gyi/ /gru 'jig gnyen po'i thang bde la/ /slebs pa'i phugs nor mchog tu snang / /bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs dang / /'dis mtshon rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /kun gyis tshe 'di blos thongs nas/ /lha chos byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces smras pas/ chos pa rab kyis zhag gi mi 'dzin/ /'bring gis 43

'gro ba song dang gnyis/ /cis kyang dgos pa med dang gsum/ /rgya ras drag sngags gsum du grags/ /chags med zhen med 'dzin med kyi/ /ngang nas drag sngags nyams len la/ /'bad na tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /blo phugs chos la gtad dang gcig /chos phugs sprang la gtad dang gnyis/ /sprang phugs shi la gtad dang gsum/ /shi phugs brag la gtad dang bzhi/ /gtad pa bzhi zhes zer ba yin/ /mi yi gral nas bud dang gcig /khye yi gral du bsnyegs dang gnyis/ /lha yi gral de thob dang gsum/ /bud bsnyegs thob gsum bya ba lags/ /thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / /khrel med rdo rje rjes la bzhag /ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ /rdo rje gsum zhes bshad pa yin/ /de rnams phyogs gcig sdom pa la/ /phugs nor bcu yi tha snyad btags/ /'di bcu yid la bzhag tsam gyes/ /'khrul ba kun 'joms chags zhen gyi/ /mtsho bskams chos brgyad ri bo bsnyil/ /nyon mongs rdzong 'gyel las ngan gyi/ /gru 'jig gnyen po'i thang bde la/ /slebs pa'i phugs nor mchog tu snang / /bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs dang / /'dis mtshon rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /kun gyis tshe 'di blos thongs nas/ /lha chos byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces smras pas/ chos pa rab kyis zhag gi mi 'dzin/ /'bring gis 43

zla bar mi 'dzin/ /tha mas lor mi 'dzin pa'i tshe blos btang gi chos pa mang po byung ngo / /yang nyin cig tshe 'di'i snang shas dor nas phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i dkar rtse gdong gi rgya mtsho dang 'jigs med sogs skal ldan slob ma mang pos/ 'jig rten chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum blos gtong tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /mgon khyod chos kyi thog ma ru/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi/ /bya ba thams cad blo yis btang / /mtshan ldan bla ma tshul bzhin bsten/ /mdo sngags chos la thos bsam byas/ /dben par bsgom pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa mtshar/ /deng sang bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /chos par rlom pa phal cher gyis/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /blo yis gtong ba phar la zhog /de dag gang red dris tsa na/ /bshad kyang shes mkhan dkon par gda'/ /'di phyi'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ /khyed kyi rjes 'jug slob ma dang / /ma 'ongs gdul byar phan pa'i phyir/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /so sor ma 'dres gsal bo zhig /brtse ba chen pos gsung du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/44

zla bar mi 'dzin/ /tha mas lor mi 'dzin pa'i tshe blos btang gi chos pa mang po byung ngo / /yang nyin cig tshe 'di'i snang shas dor nas phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i dkar rtse gdong gi rgya mtsho dang 'jigs med sogs skal ldan slob ma mang pos/ 'jig rten chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum blos gtong tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /mgon khyod chos kyi thog ma ru/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi/ /bya ba thams cad blo yis btang / /mtshan ldan bla ma tshul bzhin bsten/ /mdo sngags chos la thos bsam byas/ /dben par bsgom pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa mtshar/ /deng sang bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /chos par rlom pa phal cher gyis/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /blo yis gtong ba phar la zhog /de dag gang red dris tsa na/ /bshad kyang shes mkhan dkon par gda'/ /'di phyi'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ /khyed kyi rjes 'jug slob ma dang / /ma 'ongs gdul byar phan pa'i phyir/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /so sor ma 'dres gsal bo zhig /brtse ba chen pos gsung du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/44

'o 'jig rten chos brgyad gang la zer na/ rnyed ma rnyed/ bde mi bde/ snyan mi snyan/ bstod dang smad pa 'di brgyad la zer te/slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang mi bde snyan dang mi snyan dang / /bstod smad ces bgyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /bdag gi yid yul min pas mgo snyoms mdzod/ /ces dang / rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/'jig rten chos brgyad don du gnyer/ /bstod dang smad dang grags mi grags/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde dang sdug /de rnams la ni dga' mi dga'i/ /rnam par rtog pa yod ring la/ /chos pa yin snyam ma sems shig /sngar byas phyir byed da lta'i lam/ /chos brgyad kun slong yod dam med/ /rang gis rang la dri bar gyis/ /zhes dang / dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ grags dang ma grags rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin bstod smad dang / /sems kyis 'jig rten chos rnams rab bcom ste/ /sdig pa'i gnas su gyur pa spang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar spong ba gal che/ yang chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gang la zer na/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos/ chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gdon chen po/ /snying la zhugs pas sdug bsngal bde ba ru/ /bzung nas gtan gyi mdun ma rlung la 45

'o 'jig rten chos brgyad gang la zer na/ rnyed ma rnyed/ bde mi bde/ snyan mi snyan/ bstod dang smad pa 'di brgyad la zer te/slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang mi bde snyan dang mi snyan dang / /bstod smad ces bgyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /bdag gi yid yul min pas mgo snyoms mdzod/ /ces dang / rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/'jig rten chos brgyad don du gnyer/ /bstod dang smad dang grags mi grags/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde dang sdug /de rnams la ni dga' mi dga'i/ /rnam par rtog pa yod ring la/ /chos pa yin snyam ma sems shig /sngar byas phyir byed da lta'i lam/ /chos brgyad kun slong yod dam med/ /rang gis rang la dri bar gyis/ /zhes dang / dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ grags dang ma grags rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin bstod smad dang / /sems kyis 'jig rten chos rnams rab bcom ste/ /sdig pa'i gnas su gyur pa spang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar spong ba gal che/ yang chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gang la zer na/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos/ chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gdon chen po/ /snying la zhugs pas sdug bsngal bde ba ru/ /bzung nas gtan gyi mdun ma rlung la 45

bskur/ /zhes gsungs/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis rang gi 'dod phyogs rnyed pa dang / bde ba dang / snyan pa dang / bstod pa bzhi bo bsgrub phyir dang / rang gomi 'dod pa'i phyogs ma rnyed pa dang / mi bde ba dang / mi snyan pa dang / smad pa bzhi bo spong ba'i phyir/ chos 'chad/ dbang bskur/ lha bsgom sngags bzla/ mchod sbyin gtong ba sogs byas na chos brgyad dkar po zer/ yang chos brgyad kyis rang gi 'dod phyogs bzhi bo bsgrub pa dang / mi 'dod pa'i phyogs bzhi bo spong pa'i phyir/ srog gcod brku 'phrog rdzun sogs mi dge ba byas na chos brgyad nag po zer/ yang chos brgyad spang blang gi phyir/ chos 'dri lha bzhengs/ mo sman rtsis gsum/ gtor mdos glud gsum/ khe tshong zhing las 'tsho skyong sogs dge sdig 'dres ma byas na/ chos brgyad khra bo zer/ sngon byon dam pa gong ma rnams kyis 'jig rten chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi phyir/ lus ngag gis brtson pa phar zhog de'i kun slong ngan pa tsam zhig yid la shar yang de ma thag mgo la bzlog pa brgyab pa yin te/ bla ma zhing gis/ 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo la bzlog pa brgyab gsungs/gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ chos brgyad 'gram pa thang la bsnyal/gsungs pa ltar/ ngas kyang byas pas chos pa'i gral du chud pa 46

bskur/ /zhes gsungs/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis rang gi 'dod phyogs rnyed pa dang / bde ba dang / snyan pa dang / bstod pa bzhi bo bsgrub phyir dang / rang gomi 'dod pa'i phyogs ma rnyed pa dang / mi bde ba dang / mi snyan pa dang / smad pa bzhi bo spong ba'i phyir/ chos 'chad/ dbang bskur/ lha bsgom sngags bzla/ mchod sbyin gtong ba sogs byas na chos brgyad dkar po zer/ yang chos brgyad kyis rang gi 'dod phyogs bzhi bo bsgrub pa dang / mi 'dod pa'i phyogs bzhi bo spong pa'i phyir/ srog gcod brku 'phrog rdzun sogs mi dge ba byas na chos brgyad nag po zer/ yang chos brgyad spang blang gi phyir/ chos 'dri lha bzhengs/ mo sman rtsis gsum/ gtor mdos glud gsum/ khe tshong zhing las 'tsho skyong sogs dge sdig 'dres ma byas na/ chos brgyad khra bo zer/ sngon byon dam pa gong ma rnams kyis 'jig rten chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi phyir/ lus ngag gis brtson pa phar zhog de'i kun slong ngan pa tsam zhig yid la shar yang de ma thag mgo la bzlog pa brgyab pa yin te/ bla ma zhing gis/ 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo la bzlog pa brgyab gsungs/gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ chos brgyad 'gram pa thang la bsnyal/gsungs pa ltar/ ngas kyang byas pas chos pa'i gral du chud pa 46

byung / khyed rnams kyis kyang chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po dug bzhin spongs la ri khrod dben par sgrub pa snying por gyis dang / sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/rje btsun mi la yab sras sogs/ /mkhas grub gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /blo yis thongs par byin gyes rlobs/ /'jig rten chos brgyad zer ba de/ /gang la zer ba bshad kyis nyon/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde mi bde/ /snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad la/ /'jig rten chos brgyad zer ba yin/ /'dod phyogs bzhi bo bsgrub pa dang / /mi 'dod phyogs bzhi spong ba'i phyir/ /chos 'chad dbang bskur mchod sbyin sogs/ /byas na chos brgyad dkar po zer/ /srog gcod brku 'phrog mi dge'i las/ /byas na chos brgyad nag po zer/ /gtor mdos glud gsum mo rtsis sogs/ /byas na chos brgyad khra bo zer/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa sogs/ /dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /spangs nas ri khrod dben pa ru/ /gcig pur sgrub la gzhol bar gsungs/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang de ltar byas/ /khyed rnams kun kyang de ltar mdzod/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i byen rlabs dang / /'dis mtshon 47

byung / khyed rnams kyis kyang chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po dug bzhin spongs la ri khrod dben par sgrub pa snying por gyis dang / sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/rje btsun mi la yab sras sogs/ /mkhas grub gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /blo yis thongs par byin gyes rlobs/ /'jig rten chos brgyad zer ba de/ /gang la zer ba bshad kyis nyon/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde mi bde/ /snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad la/ /'jig rten chos brgyad zer ba yin/ /'dod phyogs bzhi bo bsgrub pa dang / /mi 'dod phyogs bzhi spong ba'i phyir/ /chos 'chad dbang bskur mchod sbyin sogs/ /byas na chos brgyad dkar po zer/ /srog gcod brku 'phrog mi dge'i las/ /byas na chos brgyad nag po zer/ /gtor mdos glud gsum mo rtsis sogs/ /byas na chos brgyad khra bo zer/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa sogs/ /dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /spangs nas ri khrod dben pa ru/ /gcig pur sgrub la gzhol bar gsungs/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang de ltar byas/ /khyed rnams kun kyang de ltar mdzod/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i byen rlabs dang / /'dis mtshon 47

rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /kun gyi blo yis thongs par shog /ces spras pas slob ma rnams kyis chos brgyad kyi bya ba blos btang ste sgrub pa byas pas/rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig gi rnal 'byor pa mang po byung ngo //yang zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes la/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i la dwags mkhan po/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ rab byung / kun dga'/ phun tshogs dge legs sogs sa thag ring po nas 'ongs pa dang / blo ldan rtsa dge slong / gnam kho'i bla ma/ khro rgyal 'bum/ lha bzo rig 'dzin la sogs pa'i thag nye'i dge 'dun pa mang po dang / g.yang sde bsod nams can 'jam gling zho 'ong la steng 'og gi bla ma dpon po/ yon bdag lha phyug rgyal/ lha 'bum byams/ rin chen skyid/ bo chog byams la sogs pa'i dad can skya ser pho mo brgya phrag mang po 'tshogs pa'i dbus nas/ blo ldan nyang gi mtshams pa rgya mtshos rab tu gus pa'i lha phyag sngon du btang / maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas dri ma med pa phul nas/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor dgos zhes gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs par gda'/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad las/ /bka' drin lhag par che ba yi/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /brtse ba chen pos 48

rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum po/ /kun gyi blo yis thongs par shog /ces spras pas slob ma rnams kyis chos brgyad kyi bya ba blos btang ste sgrub pa byas pas/rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig gi rnal 'byor pa mang po byung ngo //yang zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes la/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i la dwags mkhan po/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ rab byung / kun dga'/ phun tshogs dge legs sogs sa thag ring po nas 'ongs pa dang / blo ldan rtsa dge slong / gnam kho'i bla ma/ khro rgyal 'bum/ lha bzo rig 'dzin la sogs pa'i thag nye'i dge 'dun pa mang po dang / g.yang sde bsod nams can 'jam gling zho 'ong la steng 'og gi bla ma dpon po/ yon bdag lha phyug rgyal/ lha 'bum byams/ rin chen skyid/ bo chog byams la sogs pa'i dad can skya ser pho mo brgya phrag mang po 'tshogs pa'i dbus nas/ blo ldan nyang gi mtshams pa rgya mtshos rab tu gus pa'i lha phyag sngon du btang / maṇ+ḍal lha rdzas dri ma med pa phul nas/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor dgos zhes gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs par gda'/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad las/ /bka' drin lhag par che ba yi/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /brtse ba chen pos 48

bdag la dgongs/ /dang po mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /bar du dben par nyams len gnang / /tha mar bstan 'gror gang phan mdzad/ /mgon khyod rnam thar ngo mtshar che/ /stod kyi nyi ma 'char sa nas/ /smad kyi nyi ma nub sa'i bar/ /khyed kyi mtshan dang snyan grags kyis/ /nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa mtshar/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam gyes/ /tshe 'dir mi lus rin chen thob/ /skyabs mgon khyed kyi gser zhal mchog /mjal ba skal ba shin tu bzang / /da ni bstan 'gror phan pa'i phyir/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /snying khu byang chub lam rim gyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bsgul/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar tshe rabs kun tu bla ma dang / /dam chos mched grogs bzang po dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /thos bsam sgom gsum gang gi dus/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung bar/ /mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don rnams kun/ /yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i mthar/ ngas kyang kun la rdor sems kyi sgo nas khrus byas/ ston pa sangs rgyas la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gye sgo nas byin rlabs byas/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong kun spyod rnams gsal btab ste/ thog mar chos bshad 'di ltar byas/ 'o de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' 49

bdag la dgongs/ /dang po mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /bar du dben par nyams len gnang / /tha mar bstan 'gror gang phan mdzad/ /mgon khyod rnam thar ngo mtshar che/ /stod kyi nyi ma 'char sa nas/ /smad kyi nyi ma nub sa'i bar/ /khyed kyi mtshan dang snyan grags kyis/ /nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa mtshar/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam gyes/ /tshe 'dir mi lus rin chen thob/ /skyabs mgon khyed kyi gser zhal mchog /mjal ba skal ba shin tu bzang / /da ni bstan 'gror phan pa'i phyir/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /snying khu byang chub lam rim gyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bsgul/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar tshe rabs kun tu bla ma dang / /dam chos mched grogs bzang po dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /thos bsam sgom gsum gang gi dus/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung bar/ /mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don rnams kun/ /yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i mthar/ ngas kyang kun la rdor sems kyi sgo nas khrus byas/ ston pa sangs rgyas la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gye sgo nas byin rlabs byas/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong kun spyod rnams gsal btab ste/ thog mar chos bshad 'di ltar byas/ 'o de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' 49

bshes chen po/ mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ tha mar rgya gar rdo rje'e gdan gyi byang chub shing drung nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba bstan nas/ zhing brgya 'od kyis 'gengs bzhin gdul bya sems can thams cad gnas skabs su mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag nyid du 'thob pa'i thabs su chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa rnams tshur bsdu na/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang gnyis su 'du la/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi brjod bya'i don thams cad tshur bsdu na/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo chen pos mdzad pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par 'du/ der ji ltar 'du na/ mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang 'thob thabs rnams skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor du 'du/ nges legs thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i thabs skyes bu 'bring gi chos skor du 'du/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i thabs skyes bu chen po'i chos skor du 'du/ chos kyi snying khu byang chub lam gye rim pa 50

bshes chen po/ mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ tha mar rgya gar rdo rje'e gdan gyi byang chub shing drung nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba bstan nas/ zhing brgya 'od kyis 'gengs bzhin gdul bya sems can thams cad gnas skabs su mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag nyid du 'thob pa'i thabs su chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa rnams tshur bsdu na/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang gnyis su 'du la/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi brjod bya'i don thams cad tshur bsdu na/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo chen pos mdzad pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par 'du/ der ji ltar 'du na/ mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang 'thob thabs rnams skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor du 'du/ nges legs thar pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i thabs skyes bu 'bring gi chos skor du 'du/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i thabs skyes bu chen po'i chos skor du 'du/ chos kyi snying khu byang chub lam gye rim pa 50

'di ni/ sgye dgu'i 'dod don skong ba'i nor bu/ nyon mongs nad kun 'joms pa'i sman mchog gzhung bzang chu bo kun 'dus rgya mtsho dang 'dra bas/ 'di lta bu'i chos bzang po zhig jo bo yab sras kyi bka' drin las bod yul gangs can ljongs 'dir byung ba ma gtogs/ sngar yang ma byung phyin chad kyang mi 'byung zhes mkhas grub rnams kyi bsngags brjod mang ste/ rje rin po che'i nyams mgur las/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba/ /klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du/ /legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pa yis/ /skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na/ /gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang / /rgyal ba'i go 'phang bde blag rnyed pa dang / /nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang bsrung / /de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo ni/ /skal bzang du mas bstan pa'i gdams pa mchog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yis/ /yid rab mi 'phrog dpyod ldan su zhig yod/ /gsungs/ chos rje sgam po pas/ theg pa thams 51

'di ni/ sgye dgu'i 'dod don skong ba'i nor bu/ nyon mongs nad kun 'joms pa'i sman mchog gzhung bzang chu bo kun 'dus rgya mtsho dang 'dra bas/ 'di lta bu'i chos bzang po zhig jo bo yab sras kyi bka' drin las bod yul gangs can ljongs 'dir byung ba ma gtogs/ sngar yang ma byung phyin chad kyang mi 'byung zhes mkhas grub rnams kyi bsngags brjod mang ste/ rje rin po che'i nyams mgur las/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba/ /klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du/ /legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pa yis/ /skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na/ /gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang / /rgyal ba'i go 'phang bde blag rnyed pa dang / /nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang bsrung / /de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo ni/ /skal bzang du mas bstan pa'i gdams pa mchog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yis/ /yid rab mi 'phrog dpyod ldan su zhig yod/ /gsungs/ chos rje sgam po pas/ theg pa thams 51

cad brjod byar byas pa yi/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa 'di/ /dus gsum 'phags pa rnams kyi gzhung lam ste/ /gsungs/ mkhas mchog bdud rtsi grags kyi zhal nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas mang po yis/ /byen gyis brlabs pa'i rin bo che/ /sgrol mas lung bstan a ti sha /'dzam gling spyi nor sgos kyis thob/ /bla ma mnyes pa'i slob ma gcig /dka' ba spyad pa'i skyes bu mchog /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i bdag /mar me gcig las dpag med mched/ /sems can dmu rgod kha lo bsgyur/ /duḥ kha nad kyi sman gcig po/ /skyes bu gsum gyi man ngag mchog /sngon chad bod du ma byung chos/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /kha rag lam gyi so mtshams yin/ /g.yan lam 'gro bar mi rigs kyi/ /snying nas dam chos nyams su longs/ /gsungs/ bu ston rin chen grub kyi zhal nas/ mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i don/ /mkhas grub kun gyi man ngag 'di/ /rnam pa kun tu gsan par zhu/ /skyes bu gsum gyi don sgrub pa'i/ /rten mchog dal 'byor rin chen 'di/ /thob dus snying po ma blangs na/ /phyi nas rnyed par shin tu dka'/ /tshe 'di long med myur du 'chi/ /gsod sar 'khrid pa'i dud 'gro bzhin/ /skad cig re re 'chi la nye/ /de bas brtson 'grus drag tu brtsams/ /gsungs/52

cad brjod byar byas pa yi/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa 'di/ /dus gsum 'phags pa rnams kyi gzhung lam ste/ /gsungs/ mkhas mchog bdud rtsi grags kyi zhal nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas mang po yis/ /byen gyis brlabs pa'i rin bo che/ /sgrol mas lung bstan a ti sha /'dzam gling spyi nor sgos kyis thob/ /bla ma mnyes pa'i slob ma gcig /dka' ba spyad pa'i skyes bu mchog /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i bdag /mar me gcig las dpag med mched/ /sems can dmu rgod kha lo bsgyur/ /duḥ kha nad kyi sman gcig po/ /skyes bu gsum gyi man ngag mchog /sngon chad bod du ma byung chos/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /kha rag lam gyi so mtshams yin/ /g.yan lam 'gro bar mi rigs kyi/ /snying nas dam chos nyams su longs/ /gsungs/ bu ston rin chen grub kyi zhal nas/ mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i don/ /mkhas grub kun gyi man ngag 'di/ /rnam pa kun tu gsan par zhu/ /skyes bu gsum gyi don sgrub pa'i/ /rten mchog dal 'byor rin chen 'di/ /thob dus snying po ma blangs na/ /phyi nas rnyed par shin tu dka'/ /tshe 'di long med myur du 'chi/ /gsod sar 'khrid pa'i dud 'gro bzhin/ /skad cig re re 'chi la nye/ /de bas brtson 'grus drag tu brtsams/ /gsungs/52

dge ba'i bshes gnyen sne'u zur pa'i zhal nas/ a ti sha'i chos 'di lta bu sngar yang ma byung / da yang yong ste mi yong gsungs/dge bshes sha bo pa'i zhal nas/ skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum la blo sbyong ba 'di sdom pa 'bog bdo ba yang yin/ slob gnyer byed bdo ba yang yin/ 'dir blo 'byong na nor 'tshol ba'i blo mi skyes pas/ thams cad dad nas yong bas tshogs gsog bdo ba yang yin gsungs/ rje btsun phu chung pas spyan snga ba la/ mngon shes lnga thob pa dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa dang /grub chen brgyad thob pa dang / jo bo'i lam gyi rim pa 'di rgyud la skyes pa gang la gdams gsungs pas/ lam gyi rim pa rgyud la skyes pa phar zhog lam gyi rim pa 'di tsug yin snyam du go ba yang de las gdams te/ mngon shes lnga thob pa dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa dang / grub chen brgyad thob pa rnams grangs med pa zhig byas te/ 'khor ba las ma 'das ma 'phags/lam gye rim pa la nges pa rnyed/ 'khor ba las bzlog ste mchi gsungs/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ 'o 'o byang chub lam gyi rim pa/ /a'u chos kyi snying khu yin ya/ /kho re tshul bzhin nyams su longs dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ zhes gsungs/ des na chos 'di la brten nas 53

dge ba'i bshes gnyen sne'u zur pa'i zhal nas/ a ti sha'i chos 'di lta bu sngar yang ma byung / da yang yong ste mi yong gsungs/dge bshes sha bo pa'i zhal nas/ skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum la blo sbyong ba 'di sdom pa 'bog bdo ba yang yin/ slob gnyer byed bdo ba yang yin/ 'dir blo 'byong na nor 'tshol ba'i blo mi skyes pas/ thams cad dad nas yong bas tshogs gsog bdo ba yang yin gsungs/ rje btsun phu chung pas spyan snga ba la/ mngon shes lnga thob pa dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa dang /grub chen brgyad thob pa dang / jo bo'i lam gyi rim pa 'di rgyud la skyes pa gang la gdams gsungs pas/ lam gyi rim pa rgyud la skyes pa phar zhog lam gyi rim pa 'di tsug yin snyam du go ba yang de las gdams te/ mngon shes lnga thob pa dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa dang / grub chen brgyad thob pa rnams grangs med pa zhig byas te/ 'khor ba las ma 'das ma 'phags/lam gye rim pa la nges pa rnyed/ 'khor ba las bzlog ste mchi gsungs/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ 'o 'o byang chub lam gyi rim pa/ /a'u chos kyi snying khu yin ya/ /kho re tshul bzhin nyams su longs dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ zhes gsungs/ des na chos 'di la brten nas 53

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag rgyas shing sems can la bde skyid tshad med pa sngar yang byung / da lta yang yong bzhin pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na'ang 'ong bar 'gyur bas na/ bod kyi bstan 'dzin skyes chog rnams kyis/ snyigs dus kyi gdul bya gcig char ba dang rim gyis pa su yin yang / thog mar lam bzang 'dir 'khrid na/ gdod ma nas chos kyi babs mi brdal zhing / gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la yang dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs yong bar 'dug pas/ gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum thams cad lam bzang 'dir 'jug par bya ste/spyod bsdus las/ go rim ji lta ba bzhin bslab par bgyi'am/yang na bla ma'i man ngag tsam gyes de dag skad tsam gyis so so snang bar bgyid/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis smras pa/ rim gyis 'jug pas bslab par bya yi/ gcig char ni ma yin no gsungs/yang sems can dang po'i las can rnams/ /dam pa'i don la 'jug pa la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur bstan/ /ces gang gsungs pa ltar/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam la rim gyis 'jug pa legs so/ /zhes chos bshad bsdus pa zhig sngon du btang nas/ lam rim bsdus don/ myur lam dmar 'khrid/ blo sbyong don bdun ma dang / ngas bshad 54

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag rgyas shing sems can la bde skyid tshad med pa sngar yang byung / da lta yang yong bzhin pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na'ang 'ong bar 'gyur bas na/ bod kyi bstan 'dzin skyes chog rnams kyis/ snyigs dus kyi gdul bya gcig char ba dang rim gyis pa su yin yang / thog mar lam bzang 'dir 'khrid na/ gdod ma nas chos kyi babs mi brdal zhing / gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la yang dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs yong bar 'dug pas/ gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum thams cad lam bzang 'dir 'jug par bya ste/spyod bsdus las/ go rim ji lta ba bzhin bslab par bgyi'am/yang na bla ma'i man ngag tsam gyes de dag skad tsam gyis so so snang bar bgyid/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis smras pa/ rim gyis 'jug pas bslab par bya yi/ gcig char ni ma yin no gsungs/yang sems can dang po'i las can rnams/ /dam pa'i don la 'jug pa la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur bstan/ /ces gang gsungs pa ltar/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam la rim gyis 'jug pa legs so/ /zhes chos bshad bsdus pa zhig sngon du btang nas/ lam rim bsdus don/ myur lam dmar 'khrid/ blo sbyong don bdun ma dang / ngas bshad 54

pa'i lam rim blo sbyong rnams kyi lung 'khrid byas pas/ der 'tshogs pa phal cher gyi chags zhen dang / nyon mongs chung du song / snying rje dang byang semās che ru song nas sngar bas blo bskyed chen po byung / de'i dus su mtshan mo snga mo nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang / nyi dros nas nyi ma la 'ja' 'khyil ba dang /phyogs kun nas 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin sprin dkar po langs pas phal cher gye mtha' kun 'ja' tshon du gyur/ phyi dro nub phyogs nas sprin sngon po dar yug brkyangs pa bzhin nam mkha' la 'then pa'i nang nas/ kha ba kha dog dkar po bar snang la 'od lam lam 'khor zhing re zhig sa la mi 'bab pa dang /babs pa rnams me tog pad dkar 'dab ma bzhi ba brgyad pa sogs kyi dbyebs 'dra bas sa phyogs phal cher khyab pa byung /ngas bsam pa la da res kyi chos 'di la nam mkha'i lhas kyang mnyan nas dga' ste me tog gi char phab pa yin nam snyam pa byung / slar yang der 'tshogs pa rnams la lam rim gyi bsngags brjod zhal gdams kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//skyon zad yon tan kun ldan zhing / /phan btags ma btags med pa yi/ /'gro kun mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du/ /gyur pa'i sangs rgyas mgos phyag 'tshal/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi ma 55

pa'i lam rim blo sbyong rnams kyi lung 'khrid byas pas/ der 'tshogs pa phal cher gyi chags zhen dang / nyon mongs chung du song / snying rje dang byang semās che ru song nas sngar bas blo bskyed chen po byung / de'i dus su mtshan mo snga mo nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang / nyi dros nas nyi ma la 'ja' 'khyil ba dang /phyogs kun nas 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin sprin dkar po langs pas phal cher gye mtha' kun 'ja' tshon du gyur/ phyi dro nub phyogs nas sprin sngon po dar yug brkyangs pa bzhin nam mkha' la 'then pa'i nang nas/ kha ba kha dog dkar po bar snang la 'od lam lam 'khor zhing re zhig sa la mi 'bab pa dang /babs pa rnams me tog pad dkar 'dab ma bzhi ba brgyad pa sogs kyi dbyebs 'dra bas sa phyogs phal cher khyab pa byung /ngas bsam pa la da res kyi chos 'di la nam mkha'i lhas kyang mnyan nas dga' ste me tog gi char phab pa yin nam snyam pa byung / slar yang der 'tshogs pa rnams la lam rim gyi bsngags brjod zhal gdams kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//skyon zad yon tan kun ldan zhing / /phan btags ma btags med pa yi/ /'gro kun mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du/ /gyur pa'i sangs rgyas mgos phyag 'tshal/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi ma 55

'dris pa'i/ /mdza' bshes ston pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /gdul bya sems can snying rje nas/ /mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / /nges legs thar pa tsam pa dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /de dag thams cad tshur bsdu na/ /mdo sngags lam bzang gnyis su 'du/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi brjod bya'i don/ /byang chub lam gyi rim par 'du/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim 'di/ /dam chos kun gyi snying khu yin/ /mngon mtho lha mi 'thob 'dod na/ /skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs na yod/ /nges legs thar pa 'thob 'dod na/ /skyes bu 'bring gi skabs na yod/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob 'dod na/ /skyes bu chen po'i skabs na yod/ /lam rim nang ltar sus byas kyang / /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /lam rim tshar re bton na yang / /chos kun bton pa'i phan yon 'byung / /lam rim sngas mgor bzhag na yang / /dad rten phyag mchod zhing du 'gyur/ /lam rim khyer nas song na yang / /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis 'byung / /lam rim mthong thos dran reg gi /phan yon bshad na brjod mi lang / /skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum gyi/ /lam rim 'di 'dra sngon chad kyang / /ma byung phyin chad mi 'byung zhes/ /56

'dris pa'i/ /mdza' bshes ston pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /gdul bya sems can snying rje nas/ /mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / /nges legs thar pa tsam pa dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /de dag thams cad tshur bsdu na/ /mdo sngags lam bzang gnyis su 'du/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi brjod bya'i don/ /byang chub lam gyi rim par 'du/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim 'di/ /dam chos kun gyi snying khu yin/ /mngon mtho lha mi 'thob 'dod na/ /skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs na yod/ /nges legs thar pa 'thob 'dod na/ /skyes bu 'bring gi skabs na yod/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob 'dod na/ /skyes bu chen po'i skabs na yod/ /lam rim nang ltar sus byas kyang / /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /lam rim tshar re bton na yang / /chos kun bton pa'i phan yon 'byung / /lam rim sngas mgor bzhag na yang / /dad rten phyag mchod zhing du 'gyur/ /lam rim khyer nas song na yang / /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis 'byung / /lam rim mthong thos dran reg gi /phan yon bshad na brjod mi lang / /skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum gyi/ /lam rim 'di 'dra sngon chad kyang / /ma byung phyin chad mi 'byung zhes/ /56

bka' gdams gong ma mang pos gsungs/ /de'i phyir skal ldan slob ma rnams/ /byang chub lam rim nang bzhin mdzod/ /de ltar mdzad na gnas skabs bde/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /mgur dbyangs mthong thos dran reg gi /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces blangs pas kun dga' zhing spro bzhin phyag dang skor ba byas nas rang rang gi gnas su song /yang bkra shis g.yang chags sa bzang tsha kho'i phyogs kyi dad gtong blo gros che ba'i rdzong 'gag rgyal mo ma bu gnyis kyis/ rin chen dang po zho bdun dri med lha rdzas kyi rten can gye yi ge rgya can zhig bang chen pa bzhi la bskur pa'i nang na/ yig mkhan mkhas pa zhig gis nga la bstod bsngags mang po byas/ don gye gtso bo nga tsha kho'i phyogs su phebs dgos zhes gdan 'dren byas snang / yang sku gzhogs shar thams cad mkhyen pa la yang nga phebs chog pa'i gnang ba stsol zhes zhu yig phul 'dug nga 'gro 'dod skyes nas sku gzhogs la zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ khyed sa thag ring po der song na rim gyis khams phyogs brgyud nas dbus tsho bud 'gro bas na/ khyed da dung reb gong srin yul lta bu 'dir bzhugs nas 'gro don byed dgos/ sa bzang tsha kho de ru sku gzhogs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che yang phebs/57

bka' gdams gong ma mang pos gsungs/ /de'i phyir skal ldan slob ma rnams/ /byang chub lam rim nang bzhin mdzod/ /de ltar mdzad na gnas skabs bde/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /mgur dbyangs mthong thos dran reg gi /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces blangs pas kun dga' zhing spro bzhin phyag dang skor ba byas nas rang rang gi gnas su song /yang bkra shis g.yang chags sa bzang tsha kho'i phyogs kyi dad gtong blo gros che ba'i rdzong 'gag rgyal mo ma bu gnyis kyis/ rin chen dang po zho bdun dri med lha rdzas kyi rten can gye yi ge rgya can zhig bang chen pa bzhi la bskur pa'i nang na/ yig mkhan mkhas pa zhig gis nga la bstod bsngags mang po byas/ don gye gtso bo nga tsha kho'i phyogs su phebs dgos zhes gdan 'dren byas snang / yang sku gzhogs shar thams cad mkhyen pa la yang nga phebs chog pa'i gnang ba stsol zhes zhu yig phul 'dug nga 'gro 'dod skyes nas sku gzhogs la zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ khyed sa thag ring po der song na rim gyis khams phyogs brgyud nas dbus tsho bud 'gro bas na/ khyed da dung reb gong srin yul lta bu 'dir bzhugs nas 'gro don byed dgos/ sa bzang tsha kho de ru sku gzhogs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che yang phebs/57

gzhan gsar rnying gi bla ma skyes chen dam pa mang po bzhugs pas phebs mi dgos/ khyed cig phebs na dbus pa mar 'ong ba'i mkhan nang dang smad sog dad can yar 'gro/ mtsho sngon phyogs kyi sde dgon mang po la gnod pa'i mgo log dang / rang ngan tsho phebs nas chos re gsungs/ jag khrims rkun khrims re bsdams na 'gro don che/ da re 'di la ma phebs na chog par gda' gsungs tshe/ ngas kyang thugs bden snyam gsung de la nyan nas ma song bar 'byor lan yi ge rgyas pa/ dad rten du rang gi skra lo na bza'i tshal bu/ tshe ril bsrung mdud lha rdzas bcas phul ba'i mthar/ 'o dad can rgyal mo ma bu tsho blon dang bcas pa'i sems la phan pa'i bslab bya la/ spyir 'khor ba'i khyem thab 'di me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul gye tshang dang 'dra/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs rnams kyang dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas/ spu gri'i kha yi sbrang rtsi/ dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu ltar bsten na phung bar 'gyur la/ khyad par du rgyal srid 'di dug gi sdong po dang 'dra bar gzigs nas/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / rgyal srid spangs tshul sogs la bsams nas/ khyed rnams kyang rgyal srid la ma chags par dam pa'i lha chos mdzod dang / tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char nges/ zhes 58

gzhan gsar rnying gi bla ma skyes chen dam pa mang po bzhugs pas phebs mi dgos/ khyed cig phebs na dbus pa mar 'ong ba'i mkhan nang dang smad sog dad can yar 'gro/ mtsho sngon phyogs kyi sde dgon mang po la gnod pa'i mgo log dang / rang ngan tsho phebs nas chos re gsungs/ jag khrims rkun khrims re bsdams na 'gro don che/ da re 'di la ma phebs na chog par gda' gsungs tshe/ ngas kyang thugs bden snyam gsung de la nyan nas ma song bar 'byor lan yi ge rgyas pa/ dad rten du rang gi skra lo na bza'i tshal bu/ tshe ril bsrung mdud lha rdzas bcas phul ba'i mthar/ 'o dad can rgyal mo ma bu tsho blon dang bcas pa'i sems la phan pa'i bslab bya la/ spyir 'khor ba'i khyem thab 'di me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul gye tshang dang 'dra/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs rnams kyang dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas/ spu gri'i kha yi sbrang rtsi/ dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu ltar bsten na phung bar 'gyur la/ khyad par du rgyal srid 'di dug gi sdong po dang 'dra bar gzigs nas/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / rgyal srid spangs tshul sogs la bsams nas/ khyed rnams kyang rgyal srid la ma chags par dam pa'i lha chos mdzod dang / tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char nges/ zhes 58

gzhan yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs pa/mnyam med zas gtsang sras po 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon de'i zhal nas gsungs pa dam pa'i chos/ /chos bzhin mdzad pa'i dge 'dun gtan gyi skyabs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyis dge legs stsol/ /rgyal ba rang nyid zhing 'dir byon pa ltar/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags ma lus pa/ /rgyal khams yongs la spel ba'i bka' drin can/ /rgyal ba yab sras gsum gyis bod khams skyongs/ /dung dung snying nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /lhang lhang gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas rgyal mo la/ /bzang bzang byin rlabs dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /mi rgan glu dbyangs len pas mi rigs kyang / /ban rgan bdag gi rang gshis yin pas na/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab rgyang glu ring po len/ /skal ldan rgyal mo rgyang na gnas kyang gson/ /e ma dam chos dar ba'i yul dbus su/ /legs par skyes pa'i skal bzang pho mo rnams/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' ru/ /skye bar 'dod na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /rang yul skyid kyang gtan du sdod dbang med/ /phyi mar lha chos ma gtogs phan pa med/ /de phyir chos med phyi mar 'gro ba rnams/ /rin chen gling nas stong log byas pa 'dra/ /kye 59

gzhan yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs pa/mnyam med zas gtsang sras po 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon de'i zhal nas gsungs pa dam pa'i chos/ /chos bzhin mdzad pa'i dge 'dun gtan gyi skyabs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyis dge legs stsol/ /rgyal ba rang nyid zhing 'dir byon pa ltar/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags ma lus pa/ /rgyal khams yongs la spel ba'i bka' drin can/ /rgyal ba yab sras gsum gyis bod khams skyongs/ /dung dung snying nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /lhang lhang gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas rgyal mo la/ /bzang bzang byin rlabs dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /mi rgan glu dbyangs len pas mi rigs kyang / /ban rgan bdag gi rang gshis yin pas na/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab rgyang glu ring po len/ /skal ldan rgyal mo rgyang na gnas kyang gson/ /e ma dam chos dar ba'i yul dbus su/ /legs par skyes pa'i skal bzang pho mo rnams/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' ru/ /skye bar 'dod na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /rang yul skyid kyang gtan du sdod dbang med/ /phyi mar lha chos ma gtogs phan pa med/ /de phyir chos med phyi mar 'gro ba rnams/ /rin chen gling nas stong log byas pa 'dra/ /kye 59

ma snyigs dus tshe la nges pa med/ /'chi tshe zas nor khyer nas 'gro sa med/ /de'i phyir gtong phod can tsho smos ci dgos/ /ser sna can yang ma 'dug mchod sbyin thongs/ /gzhan gyi dge la rjes su yi rang re/ /phul yang bsod nams de dang mnyam pa 'thob/ /de'i phyir dbul bos mchod sbyin ma nus kyang / /gzhan gyi dge bar rjes su yi rang gyis/ /dge ba rang gis byed bzhin gzhan dag la/ /dge bskul byas pas 'dis mtshon dge ba'i mthus/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis 'gro kun rjes bzung nas/ /dge la gzhol nas myur du sangs rgyas shog /ces dad gtong blo gros che ba'i tsha kho'i rdzong 'gag rgyal mo bsod nams sgol ma la gdams pa'o/ /yang sras mo bsod nams 'tsho dang chos blon rnams la gdams pa/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos bzhin 'khor 'bangs sde rnams legs skyong ba'i/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad pa yi/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /du ma'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /su dang ma 'phrad gcig pur bsdad pas skyid/ /skyid pa'i shugs kyis mdo sngags glu ru len/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /ma 60

ma snyigs dus tshe la nges pa med/ /'chi tshe zas nor khyer nas 'gro sa med/ /de'i phyir gtong phod can tsho smos ci dgos/ /ser sna can yang ma 'dug mchod sbyin thongs/ /gzhan gyi dge la rjes su yi rang re/ /phul yang bsod nams de dang mnyam pa 'thob/ /de'i phyir dbul bos mchod sbyin ma nus kyang / /gzhan gyi dge bar rjes su yi rang gyis/ /dge ba rang gis byed bzhin gzhan dag la/ /dge bskul byas pas 'dis mtshon dge ba'i mthus/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis 'gro kun rjes bzung nas/ /dge la gzhol nas myur du sangs rgyas shog /ces dad gtong blo gros che ba'i tsha kho'i rdzong 'gag rgyal mo bsod nams sgol ma la gdams pa'o/ /yang sras mo bsod nams 'tsho dang chos blon rnams la gdams pa/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos bzhin 'khor 'bangs sde rnams legs skyong ba'i/ /chos la thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad pa yi/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /du ma'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /su dang ma 'phrad gcig pur bsdad pas skyid/ /skyid pa'i shugs kyis mdo sngags glu ru len/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /ma 60

nor lam la rim gyis 'khrid la mkhas/ /mdo sngags lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /'khrul med lam ston bla ma bsten pa gces/ /skyon med dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che dang / /long med 'chi ba 'di la rab 'jigs nas/ /don med tshe 'di'i zas nor longs spyod la/ /chags med chos kyi phyogs su btang na legs/ /'jigs rung ngan song g.yang la rab 'jigs nas/ /'jigs las skyob mkhan dkon mchog skyabs su bsten/ /'jig rten 'di ru sdig spongs dge la 'bod/ /'jigs pa med pa'i gdeng re e rnyed ltos/ /phyi mar rnam smin brgyad ldan lus thob pa'i/ /rgyu de rnams kyang da lta sgrub la brtson/ /sdig ltung rnams ni 'dag thabs stobs bzhi yi/ /bshags pa rnam dag byed pa gal re che/ /srid rtse nas bzung dmyal khams yan chad kyi/ /srid gsum gnas rnams me mur 'obs ltar mthong / /srid pa'i bde la mngon zhen gting nas log /srid las thar 'dod nges 'byung shugs drag bskyed/ /thar dka' 'khor ba'i me dong chen po las/ /thar thabs bslab gsum them skas la brten nas/ /thar par dka' ba'i 'khor ba'i me dong nas/ /thar pa'i go 'phang bde sar bsnyegs re ran/ /ma rig las nyon dbang song sdug myong ba'i/ /ma gyur 'go ba'i don du sems bskyed la/ /61

nor lam la rim gyis 'khrid la mkhas/ /mdo sngags lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /'khrul med lam ston bla ma bsten pa gces/ /skyon med dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che dang / /long med 'chi ba 'di la rab 'jigs nas/ /don med tshe 'di'i zas nor longs spyod la/ /chags med chos kyi phyogs su btang na legs/ /'jigs rung ngan song g.yang la rab 'jigs nas/ /'jigs las skyob mkhan dkon mchog skyabs su bsten/ /'jig rten 'di ru sdig spongs dge la 'bod/ /'jigs pa med pa'i gdeng re e rnyed ltos/ /phyi mar rnam smin brgyad ldan lus thob pa'i/ /rgyu de rnams kyang da lta sgrub la brtson/ /sdig ltung rnams ni 'dag thabs stobs bzhi yi/ /bshags pa rnam dag byed pa gal re che/ /srid rtse nas bzung dmyal khams yan chad kyi/ /srid gsum gnas rnams me mur 'obs ltar mthong / /srid pa'i bde la mngon zhen gting nas log /srid las thar 'dod nges 'byung shugs drag bskyed/ /thar dka' 'khor ba'i me dong chen po las/ /thar thabs bslab gsum them skas la brten nas/ /thar par dka' ba'i 'khor ba'i me dong nas/ /thar pa'i go 'phang bde sar bsnyegs re ran/ /ma rig las nyon dbang song sdug myong ba'i/ /ma gyur 'go ba'i don du sems bskyed la/ /61

ma rabs spyod ngan spongs la rgyal sras spyod/ /ma lus sgrubs la zhum pa med par gyis/ /gsang sngags nyams su len mkhan bla ma la/ /gsang sngags dbang bzhi tshad ldan sngon du zhus/ /gsang sngags gzhung bzhin dam tshig legs bsrungs nas/ /gsang sngags nyams su len la brtson par mdzod/ /dben par drang srong gcig pur gnas pa bzhin/ /dben zhing dam pa gong mas byin brlabs pa'i/ /dben gnas gangs rdza g.ya' dang nags tshal sogs/ /dben pa'i gnas su mdo sngags nyams su longs/ /de ltar tshe 'dir nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /tshe ring nad med lus sems rtag tu bde/ /bde 'gro'i lus rten 'di la ring min du/ /du ma'i nyams rtogs yon tan 'char bar nges/ /dam gtsang grogs dang 'grogs sam gcig pu ru/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin legs bsrungs nas/ /dam chos mdo sngags nyams su len pa la/ /dam can chos skyong srung mas grogs byed shog /ces phul ba 'byor ba dang dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro shar/rgyal srid la yang ma chags par dam pa'i chos kho na byas pa'i mthar ma bu gnyis gas 'chi khar lam sna zin par gyur to/ /yang zla ba gsum pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin par tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bskor pa'i tshe/ grwa btsun yon bdag pho 62

ma rabs spyod ngan spongs la rgyal sras spyod/ /ma lus sgrubs la zhum pa med par gyis/ /gsang sngags nyams su len mkhan bla ma la/ /gsang sngags dbang bzhi tshad ldan sngon du zhus/ /gsang sngags gzhung bzhin dam tshig legs bsrungs nas/ /gsang sngags nyams su len la brtson par mdzod/ /dben par drang srong gcig pur gnas pa bzhin/ /dben zhing dam pa gong mas byin brlabs pa'i/ /dben gnas gangs rdza g.ya' dang nags tshal sogs/ /dben pa'i gnas su mdo sngags nyams su longs/ /de ltar tshe 'dir nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /tshe ring nad med lus sems rtag tu bde/ /bde 'gro'i lus rten 'di la ring min du/ /du ma'i nyams rtogs yon tan 'char bar nges/ /dam gtsang grogs dang 'grogs sam gcig pu ru/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin legs bsrungs nas/ /dam chos mdo sngags nyams su len pa la/ /dam can chos skyong srung mas grogs byed shog /ces phul ba 'byor ba dang dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro shar/rgyal srid la yang ma chags par dam pa'i chos kho na byas pa'i mthar ma bu gnyis gas 'chi khar lam sna zin par gyur to/ /yang zla ba gsum pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin par tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bskor pa'i tshe/ grwa btsun yon bdag pho 62

mo mang po 'tshogs pa byung / de'i dus dad gtong blo gros che ba'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu sangs rgyas rin chen gyis sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi 'jings las 'khrungs/ /'gro drug nyon mongs tsha reg kun sel ba'i/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'i gzhir grol bdud rtsi'i zer/ /spro mdzad 'od dkar can der gus phyag 'tshal/ /'das dang ma 'das phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas dag gis mchod/ /sdom gsum bcas mtshams pham ltung sbom po'i sde/ /'gal nyams 'das ral gyur rnams mthol lo bshags/ /so skyes nyan rang byang sems rig 'dzin dang / /gang gi gsang gsum mdzad par rjes yi rang / /phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs rab 'byams rgyal ba dang / /mgon khyod gzugs sgu tshangs chen bskal brgyar bzhugs/ /zab dang rgya che'i gsang chen chos rnga'i sgra/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du sgrog par gsol/ /de las byung ba'i dge tshogs nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /rnam mkhyen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /sgu mchog mthong na srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob/ /gsung chos zab brling 'dod pa'i re ba skong / /thugs zab g.yo med 'gro 63

mo mang po 'tshogs pa byung / de'i dus dad gtong blo gros che ba'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu sangs rgyas rin chen gyis sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi 'jings las 'khrungs/ /'gro drug nyon mongs tsha reg kun sel ba'i/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'i gzhir grol bdud rtsi'i zer/ /spro mdzad 'od dkar can der gus phyag 'tshal/ /'das dang ma 'das phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas dag gis mchod/ /sdom gsum bcas mtshams pham ltung sbom po'i sde/ /'gal nyams 'das ral gyur rnams mthol lo bshags/ /so skyes nyan rang byang sems rig 'dzin dang / /gang gi gsang gsum mdzad par rjes yi rang / /phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs rab 'byams rgyal ba dang / /mgon khyod gzugs sgu tshangs chen bskal brgyar bzhugs/ /zab dang rgya che'i gsang chen chos rnga'i sgra/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du sgrog par gsol/ /de las byung ba'i dge tshogs nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /rnam mkhyen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /sgu mchog mthong na srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob/ /gsung chos zab brling 'dod pa'i re ba skong / /thugs zab g.yo med 'gro 63

kun bu ltar skyongs/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon yud tsam dgongs/ /zla med mgon khyod slob bu'i tha shal ba/ /chos med smyon pa'i rang rgyud la brtag tshe/ /chos dang sems gnyis ma 'dres so sor gda'/ /da ni chos sems 'dres pa'i gdams pa zhu/ /rmad byung zhal gdams dad pa'i yol go ru/ /legs stsal mthu yis nyon shes sgrib mthar byas/ /sku gsum 'bras bu rgyud la myur smin nas/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa la 'god par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o pha rgan ngas sngar chos ji ltar nyams su blangs pa bzhin/ khyed rnams kyis mdo sngags kyi gdams pa rnams rim bzhin du nyams su longs/ chos sems 'dres pa'i chos pa bzang po re yong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /chos mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi mdzod/ /rje chos rgyal ngag gi dbang por 'dud/ /bu'i chos kyi mgo nas mjug gi bar/ /kun nyams su lon par byen gyis rlobs/ /chung gzhon nu'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ /chos nyams su blangs pa'i pha rgan ngas/ /bus nyams len byed tshul glu ru len/ /yid rab tu dga' zhing gus pas nyon/ /khyod chung nas nga yi drung du 'ongs/ /chos mang po thos rgyu'i skal ba byung / dus deng sang rnam rig ches cher gsal/ /chos gang la bltas kyang shes par gda'/ /da shes pas 64

kun bu ltar skyongs/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon yud tsam dgongs/ /zla med mgon khyod slob bu'i tha shal ba/ /chos med smyon pa'i rang rgyud la brtag tshe/ /chos dang sems gnyis ma 'dres so sor gda'/ /da ni chos sems 'dres pa'i gdams pa zhu/ /rmad byung zhal gdams dad pa'i yol go ru/ /legs stsal mthu yis nyon shes sgrib mthar byas/ /sku gsum 'bras bu rgyud la myur smin nas/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa la 'god par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o pha rgan ngas sngar chos ji ltar nyams su blangs pa bzhin/ khyed rnams kyis mdo sngags kyi gdams pa rnams rim bzhin du nyams su longs/ chos sems 'dres pa'i chos pa bzang po re yong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /chos mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi mdzod/ /rje chos rgyal ngag gi dbang por 'dud/ /bu'i chos kyi mgo nas mjug gi bar/ /kun nyams su lon par byen gyis rlobs/ /chung gzhon nu'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ /chos nyams su blangs pa'i pha rgan ngas/ /bus nyams len byed tshul glu ru len/ /yid rab tu dga' zhing gus pas nyon/ /khyod chung nas nga yi drung du 'ongs/ /chos mang po thos rgyu'i skal ba byung / dus deng sang rnam rig ches cher gsal/ /chos gang la bltas kyang shes par gda'/ /da shes pas 64

mi chog nyams len dgos/ /chos nyams su len na mchong mi rung / /dpe ri la dal bus 'gro ba bzhin/ /chos rim bzhin nyams su len pa gces/ /dus dang po bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas/ /'go btsugs te skyes bu gsum gye lam/ /yar rim pa bzhin du nyams su longs/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /de'i rjes su mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /chos gsang sngags nye lam dbang bzhi zhus/ /lam bskyed rdzogs zab mo nyams su longs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub ci yang 'byung / /de'i rjes su gsang sngags mthar thug don/ /chos phyag rdzogs do ha nyams su longs/ /sems 'od gsal chos sku mngon gyur nas/ /dus ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /dus deng sang spyod pa rtsing po mang / /des bstan 'gro'i don chen mi 'grub pas/ /khyod sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs la phan par 'gyur/ /don de ltar nyams su len 'dod na/ /tshe 'di yi bde la ma chags par/ /khyod mi nor zas gsum blo yis thongs/ /gnas dben par tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /nga'i slob ma yang slob thams cad kyis/ /chos thams cad rim bzhin nyams su blangs/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang myur 'thob shog /ces blangs pas der 65

mi chog nyams len dgos/ /chos nyams su len na mchong mi rung / /dpe ri la dal bus 'gro ba bzhin/ /chos rim bzhin nyams su len pa gces/ /dus dang po bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas/ /'go btsugs te skyes bu gsum gye lam/ /yar rim pa bzhin du nyams su longs/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /de'i rjes su mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /chos gsang sngags nye lam dbang bzhi zhus/ /lam bskyed rdzogs zab mo nyams su longs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub ci yang 'byung / /de'i rjes su gsang sngags mthar thug don/ /chos phyag rdzogs do ha nyams su longs/ /sems 'od gsal chos sku mngon gyur nas/ /dus ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /dus deng sang spyod pa rtsing po mang / /des bstan 'gro'i don chen mi 'grub pas/ /khyod sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs la phan par 'gyur/ /don de ltar nyams su len 'dod na/ /tshe 'di yi bde la ma chags par/ /khyod mi nor zas gsum blo yis thongs/ /gnas dben par tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /nga'i slob ma yang slob thams cad kyis/ /chos thams cad rim bzhin nyams su blangs/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang myur 'thob shog /ces blangs pas der 65

'tshogs pa rnams kyi rgyud la phan thogs nas rjes su chos dang mthun pa'i chos pa mang po byung ngo / /yang sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i khyung dgon sprul skus dngos su 'byor ba'i lha rdzas maṇ+ḍal dang / yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod tshogs phul nas zhal gdams zab mo zhig gnang dgos zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/tshogs gnyis chu shel khams las grub/ /zab rgya'i chos kyi 'od dkar 'phro/ /'gro kun ma rig smag rum sel/ /rje zla ba lta bu'i zhabs dkar ba/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsal stobs che/ /thabs mkhas bzhi yi rkang lag bde/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i khur chen 'khur/ /rje glang chen lta bu'i zhabs dkar ba/ /mkhyen rab gser gyi lde'u mig gis/ /gsung rab rin chen mdzod kyi sgo/ /thams cad phyes nas gang 'dod ster/ /rje rnam sras lta bu'i zhabs dkar ba/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i gru chen la/ /brten nas gdul bya mgron po rnams/ /'khor ba'i chu bo che las sgol/ /rje mnyan pa lta bu'i zhabs dkar ba/ /mdo sngags chos kyi sman rkyal thogs/ /'gro kun nyon mongs nad kun sel/ /nyams rtogs lus zungs rgyas par byed/ /rje 'tsho byed lta bu'i zhabs 66

'tshogs pa rnams kyi rgyud la phan thogs nas rjes su chos dang mthun pa'i chos pa mang po byung ngo / /yang sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i khyung dgon sprul skus dngos su 'byor ba'i lha rdzas maṇ+ḍal dang / yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod tshogs phul nas zhal gdams zab mo zhig gnang dgos zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/tshogs gnyis chu shel khams las grub/ /zab rgya'i chos kyi 'od dkar 'phro/ /'gro kun ma rig smag rum sel/ /rje zla ba lta bu'i zhabs dkar ba/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsal stobs che/ /thabs mkhas bzhi yi rkang lag bde/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i khur chen 'khur/ /rje glang chen lta bu'i zhabs dkar ba/ /mkhyen rab gser gyi lde'u mig gis/ /gsung rab rin chen mdzod kyi sgo/ /thams cad phyes nas gang 'dod ster/ /rje rnam sras lta bu'i zhabs dkar ba/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i gru chen la/ /brten nas gdul bya mgron po rnams/ /'khor ba'i chu bo che las sgol/ /rje mnyan pa lta bu'i zhabs dkar ba/ /mdo sngags chos kyi sman rkyal thogs/ /'gro kun nyon mongs nad kun sel/ /nyams rtogs lus zungs rgyas par byed/ /rje 'tsho byed lta bu'i zhabs 66

dkar ba/ /bdag dang 'dir 'tshogs bu slob kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ /mgon khyod thugs la 'khrungs pa yi /zhal gdams zab mo gnang du gsol/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs rnams/ /khyed kyis rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ rang gi nyams la shar ba'i zhal gdams chos kyi snying khu 'di byin/ 'o de yang las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pas/ dang po mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs/ de nas dngos gzhi sems ngo skyong tshul ni/ snang grags kyis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ni/ nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon/ chu nang gi zla ba/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel sna tshogs la brten nas med bzhin du snang / snang bzhin du stong / snang stong dbyer med sems kyi rol bar thag gcod cing / sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs spros blal nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la yin par shes nas/ de'i ngang la mnyam par mjog dus/ dper na ri mthon po'i rtse nas 67

dkar ba/ /bdag dang 'dir 'tshogs bu slob kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ /mgon khyod thugs la 'khrungs pa yi /zhal gdams zab mo gnang du gsol/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs rnams/ /khyed kyis rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ rang gi nyams la shar ba'i zhal gdams chos kyi snying khu 'di byin/ 'o de yang las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pas/ dang po mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs/ de nas dngos gzhi sems ngo skyong tshul ni/ snang grags kyis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ni/ nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon/ chu nang gi zla ba/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel sna tshogs la brten nas med bzhin du snang / snang bzhin du stong / snang stong dbyer med sems kyi rol bar thag gcod cing / sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs spros blal nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la yin par shes nas/ de'i ngang la mnyam par mjog dus/ dper na ri mthon po'i rtse nas 67

phyogs kun tu bltas pa ltar yangs khro ler zhog zang thal kha yan du skyongs dang / dper na nam mkha' stong ba la bya 'phur na rjes mi mngon par yal nas 'gro ba ltar/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang der gnas na rnam rtog ci shar yang / rjes mi mngon par rang yal la 'gro bar 'gyur/ de ltar sems ngo skyong shes na skabs shig dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i smon lam thobs/ /dngos su phan gang thogs la rem dang / tshe 'dir rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes nyams mgur 'di blangs so/ /'gro ba ni yongs kyi sngon ma nas ma 'dris/ /mdza' bshes ni chen pos sangs rgyas rang mkhyen no/ /dus gsum gye sangs rgyas mi gzugs su shar ba'i/ /mtshan ldan gye bla ma'i bka' drin la brten nas/ /sangs rgyas kyi gsung la yang yang du sbyangs pas/ /mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs gdams pa ru shar byung / /chos nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par rang bzhag pas/ /chos dbyings kyi pho brang yangs po ru slebs song / /ma gyur gyi 'gro la snying rje 68

phyogs kun tu bltas pa ltar yangs khro ler zhog zang thal kha yan du skyongs dang / dper na nam mkha' stong ba la bya 'phur na rjes mi mngon par yal nas 'gro ba ltar/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang der gnas na rnam rtog ci shar yang / rjes mi mngon par rang yal la 'gro bar 'gyur/ de ltar sems ngo skyong shes na skabs shig dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i smon lam thobs/ /dngos su phan gang thogs la rem dang / tshe 'dir rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes nyams mgur 'di blangs so/ /'gro ba ni yongs kyi sngon ma nas ma 'dris/ /mdza' bshes ni chen pos sangs rgyas rang mkhyen no/ /dus gsum gye sangs rgyas mi gzugs su shar ba'i/ /mtshan ldan gye bla ma'i bka' drin la brten nas/ /sangs rgyas kyi gsung la yang yang du sbyangs pas/ /mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs gdams pa ru shar byung / /chos nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par rang bzhag pas/ /chos dbyings kyi pho brang yangs po ru slebs song / /ma gyur gyi 'gro la snying rje 68

rang bsgoms pas/ /bdag pas ni gzhan gces byang chub sems 'byongs snang / /gnas lugs kyi ngang nas 'gro don rang byas pas/ /mi tshe 'dir 'gro don rgya chen zhig 'grub byung / /stong nyid dang snying rje chos kun gyi snying po/ /kun gyis ni thugs dam mthil du rang zungs shig /snang grags kyi chos rnams dpe ru rang bkod nas/ /sangs rgyas kyi gsung rnams mgur dbyangs su blangs so/ /ban rgan nga zas gtsang sras po yi bu rgyud/ /chos glu 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang blangs yong / /phyi rabs kyi ston pa'i rjes 'jug gi tshogs rnams/ /dam chos kyi glu dbyangs 'di 'dra rang longs shog /ces blangs pas pha rjes bu yis zin par gyur to//yang de dus chos 'jig rten gyi blo gros che ba'i zho 'ong bla ma chung bas/ skyabs mgon rin po che khyed phyogs phyogs su phebs dus ltad mo sna tshogs gzigs pa nged 'dir 'tshogs spro ba sgye phyir gsung bar zhu zer ba'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o skal ldan kun sngon pha dam pa'i bu chen 'ga' res/dam pa rgyal khams kun tu byon nas ngo mtshar che ba ci gzigs zhus pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ ngas ngo mtshar che ba 'ga' re mthong / rnal 'byor pa gcig sgom sgrub nya'i 69

rang bsgoms pas/ /bdag pas ni gzhan gces byang chub sems 'byongs snang / /gnas lugs kyi ngang nas 'gro don rang byas pas/ /mi tshe 'dir 'gro don rgya chen zhig 'grub byung / /stong nyid dang snying rje chos kun gyi snying po/ /kun gyis ni thugs dam mthil du rang zungs shig /snang grags kyi chos rnams dpe ru rang bkod nas/ /sangs rgyas kyi gsung rnams mgur dbyangs su blangs so/ /ban rgan nga zas gtsang sras po yi bu rgyud/ /chos glu 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang blangs yong / /phyi rabs kyi ston pa'i rjes 'jug gi tshogs rnams/ /dam chos kyi glu dbyangs 'di 'dra rang longs shog /ces blangs pas pha rjes bu yis zin par gyur to//yang de dus chos 'jig rten gyi blo gros che ba'i zho 'ong bla ma chung bas/ skyabs mgon rin po che khyed phyogs phyogs su phebs dus ltad mo sna tshogs gzigs pa nged 'dir 'tshogs spro ba sgye phyir gsung bar zhu zer ba'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o skal ldan kun sngon pha dam pa'i bu chen 'ga' res/dam pa rgyal khams kun tu byon nas ngo mtshar che ba ci gzigs zhus pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ ngas ngo mtshar che ba 'ga' re mthong / rnal 'byor pa gcig sgom sgrub nya'i 69

khog par byed pa mthong / gzigs mo rgya mtsho'i gting du blta ba mthong / skyo bsang ri bo'i rtse la byed pa mthong /sems can phag pa'i lus po la/ bya'i mgo can mjug ma sbrul las byas pa sgo nga drug mig nas skyes pa mthong / shing lo gcig thogs nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba mthong / me tog cig ltor zos pas ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa yang mthong chu phor gang 'thungs pas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa yang mthong sha kham gcig zos pas dngos grub brnyes pa yang mthong / rnal 'byor pa cig gis rdo'i mi la chos bshad pas/ rus sbal gye rna bar thos/ de rgyal po'i btsun mo'i nyams su blangs pas grub pa dong nang gi btson bus thob pa yang mthong gsungs pas kun ya mtshan par gyur to/ /ngas de lta bu'i ngo mtshar che ba mang po ma mthong mod/ 'on kyang khyed tshor bltas na ya mtshan can gyi ltad mo sna tshogs mthong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ / rje bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /ngar phyogs med rgyal khams mang po dang / /gnas nges med ri khrod 'grim rgyu byung / /de'i zhor la ltad mo sna tshogs mthong / /dgun me tog bkra ba'i yul phyogs mthong / /phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling gi mi zhig mthong / /70

khog par byed pa mthong / gzigs mo rgya mtsho'i gting du blta ba mthong / skyo bsang ri bo'i rtse la byed pa mthong /sems can phag pa'i lus po la/ bya'i mgo can mjug ma sbrul las byas pa sgo nga drug mig nas skyes pa mthong / shing lo gcig thogs nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba mthong / me tog cig ltor zos pas ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa yang mthong chu phor gang 'thungs pas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa yang mthong sha kham gcig zos pas dngos grub brnyes pa yang mthong / rnal 'byor pa cig gis rdo'i mi la chos bshad pas/ rus sbal gye rna bar thos/ de rgyal po'i btsun mo'i nyams su blangs pas grub pa dong nang gi btson bus thob pa yang mthong gsungs pas kun ya mtshan par gyur to/ /ngas de lta bu'i ngo mtshar che ba mang po ma mthong mod/ 'on kyang khyed tshor bltas na ya mtshan can gyi ltad mo sna tshogs mthong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ / rje bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /ngar phyogs med rgyal khams mang po dang / /gnas nges med ri khrod 'grim rgyu byung / /de'i zhor la ltad mo sna tshogs mthong / /dgun me tog bkra ba'i yul phyogs mthong / /phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling gi mi zhig mthong / /70

dus rgyun du 'bar ba'i me zhig mthong / /rdo ka ma ru ba'i sku zhig mthong / /rje mi la bzhugs pa'i g.yag rwa mthong ma lab kyi sgol ma'i zhabs rjes mthong / /rje grub thob mda' 'phyar phur ba mthong / /dpal thang stong rgyal po'i lcags zam mthong mi'i pho khar rdo bzhag gcog pa mthong / /gri rnon po'i kha nas langs pa mthong / /shing ring po'i rtse nas 'khrab pa mthong rtse'i mar la thag shud byed pa mthong / /yul rgya gar rus sbal gson po mthong / /bya ne tsos mi skad smra ba mthong / /mi kha rgod rdo rje rnam rgyal mthong / /'bras dkar po bsam pa'i don 'grub mthong / /khyed rnams kyang gnas mjal byed du song / /ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo mthong bar 'gyur/ /da sa blta yul blta'i phyir du yang / /dbus yar tsho lan re 'gro thub ltos/ /zhes blangs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams rab tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /yang zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la chos thog dang sgyung gnas bzung / ban bon sngags gsum gyis gtso byas dang dad can gyi skye bo pho mo brgya phrag mang po la thun mong gi chos bshad/ dbang lung mang po dang / sems 'khrid 'dra byas pas kun gyi sems la phan po byung / thams cad so sor gyes khar kun gyis khyed da lo phyogs gzhan gyi 'gro don la phebs song na/ mi'i skye 'chi la 71
