dus rgyun du 'bar ba'i me zhig mthong / /rdo ka ma ru ba'i sku zhig mthong / /rje mi la bzhugs pa'i g.yag rwa mthong ma lab kyi sgol ma'i zhabs rjes mthong / /rje grub thob mda' 'phyar phur ba mthong / /dpal thang stong rgyal po'i lcags zam mthong mi'i pho khar rdo bzhag gcog pa mthong / /gri rnon po'i kha nas langs pa mthong / /shing ring po'i rtse nas 'khrab pa mthong rtse'i mar la thag shud byed pa mthong / /yul rgya gar rus sbal gson po mthong / /bya ne tsos mi skad smra ba mthong / /mi kha rgod rdo rje rnam rgyal mthong / /'bras dkar po bsam pa'i don 'grub mthong / /khyed rnams kyang gnas mjal byed du song / /ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo mthong bar 'gyur/ /da sa blta yul blta'i phyir du yang / /dbus yar tsho lan re 'gro thub ltos/ /zhes blangs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams rab tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /yang zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la chos thog dang sgyung gnas bzung / ban bon sngags gsum gyis gtso byas dang dad can gyi skye bo pho mo brgya phrag mang po la thun mong gi chos bshad/ dbang lung mang po dang / sems 'khrid 'dra byas pas kun gyi sems la phan po byung / thams cad so sor gyes khar kun gyis khyed da lo phyogs gzhan gyi 'gro don la phebs song na/ mi'i skye 'chi la 71

khrigs khrigs mi 'dug pas phyin chad mjal ba dka' mo red/da re kun la phan pa'i zhal gdams zab mo zhig gnang dgos zhes zhus tshe/ ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o khyed 'dir 'tshogs ban bon sngags gsum gyis gtso byas pa'i skal ldan gyi slob ma kun ma g.yengs par legs par nyon cig dper na rgyun bzang gi chu bo chen po'i mgo de gangs la thug pa bzhin/ nga'i gdams ngag gi phugs kyi thug sa bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi gsung rab mdo sngags kyi chos dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub gong ma'i legs bshad rnams yin pas/ de las lhag gi gdams ngag cig bshad gtong rgyu med/ khyed rnams kyis da phyin chad bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gtso byas pa'i dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs bzhin gsung rab rnams la legs par ltos dang /zhal gdams zab mo brgya dgos na stong 'dug de la dgongs nas sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo sde la 'chos zhes zhal chems su gsungs shing / mnyam med po to bas kyang / da lta dpe cha la blta ba la 'bad na/ nyams len pa min pa tsam du brtsi bar snang ste/ min na yang min/ nad khyags par bya yi/ gzhung chen po rnams la 72

blta ba la 'bad dgos gsungs pa dang / phu chung ba'i zhal nas/nga ni rgas khar mdo sde mdzangs blun la kha glan song gsungs pa lta bur byed dgos/ spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ de yang nas phung chen po'i dbus nas/ nas rdog gcig kho na bton nas/ 'di nas yin gyi gzhan min no zhes nas phung dor nas/nas rdog gcig la rtsis byed na dbul bor 'gyur ba bzhin/gsung rab dpag tu med pa dor nas/ be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la 'di gdams ngag yin no zhes rtsis byed cing /gdams ngag gi dbul bor gyur pa rnams kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ nas phung thams cad nas su byed shes pas phyug por 'gyur ba bzhin/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu shes par byas la gdams ngag gis phyug par bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur mkhas grub gong ma'i gsung 'bum rnams la bltas nas/ rang rgyud gdams ngag gis phyug par bya'o zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/chu mgo gangs la thug 'dra ba'i/ /gdams pa kun gye thug sa mchog /sangs rgyas rnams dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rgya bod mkhas grub rnams la 'dud/ /dam pa gong ma thams cad kyi/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel ma lus pa/ /gdams pa'i mchog tu 73

blta ba la 'bad dgos gsungs pa dang / phu chung ba'i zhal nas/nga ni rgas khar mdo sde mdzangs blun la kha glan song gsungs pa lta bur byed dgos/ spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ de yang nas phung chen po'i dbus nas/ nas rdog gcig kho na bton nas/ 'di nas yin gyi gzhan min no zhes nas phung dor nas/nas rdog gcig la rtsis byed na dbul bor 'gyur ba bzhin/gsung rab dpag tu med pa dor nas/ be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la 'di gdams ngag yin no zhes rtsis byed cing /gdams ngag gi dbul bor gyur pa rnams kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ nas phung thams cad nas su byed shes pas phyug por 'gyur ba bzhin/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu shes par byas la gdams ngag gis phyug par bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur mkhas grub gong ma'i gsung 'bum rnams la bltas nas/ rang rgyud gdams ngag gis phyug par bya'o zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/chu mgo gangs la thug 'dra ba'i/ /gdams pa kun gye thug sa mchog /sangs rgyas rnams dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rgya bod mkhas grub rnams la 'dud/ /dam pa gong ma thams cad kyi/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel ma lus pa/ /gdams pa'i mchog tu 73

legs shes te/ /sangs rgyas las kyang gus par byed/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i mchod pa yis/ /mchod cing mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams/ /dpag tshad stong du blta phyir 'gro/ /des na skad cig re re yang / /dam pa'i chos kyi rnyed pa ni/ /ri rab lhun bo'i tshad tsam rnyed/ /chu lbur chu yis mi non ltar/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gro/ /des na mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyis/ /man ngag thams cad ston pas na/ /ston pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos nyid/ /man ngag kun gyi rab dang phul/ /mchog dang gtso bor shes gyis la/ /rnam rtog spros pa kun spangs nas/ /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /gsung rab mchog rnams blta bar gyes/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag gi /mchog tu shes shing blo khel nas/ /blta rtogs gus par byed pa la/ /rmongs pa 'byung ba ga la srid/ /lung dang rig pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /sgo nas rnam grangs mtha' yas par/ /ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel la/ /bltas pas mkhas pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /mdo rgyud bklags pa rang la yang / /phan yon mtha' yas mu med gsungs/ /de phyir dus rnam thams cad du/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la blta bar gyes/ /rtag tu dam chos mchod byed cing / /nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / /tshul bzhin sems dang bsgom pa 74

legs shes te/ /sangs rgyas las kyang gus par byed/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i mchod pa yis/ /mchod cing mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams/ /dpag tshad stong du blta phyir 'gro/ /des na skad cig re re yang / /dam pa'i chos kyi rnyed pa ni/ /ri rab lhun bo'i tshad tsam rnyed/ /chu lbur chu yis mi non ltar/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gro/ /des na mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyis/ /man ngag thams cad ston pas na/ /ston pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos nyid/ /man ngag kun gyi rab dang phul/ /mchog dang gtso bor shes gyis la/ /rnam rtog spros pa kun spangs nas/ /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /gsung rab mchog rnams blta bar gyes/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag gi /mchog tu shes shing blo khel nas/ /blta rtogs gus par byed pa la/ /rmongs pa 'byung ba ga la srid/ /lung dang rig pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /sgo nas rnam grangs mtha' yas par/ /ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel la/ /bltas pas mkhas pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /mdo rgyud bklags pa rang la yang / /phan yon mtha' yas mu med gsungs/ /de phyir dus rnam thams cad du/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la blta bar gyes/ /rtag tu dam chos mchod byed cing / /nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / /tshul bzhin sems dang bsgom pa 74

la/ /rab brtson sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /ces rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnams la bltas pa'i phan yon 'di ni spyan snga ba'i gsung ltar yongs la gdams pas blo ldan phal che ba zhig gis/ ngas bshad pa ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnams la bltas nas thos pa btsal bas/ rgyal ba'i gsung gi byen rlabs kyis go rgyu chen po byung / nga'i rnam thar mgur 'bum legs bshad glegs bam rnams kyang gdams pa'i mchog tu go nas/ sngas mgo ru bzhag skabs skabs nyams su blangs pas/ yar mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba can gye chos mdzad sgye bo pho mo mang po byung ngo / /de nas zla ba drug pa'i tshes pa bcu'i snga dro dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel ba nas chas te/ de na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa thams cad dang / der 'dug pa'i grwa pa btsun ma slob ma yon bdag dad can mang pos mar gyi la mgo'i nyag kha bar du bskyal tshe/der 'tshogs pa rnams la ngas phyogs med kyi ri khrod rnams la gnas 'brel bzhag nas slar 'ong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rgya gar grong khyer bde ldan na gnas pa'i/ /ded dpon 75

la/ /rab brtson sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /ces rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnams la bltas pa'i phan yon 'di ni spyan snga ba'i gsung ltar yongs la gdams pas blo ldan phal che ba zhig gis/ ngas bshad pa ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnams la bltas nas thos pa btsal bas/ rgyal ba'i gsung gi byen rlabs kyis go rgyu chen po byung / nga'i rnam thar mgur 'bum legs bshad glegs bam rnams kyang gdams pa'i mchog tu go nas/ sngas mgo ru bzhag skabs skabs nyams su blangs pas/ yar mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba can gye chos mdzad sgye bo pho mo mang po byung ngo / /de nas zla ba drug pa'i tshes pa bcu'i snga dro dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel ba nas chas te/ de na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa thams cad dang / der 'dug pa'i grwa pa btsun ma slob ma yon bdag dad can mang pos mar gyi la mgo'i nyag kha bar du bskyal tshe/der 'tshogs pa rnams la ngas phyogs med kyi ri khrod rnams la gnas 'brel bzhag nas slar 'ong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rgya gar grong khyer bde ldan na gnas pa'i/ /ded dpon 75

bzang po gru gzings la zhugs nas/ /nyams dga' rin chen gling mchog tu chas 'gro/ /re zhig bde ldan skye bo tshor bral yang / /sems 'phreng mi dgos bde ba ru sdod dang / /nor bu blangs nas bde ldan du sleb yong / /ma pham g.yu yi mtsho nang na gnas pa'i/ /'gyur lcam nya mo chu gzhung la zhugs nas/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i gling mchog tu chas 'gro/ /re zhig gser mig nya chung tshor bral yang / /sems 'phreng mi dgos bde ba ru sdod dang / /gangs chu 'thungs nas g.yu mtsho ru sleb yong / /lho rong brag gi sbrang tshang na gnas pa'i/ /stag chung bung ba lha lam la zhugs nas/ /me tog sna tshogs gling mchog tu chas 'gro/ /re zhig g.yu sbrang gzhon nu tshor bral yang / /sems 'phreng mi dgos bde ba ru sdod dang / /bcud bzang myangs nas sbrang tshang du sleb yong / /dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba ru gnas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob bde lam la zhugs nas/ /phyogs med ri khrod nyams dga' ru chas 'gro/ /re zhig dad can pho mo tshor bral yang / /sems 'phreng mi dgos bde ba ru sdod dang / /gnas 'brel bzhag nas yul phyogs su sleb yong / /gal te ma slebs shi ba 'dra byung na/ /lo lon yin pas 'gyod pa rang mi dgos/ /thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir mchod me 'dra zhog dang / /phyi mar 76

bzang po gru gzings la zhugs nas/ /nyams dga' rin chen gling mchog tu chas 'gro/ /re zhig bde ldan skye bo tshor bral yang / /sems 'phreng mi dgos bde ba ru sdod dang / /nor bu blangs nas bde ldan du sleb yong / /ma pham g.yu yi mtsho nang na gnas pa'i/ /'gyur lcam nya mo chu gzhung la zhugs nas/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i gling mchog tu chas 'gro/ /re zhig gser mig nya chung tshor bral yang / /sems 'phreng mi dgos bde ba ru sdod dang / /gangs chu 'thungs nas g.yu mtsho ru sleb yong / /lho rong brag gi sbrang tshang na gnas pa'i/ /stag chung bung ba lha lam la zhugs nas/ /me tog sna tshogs gling mchog tu chas 'gro/ /re zhig g.yu sbrang gzhon nu tshor bral yang / /sems 'phreng mi dgos bde ba ru sdod dang / /bcud bzang myangs nas sbrang tshang du sleb yong / /dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba ru gnas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob bde lam la zhugs nas/ /phyogs med ri khrod nyams dga' ru chas 'gro/ /re zhig dad can pho mo tshor bral yang / /sems 'phreng mi dgos bde ba ru sdod dang / /gnas 'brel bzhag nas yul phyogs su sleb yong / /gal te ma slebs shi ba 'dra byung na/ /lo lon yin pas 'gyod pa rang mi dgos/ /thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir mchod me 'dra zhog dang / /phyi mar 76

mngon dga'i zhing khams nas mjal yong / /zhes blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i dad can phal cher gyi bsam pa la mi yi skye 'chi la nges pa med phyin chad tsho e mjal ci shes snyam sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis/ mig nas mchi ma g.yo zhing nga la lta bzhin 'dug ngas kyang skabs rer phyi mig 'dra lta bzhin 'ong / de nas thams cad snga phyi byas rang rang gi yul du song / sdig spong dge sgrub la brtson par gyur to/ /yang zho 'ong brgyud nas gling rgya'i sngags khang du song / sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can dgu rong sprul sku dang / 'jam dpon po/mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ lha pa/ gling rgya'i g.yung drung rnam rgyal/ sngags rgan pad+ma tshe ring / dkon mchog rdo rje/ snying 'bum rgyal/ phag mo tshe ring sogs/ 'jam gling smad pa'i sngags pa phal che ba zhig la/ rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang / mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang sogs byas/rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gyi lung khrid 'dra byas pas/ bla ma la mos gus/mched grogs la brtse gdung / sems can la snying rje/ chos la dag snang 'byongs pa dang / sems nyid kyi rang zhal mjal ba mang po byung / de dus sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can rig bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med cing snying rje che la bla ma la gus pa'i dgu 77

mngon dga'i zhing khams nas mjal yong / /zhes blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i dad can phal cher gyi bsam pa la mi yi skye 'chi la nges pa med phyin chad tsho e mjal ci shes snyam sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis/ mig nas mchi ma g.yo zhing nga la lta bzhin 'dug ngas kyang skabs rer phyi mig 'dra lta bzhin 'ong / de nas thams cad snga phyi byas rang rang gi yul du song / sdig spong dge sgrub la brtson par gyur to/ /yang zho 'ong brgyud nas gling rgya'i sngags khang du song / sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can dgu rong sprul sku dang / 'jam dpon po/mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ lha pa/ gling rgya'i g.yung drung rnam rgyal/ sngags rgan pad+ma tshe ring / dkon mchog rdo rje/ snying 'bum rgyal/ phag mo tshe ring sogs/ 'jam gling smad pa'i sngags pa phal che ba zhig la/ rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang / mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang sogs byas/rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gyi lung khrid 'dra byas pas/ bla ma la mos gus/mched grogs la brtse gdung / sems can la snying rje/ chos la dag snang 'byongs pa dang / sems nyid kyi rang zhal mjal ba mang po byung / de dus sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can rig bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med cing snying rje che la bla ma la gus pa'i dgu 77

rong sprul pa'i skus/ nyin cig dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po phul nas zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes zhu don glu dbyangs su phul ba/tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho che las 'khrungs/ /thugs rje 'od la phyogs ris med/ /'gro kun ma rig mun pa sel/ /rje nyi ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sgrib gnyis sgo nga'i rgya las grol/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi gshog sgo rgyas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkha' la lding / /rje khyung chen lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /lus la sgu gsum rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /ye shes lnga yi g.yu ral rgyas/ /bod yul gangs can khrod kyi rgyan/ /rje seng ge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /lung gi chos kyi yal 'dab rgyas/ /rtogs pa'i chos kyi 'bras bu smin/ /gdul bya 'dod lha'i re ba skong / /rje dpag bsam lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos par/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyis/ /sems can yongs kyi re ba skong / /rje nor bu lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag dang ma 'ongs gdul bya yi/ /nang gi sems la phan pa'i phyir/ /khyed kyi thugs la shar ba yi/ /zab mo'i gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /'bral ba med par rjes su zungs/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub nus par/ /byen gyis brlab par 78

mdzad du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ rang gi sems la shar ba'i zhal gdams chos kyi yang snying 'di byen/ 'o de yang tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis/ dang po tshe 'di blo yis btang nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin du bsten te/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs/'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa la ci nus su slob cing / khyad par rang la nges don ston pa'i bla ma de nyid rgyal kun 'dus pa'i rang gzugs su bltas nas spyi bor bsgoms te gsol ba btab/ dbang bzhi blangs thugs yid bsres la/ de nas chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog dus/ dper na ri mthon po'i rtse nas nam mkha' yangs pa la bltas pa ltar/ dmigs gtad chos med har las rgya yan chen po'i ngang du yangs phyal ler thongs/ mtha' bral chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong du dga' yal ler gnas pa zhig gyis dang / rnam rtog thams cad rang sar yal nas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yong / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i ma gyur 'gro la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i 79

mdzad du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ rang gi sems la shar ba'i zhal gdams chos kyi yang snying 'di byen/ 'o de yang tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis/ dang po tshe 'di blo yis btang nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin du bsten te/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs/'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa la ci nus su slob cing / khyad par rang la nges don ston pa'i bla ma de nyid rgyal kun 'dus pa'i rang gzugs su bltas nas spyi bor bsgoms te gsol ba btab/ dbang bzhi blangs thugs yid bsres la/ de nas chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog dus/ dper na ri mthon po'i rtse nas nam mkha' yangs pa la bltas pa ltar/ dmigs gtad chos med har las rgya yan chen po'i ngang du yangs phyal ler thongs/ mtha' bral chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong du dga' yal ler gnas pa zhig gyis dang / rnam rtog thams cad rang sar yal nas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yong / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i ma gyur 'gro la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i 79

smon lam thobs/ phan gang thogs la rem dang tshe 'dir rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po dang / nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru grol nas gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don la 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /bod yul la bka' drin sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i/ /rgyal kun gyi thugs sprul o rgyan khong mkhyen no/ /rnal 'byor pa gu yangs blo bde nga skyid pa/ /skyid dga' yi ngang nas glu dbyangs 'di len no/ /bla ma yi drin gyis chos kun gyi gnas lugs/ /stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu ru rtogs byung / /mnyam gzhag gi thang ma phyogs bcu ru brdal pas/ /sdug btsir gyi 'ching ba lhod grol la langs song / /'od gsal gyi nam mkha' mtha' nas rang langs pas/ /bying rgod kyi mun pa rang yal la bud song / /bde gsal dang mi rtog ting 'dzin ros myos nas/ /nyin mtshan kun gar shor mi shes pa skyid do/ /nam zhig ni 'chi ba chos sku ru grol ba'i/ /blo gdeng zhig sems la rnyed pa 'di ngo mtshar/ /nyams snang dang rmi lam bzang po rang yong snang / /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i bka' drin du go byung / /rnal 'byor nga o rgyan pad+ma yi bu rgyud/ /nyams mgur 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang blangs yong /o rgyan gyi rjes 'jug rig 'dzin gyi tshogs rnams/ /dben pa ru 80

smon lam thobs/ phan gang thogs la rem dang tshe 'dir rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po dang / nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru grol nas gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don la 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /bod yul la bka' drin sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i/ /rgyal kun gyi thugs sprul o rgyan khong mkhyen no/ /rnal 'byor pa gu yangs blo bde nga skyid pa/ /skyid dga' yi ngang nas glu dbyangs 'di len no/ /bla ma yi drin gyis chos kun gyi gnas lugs/ /stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu ru rtogs byung / /mnyam gzhag gi thang ma phyogs bcu ru brdal pas/ /sdug btsir gyi 'ching ba lhod grol la langs song / /'od gsal gyi nam mkha' mtha' nas rang langs pas/ /bying rgod kyi mun pa rang yal la bud song / /bde gsal dang mi rtog ting 'dzin ros myos nas/ /nyin mtshan kun gar shor mi shes pa skyid do/ /nam zhig ni 'chi ba chos sku ru grol ba'i/ /blo gdeng zhig sems la rnyed pa 'di ngo mtshar/ /nyams snang dang rmi lam bzang po rang yong snang / /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i bka' drin du go byung / /rnal 'byor nga o rgyan pad+ma yi bu rgyud/ /nyams mgur 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang blangs yong /o rgyan gyi rjes 'jug rig 'dzin gyi tshogs rnams/ /dben pa ru 80

nyams mgur 'di 'dra rang longs shig /ces blangs pas sprul sku rin po che'i rgyud smin cing grol ba byung ngo / /yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje yab sras rnams bzhugs pa'i yer pa lha ri snying po'i mgul dang mtshungs pa'i a myes lha ri'i ngos sngags 'chang gnam lha byams kyi mtshams khang sa cha khod yangs po de nas/'jam gling smad pa'i phyogs kyi dad can skya ser pho mo brgya phrag mang po la chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma'i lung byas pas mi 'ga' res/ khong dbus phyogs nas mdo smad 'dir phebs nas da bar du 'di 'dra'i chos bshad rgyas pa zhig ma byung / da lo skal ba bzang po byung zer kun gyi yid tshims pa byung / dad can 'go ba dpal lo na re/ khong gis de ring tsho las rgyu 'bras kyi chos zab mo mang po gsungs pa bka' drin che ste/ deng sang dus kyi stabs shig yin nam chos pa 'jig rten pa gnyis kyi nang na las rgyu 'bras brtsi mkhan mi 'dug zer/ de'i lan du ngas 'di skad smras/ 'o phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po las rgyu 'bras yin/ las rgyu 'bras yod par blta ba 'di chos pa 'jig rten pa thams cad la gal che ste/de'i rgyu mtshan sngon dge slong shags pham pa zhig gis/ dge 81

nyams mgur 'di 'dra rang longs shig /ces blangs pas sprul sku rin po che'i rgyud smin cing grol ba byung ngo / /yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje yab sras rnams bzhugs pa'i yer pa lha ri snying po'i mgul dang mtshungs pa'i a myes lha ri'i ngos sngags 'chang gnam lha byams kyi mtshams khang sa cha khod yangs po de nas/'jam gling smad pa'i phyogs kyi dad can skya ser pho mo brgya phrag mang po la chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma'i lung byas pas mi 'ga' res/ khong dbus phyogs nas mdo smad 'dir phebs nas da bar du 'di 'dra'i chos bshad rgyas pa zhig ma byung / da lo skal ba bzang po byung zer kun gyi yid tshims pa byung / dad can 'go ba dpal lo na re/ khong gis de ring tsho las rgyu 'bras kyi chos zab mo mang po gsungs pa bka' drin che ste/ deng sang dus kyi stabs shig yin nam chos pa 'jig rten pa gnyis kyi nang na las rgyu 'bras brtsi mkhan mi 'dug zer/ de'i lan du ngas 'di skad smras/ 'o phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po las rgyu 'bras yin/ las rgyu 'bras yod par blta ba 'di chos pa 'jig rten pa thams cad la gal che ste/de'i rgyu mtshan sngon dge slong shags pham pa zhig gis/ dge 81

'dun pa rnams la khyed ni bud med du zad do zhes 'thab mos brgal bas/ dge slong de mthong chos de nyid du skyes pa'i mtshan nub nas/ mo mtshan can du gyur pa dang / sngon tsi na'i yul du bstan pa byung nas ring po ma lon pa zhig na/ hwa shang ming ṭhan zhes pa'i dge slong thos pa mang ba zhig gis chos smra ba gzhan la/sbrul dang 'dra ba'i bstan bcos byas pas/ gzhan zhig tu sbyin bdag gi chos ston la phyin pa na/ lam du chos gos phud de gcer bur 'gre ldog byed cing lag pa gnyis rtsib logs la 'byar/ rkang pa gnyis gcig tu gyur nas phra zhing ring par gyur pa dang / zla bo rnams la/ sbrul dpe'i bstan bcos kyi rnam smin myong dgos shas che bas/ 'du shes ma 'gyur gong khyed rnams bros shig byas pas 'ga' zhig bros/ 'ga' zhig shing la 'dzegs/ mgo bo tsam 'gyur dka' bar snang zer/ mjug rtses mgo la yang yang brdegs pas/ thod pa gas te mgo zung ral pa'i nang nas sbrul mgo byil le ba byung nas nags kyi gseb tu song ba'i lo rgyus dang / nyug rum zhig gis glang dag rlig pa 'byen pa mthong nas/ bdag kyang 'di 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal bar gyur to snyam pa'i bsam pa drag pos glang de dag gi rlig pa phyung ba las btang ba dang / nyug rum pa de mthong ba'i chos 82

nyid la dbang po dang ldan par gyur/ sngon bram ze bza' mi gnyis kyis rang sangs rgyas shig la chos ston zhig drangs pas/tshe de nyid la zhing gi thog tu gser gyi snye ma 'khrungs pa byung /sngon rgyan po rgyal ba zhes bya ba shin tu dbul zhing phongs pa zhig gis/ chos smra ba zhig la rang gi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs gnyis/ gdugs gcig lham gcig 'gron bu spar gang phul bas/ khyim du slebs pa na khron pa'i nang nas gser bum pa bdun byung / yul de'i rgyal po thob pa byung / sngon phreng ldan mas sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms lhung bzed gang phul nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag bran mo dang dbul mor mi 'gyur bar shog ces smon lam btab pas/ tshe 'di nyid la ring por ma lon par rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis blangs nas btsun mor gyur/ des na las dge sdig gi 'bras bu tshe 'dir smin pa yong / tshe 'dir ma smin rung tshe phyi mar smin te/ sngon dge tshul kyun tas/ dge slong dbyangs mi snyan pa zhig la/ khyod kyi dbyangs ni khye zug pa dang 'dra'o zhes smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du khyer skyes pa dang / dge slong lus rtsal che ba zhig la/ khyod ni spre'u dang 'dra'o zhes smras pas/ spre'u'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs pa dang / sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la/ dge slong zhig gis dge slong zla 83

bo gzhan la ngan sems kyis mi gtsang ba zo zhig smras pas/ skye ba de'i 'og tu bshang gci 'dor ba'i snam khung du srin bur skyes pa byung / sngon sran ma 'tshong mkhan zhig gis/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs la dang ba'i sems kyis sran ma gtor ba'i bzhi lhung bzed du song / gcig dbu la chags pas/ phyis gling bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum phyed dbang ba'i rgyal po bye bo skyes zhes bya bar gyur/ sngon bram ze zhig gis mchod rten cig gi glang po'i gzugs nyams pa la slar zhig gsos byas pas/ tshe rabs mang por glang po che dang 'bral med byung / sangs rgyas kyi dus su yang khye'u ba glang skyong zhes bya ba skyes pa dang dus mnyam du glang po che zhig kyang skyes pa 'bral med byung / des na las sdig pa byas pas sdug po mi yong / dge ba byas pas skyid po mi yong zhes dge ba mi byed par sdig pa la 'jol nyog tu spyad na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub la nye ba'i snga ltas yin zhes mgur dbyas 'di blangs so/ /sngon chos rgyal dus nas da lta'i bar/ /mgon thub bstan nyi ma bod la shar/ /da dus kyi dbang gis nub la nye/ /de'i snga ltas cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ /las rgyu 'bras bstan pa'i snying po yin/ /sdig grwa bas byas kyang bstan bshig dang / /dge mi skyas 84

byas kyang bstan 'dzin zer/ /bstan gnas dang mi gnas 'di la thug /dus deng sang dgon pa phal cher gyis/ /grong las kyang sdig zas sha yi phyir/ /ma sems can srog la 'tshe ba mang / /'di bltas na bstan pa nub la nye/ /dus deng sang bla ma phal che ba/ /gar phebs sar sdig pa byed mi mang / /sha med na bla ma'i thugs mi dgyes/ /'di bltas na bstan pa nub la nye/ /dus deng sang grwa ba phal cher gyis/ /byams snying rje med pa'i snga ltas su/ /dman sprang po khyem la lhag par sdang / /'di bltas na bstan pa nub la nye/ /dus deng sang sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas snyam yang / /phyi'i dgon lhag rgyas pa ma gtogs pa/ /don rgyud la rgyas pa dka' mor gda'/ /dus deng sang bstan 'dzin phal cher gyis/ /sngags bstan pa'i snying po yin snyam yang / /las rgyu 'bras bstan pa 'di med na/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan pa dka'/ /dus deng sang chos pa phal cher gyis/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan 'dogs na/ /sngags las kyang rgyu 'bras gtso bor ston/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan par 'gyur/ /dus deng sangs kun gyes bstan pa 'di/ /yun ring po'i bar du gnas 'dod na/ /las mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang po mdzod/ /mgon thub pa'i thugs 85

byas kyang bstan 'dzin zer/ /bstan gnas dang mi gnas 'di la thug /dus deng sang dgon pa phal cher gyis/ /grong las kyang sdig zas sha yi phyir/ /ma sems can srog la 'tshe ba mang / /'di bltas na bstan pa nub la nye/ /dus deng sang bla ma phal che ba/ /gar phebs sar sdig pa byed mi mang / /sha med na bla ma'i thugs mi dgyes/ /'di bltas na bstan pa nub la nye/ /dus deng sang grwa ba phal cher gyis/ /byams snying rje med pa'i snga ltas su/ /dman sprang po khyem la lhag par sdang / /'di bltas na bstan pa nub la nye/ /dus deng sang sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas snyam yang / /phyi'i dgon lhag rgyas pa ma gtogs pa/ /don rgyud la rgyas pa dka' mor gda'/ /dus deng sang bstan 'dzin phal cher gyis/ /sngags bstan pa'i snying po yin snyam yang / /las rgyu 'bras bstan pa 'di med na/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan pa dka'/ /dus deng sang chos pa phal cher gyis/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan 'dogs na/ /sngags las kyang rgyu 'bras gtso bor ston/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan par 'gyur/ /dus deng sangs kun gyes bstan pa 'di/ /yun ring po'i bar du gnas 'dod na/ /las mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang po mdzod/ /mgon thub pa'i thugs 85

bskyed smon lam dang / /rang gzhan gyi rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /mgon thub bstan nyi ma 'od po che/ /dus nam yang mi nub gnas par shog /ces blangs pas kun gyi rgyud la phan thogs rgya chen po byung / yang 'gro khar slar yang mjal ba'i smon lam gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs blo kha chos la sgyur/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mdog sngo ljang ljon shing bde bar bzhugs/ /nga khu byug thag ring ri la 'gro/ /dus nam zhig skad snyan sgrog bzhin du/ /slar ljon shing rtse ru slebs nas 'ong / /mdog rab mdzes me tog bde bar bzhugs/ /nga bung ba thag ring yul la 'gro/ /dus nam zhig sgra dbyangs sgrog bzhin du/ /slar me tog rtse ru slebs nas 'ong / /mi dad can 'dir 'tshogs bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rnal 'byor thag ring dben par 'gro/ /dus nam zhig mgur dbyangs len bzhin du/ /slar yul phyogs 'di ru slebs nas 'ong / /kun tshe ring nad med smon lam 'debs/ /zhal yang nas yang du mjal bar shog /bkra shis pas phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas dad can pho mo 'ga' res da phyin chad mjal mi mjal ci shes snyam 86

sems skyo nas mig sgor mchi ma 'khyel mkhan yang snang / de nas dgu chu brgal nas nu rong khog brgyud de gcan za'i thang du song / de ru dad can gcan za'i dpon po dang / zla tshang snying po lha la sogs pa'i dad can 'brog pa mang po mjal du 'ong ba la/ ngas bka' bsgo byin rlabs ma ṇi'i lung 'dra byas/ de nas yon bdag rnams la chos bshad 'di ltar byas/ 'o rgya gar gyi mi de rigs bzang bas drin can gyi pha ma gnyis la brtsi bkur che bas bsod nams sgyes pa yin/ bod rigs ngan yin pas pha ma la brtsi bkur med pas bsod nams ma skyes pa yin/ des na bu la bsod nams skye bar 'dod pas/ pha ma gnyis drin che tshul bsams nas drin gzo bya dgos zhes smras pas/ dad can sbyin bdag snying po lhas khyed kyis da re nged rnams la pha ma'i drin dran tshul gyi mgur zhig gsung du gsol/ zhes bskul ngor mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /pha yi drin de dran par byin gyes rlobs/ /tshe 'dir dgos pa'i bu gcig yod na snyam/ /mo rtsis rim gro byas pa'i drin can pha/ /ma la bu dang bu mo skyes pa'i tshe/ /nor bu rnyed ltar dga' ba'i drin can pha/ /chung ngu'i dus nas kha la za rgyu dang / /rgyab la gon pa bskon pa'i 87

sems skyo nas mig sgor mchi ma 'khyel mkhan yang snang / de nas dgu chu brgal nas nu rong khog brgyud de gcan za'i thang du song / de ru dad can gcan za'i dpon po dang / zla tshang snying po lha la sogs pa'i dad can 'brog pa mang po mjal du 'ong ba la/ ngas bka' bsgo byin rlabs ma ṇi'i lung 'dra byas/ de nas yon bdag rnams la chos bshad 'di ltar byas/ 'o rgya gar gyi mi de rigs bzang bas drin can gyi pha ma gnyis la brtsi bkur che bas bsod nams sgyes pa yin/ bod rigs ngan yin pas pha ma la brtsi bkur med pas bsod nams ma skyes pa yin/ des na bu la bsod nams skye bar 'dod pas/ pha ma gnyis drin che tshul bsams nas drin gzo bya dgos zhes smras pas/ dad can sbyin bdag snying po lhas khyed kyis da re nged rnams la pha ma'i drin dran tshul gyi mgur zhig gsung du gsol/ zhes bskul ngor mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /pha yi drin de dran par byin gyes rlobs/ /tshe 'dir dgos pa'i bu gcig yod na snyam/ /mo rtsis rim gro byas pa'i drin can pha/ /ma la bu dang bu mo skyes pa'i tshe/ /nor bu rnyed ltar dga' ba'i drin can pha/ /chung ngu'i dus nas kha la za rgyu dang / /rgyab la gon pa bskon pa'i 87

drin can pha/ /phyogs kun 'khyams nas zas gos nor rnams btsal/ /gang mkho khyer nas 'ong ba'i drin can pha/ /nyin mtshan med par zhing las 'tsho skyong byas/ /nam yang sdod khom med pa'i drin can pha/ /bu la mgo na cham pa tsam byung yang / /mo sman rim gro byed pa'i drin can pha/ /de nas bu dang bu mo che ru song / /las rogs thub tshe dga' ba'i drin can pha/ /bu tsha la lar chos bslab rab byung byas/ /la lar chung ma len pa'i drin can pha/ /bu mo gnas la 'gro dus gos rgyan btags/ /nor gyis rdzongs pa brgyag pa'i drin can pha/ /nyin par 'gro zhing mtshan mo nyal na yang / /sems khur ma las lhag pa'i drin can pha/ /bu dang mna' mas khyim so zin pa'i tshe/ /yod tshad dga' bzhin sprod pa'i drin can pha/ /bu dang bu mo'i lto rgyab bsgrubs bsgrubs nas/ /dam chos bsgrub long ma byung drin can pha/ /zas ni ngan ngon gos ni slog hrul gyon/ /tshe 'dir skyid kyang ma brgyab drin can pha/ /sdig las mang po zhar dang zhor la bsags/ /phyi mar skyid po mi yong drin can pha/ /gson dus zas gos byen la byams skyong gyis/ /shi dus dge rtsa dgung zhag yag po thongs/ /de ltar byas na bu la bsod nams skye/ /phyi mar lha mi'i rten bzang 'thob par 'gyur//88

drin can pha/ /phyogs kun 'khyams nas zas gos nor rnams btsal/ /gang mkho khyer nas 'ong ba'i drin can pha/ /nyin mtshan med par zhing las 'tsho skyong byas/ /nam yang sdod khom med pa'i drin can pha/ /bu la mgo na cham pa tsam byung yang / /mo sman rim gro byed pa'i drin can pha/ /de nas bu dang bu mo che ru song / /las rogs thub tshe dga' ba'i drin can pha/ /bu tsha la lar chos bslab rab byung byas/ /la lar chung ma len pa'i drin can pha/ /bu mo gnas la 'gro dus gos rgyan btags/ /nor gyis rdzongs pa brgyag pa'i drin can pha/ /nyin par 'gro zhing mtshan mo nyal na yang / /sems khur ma las lhag pa'i drin can pha/ /bu dang mna' mas khyim so zin pa'i tshe/ /yod tshad dga' bzhin sprod pa'i drin can pha/ /bu dang bu mo'i lto rgyab bsgrubs bsgrubs nas/ /dam chos bsgrub long ma byung drin can pha/ /zas ni ngan ngon gos ni slog hrul gyon/ /tshe 'dir skyid kyang ma brgyab drin can pha/ /sdig las mang po zhar dang zhor la bsags/ /phyi mar skyid po mi yong drin can pha/ /gson dus zas gos byen la byams skyong gyis/ /shi dus dge rtsa dgung zhag yag po thongs/ /de ltar byas na bu la bsod nams skye/ /phyi mar lha mi'i rten bzang 'thob par 'gyur//88

drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma yi drin de dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /las kyi dbang gis tshe 'dir ma bur gyur/ /zla dgu zhag bcur khur ba'i drin can ma/ /thur sel rlung gis 'byung ba g.yos pa'i tshe/ /sha rus kha bkar phral ba'i drin can ma/ /khrag dang chu ser lhan du btsas pa'i tshe/ /mi gtsang 'o mas bkrus pa'i drin can ma/ /sha rus nyor nyor len na med pa'i dus/ /lag gis 'jam por blangs pa'i drin can ma/ /mig dang dbang po'i sgo rnams btod pa tsam/ /kha 'jam lce yis bldags pa'i drin can ma/ /mi gtsang la sogs kha ru song ba'i tshe/ /snang ba zhen pa ma log drin can ma/ /brang gi nu 'bur 'jam zhing rab rgyas pa'i/ /nu zho kha ru bsnun pa'i drin can ma/ /nyin mtshan med par rum phug dro sar bcug /mchin khar 'bral med glan pa'i drin can ma/ /nub mo gti mug gnyid kyis 'khyer ba'i dus/ /gsod dogs nub gnyid chag pa'i drin can ma/ /'o mas 'grangs nas 'dzum zhing rgod pa'i dus/ /sems la dga' spro shar ba'i drin can ma/ /ltogs nas mi sdod g.yo zhing ngu ba'i dus/ /mi bzod nu ma bsnun pa'i drin can ma/ /nyi dug rlung dang bser bu phog pa'i tshe/ /tsha grang myur du skyob pa'i drin can ma/ /dud 'gro bzhin du ci yang mi shes tshe/ /'gro 'dug 89

skad cha bslab pa'i drin can ma/ /cher song mi yi gral du chud pa'i tshe/ /sems kyis kho thag chod pa'i drin can ma/ /gson dus zas gos byen la byams skyong gyis/ /shi dus dge rtsa dgung zhag yag po thongs/ /de ltar byas na bu la bsod nams skye/ /phyi mar lha mi'i lus rten 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas/kun la blo bskyed thon nas pha ma gnyis la byams mkhan mang po byung ngo / /de'i phyi nyin ga le byas gshong mo che'i dgon par song /zhag gis bsdad dge 'dun pa rnams la mang ja btang bsnyen bkur yag po byas/ phyi'i nyin dam pa gong ma'i byin gyes brlabs pa'i mtshar lung dben pa'i dga' tshal du song / nyi ma bco lnga tsam la gnas 'brel bzhag pa'i tshe/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i a lags brtson 'grus dang / rig pa gsal ba'i pad+ma rig 'dzin/ dam tshig gtsang ba'i sngags rgan tshe brtan dang / de'i bu dge slong tshul khrims la sogs pa'i slob ma gsar rnying mang pos/ dam pa khyed kyi sku drin gyes sngar phyag rdzogs gnyis kyi lta ba'i 'gro phyogs re shes kyang / dbu ma'i lta ba de gzhung lugs sbyangs pa 'dra ma gtogs rtogs dka' gsungs pa de bden par 'dug pas/ skyabs mgon mchog 90

gis bdag cag rnams la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas/ dbu ma'i lta ba rten cing 'brel 'byung gi don cig gsung dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/bden gnyis chos kyi don rtogs nas/ /tshogs gnyis rlabs chen bsags pa'i mthus/ /sku gnyis go 'phang mngon gyur pa'i/ /don gnyis lhun grub rin po che/ /bdag cag rnams dang ma 'ongs pa'i/ /skal bzang gdul byar phan pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i gsung gi khyad chos mchog /dam pa gong ma'i thugs dam mthil/ /kun rdzob don dam bden pa las/ /brtsams pa'i zab mo dbu ma yi/ /lta ba rten cing 'brel 'byung gi /chos shig legs par gsung du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyi gsung gi khyad chos/ rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa'i don/ rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras kyis legs par bkral ba'i zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di nyid dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin bshad par bya ste/ de yang rten 'byung zhes pa mtha' bral stong pa nyid kyi don du bya dgos te/ rtsa ba shes rab nyer bzhi ba las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang / /de ni stong pa nyid du bshad/ /de ni 91

gis bdag cag rnams la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas/ dbu ma'i lta ba rten cing 'brel 'byung gi don cig gsung dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/bden gnyis chos kyi don rtogs nas/ /tshogs gnyis rlabs chen bsags pa'i mthus/ /sku gnyis go 'phang mngon gyur pa'i/ /don gnyis lhun grub rin po che/ /bdag cag rnams dang ma 'ongs pa'i/ /skal bzang gdul byar phan pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i gsung gi khyad chos mchog /dam pa gong ma'i thugs dam mthil/ /kun rdzob don dam bden pa las/ /brtsams pa'i zab mo dbu ma yi/ /lta ba rten cing 'brel 'byung gi /chos shig legs par gsung du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyi gsung gi khyad chos/ rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa'i don/ rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras kyis legs par bkral ba'i zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di nyid dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin bshad par bya ste/ de yang rten 'byung zhes pa mtha' bral stong pa nyid kyi don du bya dgos te/ rtsa ba shes rab nyer bzhi ba las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang / /de ni stong pa nyid du bshad/ /de ni 91

brten nas gdags pa ste/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes dang / rtsod bzlog las/ gang zhig stong dang rten 'byung dag /dbu ma'i don du don gcig par/ /zhes de gsum rnam grangs su gsungs so/ /des na stong pa nyid dang rten 'byung gnyis don gcig ste/ legs bshad snying po las/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i don/ rten 'byung gi don du gsungs pa/ ston pa smra ba gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khyad chos bla na med par gzigs nas/ slob dbon gyi gzhung mang por bcom ldan 'das la rten 'byung gsungs pa'i sgo nas bstod de zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rje rin po ches kyang / rten 'brel bstod pa las/ 'di kun ngo bos stong pa dang / /'di las 'di 'bras 'byung ba yi/ /nges pa gnyis po phan tshun du/ /gegs med par ni grogs byed pa/ /'di las ngo mtshar gyur pa dang / /'di las rmad du byung ba gang / /tshul 'dis khyod la bstod na ni/ /bstod par 'gyur gyis gzhan gyis min/ /gsungs/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi byang chub sems 'grel las/ chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas/ /las dang 'bras bu brten pa gang / /ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung / /zhes gsungs pa la/ rje bla mas rje btsun red mda' ba la phul ba'i 92

brten nas gdags pa ste/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes dang / rtsod bzlog las/ gang zhig stong dang rten 'byung dag /dbu ma'i don du don gcig par/ /zhes de gsum rnam grangs su gsungs so/ /des na stong pa nyid dang rten 'byung gnyis don gcig ste/ legs bshad snying po las/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i don/ rten 'byung gi don du gsungs pa/ ston pa smra ba gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khyad chos bla na med par gzigs nas/ slob dbon gyi gzhung mang por bcom ldan 'das la rten 'byung gsungs pa'i sgo nas bstod de zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rje rin po ches kyang / rten 'brel bstod pa las/ 'di kun ngo bos stong pa dang / /'di las 'di 'bras 'byung ba yi/ /nges pa gnyis po phan tshun du/ /gegs med par ni grogs byed pa/ /'di las ngo mtshar gyur pa dang / /'di las rmad du byung ba gang / /tshul 'dis khyod la bstod na ni/ /bstod par 'gyur gyis gzhan gyis min/ /gsungs/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi byang chub sems 'grel las/ chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas/ /las dang 'bras bu brten pa gang / /ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung / /zhes gsungs pa la/ rje bla mas rje btsun red mda' ba la phul ba'i 92

zhal gdams las/ de'ang spyir stong pas yod mtha' dang / snang bas med mtha' sel ba 'di rgyangs 'phen gyi bar la thun mong pa yin pas/ thal 'gyur ba'i khyad chos la snang bas yod mtha' dang / stong pas med mtha' sel zhing / stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'gro tshul shes dgos la zhes dang / rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba mi bslu bar mthong ba'i blo de nyid kyis blo gzhan la ltos med du dmigs gtad zhig pa'i stong pa'ang 'ong ba'i tshul dang / rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i gtan tshigs de nyid kyis rtags gzhan la ltos med yod mtha' sogs dang bral ba'am stong par grub pa'i tshul las rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba la gting nas nges shes 'drongs shing / de ka nas dmigs gtad thams cad zhig pa'i zhen med kyang 'ong ba yin zhes gsungs shing / de dag gi gnad 'dus pa lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum las/ gang zhig 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med mthong zhing / /dmigs pa'i gtad so gang yin kun zhig pa/ /de ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs/ /snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / /stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis/ /ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med/ /nam zhig re 'jog med par gcig 93

zhal gdams las/ de'ang spyir stong pas yod mtha' dang / snang bas med mtha' sel ba 'di rgyangs 'phen gyi bar la thun mong pa yin pas/ thal 'gyur ba'i khyad chos la snang bas yod mtha' dang / stong pas med mtha' sel zhing / stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'gro tshul shes dgos la zhes dang / rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba mi bslu bar mthong ba'i blo de nyid kyis blo gzhan la ltos med du dmigs gtad zhig pa'i stong pa'ang 'ong ba'i tshul dang / rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i gtan tshigs de nyid kyis rtags gzhan la ltos med yod mtha' sogs dang bral ba'am stong par grub pa'i tshul las rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba la gting nas nges shes 'drongs shing / de ka nas dmigs gtad thams cad zhig pa'i zhen med kyang 'ong ba yin zhes gsungs shing / de dag gi gnad 'dus pa lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum las/ gang zhig 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med mthong zhing / /dmigs pa'i gtad so gang yin kun zhig pa/ /de ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs/ /snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / /stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis/ /ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med/ /nam zhig re 'jog med par gcig 93

char du/ /rten 'brel mi bslu mthong ba tsam nyid nas//nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na/ /de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags/ /gzhan yang snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang / /stong pas med mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'char ba'i tshul shes na/ /mthar 'dzin lta bas 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos khri gung thang pas/ snang ba rgyu mtshan du byas te/ gdags gzhi'i ngos nas ma grub pa dang / rang bzhin gyis stong pa rgyu mtshan du byas te/ snang ba cir yang 'char rung bar bsgrubs pas/ mtha' gnyis sel tshul 'di ni gong du smos pa ltar stong pa zhes pa dang / rten 'byung zhes pa don go tshul gcig tu 'bab pa la thug pas/ gtan tshigs 'di la mtha' gnyis char sel ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po zhes gsungs so gsungs la/ de bzhin du paṇa chen rin po ches/ chos nyid la bltas pas chos can bkra/ /chos can la dpyad pas stong par bros/ /snang stong gnyis re 'jog mi byed pa'i/ /zung 'jug de bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /ces dang / rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ lar snang bas stong pa mi 'gog cing / /yul stong pa'i ngang la snang ba bkra/ /gang shar kyang bden par mi zhen par/ /mtsho dwangs par shar 94

char du/ /rten 'brel mi bslu mthong ba tsam nyid nas//nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na/ /de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags/ /gzhan yang snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang / /stong pas med mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'char ba'i tshul shes na/ /mthar 'dzin lta bas 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos khri gung thang pas/ snang ba rgyu mtshan du byas te/ gdags gzhi'i ngos nas ma grub pa dang / rang bzhin gyis stong pa rgyu mtshan du byas te/ snang ba cir yang 'char rung bar bsgrubs pas/ mtha' gnyis sel tshul 'di ni gong du smos pa ltar stong pa zhes pa dang / rten 'byung zhes pa don go tshul gcig tu 'bab pa la thug pas/ gtan tshigs 'di la mtha' gnyis char sel ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po zhes gsungs so gsungs la/ de bzhin du paṇa chen rin po ches/ chos nyid la bltas pas chos can bkra/ /chos can la dpyad pas stong par bros/ /snang stong gnyis re 'jog mi byed pa'i/ /zung 'jug de bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /ces dang / rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ lar snang bas stong pa mi 'gog cing / /yul stong pa'i ngang la snang ba bkra/ /gang shar kyang bden par mi zhen par/ /mtsho dwangs par shar 94

ba'i zla gzugs ltar/ /don bden gnyis snang stong rnal 'byor la/ /dus nyin bzhin ltad mo blta ba la/ /blo 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bden gnyis kyi don khong du chud nas tshogs gnyis gsog pa la 'bad na/ ring por mi thogs par sku gnyis mngon du byas nas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/zab mo rten cing 'brel 'byung don gzigs pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /lta ba'i yang rtse dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i/ /lta ba ji bzhin rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ston pa'i gsung rab kun gyi khyad chos mchog /'phags mchog klu sgrub bzhed srol lta ba'i gnad/ /rgyal ba yab sras bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /bdag gis glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /lung rigs gnyis kyis yang yang dpyad pa'i tshe/ /chos kun rang bzhin rdul tsam med pa dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gal med grogs su 'char ba dgos/ /dper na nas kyi ljang bu ring po de/ /sa bon chu lud drod gsher gang las byung / /dpyad na rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /med bzhin rgyu rkyen 'tshogs las 'byung ba mtshar/ /95

ba'i zla gzugs ltar/ /don bden gnyis snang stong rnal 'byor la/ /dus nyin bzhin ltad mo blta ba la/ /blo 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bden gnyis kyi don khong du chud nas tshogs gnyis gsog pa la 'bad na/ ring por mi thogs par sku gnyis mngon du byas nas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/zab mo rten cing 'brel 'byung don gzigs pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /lta ba'i yang rtse dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i/ /lta ba ji bzhin rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ston pa'i gsung rab kun gyi khyad chos mchog /'phags mchog klu sgrub bzhed srol lta ba'i gnad/ /rgyal ba yab sras bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /bdag gis glu ru len gyis dga' bas nyon/ /lung rigs gnyis kyis yang yang dpyad pa'i tshe/ /chos kun rang bzhin rdul tsam med pa dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gal med grogs su 'char ba dgos/ /dper na nas kyi ljang bu ring po de/ /sa bon chu lud drod gsher gang las byung / /dpyad na rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /med bzhin rgyu rkyen 'tshogs las 'byung ba mtshar/ /95

dper na sgyu ma'i rta dang glang po che/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi rdzas sngags gang las byung / /dpyad na rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /med bzhin rdzas sngags 'tshogs las 'byung ba mtshar/ /dper na rmi lam bzang ngan rmis pa de/ /gti mug gnyid dang sems nyid gang las byung / /dpyad na rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /med bzhin gnyid sems 'dzoms las 'byung ba mtshar/ /de ltar chos kun rang bzhin med pa dang / /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'tshogs las 'byung ba'i tshul/ /shes na sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyi/ /dgongs pa'i mthar thug dbu ma'i khyad chos te/ /snang bzhin stong pas yod pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /stong bzhin snang bas med pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /snang stong gnyis po re 'jog mi dgos par/ /gcig char zung 'jug rtogs pa ngo mtshar che/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bgrod gcig lam/ /rgyal yum sher phyin dgongs pa 'di nyid ces/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la mchod par 'bul/ /don gnyis sgrub 'dod chos mdzad skyes bu rnams/ /bden gnyis chos kyi glu dbyangs len bzhin du/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'brel gom stabs rab bsgyur nas/ /sgu gnyis sangs rgyas sa ru da song zhig /ces blangs pas der 96

dper na sgyu ma'i rta dang glang po che/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi rdzas sngags gang las byung / /dpyad na rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /med bzhin rdzas sngags 'tshogs las 'byung ba mtshar/ /dper na rmi lam bzang ngan rmis pa de/ /gti mug gnyid dang sems nyid gang las byung / /dpyad na rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /med bzhin gnyid sems 'dzoms las 'byung ba mtshar/ /de ltar chos kun rang bzhin med pa dang / /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'tshogs las 'byung ba'i tshul/ /shes na sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyi/ /dgongs pa'i mthar thug dbu ma'i khyad chos te/ /snang bzhin stong pas yod pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /stong bzhin snang bas med pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /snang stong gnyis po re 'jog mi dgos par/ /gcig char zung 'jug rtogs pa ngo mtshar che/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bgrod gcig lam/ /rgyal yum sher phyin dgongs pa 'di nyid ces/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la mchod par 'bul/ /don gnyis sgrub 'dod chos mdzad skyes bu rnams/ /bden gnyis chos kyi glu dbyangs len bzhin du/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'brel gom stabs rab bsgyur nas/ /sgu gnyis sangs rgyas sa ru da song zhig /ces blangs pas der 96

'tshogs pa rnams kyis bden gnyis kyi don rtogs nas tshogs gnyis gsog pa la sngar bas brtson par gyur to/ /de nas chos kyi yul dbus lha ldan dang mtshungs pa'i yul bzang khri ga'i jo bo chen po la mjal du song / jo bo'i lha khang de dang po chos rje lhun grub rgya mtshos bzhengs/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis rab gnas mdzad/ de dus sangs rgyas byang sems mang po thim pa'i snang ba shar/ lha ldan jo bo dang byin rlabs mnyam zhes a mdo chos 'byung las gsungs/ jo bo byin rlabs can de'i sku mdun du dngul kong chen po mar khus bkang nas mar me gsal bor sbar/ gzhan yang brgya mchod dang chu gtsang gi mchod pa sogs dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul nas/ gsol ba btab bsngo sgon kyang byas nyi ma mang po bsdad/ phyag dang skor ba mang po byas/ der dad can khye go pa go la sogs khri ga'i lung ba'i yon bdag pho mo ya rabs brgya phrag mang po mjal du byung ba la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad nas kun gye blo kha dam pa'i chos la ci 'gyur byas te mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /bla med ston pa sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon des legs gsungs mdo sngags dam pa'i chos/ /chos kyi mdzod 97

'tshogs pa rnams kyis bden gnyis kyi don rtogs nas tshogs gnyis gsog pa la sngar bas brtson par gyur to/ /de nas chos kyi yul dbus lha ldan dang mtshungs pa'i yul bzang khri ga'i jo bo chen po la mjal du song / jo bo'i lha khang de dang po chos rje lhun grub rgya mtshos bzhengs/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis rab gnas mdzad/ de dus sangs rgyas byang sems mang po thim pa'i snang ba shar/ lha ldan jo bo dang byin rlabs mnyam zhes a mdo chos 'byung las gsungs/ jo bo byin rlabs can de'i sku mdun du dngul kong chen po mar khus bkang nas mar me gsal bor sbar/ gzhan yang brgya mchod dang chu gtsang gi mchod pa sogs dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul nas/ gsol ba btab bsngo sgon kyang byas nyi ma mang po bsdad/ phyag dang skor ba mang po byas/ der dad can khye go pa go la sogs khri ga'i lung ba'i yon bdag pho mo ya rabs brgya phrag mang po mjal du byung ba la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad nas kun gye blo kha dam pa'i chos la ci 'gyur byas te mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /bla med ston pa sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon des legs gsungs mdo sngags dam pa'i chos/ /chos kyi mdzod 97

'dzin dge 'dun gtan gyi skyabs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyis 'gro kun skyongs/ /mi rgan glu dbyangs len par mi rigs mod/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor rang gshis yin pas na/ /dam pa'i chos kyi glu dbyangs len pa la/ /yon bdag pho mo dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /'di dang phyi ma'i bde skyid ma lus pa/ /dam pa'i lha chos byas las 'byung ngo zhes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la nam yang bslu ba med/ /de phyir nam 'chi cha med tshul soms la/ /phyi mar 'gro ba'i mi zad rgyags phye ru/ /dmigs la mchod sbyin phyag skor kha ton sogs/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bad par mdzod/ /lha chos byas na phyi mar nam 'gro yang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /'gro ba'i lam gcig sangs rgyas zhing gcig cing / /sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i skal ba yod/ /mgur dbyangs 'di nyid blangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod ming yang mi grags shing / /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces blangs pas yon bdag rnams sngar bas dad cing gus par gyur/ yang nyin cig ban bon sngags gsum/ rgya bod sog gsum 98

'dzin dge 'dun gtan gyi skyabs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyis 'gro kun skyongs/ /mi rgan glu dbyangs len par mi rigs mod/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor rang gshis yin pas na/ /dam pa'i chos kyi glu dbyangs len pa la/ /yon bdag pho mo dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /'di dang phyi ma'i bde skyid ma lus pa/ /dam pa'i lha chos byas las 'byung ngo zhes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la nam yang bslu ba med/ /de phyir nam 'chi cha med tshul soms la/ /phyi mar 'gro ba'i mi zad rgyags phye ru/ /dmigs la mchod sbyin phyag skor kha ton sogs/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bad par mdzod/ /lha chos byas na phyi mar nam 'gro yang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /'gro ba'i lam gcig sangs rgyas zhing gcig cing / /sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i skal ba yod/ /mgur dbyangs 'di nyid blangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod ming yang mi grags shing / /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces blangs pas yon bdag rnams sngar bas dad cing gus par gyur/ yang nyin cig ban bon sngags gsum/ rgya bod sog gsum 98

sogs kyi mi sna mang po 'tshogs pa'i dus shig la/ chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang yong ba'i chos bshad 'di ltar byas/ 'o bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyis mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'job par bya ba'i phyir/ gang 'dul gyi sku'i bkod pa cir yang bstan nas gang 'tsham gye chos ston pa yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ nga yi bstan pa rnam gnyis te/ /dman pa mu stegs theg pa dang / /mchog gyur sangs rgyas theg pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis rang gi bstan pa'i che ba 'byin phyir/ rgyal po rkang ba brgyad pa'i sras su sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul bstan nas/ mu stegs pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad gsungs pa yin skad/ des na dad gug dag snang byed pa ma gtogs smad cing spang mi rung ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ mu stegs can la smod mi bya/ /mu stegs can la smad gyur na/ /rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyu/ /spyan snga bas/ mu stegs lam gyi gtso bo rnams kyang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bstan pa yin pas sgod par mi bya gsungs/ phyi nang gi chos gang la chags sdang med 99

sogs kyi mi sna mang po 'tshogs pa'i dus shig la/ chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang yong ba'i chos bshad 'di ltar byas/ 'o bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyis mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'job par bya ba'i phyir/ gang 'dul gyi sku'i bkod pa cir yang bstan nas gang 'tsham gye chos ston pa yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ nga yi bstan pa rnam gnyis te/ /dman pa mu stegs theg pa dang / /mchog gyur sangs rgyas theg pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis rang gi bstan pa'i che ba 'byin phyir/ rgyal po rkang ba brgyad pa'i sras su sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul bstan nas/ mu stegs pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad gsungs pa yin skad/ des na dad gus dag snang byed pa ma gtogs smad cing spang mi rung ste/ rnam rgeng mngon byang las/ mu stegs can la smod mi bya/ /mu stegs can la smad gyur na/ /rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyu/ /spyan snga bas/ mu stegs lam gyi gtso bo rnams kyang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bstan pa yin pas sgod par mi bya gsungs/ phyi nang gi chos gang la chags sdang med 99

pa ni/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i mchog yin te/ yum las/ gang dag sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la rjes su chags pa yang med la/ mu stegs can gyi chos la khong khro ba ma mchis pa de dag gis chos yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /gang dag chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur yang / chos dang chos ma lags pa'i 'du shes la mi spyod pa de dag gis dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ yang ston pa sangs rgyas kyis bon gyi ston pa gshen rab sogs su sprul nas bon gyi gzhung phal cher bstan pa yin skad/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ gshen lha 'od dkar spyan ras gzigs dbang yin/ /gtsang ma'i bon dang chos la khyad par med/ /gsungs/ rgyal bu blo gros 'phel gyis/ rgya gar nang pa'i blo ngo na/ /de ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /blo gros 'phel zhes 'bod par byed/ /bon po gshen lha 'od dkar zhes/ /da lta lcags 'bar bu ru 'bod/ /phyi pa dbang phyug chen po zhes/ /chos kyang de dang mtshungs par smra/ /zhes dang / spyan snga bas/ bon po'ang nang pa'i khyad chos rnams khas len par 'dug pas nang pa la the bar mngon no gsungs/ zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon gyis/'o skol bon la'ang re chod mi bgyi'o zhes gsungs/ des na bon la'ang dad gus dag snang byed pa ma gtogs khas gtan nas 100

pa ni/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i mchog yin te/ yum las/ gang dag sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la rjes su chags pa yang med la/ mu stegs can gyi chos la khong khro ba ma mchis pa de dag gis chos yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /gang dag chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur yang / chos dang chos ma lags pa'i 'du shes la mi spyod pa de dag gis dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ yang ston pa sangs rgyas kyis bon gyi ston pa gshen rab sogs su sprul nas bon gyi gzhung phal cher bstan pa yin skad/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ gshen lha 'od dkar spyan ras gzigs dbang yin/ /gtsang ma'i bon dang chos la khyad par med/ /gsungs/ rgyal bu blo gros 'phel gyis/ rgya gar nang pa'i blo ngo na/ /de ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /blo gros 'phel zhes 'bod par byed/ /bon po gshen lha 'od dkar zhes/ /da lta lcags 'bar bu ru 'bod/ /phyi pa dbang phyug chen po zhes/ /chos kyang de dang mtshungs par smra/ /zhes dang / spyan snga bas/ bon po'ang nang pa'i khyad chos rnams khas len par 'dug pas nang pa la the bar mngon no gsungs/ zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon gyis/'o skol bon la'ang re chod mi bgyi'o zhes gsungs/ des na bon la'ang dad gus dag snang byed pa ma gtogs khas gtan nas 100

gtong bar mi bya'o/ /gal te grub mtha' gzhan la smad na mi des bslabs tshad chu la 'bo ba yin pas/ nam yang thar pa thob mi srid de/ rje mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/ mkhas btsun thams cad thugs mthun par/ /pho rus chags sdang byed pa rnams/ /bslabs tshad chu la 'bo ba yin/ /chos la dkar nag med pa la/ /grub mtha'i kha 'dzin chos la smod/ /thar pa'i 'ju thag chad pa yin/ /gsungs/ des na phyi rol ba/ bon po/ hwa shang / rnying ma/bka' brgyud pa/ sa skya/ dge ldan pa sogs phyi nang gi chos lugs grub mtha' thams cad thub dbang sras bcas kyi rnam 'phrul du shes par byas/ mi spang bar gong du 'khur dgos te/zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon gyis/ 'o skol rang cag chos dang chos min zhes/ /khyad du mi gsod ris su mi bcad cing / /thams cad thub dbang sras bcas rnam 'phrul du/ /shes par bya zhing mi spang 'khur bgyi'o/ /zhes dang / rje rgod tshang bas/ngas dam chos thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas bzhag tshe 'di blos gtong ba/ sprang po'i dman sa bzung nas thams cad spyi bor 'khur ba/kun la dag snang sbyong ba gsum yin/ bslab pa rin po che gsum mam/ sdom pa gsum yang 'dir 'dus sam snyam gsungs pa ltar/ ngas kyang gzhon nu'i dus nas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad 101

gtong bar mi bya'o/ /gal te grub mtha' gzhan la smad na mi des bslabs tshad chu la 'bo ba yin pas/ nam yang thar pa thob mi srid de/ rje mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/ mkhas btsun thams cad thugs mthun par/ /pho rus chags sdang byed pa rnams/ /bslabs tshad chu la 'bo ba yin/ /chos la dkar nag med pa la/ /grub mtha'i kha 'dzin chos la smod/ /thar pa'i 'ju thag chad pa yin/ /gsungs/ des na phyi rol ba/ bon po/ hwa shang / rnying ma/bka' brgyud pa/ sa skya/ dge ldan pa sogs phyi nang gi chos lugs grub mtha' thams cad thub dbang sras bcas kyi rnam 'phrul du shes par byas/ mi spang bar gong du 'khur dgos te/zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon gyis/ 'o skol rang cag chos dang chos min zhes/ /khyad du mi gsod ris su mi bcad cing / /thams cad thub dbang sras bcas rnam 'phrul du/ /shes par bya zhing mi spang 'khur bgyi'o/ /zhes dang / rje rgod tshang bas/ngas dam chos thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas bzhag tshe 'di blos gtong ba/ sprang po'i dman sa bzung nas thams cad spyi bor 'khur ba/kun la dag snang sbyong ba gsum yin/ bslab pa rin po che gsum mam/ sdom pa gsum yang 'dir 'dus sam snyam gsungs pa ltar/ ngas kyang gzhon nu'i dus nas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad 101

blos btang nas phyogs med kyi rgyal khams gang bzang dang /nges med kyi ri khrod nyams dga' rnams 'grims dus/ sprang po bzhin dman sa bzung nas thams cad spyi bor khur/ phyi nang gi grub mtha' gang la'ang dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin song bas/gang du song yang de dag thams cad kyis nga la yang mchod bstod bkur nas rang gzhan gyi don thams cad 'grub pa byung / des na khyed rnams kyis kyang de bzhin gyis dang bzang gi zhes bshad pas/ de kun gyis khyed phyi nang gi grub mtha' gang la'ang phyogs ris med pa ngo mtshar che/ nged rnams kyis kyang de ltar yong ba'i smon lam 'debs zhes dga' zhing spro bzhin rang rang so so'i gnas su mi rtag sgyu ma'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas song ngo //de nas khri ga'i lung ba gnyis kyi dgon gnas dang / sde ba phal cher zhig gi nang du song / dgon pa tsho'i rten la rab gnas byen rlabs 'dra byas/ khyem tshang nang du song bgegs bskrad bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis brjod/ khyim tshang tsho mthun dgos pha ma tshor brtsi bkur gyis sogs kyi kha ta 'dra bcug pas/ kun sems dga' nas/ rta nor gro nas dong tse ras dang kha btags sogs kyi 'bul ba mang po phul ba'i nang nas/ rgya 102

blos btang nas phyogs med kyi rgyal khams gang bzang dang /nges med kyi ri khrod nyams dga' rnams 'grims dus/ sprang po bzhin dman sa bzung nas thams cad spyi bor khur/ phyi nang gi grub mtha' gang la'ang dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin song bas/gang du song yang de dag thams cad kyis nga la yang mchod bstod bkur nas rang gzhan gyi don thams cad 'grub pa byung / des na khyed rnams kyis kyang de bzhin gyis dang bzang gi zhes bshad pas/ de kun gyis khyed phyi nang gi grub mtha' gang la'ang phyogs ris med pa ngo mtshar che/ nged rnams kyis kyang de ltar yong ba'i smon lam 'debs zhes dga' zhing spro bzhin rang rang so so'i gnas su mi rtag sgyu ma'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas song ngo //de nas khri ga'i lung ba gnyis kyi dgon gnas dang / sde ba phal cher zhig gi nang du song / dgon pa tsho'i rten la rab gnas byen rlabs 'dra byas/ khyem tshang nang du song bgegs bskrad bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis brjod/ khyim tshang tsho mthun dgos pha ma tshor brtsi bkur gyis sogs kyi kha ta 'dra bcug pas/ kun sems dga' nas/ rta nor gro nas dong tse ras dang kha btags sogs kyi 'bul ba mang po phul ba'i nang nas/ rgya 102

mkhar nang gi lha khang bzhengs pa'i dkar thig mtshon byed la rta gcig phul/ de ma yin pa'i gzhan rnams jo bo'i lha khang gi phyi ra nang skor la nyams gso byas/ jo bo chen po la seng ges btegs pa'i khri dang / g.yas g.yon gyi sku gnyis kyi khri yang grub dbang pad+ma rang grol gyis nyams gso gsar bskrun mdzad/nang gi mdun du mchod khri chen po gsum phyi khyams skor lam gyi ngos la ldebs bris sna tshogs dang / sa la mthil shing brgyab nas slar gsar bzhengs lta bu phyi na blta rgyu dang / nang na mjal rgyu yod pa byas/ de'i rgyu song la dong tse khron stong tsho tsam zhig gi rtsis song / rab gnas dga' ston yag po byas pas mi dga' lha dga' byung / yang der 'tshogs pa'i dad can gyi slob ma yon bdag skya ser pho mo mang po la 'di skad smras/ 'o skol rnams kyis rten khyad par can rnams la nyams gso byas/ rten med pa'i sa phyogs tshor sku gsung thugs rten re bzheng thub na phan yon che ste/ sngon rig sngags grub pa'i bram ze zhig gis/ mchod sdong bsgrubs nas bzhag pas/ rang nyid tshe'i dus byas kyang rjes 'jug rnams kyi 'dod pa mchod sdong gis skong bar byed pa ltar/ sngon byon sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis lha ldan jo shāka rnam gnyis dang /103

mkhar nang gi lha khang bzhengs pa'i dkar thig mtshon byed la rta gcig phul/ de ma yin pa'i gzhan rnams jo bo'i lha khang gi phyi ra nang skor la nyams gso byas/ jo bo chen po la seng ges btegs pa'i khri dang / g.yas g.yon gyi sku gnyis kyi khri yang grub dbang pad+ma rang grol gyis nyams gso gsar bskrun mdzad/nang gi mdun du mchod khri chen po gsum phyi khyams skor lam gyi ngos la ldebs bris sna tshogs dang / sa la mthil shing brgyab nas slar gsar bzhengs lta bu phyi na blta rgyu dang / nang na mjal rgyu yod pa byas/ de'i rgyu song la dong tse khron stong tsho tsam zhig gi rtsis song / rab gnas dga' ston yag po byas pas mi dga' lha dga' byung / yang der 'tshogs pa'i dad can gyi slob ma yon bdag skya ser pho mo mang po la 'di skad smras/ 'o skol rnams kyis rten khyad par can rnams la nyams gso byas/ rten med pa'i sa phyogs tshor sku gsung thugs rten re bzheng thub na phan yon che ste/ sngon rig sngags grub pa'i bram ze zhig gis/ mchod sdong bsgrubs nas bzhag pas/ rang nyid tshe'i dus byas kyang rjes 'jug rnams kyi 'dod pa mchod sdong gis skong bar byed pa ltar/ sngon byon sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis lha ldan jo shāka rnam gnyis dang /103

jo bo 'di la sogs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten khyad par can bzhengs/ rab gnas bsngo smon bkra shis byas nas bzhag pas/ rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams kyi phyogs la phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba yin/ des na rten khyad par can rnams la nyams gso byas te nyams su mi 'jug pa dang / rten med pa'i sa phyogs tsho la yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten re bzheng thub na 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bstan 'gro la phan thogs rgya chen po yong / bskal pa zhig pa'i dus su yang rten khyad par can rnams zhig pa'i rdul rnams rdul gzhan dang mi 'dres par yid bzhin gyi nor bur gyur nas sems can gyi don byed par bshad de/slob dpon dbyeg gnyen gyi dngos slob rgya'i slob dpon wen tsheg gis/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel gye 'grel bar/ klu sgrub kyis yum gyi 'grel ba'i lung khungs su drangs par/ rten gsum gye rdul rnams bskal pa zhig pa'i dus su yang / rdul gzhan dang mi 'dres par yid bzhin gyi nor bur gyur nas sems can gyi don byed par bshad do/ /zhes gsungs 'dug ces bshad pas kun dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas phyag mang du byas te/ rang rang gi yul du song ngo / /lo de'i ston ka rma phar 104

jo bo 'di la sogs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten khyad par can bzhengs/ rab gnas bsngo smon bkra shis byas nas bzhag pas/ rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams kyi phyogs la phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba yin/ des na rten khyad par can rnams la nyams gso byas te nyams su mi 'jug pa dang / rten med pa'i sa phyogs tsho la yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten re bzheng thub na 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bstan 'gro la phan thogs rgya chen po yong / bskal pa zhig pa'i dus su yang rten khyad par can rnams zhig pa'i rdul rnams rdul gzhan dang mi 'dres par yid bzhin gyi nor bur gyur nas sems can gyi don byed par bshad de/slob dpon dbyeg gnyen gyi dngos slob rgya'i slob dpon wen tsheg gis/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel gye 'grel bar/ klu sgrub kyis yum gyi 'grel ba'i lung khungs su drangs par/ rten gsum gye rdul rnams bskal pa zhig pa'i dus su yang / rdul gzhan dang mi 'dres par yid bzhin gyi nor bur gyur nas sems can gyi don byed par bshad do/ /zhes gsungs 'dug ces bshad pas kun dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas phyag mang du byas te/ rang rang gi yul du song ngo / /lo de'i ston ka rma phar 104

kha'i sgo me'i phyogs su song / hor rgya'i dad can yon bdag rnams la chos bshad 'di 'dra byas/ 'o dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu la zas gos sogs thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung yang /mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mi 'byung / mi lus rin po che 'di la brten nas chos byas na mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub tshe 'dir 'byung bas yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag zer ba yin/ da re tsam ma gtogs phyin chad rnyed dka' ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan mi lus rin po che thob pa la/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar nas thob dgos pas na/ deng sang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na rgyu de gsum sgrub pa dkon pas na rnyed dka'/ rnyed par dka' ba tsam du ma zad 'jig par sla ba nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra bas na/ tshul de bsams nas snying po med pa'i tshe 'di'i bya ba spangs nas dam pa'i chos kyi snying po len dgos te/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da re tsam zhig yin/ /rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /tshul 'di bsams nas 'jig rten bya ba kun/ /sbun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur 105

kha'i sgo me'i phyogs su song / hor rgya'i dad can yon bdag rnams la chos bshad 'di 'dra byas/ 'o dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu la zas gos sogs thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung yang /mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mi 'byung / mi lus rin po che 'di la brten nas chos byas na mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub tshe 'dir 'byung bas yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag zer ba yin/ da re tsam ma gtogs phyin chad rnyed dka' ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan mi lus rin po che thob pa la/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar nas thob dgos pas na/ deng sang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na rgyu de gsum sgrub pa dkon pas na rnyed dka'/ rnyed par dka' ba tsam du ma zad 'jig par sla ba nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra bas na/ tshul de bsams nas snying po med pa'i tshe 'di'i bya ba spangs nas dam pa'i chos kyi snying po len dgos te/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da re tsam zhig yin/ /rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /tshul 'di bsams nas 'jig rten bya ba kun/ /sbun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur 105

nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa dgos/ /gsungs pa yin/ dper na dpyid ka rgyu sa bon mngar kha gang btab pa rnams ston kha so sor smin pa bzhin/ tshe 'dir rgyu dge sdig gang byas kyang tshe phyi mar 'bras bu bde sdug so sor smin pa'i tshul la bsams nas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sems can gzhan gyi srog gcod pa/ ma byin pa len pa/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa/dzun gtam pa/ phra ma 'jug pa/ tshig rtsub smra ba/ don med ngag 'khyal lab pa/ gzhan gyi nor la rnab sems byed pa/ gnod sems 'dzin pa/ las rgyu 'bras la log par lta ba rnams la mi dge ba bcu zer ba yin pas dug bzhin du spong dgos/ sems can gzhan gye srog skyob pa/ ma chags par sbyin pa gtong ba/sdom pa bsrung ba/ bden par smra ba/ mi mthun pa 'dum pa/ zhi zhing des par smra ba/ don dang ldan pa'i gtam brjod pa/'dod chung chog shes pa/ sems can gzhan la byams pa las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa rnams dge ba bcu yin pas dang du blangs nas bsgrub dgos/ de yang gnas skabs su mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru dmigs nas bsgrubs na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad 106

nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa dgos/ /gsungs pa yin/ dper na dpyid ka rgyu sa bon mngar kha gang btab pa rnams ston kha so sor smin pa bzhin/ tshe 'dir rgyu dge sdig gang byas kyang tshe phyi mar 'bras bu bde sdug so sor smin pa'i tshul la bsams nas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sems can gzhan gyi srog gcod pa/ ma byin pa len pa/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa/dzun gtam pa/ phra ma 'jug pa/ tshig rtsub smra ba/ don med ngag 'khyal lab pa/ gzhan gyi nor la rnab sems byed pa/ gnod sems 'dzin pa/ las rgyu 'bras la log par lta ba rnams la mi dge ba bcu zer ba yin pas dug bzhin du spong dgos/ sems can gzhan gye srog skyob pa/ ma chags par sbyin pa gtong ba/sdom pa bsrung ba/ bden par smra ba/ mi mthun pa 'dum pa/ zhi zhing des par smra ba/ don dang ldan pa'i gtam brjod pa/'dod chung chog shes pa/ sems can gzhan la byams pa las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa rnams dge ba bcu yin pas dang du blangs nas bsgrub dgos/ de yang gnas skabs su mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru dmigs nas bsgrubs na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad 106

yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur zhes las rgyu 'bras kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /sngon lha mi'i ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa'i phyir/ /las rgyu 'bras bden pa'i chos 'di gsungs/ /gsung 'di la kun gyis gus pas nyon/ /rgyu sa bon tsha ba dpyid btab na/ /'bras tsha ba ston dus smin pa bzhin/ /rgyu sdig pa tshe 'dir byas gyur na/ /'bras sdug bsngal phyi mar smin par 'gyur/ /rgyu sa bon mngar ba dpyid btab na/ /'bras mngar ba ston dus smin pa bzhin/ /rgyu dge ba tshe 'dir byas gyur na/ /'bras bde ba phyi mar smin par 'gyur/ /tshe 'di ru lus sems mi sdug phyir/ /mtshon dug sogs gnod la 'dzems pa bzhin/ /tshe phyi mar sdug bsngal mi 'byung phyir/ /las mi dge'i sdig la 'dzem pa dgos/ /tshe 'di ru lus sems bde ba'i phyir/ /zas gos sogs phan pa sgrub pa ltar/ /tshe phyi mar bde skyid 'byung ba'i phyir/ /las rnam dkar dge la 'bad pa dgos/ /sman dug gnyis shes bzhin dug zos na/ /mi de las smyon pa gzhan med bzhin/ /las rgyu 'bras shes bzhin sdig bsags na/ /mi de ni snying med smyon pa dngos/ /chos zab zab myur myur mang na yang / /las rgyu 'bras chos las zab pa med/ /chos byed 107

yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur zhes las rgyu 'bras kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /sngon lha mi'i ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa'i phyir/ /las rgyu 'bras bden pa'i chos 'di gsungs/ /gsung 'di la kun gyis gus pas nyon/ /rgyu sa bon tsha ba dpyid btab na/ /'bras tsha ba ston dus smin pa bzhin/ /rgyu sdig pa tshe 'dir byas gyur na/ /'bras sdug bsngal phyi mar smin par 'gyur/ /rgyu sa bon mngar ba dpyid btab na/ /'bras mngar ba ston dus smin pa bzhin/ /rgyu dge ba tshe 'dir byas gyur na/ /'bras bde ba phyi mar smin par 'gyur/ /tshe 'di ru lus sems mi sdug phyir/ /mtshon dug sogs gnod la 'dzems pa bzhin/ /tshe phyi mar sdug bsngal mi 'byung phyir/ /las mi dge'i sdig la 'dzem pa dgos/ /tshe 'di ru lus sems bde ba'i phyir/ /zas gos sogs phan pa sgrub pa ltar/ /tshe phyi mar bde skyid 'byung ba'i phyir/ /las rnam dkar dge la 'bad pa dgos/ /sman dug gnyis shes bzhin dug zos na/ /mi de las smyon pa gzhan med bzhin/ /las rgyu 'bras shes bzhin sdig bsags na/ /mi de ni snying med smyon pa dngos/ /chos zab zab myur myur mang na yang / /las rgyu 'bras chos las zab pa med/ /chos byed 107

na mang po shes mi dgos/ /las rgyu 'bras brtsi ba gcig pus chog /sdig ma byas phyi mar mi sdug snyam/ /nam 'chi rung sems la 'gyod pa med/ /dge byas pas phyi mar skyid yong snyam/ /sems dga' zhing spro bzhin 'chi bar 'gyur/ /las rgyu 'bras yod par blta ba 'di/ /khyed 'jig rten pa yi lta ba de/ /mi gang gi rgyud na yod gyur kyang / /yar mtho nas mtho ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes kun gyi sems la phan po byung nas nang nas sdig pa sna re spong ba dang / dge ba sna re sgrub pa'i khas len byed mkhan mang po byung ngo / /yang nyin cig dad gtong blo gros che ba'i sgo me'i mtshams pa rig gsal sogs dad can slob ma sngags 'chang mang pos/gsang sngags snga 'gyur 'di la khas gtong mkhan mang po 'di ci las byung ba yin nam snyam/ zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/bla ma yongs la dad gus che/ /mched grogs yongs la brtse dung che/ /sems can yongs la snying rje che/ /chos lugs yongs la dag snang che/ /chos pa'i khyad chos che ba bzhi/ /ldan pa'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ /rje khyed snyan gyi dbang po la/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma lags te/ /snga 'gyur rdzogs pa chen po 'di/ /nyams su 108

na mang po shes mi dgos/ /las rgyu 'bras brtsi ba gcig pus chog /sdig ma byas phyi mar mi sdug snyam/ /nam 'chi rung sems la 'gyod pa med/ /dge byas pas phyi mar skyid yong snyam/ /sems dga' zhing spro bzhin 'chi bar 'gyur/ /las rgyu 'bras yod par blta ba 'di/ /khyed 'jig rten pa yi lta ba de/ /mi gang gi rgyud na yod gyur kyang / /yar mtho nas mtho ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes kun gyi sems la phan po byung nas nang nas sdig pa sna re spong ba dang / dge ba sna re sgrub pa'i khas len byed mkhan mang po byung ngo / /yang nyin cig dad gtong blo gros che ba'i sgo me'i mtshams pa rig gsal sogs dad can slob ma sngags 'chang mang pos/gsang sngags snga 'gyur 'di la khas gtong mkhan mang po 'di ci las byung ba yin nam snyam/ zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/bla ma yongs la dad gus che/ /mched grogs yongs la brtse dung che/ /sems can yongs la snying rje che/ /chos lugs yongs la dag snang che/ /chos pa'i khyad chos che ba bzhi/ /ldan pa'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ /rje khyed snyan gyi dbang po la/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma lags te/ /snga 'gyur rdzogs pa chen po 'di/ /nyams su 108

blangs pas grol ba dang / /grub pa brnyes pa dpag med cig /byung ba'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus mang / /'on kyang 'di la snga mo dang / /da lta kha yis gtong mkhan snang / /khyed kyis de yi rgyu mtshan zhig /bdag cag rnams la gsung du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yi rgyu mtshan ni/ sngon dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mkhas grub rin po che la/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba 'di la snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi yang dgag pa 'dug cing / da lta yang sgur ba 'debs pa mang du 'dug pa 'di ji 'dra yin zhus pa la/ khong gi zhal nas/ gsang sngags bstan pa snga dar gye dus su bsgyur pa la rnying ma dang / phyi dar gyi dus bsgyur pa la gsar ma zhes 'byung ba yin/ rnying ma la skur ba 'debs pa mang ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/sngon glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas bar stong byung dus/gsang sngags pa rnams sbyor sgol la sogs pa spyod pa phyin ci log byed pa byung ba dang / deng sang yang khyim pa lcang lo can gye spyod pa mang bas/ gang zag gi spyod pa la dpags nas/ chos la sgod pa 'di byung ba 'dra/ de min sngags rnying ma 'di dang po chos rgyal dam pa rnams kyis bai ro tsā na dang / rma gnyags gnyis/ dge slong mi lnga la sogs pa'i tshad ma'i skyes bur gyur 109

blangs pas grol ba dang / /grub pa brnyes pa dpag med cig /byung ba'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus mang / /'on kyang 'di la snga mo dang / /da lta kha yis gtong mkhan snang / /khyed kyis de yi rgyu mtshan zhig /bdag cag rnams la gsung du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yi rgyu mtshan ni/ sngon dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mkhas grub rin po che la/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba 'di la snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi yang dgag pa 'dug cing / da lta yang sgur ba 'debs pa mang du 'dug pa 'di ji 'dra yin zhus pa la/ khong gi zhal nas/ gsang sngags bstan pa snga dar gye dus su bsgyur pa la rnying ma dang / phyi dar gyi dus bsgyur pa la gsar ma zhes 'byung ba yin/ rnying ma la skur ba 'debs pa mang ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/sngon glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas bar stong byung dus/gsang sngags pa rnams sbyor sgol la sogs pa spyod pa phyin ci log byed pa byung ba dang / deng sang yang khyim pa lcang lo can gye spyod pa mang bas/ gang zag gi spyod pa la dpags nas/ chos la sgod pa 'di byung ba 'dra/ de min sngags rnying ma 'di dang po chos rgyal dam pa rnams kyis bai ro tsā na dang / rma gnyags gnyis/ dge slong mi lnga la sogs pa'i tshad ma'i skyes bur gyur 109
