pa'i lo tsā ba rnams la gser brer gzhal la yon du bskur nas rgya gar du brdzangs te/ rdzogs pa chen po la sogs pa'i chos rnams parnyi ta dang grub pa brnyes pa rtsod med du grags pa rnams la zhus shing bsgyur/ gzhan yang pad+ma 'byung gnas dang /bi mā la mi tra dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba la sogs pa'ang bod du spyan drangs nas/ de dag gis kyang gsungs pa'i chos/ theg pa bla na med pa'i chos zab mo skyon dang bral ba yin te/ 'di'i tshul nyams su blangs pas grol ba dang / grub pa brnyes pa dpag tu med pa byung ba tshad mas grub bo/ /bsam yas na da dung snga 'gyur gyi rgya dpe mang du yod par 'dug cing / bod pa lo tsā ba yang rgya gar du byon nas yul dbus 'gyur tshal na gsar rnying lung gi mdo la sogs rgya dpe 'dug zer/ des na 'di lta bu'i theg chen bla na med pa'i chos zab mo la skur ba 'debs pa rnams ni dmyal ba'i rgyu kho nar 'dug pas so zhes gsungs/yang rje yab sras gnyis ga'i dngos slob spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ gtso bo rnying ma'i rdzogs rim sogs ston pa yin pas rdzogs chen la sangs rgyas kyi chos med ces byar mi rung la/chos sgong las ni mtshams med las kyang lci ba mang du gsungs pas bag yod gyis gsungs/ las kyi rdo rjes zhus pa/ rdzogs pa 110

pa'i lo tsā ba rnams la gser brer gzhal la yon du bskur nas rgya gar du brdzangs te/ rdzogs pa chen po la sogs pa'i chos rnams parnyi ta dang grub pa brnyes pa rtsod med du grags pa rnams la zhus shing bsgyur/ gzhan yang pad+ma 'byung gnas dang /bi mā la mi tra dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba la sogs pa'ang bod du spyan drangs nas/ de dag gis kyang gsungs pa'i chos/ theg pa bla na med pa'i chos zab mo skyon dang bral ba yin te/ 'di'i tshul nyams su blangs pas grol ba dang / grub pa brnyes pa dpag tu med pa byung ba tshad mas grub bo/ /bsam yas na da dung snga 'gyur gyi rgya dpe mang du yod par 'dug cing / bod pa lo tsā ba yang rgya gar du byon nas yul dbus 'gyur tshal na gsar rnying lung gi mdo la sogs rgya dpe 'dug zer/ des na 'di lta bu'i theg chen bla na med pa'i chos zab mo la skur ba 'debs pa rnams ni dmyal ba'i rgyu kho nar 'dug pas so zhes gsungs/yang rje yab sras gnyis ga'i dngos slob spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ gtso bo rnying ma'i rdzogs rim sogs ston pa yin pas rdzogs chen la sangs rgyas kyi chos med ces byar mi rung la/chos sgong las ni mtshams med las kyang lci ba mang du gsungs pas bag yod gyis gsungs/ las kyi rdo rjes zhus pa/ rdzogs pa 110

chen po 'di lta ba rnam dag lags sam/ zhes gsol pas/gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ rdzogs pa chen po yang lta ba mthon po yin gsungs/ pha dam pa la slob ma kha cig na re/ dam pa rdzogs pa chen po la las dkar nag gi 'bras bu med par 'dod skad na/ de bde'am mi bde zhus pas/ rdzogs na bde gsungs/ de lta ba mtho ba ma lags sam zhus pas/ rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' dang 'dra ba yin/ nam mkha' la mtho dman gda' ye gsungs/ras chung rdo rje grags kyis/ chos snga 'gyur 'di la la las 'thab cing 'dug pa/ 'di la sangs rgyas kyi gsung ngo shes so zhus pas/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas ma gsungs pa'i chos shig lo paṇa sprul sku rnams kyis khyer ga na yong gsungs/ yang mnyam med dwags po rin po ches/ mi mang rab cig yod pa'i dus su rdzogs chen ci tsug lags zhus pas/ rje mi las/ bla ma mar pa'i zhal nas/chos min pa skad zer te/ chos min par mi 'dug sa drug pa bdun pa yan chad kyi chos su 'dug gsungs/ grub thob o rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ rdzogs pa chen po chos ma yin zhes nges pa'i don rtsa ba nas spong ba/ don dam pa'i bden pa rtsa ba nas spong ba/chos zab mo gting nas spong ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don rtsa 111

chen po 'di lta ba rnam dag lags sam/ zhes gsol pas/gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ rdzogs pa chen po yang lta ba mthon po yin gsungs/ pha dam pa la slob ma kha cig na re/ dam pa rdzogs pa chen po la las dkar nag gi 'bras bu med par 'dod skad na/ de bde'am mi bde zhus pas/ rdzogs na bde gsungs/ de lta ba mtho ba ma lags sam zhus pas/ rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' dang 'dra ba yin/ nam mkha' la mtho dman gda' ye gsungs/ras chung rdo rje grags kyis/ chos snga 'gyur 'di la la las 'thab cing 'dug pa/ 'di la sangs rgyas kyi gsung ngo shes so zhus pas/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas ma gsungs pa'i chos shig lo paṇa sprul sku rnams kyis khyer ga na yong gsungs/ yang mnyam med dwags po rin po ches/ mi mang rab cig yod pa'i dus su rdzogs chen ci tsug lags zhus pas/ rje mi las/ bla ma mar pa'i zhal nas/chos min pa skad zer te/ chos min par mi 'dug sa drug pa bdun pa yan chad kyi chos su 'dug gsungs/ grub thob o rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ rdzogs pa chen po chos ma yin zhes nges pa'i don rtsa ba nas spong ba/ don dam pa'i bden pa rtsa ba nas spong ba/chos zab mo gting nas spong ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don rtsa 111

ba nas spong ba gsungs/ yang rdzogs pa chen po chos ma yin zer ba khas 'ches pas/ theg pa chen po spong ba'i rtsa ltung yong bas de skad zlar mi btub/ skur ba de lta bu ma btab par/ rang gi rgyud dang mthun pa'i chos de nyams su blangs na legs pa yin gsungs/ rje btsun chen po skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ chos lta ba'i rgyal po rdzogs pa che/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ chos nyid rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rtse/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun las 'phags pas na/ /'di dang su phrad tshe 'dir grol ba thob/ /gsungs/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos/ pad 'byung bi mā la dang bai ro dang / /bka' gter las 'ongs snga 'gyur rdzogs pa che/ /mkhas blun bar ma gang gis nyams blangs kyang / /tshegs chung don che 'phrul gyi gnad gsang zab/ /dper na mi pham mgon po ches rgan pa/ /bai ros tshe der byang chub lam la khrid/ /rgya bod gnyis ka rtogs grol dus gcig tu/ /byung ba'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus pha mtha' yas/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du gsar rnying gi mkhas grub mang po'i bsngags brjod kyang mang / sngon bsags bsod nams can ma gtogs su gang yin chos zab mo 'di dang mjal ba dang thos pa yang dka' ste/kun mkhyen chen pos/ theg chen bskal pa rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed 112

ba nas spong ba gsungs/ yang rdzogs pa chen po chos ma yin zer ba khas 'ches pas/ theg pa chen po spong ba'i rtsa ltung yong bas de skad zlar mi btub/ skur ba de lta bu ma btab par/ rang gi rgyud dang mthun pa'i chos de nyams su blangs na legs pa yin gsungs/ rje btsun chen po skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ chos lta ba'i rgyal po rdzogs pa che/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ chos nyid rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rtse/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun las 'phags pas na/ /'di dang su phrad tshe 'dir grol ba thob/ /gsungs/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos/ pad 'byung bi mā la dang bai ro dang / /bka' gter las 'ongs snga 'gyur rdzogs pa che/ /mkhas blun bar ma gang gis nyams blangs kyang / /tshegs chung don che 'phrul gyi gnad gsang zab/ /dper na mi pham mgon po ches rgan pa/ /bai ros tshe der byang chub lam la khrid/ /rgya bod gnyis ka rtogs grol dus gcig tu/ /byung ba'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus pha mtha' yas/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du gsar rnying gi mkhas grub mang po'i bsngags brjod kyang mang / sngon bsags bsod nams can ma gtogs su gang yin chos zab mo 'di dang mjal ba dang thos pa yang dka' ste/kun mkhyen chen pos/ theg chen bskal pa rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed 112

nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab rdzogs pas/ /'di la 'jug pa'i skyes bu skal ba rab/ /gsungs/ rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos/ ha ha brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi bcud/ /a ru rnam rgyal lta bu'i gcig chog chos/ /thun re bsgom pa lta zhog thos pa yang / /bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bur gda'/ /gsungs/ des na sngon sbyangs las 'phro can gye gang zag gcig char ba zhig gam/ yang na tshe 'dir mtshan ldan gye bla ma bsten nas/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi khrid rgyab rten gyi lung dang bcas pa zhus nas bskyed rdzogs kyi lam la bag chags ci thebs byas/ de nas yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i chos zab mo zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i thabs mchog bla na med pa 'od gsal dang sgyu lus thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos/theg pa gzhan la ming tsam ma grags pa'i gdams pa o rgyan chen pos mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas blangs pa'i khregs chod thod rgal gnyis nyams su blangs na/ tshe gcig lus gcig la zung 'jug 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku bsnyes par gsungs pas/des na gang zag dbang po rab kyis nyams su longs/ ma lon 113

nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab rdzogs pas/ /'di la 'jug pa'i skyes bu skal ba rab/ /gsungs/ rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos/ ha ha brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi bcud/ /a ru rnam rgyal lta bu'i gcig chog chos/ /thun re bsgom pa lta zhog thos pa yang / /bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bur gda'/ /gsungs/ des na sngon sbyangs las 'phro can gye gang zag gcig char ba zhig gam/ yang na tshe 'dir mtshan ldan gye bla ma bsten nas/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi khrid rgyab rten gyi lung dang bcas pa zhus nas bskyed rdzogs kyi lam la bag chags ci thebs byas/ de nas yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i chos zab mo zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i thabs mchog bla na med pa 'od gsal dang sgyu lus thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos/theg pa gzhan la ming tsam ma grags pa'i gdams pa o rgyan chen pos mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas blangs pa'i khregs chod thod rgal gnyis nyams su blangs na/ tshe gcig lus gcig la zung 'jug 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku bsnyes par gsungs pas/des na gang zag dbang po rab kyis nyams su longs/ ma lon 113

kyang chos zab mo yin rgyu red snyam du dad gus dag snang rjes su yi rang gyis dang / bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob par 'gyur zhes snga 'gyur chos kyi che ba drug gi glu 'di blangs so/ /rgya gar mkhas grub lo paṇa thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byen gyis rlobs/ /snga 'gyur chos kyi che ba rnam pa drug /glu ru len gyis rab tu dga' bas nyon/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas grub rnams/ /bod yul dbus su gdan 'dren mdzad mkhan po/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa chos rgyal rnam gsum mchog /khri srong lde'u btsan yon bdag bsod nams che/ /khri gdugs 'og na 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /dpal gyi bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi/ /chos 'khor smad nas mdo sngags chos kun bsgyur/ /sgra bsgyur gling de bkra shis byin rlabs che/ /bai ro tsā na ska cog zhang gsum sogs/ /sprul pa'i lo tsā ba yis chos kyi don/ /ji lta ba bzhin gtan la phab pas na/ /sgra bsgyur lo tsā ba rnams yon tan che/ /mkhan chen zhi 'tsho sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / /pad+ma 'byung gnas bi mā mi tra sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems sprul pa sha stag yin/ /paṇ+ḍi ta rnams mngon shes rdzu 'phrul che/ /gser gyis sha ba'i rlid bu mang po bkang / /rgya gar yul du brdzangs shing bre la gzhal/ /phangs 114

kyang chos zab mo yin rgyu red snyam du dad gus dag snang rjes su yi rang gyis dang / bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob par 'gyur zhes snga 'gyur chos kyi che ba drug gi glu 'di blangs so/ /rgya gar mkhas grub lo paṇa thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byen gyis rlobs/ /snga 'gyur chos kyi che ba rnam pa drug /glu ru len gyis rab tu dga' bas nyon/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas grub rnams/ /bod yul dbus su gdan 'dren mdzad mkhan po/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa chos rgyal rnam gsum mchog /khri srong lde'u btsan yon bdag bsod nams che/ /khri gdugs 'og na 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /dpal gyi bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi/ /chos 'khor smad nas mdo sngags chos kun bsgyur/ /sgra bsgyur gling de bkra shis byin rlabs che/ /bai ro tsā na ska cog zhang gsum sogs/ /sprul pa'i lo tsā ba yis chos kyi don/ /ji lta ba bzhin gtan la phab pas na/ /sgra bsgyur lo tsā ba rnams yon tan che/ /mkhan chen zhi 'tsho sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / /pad+ma 'byung gnas bi mā mi tra sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems sprul pa sha stag yin/ /paṇ+ḍi ta rnams mngon shes rdzu 'phrul che/ /gser gyis sha ba'i rlid bu mang po bkang / /rgya gar yul du brdzangs shing bre la gzhal/ /phangs 114

med phul te zhus pa'i chos yin pas/ /zhu rten gser gyi me tog rin thang che/ /'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa ma nyams dus/ /bi mā la dang pad 'byung la sogs kyis/ /rgya gar yul dang gzhan nas dzu 'phrul gyis/ /blangs nas bsgyur pa'i chos yin ngo mtshar che/ /de ltar chos kyi che ba drug po la/ /bsam na chu mgo gangs la thug pa bzhin/ /snga 'gyur dus su bsgyur pa'i rdzogs chen sogs/ /'khrul med yin snyam dad gus mtsho ltar rgyas/ /de'i phyir slob ma phyi rabs chos mdzad kun/ /snga 'gyur rdzogs chen la sogs gsang sngags chos/ /dad gus dag snang rjes su yi rang gyis/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas kun gyi sems la phan po byung / rjes su chos shes mi shes gnyis gas smod ci thub thub byas chos spong gi las ngan pa gsog pa rgyun chad nas/ dag snang byed mkhan mang po byung ngo / /de nas hor rgya yan chad kyi sgo me'i phyogs kyi bstan 'gro'i don gang nus byas/ de'i dgun kha dwangs rgya dgon nas mtshams byas bsdad dge sbyor 'phel po byung / lo gsar nas mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom dwangs rgya sprul sku/ rgod rtse'i sprul sku/a lags sgom chen/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun yon bdag mang po la tshe dbang dang / nor dbang byas pa'i dus su/ sku gzhogs 115

med phul te zhus pa'i chos yin pas/ /zhu rten gser gyi me tog rin thang che/ /'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa ma nyams dus/ /bi mā la dang pad 'byung la sogs kyis/ /rgya gar yul dang gzhan nas dzu 'phrul gyis/ /blangs nas bsgyur pa'i chos yin ngo mtshar che/ /de ltar chos kyi che ba drug po la/ /bsam na chu mgo gangs la thug pa bzhin/ /snga 'gyur dus su bsgyur pa'i rdzogs chen sogs/ /'khrul med yin snyam dad gus mtsho ltar rgyas/ /de'i phyir slob ma phyi rabs chos mdzad kun/ /snga 'gyur rdzogs chen la sogs gsang sngags chos/ /dad gus dag snang rjes su yi rang gyis/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas kun gyi sems la phan po byung / rjes su chos shes mi shes gnyis gas smod ci thub thub byas chos spong gi las ngan pa gsog pa rgyun chad nas/ dag snang byed mkhan mang po byung ngo / /de nas hor rgya yan chad kyi sgo me'i phyogs kyi bstan 'gro'i don gang nus byas/ de'i dgun kha dwangs rgya dgon nas mtshams byas bsdad dge sbyor 'phel po byung / lo gsar nas mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom dwangs rgya sprul sku/ rgod rtse'i sprul sku/a lags sgom chen/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun yon bdag mang po la tshe dbang dang / nor dbang byas pa'i dus su/ sku gzhogs 115

rgod rtse rin po ches/ bdag la bstod bsngags mang po byas/nged 'dir 'tshogs rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/sku ni nyi ma bzhin du mdzes/ /gsung ni tshangs dbyangs bzhin du snyan/ /thugs ni nam mkha' bzhin du yangs/ /khyed ni nor bu bzhin du bzang / /me tog pad+mar bcud yod pas/ /bung ba thams cad 'du ba bzhin/ /khyed la byang chub sems mnga' bas/ /skye 'gro gdul bya 'du ba mtshar/ /khyed kyi thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi yis/ /'gro don mdzad la mi ngal zhing / /'gro ba rnams kyis mgon khyod kyi/ /bstod bsngags brjod la ngal ma gyur/ /de'i phyir 'gro kun ma 'dris bshes/ /khyed la sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags/ /'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rang / /rtag tu chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs sang rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /'di phyi'i skyabs mgon bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /'dir 'tshogs slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /phan pa'i zhal gdams gnang du gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun/ /khyed kyi rnams thar gsung bzhin du/ /bsgrub par 116

rgod rtse rin po ches/ bdag la bstod bsngags mang po byas/nged 'dir 'tshogs rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/sku ni nyi ma bzhin du mdzes/ /gsung ni tshangs dbyangs bzhin du snyan/ /thugs ni nam mkha' bzhin du yangs/ /khyed ni nor bu bzhin du bzang / /me tog pad+mar bcud yod pas/ /bung ba thams cad 'du ba bzhin/ /khyed la byang chub sems mnga' bas/ /skye 'gro gdul bya 'du ba mtshar/ /khyed kyi thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi yis/ /'gro don mdzad la mi ngal zhing / /'gro ba rnams kyis mgon khyod kyi/ /bstod bsngags brjod la ngal ma gyur/ /de'i phyir 'gro kun ma 'dris bshes/ /khyed la sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags/ /'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rang / /rtag tu chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs sang rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /'di phyi'i skyabs mgon bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /'dir 'tshogs slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /phan pa'i zhal gdams gnang du gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun/ /khyed kyi rnams thar gsung bzhin du/ /bsgrub par 116

nus pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /smon bzhin 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o khyed rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na dbul zhing phongs pa'i nyam thag ngan slong rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i ma gyur sems can thams cad yid bzhin gye nor bu lta bur bltas nas/ zas gos sogs kyis mchod bstod bkur na rang gzhan gye don thams cad 'bad med yid bzhin du 'grub par gsungs te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gsung rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam las/ gang dag dga' bar byas pas mang po rnams/ /'grub par 'gyur ba sems can 'di rnams so/ /'jig rten na ni sems can dag las gzhan/ /'grub par 'gyur ba'i zhing ni yod ma yin/ /'di dag yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang / /'dod dgu bzho bar bya ba'i bzhon dang mtshungs/ /bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha yang 'dra/ /de lta bas na de dag mgu bar bya/ /zhes dang / glang ri thang ba byang chub sems dpas kyang / spyir sems can thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bar bslabs/ zhes dang /chos rje rgyal sras pas kyang / nga rgyal sbrang bu'i gshog rgyangs kyis/ /'khos med blo 'phang ma gtod par/ /sems can yid bzhin nor bu rnams/ /gus pas spyi bor longs shig ang / /zhes 117

nus pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /smon bzhin 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o khyed rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na dbul zhing phongs pa'i nyam thag ngan slong rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i ma gyur sems can thams cad yid bzhin gye nor bu lta bur bltas nas/ zas gos sogs kyis mchod bstod bkur na rang gzhan gye don thams cad 'bad med yid bzhin du 'grub par gsungs te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gsung rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam las/ gang dag dga' bar byas pas mang po rnams/ /'grub par 'gyur ba sems can 'di rnams so/ /'jig rten na ni sems can dag las gzhan/ /'grub par 'gyur ba'i zhing ni yod ma yin/ /'di dag yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang / /'dod dgu bzho bar bya ba'i bzhon dang mtshungs/ /bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha yang 'dra/ /de lta bas na de dag mgu bar bya/ /zhes dang / glang ri thang ba byang chub sems dpas kyang / spyir sems can thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bar bslabs/ zhes dang /chos rje rgyal sras pas kyang / nga rgyal sbrang bu'i gshog rgyangs kyis/ /'khos med blo 'phang ma gtod par/ /sems can yid bzhin nor bu rnams/ /gus pas spyi bor longs shig ang / /zhes 117

sogs mang du gsungs so/ /des na sems can rnams gus pas mchod pa phar zhog sems can la phan sems re skyes na yang bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/dka' ba med par tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs yod kyi gsungs/gang lags na byas pas/ mi gcig skad cig thang cig re la sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag 'bum 'gyur mang bo gom pa hangs pa re byas kyin shar phyogs su gtad phyin/ tshul de 'dra stobs mgyogs khyad yod pa zhig gis/ ngal gcig kyang ma gsos par bskal pa brgya stong khri 'bum grangs las 'das pa/chu bo gaṅgā'i klung gi mgo mjug bye ma ji snyed yod pa'i grangs dang mnyam par phyin kyang / shar phyogs la 'jig rten gye khams zad pa med/ de bzhin du steng 'og phyogs bcu thams cad la zad pa med/ nam mkhas gar khyab tu sems can yang / sa thams cad kyi rdul las grangs mang bas khyab yod/ de thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad las bsgral nas sang rgyas la 'god pa'i bsam pa skyes pa na/ de brgyal lam/ gnyid log gam/ myos sam/ bag med par gyur kyang / sems can gyi grangs dang mtshungs pa'i bsod nams mtha' yas mu med pa zhig rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bas/ tshogs rdzogs pa la dka' rgyu med/118

sogs mang du gsungs so/ /des na sems can rnams gus pas mchod pa phar zhog sems can la phan sems re skyes na yang bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/dka' ba med par tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs yod kyi gsungs/gang lags na byas pas/ mi gcig skad cig thang cig re la sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag 'bum 'gyur mang bo gom pa hangs pa re byas kyin shar phyogs su gtad phyin/ tshul de 'dra stobs mgyogs khyad yod pa zhig gis/ ngal gcig kyang ma gsos par bskal pa brgya stong khri 'bum grangs las 'das pa/chu bo gaṅgā'i klung gi mgo mjug bye ma ji snyed yod pa'i grangs dang mnyam par phyin kyang / shar phyogs la 'jig rten gye khams zad pa med/ de bzhin du steng 'og phyogs bcu thams cad la zad pa med/ nam mkhas gar khyab tu sems can yang / sa thams cad kyi rdul las grangs mang bas khyab yod/ de thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad las bsgral nas sang rgyas la 'god pa'i bsam pa skyes pa na/ de brgyal lam/ gnyid log gam/ myos sam/ bag med par gyur kyang / sems can gyi grangs dang mtshungs pa'i bsod nams mtha' yas mu med pa zhig rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bas/ tshogs rdzogs pa la dka' rgyu med/118

sangs rgyas 'thob pa la'ang dka' rgyu med gsungs/ de bzhin du rin chen phreng ba las/ phyogs rnams kun tu nam mkha' dang / /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /ji ltar mtha' yas de bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal sems can mtha' yas 'dod/ /sems can mtha' yas de dag ni/ /byang chub sems pa'i snying brtse bas/ /sdug bsngal dag las drangs byas te/ /sangs rgyas nyid la 'god par nges/ /de ltar brtan par gnas de ni/ /mi nyal pa lam nyal yang rung / /yang dag blangs pa nas bzung ste/ /bag med gyur kyang sems can rnams/ /mtha' yas phyir na sems can bzhin/ /bsod nams mtha' yas rtag gsog 'gyur/ /mtha' yas des na sangs rgyas nyid/ /mtha' yas thob mi dka' zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams la bsams nas/ ma gyur sems can rnams blo'i phugs su bzhag ste dus rtag tu phan pa'i bsam sbyor la 'bad par bya'o zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/'gro rnams yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /bsten na legs tshogs kun 'byung zhing / /ma bsten legs tshogs mi 'byung bar/ /shes nas 'gro la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'gro dang yid bzhin nor bu la/ /khyad par gcig kyang mi 'dug na/ /'gro ba mchod 119

sangs rgyas 'thob pa la'ang dka' rgyu med gsungs/ de bzhin du rin chen phreng ba las/ phyogs rnams kun tu nam mkha' dang / /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /ji ltar mtha' yas de bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal sems can mtha' yas 'dod/ /sems can mtha' yas de dag ni/ /byang chub sems pa'i snying brtse bas/ /sdug bsngal dag las drangs byas te/ /sangs rgyas nyid la 'god par nges/ /de ltar brtan par gnas de ni/ /mi nyal pa lam nyal yang rung / /yang dag blangs pa nas bzung ste/ /bag med gyur kyang sems can rnams/ /mtha' yas phyir na sems can bzhin/ /bsod nams mtha' yas rtag gsog 'gyur/ /mtha' yas des na sangs rgyas nyid/ /mtha' yas thob mi dka' zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams la bsams nas/ ma gyur sems can rnams blo'i phugs su bzhag ste dus rtag tu phan pa'i bsam sbyor la 'bad par bya'o zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/'gro rnams yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /bsten na legs tshogs kun 'byung zhing / /ma bsten legs tshogs mi 'byung bar/ /shes nas 'gro la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'gro dang yid bzhin nor bu la/ /khyad par gcig kyang mi 'dug na/ /'gro ba mchod 119

par mi byed la/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchod par byed/ /g.yo med legs par mchod na ni/ /gnyis ka 'dod don 'grub par mtshungs/ /g.yo med legs par ma mchod na/ /'dod don mi 'grub par yang mtshungs/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /'gro la g.yo med legs mchod pas/ /thugs la gang bzhed legs par thob/ /legs par brtags na 'gro rnams la/ /mchod pas phan bde thob pa ni/ /yid bzhin nor bus dper mi phod/ /tshogs rdzogs sdig pa ma lus byang / /zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs rnams/ /legs par dul zhing zhi bar 'gyur/ /byams dang snying rje la sogs pa'i/ /yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /myur du mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dngos su phan thogs lta ci smos/ /phan 'dogs bsam pa skyes tsam la'ang / /phan bde dpag med 'byung ba dang / /bsod nams shin tu che ba yi/ /gnas su legs par 'byung 'gyur zhing / /mchod pas phan bde thob pa ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu la med kyi/ /'gro ba sems can rnams la yod/ /de phyir sems can su mthong yang / /byams pa'i mig gis legs par ltos/ /rab tu dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ /ci 'dod yid bzhin sgrub par gyis/ /slong ba legs par tshims byed pa/ /rang nyid bde ba'i 120

par mi byed la/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchod par byed/ /g.yo med legs par mchod na ni/ /gnyis ka 'dod don 'grub par mtshungs/ /g.yo med legs par ma mchod na/ /'dod don mi 'grub par yang mtshungs/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /'gro la g.yo med legs mchod pas/ /thugs la gang bzhed legs par thob/ /legs par brtags na 'gro rnams la/ /mchod pas phan bde thob pa ni/ /yid bzhin nor bus dper mi phod/ /tshogs rdzogs sdig pa ma lus byang / /zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs rnams/ /legs par dul zhing zhi bar 'gyur/ /byams dang snying rje la sogs pa'i/ /yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /myur du mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dngos su phan thogs lta ci smos/ /phan 'dogs bsam pa skyes tsam la'ang / /phan bde dpag med 'byung ba dang / /bsod nams shin tu che ba yi/ /gnas su legs par 'byung 'gyur zhing / /mchod pas phan bde thob pa ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu la med kyi/ /'gro ba sems can rnams la yod/ /de phyir sems can su mthong yang / /byams pa'i mig gis legs par ltos/ /rab tu dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ /ci 'dod yid bzhin sgrub par gyis/ /slong ba legs par tshims byed pa/ /rang nyid bde ba'i 120

thabs yin la/ /gzhan yang bde ba'i thabs yin na/ /mkhas pa su zhig de mi byed/ /mdor na yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'gro kun mchod bstod bkur nus na/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gcig chog gdams pa 'di ka lags/ /legs bshad 'di la dge ba gang / /thob pa des ni 'gro ba kun/ /byang chub spyod la rab zhugs te/ /bla med byang chub 'thob gyur cig /ces spyan snga bas gsungs pa ltar gdams pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs rgya chen bo byung / de ltar 'gro don byas pas phyogs de'i dad can rnams kyis/ rta rgod ma drug cu rtsa bdun/ mdzo 'bri ba glang nyis brgya/ ra lug sum brgya/ gzhan yang nang rdzas nom pa yang mang po phul byung / de rnams kyi nang nas zhabs phyi pa rnams la rta bzang po re byin pas rta bcu gsum song / phyogs de'i bla ma dang mtshams pa ri khrod pa dgon pa rnams la rta rgod mas gtso byas che rdo lnga bcu tsam phul/'gyed mang ja btang / sa rig dge bshes rin po che'i sku gdung mdun du mar me'i thebs su ra lug drug cu rtsa bdun phul/gzhan rnams tshe thar du btang / de nas mtsho sngon po brgyud nas dbus su yar la 'gro snyam/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum gyi slob ma rnams la phan phyir lam rim dang mthun pa'i zhal gdams 121

thabs yin la/ /gzhan yang bde ba'i thabs yin na/ /mkhas pa su zhig de mi byed/ /mdor na yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'gro kun mchod bstod bkur nus na/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gcig chog gdams pa 'di ka lags/ /legs bshad 'di la dge ba gang / /thob pa des ni 'gro ba kun/ /byang chub spyod la rab zhugs te/ /bla med byang chub 'thob gyur cig /ces spyan snga bas gsungs pa ltar gdams pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs rgya chen bo byung / de ltar 'gro don byas pas phyogs de'i dad can rnams kyis/ rta rgod ma drug cu rtsa bdun/ mdzo 'bri ba glang nyis brgya/ ra lug sum brgya/ gzhan yang nang rdzas nom pa yang mang po phul byung / de rnams kyi nang nas zhabs phyi pa rnams la rta bzang po re byin pas rta bcu gsum song / phyogs de'i bla ma dang mtshams pa ri khrod pa dgon pa rnams la rta rgod mas gtso byas che rdo lnga bcu tsam phul/'gyed mang ja btang / sa rig dge bshes rin po che'i sku gdung mdun du mar me'i thebs su ra lug drug cu rtsa bdun phul/gzhan rnams tshe thar du btang / de nas mtsho sngon po brgyud nas dbus su yar la 'gro snyam/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum gyi slob ma rnams la phan phyir lam rim dang mthun pa'i zhal gdams 121

mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan sangs rgyas dang / /mgon de'i gsung rab mdo sngags dam pa'i chos/ /de 'dzin byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /thub bstan bstan pa rgyas mdzad 'dzam gling gi /gtsug rgyan rgyan mchog klu sgrub thogs med lugs/ /lam rim rim pa bzhin du dbyangs su len/ /rnam grol grol ba don gnyer can gyis nyon/ /mdo sngags gzhung lugs chen por rab sbyangs pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul mtha' yas la/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas sbyongs shig mdo khams pa/ /tshul khrims gzhi bzung sbyin sogs grogs byas shing / /smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /don ldan lha chos sgrubs shig mdo khams pa/ /sgyu ma lus kyi mgon khang rnying ba de/ /rnam shes mgon pos stong par bskyur nas ni/ /phyi ma'i yul la myur du 'gro nges pa'i/ /'gro grabs lha chos gyis shig mdo khams pa/ /phyi mar song na sdig pa'i las dbang gis/ /ngan song gsum du lhung na sdug bsngal che/ /'jigs pa kun las skyob pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /122

mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan sangs rgyas dang / /mgon de'i gsung rab mdo sngags dam pa'i chos/ /de 'dzin byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /thub bstan bstan pa rgyas mdzad 'dzam gling gi /gtsug rgyan rgyan mchog klu sgrub thogs med lugs/ /lam rim rim pa bzhin du dbyangs su len/ /rnam grol grol ba don gnyer can gyis nyon/ /mdo sngags gzhung lugs chen por rab sbyangs pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul mtha' yas la/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas sbyongs shig mdo khams pa/ /tshul khrims gzhi bzung sbyin sogs grogs byas shing / /smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /don ldan lha chos sgrubs shig mdo khams pa/ /sgyu ma lus kyi mgon khang rnying ba de/ /rnam shes mgon pos stong par bskyur nas ni/ /phyi ma'i yul la myur du 'gro nges pa'i/ /'gro grabs lha chos gyis shig mdo khams pa/ /phyi mar song na sdig pa'i las dbang gis/ /ngan song gsum du lhung na sdug bsngal che/ /'jigs pa kun las skyob pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /122

gtan gyi skyabs su sten cig mdo khams pa/ /rang gis dge sdig gang byas gzugs brnyan rnams/ /gsung rab me long nang du bltas na gsal/ /mi dge bcu yi dri mas gos pa rnams/ /yang yang bye dor gyis shig mdo khams pa/ /ngag gi nyes pa phra mo re res kyang / /skye ba lnga brgyar sdug bsngal myong dgos na/ /dzun dang dgos med ngag 'khyal spangs nas ni/ /gzungs sngags bzlas brjod gyis shig mdo khams pa/ /mchod rten re la phyag re 'tshal bas kyang / /'khor los bsgyur rgyal grangs med thob gyur na/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar/ /phyag dang skor ba gyis shig mdo khams pa/ /ngan 'gror skye ba'i sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas ma bshags na/ /phyi mar ngan song gnas su lhung nyen gda'/ /snying nas bshags sdom gyes shig mdo khams pa/ /'khor ba spyi dang bye brag rigs drug gi /sdug bsngal bsams nas thar 'dod shugs drag bskyed/ /thar thabs bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len la/ /tshul bzhin slob par mdzod cig mdo khams pa/ /rang rgyud zhing sa btang snyoms bde 'jam la/ /rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi chu lud sbyor/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems kyi sa bon de/ /yang yang 'debs par mdzod cig mdo khams pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs 123

gtan gyi skyabs su sten cig mdo khams pa/ /rang gis dge sdig gang byas gzugs brnyan rnams/ /gsung rab me long nang du bltas na gsal/ /mi dge bcu yi dri mas gos pa rnams/ /yang yang bye dor gyis shig mdo khams pa/ /ngag gi nyes pa phra mo re res kyang / /skye ba lnga brgyar sdug bsngal myong dgos na/ /dzun dang dgos med ngag 'khyal spangs nas ni/ /gzungs sngags bzlas brjod gyis shig mdo khams pa/ /mchod rten re la phyag re 'tshal bas kyang / /'khor los bsgyur rgyal grangs med thob gyur na/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar/ /phyag dang skor ba gyis shig mdo khams pa/ /ngan 'gror skye ba'i sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas ma bshags na/ /phyi mar ngan song gnas su lhung nyen gda'/ /snying nas bshags sdom gyes shig mdo khams pa/ /'khor ba spyi dang bye brag rigs drug gi /sdug bsngal bsams nas thar 'dod shugs drag bskyed/ /thar thabs bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len la/ /tshul bzhin slob par mdzod cig mdo khams pa/ /rang rgyud zhing sa btang snyoms bde 'jam la/ /rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi chu lud sbyor/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems kyi sa bon de/ /yang yang 'debs par mdzod cig mdo khams pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs 123

rgyas mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ /rgyal sras lam la slob tshul mang na yang / /pha rol phyin drug thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi la/ /brtson pa drag pos slobs shig mdo khams pa/ /khyad par snyigs dus tshe thung 'di nyid la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob pa'i thabs/ /gsang sngags smin grol gdams pa nyams su longs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub bo mdo khams pa/ /mdo smad reb gong yul du skyes pa yi/ /'do med rgyal khams nyul ba'i zhabs dkar pas/ /mdo sngags gdams pa glu ru blangs pa 'dis/ /mdo khams skye bo yongs la phan par shog /ces blangs pas mthong thos rnams kyis lam rim blo sbyong tshor bltas nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas rang rgyud 'dul mkhan gye slob ma bu chen mang po byung / nga rma phar kha nas dbus su 'gro rgyu red zer ba tshor nas/rong bo'i dgon chen gyi gser khri sku gzhogs bus pa rin po ches dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas bcas gsung shog 'di stsal snang /lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs mgon dam pa mchog /grub dbang tshogs drug rang grol rin po che/ /zhabs zung gser gyi 'khor los mtshan pa'i drung / /mkhas btsun bzang gsum yon tan kun tshang ba'i /124

rgyas mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ /rgyal sras lam la slob tshul mang na yang / /pha rol phyin drug thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi la/ /brtson pa drag pos slobs shig mdo khams pa/ /khyad par snyigs dus tshe thung 'di nyid la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob pa'i thabs/ /gsang sngags smin grol gdams pa nyams su longs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub bo mdo khams pa/ /mdo smad reb gong yul du skyes pa yi/ /'do med rgyal khams nyul ba'i zhabs dkar pas/ /mdo sngags gdams pa glu ru blangs pa 'dis/ /mdo khams skye bo yongs la phan par shog /ces blangs pas mthong thos rnams kyis lam rim blo sbyong tshor bltas nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas rang rgyud 'dul mkhan gye slob ma bu chen mang po byung / nga rma phar kha nas dbus su 'gro rgyu red zer ba tshor nas/rong bo'i dgon chen gyi gser khri sku gzhogs bus pa rin po ches dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas bcas gsung shog 'di stsal snang /lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs mgon dam pa mchog /grub dbang tshogs drug rang grol rin po che/ /zhabs zung gser gyi 'khor los mtshan pa'i drung / /mkhas btsun bzang gsum yon tan kun tshang ba'i /124

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gong ma'i sprul pa'i sku/ /mtshan tsam 'dzin pa'i bus pa sku skyes kyis/ /rab tu gus pas nan tan zhu ba'i 'bras/ /mdo smad yul gyi mkha' la cher 'phags pa'i/ /yon tan dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i nyin byed khyed/ /slob bu rta bdun shugs kyis nyer drangs te/ /mi ring dbus gtsang lha lam bsnyegs zhes thos/ /e ma dbus su bstan 'dzin bgrang las 'das/ /der gnas skye bo kun kyang rang rgyud 'jam/ /nyi shar phyogs su nyi ma dgos don chung / /chos kyi gling la khyed byon ci zhig dgongs/ /sems dpa' dam pa'i dam bca' brtan byed na/ /mtha' 'khob mun par chos kyi sgron me sbor/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan gyi/ /dkon mchog rten bzhengs bsod nams zhing du bskrun/ /mtha' 'khob yang 'khob chos kyis kha lo sgyur/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis gang 'dul 'gro ba skyongs/ /dbus su lo brgyar bstan pa spel ba las/ /yul 'dir nyin gcig chos bshad bsod nams lhag /dag zhing dbus gtsang yul dbus bzhugs pa las/ /ma rungs gcig 'dul tshogs bsags rgya chen lags/ /bde skyid yul bzang dam pa'i zhen yul min/ /dpa' bo gzhan gyis bsgyur la ci zhig gsan/ /bstan 'gror dgongs nas cis kyang bzhugs gsol 125

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gong ma'i sprul pa'i sku/ /mtshan tsam 'dzin pa'i bus pa sku skyes kyis/ /rab tu gus pas nan tan zhu ba'i 'bras/ /mdo smad yul gyi mkha' la cher 'phags pa'i/ /yon tan dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i nyin byed khyed/ /slob bu rta bdun shugs kyis nyer drangs te/ /mi ring dbus gtsang lha lam bsnyegs zhes thos/ /e ma dbus su bstan 'dzin bgrang las 'das/ /der gnas skye bo kun kyang rang rgyud 'jam/ /nyi shar phyogs su nyi ma dgos don chung / /chos kyi gling la khyed byon ci zhig dgongs/ /sems dpa' dam pa'i dam bca' brtan byed na/ /mtha' 'khob mun par chos kyi sgron me sbor/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan gyi/ /dkon mchog rten bzhengs bsod nams zhing du bskrun/ /mtha' 'khob yang 'khob chos kyis kha lo sgyur/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis gang 'dul 'gro ba skyongs/ /dbus su lo brgyar bstan pa spel ba las/ /yul 'dir nyin gcig chos bshad bsod nams lhag /dag zhing dbus gtsang yul dbus bzhugs pa las/ /ma rungs gcig 'dul tshogs bsags rgya chen lags/ /bde skyid yul bzang dam pa'i zhen yul min/ /dpa' bo gzhan gyis bsgyur la ci zhig gsan/ /bstan 'gror dgongs nas cis kyang bzhugs gsol 125

'debs/ /bdag la 'di phyir dge ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /dri med lha rdzas dang bcas zhu yig 'di/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rong bo'i dgon nas phul/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i reb gong gi bla skya dpon gsum dang / sngags mang / khri ga'i sa sgo'i yon bdag dad can khyi go pa go sogs kyis bshol btab nas sdod dgos byung / de nas sgo me'i bal won phyogs kyi skya ser rnams la khyed rnams kyis bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas/ dgon pa'i 'du khang phug tu bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas kyi skus gtso byas nyan thos gnyis dang / gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi sku sman 'dam las grub pa zhig bzhengs na bzang zhes bshad pas/ khong rnams kyis rjes nas bzhengs pa'i nang du gser shog dmar ser gnyis la stong bam brgyad dang / yon gyi nang du rta rgod ma gnyis byin/ yul phyogs la phan pa'i byen 'bebs bkra shis yag po byas/ de nas phyir log bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug byams pa zla 'od rin po cher mjal/ rta dang gos dar sogs phul nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud gyi lung zhus nas gnang / nyi ma kha shas mdun nas bsdad/ khong thugs dgyes thugs yid gcig 'dres byung / 'gro khar khong dgung lo bgres tshul bsams nas da phyin chad mjal 126

'debs/ /bdag la 'di phyir dge ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /dri med lha rdzas dang bcas zhu yig 'di/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rong bo'i dgon nas phul/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i reb gong gi bla skya dpon gsum dang / sngags mang / khri ga'i sa sgo'i yon bdag dad can khyi go pa go sogs kyis bshol btab nas sdod dgos byung / de nas sgo me'i bal won phyogs kyi skya ser rnams la khyed rnams kyis bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su dmigs nas/ dgon pa'i 'du khang phug tu bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas kyi skus gtso byas nyan thos gnyis dang / gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi sku sman 'dam las grub pa zhig bzhengs na bzang zhes bshad pas/ khong rnams kyis rjes nas bzhengs pa'i nang du gser shog dmar ser gnyis la stong bam brgyad dang / yon gyi nang du rta rgod ma gnyis byin/ yul phyogs la phan pa'i byen 'bebs bkra shis yag po byas/ de nas phyir log bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug byams pa zla 'od rin po cher mjal/ rta dang gos dar sogs phul nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud gyi lung zhus nas gnang / nyi ma kha shas mdun nas bsdad/ khong thugs dgyes thugs yid gcig 'dres byung / 'gro khar khong dgung lo bgres tshul bsams nas da phyin chad mjal 126

mi mjal ci shes snyam nga'i mig nas mchi ma byung ba dang / khong gis kyang spyan chab bsil bar gda'/ de nas bzung rjes su mjal rgyu ma byung / de nas tshur khri ka ru 'ongs nas jo bo la mchod pa rgya chen po phul khri ga'i sa sgo'i bla ma dpon po yon bdag gal can rnams la rta bcu gcig gis gtso byas rgyu nom pa'i mtshams rtags phul bas kun dga' bar gyur/ phyis chos kyi grogs byas 'gro phan chen po byung / de nas khri ga'i yul lha mchod du song nang nas zhag gcig bsdad mchod bstod gsol ba btab pas rjes su 'phrin las 'grub pa byung / de nas chos rgyal mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi dbu lo nang du bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dkar po la mjal/ mchod pa dang dge 'dun pa rnams la mang ja btang / yang nang rten du pha bong zhig la rgyal ba byams pa'i sku rang byon du babs pa zhig bzhugs pa'i lha dkar po la mjal mchod 'bul byas/ phyi'i lcags ri'i rdo rtsig gsar rgyag byas/ de nas gnas chen brag dkar me long du song / brag phug gi 'dug sa gsum bzos/ zhag po bco lnga tsam la bsdad pas shin tu spro zhing skyid po byung / yang a chung gnam rdzong phyogs kyi ban sngags yon bdag rnams kyis gdan 'dren pa byung / ban sngags kha shas kyis khyed ri khrod na bzhugs dus 127

mi mjal ci shes snyam nga'i mig nas mchi ma byung ba dang / khong gis kyang spyan chab bsil bar gda'/ de nas bzung rjes su mjal rgyu ma byung / de nas tshur khri ka ru 'ongs nas jo bo la mchod pa rgya chen po phul khri ga'i sa sgo'i bla ma dpon po yon bdag gal can rnams la rta bcu gcig gis gtso byas rgyu nom pa'i mtshams rtags phul bas kun dga' bar gyur/ phyis chos kyi grogs byas 'gro phan chen po byung / de nas khri ga'i yul lha mchod du song nang nas zhag gcig bsdad mchod bstod gsol ba btab pas rjes su 'phrin las 'grub pa byung / de nas chos rgyal mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi dbu lo nang du bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dkar po la mjal/ mchod pa dang dge 'dun pa rnams la mang ja btang / yang nang rten du pha bong zhig la rgyal ba byams pa'i sku rang byon du babs pa zhig bzhugs pa'i lha dkar po la mjal mchod 'bul byas/ phyi'i lcags ri'i rdo rtsig gsar rgyag byas/ de nas gnas chen brag dkar me long du song / brag phug gi 'dug sa gsum bzos/ zhag po bco lnga tsam la bsdad pas shin tu spro zhing skyid po byung / yang a chung gnam rdzong phyogs kyi ban sngags yon bdag rnams kyis gdan 'dren pa byung / ban sngags kha shas kyis khyed ri khrod na bzhugs dus 127

nyin rer ja ci tsam 'thung ba yin zer ba'i lan du/ ngas der 'tshogs pa rnams la ku re rtse mtshar gyi tshul du rnal 'byor chos ja bskol nas 'thung tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos dang mthun par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos pa tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /chos ja bskol tshul glu ru len/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su song / /rang rgyud thang ka yangs po yi/ /kun slong ngan pa'i rdo ba bsal/ /btang rnyoms chen po'i sa gzhi brdal/ /mar shes drin dran drin gzo yi/ /rin chen sgyed pu gsum gyi khar/ /byams pa chen po'i mkhar zangs btsugs/ /snying rje chen po'i me chen sbar/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i ja chu btsugs/ /smon 'jug byang sems ja bzang bskol/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i 'o ma blugs/ /gsang sngags dbang bzhi'i 'bri mar brgyab/ /bskyed rdzogs 'khrid kyi thom bus 'phyar/ /byen rlabs dri ngad rlangs pa 'thul/ /e ma 'thung tshad thams cad la/ /phan pa'i mdo sngags chos kyi ja/ /bdag gis rgyun du 'thung ba 'di/ /dad gus dkar yol snod ldan pa'i/ /skal ldan slob ma yang slob la/ /phangs pa med par bdag gis ster/ /rnam dpyod ljags kyis gsol nus na/ /nyon mongs skom gdungs kun zhi 128

nyin rer ja ci tsam 'thung ba yin zer ba'i lan du/ ngas der 'tshogs pa rnams la ku re rtse mtshar gyi tshul du rnal 'byor chos ja bskol nas 'thung tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos dang mthun par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos pa tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /chos ja bskol tshul glu ru len/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su song / /rang rgyud thang ka yangs po yi/ /kun slong ngan pa'i rdo ba bsal/ /btang rnyoms chen po'i sa gzhi brdal/ /mar shes drin dran drin gzo yi/ /rin chen sgyed pu gsum gyi khar/ /byams pa chen po'i mkhar zangs btsugs/ /snying rje chen po'i me chen sbar/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i ja chu btsugs/ /smon 'jug byang sems ja bzang bskol/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i 'o ma blugs/ /gsang sngags dbang bzhi'i 'bri mar brgyab/ /bskyed rdzogs 'khrid kyi thom bus 'phyar/ /byen rlabs dri ngad rlangs pa 'thul/ /e ma 'thung tshad thams cad la/ /phan pa'i mdo sngags chos kyi ja/ /bdag gis rgyun du 'thung ba 'di/ /dad gus dkar yol snod ldan pa'i/ /skal ldan slob ma yang slob la/ /phangs pa med par bdag gis ster/ /rnam dpyod ljags kyis gsol nus na/ /nyon mongs skom gdungs kun zhi 128

nas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan lus stobs rgyas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku 'thob 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /dam chos ja bzang 'thung bar shog /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i dad can gyi skyes pho mo kun yid dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /gnas bzang po de nas thon te ban le'i sngags rgan mkha' 'gro'i nang du song zhag gcig gnyis bsdad/ bka' bsgo byin rlabs bkra shis byas/ chos bshad pas kun gyi blo kha chos la 'gyur/ rab tu dad pas dre'u gcig gis 'go byas zang zing nor gye 'brel ba mang po bzhag de nas bang mdzod dang a dze'i sgang du song / sngags rgan tshe ring don 'grub dang / blo bzang bkra shis gnyis kyis dre'u gnyis kyis 'go byas sde ba'i dad can tshos zas nor gyi 'brel ba mang po phul/ de nas ban rgyag tu song zas nor mang po phul/ sngon grub thob pho mo bzhugs pa'i sgrub gnas deng sang 'gro mi thub sa zhig 'dug de'i lam bde mo bcos brag phug la nyams gso btang / nang nas zhag kha shas bsdad/ byen rlabs byas rjes su nga'i slob ma mtshams pa rgya ldang lo gsum bsdad dge sbyor 'phel po byung skad/ de nas gnas chen a chung gnam rdzong du song / gnas de nas dang po gtsang rab gsal dang / g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya ste/ bod kyi 129

nas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan lus stobs rgyas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku 'thob 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /dam chos ja bzang 'thung bar shog /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i dad can gyi skyes pho mo kun yid dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /gnas bzang po de nas thon te ban le'i sngags rgan mkha' 'gro'i nang du song zhag gcig gnyis bsdad/ bka' bsgo byin rlabs bkra shis byas/ chos bshad pas kun gyi blo kha chos la 'gyur/ rab tu dad pas dre'u gcig gis 'go byas zang zing nor gye 'brel ba mang po bzhag de nas bang mdzod dang a dze'i sgang du song / sngags rgan tshe ring don 'grub dang / blo bzang bkra shis gnyis kyis dre'u gnyis kyis 'go byas sde ba'i dad can tshos zas nor gyi 'brel ba mang po phul/ de nas ban rgyag tu song zas nor mang po phul/ sngon grub thob pho mo bzhugs pa'i sgrub gnas deng sang 'gro mi thub sa zhig 'dug de'i lam bde mo bcos brag phug la nyams gso btang / nang nas zhag kha shas bsdad/ byen rlabs byas rjes su nga'i slob ma mtshams pa rgya ldang lo gsum bsdad dge sbyor 'phel po byung skad/ de nas gnas chen a chung gnam rdzong du song / gnas de nas dang po gtsang rab gsal dang / g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya ste/ bod kyi 129

mkhas pa mi gsum yun ring bzhugs shing bsgom khrid bskyangs/phyis su rgyal dbang sde pa chos rje rin po che dang / chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs skyes bu dam pa mang po bzhugs shing byen gyis brlabs pa'i lha khang nang du dgun mtshams la bsdad nas dge sbyor yag po byed rgyu byung / de'i dus nyin cig bu chen pad+ma rig 'dzin sogs phyogs de'i ban sngags mang pos lha rdzas bcas gnas bstod cig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor/ bdag gis gnas bstod dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di glu ru blangs so//sngon tshe gnas 'dir byon pa yi/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag dgongs pa gsal/ /'gro ba'i mgon po shākya'i mtshan/ /mtshan snyan don ldan dge ba 'byung / /bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gnas 'dir 'dug pa thams cad la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /gnas kyis gang zag byen brlabs pa'i/ /gnas chen a chung gnam rdzong la/ /gnas bstod cung zad tsam zhig byas/ /gnas 'di'i lha mi dga' bas nyon/ /ri rgyal lho yi 'dzam gling gi /byang phyogs mdo smad khams ra yi/ /gnam rdzong dpal gyi brag ri 'di/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo 'dra/ /dpa' bo 130

mkhas pa mi gsum yun ring bzhugs shing bsgom khrid bskyangs/phyis su rgyal dbang sde pa chos rje rin po che dang / chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs skyes bu dam pa mang po bzhugs shing byen gyis brlabs pa'i lha khang nang du dgun mtshams la bsdad nas dge sbyor yag po byed rgyu byung / de'i dus nyin cig bu chen pad+ma rig 'dzin sogs phyogs de'i ban sngags mang pos lha rdzas bcas gnas bstod cig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor/ bdag gis gnas bstod dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di glu ru blangs so//sngon tshe gnas 'dir byon pa yi/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag dgongs pa gsal/ /'gro ba'i mgon po shākya'i mtshan/ /mtshan snyan don ldan dge ba 'byung / /bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gnas 'dir 'dug pa thams cad la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /gnas kyis gang zag byen brlabs pa'i/ /gnas chen a chung gnam rdzong la/ /gnas bstod cung zad tsam zhig byas/ /gnas 'di'i lha mi dga' bas nyon/ /ri rgyal lho yi 'dzam gling gi /byang phyogs mdo smad khams ra yi/ /gnam rdzong dpal gyi brag ri 'di/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo 'dra/ /dpa' bo 130

mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'khor/ /chos skyong srung ma bran ltar 'du/ /rtse na thub dbang pad 'byung sogs/ /sku gsung thugs rten mang po bzhugs/ /rtsa na phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ban sngags gnyis kyi sgrub sde chags/ /g.yas g.yon kun na chu gtsang 'bab/ /mtha' bskor nags tshal mang pos bskor/ /ri ngos rtsi shing me tog bkra/ /khu byug 'jol mo skad snyan 'byin/ /gnas chen de yi shar lho na/ /lha lung dpal rdor sgrub gnas yod/ /phyogs de'i ri brag 'ga' zhig la/ /rigs gsum mgon po sgol ma sogs/ /lha tshogs mang po gnas so zhes/ /sngon byon mkhas grub mang pos gsungs/ /bskyed rim 'byongs pas snod bcud kun/ /gzhal yas khang dang lha ru mthong / /dag snang che bas ri brag la/ /bltas kyang lha dang lha mor 'char/ /des na chos kun 'dun pa la/ /rag las khyad par gsang sngags chos/ /mos lam kho nas 'grub pas na/ /gang la dag snang sbyong ba gces/ /bdag kyang gnas 'di rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /lha yi pho brang chen po ru/ /mos nas mchod bstod gsol btab pas/ /nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs byung / /khyed rnams kun kyang de bzhin du/ /mos nas dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis/ /mchod cing gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'byung / /131

mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'khor/ /chos skyong srung ma bran ltar 'du/ /rtse na thub dbang pad 'byung sogs/ /sku gsung thugs rten mang po bzhugs/ /rtsa na phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ban sngags gnyis kyi sgrub sde chags/ /g.yas g.yon kun na chu gtsang 'bab/ /mtha' bskor nags tshal mang pos bskor/ /ri ngos rtsi shing me tog bkra/ /khu byug 'jol mo skad snyan 'byin/ /gnas chen de yi shar lho na/ /lha lung dpal rdor sgrub gnas yod/ /phyogs de'i ri brag 'ga' zhig la/ /rigs gsum mgon po sgol ma sogs/ /lha tshogs mang po gnas so zhes/ /sngon byon mkhas grub mang pos gsungs/ /bskyed rim 'byongs pas snod bcud kun/ /gzhal yas khang dang lha ru mthong / /dag snang che bas ri brag la/ /bltas kyang lha dang lha mor 'char/ /des na chos kun 'dun pa la/ /rag las khyad par gsang sngags chos/ /mos lam kho nas 'grub pas na/ /gang la dag snang sbyong ba gces/ /bdag kyang gnas 'di rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /lha yi pho brang chen po ru/ /mos nas mchod bstod gsol btab pas/ /nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs byung / /khyed rnams kun kyang de bzhin du/ /mos nas dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis/ /mchod cing gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'byung / /131

gnas 'di bstod pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /gnas bdag lha rnams rab dgyes te/ /gnas 'dir 'dug pa thams cad la/ /gnas po bzang po mdzad par shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo phyugs legs/ /yul mi thams cad tshe ring zhing / /yul la na tsha god kha med/ /yul khams bde ba'i bkra shis shog /ces blangs pas lha mi kun dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ / de'i dgun stod la kha kya'i shākya rin chen dang / ma ṇi ba shes rab bzang po/ dge slong bkra shis lhun po/ stag yan bstan 'dzin nor bu sogs tshe blos btang gi slob ma mang pos bka' brgyud kyi chos skor zhus par/ ngas rdo rje 'chang la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gis byen rlabs byas te/ phyag rgya chen po dang nā ro chos drug gi lung khrid byas/ de'i 'khrul 'khor rnams bslabs pas phal cher gyis shes pa byung / de'i dus grub thob lce sgom pa'i brgya rtsa'i rnam bshad nas gsungs pa'i spang bya rnams tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/snying rje'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas la/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /rgyud la skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ /132

gnas 'di bstod pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /gnas bdag lha rnams rab dgyes te/ /gnas 'dir 'dug pa thams cad la/ /gnas po bzang po mdzad par shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo phyugs legs/ /yul mi thams cad tshe ring zhing / /yul la na tsha god kha med/ /yul khams bde ba'i bkra shis shog /ces blangs pas lha mi kun dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ / de'i dgun stod la kha kya'i shākya rin chen dang / ma ṇi ba shes rab bzang po/ dge slong bkra shis lhun po/ stag yan bstan 'dzin nor bu sogs tshe blos btang gi slob ma mang pos bka' brgyud kyi chos skor zhus par/ ngas rdo rje 'chang la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gis byen rlabs byas te/ phyag rgya chen po dang nā ro chos drug gi lung khrid byas/ de'i 'khrul 'khor rnams bslabs pas phal cher gyis shes pa byung / de'i dus grub thob lce sgom pa'i brgya rtsa'i rnam bshad nas gsungs pa'i spang bya rnams tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/snying rje'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas la/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /rgyud la skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ /132

snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung bas/ /snying rje nyams pa'i sdig zas sha /ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis spongs/ /sha ni srin po'i zas yin pas/ /sdig par 'gyur bas nyes dmigs che/ /sha mi za ba'i sems can rnams/ /'jigs shing skrag pas nyes pa yod/ /ston pa sangs rgyas zhal snga nas/ /sha za ba la snying rje med/ /rnam par grol ba rgyan gyi mchog /'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan dag dang 'gal/ /zhes sogs nyes dmigs mang po gsungs/ /chang ni gnod sbyin smyo chu yin/ /myos par 'gyur bas nyes skyon yod/ /bram ze drang srong rnams kyis dri/ /tshor na'ang skyugs bro 'bros par 'gyur/ /ston pa sangs rgyas zhal snga nas/ /chang ni nyes pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /rtswa zil tsam yang btung mi bya/ /rnal 'byor chang gis myos gyur pa/ /shi nas ngu 'bod gnas su 'gro/ /zhes sogs nyes skyon mtha' yas gsungs/ /nya sha bse rag zas yin pas/ /gtsang ma rigs kyi lha mi dgyes/ /yi dwags rigs ni kha cig gis/ /skyugs bro blta ba'i nyes pa yod/ /la phug 'byung bo'i zas yin pas/ /gtsang ma rigs kyi lha dang ni/ /yi dwags kha cig dga' mi 'gyur/ /zas ngan 'di dag rab spangs nas/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa chu sbyin sogs/ /tshegs chung don che rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod pa rnams la bslab par gyis/ /legs 133

snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung bas/ /snying rje nyams pa'i sdig zas sha /ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis spongs/ /sha ni srin po'i zas yin pas/ /sdig par 'gyur bas nyes dmigs che/ /sha mi za ba'i sems can rnams/ /'jigs shing skrag pas nyes pa yod/ /ston pa sangs rgyas zhal snga nas/ /sha za ba la snying rje med/ /rnam par grol ba rgyan gyi mchog /'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan dag dang 'gal/ /zhes sogs nyes dmigs mang po gsungs/ /chang ni gnod sbyin smyo chu yin/ /myos par 'gyur bas nyes skyon yod/ /bram ze drang srong rnams kyis dri/ /tshor na'ang skyugs bro 'bros par 'gyur/ /ston pa sangs rgyas zhal snga nas/ /chang ni nyes pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /rtswa zil tsam yang btung mi bya/ /rnal 'byor chang gis myos gyur pa/ /shi nas ngu 'bod gnas su 'gro/ /zhes sogs nyes skyon mtha' yas gsungs/ /nya sha bse rag zas yin pas/ /gtsang ma rigs kyi lha mi dgyes/ /yi dwags rigs ni kha cig gis/ /skyugs bro blta ba'i nyes pa yod/ /la phug 'byung bo'i zas yin pas/ /gtsang ma rigs kyi lha dang ni/ /yi dwags kha cig dga' mi 'gyur/ /zas ngan 'di dag rab spangs nas/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa chu sbyin sogs/ /tshegs chung don che rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod pa rnams la bslab par gyis/ /legs 133

bshad 'di yang thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces smras pas nang nas slob ma re gnyis kyis sha gtan nas spangs shing / /gzhan gyis brgya rtsa'i dus su mi za ba byas so/ /lo gsar nas phyogs de'i sngags mang la rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gye lung khrid byas shing / sems kyi ngo sprod go sla 'khyer bde 'di yang byen/ /'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa o rgyan rin po che'i gsung gter ston khungs btsun garma gling pa'i gter kha zab chos dgongs pa rang grol las/ lus gnad chos bdun sngar ltar byas la/ mig gis mdun gyi nam mkha' 'am/sna rtse'i thad kyi bar snang tsam la tshub dang gya gyu med par cer re hrig ge blta/ lta stangs kyi yon tan ni/ 'gro ba rnams kyi snying gi dkyil du rtsa ka ti shel gyi spu gu can zhes bya ba ye shes kyi rtsa zhig yod de/ de thur du blta zhing kha zum na ye shes 'grib cing gti mug 'phel bar byed pas/ des na dud 'gro la rtsa de kha thur la bstan nas zum pas blun shing gti mug pa'o/ /mi la rtsa de 'phred la phyogs shing cung zad kha phye bas/ mi shes rig bkra zhing / shes pa gsal ba yin no/ /grub pa'i skyes bu dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rtsa de'i kha phye nas gyen du bstan pas/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gyes mi khyab pa dang / mkhyen 134

bshad 'di yang thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces smras pas nang nas slob ma re gnyis kyis sha gtan nas spangs shing / /gzhan gyis brgya rtsa'i dus su mi za ba byas so/ /lo gsar nas phyogs de'i sngags mang la rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gye lung khrid byas shing / sems kyi ngo sprod go sla 'khyer bde 'di yang byen/ /'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa o rgyan rin po che'i gsung gter ston khungs btsun garma gling pa'i gter kha zab chos dgongs pa rang grol las/ lus gnad chos bdun sngar ltar byas la/ mig gis mdun gyi nam mkha' 'am/sna rtse'i thad kyi bar snang tsam la tshub dang gya gyu med par cer re hrig ge blta/ lta stangs kyi yon tan ni/ 'gro ba rnams kyi snying gi dkyil du rtsa ka ti shel gyi spu gu can zhes bya ba ye shes kyi rtsa zhig yod de/ de thur du blta zhing kha zum na ye shes 'grib cing gti mug 'phel bar byed pas/ des na dud 'gro la rtsa de kha thur la bstan nas zum pas blun shing gti mug pa'o/ /mi la rtsa de 'phred la phyogs shing cung zad kha phye bas/ mi shes rig bkra zhing / shes pa gsal ba yin no/ /grub pa'i skyes bu dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rtsa de'i kha phye nas gyen du bstan pas/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gyes mi khyab pa dang / mkhyen 134

pa'i ye shes dang / mngon par shes pa rgya chen po 'char bas ye shes kyi rtsa de kha phye ba'i yon tan las byung ba'o/ /des na mig btsum na/ rtsa de kha zum nas thur du shes pa nag thum gyi gti mug 'thib pa'o/ /lta stangs trig ge byas pas rtsa de'i kha gyen la bstan pas rig pa dwangs snyigs phyed nas/ gsal la rtog pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dag pa'i mthong snang du ma 'char bar 'gyur bas lta stangs gal che'o gsungs/ de yi dus su bla mas 'di skad ngo sprad do/ /'o de ltar sems ma bcos par lhan ne bzhag pa'i dus kyi shes pa 'di la cer re ltos shig 'o khyed rang rnams kyi sems rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas ma bcos pa'i ngang la lhan ne gnas pa cig mi 'dug gam/ 'di la zhi gnas zhes bya ba yin te/ sems kyi ngo bo min no/ /da khyod rang gi sems gnas mkhan gyi ngo bo kho rang la cer re ltos dang /dngos po dbyibs dang kha dog ci yi ngo bor yang ma grub pa/ ci yang med pa'i stong pa lhang nge ba cig mi 'dug gam/ 'di la ngo bo stong pa bya ba yin/ stong pa de'i gdangs ma 'gags par sa le ba 'dra ba/ sang nge ba 'dra ba/ wal le gsal ba cig mi 'dug gam/ 'di la rang bzhin gsal ba zhes bya ba yin/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i stong sang nge ba de dang / de'i gdangs ma 135

pa'i ye shes dang / mngon par shes pa rgya chen po 'char bas ye shes kyi rtsa de kha phye ba'i yon tan las byung ba'o/ /des na mig btsum na/ rtsa de kha zum nas thur du shes pa nag thum gyi gti mug 'thib pa'o/ /lta stangs trig ge byas pas rtsa de'i kha gyen la bstan pas rig pa dwangs snyigs phyed nas/ gsal la rtog pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dag pa'i mthong snang du ma 'char bar 'gyur bas lta stangs gal che'o gsungs/ de yi dus su bla mas 'di skad ngo sprad do/ /'o de ltar sems ma bcos par lhan ne bzhag pa'i dus kyi shes pa 'di la cer re ltos shig 'o khyed rang rnams kyi sems rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas ma bcos pa'i ngang la lhan ne gnas pa cig mi 'dug gam/ 'di la zhi gnas zhes bya ba yin te/ sems kyi ngo bo min no/ /da khyod rang gi sems gnas mkhan gyi ngo bo kho rang la cer re ltos dang /dngos po dbyibs dang kha dog ci yi ngo bor yang ma grub pa/ ci yang med pa'i stong pa lhang nge ba cig mi 'dug gam/ 'di la ngo bo stong pa bya ba yin/ stong pa de'i gdangs ma 'gags par sa le ba 'dra ba/ sang nge ba 'dra ba/ wal le gsal ba cig mi 'dug gam/ 'di la rang bzhin gsal ba zhes bya ba yin/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i stong sang nge ba de dang / de'i gdangs ma 135

'gags par sa le ba gnyis dbyer mi phyed par hrig ge ba 'dra ba/ lhang nge ba 'dra ba'i rig pa yod rgyu zhig yod la/ khar dngos su smra rgyu ma rnyed pa'i shes pa da lta'i trig ge ba 'di la rig pa zhes ming du btags pa yin/ bsam par byed pa'i mkhan po yang 'di kho na yin pas sems zhes ming du btags pa yin/ mi dran dgu dran gyi mkhan bo yang 'di yin pas dran pa zhes ming du btags pa yin/ mthong rgyu med bzhin du gsal hrig ge rjen ne cer re lhag ges mthong bas/ lhag mthong zhes ming du btags pa yin gsungs/ mdor na rang tha mal rang dga' la gnas pa'i dus kyi shes pa gsal le hrig ge ba 'di kho na yin no/ /'di la dbyibs dang kha dog ci'i ngo bo yang ma grub pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ de bzhin du trig ge gsal le ba/sus kyang ma byas pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal bas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ dus 'di tsam nas byung / rgyu rkyen 'di las byung bya ba med pas/ skye ba'i mtha' dang bral/ dus 'di tsam na sems la shi ba'am/ 'gags bya ba med pas 'gags pa'i mtha' dang bral/ med bzhin 'gags med kyi rtsal ci cir yang 'char bas gcig gi mtha' dang bral/ sna tshogs su 'char yang rang bzhin med par grol bas du ma'i mtha' dang bral/ des na 136

'gags par sa le ba gnyis dbyer mi phyed par hrig ge ba 'dra ba/ lhang nge ba 'dra ba'i rig pa yod rgyu zhig yod la/ khar dngos su smra rgyu ma rnyed pa'i shes pa da lta'i trig ge ba 'di la rig pa zhes ming du btags pa yin/ bsam par byed pa'i mkhan po yang 'di kho na yin pas sems zhes ming du btags pa yin/ mi dran dgu dran gyi mkhan bo yang 'di yin pas dran pa zhes ming du btags pa yin/ mthong rgyu med bzhin du gsal hrig ge rjen ne cer re lhag ges mthong bas/ lhag mthong zhes ming du btags pa yin gsungs/ mdor na rang tha mal rang dga' la gnas pa'i dus kyi shes pa gsal le hrig ge ba 'di kho na yin no/ /'di la dbyibs dang kha dog ci'i ngo bo yang ma grub pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ de bzhin du trig ge gsal le ba/sus kyang ma byas pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal bas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ dus 'di tsam nas byung / rgyu rkyen 'di las byung bya ba med pas/ skye ba'i mtha' dang bral/ dus 'di tsam na sems la shi ba'am/ 'gags bya ba med pas 'gags pa'i mtha' dang bral/ med bzhin 'gags med kyi rtsal ci cir yang 'char bas gcig gi mtha' dang bral/ sna tshogs su 'char yang rang bzhin med par grol bas du ma'i mtha' dang bral/ des na 136

mtha' bral gyi lta ba zhes bya gsungs/ sems kho rang ye gdod ma nas kho rang gi rang gshis de ka ltar yod pa yin kyang / sngar lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas bsgribs nas ngo ma shes/ thag ma chod/ zhe ma tshims/ yid ma ches pas da lta bar du 'khrul ba yin mod/ da ni nor bdag po la 'phrod/rang ngo rang gis shes/ rang mtshang rang gis rig sems ngo 'phrod pa zhes bya ba yin no zhes rgya cher gsungs so/ /gzhan yang yid ches pa'i lung ni/ bltas pas grol ba'i rgyud las/ kye gsang ba'i bdag po nyon cigarang gi shes rig gi ngo bo sang nge ba/ dngos po dang kha dog ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa/ stong sang nge ba 'di sangs rgyas kun tu bzang mo yin no/ /rang gi shes rig gi ngo bo stong bdo tsa na stong pa phyad chad du ma song bar/ rang gi shes rig ma 'gags par wal le gsal ba 'di ka sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yin no/ /rang gi rig pa dngos po cir yang ma grub pa'i ngo bo stong pa dang / rang gi shes rig wal le gsal bar 'dug pa 'di gnyis dbyer mi phyed par 'dug pa sangs rgyas chos kyi sku yin no/ /rang gi rig pa gsal stong dbyer med 'od kyi phung po chen por bzhugs pa 'di la skye 'chi med pas sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ngo shes pas chos go zhes gsungs pa 137

mtha' bral gyi lta ba zhes bya gsungs/ sems kho rang ye gdod ma nas kho rang gi rang gshis de ka ltar yod pa yin kyang / sngar lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas bsgribs nas ngo ma shes/ thag ma chod/ zhe ma tshims/ yid ma ches pas da lta bar du 'khrul ba yin mod/ da ni nor bdag po la 'phrod/rang ngo rang gis shes/ rang mtshang rang gis rig sems ngo 'phrod pa zhes bya ba yin no zhes rgya cher gsungs so/ /gzhan yang yid ches pa'i lung ni/ bltas pas grol ba'i rgyud las/ kye gsang ba'i bdag po nyon cigarang gi shes rig gi ngo bo sang nge ba/ dngos po dang kha dog ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa/ stong sang nge ba 'di sangs rgyas kun tu bzang mo yin no/ /rang gi shes rig gi ngo bo stong bdo tsa na stong pa phyad chad du ma song bar/ rang gi shes rig ma 'gags par wal le gsal ba 'di ka sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yin no/ /rang gi rig pa dngos po cir yang ma grub pa'i ngo bo stong pa dang / rang gi shes rig wal le gsal bar 'dug pa 'di gnyis dbyer mi phyed par 'dug pa sangs rgyas chos kyi sku yin no/ /rang gi rig pa gsal stong dbyer med 'od kyi phung po chen por bzhugs pa 'di la skye 'chi med pas sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ngo shes pas chos go zhes gsungs pa 137

dang / yang ye shes mar me'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i bdag po rang gi snying gi dkyil na chos kyi sku mtshan mar ma grub pas stong par bzhugs so/ /rig pa ma 'gags par gsal bar bzhugs so/ /sgrib pa med par zang thal du bzhugs so/ /lhun gyis grub pas phyogs med du 'char bzhin ma 'gags par bzhugs so/ /gsang ba'i bdag po/ chos sku mtshan mar ma grub pas stong par bzhugs pa ni/ rang gi shes rig gi ngo bo stong sang nge ba 'di/dngos po dang kha dog ci yi ngo bor ma grub pas/ stong sang nge ba 'di yin no/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /zhes rgyas par bshad pas sems ngo skyong mkhan rnams la phan thogs chen po byung / de'i rjes su nyams mgur 'di yang blangs so//rang sems sangs rgyas kyi rang ngo sprod mkhan gyi bla ma/ /rang la sangs rgyas las bka' drin lhag par du che byung / /mi lta snyam na yang gsal stong rjen pa kho mthong byung / mi bsgom snyam na yang sgom gyis tshur la rang bskyangs byung / /mi spyod snyam na yang bde stong ting 'dzin ros myos byung / /mi dgos snyam na yang nyams rtogs yon tan 'dra shar byung / /mi skye snyam na yang snying rje rang shugs kyis skyes byung / /stong nyid snying rje gnyis 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor nga skyid pa/ /nyams mgur 'di nyid ni 138

dang / yang ye shes mar me'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i bdag po rang gi snying gi dkyil na chos kyi sku mtshan mar ma grub pas stong par bzhugs so/ /rig pa ma 'gags par gsal bar bzhugs so/ /sgrib pa med par zang thal du bzhugs so/ /lhun gyis grub pas phyogs med du 'char bzhin ma 'gags par bzhugs so/ /gsang ba'i bdag po/ chos sku mtshan mar ma grub pas stong par bzhugs pa ni/ rang gi shes rig gi ngo bo stong sang nge ba 'di/dngos po dang kha dog ci yi ngo bor ma grub pas/ stong sang nge ba 'di yin no/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /zhes rgyas par bshad pas sems ngo skyong mkhan rnams la phan thogs chen po byung / de'i rjes su nyams mgur 'di yang blangs so//rang sems sangs rgyas kyi rang ngo sprod mkhan gyi bla ma/ /rang la sangs rgyas las bka' drin lhag par du che byung / /mi lta snyam na yang gsal stong rjen pa kho mthong byung / mi bsgom snyam na yang sgom gyis tshur la rang bskyangs byung / /mi spyod snyam na yang bde stong ting 'dzin ros myos byung / /mi dgos snyam na yang nyams rtogs yon tan 'dra shar byung / /mi skye snyam na yang snying rje rang shugs kyis skyes byung / /stong nyid snying rje gnyis 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor nga skyid pa/ /nyams mgur 'di nyid ni 138

mthong thos dran reg gi rgyud la/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'dra skye ba'i smon lam rang 'debs so/ /zhes blangs pas kun dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de'i dbyar sos char chen po ma babs tshe thams cad kyis char 'bebs dgos byas pas/ 'o nga la char 'bebs pa'i gdams pa tsho med de/ ngas bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs zhes nyin cig ri rtse nas mnyam gzhag byas sems can la snying rje bsgoms/ de nas rang nyid skad cig nyid la rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ 'od zer nyi ma shar ba ltar phyogs bcur 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ phyi snod 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad dag pa'i zhing dang gzhal yas khang / nang bcud kyi skye 'gro sems can thams cad lha lha mo'i rang bzhin dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing khams 'di dag rnams su lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa/'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta 139

mthong thos dran reg gi rgyud la/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'dra skye ba'i smon lam rang 'debs so/ /zhes blangs pas kun dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de'i dbyar sos char chen po ma babs tshe thams cad kyis char 'bebs dgos byas pas/ 'o nga la char 'bebs pa'i gdams pa tsho med de/ ngas bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs zhes nyin cig ri rtse nas mnyam gzhag byas sems can la snying rje bsgoms/ de nas rang nyid skad cig nyid la rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ 'od zer nyi ma shar ba ltar phyogs bcur 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ phyi snod 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad dag pa'i zhing dang gzhal yas khang / nang bcud kyi skye 'gro sems can thams cad lha lha mo'i rang bzhin dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing khams 'di dag rnams su lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa/'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta 139

bus sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur ces mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bton/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong / nor lha gter bdag lha klu mi ma yin mthu bo che/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba thams cad spyan drangs/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams thams cad char sprin gyis gang ba'i klong du dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa'i gnas lnga dang phyag zhabs kyi mthil/ sku'i cha thams cad nas char sprin chen po byung nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams thams cad khyab nas char chen po babs/ sku'i cha las kyang bdud rtsi'i char rgyun babs/lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ steng lha'i yul gyi sprin dang / 'og klu'i yul gyi sprin dang / bar mi'i yul gyi sprin dang / gzhan yang phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og dang bcu na gnas pa'i sprin nam mkha'i khams la mi shong ba tsam tshur bsdus/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams thams cad khyab nas char chen po 'bab par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin 140

bus sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur ces mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bton/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong / nor lha gter bdag lha klu mi ma yin mthu bo che/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba thams cad spyan drangs/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams thams cad char sprin gyis gang ba'i klong du dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa'i gnas lnga dang phyag zhabs kyi mthil/ sku'i cha thams cad nas char sprin chen po byung nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams thams cad khyab nas char chen po babs/ sku'i cha las kyang bdud rtsi'i char rgyun babs/lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ steng lha'i yul gyi sprin dang / 'og klu'i yul gyi sprin dang / bar mi'i yul gyi sprin dang / gzhan yang phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og dang bcu na gnas pa'i sprin nam mkha'i khams la mi shong ba tsam tshur bsdus/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i khams thams cad khyab nas char chen po 'bab par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin 140

rlabs/ bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs/khyad par du bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas tshe gang bo 'di la dge ba bgyis pa dang / ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu dang nus pa de rnams char sprin chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab nas char chen po babs te/ 'jig rten khams 'di'i btab pa'i lo tog dang / ma btab pa'i rtsi thog thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa'i re ba thams cad yongs su skong bar gyur/ oṃ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams mchod 'os skyabs gyur gyi lha rnams kyis nam mkha' la sprin bsdus char phobs swā hā/ zhes ngag gis bton/ yid kyis char sprin las char chen po 'bab pa'i dmigs pa byas pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas/nyin gung nas nam mkha' la sprin chen po phyogs phyogs nas 'dus te/ char chen po babs pas slob ma yon bdag thams cad dga' zhing spro ba byung / de nas dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis mchod pa phul bsngo smon gyes mtshams sbyor yang byas/ rjes su char dgos pa'i dus su/ de lta bu'i char sprin gye ting nge 'dzin la bsdad pas char chen po babs pa byung tshe/ lha mi thams cad 141

rlabs/ bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs/khyad par du bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas tshe gang bo 'di la dge ba bgyis pa dang / ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu dang nus pa de rnams char sprin chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab nas char chen po babs te/ 'jig rten khams 'di'i btab pa'i lo tog dang / ma btab pa'i rtsi thog thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa'i re ba thams cad yongs su skong bar gyur/ oṃ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams mchod 'os skyabs gyur gyi lha rnams kyis nam mkha' la sprin bsdus char phobs swā hā/ zhes ngag gis bton/ yid kyis char sprin las char chen po 'bab pa'i dmigs pa byas pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas/nyin gung nas nam mkha' la sprin chen po phyogs phyogs nas 'dus te/ char chen po babs pas slob ma yon bdag thams cad dga' zhing spro ba byung / de nas dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis mchod pa phul bsngo smon gyes mtshams sbyor yang byas/ rjes su char dgos pa'i dus su/ de lta bu'i char sprin gye ting nge 'dzin la bsdad pas char chen po babs pa byung tshe/ lha mi thams cad 141

kyis snyan pa dang grags pa bsgrags/ lo yag skal bzang byung /chos pa nas bsod pa dang / ngan slong tsho lto mod pa byung tshe/ltogs na rkus dran/ brgyags na chos dran zer ba'i 'jig rten gtam dpe ltar/ ma ṇi la sogs pa'i chos dran mkhan mang po byung ngo / /nga'i bsam pa la char 'di 'bebs mi thub pa ma gtogs/ thub rgyu yin na nas do bo khri phrag 'bum phrag mang po'i sbyin pa btang ba las lhag gi phan yon 'dug ang snyam pa byung nas/ dbyar sos rang gis rang la bskul nas char sprin gyi ting nge 'dzin la yang yang snyoms par zhugs so//de'i dus sku gzhogs ska phug sprul pa'i sku dang dge 'dun pa rnams kyis skyabs mgon gser khang rdo rje 'chang gdan drangs nas/ kun rig gi dbang zhus pa'i gral du nga yang bsdad nas dbang thob pa'i skal ba bzang po byung / de'i lo a chung gnam rdzong rtser mtshams khang yag po zhig bzos sngags pa rnams kyis mtshams re bshar/ rtsa ru dgon pa btab dge 'dun pa rnams kyis dge sbyor byas/ rjes su rtse yi brag phug gong du zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing bkod cig bzhengs na bzang byas pas/ sngags mang gis bzhengs nas legs po grub pa byung /de dag rnams kyi rgyu khong tshos phul bas 'di nas 'gro dbos 142

chen po ma byung / de nas skyid le ru song rma chu'i pha khar bud/ de ru rdis tsha la sogs rma pha ri'i mjal ba brgya phrag mang po byung ba la mjal kha btang / kun sa la 'tshogs pa dang khrus dang byen rlabs byas pa'i mthar/ 'o 'khor ba 'di la snying po med pa/ mi rtag pa sdug bsngal pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di las thar pa zhig bya dgos/ thar pa tsam gyes kyang mi chog par thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob dgos/ de 'thob pa'i phyir sems can gzhan la gnod pa'i las sdig pa spang dgos/ phan pa'i las dge ba sgrub dgos/ dus rgyun du sems bzang po byed dgos/ de ltar byas na gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur zhes mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//rang lha ru gsal ba'i spyi bo'i steng / /zhing dag pa rab 'byams pho brang dbus/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sku rab mdzes 'od zer 'phro bzhin bzhugs/ /bus mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas 'dir 'tshogs skal bzang pho mo yi/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /nged thams cad gnas 'dir yud tsam 'dus/ /yun mi ring gyes nas 'gro ba bzhin/ /chos 143

chen po ma byung / de nas skyid le ru song rma chu'i pha khar bud/ de ru rdis tsha la sogs rma pha ri'i mjal ba brgya phrag mang po byung ba la mjal kha btang / kun sa la 'tshogs pa dang khrus dang byen rlabs byas pa'i mthar/ 'o 'khor ba 'di la snying po med pa/ mi rtag pa sdug bsngal pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di las thar pa zhig bya dgos/ thar pa tsam gyes kyang mi chog par thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob dgos/ de 'thob pa'i phyir sems can gzhan la gnod pa'i las sdig pa spang dgos/ phan pa'i las dge ba sgrub dgos/ dus rgyun du sems bzang po byed dgos/ de ltar byas na gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur zhes mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//rang lha ru gsal ba'i spyi bo'i steng / /zhing dag pa rab 'byams pho brang dbus/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sku rab mdzes 'od zer 'phro bzhin bzhugs/ /bus mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas 'dir 'tshogs skal bzang pho mo yi/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /nged thams cad gnas 'dir yud tsam 'dus/ /yun mi ring gyes nas 'gro ba bzhin/ /chos 143

thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /chos nyams su len na mang mi dgos/ /las mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang po gyis/ /tshig de gsum nang du chos kun 'dus/ /'di ma brjed kun gyi sems la zungs/ /ngas khyed rnams mi brjed sems la 'dzin/ /dus da re mjal ba yud tsam snang / /phyis lhod lhod byas nas mjal bar smon/ /sa thag ring skye 'chi khrigs khrigs med/ /dus da nas tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar rgyal ba rigs lnga yi/ /zhing rnams su yang yang mjal bar shog /steng lha yi yul la bkra shis shog /'og klu yi yul la bkra shis shog /bar mi yi yul la bkra shis shog /bkra shis pas yul kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pa'i mthar yar langs phyag dang skor ba byas dad bzhin rang rang gi yul du song nas sdig spong dge sgrub la brtson pa mang po byung ngo / /de nas tshur 'ong ga nub khams ra'i sde ba gzhan rnams kyi nang du song bsngo smon bkra shis brjod nas kun gyi sems dga' bar byas/ de nas do rgya ru 'ong lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rgya che zhing bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i lhag bsam can do rgya'i dpon po pha bu sogs dam ldan sngags 'chang rnams kyis sngags khang gsar ba'i nang du gdan drangs/144

thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /chos nyams su len na mang mi dgos/ /las mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang po gyis/ /tshig de gsum nang du chos kun 'dus/ /'di ma brjed kun gyi sems la zungs/ /ngas khyed rnams mi brjed sems la 'dzin/ /dus da re mjal ba yud tsam snang / /phyis lhod lhod byas nas mjal bar smon/ /sa thag ring skye 'chi khrigs khrigs med/ /dus da nas tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar rgyal ba rigs lnga yi/ /zhing rnams su yang yang mjal bar shog /steng lha yi yul la bkra shis shog /'og klu yi yul la bkra shis shog /bar mi yi yul la bkra shis shog /bkra shis pas yul kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pa'i mthar yar langs phyag dang skor ba byas dad bzhin rang rang gi yul du song nas sdig spong dge sgrub la brtson pa mang po byung ngo / /de nas tshur 'ong ga nub khams ra'i sde ba gzhan rnams kyi nang du song bsngo smon bkra shis brjod nas kun gyi sems dga' bar byas/ de nas do rgya ru 'ong lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rgya che zhing bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i lhag bsam can do rgya'i dpon po pha bu sogs dam ldan sngags 'chang rnams kyis sngags khang gsar ba'i nang du gdan drangs/144

nyi ma mang po'i bar du zhabs tog byas/ sku gsung thugs rten rnams la rab gnas yang yang byas/ mchod pa phul bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ phyogs de'i skya ser rnams kyis zas nor mang po phul ba rnams kyi nang nas lha ri gsang sgrogs sogs phyogs de'i dgon pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byas/ ngan slong rnams la phying ba snam bu btsems nas gos lham lnga bcu lhag gis sbyin pa btang / mi dga' lha dga' byung / ngas dad can kun gyi sems la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yin/ /spyi bor brgyan nas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i lam chen la zhugs nas/ /sangs rgyas sa ru 'gro rnams dga' bas nyon/ /bla mas ci gsung bsgrubs na ci bsam 'grub/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrubs shig yon bdag rnams/ /dal 'byor mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /don med chud zos ma gtong yon bdag rnams/ /'chi ba bsams na dam pa'i lha chos 'ong / /nam 'chi cha med soms shig yon bdag rnams/ /shi na sdig can dmyal ba'i gnas su 'go/ /mi dge'i sdig pa ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /las can mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /rnam dkar dge la 'bod cig yon bdag rnams/ /'gro kun skye ba 145
