nyi ma mang po'i bar du zhabs tog byas/ sku gsung thugs rten rnams la rab gnas yang yang byas/ mchod pa phul bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ phyogs de'i skya ser rnams kyis zas nor mang po phul ba rnams kyi nang nas lha ri gsang sgrogs sogs phyogs de'i dgon pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byas/ ngan slong rnams la phying ba snam bu btsems nas gos lham lnga bcu lhag gis sbyin pa btang / mi dga' lha dga' byung / ngas dad can kun gyi sems la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yin/ /spyi bor brgyan nas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i lam chen la zhugs nas/ /sangs rgyas sa ru 'gro rnams dga' bas nyon/ /bla mas ci gsung bsgrubs na ci bsam 'grub/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrubs shig yon bdag rnams/ /dal 'byor mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /don med chud zos ma gtong yon bdag rnams/ /'chi ba bsams na dam pa'i lha chos 'ong / /nam 'chi cha med soms shig yon bdag rnams/ /shi na sdig can dmyal ba'i gnas su 'go/ /mi dge'i sdig pa ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /las can mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /rnam dkar dge la 'bod cig yon bdag rnams/ /'gro kun skye ba 145

sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /byams dang snying rje sbyongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /skyid sdug gang gi dus su khyem mtshes dgos/ /khyim mtshes byams po gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /khyim tshang mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /thams cad mthun par 'grogs shig yon bdag rnams/ /ser sna che na yi dwags gnas su skye/ /g.yog por zas gos byen cig yon bdag rnams/ /bod kyi lha skal thugs rje chen po yin/ /rgyun du ma ṇi bgrongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /bsam pa bzang na yid la bsam tshad 'grub/ /bsam pa dkar po gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /lha chos byed na zhal gdams mang mi dgos/ /'di tsam gyis kyang chog go yon bdag rnams/ /glu 'di thos tshad yon bdag pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis g.yang 'khyil zhing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas kun gyis de ltar byas pas yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis lo legs byung nas thams cad bde zhing skyid par gyur to//de'i skabs su sku gzhogs lha ri tshang la sprul sku gnyis 'khrungs pa/ de'i don du dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa dang / a 'byung gi bkra shis don 'grub rnams ma 'grigs pa'i bar la/146

sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /byams dang snying rje sbyongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /skyid sdug gang gi dus su khyem mtshes dgos/ /khyim mtshes byams po gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /khyim tshang mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /thams cad mthun par 'grogs shig yon bdag rnams/ /ser sna che na yi dwags gnas su skye/ /g.yog por zas gos byen cig yon bdag rnams/ /bod kyi lha skal thugs rje chen po yin/ /rgyun du ma ṇi bgrongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /bsam pa bzang na yid la bsam tshad 'grub/ /bsam pa dkar po gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /lha chos byed na zhal gdams mang mi dgos/ /'di tsam gyis kyang chog go yon bdag rnams/ /glu 'di thos tshad yon bdag pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis g.yang 'khyil zhing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas kun gyis de ltar byas pas yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis lo legs byung nas thams cad bde zhing skyid par gyur to//de'i skabs su sku gzhogs lha ri tshang la sprul sku gnyis 'khrungs pa/ de'i don du dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa dang / a 'byung gi bkra shis don 'grub rnams ma 'grigs pa'i bar la/146

nga'i sku tshab tu blo ldan stag yan btang nas chos gzu byas/ a 'byung sprul sku'i yab bkra shis don 'grub la dngul srang lnga bcu ma gcig gis 'go byas dngul rdo tshad lnga'i rtsis byen/gdan sa blos gtong ba byas/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis khri ga'i jo'u bdag tshang la 'khrungs pa'i sprul sku de gdan sar bkod nas khri ston byas/ a mgron sprul sku nga'i rjes su phebs/ phan tshun gnyis ka la bshad rgyu med par bkra shis po byas/ de nas do rgya'i sde ba bar tshigs/ la rnga/ lha chung / srin mo/ khen rgya/ ska phug tsho gsum/ bod bya tshang rnams la rim gyis song / chos bshad mgur dbyangs mang po blangs nas kun gyi blo kha chos la bsgyur te/ yul khams chos kyis dkar por btang / de nas a 'byung sde ba'i nang du song / dad gtong blo gros mchog tu mnga' ba'i mgon po rgya mtsho'i khyem du bsdad/ zhag ma kha shas zhabs tog byas/ phyogs de'i dad can yon bdag rnams kyis nga'i rjes na ngan slong brgya lhag tsam zhig yod pa la/ ja thug sogs kyi zas sbyin rgya chen po btang kun tshims par byas nas/ dad can mgon po rgya mtshos 'dir 'tshogs rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i bka' chos shig gnang dgos zhes zhu yig tshigs bcad 'di phul lo//147

nga'i sku tshab tu blo ldan stag yan btang nas chos gzu byas/ a 'byung sprul sku'i yab bkra shis don 'grub la dngul srang lnga bcu ma gcig gis 'go byas dngul rdo tshad lnga'i rtsis byen/gdan sa blos gtong ba byas/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis khri ga'i jo'u bdag tshang la 'khrungs pa'i sprul sku de gdan sar bkod nas khri ston byas/ a mgron sprul sku nga'i rjes su phebs/ phan tshun gnyis ka la bshad rgyu med par bkra shis po byas/ de nas do rgya'i sde ba bar tshigs/ la rnga/ lha chung / srin mo/ khen rgya/ ska phug tsho gsum/ bod bya tshang rnams la rim gyis song / chos bshad mgur dbyangs mang po blangs nas kun gyi blo kha chos la bsgyur te/ yul khams chos kyis dkar por btang / de nas a 'byung sde ba'i nang du song / dad gtong blo gros mchog tu mnga' ba'i mgon po rgya mtsho'i khyem du bsdad/ zhag ma kha shas zhabs tog byas/ phyogs de'i dad can yon bdag rnams kyis nga'i rjes na ngan slong brgya lhag tsam zhig yod pa la/ ja thug sogs kyi zas sbyin rgya chen po btang kun tshims par byas nas/ dad can mgon po rgya mtshos 'dir 'tshogs rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i bka' chos shig gnang dgos zhes zhu yig tshigs bcad 'di phul lo//147

sngon gyi sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon/ /de la sems can 'ga' zhig gis/ /g.yas nas tsan dan sde gu yis/ /sku la byugs par byed pa dang / /g.yon nas sta gris gshags pa gnyis/ /nye ring chags sdang mi mdzad par/ /sems can kun gyi mgon dang skyabs/ /dpung gnyen mdzad pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /skyabs mgon khyed kyi snying rje'i sgos/ /sems can 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshe/ /sems can 'ga' res phan btags pa'i/ /lan du gnod pa skyel na yang / /da dung yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /slar yang brtse bas rjes su bzung / /gnod lan phan pas 'jal ba yi/ /rnam thar 'di ni ngo mtshar che//ngo mtshar che ba'i bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyed thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rang gzhan sdig ltung mthol lo bshags/ /'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rang / /zab rgya'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /'dir 'tshogs slob ma yon bdag la/ /'di phyi kun tu phan pa yi/ /zhal gdams bzang po stsal du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du ngas 'di skad smras/ 'o dper na 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi 'khor lo rin po che gang du mchis pa der/ 'khor dang dpung 148

sngon gyi sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon/ /de la sems can 'ga' zhig gis/ /g.yas nas tsan dan sde gu yis/ /sku la byugs par byed pa dang / /g.yon nas sta gris gshags pa gnyis/ /nye ring chags sdang mi mdzad par/ /sems can kun gyi mgon dang skyabs/ /dpung gnyen mdzad pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /skyabs mgon khyed kyi snying rje'i sgos/ /sems can 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshe/ /sems can 'ga' res phan btags pa'i/ /lan du gnod pa skyel na yang / /da dung yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /slar yang brtse bas rjes su bzung / /gnod lan phan pas 'jal ba yi/ /rnam thar 'di ni ngo mtshar che//ngo mtshar che ba'i bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyed thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rang gzhan sdig ltung mthol lo bshags/ /'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rang / /zab rgya'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /'dir 'tshogs slob ma yon bdag la/ /'di phyi kun tu phan pa yi/ /zhal gdams bzang po stsal du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du ngas 'di skad smras/ 'o dper na 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi 'khor lo rin po che gang du mchis pa der/ 'khor dang dpung 148

dang bcas pa mchis pa bzhin/ snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchis par gsungs/dper na ma bzang mo zhig gis bu la snying rje mchis na/ gnod pa mi byed pas phan 'dogs pa chos nyid yin pa ltar/ nged rnams kyi rgyud la snying rje chen po mchis na/ sems can la gnod mi byed par phan 'dogs pa chos nyid yin kyang / deng sang kun gyis sems can la phan mi 'dogs pa'i khar gnod skyel ba 'di rgyud la snying rje chen po ma skyes pas lan 'dug pas/ des na chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'di gal che zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub kyi/ /sems las byung zhing de nyid kyi/ /rtsa ba snying rje thabs kyi mthar/ /phyin ces rnam snang rgyud las gsungs/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod pas/ /thog mtha' bar gsum gang la yang / /snying rje bsgom pa gal che zhes/ /byang chub lam rim chen mor gsungs/ /snying rje chen po'i nor bu mchog /thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i 'jigs med ces/ /byams pa'i rnam thar mdo las gsungs/ /snying brtser bcas pas rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod par bslab na byang chub rig /'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi dge /149

dang bcas pa mchis pa bzhin/ snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchis par gsungs/dper na ma bzang mo zhig gis bu la snying rje mchis na/ gnod pa mi byed pas phan 'dogs pa chos nyid yin pa ltar/ nged rnams kyi rgyud la snying rje chen po mchis na/ sems can la gnod mi byed par phan 'dogs pa chos nyid yin kyang / deng sang kun gyis sems can la phan mi 'dogs pa'i khar gnod skyel ba 'di rgyud la snying rje chen po ma skyes pas lan 'dug pas/ des na chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'di gal che zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub kyi/ /sems las byung zhing de nyid kyi/ /rtsa ba snying rje thabs kyi mthar/ /phyin ces rnam snang rgyud las gsungs/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod pas/ /thog mtha' bar gsum gang la yang / /snying rje bsgom pa gal che zhes/ /byang chub lam rim chen mor gsungs/ /snying rje chen po'i nor bu mchog /thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i 'jigs med ces/ /byams pa'i rnam thar mdo las gsungs/ /snying brtser bcas pas rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod par bslab na byang chub rig /'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi dge /149

'byung zhes sdud pa dag las gsungs/ /byams dang snying rje kun mkhyen sems/ /yid la byed pas gnas pa 'di/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan no zhes/ /rnam nges cho 'phrul mdo las gsungs/ /snying rje'i yon tan nam mkha' mnyam/ /spyod yul ston pa sangs rgyas gcig /rgyu spyod bsod nams tshogs ldan zhes/ /mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang bas gsungs/ /snying rje brtan pa'i byang sems brtan/ /skye gnas mthar phyin rgyu yin phyir/ /'gro la snying rje che ba ni/ /rnyed dka' rin chen 'byung gnas gsungs//theg pa che chung khyad par yang / /lta ba'i sgo nas ma phyes par/ /snying rje'i sgo nas phyes so zhes/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bos gsungs/ /stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye/ /snying rje skyes na bdag gzhan med/ /bdag gzhan med na 'gro ba'i don/ /'grub ces rje btsun mi las gsungs/ /de bzhin rgyal ba sras bcas kyis//snying rje'i phan yon mtha' yas gsungs/ /chos pa bzang po byed 'dod na/ /snying rje phan sems ldan par mdzod/ /ces smras pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs nas sprang po tsho la sbyin pa gtong mkhan mang po byung ngo / /de nas ku ba dgon du 'ong sku gzhogs rin po che la mjal/chos 'brel zhus khong gis kyang tshur gsol ras bdag rkyen chen 150

'byung zhes sdud pa dag las gsungs/ /byams dang snying rje kun mkhyen sems/ /yid la byed pas gnas pa 'di/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan no zhes/ /rnam nges cho 'phrul mdo las gsungs/ /snying rje'i yon tan nam mkha' mnyam/ /spyod yul ston pa sangs rgyas gcig /rgyu spyod bsod nams tshogs ldan zhes/ /mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang bas gsungs/ /snying rje brtan pa'i byang sems brtan/ /skye gnas mthar phyin rgyu yin phyir/ /'gro la snying rje che ba ni/ /rnyed dka' rin chen 'byung gnas gsungs//theg pa che chung khyad par yang / /lta ba'i sgo nas ma phyes par/ /snying rje'i sgo nas phyes so zhes/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bos gsungs/ /stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye/ /snying rje skyes na bdag gzhan med/ /bdag gzhan med na 'gro ba'i don/ /'grub ces rje btsun mi las gsungs/ /de bzhin rgyal ba sras bcas kyis//snying rje'i phan yon mtha' yas gsungs/ /chos pa bzang po byed 'dod na/ /snying rje phan sems ldan par mdzod/ /ces smras pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs nas sprang po tsho la sbyin pa gtong mkhan mang po byung ngo / /de nas ku ba dgon du 'ong sku gzhogs rin po che la mjal/chos 'brel zhus khong gis kyang tshur gsol ras bdag rkyen chen 150

po byung / de'i lo nam tsha ngan pas sprang po je mang du song sprang po nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam khrid nas/ yon bdag rna gong ba nya mo klu rgyal sogs phyogs de'i sde ba che chung mang po brgyud nas song zas sbyin gtong du bcug nas/ nyam thag sprang po 'chi la nye ba mang po'i srog thar par byas/ de'i dus rang nyid sbyin pa la dga' ba'i shugs kyis mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs sbyin pa ru/ /gtong ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal po sbyin la dga' ba'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gang yod sbyin par gtong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir zas nor longs spyod 'dzom na yang / /yun ring mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /da lta yud tsam 'dzom pa'i dus skabs su/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /zas skom gos lham sman sogs sbyin par thongs/ /bu la byen na pha ma dga' ba ltar/ /sbyin pa btang na sangs rgyas byang sems mnyes/ /lha chos byed na mang po shes mi dgos/ /lag len dgos pas sprang po nyam thag la/ /phan pa'i sems kyis zan chang gcig byin kyang / /phyi ma 'byor ba can gyi mi ru skyes/ /rim gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par gsungs/ /rang nyid sbyin la dga' ba'i spro shugs kyis/ /kun la sbyin pa thongs zhes bshad pa 'di//151

po byung / de'i lo nam tsha ngan pas sprang po je mang du song sprang po nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam khrid nas/ yon bdag rna gong ba nya mo klu rgyal sogs phyogs de'i sde ba che chung mang po brgyud nas song zas sbyin gtong du bcug nas/ nyam thag sprang po 'chi la nye ba mang po'i srog thar par byas/ de'i dus rang nyid sbyin pa la dga' ba'i shugs kyis mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs sbyin pa ru/ /gtong ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal po sbyin la dga' ba'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gang yod sbyin par gtong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir zas nor longs spyod 'dzom na yang / /yun ring mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /da lta yud tsam 'dzom pa'i dus skabs su/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /zas skom gos lham sman sogs sbyin par thongs/ /bu la byen na pha ma dga' ba ltar/ /sbyin pa btang na sangs rgyas byang sems mnyes/ /lha chos byed na mang po shes mi dgos/ /lag len dgos pas sprang po nyam thag la/ /phan pa'i sems kyis zan chang gcig byin kyang / /phyi ma 'byor ba can gyi mi ru skyes/ /rim gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par gsungs/ /rang nyid sbyin la dga' ba'i spro shugs kyis/ /kun la sbyin pa thongs zhes bshad pa 'di//151

thos tshad rgyud la snying rje chen po skyes/ /nyam thag 'gro la sbyin pa gtong bar shog /ces blangs pas dad can rnams sbyin pa gtong bar yid spro ba byung / de nas ngang rong zer ba'i dgon pa skyid po zhig snang / de ru song nas zhag gcig bsdad sku gzhogs mog kya'i sprul sku dang mjal/ phyag rten phran bu phul/dge 'dun pa rnams la bsnyen bkur cung zad byas/ tshur mi mang por 'tsho ba zhabs tog yag po 'dug de'i dus ra rgod sprul sku tshang snyung ba la bka' bsgo byin rlabs byas pas drag pa byung / 'gro khar dad can dge 'dun pa 'ga' res phyis su yul phyogs gang la yang bkra mi shis pa mang po yong gin 'dug de la khyed kyis bkra shis re brjod na zer ba'i dus su 'di skad brjod/oṃ shar gyi phyogs kyi bkra shis lha/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bkra shis shog /nad gdon sdig sgrib kun zhi ba'i/ /bkra shis shar gyi phyogs nas shog /lho yi phyogs kyi bkra shis lha/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis shog /tshe dpal bsod nams kun rgyas pa'i/ /bkra shis lho yi phyogs nas shog /nub kyi phyogs kyi bkra shis lha/ /snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis shog /mi nor zas gsum dbang 'dus pa'i/ /bkra shis nub kyi phyogs nas shog /byang gi 152

thos tshad rgyud la snying rje chen po skyes/ /nyam thag 'gro la sbyin pa gtong bar shog /ces blangs pas dad can rnams sbyin pa gtong bar yid spro ba byung / de nas ngang rong zer ba'i dgon pa skyid po zhig snang / de ru song nas zhag gcig bsdad sku gzhogs mog kya'i sprul sku dang mjal/ phyag rten phran bu phul/dge 'dun pa rnams la bsnyen bkur cung zad byas/ tshur mi mang por 'tsho ba zhabs tog yag po 'dug de'i dus ra rgod sprul sku tshang snyung ba la bka' bsgo byin rlabs byas pas drag pa byung / 'gro khar dad can dge 'dun pa 'ga' res phyis su yul phyogs gang la yang bkra mi shis pa mang po yong gin 'dug de la khyed kyis bkra shis re brjod na zer ba'i dus su 'di skad brjod/oṃ shar gyi phyogs kyi bkra shis lha/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bkra shis shog /nad gdon sdig sgrib kun zhi ba'i/ /bkra shis shar gyi phyogs nas shog /lho yi phyogs kyi bkra shis lha/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis shog /tshe dpal bsod nams kun rgyas pa'i/ /bkra shis lho yi phyogs nas shog /nub kyi phyogs kyi bkra shis lha/ /snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis shog /mi nor zas gsum dbang 'dus pa'i/ /bkra shis nub kyi phyogs nas shog /byang gi 152

phyogs kyi gakra shis lha/ /don yod grub pa'i bkra shis shog /dgra bgegs bar chad tshar gcod pa'i/ /bkra shis byang gi phyogs nas shog /dbus kyi phyogs kyi bkra shis lha/ /rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis shog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyi/ /bkra shis dbus kyi phyogs nas shog /lha yi yul la bkra shis shog /klu yi yul la bkra shis shog /mi yi yul la bkra shis shog /yul phyogs kun la bkra shis shog /nam mkha'i khams la bkra shis shog /bar snang khams la bkra shis shog /sa gzhi'i khams la bkra shis shog /rgyal khams yongs la bkra shis shog /bkra shis dang dge legs bde skyid chen pos phyogs thams cad la khyab par gyur cig khyad par dgon gnas 'di la byen chags par gyur cig nang kun la g.yang 'khyil bar gyur cig ces brjod pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas yul khams thams cad la bkra shis par gyur to/ /de nas gnas chen lo ba'i brag dkar du song / gnas de ni kha lhor blta ba/ mdog shel ltar dkar pa ri mtho la sa gtsang ba/ lha shing shug pa sogs shing sna tshogs skyes pa chu shing 'dzom pa yid mthun bag phebs ri rgyud bzang zhing byin ldan gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas mchog khyad du 'phags pa zhig gda'/ der zhag po 153

phyogs kyi gakra shis lha/ /don yod grub pa'i bkra shis shog /dgra bgegs bar chad tshar gcod pa'i/ /bkra shis byang gi phyogs nas shog /dbus kyi phyogs kyi bkra shis lha/ /rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis shog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyi/ /bkra shis dbus kyi phyogs nas shog /lha yi yul la bkra shis shog /klu yi yul la bkra shis shog /mi yi yul la bkra shis shog /yul phyogs kun la bkra shis shog /nam mkha'i khams la bkra shis shog /bar snang khams la bkra shis shog /sa gzhi'i khams la bkra shis shog /rgyal khams yongs la bkra shis shog /bkra shis dang dge legs bde skyid chen pos phyogs thams cad la khyab par gyur cig khyad par dgon gnas 'di la byen chags par gyur cig nang kun la g.yang 'khyil bar gyur cig ces brjod pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas yul khams thams cad la bkra shis par gyur to/ /de nas gnas chen lo ba'i brag dkar du song / gnas de ni kha lhor blta ba/ mdog shel ltar dkar pa ri mtho la sa gtsang ba/ lha shing shug pa sogs shing sna tshogs skyes pa chu shing 'dzom pa yid mthun bag phebs ri rgyud bzang zhing byin ldan gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas mchog khyad du 'phags pa zhig gda'/ der zhag po 153

bdun gyi bar du gnas 'brel bzhag pas/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa spyir dge sbyor 'phel zhing / khyad par nyin cig gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas/ skabs shig mtha' dbus med pa'i nam mkhas brtan g.yo thams cad la khyab pa de bzhin du/ sems kyis kyang yongs su khyab cing /gshis cir yang ma grub pa shin tu gsal ba me long lta bu la 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan cir yang 'char zhing / de yang sems las gzugs gzhan ma yin/ gzugs las kyang sems gzhan ma yin par sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin mthong tshe nga'i bsam pa la sems ngo skyong rgyu yin na bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis skabs shig sngon byon gong ma'i gsung bzhin/ snang ba phyi ru ma lus sems nyid nang du ma lus par/ mnyam par bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo ci yang mthong rgyu red snyam rab tu dga' zhing spro ba'i ngang nas nyams mgur 'di blangs so// kun gsal gyi thugs dgongs nam mkha' las yangs pa'i//kun mkhyen gyi 'jigs med gling pa khong mkhyen no/ /gnas lugs kyi ngang la yun ring du 'byams pa'i/ /rnal 'byor nga'i nyams shar glu dbyangs su len no/ /nam mkha' la nyi zla 154

bdun gyi bar du gnas 'brel bzhag pas/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa spyir dge sbyor 'phel zhing / khyad par nyin cig gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas/ skabs shig mtha' dbus med pa'i nam mkhas brtan g.yo thams cad la khyab pa de bzhin du/ sems kyis kyang yongs su khyab cing /gshis cir yang ma grub pa shin tu gsal ba me long lta bu la 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan cir yang 'char zhing / de yang sems las gzugs gzhan ma yin/ gzugs las kyang sems gzhan ma yin par sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin mthong tshe nga'i bsam pa la sems ngo skyong rgyu yin na bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis skabs shig sngon byon gong ma'i gsung bzhin/ snang ba phyi ru ma lus sems nyid nang du ma lus par/ mnyam par bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo ci yang mthong rgyu red snyam rab tu dga' zhing spro ba'i ngang nas nyams mgur 'di blangs so// kun gsal gyi thugs dgongs nam mkha' las yangs pa'i//kun mkhyen gyi 'jigs med gling pa khong mkhyen no/ /gnas lugs kyi ngang la yun ring du 'byams pa'i/ /rnal 'byor nga'i nyams shar glu dbyangs su len no/ /nam mkha' la nyi zla 154

gza' skar rnams shar bzhin/ /sems nyid kyi klong du 'khor 'das kun shar snang / /'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhi rang sems kyi gnas lugs/ /nam mkha' las yangs pa'i ngang du rang glod pas/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa rang sangs la song nas/ /'od gsal gyi nam mkha' rang shugs kyis langs song / /bying rmugs dang 'phro rgod gtan med du sangs nas/ /mnyam gzhag la gsal 'grib med pa 'di skyid do/ /mnyam gzhag ni nam mkha' lta bu yi ngang nas/ /'khor 'das kyi ltad mo sna tshogs shig mthong song / /nam mkha' las nyi ma 'gags med du 'char bzhin/ /sems nyid las snying rje 'gags med du 'char snang / /snang grags kyi chos kun dpe cha ru shar zhing / /mgrin pa 'di glu yi mdzod khang du 'dug go /rnal 'byor nga 'jigs med gling pa yi bu rgyud/ /nyams mgur 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang blangs yong / /phyi rabs kyi rjes 'jug rig 'dzin gyi tshogs rnams/ /nyams dbyangs 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang longs shog /ma 'ongs pa'i dad can rig 'dzin gyi tshogs la/ /nyams mgur 'di blangs pas phan par rang smon no/ /zhes blangs nas bsdad yod dus sngags rgan bkra shis don 'grub/ gnas skyabs 'bum/ yum lo/rna gong ba'i lha bzo la sogs phyogs de'i sngags 155

gza' skar rnams shar bzhin/ /sems nyid kyi klong du 'khor 'das kun shar snang / /'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhi rang sems kyi gnas lugs/ /nam mkha' las yangs pa'i ngang du rang glod pas/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa rang sangs la song nas/ /'od gsal gyi nam mkha' rang shugs kyis langs song / /bying rmugs dang 'phro rgod gtan med du sangs nas/ /mnyam gzhag la gsal 'grib med pa 'di skyid do/ /mnyam gzhag ni nam mkha' lta bu yi ngang nas/ /'khor 'das kyi ltad mo sna tshogs shig mthong song / /nam mkha' las nyi ma 'gags med du 'char bzhin/ /sems nyid las snying rje 'gags med du 'char snang / /snang grags kyi chos kun dpe cha ru shar zhing / /mgrin pa 'di glu yi mdzod khang du 'dug go /rnal 'byor nga 'jigs med gling pa yi bu rgyud/ /nyams mgur 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang blangs yong / /phyi rabs kyi rjes 'jug rig 'dzin gyi tshogs rnams/ /nyams dbyangs 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang longs shog /ma 'ongs pa'i dad can rig 'dzin gyi tshogs la/ /nyams mgur 'di blangs pas phan par rang smon no/ /zhes blangs nas bsdad yod dus sngags rgan bkra shis don 'grub/ gnas skyabs 'bum/ yum lo/rna gong ba'i lha bzo la sogs phyogs de'i sngags 155

pa bco lnga tsam 'ongs nas zas nor mang po phul nas/ sems khrid cig gnang dgos zhes bshad pas/ ngas rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gyi sgo nas sems khrid byas/ rig 'dzin nor bu la sogs pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa mang po byung / de dus sngags pa 'ga' res bla ma gzhan tsho la ma mkha' 'gros ma 'ongs lung bstan 'dra byung ba ltar khyed la e yong gi zer ba'i lan du/ ngas lung bstan bzang ngan gnyis ka yong gi zhes ku re'i tshul du 'di skad smras/deng sang bla ma 'ga' re la/ /mkha' 'gros lung bstan byung ba bzhin/ /bdag la bzang ngan gnyis ka yi/ /ma 'ongs lung bstan yong bar gda'/ /'gro don phyogs med bla ma rnams/ /zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i lung bstan byung / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i dge bshes rnams/ /sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i lung bstan byung / /brag la bsgom pa'i sgom chen rnams/ /'chi khar grol ba'i lung bstan byung / /tshul khrims bsrung ba'i dge slong rnams/ /dag zhing skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /pha mar byams pa'i mi skya rnams/ /lha ru skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /sbyin pa gtong ba'i bud med rnams/ /phyug por skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /chos dad che ba'i g.yog po rnams/ /dpon por skye ba'i lung bstan 156

pa bco lnga tsam 'ongs nas zas nor mang po phul nas/ sems khrid cig gnang dgos zhes bshad pas/ ngas rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gyi sgo nas sems khrid byas/ rig 'dzin nor bu la sogs pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa mang po byung / de dus sngags pa 'ga' res bla ma gzhan tsho la ma mkha' 'gros ma 'ongs lung bstan 'dra byung ba ltar khyed la e yong gi zer ba'i lan du/ ngas lung bstan bzang ngan gnyis ka yong gi zhes ku re'i tshul du 'di skad smras/deng sang bla ma 'ga' re la/ /mkha' 'gros lung bstan byung ba bzhin/ /bdag la bzang ngan gnyis ka yi/ /ma 'ongs lung bstan yong bar gda'/ /'gro don phyogs med bla ma rnams/ /zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i lung bstan byung / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i dge bshes rnams/ /sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i lung bstan byung / /brag la bsgom pa'i sgom chen rnams/ /'chi khar grol ba'i lung bstan byung / /tshul khrims bsrung ba'i dge slong rnams/ /dag zhing skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /pha mar byams pa'i mi skya rnams/ /lha ru skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /sbyin pa gtong ba'i bud med rnams/ /phyug por skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /chos dad che ba'i g.yog po rnams/ /dpon por skye ba'i lung bstan 156

byung / /chos la dag snang sbyong ba rnams/ /yul dbus skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /lung bstan bzang po de rnams steng / /'gro phyir kun gyis de bzhin gyis/ /zhen chags che ba'i bla ma rnams//rang yul skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /nga rgyal che ba'i dge bshes rnams/ /seng ger skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /phrag dog che ba'i sgom chen rnams/ /khye ru skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /'dod chags che ba'i grwa log rnams/ /bya ru skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /zhe sdang che ba'i mi skya rnams/ /sbrul du skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /ser sna che ba'i bud med rnams/ /yi dwags sgye ba'i lung bstan byung / /gti mug che ba'i g.yog po rnams/ /phag tu skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /chos la phyogs ris byed mkhan rnams/ /dmyal bar skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /lung bstan ngan pa de rnams steng / /ma song gong 'dir dogs zon gyis/ /zhes smras pas kun dga' bar gyur to//de nas 'gro khar sngags rgan rnams la/ nged rnams gnas chen 'dir yud tsam zhig 'dus nas so sor gyes pa bzhin/chos thams cad mi rtag 'di'i rang bzhin can yin pas/ mi nor zas gsum la chags zhen ma che/ tshe blos thongs phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir dge sbyor 'phel po 'dug pas/157

byung / /chos la dag snang sbyong ba rnams/ /yul dbus skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /lung bstan bzang po de rnams steng / /'gro phyir kun gyis de bzhin gyis/ /zhen chags che ba'i bla ma rnams//rang yul skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /nga rgyal che ba'i dge bshes rnams/ /seng ger skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /phrag dog che ba'i sgom chen rnams/ /khye ru skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /'dod chags che ba'i grwa log rnams/ /bya ru skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /zhe sdang che ba'i mi skya rnams/ /sbrul du skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /ser sna che ba'i bud med rnams/ /yi dwags sgye ba'i lung bstan byung / /gti mug che ba'i g.yog po rnams/ /phag tu skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /chos la phyogs ris byed mkhan rnams/ /dmyal bar skye ba'i lung bstan byung / /lung bstan ngan pa de rnams steng / /ma song gong 'dir dogs zon gyis/ /zhes smras pas kun dga' bar gyur to//de nas 'gro khar sngags rgan rnams la/ nged rnams gnas chen 'dir yud tsam zhig 'dus nas so sor gyes pa bzhin/chos thams cad mi rtag 'di'i rang bzhin can yin pas/ mi nor zas gsum la chags zhen ma che/ tshe blos thongs phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir dge sbyor 'phel po 'dug pas/157

khyed rnams phyin chad gnas 'dir lo re lo phyed tsam sdod la/rang gi chos gang shes rnams nyams su longs la rgyud la skye nges re gyis/ gzhan tshe blos btang gi ri khrod pa sdod mkhan byung na mthun rkyen re sgrubs dang sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i rten 'brel yod byas/ de nas thon te gcan za'i thang brgyud nas a byes lha gnyan brag dkar spun gsum gyi gangs ri'i 'dabs/go ra ka ron gyi phu na 'brog pa mang po yod sar song ri rtser lha rnams mnyes pa'i bsang btang khams gseng byas/ yon bdag rnams la thun mong gi chos bshad byas kun gyi blo kha chos phyogs la bsgyur/ 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa'i kha ta 'di ltar byas/ 'o sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gye mnyan yod na rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi blon po ri dwags zhes bya ba la bu bdun yod pa la/ chung shos de la mna' ma lha 'tshams ma zhes bya ba len dus/a ma na re/ bu mo khyod kyis de ring phan chad nas nyi ma zla ba gnyis la phyag 'tshol/ gos bzang gyon/ zas bzang zo/ bde bar nyol/ dus rgyun du me long la ltos shig zer bas/ bu mos de bzhin bya'o zer/ nang du 'ongs nas de ltar ma byas tshe/ gzhan gyes khyod mas bslabs pa ltar mi byed pa ci yin byas pas/ mo na re/ bdag gi ma ni mkhas ma yin pas/ nyi zla gnyis la phyag 158

khyed rnams phyin chad gnas 'dir lo re lo phyed tsam sdod la/rang gi chos gang shes rnams nyams su longs la rgyud la skye nges re gyis/ gzhan tshe blos btang gi ri khrod pa sdod mkhan byung na mthun rkyen re sgrubs dang sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i rten 'brel yod byas/ de nas thon te gcan za'i thang brgyud nas a byes lha gnyan brag dkar spun gsum gyi gangs ri'i 'dabs/go ra ka ron gyi phu na 'brog pa mang po yod sar song ri rtser lha rnams mnyes pa'i bsang btang khams gseng byas/ yon bdag rnams la thun mong gi chos bshad byas kun gyi blo kha chos phyogs la bsgyur/ 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa'i kha ta 'di ltar byas/ 'o sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gye mnyan yod na rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi blon po ri dwags zhes bya ba la bu bdun yod pa la/ chung shos de la mna' ma lha 'tshams ma zhes bya ba len dus/a ma na re/ bu mo khyod kyis de ring phan chad nas nyi ma zla ba gnyis la phyag 'tshol/ gos bzang gyon/ zas bzang zo/ bde bar nyol/ dus rgyun du me long la ltos shig zer bas/ bu mos de bzhin bya'o zer/ nang du 'ongs nas de ltar ma byas tshe/ gzhan gyes khyod mas bslabs pa ltar mi byed pa ci yin byas pas/ mo na re/ bdag gi ma ni mkhas ma yin pas/ nyi zla gnyis la phyag 158

'tshol zer ba de/ khyo ga'i pha ma gnyis la brtsi bkur gyis zer ba yin/ gos bzang po gyon zhes pa/ rtag tu ngo tsha khrel 'dzem che bar gyis zer ba yin/ zhim po zo zer ba a yi a byes khyo ka sogs la zas drangs tshar ba'i rjes la rang gis zas zo zer ba yin/ bde bar nyol zer ba/ khyim tshang bza' mi kun nyal ba'i rjes su nyol zer ba yin/ rtag tu me long la ltos zer ba las dang bya ba gang la ci dgos pa la ltos shig zer ba lags byas pas kun dga' bar gyur to/ /des na 'jig rten pa'i mna' ma sogs khyim tshang nang mi rnams kyis de ltar byas na legs zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /mi rtag thugs la 'khrungs pa yi/ /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi bas rgyud bskul nas/ /lha chos nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams thams cad po/ /mi rtag mi brtan snying po med/ /khyad par khyem tshang nang mi rnams/ /dper na tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin/ /yul phyogs gcig la yud tsam 'tshogs/ /yun ring mi sdod so sor gyes/ /phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshul soms la/ /deng sang khyem tshang nang mi kun/ /go re kyil ler 'dzom pa'i dus/ /don med khong khro mi ldang zhing / /kha nas tshig ngan mi smra bar/ /thams cad bsam pa 159

'tshol zer ba de/ khyo ga'i pha ma gnyis la brtsi bkur gyis zer ba yin/ gos bzang po gyon zhes pa/ rtag tu ngo tsha khrel 'dzem che bar gyis zer ba yin/ zhim po zo zer ba a yi a byes khyo ka sogs la zas drangs tshar ba'i rjes la rang gis zas zo zer ba yin/ bde bar nyol zer ba/ khyim tshang bza' mi kun nyal ba'i rjes su nyol zer ba yin/ rtag tu me long la ltos zer ba las dang bya ba gang la ci dgos pa la ltos shig zer ba lags byas pas kun dga' bar gyur to/ /des na 'jig rten pa'i mna' ma sogs khyim tshang nang mi rnams kyis de ltar byas na legs zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /mi rtag thugs la 'khrungs pa yi/ /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi bas rgyud bskul nas/ /lha chos nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams thams cad po/ /mi rtag mi brtan snying po med/ /khyad par khyem tshang nang mi rnams/ /dper na tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin/ /yul phyogs gcig la yud tsam 'tshogs/ /yun ring mi sdod so sor gyes/ /phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshul soms la/ /deng sang khyem tshang nang mi kun/ /go re kyil ler 'dzom pa'i dus/ /don med khong khro mi ldang zhing / /kha nas tshig ngan mi smra bar/ /thams cad bsam pa 159

mthun pa'i sgos/ /zhim pa'i zas re yod na zo/ /'jam pa'i gos re yod na gon/ /snyan pa'i gtam re yod na shod/ /phan pa'i chos re yod na gyis/ /mi rnams dga' ba chos yin pas/ /rgyun du dga' dga' spro spro gyis/ /de ltar byas na tshe ring zhing / /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa yong / /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /phan pa'i kha ta byas pa 'di/ /thos tshad khyim tshang mthun pa'i sgos/ /chos byas bde zhing skyid par shog /ces blangs pas che chung gnyis ga'i rgyud la phan po byung / nang mi kun mthun pa'i sgo nas chos byas gzhan gyi chos byed pa'i grogs byas par mi la tshe ring nang la bkra shis po byung / yang kha kya ban shul gyi ru nang du song nas 'gro don byas pa'i tshe/ dad can chos mthun dge slong tshul khrims dang chos 'phel sogs 'brog phyogs kyi slob ma yon bdag dad can 'ga' res 'khor ba la skyo ba skye ba'i chos shig gsung dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /rgya bod mkhas grub rnam thar bzhin/ /khyed kyis 'khor ba me yi 'obs/ /srin mo'i gling dang dug sbrul tshang / /'khor ba'i phun tshogs zas nor kyang / /dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas dang / /spu gri'i kha yi sbrang rtsi dang / /160

mthun pa'i sgos/ /zhim pa'i zas re yod na zo/ /'jam pa'i gos re yod na gon/ /snyan pa'i gtam re yod na shod/ /phan pa'i chos re yod na gyis/ /mi rnams dga' ba chos yin pas/ /rgyun du dga' dga' spro spro gyis/ /de ltar byas na tshe ring zhing / /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa yong / /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /phan pa'i kha ta byas pa 'di/ /thos tshad khyim tshang mthun pa'i sgos/ /chos byas bde zhing skyid par shog /ces blangs pas che chung gnyis ga'i rgyud la phan po byung / nang mi kun mthun pa'i sgo nas chos byas gzhan gyi chos byed pa'i grogs byas par mi la tshe ring nang la bkra shis po byung / yang kha kya ban shul gyi ru nang du song nas 'gro don byas pa'i tshe/ dad can chos mthun dge slong tshul khrims dang chos 'phel sogs 'brog phyogs kyi slob ma yon bdag dad can 'ga' res 'khor ba la skyo ba skye ba'i chos shig gsung dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /rgya bod mkhas grub rnam thar bzhin/ /khyed kyis 'khor ba me yi 'obs/ /srin mo'i gling dang dug sbrul tshang / /'khor ba'i phun tshogs zas nor kyang / /dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas dang / /spu gri'i kha yi sbrang rtsi dang / /160

dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu ltar/ /reg pa tsam gyes phung 'gyur na/ /de nyid bsten pa smos ci dgos/ /dgongs nas tshe 'di blo yis btang / /dam pa'i lha chos byas tshul la/ /bsam zhing dad pa gting nas skyes/ /da ni skye mchog khyed nyid la/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma lags te/ /bdag cag rjes 'jug bu slob dang / /sbyin bdag rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gsung du gsol/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs legs bsams nas/ /nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yang dpal ldan sa skya ba sogs dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin skye 'chi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsams nas/ gang la yang ma chags pa zhig gal che/de la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyas par bshad na brjod kyis mi lang ste/ rje lho brag mar pas/ mi la ras pa yul du 'byon khar/bu tshe 'di dang dam pa'i chos bsres na chos shor zin pa de rang yin/ bu yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhes/ /bdag gis lce brgyar rab sprul nas/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /bshad kyang brjod kyis mi lang bas/ /ngas bshad dam chos chud ma gsan/ /gsungs pa ltar yin kyang / bsdu na gsum du 'du/ gsum po gang zhe na/161

dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu ltar/ /reg pa tsam gyes phung 'gyur na/ /de nyid bsten pa smos ci dgos/ /dgongs nas tshe 'di blo yis btang / /dam pa'i lha chos byas tshul la/ /bsam zhing dad pa gting nas skyes/ /da ni skye mchog khyed nyid la/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma lags te/ /bdag cag rjes 'jug bu slob dang / /sbyin bdag rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gsung du gsol/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs legs bsams nas/ /nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yang dpal ldan sa skya ba sogs dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin skye 'chi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsams nas/ gang la yang ma chags pa zhig gal che/de la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyas par bshad na brjod kyis mi lang ste/ rje lho brag mar pas/ mi la ras pa yul du 'byon khar/bu tshe 'di dang dam pa'i chos bsres na chos shor zin pa de rang yin/ bu yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhes/ /bdag gis lce brgyar rab sprul nas/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /bshad kyang brjod kyis mi lang bas/ /ngas bshad dam chos chud ma gsan/ /gsungs pa ltar yin kyang / bsdu na gsum du 'du/ gsum po gang zhe na/161

sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang gsum yin/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni/ dmyal ba la tsha ba'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu grang ba'i sdug bsngal/ yi dwags la bkres pa'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu skom pa'i sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal gyi thog tu sha pags kyi ched du bsad pa'i sdug bsngal/ mi la skye rgas sdug bsngal gyi thog tu na 'chi'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin la 'thab cing rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu rmas shing bsad pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu mar la ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal gcig gi thog tu gnyis/gnyis kyi thog tu gsum sogs sdug bsngal brtsegs nas 'ong bas na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zer/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'khor ba'i nang 'di na bde ba ltar snang ba thams cad kyang mi rtag par gnas 'gyur nas sdug bsngal du 'gro ste/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin lta bu'ang mi'i bran du skye ba dang / lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu'ang mun par skye ba dang / 'khor los bsgyur rgyal kyang mtha' 'khob kyi yang bran du 'gyur ba dang / mi phyug po sprang por 'gro ba/ kha drag po zhan por 'gro ba/ mi mang po gcig tu 'gro ba sogs 'jig rten khams 'di na bde ba ltar 162

sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang gsum yin/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni/ dmyal ba la tsha ba'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu grang ba'i sdug bsngal/ yi dwags la bkres pa'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu skom pa'i sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal gyi thog tu sha pags kyi ched du bsad pa'i sdug bsngal/ mi la skye rgas sdug bsngal gyi thog tu na 'chi'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin la 'thab cing rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu rmas shing bsad pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi thog tu mar la ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal gcig gi thog tu gnyis/gnyis kyi thog tu gsum sogs sdug bsngal brtsegs nas 'ong bas na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zer/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'khor ba'i nang 'di na bde ba ltar snang ba thams cad kyang mi rtag par gnas 'gyur nas sdug bsngal du 'gro ste/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin lta bu'ang mi'i bran du skye ba dang / lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu'ang mun par skye ba dang / 'khor los bsgyur rgyal kyang mtha' 'khob kyi yang bran du 'gyur ba dang / mi phyug po sprang por 'gro ba/ kha drag po zhan por 'gro ba/ mi mang po gcig tu 'gro ba sogs 'jig rten khams 'di na bde ba ltar 162

snang ba rnams kyang / 'gyur nas sdug bsngal du 'gro bas na/'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zer/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/sems can thams cad kyis rang bde na 'dod/ sdug na mi 'dod/ bde ba la brten nas 'dod chags skye/ sdug bsngal la brten nas zhe sdang skye/ btang snyoms la brten nas gti mug skye/dug gsum de gang rung gis kun nas bslangs te ngas 'di byed de byed snyam tshad po sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge'i sdig pa kho na yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ /ma chags mi sdang gti mug med/ /des bsgyed las ni dge ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dug gsum kyi dbang gis dgra 'dul gnyen skyong / tshong so nam sogs las ci byas kyang tshar dus med/ mi tshe gang bo tshe 'di'i grabs shom kho na la gzad nas/ tshe 'dir tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong bar ma zad/ tshe phyi mar yang sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis po drangs yong / sdug bsngal 'dis sems can thams cad la khyab nas yod pas na khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zer/ de'i phyir sdug bsngal 'di gsum gyi 'og nas ma thar phyin chad bde ba skad cig tsam yang med pa'i tshul la bsams nas/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la yid smon 163

snang ba rnams kyang / 'gyur nas sdug bsngal du 'gro bas na/'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zer/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/sems can thams cad kyis rang bde na 'dod/ sdug na mi 'dod/ bde ba la brten nas 'dod chags skye/ sdug bsngal la brten nas zhe sdang skye/ btang snyoms la brten nas gti mug skye/dug gsum de gang rung gis kun nas bslangs te ngas 'di byed de byed snyam tshad po sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge'i sdig pa kho na yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ /ma chags mi sdang gti mug med/ /des bsgyed las ni dge ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dug gsum kyi dbang gis dgra 'dul gnyen skyong / tshong so nam sogs las ci byas kyang tshar dus med/ mi tshe gang bo tshe 'di'i grabs shom kho na la gzad nas/ tshe 'dir tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong bar ma zad/ tshe phyi mar yang sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis po drangs yong / sdug bsngal 'dis sems can thams cad la khyab nas yod pas na khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zer/ de'i phyir sdug bsngal 'di gsum gyi 'og nas ma thar phyin chad bde ba skad cig tsam yang med pa'i tshul la bsams nas/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la yid smon 163

skad cig tsam yang mi skye bar da re 'khor ba rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra ba 'di las thar pa zhig ci nas kyang bya dgos/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar par 'dod pa rnams khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung dgos tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//spyir 'jig rten khyim thab byas phyin chad/ /sdig ma gtogs dge ba gang yang med/ /rong zhing las byas pa sdig pa'i las/ /'brog 'tsho skyong byas kyang sdig pa'i rgyu/ /zas kham gcig zos rung sdig pa'i zas/ /gos leb gcig gyon rung sdig pa'i gos/ /phar gom gsum spos rung sdig pa'i phyogs/ /las sdig pa ma gtogs byed rgyu med/ /sdig byas na phyi mar dmyal ba sogs/ /mar ngan song ngan 'gro'i gnas su skye/ /der skyes na sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /don de phyir 'jig rten khyem thab spongs/ /khyem spangs nas rab tu byung gyur na/ /nam rab tu byung ba'i nyi ma nas/ /sdig mi dge rang bzhin shugs kyis 'gags/ /chos dge ba zhar dang zhor la 'ong / /chos dge ba mang po byas pa'i mthus/ /tshe phyi mar dag pa'i zhing du skye/ /don de phyir yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /bu tsha bo cha re yod pa tshos/ /kun 'khor ba'i khyim du ma 'jog par/ /yar rab tu byung la lha chos gyis/ /de byas na pha ma bu gsum skyid/ /khyed 'dir 'tshogs yon bdag 164

skad cig tsam yang mi skye bar da re 'khor ba rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra ba 'di las thar pa zhig ci nas kyang bya dgos/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar par 'dod pa rnams khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung dgos tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//spyir 'jig rten khyim thab byas phyin chad/ /sdig ma gtogs dge ba gang yang med/ /rong zhing las byas pa sdig pa'i las/ /'brog 'tsho skyong byas kyang sdig pa'i rgyu/ /zas kham gcig zos rung sdig pa'i zas/ /gos leb gcig gyon rung sdig pa'i gos/ /phar gom gsum spos rung sdig pa'i phyogs/ /las sdig pa ma gtogs byed rgyu med/ /sdig byas na phyi mar dmyal ba sogs/ /mar ngan song ngan 'gro'i gnas su skye/ /der skyes na sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /don de phyir 'jig rten khyem thab spongs/ /khyem spangs nas rab tu byung gyur na/ /nam rab tu byung ba'i nyi ma nas/ /sdig mi dge rang bzhin shugs kyis 'gags/ /chos dge ba zhar dang zhor la 'ong / /chos dge ba mang po byas pa'i mthus/ /tshe phyi mar dag pa'i zhing du skye/ /don de phyir yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /bu tsha bo cha re yod pa tshos/ /kun 'khor ba'i khyim du ma 'jog par/ /yar rab tu byung la lha chos gyis/ /de byas na pha ma bu gsum skyid/ /khyed 'dir 'tshogs yon bdag 164

pho mo rnams/ /dus da nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mar 'jig rten 'khor ba 'di'i nang du/ /dus nam yang mi skye smon lam thob/ /ces blangs pas kun la nges 'byung dang skyo shas skyes bu tsha bo cha re yod pa tsho'i nang nas phal cher rab tu byung mkhan mang po byung ngo / /de nas 'khyams ru rkang tsha'i ru nang brgyud nas chu bzang dgon du song / de dus chu bzang la khar sku gzhogs zhabs drung dkar po'i sprul pa'i sgu rab tu byung ba'i dga' ston byed pa dang thug khong la ngas gtso byas bla ma dpon po yon bdag rta ba stong gis chibs bsus yag po byas/ ston mo chen po btegs maṇ+ḍal bshad pa brgyab/ brgya 'bul stong 'bul phul/ ngas kyang rta mdzo gser dngul gos phrug kha btags nang mdzod bcas tshan grangs bcu gsum tsam gyes 'bul ba phul/ khong thug sa dgyes tshur la yang rta gos gnyis kyi gsol ras stsal ba byung /de'i ston kha rjes su 'ong ba'i grwa btsun ngan slong mang po la/ rta nor che chung bco lnga/ lug lnga bcu tsam gyi sbyin pa btang nas rang gnas su btang / dpon po phyag mdzod sogs zhabs phyi thams cad chu bzang du bzhag nas/ nged dpon slob bzhi tsam bcas rkang thang du bud nas dben pa zhig tu 'gro dgos snyam/165

pho mo rnams/ /dus da nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mar 'jig rten 'khor ba 'di'i nang du/ /dus nam yang mi skye smon lam thob/ /ces blangs pas kun la nges 'byung dang skyo shas skyes bu tsha bo cha re yod pa tsho'i nang nas phal cher rab tu byung mkhan mang po byung ngo / /de nas 'khyams ru rkang tsha'i ru nang brgyud nas chu bzang dgon du song / de dus chu bzang la khar sku gzhogs zhabs drung dkar po'i sprul pa'i sgu rab tu byung ba'i dga' ston byed pa dang thug khong la ngas gtso byas bla ma dpon po yon bdag rta ba stong gis chibs bsus yag po byas/ ston mo chen po btegs maṇ+ḍal bshad pa brgyab/ brgya 'bul stong 'bul phul/ ngas kyang rta mdzo gser dngul gos phrug kha btags nang mdzod bcas tshan grangs bcu gsum tsam gyes 'bul ba phul/ khong thug sa dgyes tshur la yang rta gos gnyis kyi gsol ras stsal ba byung /de'i ston kha rjes su 'ong ba'i grwa btsun ngan slong mang po la/ rta nor che chung bco lnga/ lug lnga bcu tsam gyi sbyin pa btang nas rang gnas su btang / dpon po phyag mdzod sogs zhabs phyi thams cad chu bzang du bzhag nas/ nged dpon slob bzhi tsam bcas rkang thang du bud nas dben pa zhig tu 'gro dgos snyam/165

mdo khams smad 'di'i chu mgo gangs la thug pa'i rma chu chen po'i klung 'gram/ char rdo g.yang gi rde'u dkar ser dmar ljang gcal du bkram zhing / rin chen gser gyi bye ma mang po gling bar na chags pa lha shing kya rta dmar yag 'o ma 'byung ba'i 'om bu/ 'jam mnyen ring ba'i lcang ma/ sngo ljang ring ba'i ma g.yer gyi sdong bo chen po yal ga lo 'dab rgyas pa'i khrod na bya bye'u mang po'i tshang bcas nas phrug gu gso ba/ ne'u gsing spang gzhongs yid du 'ong ba'i steng rnams su 'dam bu dres ma rtsi do la sogs pa'i sngo ljang rtswa 'jam ring po mi tshad tsam skyes pa'i gseb na ri dwags nyam chung mang po bde bar rgyu ba/ chu mig che chung mang po dang dzing bu 'khyil ba'i klung na nya chung rnams kyis rtsed 'jo byed cing / sbal lcong mang po bag phebs gnas pa/mdog mdzes me tog mang po gcal du bkram pa'i rtse mor bung ba mang pos gar stabs bsgyur zhing snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len pa/ lhag par sos ka dang dbyar gyi dus su lha bya khrung khrung dkar mo ngang dkar ngur ser mthing ril khu byug de bo/ 'jol mo sogs bya rigs mi 'dra ba mang po 'tshogs nas skad snyan sna tshogs lhang lhang sgog pa/ lha yul gyi skyed tshal mi yul du 'phos 'dra'i dben gnas mang ra'i khe tsho'i rab kha/ ma phyag ri khrod 166

mdo khams smad 'di'i chu mgo gangs la thug pa'i rma chu chen po'i klung 'gram/ char rdo g.yang gi rde'u dkar ser dmar ljang gcal du bkram zhing / rin chen gser gyi bye ma mang po gling bar na chags pa lha shing kya rta dmar yag 'o ma 'byung ba'i 'om bu/ 'jam mnyen ring ba'i lcang ma/ sngo ljang ring ba'i ma g.yer gyi sdong bo chen po yal ga lo 'dab rgyas pa'i khrod na bya bye'u mang po'i tshang bcas nas phrug gu gso ba/ ne'u gsing spang gzhongs yid du 'ong ba'i steng rnams su 'dam bu dres ma rtsi do la sogs pa'i sngo ljang rtswa 'jam ring po mi tshad tsam skyes pa'i gseb na ri dwags nyam chung mang po bde bar rgyu ba/ chu mig che chung mang po dang dzing bu 'khyil ba'i klung na nya chung rnams kyis rtsed 'jo byed cing / sbal lcong mang po bag phebs gnas pa/mdog mdzes me tog mang po gcal du bkram pa'i rtse mor bung ba mang pos gar stabs bsgyur zhing snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len pa/ lhag par sos ka dang dbyar gyi dus su lha bya khrung khrung dkar mo ngang dkar ngur ser mthing ril khu byug de bo/ 'jol mo sogs bya rigs mi 'dra ba mang po 'tshogs nas skad snyan sna tshogs lhang lhang sgog pa/ lha yul gyi skyed tshal mi yul du 'phos 'dra'i dben gnas mang ra'i khe tsho'i rab kha/ ma phyag ri khrod 166

bkra shis nyams dga'i gling du song nas dgun mtshams la bsdad pa'i nyin gcig dbus gtsang phyogs kyi ri mthon po zhig gi rtse mor sprin dkar po 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin langs pa mthong bas rkyen byas/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras sogs dbus phyogs kyi chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma rnams dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs bde ldan zhing du bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di blangs so// sa dbus gtsang phyogs su kha bltas pas/ /nub ri bo mthon po'i rtse mo na/ /sprin dkar po 'o ma 'phyur bzhin langs/ /de mthong bas dbus gtsang chos yul dran/ /sprin dkar po lding ba'i nub phyogs na/ /dbus po ta la yi rtse mo na/ /gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang na/ /rje skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga dbus gtsang yul la 'gro snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing rgyal ba yab sras dran/ /gzhan bla ma mang po dran nas byung / /dbus ser 'bras dge gsum gtso byas pa'i/ /'khor skal bzang bye ba ther 'bum la/ /sngon ston pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi sogs/ /chos zab la rgya che mang po gsungs/ /dus da lta gsung na dga' ba la/ /nga 'bul ba med rung nyan snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing rgyal ba 167

bkra shis nyams dga'i gling du song nas dgun mtshams la bsdad pa'i nyin gcig dbus gtsang phyogs kyi ri mthon po zhig gi rtse mor sprin dkar po 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin langs pa mthong bas rkyen byas/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras sogs dbus phyogs kyi chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma rnams dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs bde ldan zhing du bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di blangs so// sa dbus gtsang phyogs su kha bltas pas/ /nub ri bo mthon po'i rtse mo na/ /sprin dkar po 'o ma 'phyur bzhin langs/ /de mthong bas dbus gtsang chos yul dran/ /sprin dkar po lding ba'i nub phyogs na/ /dbus po ta la yi rtse mo na/ /gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang na/ /rje skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga dbus gtsang yul la 'gro snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing rgyal ba yab sras dran/ /gzhan bla ma mang po dran nas byung / /dbus ser 'bras dge gsum gtso byas pa'i/ /'khor skal bzang bye ba ther 'bum la/ /sngon ston pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi sogs/ /chos zab la rgya che mang po gsungs/ /dus da lta gsung na dga' ba la/ /nga 'bul ba med rung nyan snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing rgyal ba 167

yab sras dran/ /gzhan bla ma mang po dran nas byung / /rang mtha' 'khob a mdo'i yul du skye/ /chos byed lo'i ngang la mi tshe song / /lo na so rgas pas non na yang / /dus da dung glu dbyangs len la dgongs/ /sa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /mgon thub bstan 'dzin mkhan mang na yang / /phyogs ris med bstan pa'i bdag po la/ /mgon khyed gnyis ma gtogs gzhan ma mchis/ /dus deng sang bstan 'dzin phal cher gyis/ /rang gzhan gnyis ngan song 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /chos bzang ngan phyogs ris byed mkhan snang / /'di rnams la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /rje skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras dang / /gzhan bla ma mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rang 'chi dus mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /zhing bde ba can du drang du gsol/ /rje rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje dang / /rang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /mgon thub bstan mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par shog /ces blangs pa'i mtshan mo rmi lam du rang bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon por slebs nas/ skyabs mgon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa la mjal ba'i snang ba byung / khong gi zhal nas khyod kyis sngar mdo smad bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan mdzad pa shin tu 168

yab sras dran/ /gzhan bla ma mang po dran nas byung / /rang mtha' 'khob a mdo'i yul du skye/ /chos byed lo'i ngang la mi tshe song / /lo na so rgas pas non na yang / /dus da dung glu dbyangs len la dgongs/ /sa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /mgon thub bstan 'dzin mkhan mang na yang / /phyogs ris med bstan pa'i bdag po la/ /mgon khyed gnyis ma gtogs gzhan ma mchis/ /dus deng sang bstan 'dzin phal cher gyis/ /rang gzhan gnyis ngan song 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /chos bzang ngan phyogs ris byed mkhan snang / /'di rnams la da dung thugs rjes gzigs/ /rje skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras dang / /gzhan bla ma mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rang 'chi dus mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /zhing bde ba can du drang du gsol/ /rje rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje dang / /rang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /mgon thub bstan mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par shog /ces blangs pa'i mtshan mo rmi lam du rang bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon por slebs nas/ skyabs mgon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa la mjal ba'i snang ba byung / khong gi zhal nas khyod kyis sngar mdo smad bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan mdzad pa shin tu 168

legs/ de la nga dga' ba yin da dung yang chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin/ bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs la brtson dang / 'di nas kyang khyod kyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen 'byung zhing / phyi mar nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing nas mngon sum mjal ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya gsungs thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad pa'i mthar rang gnyid las sad pa byung ngo / /de'i lo thugs rje chen po thig le bcu drug gi bsnyen pa btang bas/ zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nam tho rangs khar/ nyams snang la mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba'i klong na sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo yab sras rnams bzhugs pa la bdag gi snying nas dad pas gsol ba btab pas/ jo bo yab sras rnams skad cig de nyid la mi snang bar gnas 'gyur nas/ thugs rje chen po thig le bcu drug gi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ mngon sum khra lam me bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gnas gsum las bdud rtsi'i 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pa bzhin dang cig char du 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du rim dang cig char du thim pas ting nge 'dzin gye dbang bzhi thob/ de nas yang mos gus byas pas thugs rje chen 169

legs/ de la nga dga' ba yin da dung yang chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin/ bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs la brtson dang / 'di nas kyang khyod kyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen 'byung zhing / phyi mar nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing nas mngon sum mjal ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya gsungs thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad pa'i mthar rang gnyid las sad pa byung ngo / /de'i lo thugs rje chen po thig le bcu drug gi bsnyen pa btang bas/ zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nam tho rangs khar/ nyams snang la mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba'i klong na sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo yab sras rnams bzhugs pa la bdag gi snying nas dad pas gsol ba btab pas/ jo bo yab sras rnams skad cig de nyid la mi snang bar gnas 'gyur nas/ thugs rje chen po thig le bcu drug gi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ mngon sum khra lam me bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gnas gsum las bdud rtsi'i 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pa bzhin dang cig char du 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du rim dang cig char du thim pas ting nge 'dzin gye dbang bzhi thob/ de nas yang mos gus byas pas thugs rje chen 169

po'i thugs ga'i sgo phyes/ /thub pa chen po rnam snang gangs can mtshos sngar ltar dbang bskur/ de bzhin du thub pa'i thugs ka nas bzung bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i thugs ga'i bar gyi sgo phyes nas dbang bskur/ de'i thugs ga'i sgo phyes nas nang du song bas thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu dang rang sems gnyis/ nam mkha' la nam mkha' 'dres pa bzhin dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur pa'i ngang la rang bzhin shugs kyis gnas pa byung / de nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs pa dang jo bo yab sras rnams sngar ltar mjal ba'i snang ba byung / zhal nas skal ldan rigs kyi bu phyi 'dul ba nang gsang sngags gyis dang bstan 'gro la phan thogs/ nga dang dus nam yang 'du 'bral med pa yong zhes je mtho je mthor gyur nas yar dga' ldan du gshegs nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas bzung ste sems la dga' bde rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig byung / de dus tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i yul bzang mgo log mu ra'i bla ma kun grol dpon slob gnyis byung nas bka' gdams pha chos bu chos kyi lung khrid byas/ der 'tshogs pa'i slob ma bco lnga tsam la thig le bcu drug gi dbang bskur/ pha chos bu chos kyi lung khrid byas pas/dben par nyams len byed mkhan gyi chos pa bzang po mang po 170

po'i thugs ga'i sgo phyes/ /thub pa chen po rnam snang gangs can mtshos sngar ltar dbang bskur/ de bzhin du thub pa'i thugs ka nas bzung bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i thugs ga'i bar gyi sgo phyes nas dbang bskur/ de'i thugs ga'i sgo phyes nas nang du song bas thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu dang rang sems gnyis/ nam mkha' la nam mkha' 'dres pa bzhin dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur pa'i ngang la rang bzhin shugs kyis gnas pa byung / de nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs pa dang jo bo yab sras rnams sngar ltar mjal ba'i snang ba byung / zhal nas skal ldan rigs kyi bu phyi 'dul ba nang gsang sngags gyis dang bstan 'gro la phan thogs/ nga dang dus nam yang 'du 'bral med pa yong zhes je mtho je mthor gyur nas yar dga' ldan du gshegs nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas bzung ste sems la dga' bde rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig byung / de dus tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i yul bzang mgo log mu ra'i bla ma kun grol dpon slob gnyis byung nas bka' gdams pha chos bu chos kyi lung khrid byas/ der 'tshogs pa'i slob ma bco lnga tsam la thig le bcu drug gi dbang bskur/ pha chos bu chos kyi lung khrid byas pas/dben par nyams len byed mkhan gyi chos pa bzang po mang po 170

byung / yang nyin cig dben gnas de'i steng gi lab rtse bstod du song / lab rtse'i kha nas a myes rma chen gyi gangs ri mthong bas rkyen byas/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras gnyis dran pa'i mgur dbyangs snyan mo 'di yang blangs so//ri brag na bun gyis bskor pa'i/ /rma chen gangs ri de mthong bas/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis bskor pa'i/ /rgyal ba yab sras de dran byung / /rma chu'i rab kha na ngang bas/ /skad snyan sgog pa de thos pas/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi gsung gis/ /bka' chos gnang ba de dran byung / /stong gsal nam mkha' la shar ba'i/ /'od gsal nyi ma de mthong bas/ /thugs rje phyogs ris ni med par/ /kun la snyoms pa de dran byung / /bdag gi chu bur gyi mig gi /lam du mthong rgyu zhig med rung / /rang sems gsal bo yi yul la/ /zhal ras wal le rang shar byung / /mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs la/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje yis skyongs shig /tshe 'di'i bar chad kun sol la/ /phyi ma'i lam sna rang drongs shig /ces blangs so/ /yang gnas der 'dug pa'i grwa bu slob rnams kyis da lo gnas 'dir dge sbyor 'phel po byung bas/ gnas bstod cig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor gnas bstod nyung 'dus 'di yang smras/171

byung / yang nyin cig dben gnas de'i steng gi lab rtse bstod du song / lab rtse'i kha nas a myes rma chen gyi gangs ri mthong bas rkyen byas/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras gnyis dran pa'i mgur dbyangs snyan mo 'di yang blangs so//ri brag na bun gyis bskor pa'i/ /rma chen gangs ri de mthong bas/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis bskor pa'i/ /rgyal ba yab sras de dran byung / /rma chu'i rab kha na ngang bas/ /skad snyan sgog pa de thos pas/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi gsung gis/ /bka' chos gnang ba de dran byung / /stong gsal nam mkha' la shar ba'i/ /'od gsal nyi ma de mthong bas/ /thugs rje phyogs ris ni med par/ /kun la snyoms pa de dran byung / /bdag gi chu bur gyi mig gi /lam du mthong rgyu zhig med rung / /rang sems gsal bo yi yul la/ /zhal ras wal le rang shar byung / /mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs la/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje yis skyongs shig /tshe 'di'i bar chad kun sol la/ /phyi ma'i lam sna rang drongs shig /ces blangs so/ /yang gnas der 'dug pa'i grwa bu slob rnams kyis da lo gnas 'dir dge sbyor 'phel po byung bas/ gnas bstod cig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor gnas bstod nyung 'dus 'di yang smras/171

thugs bde stong nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /byams snying rje byang sems sprin 'khrigs nas/ /gsung mdo sngags chos char 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /rje skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras mchod/ /sa bkra shis g.yang chags rma chu'i 'gram//gser bye ma chags pa'i rin chen gling / /shing nags tshal rgyas pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /spang me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i ljongs/ /bya mi 'dra bdun tsam grag pa'i yul/ /steng lha yul skyed tshal mang po nas/ /gcig sa steng 'di ru 'phos/ 'dra ba'i/ /gnas khyad 'phags bkra shis nyams dga'i gling / /khong mkhas grub mang po bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /lha dkar phyogs skyong rnams 'du ba'i zhing / /gnas 'di ru rig pa dwangs shing gsal/ /sngar ma bsgrubs lha zhal mang po mthong / /nyams rtogs pa'i gter kha nang nas brdol/ /chos zab mo glu ru len snying 'dod/ /khyed phyi rabs chos mdzad pho mo rnams/ /gnas 'di 'dra sten dang nyams rtogs 'phel/ /gnas 'di nyid cung zad bstod pa'i mthus/ /phyogs 'di yi lha mi kun dga' nas/ /gnas 'di ru sdod pa'i gang zag la/ /chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor bar shog /ces glu ru blangs pas kun dga' zhing spro ba byung /yang nyin cig lha bzo ye shes la 'dir gnas pa tshos ji 172

thugs bde stong nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /byams snying rje byang sems sprin 'khrigs nas/ /gsung mdo sngags chos char 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /rje skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras mchod/ /sa bkra shis g.yang chags rma chu'i 'gram//gser bye ma chags pa'i rin chen gling / /shing nags tshal rgyas pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /spang me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i ljongs/ /bya mi 'dra bdun tsam grag pa'i yul/ /steng lha yul skyed tshal mang po nas/ /gcig sa steng 'di ru 'phos/ 'dra ba'i/ /gnas khyad 'phags bkra shis nyams dga'i gling / /khong mkhas grub mang po bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /lha dkar phyogs skyong rnams 'du ba'i zhing / /gnas 'di ru rig pa dwangs shing gsal/ /sngar ma bsgrubs lha zhal mang po mthong / /nyams rtogs pa'i gter kha nang nas brdol/ /chos zab mo glu ru len snying 'dod/ /khyed phyi rabs chos mdzad pho mo rnams/ /gnas 'di 'dra sten dang nyams rtogs 'phel/ /gnas 'di nyid cung zad bstod pa'i mthus/ /phyogs 'di yi lha mi kun dga' nas/ /gnas 'di ru sdod pa'i gang zag la/ /chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor bar shog /ces glu ru blangs pas kun dga' zhing spro ba byung /yang nyin cig lha bzo ye shes la 'dir gnas pa tshos ji 172

'dra byed zhin 'dug byas pas/ khos bzhad gad slong phyir tshigs bcad 'di phul byung /gang gi mtshan tsam yid la dran pas kyang / /legs tshogs dngos grub thams cad stsol mdzad pa'i/ /zla med bla ma mchog gi snyan dbang du/ /'dir gnas slob bu'i rnam thar chu thig tsam/ /ye shes ming can bdag gis brjod la dgongs/ /ma ti pra dz+nyā nyin mtshan bar med du/ /'od gsal rgyun chad med pa'i ngang du 'byams/ /dam pa'i yang sprul rlung sems dbang thob pas/ /bya ltar lding zhing chags med rlung ltar rgyu/ /ma ṇi rang grol sems can 'gro don du/ /yi ge mang po bris nas thugs brel byung / /ma ti shrī la gsung rab mang bklags nas/ /lus mgul ngag gis chos sgra chen po 'don/ /phun tshogs dge legs lta dgongs rab tu mtho/ /me long ye shes gaṅgā'i rgyun la 'gran/ /bya yi rigs las rtsal ldan khyung chen ni/ /bya rtsol bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig byung / /rab byung rang grol 'khor 'das so mtshams su/ /rgya mi'i thang shing bsrung ba'i dpe bzhin gnas/ /blo gros rab yangs snang bzhi mthar phyin te/ /chos nyid zad pa'i rtags rnams mngon sum byung / /gsar bu'i khrid phrug rnams kyang sems ngo 'phrod/ /srog chags mgo la sgogs rdo 'phog 173

'dra byed zhin 'dug byas pas/ khos bzhad gad slong phyir tshigs bcad 'di phul byung /gang gi mtshan tsam yid la dran pas kyang / /legs tshogs dngos grub thams cad stsol mdzad pa'i/ /zla med bla ma mchog gi snyan dbang du/ /'dir gnas slob bu'i rnam thar chu thig tsam/ /ye shes ming can bdag gis brjod la dgongs/ /ma ti pra dz+nyā nyin mtshan bar med du/ /'od gsal rgyun chad med pa'i ngang du 'byams/ /dam pa'i yang sprul rlung sems dbang thob pas/ /bya ltar lding zhing chags med rlung ltar rgyu/ /ma ṇi rang grol sems can 'gro don du/ /yi ge mang po bris nas thugs brel byung / /ma ti shrī la gsung rab mang bklags nas/ /lus mgul ngag gis chos sgra chen po 'don/ /phun tshogs dge legs lta dgongs rab tu mtho/ /me long ye shes gaṅgā'i rgyun la 'gran/ /bya yi rigs las rtsal ldan khyung chen ni/ /bya rtsol bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig byung / /rab byung rang grol 'khor 'das so mtshams su/ /rgya mi'i thang shing bsrung ba'i dpe bzhin gnas/ /blo gros rab yangs snang bzhi mthar phyin te/ /chos nyid zad pa'i rtags rnams mngon sum byung / /gsar bu'i khrid phrug rnams kyang sems ngo 'phrod/ /srog chags mgo la sgogs rdo 'phog 173

bzhin gnas/ /lha bzo chen po chos nyid zad sar 'khyol/ /chos srid ci yang ma nus ha thang chad/ /skabs 'gar rgod bro skabs 'gar yi mug pa'i/ /grub thob spyod pa ya ma zung cig byung / /nying 'khrul lam du mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul pa'i/ /'dir gnas rang bzhin brjod pa'i rnam thar 'di/ /sgro skur phrag dog log ltas bslad pa med/ /pha rgan dgyes pa'i bzhad gad 'phel phyir phul/ /zhes bris nas phul ba kun gyis bton nas bzhad gad byas/ gnas der bstan 'gror phan pa'i legs bshad nyi ma rang shar brtsams/ yang sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can a mgon sprul sku dang mtshams pa blo gros gnyis kyis/ khong gnyis la khyed kyi lta ba'i glu dbyangs mkha' lding gshog rlabs dang / legs bshad gser gyi thur ma'i nang gi gnad 'gagasems ngo skyong tshul gyi zhal gdams nyung la 'dus pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshigs su bcad nas 'di skad ces smras/rtogs pa nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med pa'i/ /rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rig pa'i ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med kyi/ /gnas lugs rjen par rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/ /rdzogs chen lta 174

bzhin gnas/ /lha bzo chen po chos nyid zad sar 'khrol/ /chos srid ci yang ma nus ha thang chad/ /skabs 'gar rgod bro skabs 'gar yi mug pa'i/ /grub thob spyod pa ya ma zung cig byung / /nying 'khrul lam du mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul pa'i/ /'dir gnas rang bzhin brjod pa'i rnam thar 'di/ /sgro skur phrag dog log ltas bslad pa med/ /pha rgan dgyes pa'i bzhad gad 'phel phyir phul/ /zhes bris nas phul ba kun gyis bton nas bzhad gad byas/ gnas der bstan 'gror phan pa'i legs bshad nyi ma rang shar brtsams/ yang sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can a mgon sprul sku dang mtshams pa blo gros gnyis kyis/ khong gnyis la khyed kyi lta ba'i glu dbyangs mkha' lding gshog rlabs dang / legs bshad gser gyi thur ma'i nang gi gnad 'gagasems ngo skyong tshul gyi zhal gdams nyung la 'dus pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshigs su bcad nas 'di skad ces smras/rtogs pa nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med pa'i/ /rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rig pa'i ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med kyi/ /gnas lugs rjen par rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/ /rdzogs chen lta 174

ba'i gnad 'gag glu ru len/ /rig pa dwangs snyigs phyes la sa ler nyon/ /gnas 'gyu gang gi dus su rig pa'i cha/ /zang thal rjen pa shel gong 'dra ba de/ /klong du ma gyur bar du sa ler skyongs/ /gyur nas de yi ngang la 'bral med kyis/ /rdzogs chen lta ba'i gnad 'gag rig pa ni/ /rjen la phud nas sa ler skyong ba la/ /zer bas gnad 'di kho na gal che bas/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor pa rnams shes par gyis/ /mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /gang du sdod kyang snang ba yangs khrol le/ /su dang 'grogs kyang shes pa dga' yal le/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa re kun gyis mdzod/ /thos tshad sems kyi gnas cha dang bral nas/ /rig pa zang thal rjen la 'bud pa dang / /de yi ngang la har sangs rgya yan du/ /glod nas rang yan skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces smras pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo / /gzhan yang zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul pa'i lan du mgur 'di blangs/gtan gye skyabs mgon bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol nga'i/ /phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /skye 'chi 'dod yon nyes dmigs soms/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam 175

ba'i gnad 'gag glu ru len/ /rig pa dwangs snyigs phyes la sa ler nyon/ /gnas 'gyu gang gi dus su rig pa'i cha/ /zang thal rjen pa shel gong 'dra ba de/ /klong du ma gyur bar du sa ler skyongs/ /gyur nas de yi ngang la 'bral med kyis/ /rdzogs chen lta ba'i gnad 'gag rig pa ni/ /rjen la phud nas sa ler skyong ba la/ /zer bas gnad 'di kho na gal che bas/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor pa rnams shes par gyis/ /mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /gang du sdod kyang snang ba yangs khrol le/ /su dang 'grogs kyang shes pa dga' yal le/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa re kun gyis mdzod/ /thos tshad sems kyi gnas cha dang bral nas/ /rig pa zang thal rjen la 'bud pa dang / /de yi ngang la har sangs rgya yan du/ /glod nas rang yan skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces smras pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo / /gzhan yang zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul pa'i lan du mgur 'di blangs/gtan gye skyabs mgon bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol nga'i/ /phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /skye 'chi 'dod yon nyes dmigs soms/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam 175

thar bzhin/ /sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs sogs/ /zab mo'i gdams pa nyams su longs/ /rgas shing ri khrod je mthor thongs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /smra ba mang pos ci zhig bya/ /gnad kyi gdams ngag snying la chongs/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /rang gzhan gnyis la phan par shog /ces blangs pas gnyis ga'i sems rab tu dga' zhing spro ba'i sgo nas lag len la gang thebs byas so/ /de nas a lags kun grol slar yul du 'gro ba la 'dod chung chog shes bya dgos tshul gyi zhal gdams 'di byin/'dod chung chog shes mdzod khang nas/ /'phags nor bdun gyis yongs gang ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chog shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zas gos nor rdzas shig tsam re'i/ /rtsa na sdug bsngal ri tsam re/ /yod pa gzigs nas sangs rgyas kyis/ /rgyal srid thams cad spangs pa yin/ /rjes 'jug slob ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gnas mal shing drung tsam dag dang / /zas gos ngan ngon tsam gyis ni/ /'dod chung chog shes gyis zhes gsungs/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ /de ni snyigs dus sangs rgyas te/ /'gro ba kun gyi gtsug gi 176

thar bzhin/ /sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs sogs/ /zab mo'i gdams pa nyams su longs/ /rgas shing ri khrod je mthor thongs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /smra ba mang pos ci zhig bya/ /gnad kyi gdams ngag snying la chongs/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /rang gzhan gnyis la phan par shog /ces blangs pas gnyis ga'i sems rab tu dga' zhing spro ba'i sgo nas lag len la gang thebs byas so/ /de nas a lags kun grol slar yul du 'gro ba la 'dod chung chog shes bya dgos tshul gyi zhal gdams 'di byin/'dod chung chog shes mdzod khang nas/ /'phags nor bdun gyis yongs gang ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chog shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zas gos nor rdzas shig tsam re'i/ /rtsa na sdug bsngal ri tsam re/ /yod pa gzigs nas sangs rgyas kyis/ /rgyal srid thams cad spangs pa yin/ /rjes 'jug slob ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gnas mal shing drung tsam dag dang / /zas gos ngan ngon tsam gyis ni/ /'dod chung chog shes gyis zhes gsungs/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ /de ni snyigs dus sangs rgyas te/ /'gro ba kun gyi gtsug gi 176

rgyan/ /de yi bsngags pa brjod par byed/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ /sdig pa'i skyon gyis gos mi srid/ /rgya mtshor chu phran 'du ba ltar/ /rgyud la yon tan thams cad 'du/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byen gyis/ /rgyan gyi rnam pa ma btags kyang / /kum gyi nang na mdzes pa ltar/ /chog sher ga rgyan gyi ga za ri pa ri mi/ /gos ngan hrul po'i nang 'dug kyang / /de ni yid 'ong mdzes par snang / /de phyir bde ba kun 'dod na/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes gyis/ /legs bshad 'di bris dge ba des/ /'gro kun 'dod la chags bral te/ /sred pa'i rtsa ba drung phyungs nas/ /chags pa med pa'i sa thob shog /ces gdams pas phyag 'tshal zhabs spyi bor blangs dus yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs bzhin phebs song ngo / /de'i dbyar ka bzhi ba'i nang la yar yong nas chu bzang dgon par g.yu lo bkod pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ ma ṇi chos 'khor bskor/ mdor 'bum khang zhig kyang brgyab/ de rnams kyi rgyu song la dngul rdo tshad gnyis dang / che rdo nyi shu/ ra lug lnga bcu tsam btang / dge 'dun pa tshor mdzo mo bcu dang lug brgya lhag sogs kyi spyi 'jog bzhag lha khang rab gnas la sku gzhogs gser khang rdo rje 'chang gdan 'dren byas/ khong gis 177

rgyan/ /de yi bsngags pa brjod par byed/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ /sdig pa'i skyon gyis gos mi srid/ /rgya mtshor chu phran 'du ba ltar/ /rgyud la yon tan thams cad 'du/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byen gyis/ /rgyan gyi rnam pa ma btags kyang / /kum gyi nang na mdzes pa ltar/ /chog sher ga rgyan gyi ga za ri pa ri mi/ /gos ngan hrul po'i nang 'dug kyang / /de ni yid 'ong mdzes par snang / /de phyir bde ba kun 'dod na/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes gyis/ /legs bshad 'di bris dge ba des/ /'gro kun 'dod la chags bral te/ /sred pa'i rtsa ba drung phyungs nas/ /chags pa med pa'i sa thob shog /ces gdams pas phyag 'tshal zhabs spyi bor blangs dus yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs bzhin phebs song ngo / /de'i dbyar ka bzhi ba'i nang la yar yong nas chu bzang dgon par g.yu lo bkod pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ ma ṇi chos 'khor bskor/ mdor 'bum khang zhig kyang brgyab/ de rnams kyi rgyu song la dngul rdo tshad gnyis dang / che rdo nyi shu/ ra lug lnga bcu tsam btang / dge 'dun pa tshor mdzo mo bcu dang lug brgya lhag sogs kyi spyi 'jog bzhag lha khang rab gnas la sku gzhogs gser khang rdo rje 'chang gdan 'dren byas/ khong gis 177

rab gnas bsdus pa dang bkra shis rgyas pa byas/ phyag rten la rta gos gnyis/ rgya nag gi lha bzo mkhas pas bris pa'i gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang / kun rig tshe dpag med sogs kyi dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba brgyad/ zangs kyi stegs gru bzhi yol gor cod pan bzhi dang bcas pa phul bas/ dkyil 'khor la gzigs pas thugs mnyes/ rta gos gnyis po dang mdzod btags gcig bcas phyir gnang / dkyil 'khor bsnams nas phebs song / de'i lo khong bya khog mdo'i rma chu'i 'gram ri khrod nas bzhugs/ sos ka dpon slob mang pos mchod pa phul snang / nga chu bzang dgon pa'i brag phug cig nas mtshams byas bsdad/de'i dgun zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang la grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma rang grol rin po che zhing gshegs song bas/ tho no ji la song gdung mchod btang / phyir chu bzang du 'ongs nas mtshams byas bsdad/ lo gsar nas zla ba dang po'i tshes la sku gzhogs gser khang rin po che la mtshams zhu rin chen gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di phul lo//ris med mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyin byed mchog /mchog thun dngos grub gter mdzod 'gro kun skyabs/ /skyabs gnas gcig mchog zla bral mkhas grub rje/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs kyi 178

rab gnas bsdus pa dang bkra shis rgyas pa byas/ phyag rten la rta gos gnyis/ rgya nag gi lha bzo mkhas pas bris pa'i gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang / kun rig tshe dpag med sogs kyi dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba brgyad/ zangs kyi stegs gru bzhi yol gor cod pan bzhi dang bcas pa phul bas/ dkyil 'khor la gzigs pas thugs mnyes/ rta gos gnyis po dang mdzod btags gcig bcas phyir gnang / dkyil 'khor bsnams nas phebs song / de'i lo khong bya khog mdo'i rma chu'i 'gram ri khrod nas bzhugs/ sos ka dpon slob mang pos mchod pa phul snang / nga chu bzang dgon pa'i brag phug cig nas mtshams byas bsdad/de'i dgun zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang la grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma rang grol rin po che zhing gshegs song bas/ tho no ji la song gdung mchod btang / phyir chu bzang du 'ongs nas mtshams byas bsdad/ lo gsar nas zla ba dang po'i tshes la sku gzhogs gser khang rin po che la mtshams zhu rin chen gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di phul lo//ris med mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyin byed mchog /mchog thun dngos grub gter mdzod 'gro kun skyabs/ /skyabs gnas gcig mchog zla bral mkhas grub rje/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs kyi 178

pad+mo'i drung / /rgyal khams dge la bskul ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/ /sgo gsum dad pa'i spu long rab g.yo zhing / /sor bcu snying gar sbyar te zhu 'bras ni/ /phun tshogs dge legs 'bum gyis nyer bskrun pa'i/ /gang sku rin chen rdul brtseg sa sa 'dzin dbang / /lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i bang rim mdzes/ /rmad byung mkhyen brtse nyi zla'i rgyan bzang bkra/ /'khor slob gser ri'i khrod na mngon mtho zhing / /ltos bcas gling bzhi'i nyer 'tshor bzhugs ngos nas/ /rlabs chen zab rgya'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i gtam/ /thos tshe dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro thob/ /'di na slob 'bangs tha shal mi rgan ngas/ /mtshams byas bka' chos 'ong rgyu ma byung yang / /zhabs brtan gsol 'debs gang nus byed bzhin du/ /dge blo ma dor tsam du bde bar mchis rang gzhan kun gyis 'dod pa'i don gyi 'bras/ /mgon khyod zhabs zung gdong lngas bteg pa'i khrir/ /rtag brtan 'gyur med rdo rje'i rang bzhin du/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal du bzhugs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong don bsdus pa'i/ /byang chub lam rim gser gyi rnga bo che/ /phyogs kyi khor yug kun tu legs brdungs nas/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyis las 179

pad+mo'i drung / /rgyal khams dge la bskul ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/ /sgo gsum dad pa'i spu long rab g.yo zhing / /sor bcu snying gar sbyar te zhu 'bras ni/ /phun tshogs dge legs 'bum gyis nyer bskrun pa'i/ /gang sku rin chen rdul brtseg sa sa 'dzin dbang / /lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i bang rim mdzes/ /rmad byung mkhyen brtse nyi zla'i rgyan bzang bkra/ /'khor slob gser ri'i khrod na mngon mtho zhing / /ltos bcas gling bzhi'i nyer 'tshor bzhugs ngos nas/ /rlabs chen zab rgya'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i gtam/ /thos tshe dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro thob/ /'di na slob 'bangs tha shal mi rgan ngas/ /mtshams byas bka' chos 'ong rgyu ma byung yang / /zhabs brtan gsol 'debs gang nus byed bzhin du/ /dge blo ma dor tsam du bde bar mchis rang gzhan kun gyis 'dod pa'i don gyi 'bras/ /mgon khyod zhabs zung gdong lngas bteg pa'i khrir/ /rtag brtan 'gyur med rdo rje'i rang bzhin du/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal du bzhugs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong don bsdus pa'i/ /byang chub lam rim gser gyi rnga bo che/ /phyogs kyi khor yug kun tu legs brdungs nas/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyis las 179

bslang du gsol/ /rgas pa'i ba mos mnar ba'i 'dam skyes bdag /gang gi gsang gsum nyin byed 'od snang gis/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /ring nas skyong ba'i brtse gzigs 'dor med mkhyen/ /de skad zhu yig rin chen gser gyi 'phreng / /dri med lha rdzas dar gyis legs dril te/ /rab tu gus pas lha phyag grangs med bcas/ /chu bzang dben pa'i gnas nas zla tshes phul/ /zhes phul ba la gzigs nas gzhan tshor bstan nas thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad 'byor lan kyang gnang 'dug yang de'i sos ka nyin cig dad gtong blo gros che ba'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu mang ra'i lha bzo ye shes la/ sngon lha mo dbyangs can ma'i phyag tu bsnams nas ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bstan pa'i/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i gnad bsdus pa'i glegs bam sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel ba shing rta chen mo bstan nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i zhabs la gsol ba zhig 'debs so/ /mdo sngags lam bzang kun shes pa'i blo gros shig stsol cig /kun mkhyen chen po yis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi mchog gyur/ /gang zag so skyes shig so so skye bo yi sa nas/ /180
