bslang du gsol/ /rgas pa'i ba mos mnar ba'i 'dam skyes bdag /gang gi gsang gsum nyin byed 'od snang gis/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /ring nas skyong ba'i brtse gzigs 'dor med mkhyen/ /de skad zhu yig rin chen gser gyi 'phreng / /dri med lha rdzas dar gyis legs dril te/ /rab tu gus pas lha phyag grangs med bcas/ /chu bzang dben pa'i gnas nas zla tshes phul/ /zhes phul ba la gzigs nas gzhan tshor bstan nas thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad 'byor lan kyang gnang 'dug yang de'i sos ka nyin cig dad gtong blo gros che ba'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu mang ra'i lha bzo ye shes la/ sngon lha mo dbyangs can ma'i phyag tu bsnams nas ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bstan pa'i/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i gnad bsdus pa'i glegs bam sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel ba shing rta chen mo bstan nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i zhabs la gsol ba zhig 'debs so/ /mdo sngags lam bzang kun shes pa'i blo gros shig stsol cig /kun mkhyen chen po yis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi mchog gyur/ /gang zag so skyes shig so so skye bo yi sa nas/ /180

sangs rgyas sa yi bar 'khrid pa'i mdo sngags kyi lam bzang /chos rnams thams cad po gzhung lam gcig tu rang ston pa'i/ /shing rta chen po yi lam srol 'di nyid la gzigs dang / /mdo rgyud man ngag kun gdams pa'i mchog cig tu go yong / /go ba de bzhin du rang gis nyams len la 'bod dang / /myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob yong / /sprin bral nam mkha' la 'od gsal nyi ma ni shar bzhin/ /blo gros snang ba de phyogs med rgyas par rang shog cig /ces byen pas kho rang gis zhib tu bltas pas blo bskyed chen po byung snang / yang legs bshad 'di'i nang ltar sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams sems kyi nang du longs la sems ngo skyongs dang / lta ba la bogs thon yong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bla ma rnams mkhyen no/ /rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig cig 'byung bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /'khor 'das chos kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems kyi gnas lugs/ /stong gsal khyab gdal gyi ngang la rang babs su 'jog dus/ /nam mkhar nyi zla dang gza' skar 'gags med du shar bzhin/ /sems la snang grags kyi chos rnams ma 'gags par shar yang / /'dzin pa ma zhugs par gu yangs khrol le rang 181

sangs rgyas sa yi bar 'khrid pa'i mdo sngags kyi lam bzang /chos rnams thams cad po gzhung lam gcig tu rang ston pa'i/ /shing rta chen po yi lam srol 'di nyid la gzigs dang / /mdo rgyud man ngag kun gdams pa'i mchog cig tu go yong / /go ba de bzhin du rang gis nyams len la 'bod dang / /myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob yong / /sprin bral nam mkha' la 'od gsal nyi ma ni shar bzhin/ /blo gros snang ba de phyogs med rgyas par rang shog cig /ces byen pas kho rang gis zhib tu bltas pas blo bskyed chen po byung snang / yang legs bshad 'di'i nang ltar sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams sems kyi nang du longs la sems ngo skyongs dang / lta ba la bogs thon yong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bla ma rnams mkhyen no/ /rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig cig 'byung bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /'khor 'das chos kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems kyi gnas lugs/ /stong gsal khyab gdal gyi ngang la rang babs su 'jog dus/ /nam mkhar nyi zla dang gza' skar 'gags med du shar bzhin/ /sems la snang grags kyi chos rnams ma 'gags par shar yang / /'dzin pa ma zhugs par gu yangs khrol le rang 181

zhog dang / /nam mkha' lta bu yi rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig cig 'byung nges/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la snying rje rang sgoms la/ /phan pa'i smon lam rang thob dang nam zhig ni phan yong / /stong nyid snying rje gnyis rgyud la nges par du skyes tshe/ /phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'dra len 'dod rang shugs kyis skyes yong / /zhes bshad pa ltar kho rang gis nyams su blangs pas sems yag tu song rgyud la snying rje chen po skyes nas/ nyam thag rnams la phan thogs pa'i chos pa bzang po zhig byung ngo / /de'i lo nga dbus su 'gro snyam yang gzhan gyis bshol nas lo kha shas 'gro ma thub tshe/ phyag mdzod grub chen dang kun dga' a zhang rnams dbus gtsang du mtshams zhus shig la 'gro rgyu byas/ khong rnams kyis sbis dkar gon pa sogs dbus su 'gro chas rnams bsgrigs/ ngas spring yig dang mtshams zhus so so'i yi ge rnams bris/ thog mar dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la spring yig kun dga'i dpal ster dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di phul/phan bde'i legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /'bral med spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /mchog dang thun mong 182

zhog dang / /nam mkha' lta bu yi rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig cig 'byung nges/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la snying rje rang sgoms la/ /phan pa'i smon lam rang thob dang nam zhig ni phan yong / /stong nyid snying rje gnyis rgyud la nges par du skyes tshe/ /phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'dra len 'dod rang shugs kyis skyes yong / /zhes bshad pa ltar kho rang gis nyams su blangs pas sems yag tu song rgyud la snying rje chen po skyes nas/ nyam thag rnams la phan thogs pa'i chos pa bzang po zhig byung ngo / /de'i lo nga dbus su 'gro snyam yang gzhan gyis bshol nas lo kha shas 'gro ma thub tshe/ phyag mdzod grub chen dang kun dga' a zhang rnams dbus gtsang du mtshams zhus shig la 'gro rgyu byas/ khong rnams kyis sbis dkar gon pa sogs dbus su 'gro chas rnams bsgrigs/ ngas spring yig dang mtshams zhus so so'i yi ge rnams bris/ thog mar dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la spring yig kun dga'i dpal ster dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di phul/phan bde'i legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /'bral med spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /mchog dang thun mong 182

dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing gi mchog /lha ldan jo bo yid bzhin nor bu dang / /rgyal ba yab sras rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /rgyal khams chos la bskul ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/ /kun gyi yid la dga' ba'i dpal ster ba'i/ /ngo mtshar dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs len/ /chos yul dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras gsung bzhin du/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i las la rab brtson pa'i/ /dad can slob ma yon bdag dga' bas nyon/ /jo bo rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje la/ /brten nas khyed rnams thams cad khams bzang zhing / /chos ldan bya ba mang po sgrub pa'i gtam/ /thos pas dngos su mjal 'dra'i dga' spro shar/ /bdag cag dbus gtsang zhing nas mdo smad 'dir/ /'ongs nas mi lo bcu gnyis tsam song yang / /da lta'i bar du dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /lus sems bde zhing 'gro don 'phel bar mchis/ /da lo dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams kyi/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras dang / /ser 'bras dge gsum la sogs phyag mchod zhing / /rnams la mjal bar thag bcad 183

dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing gi mchog /lha ldan jo bo yid bzhin nor bu dang / /rgyal ba yab sras rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /rgyal khams chos la bskul ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/ /kun gyi yid la dga' ba'i dpal ster ba'i/ /ngo mtshar dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs len/ /chos yul dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras gsung bzhin du/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i las la rab brtson pa'i/ /dad can slob ma yon bdag dga' bas nyon/ /jo bo rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje la/ /brten nas khyed rnams thams cad khams bzang zhing / /chos ldan bya ba mang po sgrub pa'i gtam/ /thos pas dngos su mjal 'dra'i dga' spro shar/ /bdag cag dbus gtsang zhing nas mdo smad 'dir/ /'ongs nas mi lo bcu gnyis tsam song yang / /da lta'i bar du dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /lus sems bde zhing 'gro don 'phel bar mchis/ /da lo dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams kyi/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras dang / /ser 'bras dge gsum la sogs phyag mchod zhing / /rnams la mjal bar thag bcad 183

chas na yang / /rang yul phyogs kyi bla dpon phal cher dang / /khyad par phur thogs stong dang lnga brgya yis/ /yul phyogs gzhan du phebs na mi chog ces/ /dbang med bshol nas re zhig sdod dgos byung / /'dir sanas bdag cag dpon slob khams bzang zhing / /chos ldan bya ba mang po 'grub pa'i gtam/ /skyel du slob bu 'di rnams btang yod pas/ /nga dang phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spro gyis/ /mi rgan nga yang ma shi tshe ring na/ /da dung dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /dngos su kun gyis 'ong du mi 'jug kyang / /lkog tu lho kha brgyud nas 'ong rtsis yod/ /'on kyang nam 'chi cha med tshul bsams nas/ /nga la 'phrad du 'ong na 'dod mkhan rnams/ /grogs po bzang por 'grogs nas lho byang lam/ /gang nas 'ongs kyang nged rnams mjal bar nges/ /'ong ma thub kyang khyed rnams thams cad kyis/ /nga yi rnam thar mgur ma'i nang ltar du/ /sdig pa spangs nas dge la 'bad nus na/ /nga la mjal dang khyad med sems la chongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod don ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyes 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug dang / /tshe rabs kun tu mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /ngo mtshar dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos 184

chas na yang / /rang yul phyogs kyi bla dpon phal cher dang / /khyad par phur thogs stong dang lnga brgya yis/ /yul phyogs gzhan du phebs na mi chog ces/ /dbang med bshol nas re zhig sdod dgos byung / /'dir sanas bdag cag dpon slob khams bzang zhing / /chos ldan bya ba mang po 'grub pa'i gtam/ /skyel du slob bu 'di rnams btang yod pas/ /nga dang phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spro gyis/ /mi rgan nga yang ma shi tshe ring na/ /da dung dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /dngos su kun gyis 'ong du mi 'jug kyang / /lkog tu lho kha brgyud nas 'ong rtsis yod/ /'on kyang nam 'chi cha med tshul bsams nas/ /nga la 'phrad du 'ong na 'dod mkhan rnams/ /grogs po bzang por 'grogs nas lho byang lam/ /gang nas 'ongs kyang nged rnams mjal bar nges/ /'ong ma thub kyang khyed rnams thams cad kyis/ /nga yi rnam thar mgur ma'i nang ltar du/ /sdig pa spangs nas dge la 'bad nus na/ /nga la mjal dang khyad med sems la chongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod don ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyes 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug dang / /tshe rabs kun tu mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /ngo mtshar dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos 184

tshad rnams kyi rgyud la phan par shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs bkra shis shing / /bkra shis chen pos 'dzam gling khyab gyur cig /ces pa dang / yang stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la/ 'phrin yig rnar snyan yid 'bab dri za'i bu mo'i glung dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di phul/'di phyi bar do'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /drin cwan bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob bsam don rnams/ /chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems nyid mkha' las rab yangs pa'i/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /'phrin yig rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi/ /dri za'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs len/ /stod phyogs mnga' ris skor gsum gye/ /dad pa dam tshig gtsang ba yi/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /thag ring gtam la dga' bas nyon/ /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /rab tu bde zhing skyid pa'i gtam/ /go bas dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /bdag cag 'dir gnas dpon slob rnams/ /rtsa gsum lha yi byen mthu yis/ /lus sems bde zhing dge sbyor 'phel/ /bstan 'gror gang phan byed bzhin mchis/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /snying po med pa'i bya ba spangs/ /snying po'i lha chos bya snyam nas/ /chos rgyal 185

tshad rnams kyi rgyud la phan par shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs bkra shis shing / /bkra shis chen pos 'dzam gling khyab gyur cig /ces pa dang / yang stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la/ 'phrin yig rnar snyan yid 'bab dri za'i bu mo'i glung dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di phul/'di phyi bar do'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /drin cwan bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob bsam don rnams/ /chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems nyid mkha' las rab yangs pa'i/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /'phrin yig rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi/ /dri za'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs len/ /stod phyogs mnga' ris skor gsum gye/ /dad pa dam tshig gtsang ba yi/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /thag ring gtam la dga' bas nyon/ /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /rab tu bde zhing skyid pa'i gtam/ /go bas dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /bdag cag 'dir gnas dpon slob rnams/ /rtsa gsum lha yi byen mthu yis/ /lus sems bde zhing dge sbyor 'phel/ /bstan 'gror gang phan byed bzhin mchis/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /snying po med pa'i bya ba spangs/ /snying po'i lha chos bya snyam nas/ /chos rgyal 185

ngag gi dbang po sogs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mang po bsten/ /mdo sngags zab rgya'i gdams pa zhus/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /nyams len byas nas rang rgyud btul/ /phyogs med rgyal khams mang po 'grims/ /bstan dang 'gro la gang phan byas/ /legs bshad po ti bcu lhag cig /ma 'ongs dad ldan don la bzhag /slob ma rnams kyis bskulo pa'i ngor/ /tshe 'dir rang gis chos byas nas/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen bsgrubs tshul gyes/ /rnam thar po ti gcig tsam brtsams/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /pha rgan nga yi rnam thar bzhin/ /sdom pa dam tshig tshul bzhin srungs/ /mdo sngags chos la nyams len gyis/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog bstan 'gro la/ /phan pa'i bsam sbyor gong 'phel mdzod/ /da lta bdag ni dben pa ru/ /sos dal bde bar bsdad pa'i dus/ /sngon chad la phyi gangs ri sogs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /nged rnams bsdad tshul yid la shar/ /yang yang yar la 'ong snyam nas/ /chas kyang gzhan gyis dbang med bshol/ /re zhig 'ong rgyu ma byung tshe/ /slob ma 'di rnams btang ba lags/ /rgyu mtshan rgyas pa ngag na gsal/ /mdor na nga ni na so rgas/ /mgo yang dkar por song nas gda'/ /khyed rnams phal cher nga bzhin du/ /na so yar la 186

ngag gi dbang po sogs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mang po bsten/ /mdo sngags zab rgya'i gdams pa zhus/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /nyams len byas nas rang rgyud btul/ /phyogs med rgyal khams mang po 'grims/ /bstan dang 'gro la gang phan byas/ /legs bshad po ti bcu lhag cig /ma 'ongs dad ldan don la bzhag /slob ma rnams kyis bskulo pa'i ngor/ /tshe 'dir rang gis chos byas nas/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen bsgrubs tshul gyes/ /rnam thar po ti gcig tsam brtsams/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /pha rgan nga yi rnam thar bzhin/ /sdom pa dam tshig tshul bzhin srungs/ /mdo sngags chos la nyams len gyis/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog bstan 'gro la/ /phan pa'i bsam sbyor gong 'phel mdzod/ /da lta bdag ni dben pa ru/ /sos dal bde bar bsdad pa'i dus/ /sngon chad la phyi gangs ri sogs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /nged rnams bsdad tshul yid la shar/ /yang yang yar la 'ong snyam nas/ /chas kyang gzhan gyis dbang med bshol/ /re zhig 'ong rgyu ma byung tshe/ /slob ma 'di rnams btang ba lags/ /rgyu mtshan rgyas pa ngag na gsal/ /mdor na nga ni na so rgas/ /mgo yang dkar por song nas gda'/ /khyed rnams phal cher nga bzhin du/ /na so yar la 186

rgas yod snyam/ /da lta nged rnams mjal re ran/ /de phyir khyed rnams nang nas kyang / /rgan pa 'ong bar ma nus kyang / /gzhon pa ma 'dug mjal du shog /nga yang ma shi tshe ring na/ /yar la 'ong ba'i thabs la 'bad/ /thams cad lhan du mjal rgyu zhig /'ong ba'i skal ba ldan par smon/ /gal te tshe yi dus byas nas/ /tshe 'dir dngos su ma mjal na/ /ngas kyang mi brjed sems la 'jog /khyed rnams yid la dung nge gyis/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mngon dga' dga' ldan bde ba can/ /gang 'dod dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /mngon sum mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /'phrin yig rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi/ /dri za'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos tshad sems la phan thogs shing / /yul la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / yang dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi phyogs phyogs kyi ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshul khrims grags pa/ dge slong pad+ma/ /snye mo'i em ji/ nya mo'i sgom chen/ rgyal thang bla ma/ dge slong byams pa rin chen/ rtsib ri pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin sogs bya btang sgom chen pa rnams la snying gtam dbyangs can pi wang rgyud mang zhes bya ba 'di phul lo/ /'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dris pa'i/ /mdza' bshes ston pa 187

rgas yod snyam/ /da lta nged rnams mjal re ran/ /de phyir khyed rnams nang nas kyang / /rgan pa 'ong bar ma nus kyang / /gzhon pa ma 'dug mjal du shog /nga yang ma shi tshe ring na/ /yar la 'ong ba'i thabs la 'bad/ /thams cad lhan du mjal rgyu zhig /'ong ba'i skal ba ldan par smon/ /gal te tshe yi dus byas nas/ /tshe 'dir dngos su ma mjal na/ /ngas kyang mi brjed sems la 'jog /khyed rnams yid la dung nge gyis/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mngon dga' dga' ldan bde ba can/ /gang 'dod dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /mngon sum mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /'phrin yig rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi/ /dri za'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos tshad sems la phan thogs shing / /yul la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / yang dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi phyogs phyogs kyi ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshul khrims grags pa/ dge slong pad+ma/ /snye mo'i em ji/ nya mo'i sgom chen/ rgyal thang bla ma/ dge slong byams pa rin chen/ rtsib ri pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin sogs bya btang sgom chen pa rnams la snying gtam dbyangs can pi wang rgyud mang zhes bya ba 'di phul lo/ /'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dris pa'i/ /mdza' bshes ston pa 187

sangs rgyas la/ /rab tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje dgongs la byen gyis rlobs/ /mdo smad ri khrod dben pa ru/ /gnas pa'i tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /kun la brtse zhing dung ba'i sgos/ /snying gtam dbyangs can pi wang 'khrol/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhan gyi/ /slob ma yang slob dga' bas nyon/ /bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /khyed rnams bde bar yod las che/ /bdag cag dpon slob lus sems bde/ /dben par sgom sgrub byed bzhin mchis/ /skal ldan slob ma yang slob rnams/ /tshe thung nam 'chi cha med soms/ /'dod yon longs spyod rtswa ltar dor/ /sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /mdo sngags gnad kyi gdams pa sgoms/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs rtsad nas thon/ /chos brgyad gdon dang gtan bral gyis/ /bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan mdzod/ /deng sang bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /grong dgon gang du bsdad na yang / /chags sdang chos brgyad ngang gis 'byung / /de phyir ri khrod dben par sdod/ /snying gtam dbyangs can pi wang sgra/ /thos tshad sems la phan thogs shing / /yul phyogs kun tu sgrub brgyud kyi/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /ces pa dang / gzhan 188

sangs rgyas la/ /rab tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje dgongs la byen gyis rlobs/ /mdo smad ri khrod dben pa ru/ /gnas pa'i tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /kun la brtse zhing dung ba'i sgos/ /snying gtam dbyangs can pi wang 'khrol/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhan gyi/ /slob ma yang slob dga' bas nyon/ /bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /khyed rnams bde bar yod las che/ /bdag cag dpon slob lus sems bde/ /dben par sgom sgrub byed bzhin mchis/ /skal ldan slob ma yang slob rnams/ /tshe thung nam 'chi cha med soms/ /'dod yon longs spyod rtswa ltar dor/ /sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /mdo sngags gnad kyi gdams pa sgoms/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs rtsad nas thon/ /chos brgyad gdon dang gtan bral gyis/ /bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan mdzod/ /deng sang bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /grong dgon gang du bsdad na yang / /chags sdang chos brgyad ngang gis 'byung / /de phyir ri khrod dben par sdod/ /snying gtam dbyangs can pi wang sgra/ /thos tshad sems la phan thogs shing / /yul phyogs kun tu sgrub brgyud kyi/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /ces pa dang / gzhan 188

yang rgyal ba yab sras sogs bla ma rnams dang / slob ma yon bdag drug cu lhag tsam la mtshams zhus yi ge tshig lhug tshigs bcad gnyis ka bris nas/ yig rten du dngul khrob srang lnga bcu tsam dngul srang gang re do re/ gos chen kha gang kha do dngul phreng g.yang ṭi pad+ma'i snying po shel phreng shel gyi gsol can gos kyi cod pan dril gdan sogs dngos po phran bu dang / dad rten du skra lo na bza'i tshal bu 'dra sku phyag tham tshe ril rten 'dus/srung mdud dkar ser dmar ljang dri med lha rdzas bcas bzhagashog rgya brgyab nas phul ba do dam byas/ de nas dad brtson shes rab snying je dang ldan pa'i phyag mdzod grub chen nam kun dga' nyi mas rin chen dang po zho gang dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas bcas phul nas/ skyabs mgon rin po che kho bo mdo smad 'dir 'ongs nas lo mang po'i bar du zhabs tog byas pa'i mthar dbus su 'gro khar kho bor rdzongs pa'i mchog tu/ khyed la chos rgyal rin po ches zhal gdams phyag rjes dang bcas te gnang ba bzhin du bdag la yang thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas gnang dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad las/ /mi bdag la bka' drin ches lhag pa'i/ /mgon skyabs rje zhabs dkar rdo rje 189

yang rgyal ba yab sras sogs bla ma rnams dang / slob ma yon bdag drug cu lhag tsam la mtshams zhus yi ge tshig lhug tshigs bcad gnyis ka bris nas/ yig rten du dngul khrob srang lnga bcu tsam dngul srang gang re do re/ gos chen kha gang kha do dngul phreng g.yang ṭi pad+ma'i snying po shel phreng shel gyi gsol can gos kyi cod pan dril gdan sogs dngos po phran bu dang / dad rten du skra lo na bza'i tshal bu 'dra sku phyag tham tshe ril rten 'dus/srung mdud dkar ser dmar ljang dri med lha rdzas bcas bzhagashog rgya brgyab nas phul ba do dam byas/ de nas dad brtson shes rab snying je dang ldan pa'i phyag mdzod grub chen nam kun dga' nyi mas rin chen dang po zho gang dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas bcas phul nas/ skyabs mgon rin po che kho bo mdo smad 'dir 'ongs nas lo mang po'i bar du zhabs tog byas pa'i mthar dbus su 'gro khar kho bor rdzongs pa'i mchog tu/ khyed la chos rgyal rin po ches zhal gdams phyag rjes dang bcas te gnang ba bzhin du bdag la yang thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas gnang dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad las/ /mi bdag la bka' drin ches lhag pa'i/ /mgon skyabs rje zhabs dkar rdo rje 189

'chang / /sprang spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'bral med bzhugs/ /yar gangs ljongs dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing / /mi bdag dang rdo rje spun grogs 'ga'/ /bsgom sgrub pa bya ru 'gro lags te/ /rje bla ma 'bral snyam sems re skyo/ /sngon las 'bras 'phen pas yun ring 'grogs/ /grogs rdo rje spun tshogs mched lcam rnams/ /da tshe 'dir gson 'bral byed pa'i dus/ /sems skyo ba skyes nas bzod glags med/ /mar mdo smad phyogs 'dir yun ring du/ /'dris che ba'i chos mdzad yon bdag rnams/ /da deng nas tshe 'dir gang nas 'phrad/ /sems skyo ba skyes nas bzod glags med/ /rje khyed kyis yang yang nan tan du/ /chos mi rtag gsungs kyang nges shes bral/ /dus da re so sor 'bral ba'i tshe/ /chos mi rtag mngon sum rjen par mthong / /da mi rtag 'chi ba sgom bzhin du/ /sa thag ring dbus la 'gro ba'i dus/ /nor zang zing rdzongs kyis ci zhig bya/ /bdag rdzongs la zhal gdams zab mo zhu/ /sngar zhal gdams dpag med gnang mod kyang / /rang g.yeng bas khur nas nges 'jog med/ /da rang la ched du gnyer nas kyang / /gsung zab mo'i bcud kyi snying po zhu/ /chos mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag gi /don zab dgu'i snying po gcig tu bsdus/ /bdag nyams len byed pa'i gsal 'debs 190

'chang / /sprang spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'bral med bzhugs/ /yar gangs ljongs dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing / /mi bdag dang rdo rje spun grogs 'ga'/ /bsgom sgrub pa bya ru 'gro lags te/ /rje bla ma 'bral snyam sems re skyo/ /sngon las 'bras 'phen pas yun ring 'grogs/ /grogs rdo rje spun tshogs mched lcam rnams/ /da tshe 'dir gson 'bral byed pa'i dus/ /sems skyo ba skyes nas bzod glags med/ /mar mdo smad phyogs 'dir yun ring du/ /'dris che ba'i chos mdzad yon bdag rnams/ /da deng nas tshe 'dir gang nas 'phrad/ /sems skyo ba skyes nas bzod glags med/ /rje khyed kyis yang yang nan tan du/ /chos mi rtag gsungs kyang nges shes bral/ /dus da re so sor 'bral ba'i tshe/ /chos mi rtag mngon sum rjen par mthong / /da mi rtag 'chi ba sgom bzhin du/ /sa thag ring dbus la 'gro ba'i dus/ /nor zang zing rdzongs kyis ci zhig bya/ /bdag rdzongs la zhal gdams zab mo zhu/ /sngar zhal gdams dpag med gnang mod kyang / /rang g.yeng bas khur nas nges 'jog med/ /da rang la ched du gnyer nas kyang / /gsung zab mo'i bcud kyi snying po zhu/ /chos mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag gi /don zab dgu'i snying po gcig tu bsdus/ /bdag nyams len byed pa'i gsal 'debs 190

su/ /thugs brtse bas zhal gdams gnang du gsol/ /mi bdag gi 'dod don tha ma 'di/ /rje khyed kyis btang snyoms ma mdzad par/ /thugs dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs dang bcas te/ /don re ba'i 'bras bu smin par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o skal ldan snying gi bu ma g.yengs par nyon la yid la zungs shigadeng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skya ser pho mo su yin yang rgyal ba'i bka' dang / bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub pa ni shin tu dkon/ dkor gyis tshims nas bla ma'i gsung mi brtsi bar dam sdom lhod nas chos min byed mkhan sdig pa'i grogs po mang dus 'dir/ sdig pa'i grogs kyi dbang du ma song ba byas/ sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo bzhin blos thongs/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog sten la dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ mdo sngags chos kyi gnad byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang / gsang sngags kyi rim gnyis khregs chod thod rgal gnyis la sogs pa'i bla ma'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams nyams su longs dang bsam don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub yong / 'di nas de lugs kyi skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya zhes zhal gdams kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /191

su/ /thugs brtse bas zhal gdams gnang du gsol/ /mi bdag gi 'dod don tha ma 'di/ /rje khyed kyis btang snyoms ma mdzad par/ /thugs dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs dang bcas te/ /don re ba'i 'bras bu smin par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o skal ldan snying gi bu ma g.yengs par nyon la yid la zungs shigadeng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skya ser pho mo su yin yang rgyal ba'i bka' dang / bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub pa ni shin tu dkon/ dkor gyis tshims nas bla ma'i gsung mi brtsi bar dam sdom lhod nas chos min byed mkhan sdig pa'i grogs po mang dus 'dir/ sdig pa'i grogs kyi dbang du ma song ba byas/ sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo bzhin blos thongs/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog sten la dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ mdo sngags chos kyi gnad byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang / gsang sngags kyi rim gnyis khregs chod thod rgal gnyis la sogs pa'i bla ma'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams nyams su longs dang bsam don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub yong / 'di nas de lugs kyi skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya zhes zhal gdams kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /191

yid bzhin nor las lhag pa yi/ /skyabs mgon bla ma yi dam lhas/ /skal ldan snying gi slob ma la/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /lus dang grib bzhin rab 'grogs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dkar phyogs lhas/ /slob bu'i 'gal skyen bar chad sol/ /mthun rkyen bsam don 'grub par mdzod/ /pha rgan tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bshad pa la/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje can/ /bu chen kun dga' nyi ma nyon/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gsung / /mi brtsi chos min byed mkhan la/ /bltas na skyo shas mi skye 'am/ /tshul 'di soms la sngar byas gyi/ /las la 'gyod cing phyin chad sdoms/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /mdo sngags lam gyi gnad 'dus pa'i/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su longs/ /de ltar nyams su len nus na/ /bu yi bsam don chos bzhin 'grub/ /pha yi snying gtam zab mo 'di/ /ma brjed snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thog 'byung ba dang / /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs shing / /chos dang bkra shis 192

yid bzhin nor las lhag pa yi/ /skyabs mgon bla ma yi dam lhas/ /skal ldan snying gi slob ma la/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /lus dang grib bzhin rab 'grogs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dkar phyogs lhas/ /slob bu'i 'gal skyen bar chad sol/ /mthun rkyen bsam don 'grub par mdzod/ /pha rgan tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bshad pa la/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje can/ /bu chen kun dga' nyi ma nyon/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gsung / /mi brtsi chos min byed mkhan la/ /bltas na skyo shas mi skye 'am/ /tshul 'di soms la sngar byas gyi/ /las la 'gyod cing phyin chad sdoms/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /mdo sngags lam gyi gnad 'dus pa'i/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag nyams su longs/ /de ltar nyams su len nus na/ /bu yi bsam don chos bzhin 'grub/ /pha yi snying gtam zab mo 'di/ /ma brjed snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thog 'byung ba dang / /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs shing / /chos dang bkra shis 192

'phel bar shog /ces blangs pas kho rang dga' mgu yi rang ba'i sgo nas/ sngar sdom gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung la snying nas bshags pa dang / phyin chad mi byed pa'i sdom sems byas dus yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam kyang btab bo/ /de nas zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes pa bcu'i nyin rtsa gsum lha la tshogs dang gtor ma btang / dbus su 'gro ba dang gzhi la 'dug pa thams cad la ston mo rgya chen po byas/ dbus pa yar 'gro rnams la zang zing nor gyi rdzongs pa la dngul rdo tshad gcig dang / khrob srang bcu gsum/ gser zho kha shas/ ras dā bu dkar dmar kha btags sogs zong rdo tshad gcig gis rtsis/ rta bzang po bdun/ dre'u gnyis/ mdzo bdun/ ha khye chung chung gnyis bcas byen/ dad rten du rnam thar bris ma gcig glegs bam bzhi/'dra sku phyag tham skra lo na bza' tshe ril rten 'dus srung mdud/mdzod btags ring po'i mgul dar bsgon nas chos kyi rdzongs pa la rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed skal ldan snying gi bu slob rnams/ /nga'i phan pa'i snying gtam glu la nyon/ /bdag skyes sa mdo khams smad yin kyang / /yar 'gro sa dbus gtsang zhing du 193

'phel bar shog /ces blangs pas kho rang dga' mgu yi rang ba'i sgo nas/ sngar sdom gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung la snying nas bshags pa dang / phyin chad mi byed pa'i sdom sems byas dus yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam kyang btab bo/ /de nas zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes pa bcu'i nyin rtsa gsum lha la tshogs dang gtor ma btang / dbus su 'gro ba dang gzhi la 'dug pa thams cad la ston mo rgya chen po byas/ dbus pa yar 'gro rnams la zang zing nor gyi rdzongs pa la dngul rdo tshad gcig dang / khrob srang bcu gsum/ gser zho kha shas/ ras dā bu dkar dmar kha btags sogs zong rdo tshad gcig gis rtsis/ rta bzang po bdun/ dre'u gnyis/ mdzo bdun/ ha khye chung chung gnyis bcas byen/ dad rten du rnam thar bris ma gcig glegs bam bzhi/'dra sku phyag tham skra lo na bza' tshe ril rten 'dus srung mdud/mdzod btags ring po'i mgul dar bsgon nas chos kyi rdzongs pa la rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed skal ldan snying gi bu slob rnams/ /nga'i phan pa'i snying gtam glu la nyon/ /bdag skyes sa mdo khams smad yin kyang / /yar 'gro sa dbus gtsang zhing du 193

song / /sngon las dang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /nged dpon slob dbus gtsang zhing nas mjal/ /lo bco brgyad bar du rang don dang / /gzhan bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen bsgrubs/ /slar mdo smad sa cha 'di ru yong / /khong yon bdag rnams kyis lha bzhin bkur/ /nor yod dgu phul nas skyabs 'jug zhus/ /nged rnams kyis gsog 'jog ma byas par/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs kyi bde thabs su/ /sngar yod pa'i rten rnams zhig gso byas/ /rten med pa'i yul la gsar du bzhengs/ /kun 'grub tshe rab gnas dga' ston byas/ /mthar bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen btab/ /da bsam na skal ba shin tu bzang / /khyed skal ldan snying gi bu slob rnams/ /stod dbus la 'khyer rgyu'i nor med rung / /sems 'dod chung chog shes khal rta la/ /yar 'phags pa'i nor bdun khol la song / /sa dbus lam bar na dgra mang yang / /khyed rnams kyi nor la dgra rkun med/ /nor dka' las myangs nas 'khyer mi dgos/ /sa dbus gtsang mnga' rir slebs tsa na/ /khyod mched lcam yon bdag pho mo mang / /rgyu nor rdzas nang du slebs pa yin/ /nga da dung ma shi tshe ring na/ /dus lan cig dbus la 'ong thub blta/ /shi song rung 'gyod pa spu tsam med/ /yar sangs rgyas zhing nas zhing du 'gro/ /da khyed 194

song / /sngon las dang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /nged dpon slob dbus gtsang zhing nas mjal/ /lo bco brgyad bar du rang don dang / /gzhan bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen bsgrubs/ /slar mdo smad sa cha 'di ru yong / /khong yon bdag rnams kyis lha bzhin bkur/ /nor yod dgu phul nas skyabs 'jug zhus/ /nged rnams kyis gsog 'jog ma byas par/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs kyi bde thabs su/ /sngar yod pa'i rten rnams zhig gso byas/ /rten med pa'i yul la gsar du bzhengs/ /kun 'grub tshe rab gnas dga' ston byas/ /mthar bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen btab/ /da bsam na skal ba shin tu bzang / /khyed skal ldan snying gi bu slob rnams/ /stod dbus la 'khyer rgyu'i nor med rung / /sems 'dod chung chog shes khal rta la/ /yar 'phags pa'i nor bdun khol la song / /sa dbus lam bar na dgra mang yang / /khyed rnams kyi nor la dgra rkun med/ /nor dka' las myangs nas 'khyer mi dgos/ /sa dbus gtsang mnga' rir slebs tsa na/ /khyod mched lcam yon bdag pho mo mang / /rgyu nor rdzas nang du slebs pa yin/ /nga da dung ma shi tshe ring na/ /dus lan cig dbus la 'ong thub blta/ /shi song rung 'gyod pa spu tsam med/ /yar sangs rgyas zhing nas zhing du 'gro/ /da khyed 194

rnams sku khams bde bar bzhud/ /bgegs bar chad med pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /sa mdo dbus bar thag ring na yang / /dus da dung mjal ba'i sgon lam 'debs/ /tshe phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing khams su/ /nged dpon slob thams cad mjal bar shog /ces dbyangs dal bo byas blangs pa'i rjes su slob bu grub chen gyis bung ba rgyang ring du 'phur ba ltar/ dbyangs ring po byas dbus su yar 'gro'i mgur dbyangs 'di phul lo/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu khyed/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /'di phyi bar do gang du yang / /skyabs dang skyel ma mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag dbus su 'gro ba la/ /rjes na 'phreng ba rnam gsum dang / /bar na 'jigs pa rnam gsum dang / /sngon na dga' ba rnam gsum yod/ /drin can bla ma khyed dang gcig /dam gtsang rdo rje'i spun dang gnyis/ /yun ring 'grogs pa'i yon bdag gsum/ /rjes su lus pas sems re 'phreng / /mgo log jag pa mang dang gcig /'bri chu 'dam chu rgyas dang gnyis/ /stod kyi kha ba che dang gsum/ /brgyud nas 'gro la zhe re 'jigs/ /lha ldan jo bo de dang gcig /rgyal ba yab sras de dang gnyis/ /ser 'bras dge gsum de dang gsum/ /sngon na bzhugs snyam nyams re dga'/ /bdag cag 195

rnams sku khams bde bar bzhud/ /bgegs bar chad med pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /sa mdo dbus bar thag ring na yang / /dus da dung mjal ba'i sgon lam 'debs/ /tshe phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing khams su/ /nged dpon slob thams cad mjal bar shog /ces dbyangs dal bo byas blangs pa'i rjes su slob bu grub chen gyis bung ba rgyang ring du 'phur ba ltar/ dbyangs ring po byas dbus su yar 'gro'i mgur dbyangs 'di phul lo/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu khyed/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /'di phyi bar do gang du yang / /skyabs dang skyel ma mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag dbus su 'gro ba la/ /rjes na 'phreng ba rnam gsum dang / /bar na 'jigs pa rnam gsum dang / /sngon na dga' ba rnam gsum yod/ /drin can bla ma khyed dang gcig /dam gtsang rdo rje'i spun dang gnyis/ /yun ring 'grogs pa'i yon bdag gsum/ /rjes su lus pas sems re 'phreng / /mgo log jag pa mang dang gcig /'bri chu 'dam chu rgyas dang gnyis/ /stod kyi kha ba che dang gsum/ /brgyud nas 'gro la zhe re 'jigs/ /lha ldan jo bo de dang gcig /rgyal ba yab sras de dang gnyis/ /ser 'bras dge gsum de dang gsum/ /sngon na bzhugs snyam nyams re dga'/ /bdag cag 195

dbus su 'gro ba la/ /nor rdzas 'khyer rgyu cher med rung / /'phags pa'i nor bdun 'khyer la 'gro/ /tha mal nor gyes ci zhig bya/ /sa 'dir 'ongs pa'i dgos pa ni/ /skyabs mgon 'gro don mdzad pa'i mthar/ /yar la gdan 'dren byed snyam 'ongs/ /da re gdan 'dren ma nus par/ /song na mched lcam yon bdag la/ /'phrad pa'i dus su ci bshad snyam/ /shin tu ngo gnong zhe re skyo/ /drin can bla ma thugs rje can/ /da re gdan 'dren ma nus rung / /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /ces blangs pa'i lan du ngas pi wang gling bu ltar skad gdangs snyan la ring ba byas skyo mgur pi wang rgyud mang zhes bya ba 'di blangs so/ /tshe 'di phyi'i skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /tshe ya dam yud la shor nas song / /rang tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer tsam/ /da yun ring tshe 'dir mi sdod snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /rang dbus la lan cig 'gro 'dod kyang / /sa mdo dbus bar thag ring ba'i mthus/ /lo na so rgas pas mi sleb snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /phyis dbus su lan cig slebs 196

dbus su 'gro ba la/ /nor rdzas 'khyer rgyu cher med rung / /'phags pa'i nor bdun 'khyer la 'gro/ /tha mal nor gyes ci zhig bya/ /sa 'dir 'ongs pa'i dgos pa ni/ /skyabs mgon 'gro don mdzad pa'i mthar/ /yar la gdan 'dren byed snyam 'ongs/ /da re gdan 'dren ma nus par/ /song na mched lcam yon bdag la/ /'phrad pa'i dus su ci bshad snyam/ /shin tu ngo gnong zhe re skyo/ /drin can bla ma thugs rje can/ /da re gdan 'dren ma nus rung / /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /ces blangs pa'i lan du ngas pi wang gling bu ltar skad gdangs snyan la ring ba byas skyo mgur pi wang rgyud mang zhes bya ba 'di blangs so/ /tshe 'di phyi'i skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /tshe ya dam yud la shor nas song / /rang tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer tsam/ /da yun ring tshe 'dir mi sdod snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /rang dbus la lan cig 'gro 'dod kyang / /sa mdo dbus bar thag ring ba'i mthus/ /lo na so rgas pas mi sleb snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /phyis dbus su lan cig slebs 196

na yang / /grwa bu slob yon bdag rgan pa mang / /phal che ba 'das nas mi thug snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul du song na yang / /las bzang ngan dbang gis so sor 'gro/ /kun mjal lam mi mjal ci shes snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /spyir 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba 'di/ /lar 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin pas na/ /nam yin yang tha ma 'bral dgos snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /khyed skal ldan snying gi bu slob rnams/ /sems skyo ba bskyed la ri khrod 'grims/ /tshe blos thongs sgrub pa snying por gyis/ /rang 'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod/ /dus deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe 'di phyi bar do gang du yang / /nam mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su/ /zhal yang nas yang du mjal bar shog /ces blangs pa'i tshe rang yang skyo ba'i shugs kyis mig nas mchi ma lhung ba dang / der 'tshogs pa rnams la yang dad gus dang dag snang nges 'byung skyo shas rang shugs kyis skyes nas phal che ba'i mig nas mchi ma byung ngo / /de'i phyi nyin tshes bcu gcig gi snga dro nyi ma rtse shar la/ dbus su 'gro ba rnams kyis mjal dar phul nas mjal ba dang / ngas bka' bsgo byin rlabs byas mjal dar khong rnams kyi mgul la 197

na yang / /grwa bu slob yon bdag rgan pa mang / /phal che ba 'das nas mi thug snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul du song na yang / /las bzang ngan dbang gis so sor 'gro/ /kun mjal lam mi mjal ci shes snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /spyir 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba 'di/ /lar 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin pas na/ /nam yin yang tha ma 'bral dgos snyam/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /khyed skal ldan snying gi bu slob rnams/ /sems skyo ba bskyed la ri khrod 'grims/ /tshe blos thongs sgrub pa snying por gyis/ /rang 'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod/ /dus deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe 'di phyi bar do gang du yang / /nam mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su/ /zhal yang nas yang du mjal bar shog /ces blangs pa'i tshe rang yang skyo ba'i shugs kyis mig nas mchi ma lhung ba dang / der 'tshogs pa rnams la yang dad gus dang dag snang nges 'byung skyo shas rang shugs kyis skyes nas phal che ba'i mig nas mchi ma byung ngo / /de'i phyi nyin tshes bcu gcig gi snga dro nyi ma rtse shar la/ dbus su 'gro ba rnams kyis mjal dar phul nas mjal ba dang / ngas bka' bsgo byin rlabs byas mjal dar khong rnams kyi mgul la 197

g.yogs nas 'gro kha'i zhal gdams mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//gnas spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od gur khang nas/ /gdan pad+ma nyi zla'i steng bzhugs pa'i/ /mgon chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /nged dpon slob yul phyogs mi gcig rung / /las smon lam dbang gis phyogs phyogs nas/ /sa mdo khams smad kyi yul 'dir 'dus/ /lo mang po'i bar du lhan du bsdad/ /bstan 'gro don mang po byas pa'i mthar/ /da mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /chos byed lugs shin tu mang na yang / /byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /rgyu tshogs gnyis gsog la sgrib gnyis sbyongs/ /mthar bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen thob/ /dus da re so sor gyes na yang / /nam mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su/ /kun dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam du/ /slar yang nar+sha yang du mjal bar shog /sa kha thag ring pos bar chod nas/ /tshe 'di ru gal te ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing khams su/ /nged dpon slob thams cad mjal bar shog /ces blangs pa'i tshe slob bu grub chen gyis nga'i zhabs spyi bor blangs nas/198

g.yogs nas 'gro kha'i zhal gdams mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//gnas spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od gur khang nas/ /gdan pad+ma nyi zla'i steng bzhugs pa'i/ /mgon chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /nged dpon slob yul phyogs mi gcig rung / /las smon lam dbang gis phyogs phyogs nas/ /sa mdo khams smad kyi yul 'dir 'dus/ /lo mang po'i bar du lhan du bsdad/ /bstan 'gro don mang po byas pa'i mthar/ /da mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /chos byed lugs shin tu mang na yang / /byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /rgyu tshogs gnyis gsog la sgrib gnyis sbyongs/ /mthar bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen thob/ /dus da re so sor gyes na yang / /nam mjal na 'dod pa'i dus skabs su/ /kun dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam du/ /slar yang nas yang du mjal bar shog /sa kha thag ring pos bar chod nas/ /tshe 'di ru gal te ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing khams su/ /nged dpon slob thams cad mjal bar shog /ces blangs pa'i tshe slob bu grub chen gyis nga'i zhabs spyi bor blangs nas/198

ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blangs pa'i mthar 'bral ma phod par yun ring po zhig gi bar du ngus pas/ ngas da mang po ngu mi dgos da dung tshe 'di dang ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du mjal yong zhes bshad kyang da dung ngu ba byung /de phyis mi mjal ba sems kyis tshor ba yin nam snyam/ de nas mched grogs mang pos bskyal nas rwa rgya brgyud nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du bzhud song / nga yang kho la yun ring 'dris pa'i stabs kyis sems skyo ba byung / chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di'i rang bzhin can red snyam dge sbyor la zhugs so/ /de'i lo phyogs phyogs nas grwa ba mang po dbus su 'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir lam yig gzhan gyis bton na tshig rna bar snyan cing don sems la 'bab pa 'di yi ger bris nas byin/yul dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /zhal bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yab sras kyis/ /yar dbus gtsang zhing du mjal mkhan la/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /dbus 'gro ba'i lam du 'khod pa yi/ /khyed dad can skya ser pho mo la/ /ngas dge ba'i gsol 'debs glu dbyangs len/ /sems rab tu dga' zhing spro bas nyon/ /chos dge ba rang gis byas pa 199

ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blangs pa'i mthar 'bral ma phod par yun ring po zhig gi bar du ngus pas/ ngas da mang po ngu mi dgos da dung tshe 'di dang ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du mjal yong zhes bshad kyang da dung ngu ba byung /de phyis mi mjal ba sems kyis tshor ba yin nam snyam/ de nas mched grogs mang pos bskyal nas rwa rgya brgyud nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du bzhud song / nga yang kho la yun ring 'dris pa'i stabs kyis sems skyo ba byung / chos thams cad mi rtag pa 'di'i rang bzhin can red snyam dge sbyor la zhugs so/ /de'i lo phyogs phyogs nas grwa ba mang po dbus su 'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir lam yig gzhan gyis bton na tshig rna bar snyan cing don sems la 'bab pa 'di yi ger bris nas byin/yul dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /zhal bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yab sras kyis/ /yar dbus gtsang zhing du mjal mkhan la/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /dbus 'gro ba'i lam du 'khod pa yi/ /khyed dad can skya ser pho mo la/ /ngas dge ba'i gsol 'debs glu dbyangs len/ /sems rab tu dga' zhing spro bas nyon/ /chos dge ba rang gis byas pa 199

dang / /gzhan rnams la byed du 'jug pa dang / /dge gang byas rjes su yi rang re/ /sus byas kyang phan yon mnyam par gsungs/ /don de phyir lam kha'i yon bdag tsho/ /yar 'gro mkhan rnams la phan thogs dang / /khyed rnams kyis dbus la mjal ba dang / /khyad med pa'i phan yon 'thob par 'gyur/ /dbus 'gro mkhan phal cher grwa sar bsdad/ /yar dga' ldan gser khri thob pa dang / /de min kyang lha rams byed mkhan mang / /de'i phan yon mnyam du 'thob par 'gyur/ /de min kyang lo zla mang po'i bar/ /tshogs chos rar 'grims nas slob gnyer byas/ /bka' rab 'byams ming btags blangs nas yong / /de'i phan yon mnyam du 'thob par 'gyur/ /chos dge ba mang po mi nus kyang / /dbus lo re bzhin du 'gro mkhan gyi/ /sman zas gos sogs kyis phan thogs dang / /de'i lhag gi chos shig bya mi dgos/ /sa thag ring a mdo'i yul nas 'ong / /yul thag ring dbus su 'gro mkhan gyi/ /dman sprang po ar lco snyem chung la/ /rkus 'phrog bcom ma byed snying re rje/ /glu thos tshad rnams kyis ar lco ba/ /snying rje nas zas gos ster bar shog /de min kyang 'phrog bcom mi byed par/ /lam bstan nas bde bar 'gro gyur cig /ces pa kho rang rnams kyis khyer nas 200

dang / /gzhan rnams la byed du 'jug pa dang / /dge gang byas rjes su yi rang re/ /sus byas kyang phan yon mnyam par gsungs/ /don de phyir lam kha'i yon bdag tsho/ /yar 'gro mkhan rnams la phan thogs dang / /khyed rnams kyis dbus la mjal ba dang / /khyad med pa'i phan yon 'thob par 'gyur/ /dbus 'gro mkhan phal cher grwa sar bsdad/ /yar dga' ldan gser khri thob pa dang / /de min kyang lha rams byed mkhan mang / /de'i phan yon mnyam du 'thob par 'gyur/ /de min kyang lo zla mang po'i bar/ /tshogs chos rar 'grims nas slob gnyer byas/ /bka' rab 'byams ming btags blangs nas yong / /de'i phan yon mnyam du 'thob par 'gyur/ /chos dge ba mang po mi nus kyang / /dbus lo re bzhin du 'gro mkhan gyi/ /sman zas gos sogs kyis phan thogs dang / /de'i lhag gi chos shig bya mi dgos/ /sa thag ring a mdo'i yul nas 'ong / /yul thag ring dbus su 'gro mkhan gyi/ /dman sprang po ar lco snyem chung la/ /rkus 'phrog bcom ma byed snying re rje/ /glu thos tshad rnams kyis ar lco ba/ /snying rje nas zas gos ster bar shog /de min kyang 'phrog bcom mi byed par/ /lam bstan nas bde bar 'gro gyur cig /ces pa kho rang rnams kyis khyer nas 200

kun la bstan pas dad can rnams kyis zas gos sogs kyis phan thogs byas pas kun skyid po byung ngo / /chu bzang nas 'gro khar dge 'dun pa rnams 'tshogs su bcug nas mang ja btang / 'o khyed rnams kyis spyir chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gyis/ khyad par bca' yig gi nang ltar 'grig lam kun spyod 'don chos spyod rnams yar ldan mdzod ces bshad nas yar tho no ji la 'ongs/ ri ngos kyi bla ma bde gshegs tshang bzhugs pa'i mtshams khang gi nang du rna gong ba'i lha bzos sku gdung mchod rten dang sku 'dra bzhengs/ rtsa ba ru jo bo yid bzhin nor bu'i lha khang zhig bzhengs/ gzhan ja khang gnyer khang grwa khang kha shas bzos/ dngul rdo tshad gcig dang srang nyi shu'i gser tshon dang /lha bzo shing bzo las byed pa rnams la rta nor bcu drug der sdod pa'i sku tshab pad+ma 'bum dang / grwa pa sdod mkhan rnams la mdzo mdzo mo 'bri g.yag bdun lug lnga bcu tsam gyi spyi 'jog bzhag rab gnas dga' ston byas/ grub dbang rin po che'i rnam thar gyi 'phro yang brtsams/ sprul sku myur 'byon thon dang yang sprul gsal bo yong bas kun gyis mya ngan sems khral ma byed ces sems gso byas/ rjes su sprul sku a lags mkha' 'gro tshang gi nang du 'khrungs/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa 201

kun la bstan pas dad can rnams kyis zas gos sogs kyis phan thogs byas pas kun skyid po byung ngo / /chu bzang nas 'gro khar dge 'dun pa rnams 'tshogs su bcug nas mang ja btang / 'o khyed rnams kyis spyir chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gyis/ khyad par bca' yig gi nang ltar 'grig lam kun spyod 'don chos spyod rnams yar ldan mdzod ces bshad nas yar tho no ji la 'ongs/ ri ngos kyi bla ma bde gshegs tshang bzhugs pa'i mtshams khang gi nang du rna gong ba'i lha bzos sku gdung mchod rten dang sku 'dra bzhengs/ rtsa ba ru jo bo yid bzhin nor bu'i lha khang zhig bzhengs/ gzhan ja khang gnyer khang grwa khang kha shas bzos/ dngul rdo tshad gcig dang srang nyi shu'i gser tshon dang /lha bzo shing bzo las byed pa rnams la rta nor bcu drug der sdod pa'i sku tshab pad+ma 'bum dang / grwa pa sdod mkhan rnams la mdzo mdzo mo 'bri g.yag bdun lug lnga bcu tsam gyi spyi 'jog bzhag rab gnas dga' ston byas/ grub dbang rin po che'i rnam thar gyi 'phro yang brtsams/ sprul sku myur 'byon thon dang yang sprul gsal bo yong bas kun gyis mya ngan sems khral ma byed ces sems gso byas/ rjes su sprul sku a lags mkha' 'gro tshang gi nang du 'khrungs/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa 201

zhig byung / de'i dbyar ka 'khyams ru dang rkang tsha sogs phyogs de'i yon bdag rnams kyis gdan 'dren byas/ yon bdag phal che ba'i nang du song tshe sgrub nor sgrub g.yang 'bod bkra shis byas/ thams cad la ma ṇi'i lung dang chos kyang 'di ltar bshad/ 'o khyed yon bdag dad can 'ga' res/ chung nas chos shig bya snyam yang de'i ngang la mi tshe shor nas 'gro bas/ da ni kun gyis nam 'chi cha med soms la/ kha rgan gzhon med pas dam pa'i lha chos gyis zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe mi rtag dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed dad can skye bo pho mo rnams/ /nga'i phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /dus dang po yul na sdod pa'i dus/ /mi kun gyi gral gye mjug tu bsdad/ /nga na so cung zhig chung nas gda'/ chos byed na da dung mi 'ong snyam/ /de'i rjes su yul na yod pa'i dus/ /mi kun gyi gral gyi bar du bsdad/ /nga na so shin tu gzhon par gda'/ /chos byed na da ni yong ngam snyam/ /de'i rjes su yul na sdod pa'i dus/ /mi kun gyi gral gyi mgo ru bsdad/ /nga na so cung zhig rgas nas gda'/ /chos byed na dka' spyad mi nus snyam/ /de'i rjes su yul na sdod pa'i dus/ /nang khyim tshang bza' ba'i gral mgor bsdad/ /nga na so 202

zhig byung / de'i dbyar ka 'khyams ru dang rkang tsha sogs phyogs de'i yon bdag rnams kyis gdan 'dren byas/ yon bdag phal che ba'i nang du song tshe sgrub nor sgrub g.yang 'bod bkra shis byas/ thams cad la ma ṇi'i lung dang chos kyang 'di ltar bshad/ 'o khyed yon bdag dad can 'ga' res/ chung nas chos shig bya snyam yang de'i ngang la mi tshe shor nas 'gro bas/ da ni kun gyis nam 'chi cha med soms la/ kha rgan gzhon med pas dam pa'i lha chos gyis zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe mi rtag dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed dad can skye bo pho mo rnams/ /nga'i phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /dus dang po yul na sdod pa'i dus/ /mi kun gyi gral gye mjug tu bsdad/ /nga na so cung zhig chung nas gda'/ chos byed na da dung mi 'ong snyam/ /de'i rjes su yul na yod pa'i dus/ /mi kun gyi gral gyi bar du bsdad/ /nga na so shin tu gzhon par gda'/ /chos byed na da ni yong ngam snyam/ /de'i rjes su yul na sdod pa'i dus/ /mi kun gyi gral gyi mgo ru bsdad/ /nga na so cung zhig rgas nas gda'/ /chos byed na dka' spyad mi nus snyam/ /de'i rjes su yul na sdod pa'i dus/ /nang khyim tshang bza' ba'i gral mgor bsdad/ /nga na so 202

yar la rgas nas gda'/ /chos chung ngu'i dus na byed snyam yang / /lo rjes ma'i rjes mar byas na snyam/ /de'i ngang la mi tshe shor nas 'gro/ /don de phyir yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /chos phyi bshol byas nas 'jog mi rung / /gzhan rgan gzhon mang po shi la ltos/ /rang nam 'chi cha med tshul soms la/ /kha rgan gzhon med par lha chos gyis/ /zhes blangs pas thams cad kyi snang ba dam pa'i chos la 'gyur nas/ sdig spong dge sgrub la brtson mkhan mang po byung / yul phyogs kyang bde zhing skyid par gyur/de dus sman zhing nas rta nor lug gsum sum brgya lhag tsam rnyed pa'i nang nas khyung dgon sprul sku dang / dgu rong sprul sku gnyis la rta bzang po re/ reb gong sngags mang gi rdo rje slob dpon dbu mdzad las sna ba dang / gzhan gyi 'bul sdud pa/grwa rkyang sprang po rnams la rta nor lug gsum bdun cu tsam gyis mchod sbyin btang / de'i 'phro na gang yod ded nas ston mjug 'bal phyogs la song / bkra tsha sha brang kho nag sogs kyis gdan drangs rab gnas byin 'bebs bkra shis byas/ 'bul ba rta nor mang po phul/ grwa btsun mang por gsol ras byin nas bkra shis 'khyil bar brdzangs/ nged dpon slob nyung 'dus byas g.yer gshong su rug sogs phyogs de'i yon bdag rnams kyis 203

yar la rgas nas gda'/ /chos chung ngu'i dus na byed snyam yang / /lo rjes ma'i rjes mar byas na snyam/ /de'i ngang la mi tshe shor nas 'gro/ /don de phyir yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /chos phyi bshol byas nas 'jog mi rung / /gzhan rgan gzhon mang po shi la ltos/ /rang nam 'chi cha med tshul soms la/ /kha rgan gzhon med par lha chos gyis/ /zhes blangs pas thams cad kyi snang ba dam pa'i chos la 'gyur nas/ sdig spong dge sgrub la brtson mkhan mang po byung / yul phyogs kyang bde zhing skyid par gyur/de dus sman zhing nas rta nor lug gsum sum brgya lhag tsam rnyed pa'i nang nas khyung dgon sprul sku dang / dgu rong sprul sku gnyis la rta bzang po re/ reb gong sngags mang gi rdo rje slob dpon dbu mdzad las sna ba dang / gzhan gyi 'bul sdud pa/grwa rkyang sprang po rnams la rta nor lug gsum bdun cu tsam gyis mchod sbyin btang / de'i 'phro na gang yod ded nas ston mjug 'bal phyogs la song / bkra tsha sha brang kho nag sogs kyis gdan drangs rab gnas byin 'bebs bkra shis byas/ 'bul ba rta nor mang po phul/ grwa btsun mang por gsol ras byin nas bkra shis 'khyil bar brdzangs/ nged dpon slob nyung 'dus byas g.yer gshong su rug sogs phyogs de'i yon bdag rnams kyis 203

gdan drangs/ kun la tshe dbang nor dbang byas chos bshad bsngo sgon bkra shis brjod mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//skyabs mgon chos rgyal yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /spyi bo brgyan nas chos kyi glu dbyangs len/ /ma nor lam la zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /sa ru 'gro ba'i skye bo pho mo nyon/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /mchod bstod gsol ba thob cig yon bdag rnams/ /tshe 'dir pha ma yan na drin can med/ /rgas dus brtsi bkur gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos de mched grogs yin/ /grogs la brtse gdung mdzod cig yon bdag rnams/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /snying rje phan sems sbyongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /phyag dang skor ba byas na sdig sgrib 'dag /rten la phyag skor gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /chos kyi snying po yi ge drug ma yin/ /rgyan du ma ṇi bgrongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /la ra ra ra snar sna da tshodag ba gang byas mjug tu bsnga sman mjad/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob bo yon bdag rnams/ /lha chos byed na zhal gdams mang mi dgos/ /de rnams yid la zungs shig yon bdag rnams/ /glu 'di thos tshad yon bdag pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la 'gyur bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis g.yang chags 204

gdan drangs/ kun la tshe dbang nor dbang byas chos bshad bsngo sgon bkra shis brjod mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//skyabs mgon chos rgyal yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /spyi bo brgyan nas chos kyi glu dbyangs len/ /ma nor lam la zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /sa ru 'gro ba'i skye bo pho mo nyon/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /mchod bstod gsol ba thob cig yon bdag rnams/ /tshe 'dir pha ma yan na drin can med/ /rgas dus brtsi bkur gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos de mched grogs yin/ /grogs la brtse gdung mdzod cig yon bdag rnams/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /snying rje phan sems sbyongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /phyag dang skor ba byas na sdig sgrib 'dag /rten la phyag skor gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /chos kyi snying po yi ge drug ma yin/ /rgyun du ma ṇi bgrongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /dge ba gang byas mjug tu bsngo smon mdzod/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob bo yon bdag rnams/ /lha chos byed na zhal gdams mang mi dgos/ /de rnams yid la zungs shig yon bdag rnams/ /glu 'di thos tshad yon bdag pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la 'gyur bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis g.yang chags 204

shing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas yon bdag rnams kyis dad pa cher song rta nor lug gsum mang po dang / khyad par mar phyur mang po 'bul mkhan byung / de rnams khyer nas bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa a rig dge bshes chen mo'i gdan sa khyad par can byang rwa sgreng dang mtshungs pa'i rwa rgya dgon chen du song / shing bza' sprul pa'i sku dang / rgyal ba'i sprul sku/ mon shul tshang / hor brdung tshang sogs bla ma rnams la phyag rten phul nas mjal/dge 'dun pa rnams la rkyal mar che chung bcu gsum tsam dang /phyur ba dang rtsam pa do bo nyi shu tsam gyi tshab ra btang / rta nor drug cu 'gyed phogs kyi thebs su phul/ phyag mchod skor ba byas/zhag mang por bsdad/ nyin cig skor ba byas pa'i lam nas dad can dbu mdzad bstan rgyas kyis/ de ring khyed kyis dge 'dun pa 'di rnams thugs spro ba'i phyir/ wa gru rgyag pa 'di dang mthun pa'i mgur dbyangs snyan mo zhig len dgos zhes bskul ngor glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//bsam bzang rwa rgya'i gru pa yis/ /nyin re bzhin du rma chu la/ /shing gi wa gsum bshibs nas btang / /mgron po mang po sgol ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /'khor 205

shing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas yon bdag rnams kyis dad pa cher song rta nor lug gsum mang po dang / khyad par mar phyur mang po 'bul mkhan byung / de rnams khyer nas bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa a rig dge bshes chen mo'i gdan sa khyad par can byang rwa sgreng dang mtshungs pa'i rwa rgya dgon chen du song / shing bza' sprul pa'i sku dang / rgyal ba'i sprul sku/ mon shul tshang / hor brdung tshang sogs bla ma rnams la phyag rten phul nas mjal/dge 'dun pa rnams la rkyal mar che chung bcu gsum tsam dang /phyur ba dang rtsam pa do bo nyi shu tsam gyi tshab ra btang / rta nor drug cu 'gyed phogs kyi thebs su phul/ phyag mchod skor ba byas/zhag mang por bsdad/ nyin cig skor ba byas pa'i lam nas dad can dbu mdzad bstan rgyas kyis/ de ring khyed kyis dge 'dun pa 'di rnams thugs spro ba'i phyir/ wa gru rgyag pa 'di dang mthun pa'i mgur dbyangs snyan mo zhig len dgos zhes bskul ngor glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//bsam bzang rwa rgya'i gru pa yis/ /nyin re bzhin du rma chu la/ /shing gi wa gsum bshibs nas btang / /mgron po mang po sgol ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /'khor 205

ba'i chu las sgrol ba'i phyir/ /mi lus rin chen wa nang du/ /rig pa'i khye'u chung mgron po zhugs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gru pa yis/ /thun mong chos bshad phyag shing gis/ /rang blos wa kha gyen du bsgyur/ /byang chub sems kyi thag pas 'then/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'brel chu khem brgyab/ /'khor ba'i chu yi pha rol sgrol/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gru pa la/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i gru gla phul/ /da ni bde nas bde bar 'gro/ /gtan bde sangs rgyas sa ru 'gro/ /dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje'i spun/ /rang snang dam pa'i chos la bsgyur/ /zhes blangs pas dge 'dun pa rnams kyang thugs shin tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de nas yar khyung dgon dben gnas su 'gro khar gnas bstod chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho dang / /mgon yongs 'dzin dge bshes chen mo sogs/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs bla ma thams cad la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /mgon thub pa'i dbang po'i lung bstan las/ /mtshan chu bo go mi zhes byar gsungs/ /ming yongs grags rma chu chen mo yi/ /chu dkar mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'gram/ /gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phub pa'i 'og /sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad gyes pa'i steng / /gnas 206

ba'i chu las sgrol ba'i phyir/ /mi lus rin chen wa nang du/ /rig pa'i khye'u chung mgron po zhugs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gru pa yis/ /thun mong chos bshad phyag shing gis/ /rang blos wa kha gyen du bsgyur/ /byang chub sems kyi thag pas 'then/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'brel chu khem brgyab/ /'khor ba'i chu yi pha rol sgrol/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gru pa la/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i gru gla phul/ /da ni bde nas bde bar 'gro/ /gtan bde sangs rgyas sa ru 'gro/ /dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje'i spun/ /rang snang dam pa'i chos la bsgyur/ /zhes blangs pas dge 'dun pa rnams kyang thugs shin tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de nas yar khyung dgon dben gnas su 'gro khar gnas bstod chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho dang / /mgon yongs 'dzin dge bshes chen mo sogs/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs bla ma thams cad la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /mgon thub pa'i dbang po'i lung bstan las/ /mtshan chu bo go mi zhes byar gsungs/ /ming yongs grags rma chu chen mo yi/ /chu dkar mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'gram/ /gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phub pa'i 'og /sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad gyes pa'i steng / /gnas 206

bkra shis g.yang chags rwa rgya yi/ /dgon chen po'i rgyab kyi ri bo de/ /ri rgya che dpangs mtho brjid chags pa'i/ /stong 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gdan bzhugs nas/ /dpe rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong dang mtshungs/ /ri gzhan rnams rgyal srid sna bdun dang / /dbyebs bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dra bar snang / /lha dkar phyogs klu yang mang po gnas/ /byang rwa sgreng dben pa'i gnas mchog dang / /khyad med pa'i gnas mchog 'di nyid du/ /dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub sprul pa dngos/ /mgon yongs 'dzin dge bshes chen mo yis/ /phan bde ba'i 'byung gnas dgon pa btab/ /chos bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa bskyed pa'i yum/ /slar ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol ba/ /rje shing bza' thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /dgon 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas/ /khong dge 'dun stong phrag lhag tsam 'dus/ /lha bcu gsum dkyil 'khor sgrub chod btsugs/ /rgyu rin chen du ma las grub pa'i/ /lha'i sku gzugs gsung rab lha khang bzhengs/ /chos bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs par du brkos/ /mgon rgyal bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad/ /de'i rjes su bla ma mang po yis/ /dgon dge 'dun sde rnams chos bzhin bskyangs/ /khong dge 'dun kun kyang khrims 207

bkra shis g.yang chags rwa rgya yi/ /dgon chen po'i rgyab kyi ri bo de/ /ri rgya che dpangs mtho brjid chags pa'i/ /stong 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gdan bzhugs nas/ /dpe rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong dang mtshungs/ /ri gzhan rnams rgyal srid sna bdun dang / /dbyebs bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dra bar snang / /lha dkar phyogs klu yang mang po gnas/ /byang rwa sgreng dben pa'i gnas mchog dang / /khyad med pa'i gnas mchog 'di nyid du/ /dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub sprul pa dngos/ /mgon yongs 'dzin dge bshes chen mo yis/ /phan bde ba'i 'byung gnas dgon pa btab/ /chos bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa bskyed pa'i yum/ /slar ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol ba/ /rje shing bza' thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /dgon 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas/ /khong dge 'dun stong phrag lhag tsam 'dus/ /lha bcu gsum dkyil 'khor sgrub chod btsugs/ /rgyu rin chen du ma las grub pa'i/ /lha'i sku gzugs gsung rab lha khang bzhengs/ /chos bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs par du brkos/ /mgon rgyal bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad/ /de'i rjes su bla ma mang po yis/ /dgon dge 'dun sde rnams chos bzhin bskyangs/ /khong dge 'dun kun kyang khrims 207

gtsang zhing / /chos tshul bzhin byed pa sha stag byung / /kun chos bzhin byas pa'i lag rjes su/ /phyogs 'di ru bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /don de phyir chos mdzad skyes bu rnams/ /gnas 'di ru bzhugs la lha chos mdzod/ /gzhan dad can skye bo pho mo rnams/ /dgon 'di la phyag mchod skor ba gyis/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos bshad sgrub bstan pa 'phel bar shog /gnas 'di ru byin chags g.yang 'khyil zhing / /bkra shis pas phyogs 'di khyab gyur cig /ces blangs nas rgyab ri'i khyung dgon ri khrod nas de'i lo dgun mtshams la bsdad nas/ dge sbyor dang mnyam gzhag gtso bor byas pas/ nyin cig mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang 'jig rten khams mang po na/ sangs rgyas dang sems can mang po mthong ba la rang lus grangs med sprul nas mchod pa 'bul ba dang / sbyin pa gtong ba sogs kyi nyams snang sna tshogs pa byung / de'i mtshan mo rmi lam la yang phyogs bcur sprul pa mang po bkyes nas sangs rgyas mchod cing sems can 'dren pa sogs rmis nas sad tshe/ shin tu nyams spro ba'i shugs kyis glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /blta bas mi ngoms rdo rje'i sku/ /'gags med gsung snyan 208

gtsang zhing / /chos tshul bzhin byed pa sha stag byung / /kun chos bzhin byas pa'i lag rjes su/ /phyogs 'di ru bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /don de phyir chos mdzad skyes bu rnams/ /gnas 'di ru bzhugs la lha chos mdzod/ /gzhan dad can skye bo pho mo rnams/ /dgon 'di la phyag mchod skor ba gyis/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos bshad sgrub bstan pa 'phel bar shog /gnas 'di ru byin chags g.yang 'khyil zhing / /bkra shis pas phyogs 'di khyab gyur cig /ces blangs nas rgyab ri'i khyung dgon ri khrod nas de'i lo dgun mtshams la bsdad nas/ dge sbyor dang mnyam gzhag gtso bor byas pas/ nyin cig mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang 'jig rten khams mang po na/ sangs rgyas dang sems can mang po mthong ba la rang lus grangs med sprul nas mchod pa 'bul ba dang / sbyin pa gtong ba sogs kyi nyams snang sna tshogs pa byung / de'i mtshan mo rmi lam la yang phyogs bcur sprul pa mang po bkyes nas sangs rgyas mchod cing sems can 'dren pa sogs rmis nas sad tshe/ shin tu nyams spro ba'i shugs kyis glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /blta bas mi ngoms rdo rje'i sku/ /'gags med gsung snyan 208

tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /'khor 'das gzigs pa'i mkhyen rgya can/ /zla med bla ma mchog la 'dud/ /gza' gtad bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde ngas/ /chos dbyengs khyab gdal chen po yi/ /klong du zhugs nas glu zhig len/ /mkha' la khyung chen lding ba bzhin/ /chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang du rig pa yangs khrol ler/ /phyogs bcur yan par glod nas bzhag /bzhag pas 'khor 'das sems su 'dres/ /nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs shar/ /gang du bsdad kyang gu re yangs/ /su dang 'grogs kyang nyams re dga'/ /ltad mo sna tshogs mthong ba 'di/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bla ma sgrub pas mnyes par shog /ces blangs nas rab tu dga' zhing spro bzhin pa'i ngang nas yod dus/ thag nye'i yon bdag 'ga' res gnas 'dir thugs spro bo e byung zer ba'i lan du/ gnas bstod dag snang ma zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs bla ma yi dam lha/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs bcas la/ /bdag mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /sprang las snang dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /rje grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho yis/ /gnas 'di yi rgyab ri'i 209

tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /'khor 'das gzigs pa'i mkhyen rgya can/ /zla med bla ma mchog la 'dud/ /gza' gtad bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde ngas/ /chos dbyengs khyab gdal chen po yi/ /klong du zhugs nas glu zhig len/ /mkha' la khyung chen lding ba bzhin/ /chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang du rig pa yangs khrol ler/ /phyogs bcur yan par glod nas bzhag /bzhag pas 'khor 'das sems su 'dres/ /nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs shar/ /gang du bsdad kyang gu re yangs/ /su dang 'grogs kyang nyams re dga'/ /ltad mo sna tshogs mthong ba 'di/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bla ma sgrub pas mnyes par shog /ces blangs nas rab tu dga' zhing spro bzhin pa'i ngang nas yod dus/ thag nye'i yon bdag 'ga' res gnas 'dir thugs spro bo e byung zer ba'i lan du/ gnas bstod dag snang ma zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs bla ma yi dam lha/ /ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs bcas la/ /bdag mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /sprang las snang dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /rje grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtsho yis/ /gnas 'di yi rgyab ri'i 209

rtse mo nas/ /lha 'jigs byed gnas brtan ba ku la'i/ /zhal yun ring bar du gzigs zhes gsungs/ /rje dge bshes chen mos rwa rgya 'di/ /sngon bla ma dri ma med pa yis/ /lung bstan pa'i rwa sgreng dben gnas dang / /khyad med ces bsngags brjod mang po gnang / /mi bdag gi dag pa'i snang ngo la/ /gnas 'di ni o rgyan yul dang mtshungs/ /ri'i rtse na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bya rgod por sprul nas skor ba byed/ /ri'i rked na bya btang sgom chen tshogs/ /nang ting 'dzin sgo brgya 'byed la brtson/ /ri'i rtsa bar khrims ldan mkhas mang tshogs/ /chos mdo sngags gzhung la thos bsam mdzad/ /phyogs kun na lha klu bye ba gnas/ /chos sgrub mkhan rnams kyi sdongs grogs byed/ /steng mkha' na lha yis khrus gsol bzhin/ /brag mthon po'i kha nas chu gtsang 'bab/ /'og mdun na klu rgyal ma dros pas/ /yar yon chab 'bul bzhin rma chu 'khyel/ /bya ri dwags rtsi shing nags tshal rnams/ /lha'i spyan gzigs mchod rdzas lta bur mdzes/ /rang 'dug gnas brag gi bya skyibs de/ /dpe gad pa gser gyi bya skyibs 'dra/ /dbyar bsil zhing dgun dus nyi ma dro/ /sa dro grang snyoms pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /chos zab mo bsgrub rgyu'i skal ba byung / /gnas 'di ru 'ongs pa'i nyi ma 210

rtse mo nas/ /lha 'jigs byed gnas brtan ba ku la'i/ /zhal yun ring bar du gzigs zhes gsungs/ /rje dge bshes chen mos rwa rgya 'di/ /sngon bla ma dri ma med pa yis/ /lung bstan pa'i rwa sgreng dben gnas dang / /khyad med ces bsngags brjod mang po gnang / /mi bdag gi dag pa'i snang ngo la/ /gnas 'di ni o rgyan yul dang mtshungs/ /ri'i rtse na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bya rgod por sprul nas skor ba byed/ /ri'i rked na bya btang sgom chen tshogs/ /nang ting 'dzin sgo brgya 'byed la brtson/ /ri'i rtsa bar khrims ldan mkhas mang tshogs/ /chos mdo sngags gzhung la thos bsam mdzad/ /phyogs kun na lha klu bye ba gnas/ /chos sgrub mkhan rnams kyi sdongs grogs byed/ /steng mkha' na lha yis khrus gsol bzhin/ /brag mthon po'i kha nas chu gtsang 'bab/ /'og mdun na klu rgyal ma dros pas/ /yar yon chab 'bul bzhin rma chu 'khyel/ /bya ri dwags rtsi shing nags tshal rnams/ /lha'i spyan gzigs mchod rdzas lta bur mdzes/ /rang 'dug gnas brag gi bya skyibs de/ /dpe gad pa gser gyi bya skyibs 'dra/ /dbyar bsil zhing dgun dus nyi ma dro/ /sa dro grang snyoms pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /chos zab mo bsgrub rgyu'i skal ba byung / /gnas 'di ru 'ongs pa'i nyi ma 210

nas/ /'phral nyams dga' rig pa shin tu dwangs/ /phugs phan pa'i dge sems 'phel po byung / /don de phyir bya btang sgom chen rnams/ /gnas 'di ru sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar bar shog /ces blangs pas der 'khod pa'i slob ma yon bdag thams cad kyang sems dga' zhing spro ba'i sgo nas/gnas der sdod pa'i ring la 'o ma dang me shing la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen gang dgos thams cad bsgrub pa byung / de'i lo gsar dga' ston gyi nyin par dbon po dkar dris dang / blo ldan stag yan la sogs pa'i zhabs phyi ba 'ga' res/ khyed kyis de ring tsho skal ba bzang bzang byas mgur dbyangs shig len dgos zhes bskul ngor/ ngas skal bzang glu dbyangs 'di blangs so //rje bla ma dkon mchog spyi bor bzhugs/ /bstan 'gro la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngas skal ba bzang po'i glu zhig len/ /khyed rnams kyang rab tu dga' bas nyon/ /rje rgyal ba yab sras gtso byas pa'i/ /ngas mkhas grub brgya dang rtsa brgyad mjal/ /de'i nang na 'brel tshad don ldan mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /chos lam rim phyag rdzogs gtso byas 211

nas/ /'phral nyams dga' rig pa shin tu dwangs/ /phugs phan pa'i dge sems 'phel po byung / /don de phyir bya btang sgom chen rnams/ /gnas 'di ru sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar bar shog /ces blangs pas der 'khod pa'i slob ma yon bdag thams cad kyang sems dga' zhing spro ba'i sgo nas/gnas der sdod pa'i ring la 'o ma dang me shing la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen gang dgos thams cad bsgrub pa byung / de'i lo gsar dga' ston gyi nyin par dbon po dkar dris dang / blo ldan stag yan la sogs pa'i zhabs phyi ba 'ga' res/ khyed kyis de ring tsho skal ba bzang bzang byas mgur dbyangs shig len dgos zhes bskul ngor/ ngas skal bzang glu dbyangs 'di blangs so //rje bla ma dkon mchog spyi bor bzhugs/ /bstan 'gro la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngas skal ba bzang po'i glu zhig len/ /khyed rnams kyang rab tu dga' bas nyon/ /rje rgyal ba yab sras gtso byas pa'i/ /ngas mkhas grub brgya dang rtsa brgyad mjal/ /de'i nang na 'brel tshad don ldan mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /chos lam rim phyag rdzogs gtso byas 211

pa'i/ /ngas bka' chos brgya dang rtsa brgyad thob/ /de'i nang na zab mo'i gdams ngag mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /lha jo shāka rnam gnyis gtso byas pa'i/ /ngas lha rten brgya dang rtsa brgyad mjal/ /de'i nang na rang byon gsung 'byon mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /gnas tsā ri gangs ris gtso byas pa'i/ /ngas dben gnas brgya dang rtsa brgyad bsten/ /de'i nang na byin can gnas chen mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /yul dbus gtsang bal bos gtso byas pa'i/ /ngas rgyal khams brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'grims/ /bstan 'gro ba gang la gang phan byas/ /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /smad mdo khams dgon dang grong yul du/ /ngas lha khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ /gzhan phyag mchod skor ba byed mkhan mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /ngas skal ba bzang po'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /lo drug cu re gcig thog tu blangs/ /dge gang bsags bstan 'gror phan phyir bsngo/ /bstan dar zhing 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /ces dbyangs ring po byas blangs pas kun dka' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de yang mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom sku gzhogs rdzogs chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i legs bshad spyi dang / khyad par mdo 212

pa'i/ /ngas bka' chos brgya dang rtsa brgyad thob/ /de'i nang na zab mo'i gdams ngag mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /lha jo shāka rnam gnyis gtso byas pa'i/ /ngas lha rten brgya dang rtsa brgyad mjal/ /de'i nang na rang byon gsung 'byon mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /gnas tsā ri gangs ris gtso byas pa'i/ /ngas dben gnas brgya dang rtsa brgyad bsten/ /de'i nang na byin can gnas chen mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /yul dbus gtsang bal bos gtso byas pa'i/ /ngas rgyal khams brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'grims/ /bstan 'gro ba gang la gang phan byas/ /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /smad mdo khams dgon dang grong yul du/ /ngas lha khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ /gzhan phyag mchod skor ba byed mkhan mang / /'di bsam na skal ba bzang po byung / /ngas skal ba bzang po'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /lo drug cu re gcig thog tu blangs/ /dge gang bsags bstan 'gror phan phyir bsngo/ /bstan dar zhing 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /ces dbyangs ring po byas blangs pas kun dka' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de yang mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom sku gzhogs rdzogs chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i legs bshad spyi dang / khyad par mdo 212

rgyud rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba'i bstan bcos chen mo la bltas pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po skyes/ lo gsar tshes la zhu yig 'di phul lo/ /tshe yi dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /tshe dpag med mgon sgol dkar sogs/ /tshe lha rnams kyis 'chi med kyi/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs kyi sprul pa o rgyan rje/ /slar yang mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom tshul/ /'dzin pa'i skyes mchog bdag la dgongs/ /mgon khyod sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /phyi rabs rjes 'jug gdul bya la/ /sangs rgyas 'di ltar sgrub dgos zhes/ /rnam thar kho nas ston pa'i phyir/ /dang po tshe 'di blo yis btang / /mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gdams pa zhus/ /thos bsam phyi yi sgo 'dogs bcad/ /bar du ri khrod dben pa ru/ /bsgoms pas nang gi sgo 'dogs bcad/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gter kha rdol/ /bla ma lha yi lung bstan ltar/ /tha ma skal bzang gdul bya yis/ /bskul ngor dbang lung khrid gsum sogs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas nyin mtshan 'das/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde mchog tu spel/ /bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi/ /213

rgyud rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba'i bstan bcos chen mo la bltas pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po skyes/ lo gsar tshes la zhu yig 'di phul lo/ /tshe yi dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /tshe dpag med mgon sgol dkar sogs/ /tshe lha rnams kyis 'chi med kyi/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs kyi sprul pa o rgyan rje/ /slar yang mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom tshul/ /'dzin pa'i skyes mchog bdag la dgongs/ /mgon khyod sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /phyi rabs rjes 'jug gdul bya la/ /sangs rgyas 'di ltar sgrub dgos zhes/ /rnam thar kho nas ston pa'i phyir/ /dang po tshe 'di blo yis btang / /mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gdams pa zhus/ /thos bsam phyi yi sgo 'dogs bcad/ /bar du ri khrod dben pa ru/ /bsgoms pas nang gi sgo 'dogs bcad/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gter kha rdol/ /bla ma lha yi lung bstan ltar/ /tha ma skal bzang gdul bya yis/ /bskul ngor dbang lung khrid gsum sogs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas nyin mtshan 'das/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde mchog tu spel/ /bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi/ /213

bka' rgya che ba'i mdo sde dang / /zab pa rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /paṇa grub du mas rgyal ba'i bka'i/ /dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kun gyi gnad/ /bstan 'dzin skyes chen thams cad las/ /brgyud pa'i phyag len nyams myong khrid/ /mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul bshad pa'i rgyun/ /mdo sngags theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras/ /lta sgom spyod gsum sdom pa gsum/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga che chung dang / /theg pa mtha' dag don gsal ba/ /tshang la ma nor legs bshad gter/ /nor bu'i bang mdzod lta bu yi/ /mdo rgyud rin po che yi mdzod/ /bstan 'gro spyi yi bde thabs dang / /khyad par da lta ma 'ongs pa'i/ /skal ldan rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jog pa mdzad pa bka' drin che/ /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul/ /ma dad log lta'i sdig pa bshags/ /rnam thar mchog la rjes yi rang / /da dung chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /lo brgyar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs zhabs pad brtan phyir bsngo/ /bla ma sku khams bzang zhing dwangs/ /mchog tu sku tshe ring par shog /bla ma'i sku bsod snyan grags rgyas/ /lhag par sku don 'grub par shog /bstan 'dzin bu slob thams cad kyang / /bstan 'gro'i don du zhabs brtan 214

bka' rgya che ba'i mdo sde dang / /zab pa rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /paṇa grub du mas rgyal ba'i bka'i/ /dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kun gyi gnad/ /bstan 'dzin skyes chen thams cad las/ /brgyud pa'i phyag len nyams myong khrid/ /mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul bshad pa'i rgyun/ /mdo sngags theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras/ /lta sgom spyod gsum sdom pa gsum/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga che chung dang / /theg pa mtha' dag don gsal ba/ /tshang la ma nor legs bshad gter/ /nor bu'i bang mdzod lta bu yi/ /mdo rgyud rin po che yi mdzod/ /bstan 'gro spyi yi bde thabs dang / /khyad par da lta ma 'ongs pa'i/ /skal ldan rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jog pa mdzad pa bka' drin che/ /bka' drin che ba'i bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul/ /ma dad log lta'i sdig pa bshags/ /rnam thar mchog la rjes yi rang / /da dung chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /lo brgyar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs zhabs pad brtan phyir bsngo/ /bla ma sku khams bzang zhing dwangs/ /mchog tu sku tshe ring par shog /bla ma'i sku bsod snyan grags rgyas/ /lhag par sku don 'grub par shog /bstan 'dzin bu slob thams cad kyang / /bstan 'gro'i don du zhabs brtan 214

shog /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'byor ba rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog /thams cad mjal na 'dod pa'i dus/ /yang yang mjal ba'i bkra shis shog /kun kyang skyid dga' longs spyod bzhin/ /chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces yig rten du tshe sgrub byas pa'i ril bu tshe sgu can gyi lha rdzas bcas phul ba'i lan du gsungs 'di 'dugatshe dang bsod nams gzi brjid dpag med mgon/ /tshe yi dngos grub char chen 'bebs pa nyid/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin skur bstan nas/ /tshe gcig gtan bder sbyor ba gang khyod rgyal/ /tshe 'dir gces pa'i rten 'di ring 'tsho'i phyir/ /tshe sgrub ril bu bcud len grub pa'i rdzas/ /tshe dpag med mgon phyag mtshan bum bzang gi /tshe chu'i rgyun dang gnyis med stsol bzhin du/ /tshe la bar chad med pa'i bden tshig gis/ /tshe ring lus bde skyid pa'i nyi gzhon rgyas/ /tshe 'dir bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub pa la/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rdo rje ltar/ /tshe chos 'khor nor 'phel bar gyur cig ces/ /tshe mda'i dar gyi g.yab mo dang bcas te/ /tshe g.yang dpal 'byor 'khor 'das stobs bcud kun/ /tshe lha rgya mtsho'i sku yi phyag rgya dang / /tshe bsnyen sngags phreng rang sgra sgog pa dang / /tshe bum phyag mtshan 215
