shog /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'byor ba rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog /thams cad mjal na 'dod pa'i dus/ /yang yang mjal ba'i bkra shis shog /kun kyang skyid dga' longs spyod bzhin/ /chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces yig rten du tshe sgrub byas pa'i ril bu tshe sgu can gyi lha rdzas bcas phul ba'i lan du gsungs 'di 'dugatshe dang bsod nams gzi brjid dpag med mgon/ /tshe yi dngos grub char chen 'bebs pa nyid/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin skur bstan nas/ /tshe gcig gtan bder sbyor ba gang khyod rgyal/ /tshe 'dir gces pa'i rten 'di ring 'tsho'i phyir/ /tshe sgrub ril bu bcud len grub pa'i rdzas/ /tshe dpag med mgon phyag mtshan bum bzang gi /tshe chu'i rgyun dang gnyis med stsol bzhin du/ /tshe la bar chad med pa'i bden tshig gis/ /tshe ring lus bde skyid pa'i nyi gzhon rgyas/ /tshe 'dir bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub pa la/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rdo rje ltar/ /tshe chos 'khor nor 'phel bar gyur cig ces/ /tshe mda'i dar gyi g.yab mo dang bcas te/ /tshe g.yang dpal 'byor 'khor 'das stobs bcud kun/ /tshe lha rgya mtsho'i sku yi phyag rgya dang / /tshe bsnyen sngags phreng rang sgra sgog pa dang / /tshe bum phyag mtshan 215

bdud rtsi'i bcud 'khyil ba/ /tshe ril myangs pas 'chi med dpal ster dang / /tshe chang btung bas g.yung drung tshe 'grub pa/ /tshe rdzas sprin chen gtibs 'dra'i char 'bebs pa'i tshe dmigs mdzad pa'i bden pa bslu med mthus/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsol mdzad mgon khyod dang / /tshe yi dngos grub stsol yul rnal 'byor nga / /tshe 'dir ltos bcas grwa slob yon bdag kun/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor mchog tu 'phel ba'i tshul/ /tshe ring lha klu'i dbang po dang mtshungs shing / /tshe gcig rdo rje'i srog la dbang 'byor pa/ /tshe dpag med dang skal ba mnyam par shog /tshe 'di'i snang zhen 'khrul ba'i rgya grol te/ /tshe lha'i zhing ltar dag mnyam gdal ba che/ /tshe dang yo byad mos sogs dbang bcur dbang / /tshe ring bde skyid 'phel 'dod gdul bya'i tshogs/ /tshe gcig grol ba'i nye lam gyis smin te/ /tshe dbang drang srong grub pa'i tshogs bzhin du/ /tshe la 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dpal thob shog /tshe srog 'gyur med ri rab ltar brtan cing / /tshe dpal gzi brjid nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'bar/ /tshe bcud dpal g.yang rgya mtsho che ltar 'khyil/ /tshe stobs 'byor pa nor bu'i gling ltar rgyas/ /tshe mtha' lcags ri mu khyud lta bur brtan/ /tshe ring bsam pa'i don kun yongs grub pa'i/ /tshe char 216

bdud rtsi'i bcud 'khyil ba/ /tshe ril myangs pas 'chi med dpal ster dang / /tshe chang btung bas g.yung drung tshe 'grub pa/ /tshe rdzas sprin chen gtibs 'dra'i char 'bebs pa'i tshe dmigs mdzad pa'i bden pa bslu med mthus/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsol mdzad mgon khyod dang / /tshe yi dngos grub stsol yul rnal 'byor nga / /tshe 'dir ltos bcas grwa slob yon bdag kun/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor mchog tu 'phel ba'i tshul/ /tshe ring lha klu'i dbang po dang mtshungs shing / /tshe gcig rdo rje'i srog la dbang 'byor pa/ /tshe dpag med dang skal ba mnyam par shog /tshe 'di'i snang zhen 'khrul ba'i rgya grol te/ /tshe lha'i zhing ltar dag mnyam gdal ba che/ /tshe dang yo byad mos sogs dbang bcur dbang / /tshe ring bde skyid 'phel 'dod gdul bya'i tshogs/ /tshe gcig grol ba'i nye lam gyis smin te/ /tshe dbang drang srong grub pa'i tshogs bzhin du/ /tshe la 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dpal thob shog /tshe srog 'gyur med ri rab ltar brtan cing / /tshe dpal gzi brjid nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'bar/ /tshe bcud dpal g.yang rgya mtsho che ltar 'khyil/ /tshe stobs 'byor pa nor bu'i gling ltar rgyas/ /tshe mtha' lcags ri mu khyud lta bur brtan/ /tshe ring bsam pa'i don kun yongs grub pa'i/ /tshe char 216

bkra shis dge legs rtag 'bab shog /ces dri med lha dar ring po mar zhig dang bcas gnang byung / yang de dus skyabs mgon gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi thugs sras byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang po khams rdo smad bla ma 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gyis/ ngo mtshar ba'i skyes kyi mchog tu legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'di gnang 'duganang gsal spros bral gzhon nu bum sku ru/ /gdod nas mngon byang chub kyang gdul bya'i ngor/ /lhun grub rtsal las ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/ /bsgyur mkhas phyag na pad+mo gnyis pa'i drung / /nyi ma'i kha chu 'thung ba'i pad+mo dag /zil mngar skyugs pa bung ba'i dga' ston bzhin/ /khyod thugs bdag pas gzhan gces goms pa'i 'bras/ /bshes bral bye ba'i bde skyid rol mtshor gyur/ /bla chen phal la 'byor ldan bu dang ni/ /chags ldan mdun sar mtshar sdug sgeg mo bzhin/ /'byor dang lang tshos ma bzung mgon med brgya/ /gang la ngo so mtho zhes ngo mtshar gtam/ /ke la sha ri'i mgul na gnas so cog /khyod la dad dang mi dad mgrin gcig tu/ /sgog pa'i grags dkar srid las brgal pa des/ /bdag yid dbang med phyogs der drangs pa ni/ /yid 'ong 'dzum pa'i rlabs kyis yongs bsus te/ /phebs 217

bkra shis dge legs rtag 'bab shog /ces dri med lha dar ring po mar zhig dang bcas gnang byung / yang de dus skyabs mgon gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi thugs sras byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang po khams rdo smad bla ma 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gyis/ ngo mtshar ba'i skyes kyi mchog tu legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'di gnang 'duganang gsal spros bral gzhon nu bum sku ru/ /gdod nas mngon byang chub kyang gdul bya'i ngor/ /lhun grub rtsal las ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/ /bsgyur mkhas phyag na pad+mo gnyis pa'i drung / /nyi ma'i kha chu 'thung ba'i pad+mo dag /zil mngar skyugs pa bung ba'i dga' ston bzhin/ /khyod thugs bdag pas gzhan gces goms pa'i 'bras/ /bshes bral bye ba'i bde skyid rol mtshor gyur/ /bla chen phal la 'byor ldan bu dang ni/ /chags ldan mdun sar mtshar sdug sgeg mo bzhin/ /'byor dang lang tshos ma bzung mgon med brgya/ /gang la ngo so mtho zhes ngo mtshar gtam/ /ke la sha ri'i mgul na gnas so cog /khyod la dad dang mi dad mgrin gcig tu/ /sgog pa'i grags dkar srid las brgal pa des/ /bdag yid dbang med phyogs der drangs pa ni/ /yid 'ong 'dzum pa'i rlabs kyis yongs bsus te/ /phebs 217

par smra ba'i gtam gyis brid pa bzhin/ /de lta na'ang ma 'dris bshes khyod zhal/ /ma mthong tshul 'di bsam gyin sems pa skyo/ /nub phyogs bde ldan zhing gi mgon po des/ /bsam bzhin mdzam gling 'di ru bsgyur ba'i gar/ /rnga yab gling pa sras bcas rgyal ba'i tshab/ /khyod las snyigs dus 'di na gzhan su zhig /smin byed dbang bzhi bskur thabs ngo sprod dang / /dkyus bshad gzhung chen 'grel ṭīka stong mthun dang / /snyan brgyud gdams ngag gnad yig dmar khrid dang / /phyag bzhes 'phrin sgrub bstan srung drag sngags bcas/ /bka' babs chu bo bzhi yi 'byung ba'i khungs/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i gdengs kha rim mdzes pa'i/ /mkhas mang klu dbang bye bas rol ba'i gnas/ /rnying bstan yan lag brgyad ldan 'o ma'i mtsho/ /mchog dman bar las ris bcad blo'i rtogs pas/ /shin tu rnyog par byas gang mgon khyod kyi/ /thugs bskyed nor bu mthon ga'i 'du byed kyis/ /kun nas kun tu dri ma dang bral mdzod/ /lus can kun dang khyad par byang phyogs 'dir/ /sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /pad+ma ka ra'i byen mthus mgon po khyod/ /rdo rje'i khri la kā ya u tiṣāḥ / /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas 'khor ba dug can mtshor/ /rang byas las kyi gzhan dbang gis byeng 218

par smra ba'i gtam gyis brid pa bzhin/ /de lta na'ang ma 'dris bshes khyod zhal/ /ma mthong tshul 'di bsam gyin sems pa skyo/ /nub phyogs bde ldan zhing gi mgon po des/ /bsam bzhin mdzam gling 'di ru bsgyur ba'i gar/ /rnga yab gling pa sras bcas rgyal ba'i tshab/ /khyod las snyigs dus 'di na gzhan su zhig /smin byed dbang bzhi bskur thabs ngo sprod dang / /dkyus bshad gzhung chen 'grel ṭīka stong mthun dang / /snyan brgyud gdams ngag gnad yig dmar khrid dang / /phyag bzhes 'phrin sgrub bstan srung drag sngags bcas/ /bka' babs chu bo bzhi yi 'byung ba'i khungs/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i gdengs kha rim mdzes pa'i/ /mkhas mang klu dbang bye bas rol ba'i gnas/ /rnying bstan yan lag brgyad ldan 'o ma'i mtsho/ /mchog dman bar las ris bcad blo'i rtogs pas/ /shin tu rnyog par byas gang mgon khyod kyi/ /thugs bskyed nor bu mthon ga'i 'du byed kyis/ /kun nas kun tu dri ma dang bral mdzod/ /lus can kun dang khyad par byang phyogs 'dir/ /sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /pad+ma ka ra'i byen mthus mgon po khyod/ /rdo rje'i khri la kā ya u tiṣāḥ / /nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas 'khor ba dug can mtshor/ /rang byas las kyi gzhan dbang gis byeng 218

bdag /rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i lus can gyi/ /sdug bsngal ma lus bdag la smin pa dang / /bsags dang gsog 'gyur bzang po'i legs byas 'bras/ /srid 'di'i dpal du smin pa kho na la/ /smon pa'i snying po bgyid de mi ring bar/ /bsam bzhin 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug g.yel med zhu/ /zhu mchid dbyangs su len pa ku hu'i mgrin/ /dri bral gos kyi gshog pa zung bskyod de/ /dam pa'i mdun sa ma la ya yi rir/ /dad pa'i 'khri shing gzhon nu'i rtse nas 'phur/ /zhes pa'i lan du 'di skad smras/gang gi 'phrin las zad pa med pa'i rgyun/ /'gro la rtag tu 'jug pa'i skabs phye ba/ /'jig rten kun gyi ma 'dris mdza' bshes mchog /shākya'i rgyal pos dus kun khyod la srungs/ /dam pa'i zhabs zung sin+tu wa ra'i 'dzum/ /spyi gtsug rgyan du thogs pa'i dge sbyong khyod/ /mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son te/ /thos don dben par sems pa dam pa'i srol/ /deng skabs 'di na bya bral rgan po bdag /bstan 'gror phan pa'i lhag bsam dkar mu nas/ /'gro phan cho gar snyad btags zang zing gi /zin med 'du 'god bya bas ci yang brel/ /'on kyang bdog pa'i dngos po byung ngo cog /dkon mchog mchod dang rten bzhengs dge 'dun sder/ /zhabs tog sbyin gtong dge rtsa gang bsgrub 219

bdag /rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i lus can gyi/ /sdug bsngal ma lus bdag la smin pa dang / /bsags dang gsog 'gyur bzang po'i legs byas 'bras/ /srid 'di'i dpal du smin pa kho na la/ /smon pa'i snying po bgyid de mi ring bar/ /bsam bzhin 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug g.yel med zhu/ /zhu mchid dbyangs su len pa ku hu'i mgrin/ /dri bral gos kyi gshog pa zung bskyod de/ /dam pa'i mdun sa ma la ya yi rir/ /dad pa'i 'khri shing gzhon nu'i rtse nas 'phur/ /zhes pa'i lan du 'di skad smras/gang gi 'phrin las zad pa med pa'i rgyun/ /'gro la rtag tu 'jug pa'i skabs phye ba/ /'jig rten kun gyi ma 'dris mdza' bshes mchog /shākya'i rgyal pos dus kun khyod la srungs/ /dam pa'i zhabs zung sin+tu wa ra'i 'dzum/ /spyi gtsug rgyan du thogs pa'i dge sbyong khyod/ /mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son te/ /thos don dben par sems pa dam pa'i srol/ /deng skabs 'di na bya bral rgan po bdag /bstan 'gror phan pa'i lhag bsam dkar mu nas/ /'gro phan cho gar snyad btags zang zing gi /zin med 'du 'god bya bas ci yang brel/ /'on kyang bdog pa'i dngos po byung ngo cog /dkon mchog mchod dang rten bzhengs dge 'dun sder/ /zhabs tog sbyin gtong dge rtsa gang bsgrub 219

tshogs/ /rdzogs byang bsngo ba kho bo'i gnas tshul lags/ /re 'ga' bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /g.ya' dang gangs khrod dben pa'i ri sul du/ /dka' ba khyad bsad bla ma'i gdams ngag rnams/ /rtse gcig sgom pa kho bo'i nyams len lags/ /khyod thugs byams brtse'i sprin gyi gdengs kha las/ /legs bshad chu yi khur gyi lcid ldan pa/ /spring yig nam mkha'i glang bo glal ba'i sgras/ /sems kyi mdongs mtha' rab dga'i gar gyis brel/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin gdang bu sbrel ba'i skas/ /rim gnyis spyod pa'i ba gam sgor btsugs par/ /'jegs nas gtan bde'i pho brang sum rtsen grong / /bgrod pa'i gom 'gros bde bar spyod lags sam/ /khyod kyi snyan grags ut+pal bdog pa'i skyes/ /gzur gnas skye bo'i ngag gi srad bu la/ /legs par brgyus pa'i do shal mtshar bo yis/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i mgrin pa yid 'ong byas/ /rgyal gsung dam chos sbrang rtsi mngar ba'i ro/ /thar pa'i srog zungs gso ba'i bcud len sman/ /mkha' khyab yongs la 'chad med spro dbyengs nas/ /'dir yang phebs tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin zhu/ /de lta'i zhu mchid skal bzang mig yangs ma/ /lha reg dar gyi stod g.yogs g.yo ba can/ /sdeb legs tshig gi lang tsho ngom bzhin du/ /khyod drung 'chi med dga' 220

tshogs/ /rdzogs byang bsngo ba kho bo'i gnas tshul lags/ /re 'ga' bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /g.ya' dang gangs khrod dben pa'i ri sul du/ /dka' ba khyad bsad bla ma'i gdams ngag rnams/ /rtse gcig sgom pa kho bo'i nyams len lags/ /khyod thugs byams brtse'i sprin gyi gdengs kha las/ /legs bshad chu yi khur gyi lcid ldan pa/ /spring yig nam mkha'i glang bo glal ba'i sgras/ /sems kyi mdongs mtha' rab dga'i gar gyis brel/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin gdang bu sbrel ba'i skas/ /rim gnyis spyod pa'i ba gam sgor btsugs par/ /'jegs nas gtan bde'i pho brang sum rtsen grong / /bgrod pa'i gom 'gros bde bar spyod lags sam/ /khyod kyi snyan grags ut+pal bdog pa'i skyes/ /gzur gnas skye bo'i ngag gi srad bu la/ /legs par brgyus pa'i do shal mtshar bo yis/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i mgrin pa yid 'ong byas/ /rgyal gsung dam chos sbrang rtsi mngar ba'i ro/ /thar pa'i srog zungs gso ba'i bcud len sman/ /mkha' khyab yongs la 'chad med spro dbyengs nas/ /'dir yang phebs tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin zhu/ /de lta'i zhu mchid skal bzang mig yangs ma/ /lha reg dar gyi stod g.yogs g.yo ba can/ /sdeb legs tshig gi lang tsho ngom bzhin du/ /khyod drung 'chi med dga' 220

ba'i tshal der thal/ /zhes yig rten stong min tsam du tshe ril lha rdzas bcas shog rgya brgyab nas/ khri ga'i jo bo'i dkor gnyer brgyud nas phul bas thugs mnyes pa byung /yang sngar mtshams zhus su song ba rnams 'tshams por lha sar slebs/ jo bo rnam gnyis la mjal mar me brgya mchod phul/ser 'bras dge gsum la mjal mang ja'i zhal 'debs byas/bkra shis lhun por song skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po cher mjal/ mtshams zhu phul dge 'dun yongs la mang ja btang phyag skor byas/ rgyal rtser song mda' dpon lcang lo can la mtshams zhu phul/ grub chen a ma la thug tu song phyir 'ong mda' dpon lcang lo can nas mthun rkyen 'tsho ba byen/ rgyal rtse'i phu'i ri khrod cig nas mtshams la bsdad nyams len byas/a zhang gis gnas mjal byas lho kha brgyud nas mar 'ongs/kun dgas dbus gtsang gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi 'byor lan rnams blangs nas/ mar 'ong mkhan gyi mgar rtse'i nu byis sngon la bskur/ stod phyogs kyi mtshams zhus yi ge rnams khyer nas slob ma yon bdag so sor sprad/ 'gro mgon sbyin pa nor bu rin po che la mjal mtshams zhu phul bas thugs shin tu mnyes/ khong gi slob ma sbyin pa btang gnyis gas stod phyogs kyi 221

ba'i tshal der thal/ /zhes yig rten stong min tsam du tshe ril lha rdzas bcas shog rgya brgyab nas/ khri ga'i jo bo'i dkor gnyer brgyud nas phul bas thugs mnyes pa byung /yang sngar mtshams zhus su song ba rnams 'tshams por lha sar slebs/ jo bo rnam gnyis la mjal mar me brgya mchod phul/ser 'bras dge gsum la mjal mang ja'i zhal 'debs byas/bkra shis lhun por song skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po cher mjal/ mtshams zhu phul dge 'dun yongs la mang ja btang phyag skor byas/ rgyal rtser song mda' dpon lcang lo can la mtshams zhu phul/ grub chen a ma la thug tu song phyir 'ong mda' dpon lcang lo can nas mthun rkyen 'tsho ba byen/ rgyal rtse'i phu'i ri khrod cig nas mtshams la bsdad nyams len byas/a zhang gis gnas mjal byas lho kha brgyud nas mar 'ongs/kun dgas dbus gtsang gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi 'byor lan rnams blangs nas/ mar 'ong mkhan gyi mgar rtse'i nu byis sngon la bskur/ stod phyogs kyi mtshams zhus yi ge rnams khyer nas slob ma yon bdag so sor sprad/ 'gro mgon sbyin pa nor bu rin po che la mjal mtshams zhu phul bas thugs shin tu mnyes/ khong gi slob ma sbyin pa btang gnyis gas stod phyogs kyi 221

'byor lan rnams khyer 'ong / bkra shis lhun po nas dngos po gang yod btsongs nas gser du bsgril gser srang bcu drug byung / paṇa chen rin potsho che la yar zhu shog phul ba'i nang ltar/gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi skyes phreng gsol 'debs ljags rtsom dang / bka' shog gsar ba 'byor lan gsung shog rten gsum srung mdud bdug spos chun po gsum bcas gnang ba de rnams khyer nas/ nga khyung dgon na gnas pa'i skabs der slebs nas/ 'byor lan yod tshad phul bas thams cad dga' ba byung /gser gyi nang nas srang bcu gnyis rnam thar gyi par 'phud rgyu'i snon pa byas/ gzhan gser g.yu byu ru 'jam dar rnams shar thams cad mkhyen pa sogs bla ma rnams la mjal rten phul ba lags/ de nas gnas der mtshams khang kha shas rgyag tu bcug rtsa rang a lags dang sman shul sprul sku sogs mtshams pa 'ga' sdod rgyu byas/ mang ja'i thebs su gser zho gang phul/yar gyi brag ngos la mang ra'i lha bzo ye shes dang dkar dris gnyis la sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra kha shas 'bri ru bcug bka' gdams mchod rten chung chung zhig rdo la brtsigs nas bzhengs/dgon pa'i dkyil nas dbyen bzlums mchod rten zhig bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul brgyab/ bka' 'gyur bar gyi lha khang 222

'byor lan rnams khyer 'ong / bkra shis lhun po nas dngos po gang yod btsongs nas gser du bsgril gser srang bcu drug byung / paṇa chen rin potsho che la yar zhu shog phul ba'i nang ltar/gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi skyes phreng gsol 'debs ljags rtsom dang / bka' shog gsar ba 'byor lan gsung shog rten gsum srung mdud bdug spos chun po gsum bcas gnang ba de rnams khyer nas/ nga khyung dgon na gnas pa'i skabs der slebs nas/ 'byor lan yod tshad phul bas thams cad dga' ba byung /gser gyi nang nas srang bcu gnyis rnam thar gyi par 'phud rgyu'i snon pa byas/ gzhan gser g.yu byu ru 'jam dar rnams shar thams cad mkhyen pa sogs bla ma rnams la mjal rten phul ba lags/ de nas gnas der mtshams khang kha shas rgyag tu bcug rtsa rang a lags dang sman shul sprul sku sogs mtshams pa 'ga' sdod rgyu byas/ mang ja'i thebs su gser zho gang phul/yar gyi brag ngos la mang ra'i lha bzo ye shes dang dkar dris gnyis la sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra kha shas 'bri ru bcug bka' gdams mchod rten chung chung zhig rdo la brtsigs nas bzhengs/dgon pa'i dkyil nas dbyen bzlums mchod rten zhig bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul brgyab/ bka' 'gyur bar gyi lha khang 222

dang / sku gzhogs shing bza' rin po che'i gzim khang la nyams gso thigs chags zla ba gcig tsam la byas/ sgrub mchod ltad mo tsho bltas nas da ni dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du 'gro snyam chas pas/ reb gong gi dad gus dag snang che ba'i bla ma dang sngags mang gis yi ge bskur nas bshol btab pa bzhin/dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis kyang 'gror ma bcug tshe/da yang phyir 'gro snyam chas pas phyag mdzod gsung rab sogs rgan las sne ba mang pos gzhung lam gyen du yar bskyal nas/ sa mgo mtho sa zhig nas sa la ngal gsos bsdad pas kun gyis mjal dar phul phyag dbang blangs/ phyag mdzod kyis khyed kyis sngar dgon pa la bka' drin che tshul dang / da dung yang yang yang phebs dgos tshul gyi gtam bshad pa tshar ba dang / ngas kun gye sems la phan pa'i lugs gnyis kyi snying gtam mang po smras/ 'gro khar skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam gye mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rang spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ /'ja' sna lnga'i gur khyim phub pa'i dbus/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sku gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro bzhin bzhugs/ /mgon khyod kyi thugs ga'i 'od zer 'phros/ /mi 'dir tshogs lus sems yongs la 223

dang / sku gzhogs shing bza' rin po che'i gzim khang la nyams gso thigs chags zla ba gcig tsam la byas/ sgrub mchod ltad mo tsho bltas nas da ni dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du 'gro snyam chas pas/ reb gong gi dad gus dag snang che ba'i bla ma dang sngags mang gis yi ge bskur nas bshol btab pa bzhin/dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis kyang 'gror ma bcug tshe/da yang phyir 'gro snyam chas pas phyag mdzod gsung rab sogs rgan las sne ba mang pos gzhung lam gyen du yar bskyal nas/ sa mgo mtho sa zhig nas sa la ngal gsos bsdad pas kun gyis mjal dar phul phyag dbang blangs/ phyag mdzod kyis khyed kyis sngar dgon pa la bka' drin che tshul dang / da dung yang yang yang phebs dgos tshul gyi gtam bshad pa tshar ba dang / ngas kun gye sems la phan pa'i lugs gnyis kyi snying gtam mang po smras/ 'gro khar skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam gye mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rang spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ /'ja' sna lnga'i gur khyim phub pa'i dbus/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sku gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro bzhin bzhugs/ /mgon khyod kyi thugs ga'i 'od zer 'phros/ /mi 'dir tshogs lus sems yongs la 223

zhugs/ /las sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun dag nas/ /nyams rtogs pa 'byung bar byin gyes rlobs/ /nged thams cad da lo phyogs gcig bsdad/ /da mi sdod so sor 'gro ba ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /chos byed na gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gnas shin tu dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /chos zab mo nyams su len nus na/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /da khyed rnams sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /nga mi sdod gzhan la 'khyams su 'gro/ /dus da lo yun ring 'dris stabs kyis/ /kun gyes khar 'bral glags mi phod par/ /sems 'phreng ba'i shugs kyis mchi ma shor/ /slar lan cig tsam yang ma mjal na/ /shi song rung zhe 'di 'phreng nyen gda'/ /don de phyir mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /tshe 'di ru gal te ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /kun mjal nas chos la spyod par smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces blangs pas kun la nges 'byung dang skyo shas skyes nas/ mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhin nga nam mthong gi bar du sa der bzhugs nas ma mthong ba dang khong rnams phyir phebs/ nga yar yong nas mi rtag sgyu ma'i rnam 'gyur bstan song ba'i rjes su phyag mdzod dang dbu mdzad 224

zhugs/ /las sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun dag nas/ /nyams rtogs pa 'byung bar byin gyes rlobs/ /nged thams cad da lo phyogs gcig bsdad/ /da mi sdod so sor 'gro ba ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /chos byed na gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gnas shin tu dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /chos zab mo nyams su len nus na/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /da khyed rnams sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /nga mi sdod gzhan la 'khyams su 'gro/ /dus da lo yun ring 'dris stabs kyis/ /kun gyes khar 'bral glags mi phod par/ /sems 'phreng ba'i shugs kyis mchi ma shor/ /slar lan cig tsam yang ma mjal na/ /shi song rung zhe 'di 'phreng nyen gda'/ /don de phyir mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /tshe 'di ru gal te ma mjal na/ /tshe phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /kun mjal nas chos la spyod par smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces blangs pas kun la nges 'byung dang skyo shas skyes nas/ mig nas mchi ma g.yo bzhin nga nam mthong gi bar du sa der bzhugs nas ma mthong ba dang khong rnams phyir phebs/ nga yar yong nas mi rtag sgyu ma'i rnam 'gyur bstan song ba'i rjes su phyag mdzod dang dbu mdzad 224

sogs phal che ba gshegs nas mjal rgyu ma byung / de nas nged dbon slob rnams mgar rtse ru nang brgyud nas mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rjer mjal du song / khong gis bsu ba ser phreng byas gzim khang nang nas mjal khong rang bzhugs pa'i khri khar bzhag 'tsho ba zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa byas/ de nas gser gyi ga'u la sogs pa'i phyag rten phul nas/ thog mar tshe dbang zhus nas gnang / de nas mdo rgyud rin po che'i bstan bcos rtsa 'grel gyi lung khrid zhus dgyes bzhin gnang / de nas zla ba phyed lhag tsam bsdad/ bka' drin gtang rag tu rta nor lug gsum kha shas phul ba ma bzhes par tshur la gnang / khong rang gis rta nor lug gsum gos phrug mang po phul nas/ khyed bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du bskal pa bye ba du ma'i bar bzhugs dgos tshul gyi zhabs brtan rgyas par phul/ ngas 'bul ba rnams blangs bsngo ba smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor dang / nang thams cad la bkra shis rgyas par brjod pas khong thugs dgyes pa byung /de nas khong gi ma yum dngos grub sgol mas nga nang du gdan drangs/ ja zhus byas rta nor lug gsum gyi nang nas kha shas phul nas 'pho lung zhus pas/ 'pho ba btab pas rtags bzang po 225

sogs phal che ba gshegs nas mjal rgyu ma byung / de nas nged dbon slob rnams mgar rtse ru nang brgyud nas mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rjer mjal du song / khong gis bsu ba ser phreng byas gzim khang nang nas mjal khong rang bzhugs pa'i khri khar bzhag 'tsho ba zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa byas/ de nas gser gyi ga'u la sogs pa'i phyag rten phul nas/ thog mar tshe dbang zhus nas gnang / de nas mdo rgyud rin po che'i bstan bcos rtsa 'grel gyi lung khrid zhus dgyes bzhin gnang / de nas zla ba phyed lhag tsam bsdad/ bka' drin gtang rag tu rta nor lug gsum kha shas phul ba ma bzhes par tshur la gnang / khong rang gis rta nor lug gsum gos phrug mang po phul nas/ khyed bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du bskal pa bye ba du ma'i bar bzhugs dgos tshul gyi zhabs brtan rgyas par phul/ ngas 'bul ba rnams blangs bsngo ba smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor dang / nang thams cad la bkra shis rgyas par brjod pas khong thugs dgyes pa byung /de nas khong gi ma yum dngos grub sgol mas nga nang du gdan drangs/ ja zhus byas rta nor lug gsum gyi nang nas kha shas phul nas 'pho lung zhus pas/ 'pho ba btab pas rtags bzang po 225

byung / de nas kha brda' 'dra byas pas mo na re/ khyed kyis sha ma bzhes par lo ci tsam song / da lta sha bzhes ki e yod zer ba'i lan drang por bshad pa'i rjes su rtse mtshar du glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bla dpon rnams kyis sha bzhes bzhin/ /bdag kyang zos tshul glu ru len/ /chos mdzad pho mo dga' bas nyon/ /nges 'byung brtan po'i thang ka ru/ /byang sems sbyin bdag stobs can gyis/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum 'khor g.yog pos/ /bdag 'dzin phung rgan g.yag rgod de/ /g.yo med zhi gnas thag pas bkyigs/ /shes rab ral gris srog rtsa bcad/ /chos brgyad phyi yi pags pa bshus/ /nang gi bsam ngan grod pu bton/ /lung rigs mtshon chas lhu ru bsil/ /de bzhin dug gsum ra lug phag /nyon mongs rnam rtog srog chags rnams/ /bsad nas dum bu mang po byas/ /mnyam bzhag khang ba yangs po ru/ /bde gsal mi rtog thab chen bzung / /mtha' bral chos dbyengs zangs chen btsugs/ /dmigs med snying rje chu yis bkang / /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs sha rnams 'phangs/ /rang byung rig pa'i khye'u yis/ /brtson 'grus sbud pa drag tu brgyab/ /ye shes lnga yi me chen sbar/ /226

byung / de nas kha brda' 'dra byas pas mo na re/ khyed kyis sha ma bzhes par lo ci tsam song / da lta sha bzhes ki e yod zer ba'i lan drang por bshad pa'i rjes su rtse mtshar du glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bla dpon rnams kyis sha bzhes bzhin/ /bdag kyang zos tshul glu ru len/ /chos mdzad pho mo dga' bas nyon/ /nges 'byung brtan po'i thang ka ru/ /byang sems sbyin bdag stobs can gyis/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum 'khor g.yog pos/ /bdag 'dzin phung rgan g.yag rgod de/ /g.yo med zhi gnas thag pas bkyigs/ /shes rab ral gris srog rtsa bcad/ /chos brgyad phyi yi pags pa bshus/ /nang gi bsam ngan grod pu bton/ /lung rigs mtshon chas lhu ru bsil/ /de bzhin dug gsum ra lug phag /nyon mongs rnam rtog srog chags rnams/ /bsad nas dum bu mang po byas/ /mnyam bzhag khang ba yangs po ru/ /bde gsal mi rtog thab chen bzung / /mtha' bral chos dbyengs zangs chen btsugs/ /dmigs med snying rje chu yis bkang / /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs sha rnams 'phangs/ /rang byung rig pa'i khye'u yis/ /brtson 'grus sbud pa drag tu brgyab/ /ye shes lnga yi me chen sbar/ /226

nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin par btsos/ /nyin re bzhin du rnal 'byor ngas/ /skye med chos sku'i zhal du bstabs/ /dmigs med pho ba'i nang du bstem/ /zag med bde bas gting nas myos/ /'bad med nyams rtogs lus stobs rgyas/ /phyi rabs chos mdzad pho mo rnams/ /pha ma'i sha la mi dga' bar/ /'di 'dra'i paṃ sa gsol nus na/ /e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang / /zhes blangs pas mo dga' zhing spro ba byung / de nas dag pa rab 'byams dang / 'jigs med la sogs pa'i shar tshang gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi phal che ba'i nang du song byen 'bebs bkra shis 'dra byas chos bshad pas/ rta nor lug gsum mang po phul skyabs 'jug zhus zhal gdams dgos zhes bskul ngor/grub mtha' gang la'ang phyogs ris byed mi nyan dag snang sbyong bzhin rang nyid gang mos chos la nyams len byed dgos tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas dang / /bstan 'dzin rgya bod mkhas grub yongs la 'dud/ /bstan pa'i snying po dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byen gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das sems su rdzogs pa'i rdzogs chen dang / /srid zhi'i spang blang bral ba'i phyag chen dang / /spros pa'i 227

nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin par btsos/ /nyin re bzhin du rnal 'byor ngas/ /skye med chos sku'i zhal du bstabs/ /dmigs med pho ba'i nang du bstem/ /zag med bde bas gting nas myos/ /'bad med nyams rtogs lus stobs rgyas/ /phyi rabs chos mdzad pho mo rnams/ /pha ma'i sha la mi dga' bar/ /'di 'dra'i paṃ sa gsol nus na/ /e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang / /zhes blangs pas mo dga' zhing spro ba byung / de nas dag pa rab 'byams dang / 'jigs med la sogs pa'i shar tshang gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi phal che ba'i nang du song byen 'bebs bkra shis 'dra byas chos bshad pas/ rta nor lug gsum mang po phul skyabs 'jug zhus zhal gdams dgos zhes bskul ngor/grub mtha' gang la'ang phyogs ris byed mi nyan dag snang sbyong bzhin rang nyid gang mos chos la nyams len byed dgos tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas dang / /bstan 'dzin rgya bod mkhas grub yongs la 'dud/ /bstan pa'i snying po dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byen gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das sems su rdzogs pa'i rdzogs chen dang / /srid zhi'i spang blang bral ba'i phyag chen dang / /spros pa'i 227

mtha' brgyad bral ba'i dbu ma ste/ /lta ba 'di gsum sngon nas bod 'dir grags/ /mi la'i thugs sras ras chung rdor grags kyis/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba phyogs ris med/ /phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba dgag sgrub med/ /dbu ma chen mo'i lta ba ngos bzung med/ /ces gsungs chos rje gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba'i phu thag khrus/ /phyag rgya chen bo'i lta ba'i ngo bo mthong / /dbu ma chen mo'i lta ba'i ngang du nyal/ /zhes gsungs paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/ /dbu rdzogs phyag gsum la sogs lta ba kun/ /mkhas pa nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab ces gsungs/ /de phyir bdag gis dbu rdzogs phyag gsum chos/ /dag snang sbyong bzhin gang nus nyams su blangs/ /phyi rabs rnams kyang dag snang sbyong bzhin du/ /gang la'ang nyams len byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces blangs pa kun gyi sems la 'bab po byung nas chos lugs gzhan la dag snang sbyong bzhin rang lugs rdzogs chen la nyams len byas pas 'chi khar lam sna zin pa mang po byung ngo / /de nas 'gro khar thag nye'i slob ma yon bdag yongs la rdo rje 'chang la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas byin rlabs byas/ nged thams cad da re 'dir 'dus nas so sor gyes pa 228

mtha' brgyad bral ba'i dbu ma ste/ /lta ba 'di gsum sngon nas bod 'dir grags/ /mi la'i thugs sras ras chung rdor grags kyis/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba phyogs ris med/ /phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba dgag sgrub med/ /dbu ma chen mo'i lta ba ngos bzung med/ /ces gsungs chos rje gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba'i phu thag khrus/ /phyag rgya chen bo'i lta ba'i ngo bo mthong / /dbu ma chen mo'i lta ba'i ngang du nyal/ /zhes gsungs paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/ /dbu rdzogs phyag gsum la sogs lta ba kun/ /mkhas pa nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab ces gsungs/ /de phyir bdag gis dbu rdzogs phyag gsum chos/ /dag snang sbyong bzhin gang nus nyams su blangs/ /phyi rabs rnams kyang dag snang sbyong bzhin du/ /gang la'ang nyams len byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces blangs pa kun gyi sems la 'bab po byung nas chos lugs gzhan la dag snang sbyong bzhin rang lugs rdzogs chen la nyams len byas pas 'chi khar lam sna zin pa mang po byung ngo / /de nas 'gro khar thag nye'i slob ma yon bdag yongs la rdo rje 'chang la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas byin rlabs byas/ nged thams cad da re 'dir 'dus nas so sor gyes pa 228

'di bzhin du/ chos thams cad mi rtag cing khyad par khyem tshang nang mi rnams kha rgan gzhon med par tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'di ltar 'gro bas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa soms la tshe phyi mar phan pa'i chos gyis zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs dpon slob yon mchod rnams/ /sus ma bsdus bzhin du gnas 'dir 'dus/ /da mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /kun tshe 'dir bsdad na 'dod mod kyang / /yun ring por mi sdod phyi mar 'gro/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'gro ba'i dus/ /chos ma gtogs gang gis phan pa med/ /da tshe 'dir sdod gshom ma mdzad par/ /tshe phyi mar 'gro grabs lha chos mdzod/ /chos byed na mang po shes mi dgos/ /sdig mi dge sgongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /chos kun gyi snying po ma ṇi thon/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa dkar po gyis/ /don de ltar mdzad pa'i mi rnams la/ /tshe 'di phyir skyid pa'i nyi ma 'char/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces blangs pas dad can 'ga' res sems skyo nas mchi ma gtong mkhan byung / de nas grub dbang rdzogs chen pa dpon 229

'di bzhin du/ chos thams cad mi rtag cing khyad par khyem tshang nang mi rnams kha rgan gzhon med par tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'di ltar 'gro bas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa soms la tshe phyi mar phan pa'i chos gyis zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'dir 'tshogs sgo gsum byen gyis rlobs/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs dpon slob yon mchod rnams/ /sus ma bsdus bzhin du gnas 'dir 'dus/ /da mi sdod so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /kun tshe 'dir bsdad na 'dod mod kyang / /yun ring por mi sdod phyi mar 'gro/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'gro ba'i dus/ /chos ma gtogs gang gis phan pa med/ /da tshe 'dir sdod gshom ma mdzad par/ /tshe phyi mar 'gro grabs lha chos mdzod/ /chos byed na mang po shes mi dgos/ /sdig mi dge sgongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /chos kun gyi snying po ma ṇi thon/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa dkar po gyis/ /don de ltar mdzad pa'i mi rnams la/ /tshe 'di phyir skyid pa'i nyi ma 'char/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces blangs pas dad can 'ga' res sems skyo nas mchi ma gtong mkhan byung / de nas grub dbang rdzogs chen pa dpon 229

slob mang pos skyel thung byas nga yar hor phyogs su yong / sku gzhogs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che hor sog gnyis ma 'grigs pa'i bar la gzu byed du phebs nas bzhugs yod pa'i drung du song / rta gos gser zho gang gi phyag rten phul nas mjal hor sog gi 'khrug pa zhi bar byas/ gzhan thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang / dzam dkar gyi rjes gnang mdzad pa'i gral du bsdad nas thob/ gsol ras su rta gcig dang / zhabs phyi tshor g.yag gsar gcig gnang / hor bon rgya sogs 'brog pa de na yod pa rnams kyis gdan drangs nas song / 'gro don byas pas rta nor lug gsum mar phyur mang po ster mkhan byung /de nas dben gnas rdzong dmar du 'ong lha khang gcig dang /mtshams khang gnyis kyang brgyab mtshams pa gnyis bzhagashing bzo gnyis la mdzo gcig rkyal mar che chung bzhi tsam gyi 'gro dgos btang / de nas slar reb gong gser mo ljongs 'dir yong mkhar gong grub gnas la mtshams khang brgyab/ a mgron sprul sku mtshams la bzhag de nas rong bo'i dgon chen du 'ong / dgon pa la mang ja btang / phyur ba do bo bcu rkyal mar che chung bcu gsum bgos nas phul bas grwa rkyang tsho dga' bar gyur/ shar thams cad mkhyen pa la rta gcig gser zho 230

slob mang pos skyel thung byas nga yar hor phyogs su yong / sku gzhogs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che hor sog gnyis ma 'grigs pa'i bar la gzu byed du phebs nas bzhugs yod pa'i drung du song / rta gos gser zho gang gi phyag rten phul nas mjal hor sog gi 'khrug pa zhi bar byas/ gzhan thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang / dzam dkar gyi rjes gnang mdzad pa'i gral du bsdad nas thob/ gsol ras su rta gcig dang / zhabs phyi tshor g.yag gsar gcig gnang / hor bon rgya sogs 'brog pa de na yod pa rnams kyis gdan drangs nas song / 'gro don byas pas rta nor lug gsum mar phyur mang po ster mkhan byung /de nas dben gnas rdzong dmar du 'ong lha khang gcig dang /mtshams khang gnyis kyang brgyab mtshams pa gnyis bzhagashing bzo gnyis la mdzo gcig rkyal mar che chung bzhi tsam gyi 'gro dgos btang / de nas slar reb gong gser mo ljongs 'dir yong mkhar gong grub gnas la mtshams khang brgyab/ a mgron sprul sku mtshams la bzhag de nas rong bo'i dgon chen du 'ong / dgon pa la mang ja btang / phyur ba do bo bcu rkyal mar che chung bcu gsum bgos nas phul bas grwa rkyang tsho dga' bar gyur/ shar thams cad mkhyen pa la rta gcig gser zho 230

gsum gye phyag rten phul nas mjal chos 'brel zhus zhag po bdun bsdad/ 'gro khar rta gos sogs gsol ras mang po gnang nas/ khyod thabs mkhas pas reb gong gi 'khrug pa la thabs du ma'i sgo nas phan thogs re gyis gsungs/ tshur lam gnyan thog dang skyi gnyis 'thab rtsod byas mi mang po bsad pa'i bar du song / kha ngo chos 'brel btsong gzu bshad sku tshab bzhag nas rim gyes 'grigs su bcug bcu gcig pa'i nang la dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil bar yong nas re zhig ngal gsos nas bsdad yod dus/ thag nye'i slob ma yon bdag tshos go nas lo kha shas ma mjal ba'i stabs kyis mang po mjal du 'ongs nas/ mjal tshe thams cad sems dga' nas yun ring por bsdad dus/ 'o de ring tsho sos dal gi ngas khyed tshor phyogs gzhan gyi skad cha bshad la gang dga' dga' bya/ chos na yang /bsam pa bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro/ /bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang / /gsungs/ 'jig rten pa 'ga' res kyang / sems ngan ma ṇi 'don pa las/ /sems bzang skad cha bshad na dga'/ zer ba yang 'dug des na mi dga' ba chos yin pas/ ngas skad cha bshad pa la chos nyan pa bzhin kun gyis nyon/ sngon sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje bla ma gser gling pa la 231

gsum gye phyag rten phul nas mjal chos 'brel zhus zhag po bdun bsdad/ 'gro khar rta gos sogs gsol ras mang po gnang nas/ khyod thabs mkhas pas reb gong gi 'khrug pa la thabs du ma'i sgo nas phan thogs re gyis gsungs/ tshur lam gnyan thog dang skyi gnyis 'thab rtsod byas mi mang po bsad pa'i bar du song / kha ngo chos 'brel btsong gzu bshad sku tshab bzhag nas rim gyes 'grigs su bcug bcu gcig pa'i nang la dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil bar yong nas re zhig ngal gsos nas bsdad yod dus/ thag nye'i slob ma yon bdag tshos go nas lo kha shas ma mjal ba'i stabs kyis mang po mjal du 'ongs nas/ mjal tshe thams cad sems dga' nas yun ring por bsdad dus/ 'o de ring tsho sos dal gi ngas khyed tshor phyogs gzhan gyi skad cha bshad la gang dga' dga' bya/ chos na yang /bsam pa bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro/ /bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang / /gsungs/ 'jig rten pa 'ga' res kyang / sems ngan ma ṇi 'don pa las/ /sems bzang skad cha bshad na dga'/ zer ba yang 'dug des na mi dga' ba chos yin pas/ ngas skad cha bshad pa la chos nyan pa bzhin kun gyis nyon/ sngon sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje bla ma gser gling pa la 231

mjal du rgya mtshor gru btang nas song dus/ gling bar zhig na gser sku chen po zhig 'dug de'i 'og tu mi gcig gis zan cig za yun tsam la 'gro rgyu 'dug gsungs/ yang thag ring nas chu srin nya'i rigs can ri rgyud tsam zhig mthong / de yang khyur mid rgyag pa'i nya chen po rgya mtsho'i gting na yod gsungs/ rgya gar gyi a tsa ra zhig na re/ kha che'i phyogs kyi sa thag ring po zhig na/ ri chen po zhig la nyin mtshan med par me 'bar ba zhig gda'/ me'i 'od kyis mtshan mo nyi ma gsum re'i bar la mun pa med par nyin par 'dra ba 'dug de'i nang du phyi rol pas sbyin sreg gi rdzas 'debs shing nang pas phyag mchod skor ba byed pa zhig gda' zer/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho dang chu bo gaṅgā gnyis 'dres mtshams la rgya gar shar phyogs kyi tshong pa chu bo gaṅgā brgyud nas song ba dang / rgya mtsho'i nang gi tshong pa gnyis 'dus nas tshong byed dus/ rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa'i chu mi dang chu rta chu lug rnams mthong ba byung zer/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi ka la ka ta bya ba'i grong khyer chen po gcig na mi tshang 'bum phrag sum cu so bzhi 'dug zer/ grong khyer de'i ge shang la ltad mo blta na shar sgo nas nub sgo'i bar du nyi ma lnga 'gro dgos zer/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgyal po gcig gi pho brang gi mkhar 232

mjal du rgya mtshor gru btang nas song dus/ gling bar zhig na gser sku chen po zhig 'dug de'i 'og tu mi gcig gis zan cig za yun tsam la 'gro rgyu 'dug gsungs/ yang thag ring nas chu srin nya'i rigs can ri rgyud tsam zhig mthong / de yang khyur mid rgyag pa'i nya chen po rgya mtsho'i gting na yod gsungs/ rgya gar gyi a tsa ra zhig na re/ kha che'i phyogs kyi sa thag ring po zhig na/ ri chen po zhig la nyin mtshan med par me 'bar ba zhig gda'/ me'i 'od kyis mtshan mo nyi ma gsum re'i bar la mun pa med par nyin par 'dra ba 'dug de'i nang du phyi rol pas sbyin sreg gi rdzas 'debs shing nang pas phyag mchod skor ba byed pa zhig gda' zer/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho dang chu bo gaṅgā gnyis 'dres mtshams la rgya gar shar phyogs kyi tshong pa chu bo gaṅgā brgyud nas song ba dang / rgya mtsho'i nang gi tshong pa gnyis 'dus nas tshong byed dus/ rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa'i chu mi dang chu rta chu lug rnams mthong ba byung zer/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi ka la ka ta bya ba'i grong khyer chen po gcig na mi tshang 'bum phrag sum cu so bzhi 'dug zer/ grong khyer de'i ge shang la ltad mo blta na shar sgo nas nub sgo'i bar du nyi ma lnga 'gro dgos zer/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgyal po gcig gi pho brang gi mkhar 232

sgo la nya chen po zhig gi mig gi rus pa zhig brgyab 'dug pa'i nang du glang po che la mi zhon nas song na yang / yangs shol le 'gro chog pa zhig 'dug zer/ sngon grub thob thang stong rgyal po rgya gar du phebs dus/ rgya gar zangs gling na/ mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ byang chub shing gi srog shing can/ bang rim bzhi la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dang / bum pa yan la bla ma sku bzhi'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa blta bas chog mi shes pa byin rlabs zhus pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma 'char ba sangs rgyas kyis rab gnas mdzad pa zhig 'dug zer/ yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi lha sa'i po ta la'i pho brang dmar po dgu thog yod pa'i bar gye thog tshad gnyis kyi nang na/ phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sku gdung mchod rten 'dzam gling rgyan gcig ces pa rin chen gser srang bye ba zhig las grub pa/ rin po che sna lnga sna bdun sna tshogs pa'i phra yis brgyan pa/ nang rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa byen rlabs kyi phung po chen po yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag pa zhig bzhugs snang / gzhan yang bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar dus su gdan sa mthil kho na la yang mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gser zangs las grub pa/ steng na lha tshogs nyis stong dgu 233

sgo la nya chen po zhig gi mig gi rus pa zhig brgyab 'dug pa'i nang du glang po che la mi zhon nas song na yang / yangs shol le 'gro chog pa zhig 'dug zer/ sngon grub thob thang stong rgyal po rgya gar du phebs dus/ rgya gar zangs gling na/ mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ byang chub shing gi srog shing can/ bang rim bzhi la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dang / bum pa yan la bla ma sku bzhi'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa blta bas chog mi shes pa byin rlabs zhus pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma 'char ba sangs rgyas kyis rab gnas mdzad pa zhig 'dug zer/ yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi lha sa'i po ta la'i pho brang dmar po dgu thog yod pa'i bar gye thog tshad gnyis kyi nang na/ phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sku gdung mchod rten 'dzam gling rgyan gcig ces pa rin chen gser srang bye ba zhig las grub pa/ rin po che sna lnga sna bdun sna tshogs pa'i phra yis brgyan pa/ nang rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa byen rlabs kyi phung po chen po yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag pa zhig bzhugs snang / gzhan yang bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar dus su gdan sa mthil kho na la yang mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gser zangs las grub pa/ steng na lha tshogs nyis stong dgu 233

brgya can dang nyis stong brgyad brgya can dang / nyis stong bzhi brgya can gye mchod rten chen po brgyad tsam la dus da lta yang mjal rgyu yod par gda'/ yang rgya nag gi 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i gser mkhar gyi byang phyogs rgya mtsho'i kha la thag nye ba'i tshong pa phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling du tshong la song ba rlung log gis khyer nas/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi thag nyer slebs tshe/ byang sgra mi snyan gye mi rnams gzugs che ba ngo gru bzhi ba de mthong ba dang tshong pa tshor dgod shor/ byang sgra mi snyan pa'i skye pho mo rnams kyis tshong pa rnams gzugs chung ba ngo nar mo de mthong ba dang yun ring bltas nas dgod shor/ zhes mthun pa'i rlung dang 'grogs nas phyir 'ong ba'i tshong dpon tshos bshad nas dgod par gda' zer/ byang phyogs de na u ru su zer ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang chen po zhig yod pa'i thag nye'i rgya mtsho'i kha na shing gi gru chen po rgya mkhar chung chung tsam zhig gi steng 'og gnyis na 'khor lo chen po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa re gda'/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling tsho tshong sogs la 'gro dgos byung tshe/ 'og gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du khro yi ho ban du rdo sol spungs me sbar tshe me'i ngar gyes steng 'og gi 'khor lo gnyis 'khor nas nyi ma mang po'i lam nyin re la bcad nas/ byang phyogs sham+bha la'i yul 234

brgya can dang nyis stong brgyad brgya can dang / nyis stong bzhi brgya can gye mchod rten chen po brgyad tsam la dus da lta yang mjal rgyu yod par gda'/ yang rgya nag gi 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i gser mkhar gyi byang phyogs rgya mtsho'i kha la thag nye ba'i tshong pa phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling du tshong la song ba rlung log gis khyer nas/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi thag nyer slebs tshe/ byang sgra mi snyan gye mi rnams gzugs che ba ngo gru bzhi ba de mthong ba dang tshong pa tshor dgod shor/ byang sgra mi snyan pa'i skye pho mo rnams kyis tshong pa rnams gzugs chung ba ngo nar mo de mthong ba dang yun ring bltas nas dgod shor/ zhes mthun pa'i rlung dang 'grogs nas phyir 'ong ba'i tshong dpon tshos bshad nas dgod par gda' zer/ byang phyogs de na u ru su zer ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang chen po zhig yod pa'i thag nye'i rgya mtsho'i kha na shing gi gru chen po rgya mkhar chung chung tsam zhig gi steng 'og gnyis na 'khor lo chen po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa re gda'/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling tsho tshong sogs la 'gro dgos byung tshe/ 'og gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du khro yi ho ban du rdo sol spungs me sbar tshe me'i ngar gyes steng 'og gi 'khor lo gnyis 'khor nas nyi ma mang po'i lam nyin re la bcad nas/ byang phyogs sham+bha la'i yul 234

gyi gangs ri tsho mthong ba yang gda' zer/ yang u ru su'i rgyal po'i drung na/ phyogs gzhan mthong ba'i rgyangs shel cig 'dug zer/ de la blta na thog mar shel gyi cog rtse che po zhig bzhagade'i thog tu shel gyi ka to ra chen po gcig bzhag de'i nang du shel gong dwangs pa mi zhig gi mgo tsam zhig bzhag de nas lta mkhan gyi mi de 'ongs nas yar langs lag pa gnyis sked pa brgyab gru mo gnyis brgyangs nas mig mi 'dzum par bltas pas/thog mar thag nye'i yul phyogs mthong / de nas yun ring bltas na/ nged tsho'i mtsho sngon po'i tshwa mtsho dkar mo tsho mthong nas bshad par gda' zer/ yul khams gzhan tsho 'khrug pa chen po yod na de'i nang du bltas na mthong ba yin skad/ yang gong ma'i pho brang la thag nye sa zhig na rgya dpon byang chub sems dpa' zhig yod pa des gong ma la khral yag po byas phul/ lo ma shing pa'i dus be sang tshor gro nas kyi bskyi bsu byas/ ngan slong la ja thug gi sbyin pa btang nas gsos pa'i gtam snyan gong ma rin po ches go nas mdun du bos/ na bza' ser po pad+ma rā ga'i tog rma bya'i sgro mdongs mig mang po can dang / gzhan yang bdag rkyen chen po gnang nas gzhan dpon po tog can mang po mdun du bos nas/ khyed rnams kyis mi 'di bzhin be+e sang tsho 235

gyi gangs ri tsho mthong ba yang gda' zer/ yang u ru su'i rgyal po'i drung na/ phyogs gzhan mthong ba'i rgyangs shel cig 'dug zer/ de la blta na thog mar shel gyi cog rtse che po zhig bzhagade'i thog tu shel gyi ka to ra chen po gcig bzhag de'i nang du shel gong dwangs pa mi zhig gi mgo tsam zhig bzhag de nas lta mkhan gyi mi de 'ongs nas yar langs lag pa gnyis sked pa brgyab gru mo gnyis brgyangs nas mig mi 'dzum par bltas pas/thog mar thag nye'i yul phyogs mthong / de nas yun ring bltas na/ nged tsho'i mtsho sngon po'i tshwa mtsho dkar mo tsho mthong nas bshad par gda' zer/ yul khams gzhan tsho 'khrug pa chen po yod na de'i nang du bltas na mthong ba yin skad/ yang gong ma'i pho brang la thag nye sa zhig na rgya dpon byang chub sems dpa' zhig yod pa des gong ma la khral yag po byas phul/ lo ma shing pa'i dus be sang tshor gro nas kyi bskyi bsu byas/ ngan slong la ja thug gi sbyin pa btang nas gsos pa'i gtam snyan gong ma rin po ches go nas mdun du bos/ na bza' ser po pad+ma rā ga'i tog rma bya'i sgro mdongs mig mang po can dang / gzhan yang bdag rkyen chen po gnang nas gzhan dpon po tog can mang po mdun du bos nas/ khyed rnams kyis mi 'di bzhin be+e sang tsho 235

byams skyong mdzod/ deng phyin chad bdag rkyen yod ces gsung byon skad/ yang smad sog phyogs shig na sog po phyug po gcig la rta stong phrag dgu dang dgu brgya yod/ da brgya yod na khri tsho gcig longs pa'i tshod la kho rang na nas 'chi khar bu rnams la nga la chos gzhan bca' mi dgos/ rta khri tsho gcig la phud la 'tshos dang des chog ces kha chems bzhag nas shi song bas bu rnams kyis rta brgya khar bsnan nas khri tsho gcig tsam long tshe glo bur du rta'i nang du nad cig byung shi ste stong phrag gcig la thug song tshe/ 'ga' res rgyu mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra zer ba de bden par gda' zer/ yang zi zhi'i mkhar mo che zer ba'i mkhar chen po sgo dgu yod pa nam langs nas sa sribs kyi bar du mi'i rgyu 'grul la 'chad rgyu med pa/ nyin re mi shi ba'i ro brgya re mkhar gyi phyi rol tu 'khyer ba mthong zhing / tshur brgya lhag re skyes pa yin skad/ sprang por sbyin pa gtong ba tshos dngul srang brgya re'i dong tse nyos nas btang na re re tsam las mi them par gda' zer sprang po kho na de tsam yod na/ gzhan mi mang pa smos ci dgos/ mi de tsam mang rung nang na chos byed mkhan shin tu nyung bar gda' zer/ yang rgya nag phyogs gyi mkhar zhig gi nang logs kyi bar snang na lcags kyi phyag na rdo rje zhig brten med 236

byams skyong mdzod/ deng phyin chad bdag rkyen yod ces gsung byon skad/ yang smad sog phyogs shig na sog po phyug po gcig la rta stong phrag dgu dang dgu brgya yod/ da brgya yod na khri tsho gcig longs pa'i tshod la kho rang na nas 'chi khar bu rnams la nga la chos gzhan bca' mi dgos/ rta khri tsho gcig la phud la 'tshos dang des chog ces kha chems bzhag nas shi song bas bu rnams kyis rta brgya khar bsnan nas khri tsho gcig tsam long tshe glo bur du rta'i nang du nad cig byung shi ste stong phrag gcig la thug song tshe/ 'ga' res rgyu mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra zer ba de bden par gda' zer/ yang zi zhi'i mkhar mo che zer ba'i mkhar chen po sgo dgu yod pa nam langs nas sa sribs kyi bar du mi'i rgyu 'grul la 'chad rgyu med pa/ nyin re mi shi ba'i ro brgya re mkhar gyi phyi rol tu 'khyer ba mthong zhing / tshur brgya lhag re skyes pa yin skad/ sprang por sbyin pa gtong ba tshos dngul srang brgya re'i dong tse nyos nas btang na re re tsam las mi them par gda' zer sprang po kho na de tsam yod na/ gzhan mi mang pa smos ci dgos/ mi de tsam mang rung nang na chos byed mkhan shin tu nyung bar gda' zer/ yang rgya nag phyogs gyi mkhar zhig gi nang logs kyi bar snang na lcags kyi phyag na rdo rje zhig brten med 236

par 'dug pa ci yin dris na/ mkhar de'i phar ka tshur ka na rdo khab len yod pa red zer/ yang rgya nag gi phyogs kyi nags shig na spang bu chung zer ba shing gi nang nas skyes pa'i mi khru gang tsam gyis lung ba gang ba la/ bod phyogs nas bya 'ol ba yong nas za ba la kun phyogs gcig tu dpung bsgril te mda' 'phen pa sogs yod zer/ lang gru sde bzhi'i phyogs kyi mi tshang phyug po gcig la rta stong dang lnga brgya/ nor dkar po stong phrag bzhi lug khre tsho gcig dang stong phrag brgyad/ de'i tshod kyi nang rdzas nom pa yod pa zhig de mgo log dang ring ngan gyi jag pas brgyab nas/ sgo'i rgyu khyem gye nor rdzas rnams khyer nas nyin gcig la sprang por btang tshe/ khyim bdag gis zi ling a 'ban la gtugs pas/ a 'ban gyis de tsam zhig yod na de'i sngon du chos re bco mod/ da ma bzang spyang ki'i kha nang du lug gu shor ni 'dra ba red/ bsad gtong na ma gtogs phyir yong rgyu yod ni ma red/ gong ma rin po che la zhus nas dmag 'phud ces gsungs skad/ des na rgyu nom pa 'dzom dus chos bca' dgos par gda'/ zhes bshad pas der 'tshogs pa thams cad ngo mtshar sems spro go rgyu chen po byung nas/ chos phyogs tshor je dga' song kun gyi sems la phan thogs byung ngo / /237

par 'dug pa ci yin dris na/ mkhar de'i phar ka tshur ka na rdo khab len yod pa red zer/ yang rgya nag gi phyogs kyi nags shig na spang bu chung zer ba shing gi nang nas skyes pa'i mi khru gang tsam gyis lung ba gang ba la/ bod phyogs nas bya 'ol ba yong nas za ba la kun phyogs gcig tu dpung bsgril te mda' 'phen pa sogs yod zer/ lang gru sde bzhi'i phyogs kyi mi tshang phyug po gcig la rta stong dang lnga brgya/ nor dkar po stong phrag bzhi lug khre tsho gcig dang stong phrag brgyad/ de'i tshod kyi nang rdzas nom pa yod pa zhig de mgo log dang ring ngan gyi jag pas brgyab nas/ sgo'i rgyu khyem gye nor rdzas rnams khyer nas nyin gcig la sprang por btang tshe/ khyim bdag gis zi ling a 'ban la gtugs pas/ a 'ban gyis de tsam zhig yod na de'i sngon du chos re bco mod/ da ma bzang spyang ki'i kha nang du lug gu shor ni 'dra ba red/ bsad gtong na ma gtogs phyir yong rgyu yod ni ma red/ gong ma rin po che la zhus nas dmag 'phud ces gsungs skad/ des na rgyu nom pa 'dzom dus chos bca' dgos par gda'/ zhes bshad pas der 'tshogs pa thams cad ngo mtshar sems spro go rgyu chen po byung nas/ chos phyogs tshor je dga' song kun gyi sems la phan thogs byung ngo / /237

yang nyin cig blo ldan slob bu sangs rgyas rin chen gyis skyabs mgon rin po che khyed kyi rnam thar mgo na sku gsum gyi mchod brjod mdzad pa gang gi lugs ltar mdzad lags zer ba la/ 'o rgyal ba thams cad sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can yin pas/ gang ltar brjod kyang 'gal ba med/ ngas 'di sngon rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ nya ma dpal dar 'bum gyis khyed chos pa rnams kyi rgyud pa'i lo rgyus bshad pas/ bu slob rnams yid ches pa dang snang ba 'gyur ba'i gdams ngag bya ba yod zer ba khyed kyis rgyud pa de gsungs dang zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis bu mo de las can gyi slob mar dgongs nas rgyud pa'i thug tshul 'di mgur du gsungs so/ /chos sku kun la khyab pa'i kun tu bzang po dang gcig /longs sku mtshan dpes spras pa rdo rje 'chang chen dang gnyis/ /sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa'i shākya thub pa dang gsum/ /rgyud pa de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags de/ /rgyud pa de gsum la dad pa'i nya ma 'dra yod dam/ /gsungs pas/ rgyud pa ngo mtshar che bar gda'/ dpe chu mgo gangs la thug pa lta bu zhig 'dug ces zhus pa ltar bshad pa lags smras pas/ yang kho na re/ chu mgo gangs la thug pa lta bu'i rgyud pa'i phugs kyi thug sa de gsum la gsol 'debs 238

yang nyin cig blo ldan slob bu sangs rgyas rin chen gyis skyabs mgon rin po che khyed kyi rnam thar mgo na sku gsum gyi mchod brjod mdzad pa gang gi lugs ltar mdzad lags zer ba la/ 'o rgyal ba thams cad sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can yin pas/ gang ltar brjod kyang 'gal ba med/ ngas 'di sngon rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ nya ma dpal dar 'bum gyis khyed chos pa rnams kyi rgyud pa'i lo rgyus bshad pas/ bu slob rnams yid ches pa dang snang ba 'gyur ba'i gdams ngag bya ba yod zer ba khyed kyis rgyud pa de gsungs dang zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis bu mo de las can gyi slob mar dgongs nas rgyud pa'i thug tshul 'di mgur du gsungs so/ /chos sku kun la khyab pa'i kun tu bzang po dang gcig /longs sku mtshan dpes spras pa rdo rje 'chang chen dang gnyis/ /sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa'i shākya thub pa dang gsum/ /rgyud pa de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags de/ /rgyud pa de gsum la dad pa'i nya ma 'dra yod dam/ /gsungs pas/ rgyud pa ngo mtshar che bar gda'/ dpe chu mgo gangs la thug pa lta bu zhig 'dug ces zhus pa ltar bshad pa lags smras pas/ yang kho na re/ chu mgo gangs la thug pa lta bu'i rgyud pa'i phugs kyi thug sa de gsum la gsol 'debs 238

shig dgos zhes zer ba la/dri med nam mkha' lta bur rnam dag cing / /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha/ /thog ma'i sangs rgyas srid zhi yongs kyi dpal/ /chos sku kun tu bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gsal thugs kyi klong ni mkha' ltar yangs/ /'khor 'das chos rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /so sor ma 'dres sa ler gzigs pa yi/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor 'das chos rnams lag mthil skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag nas bltas ltar sa ler mkhyen/ /zhal nas nam yang rdzun gyi tshig mi gsung / /sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /blo gros snang ba phyogs med rab rgyas nas/ /shes bya'i chos rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /thams cad sa ler shes par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba thobs dang / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i gnas lugs thams cad sa ler shes par 'gyur ro byas pas/ thugs rje che zer/ yang kho na re/ bstan pa'i bdag po o rgyan rin po che dang / mnyam med jo bo rje/ rje bdag nyid chen po rnams thugs rgyud gcig tshul gyi lung bstan gsal bo gang na yod lags zer/ 'o rgyal ba thams cad thugs chos sku'i dbyengs su ro gcig yin pas gang dang 239

shig dgos zhes zer ba la/dri med nam mkha' lta bur rnam dag cing / /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha/ /thog ma'i sangs rgyas srid zhi yongs kyi dpal/ /chos sku kun tu bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gsal thugs kyi klong ni mkha' ltar yangs/ /'khor 'das chos rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /so sor ma 'dres sa ler gzigs pa yi/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor 'das chos rnams lag mthil skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag nas bltas ltar sa ler mkhyen/ /zhal nas nam yang rdzun gyi tshig mi gsung / /sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /blo gros snang ba phyogs med rab rgyas nas/ /shes bya'i chos rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /thams cad sa ler shes par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba thobs dang / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i gnas lugs thams cad sa ler shes par 'gyur ro byas pas/ thugs rje che zer/ yang kho na re/ bstan pa'i bdag po o rgyan rin po che dang / mnyam med jo bo rje/ rje bdag nyid chen po rnams thugs rgyud gcig tshul gyi lung bstan gsal bo gang na yod lags zer/ 'o rgyal ba thams cad thugs chos sku'i dbyengs su ro gcig yin pas gang dang 239

gang gi sprul pa yin zhes kyang chog khyad par dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi sprul pa slob dpon rin po che dang /jo bo rje/ rje bdag nyid chen po rnams thugs rgyud gcig tshul ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ bla ma dri ma med pas/ rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs la gsungs pa/ 'di nas skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du thugs rje bzung / /bod ni rgyal po dag la mtshan mar 'dzin/ /mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar skyongs/ /o rgyan yul du ji skad smras pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang gnas der lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa de o rgyan rin po che dang / sprul pa gcig ni rgya gar gnas la 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa de jo bo rje dang / sprul pa gcig ni bal bo'i mthil du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa de paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma badz+ra dang / sprul pa gcig ni mdo khams smad du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa de rje bdag nyid chen po yin par lung bstan/ des na dad gus dag snang skye thabs shig la o rgyan rin po che dang /jo bo rje/ rje rin po che rnams thugs rgyud gcig pa 'di kho nas chog par gda'/ de bzhin du paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ grub dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /rnam 'phru' dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /yang sprul blo bzang grags pa'i 240

gang gi sprul pa yin zhes kyang chog khyad par dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi sprul pa slob dpon rin po che dang /jo bo rje/ rje bdag nyid chen po rnams thugs rgyud gcig tshul ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ bla ma dri ma med pas/ rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs la gsungs pa/ 'di nas skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du thugs rje bzung / /bod ni rgyal po dag la mtshan mar 'dzin/ /mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar skyongs/ /o rgyan yul du ji skad smras pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang gnas der lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa de o rgyan rin po che dang / sprul pa gcig ni rgya gar gnas la 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa de jo bo rje dang / sprul pa gcig ni bal bo'i mthil du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa de paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma badz+ra dang / sprul pa gcig ni mdo khams smad du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa de rje bdag nyid chen po yin par lung bstan/ des na dad gus dag snang skye thabs shig la o rgyan rin po che dang /jo bo rje/ rje rin po che rnams thugs rgyud gcig pa 'di kho nas chog par gda'/ de bzhin du paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ grub dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /rnam 'phru' dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /yang sprul blo bzang grags pa'i 240

dpal/ /khyod min bdag la skyabs gzhan gang / /zhes dang /rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung / /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzad de la 'dud/ /ces dang / rje btsun bkra shis rgya mtshos/ gzi brjid 'od dpag med mgon o rgyan rje/ /a ti sha dang 'jam dpal blo bzang grags/ /ye shes gcig la rnam 'gyur chu zla'i gar/ /nges pa snying nas rnyed pas lan brgyar 'dud/ /ces dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos khri gung thang pa rin po ches/ gangs can bstan pa'i srol 'byed pad+ma 'byung / /de don rgyud la sbyor mdzad a ti sha /de la 'khrul ba sel mdzad tsong kha pa/ /rnam gsum dbyer med tshad ma'i lung gis grub/ /ces gsungs pa sogs dus deng sang gi bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis kyang mgrin gcig dang dbyangs gcig ltar gsungs tshul la bsams nas/ bstan pa'i bdag po de gsum dang / rjes 'jug gsar rnying gi chos mdzad yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyangs te/ mchod bstod bkur ba la brtson par bya'o zhes smras/ yang kho na re/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di byang phyogs kha ba can gyi 241

dpal/ /khyod min bdag la skyabs gzhan gang / /zhes dang /rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung / /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzad de la 'dud/ /ces dang / rje btsun bkra shis rgya mtshos/ gzi brjid 'od dpag med mgon o rgyan rje/ /a ti sha dang 'jam dpal blo bzang grags/ /ye shes gcig la rnam 'gyur chu zla'i gar/ /nges pa snying nas rnyed pas lan brgyar 'dud/ /ces dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos khri gung thang pa rin po ches/ gangs can bstan pa'i srol 'byed pad+ma 'byung / /de don rgyud la sbyor mdzad a ti sha /de la 'khrul ba sel mdzad tsong kha pa/ /rnam gsum dbyer med tshad ma'i lung gis grub/ /ces gsungs pa sogs dus deng sang gi bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis kyang mgrin gcig dang dbyangs gcig ltar gsungs tshul la bsams nas/ bstan pa'i bdag po de gsum dang / rjes 'jug gsar rnying gi chos mdzad yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyangs te/ mchod bstod bkur ba la brtson par bya'o zhes smras/ yang kho na re/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di byang phyogs kha ba can gyi 241

yul nas/ byang nas byang du dar pa'i lung bstan gang na yod lags zer ba la/ 'o de dgos na mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/rigs kyi bu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas gang gis kyang gdul byar ma gyur pa'i gnas/ 'dre srin du mas gang ba'i mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams der/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na dam chos nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig rgyas par 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad kyang thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'god par 'gyur ro/ /mtha' 'khob de 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yin no/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal brtan pa rol ba'i rgyud las/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gang rgyas pa/ /byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul/ /zhes dang / mdo rgyas 'bring dag las/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa yul bar ta ni nas byang phyogs su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang phyogs su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /byang phyogs nas byang phyogs kyi cha de nyid du rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bka' gdams glegs bam las/ phyi ma'i dus su gyur pa'i tshe/ /byang gi cha nas byang phyogs su/ /rgya yul rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' lung yod/ /gsungs/ sngon ngas rmi lam rmis tshul zhus pas/ chos rgyal rin po che'i zhal nas/ byang du 242

yul nas/ byang nas byang du dar pa'i lung bstan gang na yod lags zer ba la/ 'o de dgos na mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/rigs kyi bu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas gang gis kyang gdul byar ma gyur pa'i gnas/ 'dre srin du mas gang ba'i mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams der/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na dam chos nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig rgyas par 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad kyang thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'god par 'gyur ro/ /mtha' 'khob de 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yin no/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal brtan pa rol ba'i rgyud las/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gang rgyas pa/ /byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul/ /zhes dang / mdo rgyas 'bring dag las/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa yul bar ta ni nas byang phyogs su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang phyogs su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /byang phyogs nas byang phyogs kyi cha de nyid du rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bka' gdams glegs bam las/ phyi ma'i dus su gyur pa'i tshe/ /byang gi cha nas byang phyogs su/ /rgya yul rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' lung yod/ /gsungs/ sngon ngas rmi lam rmis tshul zhus pas/ chos rgyal rin po che'i zhal nas/ byang du 242

'od zer 'phro ba de/ /bu khyod gdul bya byang na yod/ /mi mang 'od nang rgyug pa de/ /gdul bya'i nyams len nus par go /zhes gsungs pa sogs lung bstan de dag gi nang ltar/'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa du mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa byang phyogs sham+bha la dang sgra mi snyan gyi mtha' bar du rim gyis dar bar mdzad pa'i tshul la bsams nas rjes su yi rang bya zhing / ngas kyang lung bstan de dag gi nang ltar khyed rnams kyis gtso byas byang phyogs kha ba can gyi gdul bya mang por phan thogs tshul soms la dad gus dag snang bya'o zhes smras/ yang kho na re/ dpal sa ra ha'i do ha 'di bod snga rabs pa kha cig gis khas mi len pa byung yang / 'di khungs btsun pa'i tshad ldan gyi lung gang na yod zer ba la/ 'o dpal ldan sa ra ha'i do ha'i gdams pa 'di ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis/ spyan ras gzugs kyi sprul pa byang sems bde ba'i mgon po la gsungs/ des 'phags yul pa'i grub chen thams cad kyi spyi mes lta bur gyur pa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha la gsungs pas gcig char du grol bar grags/ des rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar grags pa mgon po klu sgrub la gsungs/ 'di gnyis ni 'phags yul pa'i grub chen snga rabs pa phal che ba'i bla mar gyur cing /243

'od zer 'phro ba de/ /bu khyod gdul bya byang na yod/ /mi mang 'od nang rgyug pa de/ /gdul bya'i nyams len nus par go /zhes gsungs pa sogs lung bstan de dag gi nang ltar/'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa du mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa byang phyogs sham+bha la dang sgra mi snyan gyi mtha' bar du rim gyis dar bar mdzad pa'i tshul la bsams nas rjes su yi rang bya zhing / ngas kyang lung bstan de dag gi nang ltar khyed rnams kyis gtso byas byang phyogs kha ba can gyi gdul bya mang por phan thogs tshul soms la dad gus dag snang bya'o zhes smras/ yang kho na re/ dpal sa ra ha'i do ha 'di bod snga rabs pa kha cig gis khas mi len pa byung yang / 'di khungs btsun pa'i tshad ldan gyi lung gang na yod zer ba la/ 'o dpal ldan sa ra ha'i do ha'i gdams pa 'di ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis/ spyan ras gzugs kyi sprul pa byang sems bde ba'i mgon po la gsungs/ des 'phags yul pa'i grub chen thams cad kyi spyi mes lta bur gyur pa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha la gsungs pas gcig char du grol bar grags/ des rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar grags pa mgon po klu sgrub la gsungs/ 'di gnyis ni 'phags yul pa'i grub chen snga rabs pa phal che ba'i bla mar gyur cing /243

khyad par klu sgrub kyis cig char pa'i las can mchog tu gyur cing gar mkhan gyi rigs las rab tu byung ba dpal sha wa ri'i dbang phyug grol bar mdzad pa dang / de la mnga' bdag me tri pa chen pos gdams pa ma lus pa mnos te/ de nas mang du 'phel bar gsungs/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo'i zhal nas/'brom 'tshang rgya ba la nye ba zhig dgos na gsang sngags zab mo rnams 'doms/ khyad par du do ha sems la tshud/ 'tshang rgya ba la de las thag nye ba med/ ston dus kyi lo tog kham rum me ba dang 'dra/ grub thob chen po rnams kyi nyams len yin/ khyad par du do ha 'di kun byas na lung stong na phar la rnal 'byor bzang po nyams gar rtse zhing ḍā ma ru khrol le ba 'ong srid ces dang / gson gsang sngags theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ /sgom dam chos zab mo do ha de/ /rje sa ra ha yis nga la byin/ /bu thugs kyi dkyil du 'di chongs gsungs/ /la sogs pa'i do ha'i bsngags brjod mang po gsungs snang / rje rin po ches gsungs pa'i rim lnga gsal sgon las/ bram ze chen po'i do ha sogs kyang sngar bshad pa'i lam mthon po'i skabs de dag tu spros pa gzhan dor nas/ lhan skyes ye shes kyi skor nyid gtso bor byas te skyong dgos pa'i tshul ston pa yin gsungs/ paṇa chen rin po ches 244

khyad par klu sgrub kyis cig char pa'i las can mchog tu gyur cing gar mkhan gyi rigs las rab tu byung ba dpal sha wa ri'i dbang phyug grol bar mdzad pa dang / de la mnga' bdag me tri pa chen pos gdams pa ma lus pa mnos te/ de nas mang du 'phel bar gsungs/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo'i zhal nas/'brom 'tshang rgya ba la nye ba zhig dgos na gsang sngags zab mo rnams 'doms/ khyad par du do ha sems la tshud/ 'tshang rgya ba la de las thag nye ba med/ ston dus kyi lo tog kham rum me ba dang 'dra/ grub thob chen po rnams kyi nyams len yin/ khyad par du do ha 'di kun byas na lung stong na phar la rnal 'byor bzang po nyams gar rtse zhing ḍā ma ru khrol le ba 'ong srid ces dang / gson gsang sngags theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ /sgom dam chos zab mo do ha de/ /rje sa ra ha yis nga la byin/ /bu thugs kyi dkyil du 'di chongs gsungs/ /la sogs pa'i do ha'i bsngags brjod mang po gsungs snang / rje rin po ches gsungs pa'i rim lnga gsal sgon las/ bram ze chen po'i do ha sogs kyang sngar bshad pa'i lam mthon po'i skabs de dag tu spros pa gzhan dor nas/ lhan skyes ye shes kyi skor nyid gtso bor byas te skyong dgos pa'i tshul ston pa yin gsungs/ paṇa chen rin po ches 244

mdzad pa'i phyag chen yang gsal sgon me las/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsal sgon sogs su do ha sogs ma gsungs pa ni/sngags lam mthon po'i nyams len yin gsungs pa bka' gzhan du mi 'gyur ba yin te gsungs/ des na rje yab sras sogs skyes bu dam pa gong ma mang pos do ha sogs gdams ngag zab mo rnams gsang nas nyams su bzhes kyang / snyigs dus 'dir gang zag dbang po yang rab dkon par mkhyen nas/do ha sogs la rtsal bton nas ma gsungs par/ gang zag mchog dman bar ba thams cad la phan thogs pa'i phyir/ skyes bu gsum kyi lam gyi rim pa sogs la rtsal bton nas gsungs pas/ deng sang bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ba 'di ka lags byas pas/ bka' drin che zhes tshig gi gtang rag phul nas phyag du ma byas rang gnas su song ngo / /yang bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes shing 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug pa'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu nyang gi mtshams pa rgya mtshos lha rdzas maṇ+ḍal bcas nges don zab mo'i gdams pa zhig zhu zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/zab gsal thugs kyi bum bzang du/ /zab rgya'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'khyel/ /snod ldan slob ma yongs la ster/ /mgon khyod 245

gter chen bum bzang 'dra/ /byang chub lam rim rnga bo che/ /mkhyen rab dbyug gus brdung ba'i tshe/ /dkar phyogs lha mi dga' bas nyan/ /mgon khyod lha yi rnga chen 'dra/ /sde snod gsum gyi sham bus mdzes/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi tog gis mtshan/ /gdul bya lha khang steng gi rgyan/ /mgon khyod bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dra/ /skul tshig bser bus bskyod nus na/ /rnam dpyod yal 'dab rgyas pa las/ /zhal gdams dri bzang ngad pa 'thul/ /mgon khyod tsan dan sdong bo 'dra/ /dben pa'i nags khrod nyams dga' 'grims/ /lhang lhang glu yi skad snyan sgrog /thos tshad gzhan yid dbang med 'gug /mgon khyod bya rgyal khu byug 'dra/ /khyed dang 'dra ba'i dge ba'i bshes/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad du/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas par yang yang btsal kyang rnyed par dka'/ /da re lan cig mjal ba yang / /tshe sngon bskal pa mang po'i bar/ /tshogs bsags smon lam btab pa yi/ /'bras bu yin par da gzod go /da lta mjal ba'i dus skabs 'dir/ /gdams ngag tshig 'ga' ma zhus na/ /ma mjal ba dang khyad ci yod/ /rgyal khams mi la ji skad sgrog /thos pas ngan 'gror mi ltung zhing / /bsgoms pas 'khor bar mi 'khyams pa'i/ /ngo mtshar zab mo'i gdams pa 246

gter chen bum bzang 'dra/ /byang chub lam rim rnga bo che/ /mkhyen rab dbyug gus brdung ba'i tshe/ /dkar phyogs lha mi dga' bas nyan/ /mgon khyod lha yi rnga chen 'dra/ /sde snod gsum gyi sham bus mdzes/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi tog gis mtshan/ /gdul bya lha khang steng gi rgyan/ /mgon khyod bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dra/ /skul tshig bser bus bskyod nus na/ /rnam dpyod yal 'dab rgyas pa las/ /zhal gdams dri bzang ngad pa 'thul/ /mgon khyod tsan dan sdong bo 'dra/ /dben pa'i nags khrod nyams dga' 'grims/ /lhang lhang glu yi skad snyan sgrog /thos tshad gzhan yid dbang med 'gug /mgon khyod bya rgyal khu byug 'dra/ /khyed dang 'dra ba'i dge ba'i bshes/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad du/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas par yang yang btsal kyang rnyed par dka'/ /da re lan cig mjal ba yang / /tshe sngon bskal pa mang po'i bar/ /tshogs bsags smon lam btab pa yi/ /'bras bu yin par da gzod go /da lta mjal ba'i dus skabs 'dir/ /gdams ngag tshig 'ga' ma zhus na/ /ma mjal ba dang khyad ci yod/ /rgyal khams mi la ji skad sgrog /thos pas ngan 'gror mi ltung zhing / /bsgoms pas 'khor bar mi 'khyams pa'i/ /ngo mtshar zab mo'i gdams pa 246

zhig /sba gsang med par bstan du gsol/ /bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /khyed dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /byang chub thob kyang rigs bdag gi /tshul du 'bral med spyi bor bzhugs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yang tshe 'dir bstan 'gro yongs kyi don mdzad snyam pa zhig gis rig gnas shes bya'i phyogs la sbyangs na bzang / tshe thung nam 'chi cha med bsams nas tshe 'di la rang gi lam sna zin par 'dod pas/dben pa'i gnas su don thog tu dar cig bzhag pa dga' ste/sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo chen pos mdzad pa'i 'khor ba la skyo ba'i glu las/ bla ma'i gdams ngag ces bya'i bdud rtsi'i ro/ /gang zhig mnyam par 'jog pa de tsam zhig /yongs su btsal gyis gzhung mang ci zhig dgos/ /de dag yid ni 'khrul bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du tshe gcig la grub pa mchog brnyes pa'i dpal ldan sa ra ha chen pos mdzad pa'i do ha rdo rje'i glu las/ gang zhig bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu/ /gdungs sel bsil ba ngoms par mi 'thung bar/ /de ni bstan bcos don mang mya ngan gyi/ /thang la skom pas gdungs te 'chi bar zad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rig nas shes bya'i phyogs la blo ma 'brangs par/ gcig shes kun grol mdo sngags gnad kyi 247

gdams pa 'di ltar nyams su longs dang bzang / de yang tshe thung nam 'chi cha med 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams soms la ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bsgyed la de nas rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor/ rang la nges don ston pa'i bla ma de skyabs— gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor sgoms la gsol ba thob dbang bzhi longs thugs yid gcig tu bsres/ rig pa kha yan du glod la chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog dus/ dper na ri mthon po'i rtse nas nam mkha' yangs pa la bltas pa ltar/ dmigs gtad chos med har sangs rgya yan chen po'i ngang du yangs chod de thongs/ mtha' bral chos dbyengs bde ba chen po'i klong du dga' yal ler gnas pa zhig gyis dang / rnam rtog thams cad rang sar yal nas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yong / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i ma gyur 'gro la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i sgon lam thobs/ phan gang thogs la 'bod dang / tshe 'dir yang rang gzhan gye don yang rgya chen po yong / nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru grol nas gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don la 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /248

gdams pa 'di ltar nyams su longs dang bzang / de yang tshe thung nam 'chi cha med 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams soms la ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bsgyed la de nas rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor/ rang la nges don ston pa'i bla ma de skyabs— gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor sgoms la gsol ba thob dbang bzhi longs thugs yid gcig tu bsres/ rig pa kha yan du glod la chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog dus/ dper na ri mthon po'i rtse nas nam mkha' yangs pa la bltas pa ltar/ dmigs gtad chos med har sangs rgya yan chen po'i ngang du yangs chod de thongs/ mtha' bral chos dbyengs bde ba chen po'i klong du dga' yal ler gnas pa zhig gyis dang / rnam rtog thams cad rang sar yal nas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yong / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i ma gyur 'gro la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i sgon lam thobs/ phan gang thogs la 'bod dang / tshe 'dir yang rang gzhan gye don yang rgya chen po yong / nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru grol nas gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don la 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /248

'di ltar sems ngo skyongs dang bla ma'i zhabs tog pha ma'i drin gzo sems can gyi 'gro don la 'di kho nas chog pa yin pas/skal ldan snying gi slob bu khyod kyi sems la zungs la dga' bar mdzod ces nyams mgur 'di blangs so/ /dgongs pa zab mo ni nam mkha'i pha mtha' dang mnyam zhing / /rtogs ldan rje btsun gyi bla ma snying dbus su bzhugs shig /sngon bsags legs byas kyi mthu las mi lus ni thob byung / /sangs rgyas mi gzugs su shar ba'i chos rgyal dang mjal snang / /rang sems chos sku yi rang zhal mngon sum du bstan byung / /mi blta snyam na yang sems nyid rang bzhin gyis gsal snang / /mi bsgom snyam na yang bde gsal sgom gyis tshur bskyangs byung / /mi spyod snyam na yang bde stong ye shes ros myong snang / /lta sgom spyod pa las log na 'bras bu zhig mi gda'/ /brtan pa thob pa'i tshe 'bras bu chos sku de yin snang / /chos sku'i dbyengs las ni gzugs sku grangs med cig byung nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro don rang byed pa'i smon lam ni 'debs so/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga chos rgyal ngag dbang wang bu rgyud/ /shugs 'byung 'gags med kyi nyams dbyangs 'di 'dra rang blangs yong /phyi rabs rjes 'jug gi slob ma yang slob kyi tshogs rnams/ /sems 249

'di ltar sems ngo skyongs dang bla ma'i zhabs tog pha ma'i drin gzo sems can gyi 'gro don la 'di kho nas chog pa yin pas/skal ldan snying gi slob bu khyod kyi sems la zungs la dga' bar mdzod ces nyams mgur 'di blangs so/ /dgongs pa zab mo ni nam mkha'i pha mtha' dang mnyam zhing / /rtogs ldan rje btsun gyi bla ma snying dbus su bzhugs shig /sngon bsags legs byas kyi mthu las mi lus ni thob byung / /sangs rgyas mi gzugs su shar ba'i chos rgyal dang mjal snang / /rang sems chos sku yi rang zhal mngon sum du bstan byung / /mi blta snyam na yang sems nyid rang bzhin gyis gsal snang / /mi bsgom snyam na yang bde gsal sgom gyis tshur bskyangs byung / /mi spyod snyam na yang bde stong ye shes ros myong snang / /lta sgom spyod pa las log na 'bras bu zhig mi gda'/ /brtan pa thob pa'i tshe 'bras bu chos sku de yin snang / /chos sku'i dbyengs las ni gzugs sku grangs med cig byung nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro don rang byed pa'i smon lam ni 'debs so/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga chos rgyal ngag dbang wang bu rgyud/ /shugs 'byung 'gags med kyi nyams dbyangs 'di 'dra rang blangs yong /phyi rabs rjes 'jug gi slob ma yang slob kyi tshogs rnams/ /sems 249

ngo skyong bzhin du 'di 'dra'i nyams dbyangs 'dra longs shig /ces pa 'di yang sems la shar ba ltar gdams pas kho rang gi lta sgom la bogs thon rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam ste/ de'i ngang nas 'gro don byas pas mthong thos dran reg gi gdul bya mtha' dag la phan thogs pa'i slob bu kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa zhig byung ngo / /yang dad brtson shes rab snying rje che ba'i par yig 'bri mkhan slob bu bskal bzang skyabs kyis kho bo la yang skal ba bzang bzang byas/ zhal gdams shig gnang dgos zhes lha rdzas ring po bcas zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/bskal pa snyigs ma'i tha ma la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams dma' ba'i/ /skabs 'dir bod khams snying rje nas/ /bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs/ /tha mal mi yi tshul du byon/ /stod kyi gangs dkar te se nas/ /smad kyi mdo smad a mdo'i bar/ /zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs/ /las dang skal bar ldan pa yi/ /gdul bya bye ba ther 'bum la/ /ston pa thugs rje chen po yi/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /snying khu byang chub lam rim sogs/ /zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /thams cad mngon mtho lha mi dang / /nges legs thar pa tsam pa 250
