dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang mchog la bkod pa'i mod/ /nub phyogs dza lan+dar nas/ /shar phyogs rgya mtshor thug gi bar/ /khyed kyi mtshan dang snyan grags kyis/ /nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa mtshar/ /da dung mgon khyod bskal brgya'i bar/ /'gro ba'i dorna du legs bzhugs nas/ /mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rgyun 'chad med par bskor bar bskul/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i bu slob kun/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /zab gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /nam yang 'dor med gnang ba mkhyen/ /gzhan gyi zhal gdams zhus pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang skal ba bzang bzang byas/ /sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig /zhu bas brtse bas gnang du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'di skad ces smras/ kye skal ldan snying gi bu khyod kyis da lta yi ge bris pa la yang phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs te/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / /'chang dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang bsgom pa ste/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyi/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /gsungs/ de bas kyang tshe mjug 'dir sngon byon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rgya bod kyi 251

dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang mchog la bkod pa'i mod/ /nub phyogs dza lan+dar nas/ /shar phyogs rgya mtshor thug gi bar/ /khyed kyi mtshan dang snyan grags kyis/ /nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa mtshar/ /da dung mgon khyod bskal brgya'i bar/ /'gro ba'i dorna du legs bzhugs nas/ /mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rgyun 'chad med par bskor bar bskul/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i bu slob kun/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /zab gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /nam yang 'dor med gnang ba mkhyen/ /gzhan gyi zhal gdams zhus pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang skal ba bzang bzang byas/ /sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig /zhu bas brtse bas gnang du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'di skad ces smras/ kye skal ldan snying gi bu khyod kyis da lta yi ge bris pa la yang phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs te/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / /'chang dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang bsgom pa ste/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyi/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /gsungs/ de bas kyang tshe mjug 'dir sngon byon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rgya bod kyi 251

mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar bzhin/ shin tu nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol dang / 'od gsal gye nyi ma snying dbus su shar nas tshe rabs gtan du bde zhing skyid pa'i skal ba yod ces rang gi sems la shar ba ltar skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so/ /snang sred 'khor 'das chos kun gye 'byung gnas/ /mtha' bral chos dbyings chen po yi slong nas/ /'khor 'das ltad mo thams cad la gzigs pa'i/ /kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tsho'i skyid pa/ /chos kun snang stong sgyu ma ru rtogs nas/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro ba kun snying rje'i/ /bdag pas gzhan gces byang chub sems 'byongs pa'i/ /sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' tsho'i skyid pa/ /phyi snod thams cad dag zhing dang gzhal yas/ /nang bcud lha dang lha mo ru shar zhing / /bde stong mchog gi bdud rtsi'i ros myos pa'i/ /rgya bod mkhas grub pho mo tsho'i skyid pa/ /skyid po de kun rjes su rang snyogs pa'i/ /bya btang chos mdzad pho mo 'dra yod na/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa la gzhol dang / /'od gsal nyi ma snying gabus su shar yong / /na so rgas rung lus sems gnyis bde tshe/ /'di dang 'di 'dra'i skyid 252

mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar bzhin/ shin tu nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol dang / 'od gsal gye nyi ma snying dbus su shar nas tshe rabs gtan du bde zhing skyid pa'i skal ba yod ces rang gi sems la shar ba ltar skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so/ /snang sred 'khor 'das chos kun gye 'byung gnas/ /mtha' bral chos dbyings chen po yi slong nas/ /'khor 'das ltad mo thams cad la gzigs pa'i/ /kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tsho'i skyid pa/ /chos kun snang stong sgyu ma ru rtogs nas/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro ba kun snying rje'i/ /bdag pas gzhan gces byang chub sems 'byongs pa'i/ /sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' tsho'i skyid pa/ /phyi snod thams cad dag zhing dang gzhal yas/ /nang bcud lha dang lha mo ru shar zhing / /bde stong mchog gi bdud rtsi'i ros myos pa'i/ /rgya bod mkhas grub pho mo tsho'i skyid pa/ /skyid po de kun rjes su rang snyogs pa'i/ /bya btang chos mdzad pho mo 'dra yod na/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa la gzhol dang / /'od gsal nyi ma snying gabus su shar yong / /na so rgas rung lus sems gnyis bde tshe/ /'di dang 'di 'dra'i skyid 252

glu 'dra len rgyu'i/ /skal ba bzang po tshe mjug 'dir byung ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin rang lags so/ /zhes blangs pas kho rang gi sems la phan po byung nas phyag 'tshal/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin tshe mjug ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol bas rang gzhan gye don gnyis 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig byung ngo //yang skal ldan slob bu kun dga' dang dge slong sbyin pa/btsun ma don grub sgrol ma dang chos sgon sogs dad can grwa btsun mang pos/ khyed kyi thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can de bdag gzhan yongs kyi rgyud la skye ba'i zab mo'i gdams pa zhig gsung dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /dpe yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel 'dra/ /rje bla mas sems ngo sprod pa de/ /dpe long ba'i mig gnyis phyes pa 'dra/ /spyir 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /dpe snang stong bar snang 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /phyogs kun khyab 'gyur med sems kyi dbyings/ /dpe stong gsal nam mkha'i dbyengs rum 'dra/ /de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /dpe khyung chen mkha' la lding ba 'dra/ /mnyam bzhag nas 253

glu 'dra len rgyu'i/ /skal ba bzang po tshe mjug 'dir byung ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin rang lags so/ /zhes blangs pas kho rang gi sems la phan po byung nas phyag 'tshal/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin tshe mjug ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol bas rang gzhan gye don gnyis 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig byung ngo //yang skal ldan slob bu kun dga' dang dge slong sbyin pa/btsun ma don grub sgrol ma dang chos sgon sogs dad can grwa btsun mang pos/ khyed kyi thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can de bdag gzhan yongs kyi rgyud la skye ba'i zab mo'i gdams pa zhig gsung dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /dpe yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel 'dra/ /rje bla mas sems ngo sprod pa de/ /dpe long ba'i mig gnyis phyes pa 'dra/ /spyir 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /dpe snang stong bar snang 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /phyogs kun khyab 'gyur med sems kyi dbyings/ /dpe stong gsal nam mkha'i dbyengs rum 'dra/ /de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /dpe khyung chen mkha' la lding ba 'dra/ /mnyam bzhag nas 253

bying rgod bral ba'i tshe/ /dpe sprin med dwangs pa'i nam mkha' 'dra/ /de'i ngang nas snying rje 'char ba de/ /dpe mkha' las nyi ma shar ba 'dra/ /sems stong nyid snying rje mi 'bral ba/ /dpe nam mkha' nyi ma mi 'bral 'dra/ /snying rje yis 'gro la phan pa de/ /dpe nyi mas 'gro la phan pa 'dra/ /pha'i rgyud kyi stong nyid snying rje 'di/ /bu kun gyi rgyud la skye bar shog /ces blangs pas skal ldan slob ma rnams kyi sems la phan po byung ngo / /de nas skal ldan slob bu kun dga'/ dge slong sbyin pa gnyis yar dbus gtsang zhing du 'gro rgyu byas/ ngas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis 'dir mtshams rtags bsgur pa'i 'byor lan du spring yig bde skyid nyi ma rang 'char zhes bya ba 'di phul/thugs rje nye ring mi mnga' ba'i/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras la/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /byen rlabs thugs kyi klong nas stsol/ /brtse ba'i ma yis rgyangs ring nas/ /bu la snying gtam bskur pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /brtse ba'i snying gtam bshad kyis nyon/ /bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /khyed rnams bde ba'i gtam snyan dang / /yi ge rten bcas 'byor ba'i mod/ /dngos su mjal 'dra'i dga' spro 254

bying rgod bral ba'i tshe/ /dpe sprin med dwangs pa'i nam mkha' 'dra/ /de'i ngang nas snying rje 'char ba de/ /dpe mkha' las nyi ma shar ba 'dra/ /sems stong nyid snying rje mi 'bral ba/ /dpe nam mkha' nyi ma mi 'bral 'dra/ /snying rje yis 'gro la phan pa de/ /dpe nyi mas 'gro la phan pa 'dra/ /pha'i rgyud kyi stong nyid snying rje 'di/ /bu kun gyi rgyud la skye bar shog /ces blangs pas skal ldan slob ma rnams kyi sems la phan po byung ngo / /de nas skal ldan slob bu kun dga'/ dge slong sbyin pa gnyis yar dbus gtsang zhing du 'gro rgyu byas/ ngas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis 'dir mtshams rtags bsgur pa'i 'byor lan du spring yig bde skyid nyi ma rang 'char zhes bya ba 'di phul/thugs rje nye ring mi mnga' ba'i/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras la/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ /byen rlabs thugs kyi klong nas stsol/ /brtse ba'i ma yis rgyangs ring nas/ /bu la snying gtam bskur pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /brtse ba'i snying gtam bshad kyis nyon/ /bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /khyed rnams bde ba'i gtam snyan dang / /yi ge rten bcas 'byor ba'i mod/ /dngos su mjal 'dra'i dga' spro 254

shar/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje yis/ /thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i sgos/ /dam pa'i chos la spyod bzhin mchis/ /ngo mtshar dbus gtsang chos yul gyi/ /lha ldan jo shāka rnam gnyis dang / /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras sogs/ /dran tshe mjal 'dod yid la shar/ /bdag ni dbus gtsang dag zhing du/ /lan gnyis chas kyang yul phyogs 'di'i/ /gdul bya dad can thams cad kyis/ /bshol btab 'ong du ma bcug tshe/ /dngos su 'gro ru mi 'jug na/ /lkog tu bros nas 'gro nges zhes/ /bshad tshe phal cher gros mthun sgos/ /'brug lo tshun la gtong rtsis yod/ /de dus yong 'dra ma thub na/ /de rjes dbus su 'ong 'dod kyang / /sgyu lus rgas pas lam skabs su/ /tsha grang mi theg 'ong mi nus/ /de phyir grwa btsun gzhon pa tsho/ /bla ma'i gdan sa mjal ba dang / /sa blta yul blta'i phyir du yang / /lan re mjal du 'ong thub ltos/ /gal te 'ong 'dra ma thub na/ /dben par tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /ngas kyang mi brjed sems la 'jog /khyed rnams rgyun du gsol ba thob/ /nged rnams dngos su ma mjal yang / /gcig gcig gnas tshul go ba'i tshe/ /sems la dga' spro 'char bar gda'/ /dngos su mjal dang khyad ci yod/ /da dung ma shi tshun 255

shar/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /rgyal ba yab sras thugs rje yis/ /thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i sgos/ /dam pa'i chos la spyod bzhin mchis/ /ngo mtshar dbus gtsang chos yul gyi/ /lha ldan jo shāka rnam gnyis dang / /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras sogs/ /dran tshe mjal 'dod yid la shar/ /bdag ni dbus gtsang dag zhing du/ /lan gnyis chas kyang yul phyogs 'di'i/ /gdul bya dad can thams cad kyis/ /bshol btab 'ong du ma bcug tshe/ /dngos su 'gro ru mi 'jug na/ /lkog tu bros nas 'gro nges zhes/ /bshad tshe phal cher gros mthun sgos/ /'brug lo tshun la gtong rtsis yod/ /de dus yong 'dra ma thub na/ /de rjes dbus su 'ong 'dod kyang / /sgyu lus rgas pas lam skabs su/ /tsha grang mi theg 'ong mi nus/ /de phyir grwa btsun gzhon pa tsho/ /bla ma'i gdan sa mjal ba dang / /sa blta yul blta'i phyir du yang / /lan re mjal du 'ong thub ltos/ /gal te 'ong 'dra ma thub na/ /dben par tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /ngas kyang mi brjed sems la 'jog /khyed rnams rgyun du gsol ba thob/ /nged rnams dngos su ma mjal yang / /gcig gcig gnas tshul go ba'i tshe/ /sems la dga' spro 'char bar gda'/ /dngos su mjal dang khyad ci yod/ /da dung ma shi tshun 255

chad la/ /skabs re gnas tshul yi ge gtong / /lan du yi ge rgyas pa re/ /thongs dang mtshams rtags mchog tu gda'/ /da dung lo gsum tshun chad la/ /yid ma chad par ang nyan gyes/ /sems na lan cig mjal yong snyam/ /myur du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /gal te tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing khams sogs/ /gang 'dod dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /mjal nas 'bral med 'grogs par shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs shing / /rgyal ba'i sku tshe ring ba dang / /bod khams kun la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / yang mnga' ris phyogs kyi dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la snying gtam tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di phul/'di phyi'i skyabs mgon bla ma dang / /bslu med dkon mchog rin chen la/ /rab tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /khyed rnams lus sems rab bde zhing / /rnam dkar dge la gzhol ba'i gtam/ /thos pas dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyang / /bla ma lha yi byin mthu yis/ /sgyu lus bde zhing bstan 'gro la/ /phan pa'i lhag bsam gong 'phel mchis/ /da ni phan pa'i snying gtam la/ /tshe 256

chad la/ /skabs re gnas tshul yi ge gtong / /lan du yi ge rgyas pa re/ /thongs dang mtshams rtags mchog tu gda'/ /da dung lo gsum tshun chad la/ /yid ma chad par ang nyan gyes/ /sems na lan cig mjal yong snyam/ /myur du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /gal te tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing khams sogs/ /gang 'dod dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /mjal nas 'bral med 'grogs par shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs shing / /rgyal ba'i sku tshe ring ba dang / /bod khams kun la bde skyid kyi/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / yang mnga' ris phyogs kyi dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la snying gtam tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di phul/'di phyi'i skyabs mgon bla ma dang / /bslu med dkon mchog rin chen la/ /rab tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /khyed rnams lus sems rab bde zhing / /rnam dkar dge la gzhol ba'i gtam/ /thos pas dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyang / /bla ma lha yi byin mthu yis/ /sgyu lus bde zhing bstan 'gro la/ /phan pa'i lhag bsam gong 'phel mchis/ /da ni phan pa'i snying gtam la/ /tshe 256

rabs kun tu bde ba'i phyir/ /mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /rgyun du bsam pa bzang po gyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis khyed rnams kun/ /'di phyi kun tu bde ba'i phyir//skyabs 'jug bsngo smon gang shes bya/ /yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /mi lo stong phrag thub pa yi/ /byang phyogs sgra mi snyan gyi lugs/ /'chi ba med pa'i rang gzungs sgos/ /bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril bcas te phul/ /snying gtam tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ /mthong thos rgyud la phan thogs shing / /chos dang bkra shis chen po yis/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris khyab gyur cig /ces pa dang / yang rong mtshams kyi dad can slob ma yon bdag yongs la phan pa'i bslab bya yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di phul /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma mchod/ /skal ldan slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /mchog mthun dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /rab tu bde zhing skyid pa'i gtam/ /go bas dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyang / /bla ma lha yi thugs rje yis/ /lus bde sems bzang dge sbyor 'phel/ /bstan 'gro'i don 257

rabs kun tu bde ba'i phyir/ /mi dge spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /rgyun du bsam pa bzang po gyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis khyed rnams kun/ /'di phyi kun tu bde ba'i phyir//skyabs 'jug bsngo smon gang shes bya/ /yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /mi lo stong phrag thub pa yi/ /byang phyogs sgra mi snyan gyi lugs/ /'chi ba med pa'i rang gzungs sgos/ /bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril bcas te phul/ /snying gtam tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ /mthong thos rgyud la phan thogs shing / /chos dang bkra shis chen po yis/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris khyab gyur cig /ces pa dang / yang rong mtshams kyi dad can slob ma yon bdag yongs la phan pa'i bslab bya yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di phul/bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma mchod/ /skal ldan slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /mchog mthun dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams/ /rab tu bde zhing skyid pa'i gtam/ /go bas dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyang / /bla ma lha yi thugs rje yis/ /lus bde sems bzang dge sbyor 'phel/ /bstan 'gro'i don 257

chen sgrub bzhin mchis/ /dad ldan slob ma yon bdag la/ /sngon chad mang po smras zin pas/ /da ni dge ba'i gsal 'debs su/ /phan pa'i bslab bya cung zad smra/ /bla ma mchog gsum yid bzhin nor/ /yi dam lha mchog dpag bsam shing / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bum bzang gsum/ /mchod bstod bkur dang dngos grub 'byung / /sdom gsum yid bzhin no bu la/ /dran shes byi dor yang yang gyis/ /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos na/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid dgos 'dod 'byung / /sems nyid ka la piṅka'i bya/ /tshogs gnyis 'dab gshog rgyas su chug /rnam mkhyen mkha' la legs 'phur nas/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog par nges/ /pha rgan bde bar yod pa'i rtags/ /khyed rnams dad pa'i rten tsam du/ /skra lo gos kyi tshal bu dang / /byin rten srung mdud bcas te phul/ /de ltar phul ba'i bsod nams mthus/ /slob ma yon bdag thams cad kyis / /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / yang dad can chos drung sogs slob ma yon bdag 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i bslab bya 'di yang phul/'khor ba snying po med pa'i tshul bsams nas/ /chos bzhin mdzad pa'i bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /kun gyis snying po med pa'i 258

chen sgrub bzhin mchis/ /dad ldan slob ma yon bdag la/ /sngon chad mang po smras zin pas/ /da ni dge ba'i gsal 'debs su/ /phan pa'i bslab bya cung zad smra/ /bla ma mchog gsum yid bzhin nor/ /yi dam lha mchog dpag bsam shing / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bum bzang gsum/ /mchod bstod bkur dang dngos grub 'byung / /sdom gsum yid bzhin no bu la/ /dran shes byi dor yang yang gyis/ /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos na/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid dgos 'dod 'byung / /sems nyid ka la piṅka'i bya/ /tshogs gnyis 'dab gshog rgyas su chug /rnam mkhyen mkha' la legs 'phur nas/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog par nges/ /pha rgan bde bar yod pa'i rtags/ /khyed rnams dad pa'i rten tsam du/ /skra lo gos kyi tshal bu dang / /byin rten srung mdud bcas te phul/ /de ltar phul ba'i bsod nams mthus/ /slob ma yon bdag thams cad kyis / /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / yang dad can chos drung sogs slob ma yon bdag 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i bslab bya 'di yang phul/'khor ba snying po med pa'i tshul bsams nas/ /chos bzhin mdzad pa'i bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /kun gyis snying po med pa'i 258

nor rdzas kyis/ /chos byas snying po lon par byen gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med/ /khyim tshang mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /drin can pha ma nye 'brel 'das pa la/ /mya ngan ma byed phan pa'i dge ba thongs/ /tshe 'das slar yang mi lus gtsang ma thob/ /bla ma chos grogs bzang dang mjal bar nges/ /nged rnams sa thag ring pos bar chod nas/ /mi 'phrad pa la sems khral byed mi dgos/ /bla ma kha thag ring yang sems thag nye/ /zer bzhin snying nas gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /byin rlabs la yang rgyangs ni ring thung med/ /dad pa can la mjal ba'i snang ba yong / /khas blangs sdom pa dam tshig nyams pa yi/ /bla ma'i drung nas bshags rgyu ma byung yang / /gnas chen rten bzang bla ma gzhan drung nas/ /snying nas bshags pa gyis dang 'dag par 'gyur/ /rgyun du byams dang snying rje chen po'i sgos/ /yul mi khyim mtshes gnas skor ngan slong sogs/ /nyam thag 'gro ba yongs la sbyin pa thongs/ /dkon mchog mchod pa tsam gyis phan yon yong / /'di nas bdag gis khyed rnams thams cad la/ /'di phyi kun tu phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla mas rjes 'dzin cing / /tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas par shog /ces 259

nor rdzas kyis/ /chos byas snying po lon par byen gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med/ /khyim tshang mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /drin can pha ma nye 'brel 'das pa la/ /mya ngan ma byed phan pa'i dge ba thongs/ /tshe 'das slar yang mi lus gtsang ma thob/ /bla ma chos grogs bzang dang mjal bar nges/ /nged rnams sa thag ring pos bar chod nas/ /mi 'phrad pa la sems khral byed mi dgos/ /bla ma kha thag ring yang sems thag nye/ /zer bzhin snying nas gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /byin rlabs la yang rgyangs ni ring thung med/ /dad pa can la mjal ba'i snang ba yong / /khas blangs sdom pa dam tshig nyams pa yi/ /bla ma'i drung nas bshags rgyu ma byung yang / /gnas chen rten bzang bla ma gzhan drung nas/ /snying nas bshags pa gyis dang 'dag par 'gyur/ /rgyun du byams dang snying rje chen po'i sgos/ /yul mi khyim mtshes gnas skor ngan slong sogs/ /nyam thag 'gro ba yongs la sbyin pa thongs/ /dkon mchog mchod pa tsam gyis phan yon yong / /'di nas bdag gis khyed rnams thams cad la/ /'di phyi kun tu phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla mas rjes 'dzin cing / /tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas par shog /ces 259

phul/ gzhan yang skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung shog 'byor lan dang / bla ma sbyin pa nor bu/ lo chen pa/ rtsa chang dga' sogs dad can slob ma yon bdag so sor 'byor lan yi ge bris/ yig rten gang yod bzhag rgya brgyab nas 'gro mkhan gnyis la sprad/ khal rta bro chas yag po byen nas/ zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes pa bcu gcig gi nyin dbus phyogs su song ngo yar slebs nas dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi slob ma yon bdag yongs la spring yig dang 'byor lan rnams sprad pas dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung ngo / /bdag gis kyang lnga ba tshes nas dad can yon bdag rgan rgya'i ring ngan dang / a bar the'u zho 'ong la steng 'og gi 'brog pa rnams la 'gro don la song nas chos kyang 'di ltar bshad/ 'o skol rnams kyis dal 'byor gyi mi lus yid bzhin gyi nor las lhag pa 'di nyid thob pa'i dus 'dir/ tshe 'dir yun ring po zhig bsdad yong snyam pa'i blo rgya mi bskyed par/ nam zhig la shi 'gro ci shes sems la tshe phyi mar phan pa'i chos gyis/ chos byed tshul mang na yang khyed rnams kyis sems can gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor spongs la/ phan pa'i bsam sbyor gong 'phel du thongs/ khyad par srog gcod kyi sdig pa la 'dzem tshe thar 260

phul/ gzhan yang skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung shog 'byor lan dang / bla ma sbyin pa nor bu/ lo chen pa/ rtsa chang dga' sogs dad can slob ma yon bdag so sor 'byor lan yi ge bris/ yig rten gang yod bzhag rgya brgyab nas 'gro mkhan gnyis la sprad/ khal rta bro chas yag po byen nas/ zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes pa bcu gcig gi nyin dbus phyogs su song ngo yar slebs nas dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi slob ma yon bdag yongs la spring yig dang 'byor lan rnams sprad pas dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung ngo / /bdag gis kyang lnga ba tshes nas dad can yon bdag rgan rgya'i ring ngan dang / a bar the'u zho 'ong la steng 'og gi 'brog pa rnams la 'gro don la song nas chos kyang 'di ltar bshad/ 'o skol rnams kyis dal 'byor gyi mi lus yid bzhin gyi nor las lhag pa 'di nyid thob pa'i dus 'dir/ tshe 'dir yun ring po zhig bsdad yong snyam pa'i blo rgya mi bskyed par/ nam zhig la shi 'gro ci shes sems la tshe phyi mar phan pa'i chos gyis/ chos byed tshul mang na yang khyed rnams kyis sems can gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor spongs la/ phan pa'i bsam sbyor gong 'phel du thongs/ khyad par srog gcod kyi sdig pa la 'dzem tshe thar 260

dang mchod sbyin gang thub thongs/ nyin re bzhin phyag mchod dang skor ba ma ṇi la sogs pa'i kha ton la brtson/ dus rgyun du ma gyur sems can la byams snying rje phan sems sbyongs dang /gnas skabs su lha mi'i go 'phang thob nas bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob nges pas/ des na mi lus thob pa dam pa'i chos kyi sgo nas don ldan re mdzod cig ces mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//skyabs bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /de gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid mchog /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /mgon rgyal bstan dar ba'i yul du skyes/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma mang por mjal/ /chos zab rgya'i gdams pa thob dus 'dir/ /rang gtan bde'i go 'phang sgrub re ran/ /sngon ston pas dam chos mang gsungs kyang / /las rgyu 'bras gnad la chos kun 'dus/ /tshig mang po shes pa'i kha na med/ /don rang sems 'dul ba man ngag yin/ /las sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /rgyun ring por bzod dka'i sdug bsngal 'byung / /don de phyir srog la bab na yang / /las sdig pa chung ngu yin yang 'dzem/ /las dge ba chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'phral phan zhing phugs su 261

dang mchod sbyin gang thub thongs/ nyin re bzhin phyag mchod dang skor ba ma ṇi la sogs pa'i kha ton la brtson/ dus rgyun du ma gyur sems can la byams snying rje phan sems sbyongs dang /gnas skabs su lha mi'i go 'phang thob nas bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob nges pas/ des na mi lus thob pa dam pa'i chos kyi sgo nas don ldan re mdzod cig ces mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//skyabs bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /de gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid mchog /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /mgon rgyal bstan dar ba'i yul du skyes/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma mang por mjal/ /chos zab rgya'i gdams pa thob dus 'dir/ /rang gtan bde'i go 'phang sgrub re ran/ /sngon ston pas dam chos mang gsungs kyang / /las rgyu 'bras gnad la chos kun 'dus/ /tshig mang po shes pa'i kha na med/ /don rang sems 'dul ba man ngag yin/ /las sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /rgyun ring por bzod dka'i sdug bsngal 'byung / /don de phyir srog la bab na yang / /las sdig pa chung ngu yin yang 'dzem/ /las dge ba chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'phral phan zhing phugs su 261

bde ba ster/ /don de phyir nyi ma re re bzhin/ /las dge ba chung ngu yin yang sgrubs/ /dus rgyun du ma gyur sems can la/ /byams snying rje phan pa'i sems sbyongs dang / /dus gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan phyir bsngo/ /de'i mthu las 'gro kun bde zhing skyid/ /mthar gtan bde'i sangs rgyas 'thob par shog /ces blangs pas kun dad pa cher song / rta dre'u mdzo mdzo mo 'bri g.yag lnga bcu lug brgya lhag gzhan yang rgyu nom pa mang po 'bu mkhan byung / de dus mgar rtse byams chen gye steng gi gyo mag rnams chag shing cha rul nas thigs pa rgyag pa mthong nas slar nyams gso byas/ de la rgyu nom pa'i 'gro dgos mang po btang /de'i lo rjes ma de la mtshams la bsdad/ khyung dgon sprul sku dang / dgu rong sprul sku/ dmag gsar sras po mi bskyod rdo rje/rkang tsha'i blo bzang sogs slob ma mang po mtshams la bsdad nyams len gang nus byas pas nyams rtogs yon tan skyes pa mang po byung / de'i sos ka bkra shis 'khyel ba'i 'du khang la rdo brtsigs brgyab/ rdo bzo shing bzo sogs las byed pa rnams kyi lto chas la rkyal mar che chung bcu/ ja lan chen gsum/ phye rtsam do 262

bde ba ster/ /don de phyir nyi ma re re bzhin/ /las dge ba chung ngu yin yang sgrubs/ /dus rgyun du ma gyur sems can la/ /byams snying rje phan pa'i sems sbyongs dang / /dus gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan phyir bsngo/ /de'i mthu las 'gro kun bde zhing skyid/ /mthar gtan bde'i sangs rgyas 'thob par shog /ces blangs pas kun dad pa cher song / rta dre'u mdzo mdzo mo 'bri g.yag lnga bcu lug brgya lhag gzhan yang rgyu nom pa mang po 'bu mkhan byung / de dus mgar rtse byams chen gye steng gi gyo mag rnams chag shing cha rul nas thigs pa rgyag pa mthong nas slar nyams gso byas/ de la rgyu nom pa'i 'gro dgos mang po btang /de'i lo rjes ma de la mtshams la bsdad/ khyung dgon sprul sku dang / dgu rong sprul sku/ dmag gsar sras po mi bskyod rdo rje/rkang tsha'i blo bzang sogs slob ma mang po mtshams la bsdad nyams len gang nus byas pas nyams rtogs yon tan skyes pa mang po byung / de'i sos ka bkra shis 'khyel ba'i 'du khang la rdo brtsigs brgyab/ rdo bzo shing bzo sogs las byed pa rnams kyi lto chas la rkyal mar che chung bcu/ ja lan chen gsum/ phye rtsam do 262

bo lnga bcu/ yon la dngul srang lnga bcu tsam gyi rgyu nom pa byen pas dga' song / de'i dbyar kha lnga ba'i nang la sngon las ngan pa dang 'phral rkyen gyod 'dre ngan pa mi 'ga' re'i snying la zhugs nas/ rong bo dang bla brang gi sde rnams 'khrug phan tshun gye mi dang dud 'gro mang po bsad/ de la thugs skyo nas shar thams cad mkhyen pa glo bur du zhing gshegs song bas reb gong gi bla ma dpon po skya ser pho mo ya rabs dad can rnams kyis da reb gong phyogs la nyi ma nub song / zhes mya ngan sems sdug gis yid gdungs pa'i shugs kyis mchi ma 'don mkhan mang po byung / ngas kyang go nas sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gdung dbyangs 'di blangs so//phyag na pad+ma snyigs dus gdul bya'i ngos/ /ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tshul 'dzin skyabs mgon rje/ /mi mngon dbyengs nas mgon med gdul bya yi/ /mya ngan gdung ba'i dbyangs 'di yud tsam dgongs/ /khyed sku nyi ma glo bur nub song ba/ /kun gyi yid la wal ler dran pa'i mod/ /mig nas mchi ma char bzhin 'bab pa 'di/ /gzigs nas thugs kyis bzod dam snying rje gter/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu med shul du/ /dad ldan ltos bcas re ba su yis skong / /kye ma kye hud gdul bya 263

bo lnga bcu/ yon la dngul srang lnga bcu tsam gyi rgyu nom pa byen pas dga' song / de'i dbyar kha lnga ba'i nang la sngon las ngan pa dang 'phral rkyen gyod 'dre ngan pa mi 'ga' re'i snying la zhugs nas/ rong bo dang bla brang gi sde rnams 'khrug phan tshun gye mi dang dud 'gro mang po bsad/ de la thugs skyo nas shar thams cad mkhyen pa glo bur du zhing gshegs song bas reb gong gi bla ma dpon po skya ser pho mo ya rabs dad can rnams kyis da reb gong phyogs la nyi ma nub song / zhes mya ngan sems sdug gis yid gdungs pa'i shugs kyis mchi ma 'don mkhan mang po byung / ngas kyang go nas sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gdung dbyangs 'di blangs so//phyag na pad+ma snyigs dus gdul bya'i ngos/ /ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tshul 'dzin skyabs mgon rje/ /mi mngon dbyengs nas mgon med gdul bya yi/ /mya ngan gdung ba'i dbyangs 'di yud tsam dgongs/ /khyed sku nyi ma glo bur nub song ba/ /kun gyi yid la wal ler dran pa'i mod/ /mig nas mchi ma char bzhin 'bab pa 'di/ /gzigs nas thugs kyis bzod dam snying rje gter/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu med shul du/ /dad ldan ltos bcas re ba su yis skong / /kye ma kye hud gdul bya 263

snying rje nas/ /slar yang sprul sku 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag kyang deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu sku yi grib ma bzhin/ /rjes su 'brangs shing gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ /ngoms pa med par longs su spyod par shog /ces blangs pas gzhan dad can skya ser 'ga' zhig gis khyer nas gdung mdun nas bton pas/ mig nas mchi ma gtong mkhan mang po byung skad/ de'i rjes su nyin cig skyabs mgon mchog de dran nas yang rang la phan phyir skyo mgur 'di blangs so/ /bod gangs can lha gcig spyan ras gzigs/ /phyi ngur smrig gar gye rnam rol pa/ /shar thams cad mkhyen pa zhes grags pa'i/ /pha bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /nged gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gye rigs/ /chos bskul phyir sku na gzhon thog 'dir/ /sku mi rtag glo bur gshegs tshul bstan/ /'di bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /khong skye 'chir dbang thob rje btsun kyang / /sku mi rtag 'jig pa'i tshul ston na/ /las nyon mongs gzhan gyi dbang gyur pa'i/ /sprang rang nyid 'chi ba smos ci dgos/ /don de phyir mdo med snyoms las pa/ /rje skyabs mgon zhing gzhan gshegs pa 'di/ /chos mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon du/ /rang shes par gyis la nyams len rems/ /chos 264

snying rje nas/ /slar yang sprul sku 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag kyang deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu sku yi grib ma bzhin/ /rjes su 'brangs shing gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ /ngoms pa med par longs su spyod par shog /ces blangs pas gzhan dad can skya ser 'ga' zhig gis khyer nas gdung mdun nas bton pas/ mig nas mchi ma gtong mkhan mang po byung skad/ de'i rjes su nyin cig skyabs mgon mchog de dran nas yang rang la phan phyir skyo mgur 'di blangs so/ /bod gangs can lha gcig spyan ras gzigs/ /phyi ngur smrig gar gye rnam rol pa/ /shar thams cad mkhyen pa zhes grags pa'i/ /pha bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /nged gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gye rigs/ /chos bskul phyir sku na gzhon thog 'dir/ /sku mi rtag glo bur gshegs tshul bstan/ /'di bsam zhing skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /khong skye 'chir dbang thob rje btsun kyang / /sku mi rtag 'jig pa'i tshul ston na/ /las nyon mongs gzhan gyi dbang gyur pa'i/ /sprang rang nyid 'chi ba smos ci dgos/ /don de phyir mdo med snyoms las pa/ /rje skyabs mgon zhing gzhan gshegs pa 'di/ /chos mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon du/ /rang shes par gyis la nyams len rems/ /chos 264

nyams su len na mang mi dgos/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob pa'i phyir/ /lus lhar bsgom ngag gis bzlas brjod gyis/ /sems gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la zhog /dge 'dis mtshon dus gsum gang bsags pa/ /rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo/ /slar sprul sku gsal po myur byon nas/ /rang gzhan kun rjes su 'dzin par shog /ces blangs nas/ da sprul sku re byung na snyam re ba byas pa bzhin chu bzang du 'khrungs bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa zhig byung / yang 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i hor rgya'i sku skyes dang / bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i ye shes dar rgyas gnyis kyis/ nyin cig bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas te skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la zhu ba/ snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi cha med la chos mang po shes rung bsgom lo mi 'dug pas/ da ni rje mi la yab sras sogs bka' brgyud gong ma'i thugs dam gyi mthil/ gcig shes kun grol 'od gsal phyag rgya chen bo'i gnad kyi gdams ngag cig gnang du gsol zhes slar yang zhu don glu ru phul ba/bslab pa gsum dang rim gnyis kyi/ /rtogs pa'i chos kyi nor bu'i gter/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /lung gi chos kyi nam mkha'i mdzod/ /mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom khyed 'dra 265

nyams su len na mang mi dgos/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob pa'i phyir/ /lus lhar bsgom ngag gis bzlas brjod gyis/ /sems gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la zhog /dge 'dis mtshon dus gsum gang bsags pa/ /rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo/ /slar sprul sku gsal po myur byon nas/ /rang gzhan kun rjes su 'dzin par shog /ces blangs nas/ da sprul sku re byung na snyam re ba byas pa bzhin chu bzang du 'khrungs bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa zhig byung / yang 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i hor rgya'i sku skyes dang / bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i ye shes dar rgyas gnyis kyis/ nyin cig bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas te skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la zhu ba/ snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi cha med la chos mang po shes rung bsgom lo mi 'dug pas/ da ni rje mi la yab sras sogs bka' brgyud gong ma'i thugs dam gyi mthil/ gcig shes kun grol 'od gsal phyag rgya chen bo'i gnad kyi gdams ngag cig gnang du gsol zhes slar yang zhu don glu ru phul ba/bslab pa gsum dang rim gnyis kyi/ /rtogs pa'i chos kyi nor bu'i gter/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /lung gi chos kyi nam mkha'i mdzod/ /mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom khyed 'dra 265

ba/ /deng sang 'dzam gling 'di na dkon/ /bsod nams can zhig ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan ma khyed dang mjal ba dka'/ /ngo mtshar skyes mchog rin po che/ /khyed la nged gnyis mjal lugs kyis/ /skal ldan bu gnyis yin nam snyam/ /rab tu dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /mgon khyed nyams la shar ba yi/ /nges don nyams mgur gsung du gsol/ /khyed kyi nyams mgur nang bzhin du/ /nged gnyis nyams su len par bya/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod kyis/ /rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /khyed kyi gsung bzhin sgrub pa la/ /nam yang brtson pa bgyid par smon/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yang rang lus snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong zhing bdag med pa spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu/ tshur las bzang ngan gyi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel sna tshogs la brten nas snang ba rnams nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang gi zla ba/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin snang bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du snang / snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu 'di sems kyis byas/ sems sa snang /sems kyi rnam rol/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo ni gdod nas/ stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral 266

ba/ /deng sang 'dzam gling 'di na dkon/ /bsod nams can zhig ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan ma khyed dang mjal ba dka'/ /ngo mtshar skyes mchog rin po che/ /khyed la nged gnyis mjal lugs kyis/ /skal ldan bu gnyis yin nam snyam/ /rab tu dga' zhing spro ba skyes/ /mgon khyed nyams la shar ba yi/ /nges don nyams mgur gsung du gsol/ /khyed kyi nyams mgur nang bzhin du/ /nged gnyis nyams su len par bya/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod kyis/ /rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /khyed kyi gsung bzhin sgrub pa la/ /nam yang brtson pa bgyid par smon/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yang rang lus snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong zhing bdag med pa spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu/ tshur las bzang ngan gyi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel sna tshogs la brten nas snang ba rnams nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang gi zla ba/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin snang bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du snang / snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu 'di sems kyis byas/ sems sa snang /sems kyi rnam rol/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo ni gdod nas/ stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral 266

nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la yin par ngo shes nas de'i ngang la nam mkha' ltar dpangs bstod/ sa gzhi ltar rgya bskyed/ ri bo ltar lhun phob/ nyi zla ltar gsal thob/ shel gong bzhin zang thal ler zhog de ltar bzhag pas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam ste dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong zhes nyams mgur 'di blangs so//dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i sems kyi dbyings/ /de rjen par ston mdzad bla mar 'dud/ /rje mi la yab sras thugs dam mthil/ /chos phyag chen lta ba'i glu dbyangs len/ /sems rang ngo ma 'phrod 'khor bar 'khyams/ /ngo 'phrod na tshe rabs kun tu bde/ /'di bka' brgyud gong mas rjen par gzigs/ /gzhan 'o skal rnams kyis ngos ma zin/ /rje bla ma mkhas pas ngo sprad na/ /sems stong gsal 'dzin med ngo bo de/ /dpe spros bral nam mkha' lta bur mthong / /de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog nus na/ /las nyon mongs rtogs tshogs sprin ltar dwangs/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan nyi ltar 'char/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /sems chos sku'i rang zhal mjal bar 267

nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la yin par ngo shes nas de'i ngang la nam mkha' ltar dpangs bstod/ sa gzhi ltar rgya bskyed/ ri bo ltar lhun phob/ nyi zla ltar gsal thob/ shel gong bzhin zang thal ler zhog de ltar bzhag pas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam ste dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong zhes nyams mgur 'di blangs so//dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i sems kyi dbyings/ /de rjen par ston mdzad bla mar 'dud/ /rje mi la yab sras thugs dam mthil/ /chos phyag chen lta ba'i glu dbyangs len/ /sems rang ngo ma 'phrod 'khor bar 'khyams/ /ngo 'phrod na tshe rabs kun tu bde/ /'di bka' brgyud gong mas rjen par gzigs/ /gzhan 'o skal rnams kyis ngos ma zin/ /rje bla ma mkhas pas ngo sprad na/ /sems stong gsal 'dzin med ngo bo de/ /dpe spros bral nam mkha' lta bur mthong / /de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog nus na/ /las nyon mongs rtogs tshogs sprin ltar dwangs/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan nyi ltar 'char/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /sems chos sku'i rang zhal mjal bar 267

shog /ces pa dang / yang /thugs dgongs nam mkha' las yangs pa'i/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams mkhyen no/ /gu yangs blo bde ngas sems ngo / /skyong tshul glu dbyangs su len no/ /chos rnams thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ /rang sems gdod ma yi gnas lugs/ /stong gsal mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i/ /nam mkha' lta bu yi ngang la/ /shes pa glod nas rang zhog dang / /nyon mongs sprin tshogs kun dag nas/ /rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i/ /'khrul zhig rnal 'byor zhig 'byung nges/ /snang grags chos rnams kun snang stong / /'ja' tshon brag cha ltar ltos la/ /ma rtogs 'gro ba la snying rje/ /sgoms la phan thogs rang mdzod cig /'di nyid mthong thos kyi 'gro rnams/ /'chi ba chos sku ru grol nas/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyi 'gro don/ /dpag med 'byung bar rang sgon no/ /zhes blangs pas gnyis shar blo bskyed chen po byung / rjes su tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur nyams su blangs pas/ sprin med nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin sgom byung gi shes rab phyogs med du brdol nas/gsar rnying ris med kyi chos thams cad la mkhas par gyur te/bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo //268

shog /ces pa dang / yang /thugs dgongs nam mkha' las yangs pa'i/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams mkhyen no/ /gu yangs blo bde ngas sems ngo / /skyong tshul glu dbyangs su len no/ /chos rnams thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ /rang sems gdod ma yi gnas lugs/ /stong gsal mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i/ /nam mkha' lta bu yi ngang la/ /shes pa glod nas rang zhog dang / /nyon mongs sprin tshogs kun dag nas/ /rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i/ /'khrul zhig rnal 'byor zhig 'byung nges/ /snang grags chos rnams kun snang stong / /'ja' tshon brag cha ltar ltos la/ /ma rtogs 'gro ba la snying rje/ /sgoms la phan thogs rang mdzod cig /'di nyid mthong thos kyi 'gro rnams/ /'chi ba chos sku ru grol nas/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyi 'gro don/ /dpag med 'byung bar rang sgon no/ /zhes blangs pas gnyis shar blo bskyed chen po byung / rjes su tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur nyams su blangs pas/ sprin med nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin sgom byung gi shes rab phyogs med du brdol nas/gsar rnying ris med kyi chos thams cad la mkhas par gyur te/bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo //268

yang nyin cig nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la nyi ma shar sprin dkar gzhon nu phyogs phyogs nas langs/ bya rgyal rgod po mang po 'khor ba mthong bas rkyen byas nyams mgur 'di blangs so/ /dgongs pa zab mo ni nam mkha'i pha mtha' dang mnyam zhing / /ci yang sa le rang gzigs pa'i rdo rje 'chang mkhyen no/ /dgung sngon mthon po yi dkyil na bya rgod ni spro bzhin/ /sems nyid khyab gdal gye klong na snal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /sprin dkar gzhon nu yi tshogs rnams nam mkha' la rdol bzhin/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong klong nas rang brdol byung / /'od gsal nyi ma yi 'od kyis 'dzam gling kun khyab bzhin/ /rtogs ldan rnal 'byor nga'i snying rjes 'gro kun la khyab song / /skyi bser rlung po kho chags med bar snang la rgyu bzhin/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga phyogs med 'gro don la chas 'gro/ /'khrul zhig rnal 'byor nga bka' brgyud gong ma yi bu rgyud/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi nyams mgur 'di 'dra rang blangs yong / /mi la yab sras kyi bu rgyud rtogs ldan gyi tshogs rnams/ /dben par nyams mgur 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang longs shog /nam zhig mngon dga' sogs dag pa'i zhing khams ni mang por/ /'di 'dra'i mgur dbyangs 'dra len bzhin 'gro bar rang smon 269

yang nyin cig nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la nyi ma shar sprin dkar gzhon nu phyogs phyogs nas langs/ bya rgyal rgod po mang po 'khor ba mthong bas rkyen byas nyams mgur 'di blangs so/ /dgongs pa zab mo ni nam mkha'i pha mtha' dang mnyam zhing / /ci yang sa le rang gzigs pa'i rdo rje 'chang mkhyen no/ /dgung sngon mthon po yi dkyil na bya rgod ni spro bzhin/ /sems nyid khyab gdal gye klong na snal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /sprin dkar gzhon nu yi tshogs rnams nam mkha' la rdol bzhin/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong klong nas rang brdol byung / /'od gsal nyi ma yi 'od kyis 'dzam gling kun khyab bzhin/ /rtogs ldan rnal 'byor nga'i snying rjes 'gro kun la khyab song / /skyi bser rlung po kho chags med bar snang la rgyu bzhin/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga phyogs med 'gro don la chas 'gro/ /'khrul zhig rnal 'byor nga bka' brgyud gong ma yi bu rgyud/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi nyams mgur 'di 'dra rang blangs yong / /mi la yab sras kyi bu rgyud rtogs ldan gyi tshogs rnams/ /dben par nyams mgur 'dra len na 'di 'dra rang longs shog /nam zhig mngon dga' sogs dag pa'i zhing khams ni mang por/ /'di 'dra'i mgur dbyangs 'dra len bzhin 'gro bar rang smon 269

no/ /zhes blangs pas/ gnas der 'khod pa'i skal bzang slob ma rnams kyi sems kha yangs su song snying rje che ru song nas/mthong thos kyi sems can la phan thogs pa byung ngo / /yang nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel ba na yod dus/ khri gung thang pa rin po che'i gsung gi nyams myong rgad po'i 'bel gtam yid 'byung dmar khrid mthong bas rkyen byas/ yid la rang gzhan chos la bskul ba'i rgan gzhon gyi gtam ngo mtshar sems kyi ri mo zhes bya ba 'di shar byung /'o sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pa rang nyid skabs shigakun gsal chos dbyings bde ba chen po zer ba'i ri mthon po zhig gi rtser phyin nas/ khams bsang byas phyogs thams cad la ltad mo bltas pas/ 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo ci yang mthong zhing / nyin cig mngon mtho lha mi 'tshogs pa'i skyed tshal nyams dga' ba zhig na/ ngo mtshar can gyi rdo rje tshe ring zer ba'i mi rgan mgo'i skra dkar kha'i so lhung thod pa gnyer ma chags pa rgas pa'i mtshan mas non pa zhig ngal gso zhing 'dug pa la/ ya mtshan can gyi bkra shis don 'grub zer ba'i gzugs mdzes 270

skad snyan sems gsal ba lang tsho dar la babs pa blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig 'ongs nas/ mi rgan de la 'di skad zer bar gda'/ mi rgan rdo rje tshe ring / /khyod kyi lus rten 'gyur nas/ /gzhon pa nga dang mi 'dra/ /lus por ci zhig byung song / /zer ba'i lan du/ mi rgan gyis smras pa/ gzhon nu sha rgyas khrag rgyas/ /nga yang sngon chad khyod 'dra/ /rgas pas dbang med non nas/ /'di 'dra zhig tu gyur song / /khyod kyang lo 'ga'i 'phro na/ /nga 'dra zhig la tshegs med/ /de bas gzhon nu'i dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i chos shig mdzod ang / /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ gzhon nu na re/ sngon chad mi zhig rgas shing / /'chi rgyu med pa e mthong / /phyin chad rgas nas 'chi rgyu/ /med pa'i mi 'dra e yong / /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ mi rgan na re/ mi ngas 'jig rten khams 'dir/ /rgas nas 'chi rgyu med pa/ /sngon nas da bar ma mthong / /phyin chad mthong bar mi 'gyur/ /de phyir gzhon nu don 'grub/ /da lta ma rgas gong 'dir/ /myur du lha chos gyis shig /mi rgan snying gtam yin zer/ /yar langs ga le byas ma ṇi ring 'don thung 'don byas phar song tshe/ gzhon nu de rjes su song nas/ mi rgan la/ kho bos gzhon thog 'di ru/ /chos shig byas na 'dod pas/ /lha chos byas pa'i phan yon/ /khyod kyis 271

skad snyan sems gsal ba lang tsho dar la babs pa blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig 'ongs nas/ mi rgan de la 'di skad zer bar gda'/ mi rgan rdo rje tshe ring / /khyod kyi lus rten 'gyur nas/ /gzhon pa nga dang mi 'dra/ /lus por ci zhig byung song / /zer ba'i lan du/ mi rgan gyis smras pa/ gzhon nu sha rgyas khrag rgyas/ /nga yang sngon chad khyod 'dra/ /rgas pas dbang med non nas/ /'di 'dra zhig tu gyur song / /khyod kyang lo 'ga'i 'phro na/ /nga 'dra zhig la tshegs med/ /de bas gzhon nu'i dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i chos shig mdzod ang / /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ gzhon nu na re/ sngon chad mi zhig rgas shing / /'chi rgyu med pa e mthong / /phyin chad rgas nas 'chi rgyu/ /med pa'i mi 'dra e yong / /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ mi rgan na re/ mi ngas 'jig rten khams 'dir/ /rgas nas 'chi rgyu med pa/ /sngon nas da bar ma mthong / /phyin chad mthong bar mi 'gyur/ /de phyir gzhon nu don 'grub/ /da lta ma rgas gong 'dir/ /myur du lha chos gyis shig /mi rgan snying gtam yin zer/ /yar langs ga le byas ma ṇi ring 'don thung 'don byas phar song tshe/ gzhon nu de rjes su song nas/ mi rgan la/ kho bos gzhon thog 'di ru/ /chos shig byas na 'dod pas/ /lha chos byas pa'i phan yon/ /khyod kyis 271

cung zad shod dang / /byas pa/ yang mi rgan na re/ lha chos byas na tshe 'dir/ /bde zhing phyi mar sangs rgyas/ /rgas rung 'chi bar mi 'tsher/ /'chi khar dga' spro 'char nges/ /zhes smras pas/ gzhon nu'i sems dam pa'i chos la 'gyur nas mi rgan la/chos byed na ji ltar byed dgos zhes pas/ mi rgan na re/ chos shig snying nas byed na/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten la/ /sngon du skyes bu gsum gyi/ /lam la rim pas rgyud sbyongs/ /de nas rdo rje theg pa'i/ /dbang zhus dbang dus khas blangs/ /sdom pa dam tshig bsrung la/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi nyams len/ /khyad par rdzogs rim mthar thug /'od gsal phyag chen sgoms dang / /tshe gcig lus gcig po la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob nges/ /mi rgan nga ni tshe 'dir/ /de 'dra can po ma red/ /ma ṇi cha re 'don dang / /phyi mar de gas phan zer/ /de go ba dang mnyam du gzhon nu de yul du yang ma log par/ lung ba'i phu de na mngon dga' chos gling zer ba'i ri khrod nyams dga' zhig na/ ma nor thar pa'i lam ston zer ba'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig bzhugs pa'i sku drung du song nas/ bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin du bsten nas mdo sngags gnyis la thos pa byas/ yang yang bsams nas sgro 'dogs chod tshe/ tshe blos 272

btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su song ste/ gcig pur rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas mthar grub pa thob nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba byung / de lha mi kun gyis mthong zhing thos pas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya lha mi gzhon nu mang pos dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pas tshe 'dir gtan gyi lam sna zin te/rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa mang po byung bar gyur to/ /zhes rgan gzhon gnyis kyi gtam ngo mtshar sems kyi ri mo zhes bya ba 'di bris nas/ slob ma yon bdag yongs la bstan pas kun gye sems la go rgyu chen po byung / yang blo ldan bu chen pad+ma kun grol gyes zhal gdams dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /khyed kyis mdo sngags 'gal med rtogs/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel gdams par go /rgyal ba'i dgongs don ji bzhin rnyed/ /chos spong dri ma kun dang bral/ /bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag mchog /grub mtha' yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /'di phyi bar do'i gtan gye skyabs/ /273

btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su song ste/ gcig pur rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas mthar grub pa thob nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba byung / de lha mi kun gyis mthong zhing thos pas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya lha mi gzhon nu mang pos dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pas tshe 'dir gtan gyi lam sna zin te/rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa mang po byung bar gyur to/ /zhes rgan gzhon gnyis kyi gtam ngo mtshar sems kyi ri mo zhes bya ba 'di bris nas/ slob ma yon bdag yongs la bstan pas kun gye sems la go rgyu chen po byung / yang blo ldan bu chen pad+ma kun grol gyes zhal gdams dgos zhes zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /khyed kyis mdo sngags 'gal med rtogs/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel gdams par go /rgyal ba'i dgongs don ji bzhin rnyed/ /chos spong dri ma kun dang bral/ /bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag mchog /grub mtha' yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /'di phyi bar do'i gtan gye skyabs/ /273

mgon khyod zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ /thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad zhu/ /bdag gzhan yongs la phan thogs pa'i/ /zab rgya'i gdams pa stsal du gsol/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung / /khyed kyi gsung bzhin 'grub pa'i mthus/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o de yang myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i skal bzang las 'phro can gyis tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su/mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i gsung bzhin dal 'byor rnyed dka'/'chi ba mi rtag pa las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa rnams sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi rang la sngar bla mas sems ngo sprad pa ltar/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar sems kyi rol pa dang /sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med nam mkha' ltar shes par bya/ de'i ngang la shes pa lhod kyis glod nas mnyam par bzhag yang rnam rtog skyes pa byung na sngar bzhin bzhag pas/ rtog tshogs thams cad rang sar grol nas dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong / mjug tu dge ba rdzogs 274

mgon khyod zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ /thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad zhu/ /bdag gzhan yongs la phan thogs pa'i/ /zab rgya'i gdams pa stsal du gsol/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung / /khyed kyi gsung bzhin 'grub pa'i mthus/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o de yang myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i skal bzang las 'phro can gyis tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su/mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i gsung bzhin dal 'byor rnyed dka'/'chi ba mi rtag pa las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa rnams sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi rang la sngar bla mas sems ngo sprad pa ltar/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar sems kyi rol pa dang /sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med nam mkha' ltar shes par bya/ de'i ngang la shes pa lhod kyis glod nas mnyam par bzhag yang rnam rtog skyes pa byung na sngar bzhin bzhag pas/ rtog tshogs thams cad rang sar grol nas dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong / mjug tu dge ba rdzogs 274

byang du bsngo zhing smon lam rgya chen po gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje mtshan ldan bla ma yi bzhin nor/ /steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /yid mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /dpe dpag bsam ljon shing lta bu yi/ /rje bla mar dad gus rab che ba'i/ /bu bsam don chos bzhin 'grub rgyu bo/ /khyod 'di 'dra'i yid smon gyis shig ang / /dpe sprin bral nam mkha'i dbyings rum nas/ /'od rab gsal nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /sems skye med spros bral ngang nyid las/ /phyogs kun khyab snying rje shar na ang / /dpe mtho la yangs pa'i lha lam la/ /bya rgod pos gshog rtsal sbyong ba bzhin/ /yul rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nyams rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyong byas na ang / /dpe mkha' la sprin phung cher 'khrigs nas/ /sa yangs sar char ba 'bab pa bzhin/ /rang rgyud la byang chub sems 'byongs nas/ /ma 'gro la chos char phab na ang / /dpe char bas sa gzhi brlan pa na/ /sa'i gseb nas me tog skye ba bzhin/ /chos zab mos gzhan gyi rgyud smin nas/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas na ang / /275

byang du bsngo zhing smon lam rgya chen po gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//rje mtshan ldan bla ma yi bzhin nor/ /steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /yid mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /dpe dpag bsam ljon shing lta bu yi/ /rje bla mar dad gus rab che ba'i/ /bu bsam don chos bzhin 'grub rgyu bo/ /khyod 'di 'dra'i yid smon gyis shig ang / /dpe sprin bral nam mkha'i dbyings rum nas/ /'od rab gsal nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /sems skye med spros bral ngang nyid las/ /phyogs kun khyab snying rje shar na ang / /dpe mtho la yangs pa'i lha lam la/ /bya rgod pos gshog rtsal sbyong ba bzhin/ /yul rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nyams rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyong byas na ang / /dpe mkha' la sprin phung cher 'khrigs nas/ /sa yangs sar char ba 'bab pa bzhin/ /rang rgyud la byang chub sems 'byongs nas/ /ma 'gro la chos char phab na ang / /dpe char bas sa gzhi brlan pa na/ /sa'i gseb nas me tog skye ba bzhin/ /chos zab mos gzhan gyi rgyud smin nas/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas na ang / /275

zhes blangs pa ltar kho rang gis kyang yid smon byas so/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i dge rgan dge 'dun bde legs kyis nyin cig lha rdzas bcas zhu yig tshigs bcad 'di phul byung /ston pa thugs rje chen po yis/ /sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gnyen po ru/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /gsung bzhin kun gyis sgrub dka' yang / /mgon khyod nges 'byung go khrab gyon/ /byang chub sems kyi snying stobs bskyed/ /yang dag lta ba'i mdung ring thogs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i thang thog nas/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dgra la 'thab/ /thams cad chos kyi dbyengs su bsgral/ /rgyab rten rtsa gsum lha rnams kyis/ /nyon mongs g.yul rgyal rnga chen brdung / /snyan dang grags pa'i dar chen 'phyar/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid dpa' dar gnang / /dpa' bo khrom gshog cho lo btags/ /de 'dra'i dpa' bo chen pa yi/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig bshags mdzad pa rjes su rang / /chos gsung mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ /dge tshogs zhabs pad brtan phyir bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung / /gcig la gsung rung kun la phan/ /thogs pa'i mgur zhig gsung du 276

zhes blangs pa ltar kho rang gis kyang yid smon byas so/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i dge rgan dge 'dun bde legs kyis nyin cig lha rdzas bcas zhu yig tshigs bcad 'di phul byung /ston pa thugs rje chen po yis/ /sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gnyen po ru/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /gsung bzhin kun gyis sgrub dka' yang / /mgon khyod nges 'byung go khrab gyon/ /byang chub sems kyi snying stobs bskyed/ /yang dag lta ba'i mdung ring thogs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i thang thog nas/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dgra la 'thab/ /thams cad chos kyi dbyengs su bsgral/ /rgyab rten rtsa gsum lha rnams kyis/ /nyon mongs g.yul rgyal rnga chen brdung / /snyan dang grags pa'i dar chen 'phyar/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid dpa' dar gnang / /dpa' bo khrom gshog cho lo btags/ /de 'dra'i dpa' bo chen pa yi/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig bshags mdzad pa rjes su rang / /chos gsung mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ /dge tshogs zhabs pad brtan phyir bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung / /gcig la gsung rung kun la phan/ /thogs pa'i mgur zhig gsung du 276

gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o sngon sku mched gsum gyis 'brom rin po che la/ chos dang chos ma yin pa 'byed pa'i gnam thig gang lags zhus pas/ 'brom rin po ches/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro na chos yin/ mi 'gro na chos min gsungs/ des na mdo sngags kyi chos gang yin yang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba cig mdzod ces zhal gdams mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//mdo sngags chos kyi mtshon thogs nas/ /nyon mongs dgra nams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma rgyal sras dpa' bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /ri mgo'i pha bong tho ba yis/ /bcos nas mar la 'phen pa ltar/ /mdo lugs pa yis nyon mongs pa/ /gnyen pos spangs nas grol bar byed/ /pha bong steng du me sbar bsregs/ /chu blugs bkas nas gtor ba ltar/ /gsang sngags pa yis nyon mongs pa/ /thabs kyis bsgyur nas grol bar byed/ /pha bong rtsa ba cung zad rlog /'bya' shing brgyab nas rdzogs pa ltar/ /phyag rdzogs pa yis nyon mongs pa/ /spangs bsgyur mi dgos grol bar byed/ /mdo sngags chos ni gang yin yang / /nyon mongs gnyen por 'gro dgos pas/ /bdag 'dzin chags sdang nyon mongs pa'i/ /gnyen por 'gro ba'i chos 277

gsol/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o sngon sku mched gsum gyis 'brom rin po che la/ chos dang chos ma yin pa 'byed pa'i gnam thig gang lags zhus pas/ 'brom rin po ches/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro na chos yin/ mi 'gro na chos min gsungs/ des na mdo sngags kyi chos gang yin yang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba cig mdzod ces zhal gdams mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//mdo sngags chos kyi mtshon thogs nas/ /nyon mongs dgra nams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma rgyal sras dpa' bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /ri mgo'i pha bong tho ba yis/ /bcos nas mar la 'phen pa ltar/ /mdo lugs pa yis nyon mongs pa/ /gnyen pos spangs nas grol bar byed/ /pha bong steng du me sbar bsregs/ /chu blugs bkas nas gtor ba ltar/ /gsang sngags pa yis nyon mongs pa/ /thabs kyis bsgyur nas grol bar byed/ /pha bong rtsa ba cung zad rlog /'bya' shing brgyab nas rdzogs pa ltar/ /phyag rdzogs pa yis nyon mongs pa/ /spangs bsgyur mi dgos grol bar byed/ /mdo sngags chos ni gang yin yang / /nyon mongs gnyen por 'gro dgos pas/ /bdag 'dzin chags sdang nyon mongs pa'i/ /gnyen por 'gro ba'i chos 277

de zab/ /nyon mongs gnyen por mi 'gro ba'i/ /chos dang gang zag bzang zer yang / /dgra bo gsod par mi nus pa'i/ /dpa' bo mtshon cha bzang dang 'dra/ /dpa' bos mtshon cha gcig gis kyang / /dgra rnams thams cad 'joms pa ltar/ /chos pas gdams ngag gcig gis kyang / /nyon mongs thams cad 'jom pa dgos/ /deng sang chos pa mang na yang / /nyon mongs thul ba nyung bar gda'/ /zab chos mang rung nyon mongs pa'i/ /gnyen por 'gro ba dka' mor gda'/ /de phyir skal ldan slob bu khyod/ /nyon mongs dgra bo 'bur 'joms gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad chos pa yis/ /nyon mongs dgra kun thul bar shog /ces blangs pas kun gyi rgyud la phan thogs pa byung /yang mi bskyod rdo rjes/ kho bo la nges don zab mo'i zhal gdams shig gnang dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /mkhas shing grub pa mchog brnyes pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /mgon khyod skye 'gro thams cad la/ /phan pa'i 'dzam gling nyi ma 'dra/ /gsol ba btab nas dgos 'dod kun/ /'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /khyed kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo yi/ /drung du yan lag bdun pa dang / /khyad 278

de zab/ /nyon mongs gnyen por mi 'gro ba'i/ /chos dang gang zag bzang zer yang / /dgra bo gsod par mi nus pa'i/ /dpa' bo mtshon cha bzang dang 'dra/ /dpa' bos mtshon cha gcig gis kyang / /dgra rnams thams cad 'joms pa ltar/ /chos pas gdams ngag gcig gis kyang / /nyon mongs thams cad 'jom pa dgos/ /deng sang chos pa mang na yang / /nyon mongs thul ba nyung bar gda'/ /zab chos mang rung nyon mongs pa'i/ /gnyen por 'gro ba dka' mor gda'/ /de phyir skal ldan slob bu khyod/ /nyon mongs dgra bo 'bur 'joms gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad chos pa yis/ /nyon mongs dgra kun thul bar shog /ces blangs pas kun gyi rgyud la phan thogs pa byung /yang mi bskyod rdo rjes/ kho bo la nges don zab mo'i zhal gdams shig gnang dgos zhes zhu don dbyangs su phul ba/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /mkhas shing grub pa mchog brnyes pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /mgon khyod skye 'gro thams cad la/ /phan pa'i 'dzam gling nyi ma 'dra/ /gsol ba btab nas dgos 'dod kun/ /'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /khyed kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo yi/ /drung du yan lag bdun pa dang / /khyad 278

par lus dang longs spyod dge/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'bul/ /skyabs mgon khyed kyi snyan lam du/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma mchis te/ /bdag gzhan yongs la phan thogs pa'i/ /zab mo'i gdams pa zhu ba lags/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /mgon khyod 'bral med bsten par shog /zab mo'i gdams pa nyams blangs nas/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o skal ldan bu myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis tshe blos btang nas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin du bsten te/lam thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rim pas rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bla mar gsol ba 'debs shing / dbang bzhi len thugs yid bsres/ de nas sngar bla mas sems ngo sprad pa'i nang ltar chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems nyid kyi ngo bo stong gsal spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la lhod kyis glod nas bzhag tshe/ bying rgod gang yang med par stong sang nge / gsal trig ge dga' yal le gnas pa'i ngos/ rnam rtog gang shar kyang / de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar sngar rgyun ltar mnyam par bzhag pas/ rnam rtog gang shar rang 279

par lus dang longs spyod dge/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'bul/ /skyabs mgon khyed kyi snyan lam du/ /zhu ba don gzhan ma mchis te/ /bdag gzhan yongs la phan thogs pa'i/ /zab mo'i gdams pa zhu ba lags/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /mgon khyod 'bral med bsten par shog /zab mo'i gdams pa nyams blangs nas/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/ 'o skal ldan bu myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis tshe blos btang nas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin du bsten te/lam thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rim pas rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bla mar gsol ba 'debs shing / dbang bzhi len thugs yid bsres/ de nas sngar bla mas sems ngo sprad pa'i nang ltar chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems nyid kyi ngo bo stong gsal spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la lhod kyis glod nas bzhag tshe/ bying rgod gang yang med par stong sang nge / gsal trig ge dga' yal le gnas pa'i ngos/ rnam rtog gang shar kyang / de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar sngar rgyun ltar mnyam par bzhag pas/ rnam rtog gang shar rang 279

sar grol nas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam yong / de'i rjes su ma sems can la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam thob/ phan gang thogs la 'bod dang / tshe 'dir yang bstan 'gro mang po la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so//bde chen chos sku yi rnam rol/ /bde gshegs chos rgyal ni yab yum/ /bde chen 'khor lo ru bzhugs la/ /bde stong ye shes ni stsol cig /phyag rdzogs do ha sogs gsang sngags/ /zab mo'i nye lam la zhugs nas/ /bde chen sangs rgyas sar 'gro ba'i/ /skal bzang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /bde stong ting 'dzin ros myos nas/ /mig gi lta stangs yang nam mkha'i/ /khams su rang shugs kyis shor bas/ /rtogs ldan rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'bar/ /nyams kyi rtsal sbyong gi phyir du/ /nyams mgur sna tshogs rang len pa'i/ /'khrul zhig rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'dra nga min/ /deng sang len mkhan ni mi snang / /phyi rabs sgom chen pa'i tshogs rnams/ /skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'dra longs shig /'dis mtshon dus gsum gyi dge tshogs/ /bstan 'gror phan phyir du bsngo 'o/ /bstan pa dar zhing ni rgyas la/ /'gro kun bde 280

sar grol nas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam yong / de'i rjes su ma sems can la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam thob/ phan gang thogs la 'bod dang / tshe 'dir yang bstan 'gro mang po la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so//bde chen chos sku yi rnam rol/ /bde gshegs chos rgyal ni yab yum/ /bde chen 'khor lo ru bzhugs la/ /bde stong ye shes ni stsol cig /phyag rdzogs do ha sogs gsang sngags/ /zab mo'i nye lam la zhugs nas/ /bde chen sangs rgyas sar 'gro ba'i/ /skal bzang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /bde stong ting 'dzin ros myos nas/ /mig gi lta stangs yang nam mkha'i/ /khams su rang shugs kyis shor bas/ /rtogs ldan rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'bar/ /nyams kyi rtsal sbyong gi phyir du/ /nyams mgur sna tshogs rang len pa'i/ /'khrul zhig rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'dra nga min/ /deng sang len mkhan ni mi snang / /phyi rabs sgom chen pa'i tshogs rnams/ /skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'dra longs shig /'dis mtshon dus gsum gyi dge tshogs/ /bstan 'gror phan phyir du bsngo 'o/ /bstan pa dar zhing ni rgyas la/ /'gro kun bde 280

zhing rang skyid shog /ces blangs pas/ kho rang gi tshe 'di'i bya ba rnams blos btang nas mdo smad kyi ri khrod rnams dang /dbus gtsang gi ri khrod rnams 'grims nas/ sgrub pa snying por byas bsgrubs 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa'i chos pa bzang po zhig byung ngo / /yang dbus su lo snga ma yar song ba'i kun dga' yos lo'i ston kha phyir thon pa'i 'byor lan mtshams zhus la/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i bla ma sbyin pa nor bus rgya gar li ser las grub pa'i tshe sgu dang / gser gyi tshe bum/ dngul gye bdun tshar/ gos chen gyi stod 'gags/ ther ma'i sham thabs/gos chen gye na bza'/ 'go rnam gyi stod thung / gtsugs rug gi thul ba/ smyug sgrog chab ril sogs dngos po rtsa can mang po rdo tshad lnga'i rtsis/ bla ma gangs ri bas dngul rdo tshad gcig gi rgyu song yod pa'i nga'i 'dra sku/ bla ma ye shes kyis gser gyi ga'u g.yu drug dkar gyi phra ldan/ stod 'gags rgyan drug bla ma lo chen pa dang / bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho/ rtsa chang dga'/ chos drung spun gsum sogs slob ma yon bdag mang pos na bza' cha tshang re re/ gser gye tshe bum dang dngul gyi mchod kong che chung bdun la sogs pa'i dngos po rdo tshad bcu lhag cig gi rtsis 281

zhing rang skyid shog /ces blangs pas/ kho rang gi tshe 'di'i bya ba rnams blos btang nas mdo smad kyi ri khrod rnams dang /dbus gtsang gi ri khrod rnams 'grims nas/ sgrub pa snying por byas bsgrubs 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa'i chos pa bzang po zhig byung ngo / /yang dbus su lo snga ma yar song ba'i kun dga' yos lo'i ston kha phyir thon pa'i 'byor lan mtshams zhus la/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i bla ma sbyin pa nor bus rgya gar li ser las grub pa'i tshe sgu dang / gser gyi tshe bum/ dngul gye bdun tshar/ gos chen gyi stod 'gags/ ther ma'i sham thabs/gos chen gye na bza'/ 'go rnam gyi stod thung / gtsugs rug gi thul ba/ smyug sgrog chab ril sogs dngos po rtsa can mang po rdo tshad lnga'i rtsis/ bla ma gangs ri bas dngul rdo tshad gcig gi rgyu song yod pa'i nga'i 'dra sku/ bla ma ye shes kyis gser gyi ga'u g.yu drug dkar gyi phra ldan/ stod 'gags rgyan drug bla ma lo chen pa dang / bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho/ rtsa chang dga'/ chos drung spun gsum sogs slob ma yon bdag mang pos na bza' cha tshang re re/ gser gye tshe bum dang dngul gyi mchod kong che chung bdun la sogs pa'i dngos po rdo tshad bcu lhag cig gi rtsis 281

tsam phul nas/ yar phebs dgos tshul gyi zhu shog la bla ma sbyin pa nor bus tshigs su bcad nas phul ba 'di lta ste/dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /'khor 'das kyi dpal mgon zhabs dkar pa/ /mkhyen brtse ba lung rtogs mnga' bdag la/ /gsol 'debs kyi nga ro 'di skad sgog /khri gdugs kyi nyi ma shar ba'i 'og /shar phyogs kyi mdo smad sa cha na/ /dben pa dang grong dgon nges med na/ /'di phyi yi skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter/ /sangs rgyas kyi mi gzugs de ko bzhugs/ /mtshan snyan gyi zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang / /gus ldan gyi bu la yud tsam dgongs/ /gangs can gye sprang 'khyams sbyin pa bdag /'byung 'dus kyi phung po rim gyis rgas/ /lam ston gye chos rje snying nas dran/ /nyin mtshan du khyod min bsam dran bral/ /mdzes sku dang bral nas yun ring thal/ /yi mug la sangs pa'i dus skabs med/ /thugs rje re chung ngam rin po che/ /gser zhal gyi snang brnyan mi ston nam/ /sdug bsngal 'di sangs par mi mdzad dam/ /bod stod kyi sprang 'khyams sbyin pa bdag /sngon sgon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /gnas yongs grags gangs dkar te se ru/ /rje sangs rgyas khyed drung bsnyegs pa'i dus/ /sku gzi brjid 'od 'bar lham mer 282

tsam phul nas/ yar phebs dgos tshul gyi zhu shog la bla ma sbyin pa nor bus tshigs su bcad nas phul ba 'di lta ste/dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /'khor 'das kyi dpal mgon zhabs dkar pa/ /mkhyen brtse ba lung rtogs mnga' bdag la/ /gsol 'debs kyi nga ro 'di skad sgog /khri gdugs kyi nyi ma shar ba'i 'og /shar phyogs kyi mdo smad sa cha na/ /dben pa dang grong dgon nges med na/ /'di phyi yi skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter/ /sangs rgyas kyi mi gzugs de ko bzhugs/ /mtshan snyan gyi zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang / /gus ldan gyi bu la yud tsam dgongs/ /gangs can gye sprang 'khyams sbyin pa bdag /'byung 'dus kyi phung po rim gyis rgas/ /lam ston gye chos rje snying nas dran/ /nyin mtshan du khyod min bsam dran bral/ /mdzes sku dang bral nas yun ring thal/ /yi mug la sangs pa'i dus skabs med/ /thugs rje re chung ngam rin po che/ /gser zhal gyi snang brnyan mi ston nam/ /sdug bsngal 'di sangs par mi mdzad dam/ /bod stod kyi sprang 'khyams sbyin pa bdag /sngon sgon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /gnas yongs grags gangs dkar te se ru/ /rje sangs rgyas khyed drung bsnyegs pa'i dus/ /sku gzi brjid 'od 'bar lham mer 282

mjal/ /zhal mthong ba tsam gyes snang ba 'gyur/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong legs 'doms pa'i/ /gsung thos pa tsam gyis nges shes skyes/ /dbyengs 'od gsal mkha' ltar klong yangs pa'i/ /thugs dran pa tsam gyis byin rlabs zhugs/ /pha rje btsun thugs rje'i lcags kyu des/ /bu skal ldan bdag gi snying la zug /las nyon mongs rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi/ /gnas khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /dus da re phyi phyag 'tshal nas kyang / /lam byang chub skam sar phyin pa 'di/ /pha sangs rgyas khyed kyi bka' drin yin/ /don de phyir rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku/ /khyed bka' drin mi chung che bar 'khums/ /sprang bka' drin dran pa sbyin pa'i ming / /drin 'jal blo'i nus pa cher med kyang / /rje khyed kyi dri med rnam thar ltar/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs la gang phan dang / /rje chos skur mthong ba'i mos gus la/ /dus nam yang rgyun chad yod re skan/ /gtam rin po che yi phreng ba 'di/ /pha bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod sprin mdzod/ /glu 'di ko sku drin dran pa'i glu/ /dbyangs rol mor 'bul lo skyabs kyi mchog /da zhu ba don gye snying po la/ /rje thugs rje bdag nyid yud tsam dgongs/ /sems skyo ba'i smre sngags 'di la dgongs/ /sa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams 'dir/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje spon lam 283

mjal/ /zhal mthong ba tsam gyes snang ba 'gyur/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong legs 'doms pa'i/ /gsung thos pa tsam gyis nges shes skyes/ /dbyengs 'od gsal mkha' ltar klong yangs pa'i/ /thugs dran pa tsam gyis byin rlabs zhugs/ /pha rje btsun thugs rje'i lcags kyu des/ /bu skal ldan bdag gi snying la zug /las nyon mongs rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi/ /gnas khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /dus da re phyi phyag 'tshal nas kyang / /lam byang chub skam sar phyin pa 'di/ /pha sangs rgyas khyed kyi bka' drin yin/ /don de phyir rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku/ /khyed bka' drin mi chung che bar 'khums/ /sprang bka' drin dran pa sbyin pa'i ming / /drin 'jal blo'i nus pa cher med kyang / /rje khyed kyi dri med rnam thar ltar/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs la gang phan dang / /rje chos skur mthong ba'i mos gus la/ /dus nam yang rgyun chad yod re skan/ /gtam rin po che yi phreng ba 'di/ /pha bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod sprin mdzod/ /glu 'di ko sku drin dran pa'i glu/ /dbyangs rol mor 'bul lo skyabs kyi mchog /da zhu ba don gye snying po la/ /rje thugs rje bdag nyid yud tsam dgongs/ /sems skyo ba'i smre sngags 'di la dgongs/ /sa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams 'dir/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje spon lam 283

mthus/ /bdag skal ldan gdul bya sprin ltar 'thibs/ /lo 'ga' tsam rjes su bzung mod kyang / /de yud tsam rmi lam sgyu ma dngos/ /dus de nas mdo smad phyogs su phebs/ /mi bdag dang slob 'bangs thams cad la/ /mi re re'i snying re 'thon dang ba'i/ /sems sdug bsngal duḥ kha'i khung bur tshud/ /dus de dus 'on kyang zhal bzhes bzang / /khyed bu slob ma sdug nga nyid ni/ /lo bdun nas slebs zhes zhal bzhes mdzad/ /gsung de ko byis pa'i mgo bskor dngos/ /lo bdun po lo ngo bcu bzhir song / /mi rgas po nad dang khur gyis non/ /rje bla mas 'di 'dra'i mdzad pa bstan/ /pha bla ma dran nas bzod glags med/ /'di phod par 'dug gam bka' drin can/ /khong bar snang 'ja' tshon mthong ba'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i mdzes sku yid la shar/ /sku mthong ba don ldan rin po che/ /mtshan dpe yi dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /dgung g.yu 'brug sgra skad thos pa'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i gsung snyan yid la shar/ /gsung tshangs dbyangs kyi mdo sngags chos kyi char/ /da myur myur du phob mdzod bdag cag la/ /dgung sprin bral nam mkha' mthong ba'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs yid la shar/ /dbyangs mkha' klong 'di yin ma mchis kyang / /gnas skabs kyi thugs 'dun bod la gtod/ /284

mthus/ /bdag skal ldan gdul bya sprin ltar 'thibs/ /lo 'ga' tsam rjes su bzung mod kyang / /de yud tsam rmi lam sgyu ma dngos/ /dus de nas mdo smad phyogs su phebs/ /mi bdag dang slob 'bangs thams cad la/ /mi re re'i snying re 'thon dang ba'i/ /sems sdug bsngal duḥ kha'i khung bur tshud/ /dus de dus 'on kyang zhal bzhes bzang / /khyed bu slob ma sdug nga nyid ni/ /lo bdun nas slebs zhes zhal bzhes mdzad/ /gsung de ko byis pa'i mgo bskor dngos/ /lo bdun po lo ngo bcu bzhir song / /mi rgas po nad dang khur gyis non/ /rje bla mas 'di 'dra'i mdzad pa bstan/ /pha bla ma dran nas bzod glags med/ /'di phod par 'dug gam bka' drin can/ /khong bar snang 'ja' tshon mthong ba'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i mdzes sku yid la shar/ /sku mthong ba don ldan rin po che/ /mtshan dpe yi dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /dgung g.yu 'brug sgra skad thos pa'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i gsung snyan yid la shar/ /gsung tshangs dbyangs kyi mdo sngags chos kyi char/ /da myur myur du phob mdzod bdag cag la/ /dgung sprin bral nam mkha' mthong ba'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i thugs dgongs yid la shar/ /dbyangs mkha' klong 'di yin ma mchis kyang / /gnas skabs kyi thugs 'dun bod la gtod/ /284

'od gsal gyi nyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i thugs rje yid la shar/ /da thugs rje yi dpyangs thag ma chad na/ /snying rje yi 'od zer bod la bkye/ /dgung sngon la skar tshogs bkra ba'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i mkhyen brtse yid la shar/ /brtse ba la phyogs ris ma mchis na/ /bdag cag gi mya ngan bsal du gsol/ /brda ji 'dra mthong yang bla ma dran/ /zhal mjal 'dod khong nas me ltar 'bar/ /bdag cag la thugs rjes mi gzigs sam/ /dbus gtsang 'dir chibs kha myur du sgyur/ /mdo smad der kho bo yong nas kyang / /rje bla ma gdan 'dren zhu 'dod kyang / /lo mang gi khur gyis ban rgan non/ /nag po yi skra lo dkar por song / /kha nang gi so dkar rjes med thal/ /dpral ba la gnyer ma'i bang rim chags/ /mda' mo las drang ba'i lus po sgur/ /'byung 'dus kyi lang tsho de ltar rgud/ /lhag par du mdo smad sa thag ring / /ban rgan nga yong ba'i re ba bral/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul rje khyed ni/ /mjes sku ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ /bgres rgud kyi mdzad pa ma bstan par/ /bdag cag gi bsod nams bgo skal lags/ /de'i phyir du skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter/ /thugs rje yi brtse ba rgya bskyed la/ /bod khams 'dir myur du chibs kha sgyur/ /bdag cag gis rje yi bka' bzhin 285

'od gsal gyi nyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i thugs rje yid la shar/ /da thugs rje yi dpyangs thag ma chad na/ /snying rje yi 'od zer bod la bkye/ /dgung sngon la skar tshogs bkra ba'i tshe/ /rje bla ma'i mkhyen brtse yid la shar/ /brtse ba la phyogs ris ma mchis na/ /bdag cag gi mya ngan bsal du gsol/ /brda ji 'dra mthong yang bla ma dran/ /zhal mjal 'dod khong nas me ltar 'bar/ /bdag cag la thugs rjes mi gzigs sam/ /dbus gtsang 'dir chibs kha myur du sgyur/ /mdo smad der kho bo yong nas kyang / /rje bla ma gdan 'dren zhu 'dod kyang / /lo mang gi khur gyis ban rgan non/ /nag po yi skra lo dkar por song / /kha nang gi so dkar rjes med thal/ /dpral ba la gnyer ma'i bang rim chags/ /mda' mo las drang ba'i lus po sgur/ /'byung 'dus kyi lang tsho de ltar rgud/ /lhag par du mdo smad sa thag ring / /ban rgan nga yong ba'i re ba bral/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul rje khyed ni/ /mjes sku ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ /bgres rgud kyi mdzad pa ma bstan par/ /bdag cag gi bsod nams bgo skal lags/ /de'i phyir du skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter/ /thugs rje yi brtse ba rgya bskyed la/ /bod khams 'dir myur du chibs kha sgyur/ /bdag cag gis rje yi bka' bzhin 285

bsgrub/ /'dod dgu yi nor la khyed dgyes na/ /stong 'bul dang khri 'bul ma mchis kyang / /gang yod rnams spong thag rje la byed/ /mchod sbyin gyi rnam dkar rgya cher mdzod/ /'dag sbyar dang sgrub par khyed dgyes na/ /tshe mjug 'dir sgrub pa'i dam bca' 'bul/ /nyams rtogs ni brgya 'bul stong 'bul byed/ /sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzod/ /dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul spro na/ /dbus gtsang 'dir nang rten bsam mi khyab/ /dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur zhu 'dod na/ /ris med kyi dge 'dun skar tshogs tsam/ /ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong spro na/ /sa steng 'di nyam thag sprang pos khyab/ /rtse gcig tu sgrub la gzhol 'dod na/ /byin can gyi grub gnas bgrang las 'das/ /rje khyed kyi dgyes pa'i legs tshogs kun/ /dag zhing 'dir yod do myur du byon/ /don de tsho bdag gis ma zhus kyang / /rje khyed kyi thugs nas sa ler mkhyen/ /bdag rgan bus gtso byas dbus gtsang gi /grwa slob 'bangs yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /dus da res thugs rje ma 'dor bar/ /zhal myur du dbus gtsang phyogs su sgyur/ /dus dang po'i zhal bzhes bzang po de/ /da bsnyel thabs med do rin po che/ /don de phyir sbyin pa nor bu bdag /gcig pu yi rang 'dod ma yin par/ /dad dam tshig 286

bsgrub/ /'dod dgu yi nor la khyed dgyes na/ /stong 'bul dang khri 'bul ma mchis kyang / /gang yod rnams spong thag rje la byed/ /mchod sbyin gyi rnam dkar rgya cher mdzod/ /'dag sbyar dang sgrub par khyed dgyes na/ /tshe mjug 'dir sgrub pa'i dam bca' 'bul/ /nyams rtogs ni brgya 'bul stong 'bul byed/ /sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzod/ /dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul spro na/ /dbus gtsang 'dir nang rten bsam mi khyab/ /dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur zhu 'dod na/ /ris med kyi dge 'dun skar tshogs tsam/ /ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong spro na/ /sa steng 'di nyam thag sprang pos khyab/ /rtse gcig tu sgrub la gzhol 'dod na/ /byin can gyi grub gnas bgrang las 'das/ /rje khyed kyi dgyes pa'i legs tshogs kun/ /dag zhing 'dir yod do myur du byon/ /don de tsho bdag gis ma zhus kyang / /rje khyed kyi thugs nas sa ler mkhyen/ /bdag rgan bus gtso byas dbus gtsang gi /grwa slob 'bangs yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /dus da res thugs rje ma 'dor bar/ /zhal myur du dbus gtsang phyogs su sgyur/ /dus dang po'i zhal bzhes bzang po de/ /da bsnyel thabs med do rin po che/ /don de phyir sbyin pa nor bu bdag /gcig pu yi rang 'dod ma yin par/ /dad dam tshig 286
