ldan pa'i mched lcam dang / /khong yon bdag kun kyang dad pa'i phyir/ /tshig sdeb sbyor spros pa med mod kyang / /sems gang shar shog gu'i logs la bkod/ /mi bdag kyang bsam pa'i 'khyer so la/ /rje khyed nyid dbus su phebs bsams nas/ /gnas gangs ri'i phyogs nas dbus gtsang 'dir/ /bdag 'ongs nas lo ngo lnga tsam song / /rje bla ma ma phebs sdug re bsngal/ /sems nyon mongs duḥ khas non pa'i dus/ /gsung dri med 'byor bas dga' gter rdol/ /dus da lo 'bras mo ljongs la 'gro/ /rje bla ma bod 'dir ma phebs bar/ /stod gangs rir 'gro 'dod yid na med/ /rje bla ma gsang thabs gdan zhu'i phyir/ /khong bang chen 'di tsho ched mngags btang / /don 'bras bu smin par ma mdzad na/ /bdag slob 'bangs thams cad bsad dang 'dra/ /tshig 'di ko do gal che bas zhus/ /rje dbus gtsang phyogs la phebs pa la/ /gdong phebs bsur sna len nga rang yong / /khong bang chen yar la myur du thongs/ /gsung snyan pa'i legs bshad khong tshor bskur/ /bka' ji bzhin ma bsgrubs bdag re ngan/ /rje dbus su ma phebs khrel re chung / /mi rgas po rgan 'chal langs pa dang / /rje bla ma dran pa'i sdug yus kyis/ /tshig 'grig min sna zin spu zin byas/ /rang ngal med yi ger bkod nas 287

ldan pa'i mched lcam dang / /khong yon bdag kun kyang dad pa'i phyir/ /tshig sdeb sbyor spros pa med mod kyang / /sems gang shar shog gu'i logs la bkod/ /mi bdag kyang bsam pa'i 'khyer so la/ /rje khyed nyid dbus su phebs bsams nas/ /gnas gangs ri'i phyogs nas dbus gtsang 'dir/ /bdag 'ongs nas lo ngo lnga tsam song / /rje bla ma ma phebs sdug re bsngal/ /sems nyon mongs duḥ khas non pa'i dus/ /gsung dri med 'byor bas dga' gter rdol/ /dus da lo 'bras mo ljongs la 'gro/ /rje bla ma bod 'dir ma phebs bar/ /stod gangs rir 'gro 'dod yid na med/ /rje bla ma gsang thabs gdan zhu'i phyir/ /khong bang chen 'di tsho ched mngags btang / /don 'bras bu smin par ma mdzad na/ /bdag slob 'bangs thams cad bsad dang 'dra/ /tshig 'di ko do gal che bas zhus/ /rje dbus gtsang phyogs la phebs pa la/ /gdong phebs bsur sna len nga rang yong / /khong bang chen yar la myur du thongs/ /gsung snyan pa'i legs bshad khong tshor bskur/ /bka' ji bzhin ma bsgrubs bdag re ngan/ /rje dbus su ma phebs khrel re chung / /mi rgas po rgan 'chal langs pa dang / /rje bla ma dran pa'i sdug yus kyis/ /tshig 'grig min sna zin spu zin byas/ /rang ngal med yi ger bkod nas 287

phul/ /gtam 'di la rje yis ma gsan nas/ /dus da dung mdo smad der bzhugs na/ /rje nye ring med pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /dus deng sang nye ring can du gyur/ /bdag rjes 'jug bod kyi las ngan rnams/ /nya bye tshan lta bur sdug re bsngal/ /'di phod par gda' ye 'gro ba'i mgon/ /nangs shar ba'i nyi ma nub song yang / /slar 'gro ba'i don du shar nas 'char/ /don de phyir myur du ma phebs na/ /nga sgyu lus mi thang sdod par dka'/ /lha rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ /thugs skad cig g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /rje sangs rgyas gnyis pa zhabs dkar rje/ /sa dbus su phebs pa'i mthun grogs mdzod/ /pha bka' drin can gye gser zhal de/ /bu mos gus can gyis myur du mjal/ /dus nyin mtshan med par chos 'khor bskor/ /kun dga' bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa sogs slob ma bu chen yon bdag bsod nams can mang pos mgon khyed dbus gtsang du yar cig phebs dang / zhabs tog gang dgos rnams bsgrub ces zhu shog tshig lhug tshigs bcad brgya phrag tsam zhig byung ba kha phyes nas bltas tshe/ nga yang skom pa chu 'dod pa bzhin dbus su 'gro 'dod cher gyur nas/ lo rjes ma shing 'brug gi lo nor rdzas gang yang ma khyer pa byas zla ba bzhi ba lnga ba'i nang la 288

phul/ /gtam 'di la rje yis ma gsan nas/ /dus da dung mdo smad der bzhugs na/ /rje nye ring med pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /dus deng sang nye ring can du gyur/ /bdag rjes 'jug bod kyi las ngan rnams/ /nya bye tshan lta bur sdug re bsngal/ /'di phod par gda' ye 'gro ba'i mgon/ /nangs shar ba'i nyi ma nub song yang / /slar 'gro ba'i don du shar nas 'char/ /don de phyir myur du ma phebs na/ /nga sgyu lus mi thang sdod par dka'/ /lha rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ /thugs skad cig g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /rje sangs rgyas gnyis pa zhabs dkar rje/ /sa dbus su phebs pa'i mthun grogs mdzod/ /pha bka' drin can gye gser zhal de/ /bu mos gus can gyis myur du mjal/ /dus nyin mtshan med par chos 'khor bskor/ /kun dga' bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa sogs slob ma bu chen yon bdag bsod nams can mang pos mgon khyed dbus gtsang du yar cig phebs dang / zhabs tog gang dgos rnams bsgrub ces zhu shog tshig lhug tshigs bcad brgya phrag tsam zhig byung ba kha phyes nas bltas tshe/ nga yang skom pa chu 'dod pa bzhin dbus su 'gro 'dod cher gyur nas/ lo rjes ma shing 'brug gi lo nor rdzas gang yang ma khyer pa byas zla ba bzhi ba lnga ba'i nang la 288

'brog phyogs su 'gro ba ltar byas/ phar rwa rgya dgon brgyud mgo log dang khams la byon nas yar 'gro snyam zhabs phyi nang ma re gnyis la lkog gtam byas/ de nas khyung dgon sprul sku dang reb gong sngags mang yongs la dad rten du/na mo gu ru/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byin gyes rlobs/ /'dra sku 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg gis/ /bla ma'i rnam thar zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /de yang ji skad du/ a ti bkod pa chen po las/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad kyi/ /gser dngul la sogs rgyu las ni/ /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa yi/ /sku gzugs grangs med byas pa las/ /bla ma'i sku 'bag sus bris pa/ /'di ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /brgya stong khri 'bum char mi phod/ /gang gi bla ma'i sku 'bag la/ /mchod cing bstod pa sus byas pa/ /rdo rje 'chang la bskal pa brgyar/ /mchod cing bstod las bsod nams che/ /'bum phrag sum cu rtsa lnga'i char/ /phod cing mnyam pa ma yin no/ /gsungs/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung las/phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa las/ bla ma'i sku 'dra gcig bzhengs pa phan yon che/ rdo rje 'chang la bskal pa brgya'i bar du mchod pa 289

'brog phyogs su 'gro ba ltar byas/ phar rwa rgya dgon brgyud mgo log dang khams la byon nas yar 'gro snyam zhabs phyi nang ma re gnyis la lkog gtam byas/ de nas khyung dgon sprul sku dang reb gong sngags mang yongs la dad rten du/na mo gu ru/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byin gyes rlobs/ /'dra sku 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg gis/ /bla ma'i rnam thar zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /de yang ji skad du/ a ti bkod pa chen po las/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad kyi/ /gser dngul la sogs rgyu las ni/ /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa yi/ /sku gzugs grangs med byas pa las/ /bla ma'i sku 'bag sus bris pa/ /'di ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /brgya stong khri 'bum char mi phod/ /gang gi bla ma'i sku 'bag la/ /mchod cing bstod pa sus byas pa/ /rdo rje 'chang la bskal pa brgyar/ /mchod cing bstod las bsod nams che/ /'bum phrag sum cu rtsa lnga'i char/ /phod cing mnyam pa ma yin no/ /gsungs/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung las/phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa las/ bla ma'i sku 'dra gcig bzhengs pa phan yon che/ rdo rje 'chang la bskal pa brgya'i bar du mchod pa 289

phul ba las/ bla ma'i 'dra sku'i mdun du mchod pa lan cig phul ba phan yon che zhes gsungs pa la dgongs nas/ mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom bla ma gangs ri pas/ bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir sku rgyu ru rgya dngul srang lnga bcu phul nas/ 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring gis thugs bkod gnang / gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi 'dod dpal gyi bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pas dngul gar blugs byas pa'i bzo rgyu phun sum tshogs pa 'di'i nang gi gzungs gzhug tu/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung sogs rten khams can dang / nga'i skra lo na bza' bcas bcug rgyal ba yab sras kyis phyag nas 'thor/ngas kyang rab gnas yang yang byas pa'i 'dra sku 'di nyid/ reb gong gser mo ljongs 'di'i dam ldan rig 'dzin sngags 'chang 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dad rten du byin pa yin pas/ ma ṇi chos thog nam 'ong gi dus su tshogs dbu ru zhog la phyag mchod mdzod dang / tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ 'dra sku 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas shog /'dra sku gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /lo yag skal bzang 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces lo 290

phul ba las/ bla ma'i 'dra sku'i mdun du mchod pa lan cig phul ba phan yon che zhes gsungs pa la dgongs nas/ mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom bla ma gangs ri pas/ bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir sku rgyu ru rgya dngul srang lnga bcu phul nas/ 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring gis thugs bkod gnang / gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi 'dod dpal gyi bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pas dngul gar blugs byas pa'i bzo rgyu phun sum tshogs pa 'di'i nang gi gzungs gzhug tu/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung sogs rten khams can dang / nga'i skra lo na bza' bcas bcug rgyal ba yab sras kyis phyag nas 'thor/ngas kyang rab gnas yang yang byas pa'i 'dra sku 'di nyid/ reb gong gser mo ljongs 'di'i dam ldan rig 'dzin sngags 'chang 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dad rten du byin pa yin pas/ ma ṇi chos thog nam 'ong gi dus su tshogs dbu ru zhog la phyag mchod mdzod dang / tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ 'dra sku 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas shog /'dra sku gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /lo yag skal bzang 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces lo 290

rgyus dang bcas byin pas thams cad dga' zhing spro bar gyur/dus da lta yang khyung dgon gye nang rten gyi gtso bo ru bzhugs so/ /yang zho 'ong la kha'i sngags mang gi dad rten du/ na mo gu ru/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /phur bu 'di nyid mthong thos 'gro rnams kyis/ /nyon mongs dgra bgegs thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de yang bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan rang grol mchog gis/ 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring la/ phur ba'i rgyu ru dngul srang bco lnga phul nas mkhan pos thugs bkod gnang / gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pas/ sku'i rgyu stod gser zangs dang smad gnam lcags las grub pa bzo rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyal ba yab sras kyi phyag nas phog pa 'di nyid bla ma skal ldan gyis lo gcig bsnams nas/ mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom bla ma pad+ma rang grol rin po che la phul ba/ khong gis lo mang po mgul phur byas/des bdag la phul ba lo bco lnga tsam la bzung nas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas 'di nyid/ da ni khyed dam ldan zho 'ong la kha'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams la dad rten du byin pa yin pas/ gser srang stong byen pa las lhag pa'i dga' bar 291

rgyus dang bcas byin pas thams cad dga' zhing spro bar gyur/dus da lta yang khyung dgon gye nang rten gyi gtso bo ru bzhugs so/ /yang zho 'ong la kha'i sngags mang gi dad rten du/ na mo gu ru/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /phur bu 'di nyid mthong thos 'gro rnams kyis/ /nyon mongs dgra bgegs thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de yang bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan rang grol mchog gis/ 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring la/ phur ba'i rgyu ru dngul srang bco lnga phul nas mkhan pos thugs bkod gnang / gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pas/ sku'i rgyu stod gser zangs dang smad gnam lcags las grub pa bzo rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyal ba yab sras kyi phyag nas phog pa 'di nyid bla ma skal ldan gyis lo gcig bsnams nas/ mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom bla ma pad+ma rang grol rin po che la phul ba/ khong gis lo mang po mgul phur byas/des bdag la phul ba lo bco lnga tsam la bzung nas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas 'di nyid/ da ni khyed dam ldan zho 'ong la kha'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams la dad rten du byin pa yin pas/ gser srang stong byen pa las lhag pa'i dga' bar 291

mdzod lags/ smras pa/ phur bu 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg gis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las myur 'grub shog /phur bu gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /lo yag bskal bzang 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces lo rgyus dang bcas byin pas kun dga' zhing spro ba byung / dus da lta yang zho 'ong la kha'i sngag mang gi chos thog gi skabs rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyis bsnams nas 'ong ba'i phyag srol tshugs so/ /yang skyes mchog spyang lung rdo rje 'chang gi sprul sku rin po che rnam pa gsum la zhal gdams 'di nyid byin/rje 'gran gyis do med chos rgyal la/ /bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /nga'i rjes 'jug spru sku rnam gsum gyis/ /bstan 'gro la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i mthus/ /thugs chos mthun sprul sku rnam gsum la/ /dpe gsal ba'i thog tu sgon me bzhin/ /chos dge ba'i gsol 'debs bslab bya zhu/ /khyed rnam gsum sku na gzhon pa'i dus/ /dgra le lo'i dbang du ma gtong bar/ /nang rig pa sgra tshad bzo gso sogs/ /spyir rig gnas kun la mkhas par sbyongs/ /sgos mtshan ldan bla ma mang po la/ /chos ring brgyud bka' ma nye brgyud gter/ /gzhan zab mo dag snang chos skor 292

mdzod lags/ smras pa/ phur bu 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg gis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las myur 'grub shog /phur bu gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /lo yag bskal bzang 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces lo rgyus dang bcas byin pas kun dga' zhing spro ba byung / dus da lta yang zho 'ong la kha'i sngag mang gi chos thog gi skabs rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyis bsnams nas 'ong ba'i phyag srol tshugs so/ /yang skyes mchog spyang lung rdo rje 'chang gi sprul sku rin po che rnam pa gsum la zhal gdams 'di nyid byin/rje 'gran gyis do med chos rgyal la/ /bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /nga'i rjes 'jug spru sku rnam gsum gyis/ /bstan 'gro la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i mthus/ /thugs chos mthun sprul sku rnam gsum la/ /dpe gsal ba'i thog tu sgon me bzhin/ /chos dge ba'i gsol 'debs bslab bya zhu/ /khyed rnam gsum sku na gzhon pa'i dus/ /dgra le lo'i dbang du ma gtong bar/ /nang rig pa sgra tshad bzo gso sogs/ /spyir rig gnas kun la mkhas par sbyongs/ /sgos mtshan ldan bla ma mang po la/ /chos ring brgyud bka' ma nye brgyud gter/ /gzhan zab mo dag snang chos skor 292

sogs/ /dbang lung 'khrid mang po yang yang zhus/ /da zhus pa tsam du ma bzhag par/ /chos lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs sogs/ /rang gang mos chos la lhag par du/ /gnas dben pa bsten la nyams len mdzod/ /nang lta dgongs shin tu mtho na yang / /phyi'i spyod pa chal chol mdzad mi rung / /de byas na 'gro don mi 'ong bas/ /sngags byang sems so thar sdom pa srungs/ /spyir dad can skya ser pho mo la/ /sdig mi dge byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang / /chos dge ba byas pa'i phan yon gsungs/ /kun blo kha dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /sgoms sngags 'chang rnams kyi chos thog la/ /dus rgyun du byon la bka' chos gnongs/ /'don chos spyod 'grig lam kun spyod rnams/ /lo re re bzhin du je bzang thongs/ /nor longs spyod gsog 'jog ma mdzad par/ / lo re re bzhin du chos thog zungs/ /dus rgyun du lo mtshams zla mtshams sdoms/ /lha'i bsnyen pa sems ngo skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos mdo sngags bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /ma 'gro ba kun kyang gnas skabs bde/ /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces byin/ yang dad can sngags rgan mkhar lo dang pad+ma tshe ring / tshags lo/spyang lung kun bzang / ko'u sde'i ngag dbang bkra shis/ rgyal 293

sogs/ /dbang lung 'khrid mang po yang yang zhus/ /da zhus pa tsam du ma bzhag par/ /chos lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs sogs/ /rang gang mos chos la lhag par du/ /gnas dben pa bsten la nyams len mdzod/ /nang lta dgongs shin tu mtho na yang / /phyi'i spyod pa chal chol mdzad mi rung / /de byas na 'gro don mi 'ong bas/ /sngags byang sems so thar sdom pa srungs/ /spyir dad can skya ser pho mo la/ /sdig mi dge byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang / /chos dge ba byas pa'i phan yon gsungs/ /kun blo kha dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /sgoms sngags 'chang rnams kyi chos thog la/ /dus rgyun du byon la bka' chos gnongs/ /'don chos spyod 'grig lam kun spyod rnams/ /lo re re bzhin du je bzang thongs/ /nor longs spyod gsog 'jog ma mdzad par/ / lo re re bzhin du chos thog zungs/ /dus rgyun du lo mtshams zla mtshams sdoms/ /lha'i bsnyen pa sems ngo skyong bar mdzod/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /chos mdo sngags bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /ma 'gro ba kun kyang gnas skabs bde/ /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces byin/ yang dad can sngags rgan mkhar lo dang pad+ma tshe ring / tshags lo/spyang lung kun bzang / ko'u sde'i ngag dbang bkra shis/ rgyal 293

po'i rta mgrin skyabs/ snying gar dpa'/ lha khang dbu mdzad sogs reb gong gi phur thogs stong dang lnga brgyas gtso byas slob ma sngags 'chang dam ldan yongs la zhal gdams 'di byin/rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems chos dang mthun par byin gyes rlobs/ /khyed dam ldan sngags 'chang tshogs rnams kyis/ /nga'i phan pa'i glu dbyangs 'di la nyon/ /lo gzhon dus yi ge lha bris dang / /sman rtsis sogs rig pa'i gnas la slobs/ /de'i rjes su mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /chos mdo sngags dbang lung khrid gsum zhus/ /rje bla ma 'bral med spyi bor sgoms/ /lus lhar bskyed ngag gis bzlas brjod gyis/ /sems gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la zhog /ma nyam thag 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /lha bka' brgyad dam pa rigs brgya yi/ /mtshan brjod pas ngan 'gror ltung mi srid/ /mchod bstod pas mchog thun dngos grub thob/ /dus rgyun du chos thog chag med mdzod/ /rang yul gyi dge sbyor brgya byas las/ /lha bla ma mched grogs tshogs gral du/ /gcig byas pa phan yon brgya 'gyur lhag /don de phyir chos thog kun la phebs/ /lha bla ma mched lcam dam tshig rnams/ /bsrung nus na skye ba bcu drug tshun/ /chos ma bsgoms na yang 'tshang rgya gsungs/ /chang ma 'thung sdom pa dam 294

po'i rta mgrin skyabs/ snying gar dpa'/ lha khang dbu mdzad sogs reb gong gi phur thogs stong dang lnga brgyas gtso byas slob ma sngags 'chang dam ldan yongs la zhal gdams 'di byin/rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems chos dang mthun par byin gyes rlobs/ /khyed dam ldan sngags 'chang tshogs rnams kyis/ /nga'i phan pa'i glu dbyangs 'di la nyon/ /lo gzhon dus yi ge lha bris dang / /sman rtsis sogs rig pa'i gnas la slobs/ /de'i rjes su mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /chos mdo sngags dbang lung khrid gsum zhus/ /rje bla ma 'bral med spyi bor sgoms/ /lus lhar bskyed ngag gis bzlas brjod gyis/ /sems gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la zhog /ma nyam thag 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /lha bka' brgyad dam pa rigs brgya yi/ /mtshan brjod pas ngan 'gror ltung mi srid/ /mchod bstod pas mchog thun dngos grub thob/ /dus rgyun du chos thog chag med mdzod/ /rang yul gyi dge sbyor brgya byas las/ /lha bla ma mched grogs tshogs gral du/ /gcig byas pa phan yon brgya 'gyur lhag /don de phyir chos thog kun la phebs/ /lha bla ma mched lcam dam tshig rnams/ /bsrung nus na skye ba bcu drug tshun/ /chos ma bsgoms na yang 'tshang rgya gsungs/ /chang ma 'thung sdom pa dam 294

tshig srungs/ /bstan 'gro la gnod pa'i dgra la yang / /lha chos skyong bsgul ba ma gtogs pa/ /klur gtad dang gnyan sar mnan pa sogs/ /gzhan sa brko rdo slog ma byed bzang / /skabs skabs su 'chi ba mi rtag soms/ /rang khom dus phyag mchod skor ba gyis/ /nor yod dus mchod sbyin gang nus thongs/ /dus rgyun du mtshams gyis nyams len mdzod/ /don de ltar byas na chos dang mthun/ /chos dge ba byas pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /dus gnas skabs kyen tu bde zhing skyid/ /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa dang / /chos mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par shog /ces byen/ gzhan yang bca' yig dang bslab bya 'dra byas pas/ kun yid cig ma ches par/ zhabs zhu 'ga' rer dris pas gcig gis lkog gtam byas/ lo rjes mar dbus su phebs thag chod red ces bshad pa rim gyis mkhas pa'i dbang po grub pa'i dbang phyug rong bo'i sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po ches gsan tshe gsung shog 'di gnang 'dugadapag med bskal pa'i sngon nas sangs rgyas te/ /sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul chu la zla gzugs bzhin/ /skal ldan zhing du zab rgya'i 295

tshig srungs/ /bstan 'gro la gnod pa'i dgra la yang / /lha chos skyong bsgul ba ma gtogs pa/ /klur gtad dang gnyan sar mnan pa sogs/ /gzhan sa brko rdo slog ma byed bzang / /skabs skabs su 'chi ba mi rtag soms/ /rang khom dus phyag mchod skor ba gyis/ /nor yod dus mchod sbyin gang nus thongs/ /dus rgyun du mtshams gyis nyams len mdzod/ /don de ltar byas na chos dang mthun/ /chos dge ba byas pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /dus gnas skabs kyen tu bde zhing skyid/ /mthar sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa dang / /chos mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par shog /ces byen/ gzhan yang bca' yig dang bslab bya 'dra byas pas/ kun yid cig ma ches par/ zhabs zhu 'ga' rer dris pas gcig gis lkog gtam byas/ lo rjes mar dbus su phebs thag chod red ces bshad pa rim gyis mkhas pa'i dbang po grub pa'i dbang phyug rong bo'i sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po ches gsan tshe gsung shog 'di gnang 'dugadapag med bskal pa'i sngon nas sangs rgyas te/ /sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul chu la zla gzugs bzhin/ /skal ldan zhing du zab rgya'i 295

chos char 'bebs/ /skyabs gcig rnal 'byor chen po'i zhabs pad drung / /tshul 'chos gos kyis btsun pa'i gzugs/ /nang du rnyed bkur khram pa dngos/ /tshul min las kyis dus 'da' ba/ /skyes ming zhig gis 'di skad zhu/ /deng dus snyigs ma'i dus ngan 'dir/ /bya byed rkyen ngan ru 'dzings te/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid nyams dma' ba/ /ri mo'i mar me lta bu'i dus/ /thugs bskyed sgon lam shar ri'i rtser/ /spangs rtogs dkyil 'khor mngon par rdzogs/ /snying rje'i nyi ma khyod shar bas/ /da dung thar pa'i lam ma nub/ /chos sred 'dod dgu 'jo ba yis/ /'brel tshad don ldan la sbyor ba'i/ /sems dpa' chen po'i rnam thar la/ /rnam pa kun tu yi rang smon/ /de ltar thugs la gang dgongs pa'i/ /don chen 'bad med 'grub pas na/ /yul ngan nyam thag skye bo'i tshogs/ /dor nas gzhan du spros dmigs kyis/ /bya ba'i shing rta bang slong na/ /gdul bya bzang ngan spang blang gi /spu ris phye zhing tshul 'di ni/ /dam pas smad pa'i las min nam/ /bden dzun rang bzhin ma dmigs par/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro mnyam yang / /byes pa bslu ba'i gtam 'di ni/ /'phags pa'i spang byar ma lags sam/ /de ltar gser ljongs sa'i thig ler/ /zhabs mthil pad+ma 296

chos char 'bebs/ /skyabs gcig rnal 'byor chen po'i zhabs pad drung / /tshul 'chos gos kyis btsun pa'i gzugs/ /nang du rnyed bkur khram pa dngos/ /tshul min las kyis dus 'da' ba/ /skyes ming zhig gis 'di skad zhu/ /deng dus snyigs ma'i dus ngan 'dir/ /bya byed rkyen ngan ru 'dzings te/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid nyams dma' ba/ /ri mo'i mar me lta bu'i dus/ /thugs bskyed sgon lam shar ri'i rtser/ /spangs rtogs dkyil 'khor mngon par rdzogs/ /snying rje'i nyi ma khyod shar bas/ /da dung thar pa'i lam ma nub/ /chos sred 'dod dgu 'jo ba yis/ /'brel tshad don ldan la sbyor ba'i/ /sems dpa' chen po'i rnam thar la/ /rnam pa kun tu yi rang smon/ /de ltar thugs la gang dgongs pa'i/ /don chen 'bad med 'grub pas na/ /yul ngan nyam thag skye bo'i tshogs/ /dor nas gzhan du spros dmigs kyis/ /bya ba'i shing rta bang slong na/ /gdul bya bzang ngan spang blang gi /spu ris phye zhing tshul 'di ni/ /dam pas smad pa'i las min nam/ /bden dzun rang bzhin ma dmigs par/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro mnyam yang / /byes pa bslu ba'i gtam 'di ni/ /'phags pa'i spang byar ma lags sam/ /de ltar gser ljongs sa'i thig ler/ /zhabs mthil pad+ma 296

dkar po'i ris/ /kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsi ru/ /'pho med brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /mdor na bdag sogs skye rgu kun/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe g.yul las rgyal/ /rnam dkar las la nyer zhugs te/ /dam pa'i mgon dang 'bral med shog /ces dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas ring po dang bcas te stsal snang / lo gsar nas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu tsam la rong bo'i dgon chen du shar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku gdung la mjal du song / dngul srang bcu drug tsam gyi dngul gyi bdun tshar dang dngul kong gcig kha btags nang mdzod kyi snyan shal dang bcas te phul/sprul sku myur 'byon bton nas gsol ba btab zhag po bdun bsdad nas/ mar me dang chu gtsang gi mchod pa sku gzhogs gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi phyag len ltar phul nas 'dod gsol bsngo smon byas/ de dus mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i sku gzhogs bsam 'grub/ byang rtse rin po che/ bus pa gser khri/ rong bo sprul sku/ phyag mdzod la sogs pa'i rong bo'i bla skya dpon gsum sngags mang bcas kyis nyin cig sder kha mang po/ 'jam dar bcas phul nas/ sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po ches/ bla ma rin po che khyed da lo dbus la phebs rgyu red zer ba go nas sems ma bde/ dbus gtsang la nyi ma'i 297

dkar po'i ris/ /kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsi ru/ /'pho med brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /mdor na bdag sogs skye rgu kun/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe g.yul las rgyal/ /rnam dkar las la nyer zhugs te/ /dam pa'i mgon dang 'bral med shog /ces dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas ring po dang bcas te stsal snang / lo gsar nas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu tsam la rong bo'i dgon chen du shar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku gdung la mjal du song / dngul srang bcu drug tsam gyi dngul gyi bdun tshar dang dngul kong gcig kha btags nang mdzod kyi snyan shal dang bcas te phul/sprul sku myur 'byon bton nas gsol ba btab zhag po bdun bsdad nas/ mar me dang chu gtsang gi mchod pa sku gzhogs gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi phyag len ltar phul nas 'dod gsol bsngo smon byas/ de dus mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i sku gzhogs bsam 'grub/ byang rtse rin po che/ bus pa gser khri/ rong bo sprul sku/ phyag mdzod la sogs pa'i rong bo'i bla skya dpon gsum sngags mang bcas kyis nyin cig sder kha mang po/ 'jam dar bcas phul nas/ sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po ches/ bla ma rin po che khyed da lo dbus la phebs rgyu red zer ba go nas sems ma bde/ dbus gtsang la nyi ma'i 297

thog tu nyi ma bzhin khyed mi dgos pas/ reb gong mun pa'i gling lta bu 'dir bzhugs nas 'gro don byed dgos gsungs pa'i rjes su/ de bzhin du bla ma byang rtse tshang la sogs pa'i der bzhugs pa rnams kyis rgyu mtshan mang po bcas zhu ba nan gyes phul ba'i lan du/ ngas 'di skad zhus/ reb gong lha ma yin gyi 'thab rtsod kyi gnas lta bu 'di la phan chen po mi thogs par gda'/ da yar tsho bud song na snyam pa yin te/ khyed rnams kyis re ba chen po byed na/ shar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku nyi ma bzhin du 'char rag gi bar du 'dug ces zhus pas/ kun thugs dgyes nas da phyin chad zhal bzhes mi 'gyur ba thugs la zungs zer/ yang zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la skyabs mgon gser khang rdo rje 'chang spre'u mdo'i dgon par phebs pa la mjal du song / tshe dpag med rgya gar li ma gcig gser gyi tshe bum rin chen phra ldan/ tshe mdo/ gser zho gang ras gos dri med lha rdzas 'jam dar ring po bcas phul nas mjal/ skyabs 'jug tshig lhug par grol nas zhus pa'i mthar slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs phyogs kun tu/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yi/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras kyi/ /rgyal 298

thog tu nyi ma bzhin khyed mi dgos pas/ reb gong mun pa'i gling lta bu 'dir bzhugs nas 'gro don byed dgos gsungs pa'i rjes su/ de bzhin du bla ma byang rtse tshang la sogs pa'i der bzhugs pa rnams kyis rgyu mtshan mang po bcas zhu ba nan gyes phul ba'i lan du/ ngas 'di skad zhus/ reb gong lha ma yin gyi 'thab rtsod kyi gnas lta bu 'di la phan chen po mi thogs par gda'/ da yar tsho bud song na snyam pa yin te/ khyed rnams kyis re ba chen po byed na/ shar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku nyi ma bzhin du 'char rag gi bar du 'dug ces zhus pas/ kun thugs dgyes nas da phyin chad zhal bzhes mi 'gyur ba thugs la zungs zer/ yang zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la skyabs mgon gser khang rdo rje 'chang spre'u mdo'i dgon par phebs pa la mjal du song / tshe dpag med rgya gar li ma gcig gser gyi tshe bum rin chen phra ldan/ tshe mdo/ gser zho gang ras gos dri med lha rdzas 'jam dar ring po bcas phul nas mjal/ skyabs 'jug tshig lhug par grol nas zhus pa'i mthar slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs phyogs kun tu/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yi/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras kyi/ /rgyal 298

tshab chen po bdag la dgongs/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /lung gi chos kyis rgyud phyug cing / /bslab pa gsum dang rim gnyis kyi/ /rtogs pa'i chos kyis rgyud grol ba'i/ /ngo mtshar skyes mchog rin po che/ /khyed ni bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /don du bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /khyed kyi rjes 'jug bdag cag rnams/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /'bral ba med par rjes su zungs/ /zab rgya'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs rnams/ /mgon khyod zhabs pad brtan phyir bsngo/ /mgon po tshe dpag med pa bzhin/ /rtag tu zhabs pad brtan par shog /khyed bzhin bu slob rnams kyis kyang / /phyi ru 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang / /nang du gsang sngags rim gnyis bsgom/ /zung 'jug go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces phul bas/khong gis thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad/ zhal gsung mang po 'byon par gda'/ de dus dgon pa'i dge 'dun pas zhus nas/ legs bshad snying po'i lung khrid 'chad pa la nyan nas nyi ma bco lnga song / de dus nyan thos bye brag spra ba/ mdo sde ba/dbu ma sems tsam pa/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba ste/ nang pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba la nang byan chud pa'i 299

tshab chen po bdag la dgongs/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /lung gi chos kyis rgyud phyug cing / /bslab pa gsum dang rim gnyis kyi/ /rtogs pa'i chos kyis rgyud grol ba'i/ /ngo mtshar skyes mchog rin po che/ /khyed ni bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /don du bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /khyed kyi rjes 'jug bdag cag rnams/ /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /'bral ba med par rjes su zungs/ /zab rgya'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs rnams/ /mgon khyod zhabs pad brtan phyir bsngo/ /mgon po tshe dpag med pa bzhin/ /rtag tu zhabs pad brtan par shog /khyed bzhin bu slob rnams kyis kyang / /phyi ru 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang / /nang du gsang sngags rim gnyis bsgom/ /zung 'jug go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces phul bas/khong gis thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad/ zhal gsung mang po 'byon par gda'/ de dus dgon pa'i dge 'dun pas zhus nas/ legs bshad snying po'i lung khrid 'chad pa la nyan nas nyi ma bco lnga song / de dus nyan thos bye brag spra ba/ mdo sde ba/dbu ma sems tsam pa/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba ste/ nang pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba la nang byan chud pa'i 299

gsung bshad kyis blo bskyed chen po byung / nyin cig nga khong gi mdun du bos nas/ gdan mthon por bzhag sngon du sil thog la sogs pa'i sder kha bsgrigs/ gsol ja gnang / bstan pa'i bdag po ru mnga' gsol ba yin gsungs nas/ thub dbang gi sgu li ma gcig dang blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer/ kheb bu su'i khri rgyab yol/ gzan ser bo gcig gos phrug g.yu byur dngul srang mang po bcas gnang / kha btags nang mdzod ring po zhig phyag tu bsnams nas/ 'o khyed kyi sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam bzang / 'phral du thabs mkhas la thugs rje che bas da snga yan chad la mdo smad kyi bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po byung bas bka' drin che/ da dung yang khyed dbus la sogs pa'i yul phyogs gzhan tshor ma phebs par/ reb gong la sogs pa'i dmu rgod gdul dka'i sems can 'di rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du mdo smad 'dir yun ring bzhugs dgos zhes yar bzhengs nas kha btags nga la gnang ba byung / ngas mgul du blangs nas phyag gsum 'tshal lag pa thal mo sbyar nas/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ ngas khong gi dgongs bzhed ltar/ yul phyogs thams cad la phan re thogs na bsdad yong / phan thogs pa'i skyabs 'jug thugs la zungs zhus pas/ de la khong thugs gting nas dgyes 300

gsung bshad kyis blo bskyed chen po byung / nyin cig nga khong gi mdun du bos nas/ gdan mthon por bzhag sngon du sil thog la sogs pa'i sder kha bsgrigs/ gsol ja gnang / bstan pa'i bdag po ru mnga' gsol ba yin gsungs nas/ thub dbang gi sgu li ma gcig dang blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer/ kheb bu su'i khri rgyab yol/ gzan ser bo gcig gos phrug g.yu byur dngul srang mang po bcas gnang / kha btags nang mdzod ring po zhig phyag tu bsnams nas/ 'o khyed kyi sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam bzang / 'phral du thabs mkhas la thugs rje che bas da snga yan chad la mdo smad kyi bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po byung bas bka' drin che/ da dung yang khyed dbus la sogs pa'i yul phyogs gzhan tshor ma phebs par/ reb gong la sogs pa'i dmu rgod gdul dka'i sems can 'di rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du mdo smad 'dir yun ring bzhugs dgos zhes yar bzhengs nas kha btags nga la gnang ba byung / ngas mgul du blangs nas phyag gsum 'tshal lag pa thal mo sbyar nas/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ ngas khong gi dgongs bzhed ltar/ yul phyogs thams cad la phan re thogs na bsdad yong / phan thogs pa'i skyabs 'jug thugs la zungs zhus pas/ de la khong thugs gting nas dgyes 300

pa byung / da bzang bzang gsungs/ yang nga'i nye gnas blo bzang shes rab kyis dri med lha rdzas bcas/ nga la zhabs brtan gsol bdebs shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ khong gi thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas sam ṭa zhig khyer shog gsungs nas drung yig mdun du bos 'bri ru bcug ste/tshogs drug yul snang chos sku'i rol bar shar/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'ching ba ma lus pa/ /brjod bral stong pa'i dbyings su rang sar grol/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus mtha' 'dir/ /sdig la rngam pa'i mi bsrun skye bo rnams/ /thabs tshul du mas bde la 'god pa'i phyir/ /mgon khyod srid mtha'i bar du brtan par bzhugs/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gye byin rlabs dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu med bden stobs dang / /shugs drag dad pas rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /ces pa thogs pa med par brtsams nas lung dang bcas te gnang ba byung / de dus bla ma ser rab tshang phebs nas/ nged rnam gnyis la gzu bskul byas pa'i ngor/ spre'u mdo'i dgon nas thon te tshur rong bo dgon chen du 'ongs/ reb gong dang bla brang gnyis kyi gyod ci ga 301

pa byung / da bzang bzang gsungs/ yang nga'i nye gnas blo bzang shes rab kyis dri med lha rdzas bcas/ nga la zhabs brtan gsol bdebs shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ khong gi thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas sam ṭa zhig khyer shog gsungs nas drung yig mdun du bos 'bri ru bcug ste/tshogs drug yul snang chos sku'i rol bar shar/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'ching ba ma lus pa/ /brjod bral stong pa'i dbyings su rang sar grol/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus mtha' 'dir/ /sdig la rngam pa'i mi bsrun skye bo rnams/ /thabs tshul du mas bde la 'god pa'i phyir/ /mgon khyod srid mtha'i bar du brtan par bzhugs/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gye byin rlabs dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu med bden stobs dang / /shugs drag dad pas rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /rje btsun bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /ces pa thogs pa med par brtsams nas lung dang bcas te gnang ba byung / de dus bla ma ser rab tshang phebs nas/ nged rnam gnyis la gzu bskul byas pa'i ngor/ spre'u mdo'i dgon nas thon te tshur rong bo dgon chen du 'ongs/ reb gong dang bla brang gnyis kyi gyod ci ga 301

'grigs na snyam/ rong bo'i nang so sogs bla skya dpon gsum la nyi ma mang por gtam bshad gzu sne zhig dgos byas kyang / zla ba gcig tsam la dmag la mi 'gro ba'i kha ngo tsam las ma byung bas/ khong thugs skyo nas khri lung dben pa'i nags khrod du phebs song / nga rong bo'i dgon chen de na yod thog der skal ldan snying gi bu chen nya mo'i gnam skyabs 'bum mam/ ming gzhan sngags 'chang rig 'dzin nor bus zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul tshig 'di slebs byung /thugs dgongs klong sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /sku tha mal snang ngor bshes gnyen tshul/ /gsung legs bshad nyams dbyangs char 'bebs pa'i/ /pha kun mkhyen bla mar gus pas 'dud/ /rang rig dang bla ma dbyer med du/ /rtogs gdengs bcas sor bcu thal sbyar nas/ /gdung shugs kyis rang nyams dbyangs su 'bul/ /thugs brtse bas dgyes bzhin gsan par zhu/ /gang sku khams bzang zhing bde ngos nas/ /'phrin mdzad bzang bstan 'gror sman mdzad bzhin/ /slar deng sang rong bor phebs thos pas/ /zhal dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro 'phel/ /khyed ris med bstan 'gro'i don ched du/ /phyogs nges med rgyal khams zhabs theg dus/ /bdag gus 'bangs slob 302

'grigs na snyam/ rong bo'i nang so sogs bla skya dpon gsum la nyi ma mang por gtam bshad gzu sne zhig dgos byas kyang / zla ba gcig tsam la dmag la mi 'gro ba'i kha ngo tsam las ma byung bas/ khong thugs skyo nas khri lung dben pa'i nags khrod du phebs song / nga rong bo'i dgon chen de na yod thog der skal ldan snying gi bu chen nya mo'i gnam skyabs 'bum mam/ ming gzhan sngags 'chang rig 'dzin nor bus zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul tshig 'di slebs byung /thugs dgongs klong sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /sku tha mal snang ngor bshes gnyen tshul/ /gsung legs bshad nyams dbyangs char 'bebs pa'i/ /pha kun mkhyen bla mar gus pas 'dud/ /rang rig dang bla ma dbyer med du/ /rtogs gdengs bcas sor bcu thal sbyar nas/ /gdung shugs kyis rang nyams dbyangs su 'bul/ /thugs brtse bas dgyes bzhin gsan par zhu/ /gang sku khams bzang zhing bde ngos nas/ /'phrin mdzad bzang bstan 'gror sman mdzad bzhin/ /slar deng sang rong bor phebs thos pas/ /zhal dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro 'phel/ /khyed ris med bstan 'gro'i don ched du/ /phyogs nges med rgyal khams zhabs theg dus/ /bdag gus 'bangs slob 302

bu'i tha shal ba/ /lus 'byung rgud na rgas gtugs pa yis/ /rjes ma zin pha yul chags sdang gi /rkyen zug rngus bslad bzhin rdol thabs zug /zhal lta 'dod 'dun pa cher ldan yang / /sa bskor thag ring pos bar bcad nas/ /zhal yang yang mjal rgyu'i skabs ma byung / /nga de phyir bsam zhing gdung ba 'phyo/ /rje'i mdzad bzang bka' drin thob tshul dang / /sku rjen pa'i zhal 'dzum sems la zhen/ /gsung snyan 'jebs tshangs dbyangs rna bar btags/ /thugs byams brtse ma las cher lhag pa'i/ /mgon dran pa'i gdung sems rgyun 'chad med/ /lus spu g.yo sems kyis bcos min pa'i/ /shugs 'byung gi mos gus khong nas rgyas/ /rgyud dad pa'i nor ldan slob bu ngar/ /pha'i gar bzhugs zhing nas thugs rje yis/ /bu'i gdung sol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zhal gdams kyi nying khu zab mo zhig /sngar yang yang zhus pa legs dgongs la/ /gnang gsungs pa'i zhal bzhes rdo rje'i tshig /bslu med la re ba'i skal ldan bu'i/ /re 'dod de brtse ba chen po'i sgos/ /ring min du skong ba'i bka' drin stsol/ /bdag deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skyabs khyed min re sa gzhan ma mchis/ /dus da nas tshe mjug bag tsam po/ /gshis ma bcos ngang der snyoms nus shing / /rang 303

bu'i tha shal ba/ /lus 'byung rgud na rgas gtugs pa yis/ /rjes ma zin pha yul chags sdang gi /rkyen zug rngus bslad bzhin rdol thabs zug /zhal lta 'dod 'dun pa cher ldan yang / /sa bskor thag ring pos bar bcad nas/ /zhal yang yang mjal rgyu'i skabs ma byung / /nga de phyir bsam zhing gdung ba 'phyo/ /rje'i mdzad bzang bka' drin thob tshul dang / /sku rjen pa'i zhal 'dzum sems la zhen/ /gsung snyan 'jebs tshangs dbyangs rna bar btags/ /thugs byams brtse ma las cher lhag pa'i/ /mgon dran pa'i gdung sems rgyun 'chad med/ /lus spu g.yo sems kyis bcos min pa'i/ /shugs 'byung gi mos gus khong nas rgyas/ /rgyud dad pa'i nor ldan slob bu ngar/ /pha'i gar bzhugs zhing nas thugs rje yis/ /bu'i gdung sol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zhal gdams kyi nying khu zab mo zhig /sngar yang yang zhus pa legs dgongs la/ /gnang gsungs pa'i zhal bzhes rdo rje'i tshig /bslu med la re ba'i skal ldan bu'i/ /re 'dod de brtse ba chen po'i sgos/ /ring min du skong ba'i bka' drin stsol/ /bdag deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skyabs khyed min re sa gzhan ma mchis/ /dus da nas tshe mjug bag tsam po/ /gshis ma bcos ngang der snyoms nus shing / /rang 303

rgyud la sa lam gcig char du/ /dus ring min rdzogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /phral yun gyi legs tshogs ci mchis pa/ /mgon dam pa'i bka' drin kho na la/ /rag las phyir btsan sa ma zin bar/ /bshes 'bral med tshul bzhin bsten par smon/ /zhes lha rdzas kyi rgyas btab ste phul ba'i lan du/ gar bzhugs chos kyi dbyengs kyi pho brang chen po na snang ba yangs po byas/ dus rgyun du dga' yal le 'dzum 'bol ler gnas pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas/ rab tu dga' zhing spro ba'i shugs kyis nges don gyi zhal gdams zab mo zhig 'bul bas/ dus rgyun du sems la chongs/ de yang tshe thung nam 'chi cha med soms la phyi'i spros pa mang po mi bya bar/ nyin re bzhin zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du thongs la/ dngos gzhi sems ngo skyong tshul ni/snang grags kyis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ni/nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang gi zla ba/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel sna tshogs la med bzhin du snang / snang bzhin du stong / snang stong dbyer med sems kyi rol par thag gcod cing / sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la/ yin pa shes nas de'i 304

rgyud la sa lam gcig char du/ /dus ring min rdzogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /phral yun gyi legs tshogs ci mchis pa/ /mgon dam pa'i bka' drin kho na la/ /rag las phyir btsan sa ma zin bar/ /bshes 'bral med tshul bzhin bsten par smon/ /zhes lha rdzas kyi rgyas btab ste phul ba'i lan du/ gar bzhugs chos kyi dbyengs kyi pho brang chen po na snang ba yangs po byas/ dus rgyun du dga' yal le 'dzum 'bol ler gnas pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas/ rab tu dga' zhing spro ba'i shugs kyis nges don gyi zhal gdams zab mo zhig 'bul bas/ dus rgyun du sems la chongs/ de yang tshe thung nam 'chi cha med soms la phyi'i spros pa mang po mi bya bar/ nyin re bzhin zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du thongs la/ dngos gzhi sems ngo skyong tshul ni/snang grags kyis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ni/nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang gi zla ba/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel sna tshogs la med bzhin du snang / snang bzhin du stong / snang stong dbyer med sems kyi rol par thag gcod cing / sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la/ yin pa shes nas de'i 304

ngang la mnyam par 'jog dus/ dper na ri mthon po'i rtse nas phyogs kun tu bltas pa ltar yangs khrol ler zhog zang thal kha yan du skyongs dang / dper na nam mkha' stong pa la bya 'phur na rjes mi mngon par yal nas 'gro ba ltar/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang der gnas na rnam rtog ci shar yang rjes mi mngon par rang yal du 'gro bar 'gyur/ de ltar sems ngo skyong shes na/ skabs shig dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la snyi rje kun khyab tu sgoms la phan pa'i smon lam thob/ dngos su yang phan gang thogs la rem dang / tshe 'dir rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag dang slob ma yang slob thams cad la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub thams cad char bzhin phob/ /pha rgan bdag gi phan pa'i snying gtam la/ /skal ldan bu chen rig 'dzin nor bu nyon/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir nged gnyis mjal ba skal ba bzang / /ngas ni khyod la 305

ngang la mnyam par 'jog dus/ dper na ri mthon po'i rtse nas phyogs kun tu bltas pa ltar yangs khrol ler zhog zang thal kha yan du skyongs dang / dper na nam mkha' stong pa la bya 'phur na rjes mi mngon par yal nas 'gro ba ltar/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang der gnas na rnam rtog ci shar yang rjes mi mngon par rang yal du 'gro bar 'gyur/ de ltar sems ngo skyong shes na/ skabs shig dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la snyi rje kun khyab tu sgoms la phan pa'i smon lam thob/ dngos su yang phan gang thogs la rem dang / tshe 'dir rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag dang slob ma yang slob thams cad la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub thams cad char bzhin phob/ /pha rgan bdag gi phan pa'i snying gtam la/ /skal ldan bu chen rig 'dzin nor bu nyon/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir nged gnyis mjal ba skal ba bzang / /ngas ni khyod la 305

chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs rang ngo sprad/ /khyod kyi 'ang le lo ma byas nyams su blangs/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mthus/ /da lta sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i/ /ngang la rang bzhin shugs kyis 'gro ba mtshar/ /da ni spros pa mang pos ci zhig bya/ /spros med 'od gsal klong du ngal gsos shig /de ltar ma rtogs ma gyur sems can la/ /bcos ma min pa'i snying rje skye ba de/ /rdzogs chen lta ba'i khyad chos yin pas na/ /khyad chos 'di dang cis kyang ldan par mdzod/ /nam zhig 'chi ba chos kyi sgur grol nas/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don 'ong bar 'gyur/ /phan pa'i snying gtam glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /thos tshad rnams kyi sems la phan par shog /ces bskur pas sems la phan thogs shing phyogs de'i las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams la yang phan thogs pa byung / gzhan dad can 'ga' res/ bla brang rong bo gnyis 'khrugs nas/ da dge lugs pa'i nang la yang ltas ngan byung ma bzang zer dus/ de la ngas bzlog pa rgyag dang skyon med ces 'di skad brjod/t+t+waṃ bh+yo/ dge slong lus la go mtshon can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge 306

chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs rang ngo sprad/ /khyod kyi 'ang le lo ma byas nyams su blangs/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mthus/ /da lta sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i/ /ngang la rang bzhin shugs kyis 'gro ba mtshar/ /da ni spros pa mang pos ci zhig bya/ /spros med 'od gsal klong du ngal gsos shig /de ltar ma rtogs ma gyur sems can la/ /bcos ma min pa'i snying rje skye ba de/ /rdzogs chen lta ba'i khyad chos yin pas na/ /khyad chos 'di dang cis kyang ldan par mdzod/ /nam zhig 'chi ba chos kyi sgur grol nas/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don 'ong bar 'gyur/ /phan pa'i snying gtam glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /thos tshad rnams kyi sems la phan par shog /ces bskur pas sems la phan thogs shing phyogs de'i las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams la yang phan thogs pa byung / gzhan dad can 'ga' res/ bla brang rong bo gnyis 'khrugs nas/ da dge lugs pa'i nang la yang ltas ngan byung ma bzang zer dus/ de la ngas bzlog pa rgyag dang skyon med ces 'di skad brjod/t+t+waṃ bh+yo/ dge slong lus la go mtshon can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge 306

slong lus la dmag dar can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la dmag zhus mkhan/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la chang 'thung mkhan/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la bud med can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la dud 'then mkhan/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la bre rgya can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la zhwa dkar can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /de la sogs pa'i ltas ngan rnams/ /thams cad bdag 'dzin dgra la bzlog /thams cad nyon mongs bgegs la bh+yo/ /zhes deng sang dus der rje bdag nyid chen po'i ring lugs dang mi mthun pa'i ltas ngan mang po byung ba la/ 'di bzhin bzlog pa rgyag rgyu byung na bzang ngo zhes ku re byas pas dgod mkhan mang po 'dug bla rgan dad can re gnyis kyis/'brug pa kun legs kyi gsung bzhin/ ku re'i nang na don dam 307

slong lus la dmag dar can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la dmag zhus mkhan/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la chang 'thung mkhan/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la bud med can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la dud 'then mkhan/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la bre rgya can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge slong lus la zhwa dkar can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /de la sogs pa'i ltas ngan rnams/ /thams cad bdag 'dzin dgra la bzlog /thams cad nyon mongs bgegs la bh+yo/ /zhes deng sang dus der rje bdag nyid chen po'i ring lugs dang mi mthun pa'i ltas ngan mang po byung ba la/ 'di bzhin bzlog pa rgyag rgyu byung na bzang ngo zhes ku re byas pas dgod mkhan mang po 'dug bla rgan dad can re gnyis kyis/'brug pa kun legs kyi gsung bzhin/ ku re'i nang na don dam 307

go rgyu chen po 'dug skyabs su mchi zer ba byung ngo //de nas yar nya lung gi grub dbang nam mkha' rin po che'i gdan sa dgon la khar song / khong 'brog la phebs nas mi bzhugs ki nga zhag kha shas shig bsdad nas ngal gsos/dgon pa la dar rgyas 'ong ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon bkra shis byas/ de nas rje skal ldan rgya mtshos bstod pa'i gnas/ sa bkra shis g.yang chags spangs lug brag tu song / zhag bco lnga tsam la gnas 'brel bzhag pas dge sbyor 'phel po byung / nyin gcig deng sang dus ngan bskal pa snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dgon pa che chung tsho'i bsam sbyor tshor bltas/ dam pa gong ma'i gsung sgros tsho bsams na/ da rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa 'di yang gzugs brnyan tsam du 'gro nyen gda' snyam sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /mgon rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rje skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa 'di/ /dus da bar tshul bzhin gnas na yang / /da gzugs brnyan tsam du 'gro nyen gda'/ /de'i snga ltas cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la 308

go rgyu chen po 'dug skyabs su mchi zer ba byung ngo //de nas yar nya lung gi grub dbang nam mkha' rin po che'i gdan sa dgon la khar song / khong 'brog la phebs nas mi bzhugs ki nga zhag kha shas shig bsdad nas ngal gsos/dgon pa la dar rgyas 'ong ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon bkra shis byas/ de nas rje skal ldan rgya mtshos bstod pa'i gnas/ sa bkra shis g.yang chags spangs lug brag tu song / zhag bco lnga tsam la gnas 'brel bzhag pas dge sbyor 'phel po byung / nyin gcig deng sang dus ngan bskal pa snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dgon pa che chung tsho'i bsam sbyor tshor bltas/ dam pa gong ma'i gsung sgros tsho bsams na/ da rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa 'di yang gzugs brnyan tsam du 'gro nyen gda' snyam sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /mgon rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rje skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa 'di/ /dus da bar tshul bzhin gnas na yang / /da gzugs brnyan tsam du 'gro nyen gda'/ /de'i snga ltas cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la 308

yis/ /zong mang po bsdus nas khe tshong byas/ /nang la la tshong khang zhig dang 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /nor mdzo 'bri ba glang tshags byas nas/ /nang la la gnag rdzi'i sdod sa 'dra/ /'dir bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /zhing rmo ba'i thong gshol nang du bzhag /nang la la grong ba'i sdod sa 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /dngos lkog na dud chang bud med bsten/ /nang la la khyim tshang zhig dang 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /nub nam gung brkus dang 'phrog bcom byas/ /nang la la rkun tshang zhig dang 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /dmag 'khrug pa'i kha 'go dmag jus byas/ /nang la la dmag gi 'go pa 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang skyes bu dam pa yis/ /tshong 'tsho skyong zhing las ma byed sogs/ /chos gsung rung nyan mkhan dkon par snang / /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang dgon lhag rgyas na yang / /bstan gzugs brnyan tsam du 'gro nyen 309

yis/ /zong mang po bsdus nas khe tshong byas/ /nang la la tshong khang zhig dang 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /nor mdzo 'bri ba glang tshags byas nas/ /nang la la gnag rdzi'i sdod sa 'dra/ /'dir bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /zhing rmo ba'i thong gshol nang du bzhag /nang la la grong ba'i sdod sa 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /dngos lkog na dud chang bud med bsten/ /nang la la khyim tshang zhig dang 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /nub nam gung brkus dang 'phrog bcom byas/ /nang la la rkun tshang zhig dang 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang grwa pa la la yis/ /dmag 'khrug pa'i kha 'go dmag jus byas/ /nang la la dmag gi 'go pa 'dra/ /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang skyes bu dam pa yis/ /tshong 'tsho skyong zhing las ma byed sogs/ /chos gsung rung nyan mkhan dkon par snang / /'di bltas na gzugs brnyan tsam du gda'/ /dus deng sang dgon lhag rgyas na yang / /bstan gzugs brnyan tsam du 'gro nyen 309

gda'/ /rje'i bstan pa tshul bzhin gnas 'dod na/ /kun chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin du mdzod/ /rje yab sras thugs bskyed smon lam dang / /rang gzhan gyi rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /rje'i bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de/ /phyogs kun tu tshul bzhin tshugs par shog /ces blangs nas go'u sde'i phu'i bkra shis nyams dga' ru song / dge sbyor byed zhor la sku gzhogs gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi thugs sras rdzong dkar blo gros sogs skya ser mang po la nga'i rnam thar sogs kyi lung byas/ bkra shis nyams dga' ru mtshams khang zhig kyang brgyab/ mtshams pa kha shas bzhag de nas gnas chen shel rdi'i grub gnas su song / zhag bco lnga tsam la gnas 'brel bzhag de dus sa bzang tshwa kho'i yul gyi so mang rgyal po dang rdzong 'gags rgyal mo gnyis mi bzang bas/ rdzong 'gags rgyal mos nga la mtshams zhus brtag pa zhu ru bang chen pa tshar gnyis thon pa la/ dogs pa skyes nas so mang rgyal pos mtshams zhus kyi tshul du yi ge zhig bskur ba bang chen pa gnyis kyis khyer byung ba'i lan du/ ngas 'di nas de la dogs pa mi dgos tshul gyi mtshams zhus yi ge rgyas pa 'di nyid phul lo//phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma mchog gsum nor bu bzhin 310

gda'/ /rje'i bstan pa tshul bzhin gnas 'dod na/ /kun chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin du mdzod/ /rje yab sras thugs bskyed smon lam dang / /rang gzhan gyi rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /rje'i bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de/ /phyogs kun tu tshul bzhin tshugs par shog /ces blangs nas go'u sde'i phu'i bkra shis nyams dga' ru song / dge sbyor byed zhor la sku gzhogs gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi thugs sras rdzong dkar blo gros sogs skya ser mang po la nga'i rnam thar sogs kyi lung byas/ bkra shis nyams dga' ru mtshams khang zhig kyang brgyab/ mtshams pa kha shas bzhag de nas gnas chen shel rdi'i grub gnas su song / zhag bco lnga tsam la gnas 'brel bzhag de dus sa bzang tshwa kho'i yul gyi so mang rgyal po dang rdzong 'gags rgyal mo gnyis mi bzang bas/ rdzong 'gags rgyal mos nga la mtshams zhus brtag pa zhu ru bang chen pa tshar gnyis thon pa la/ dogs pa skyes nas so mang rgyal pos mtshams zhus kyi tshul du yi ge zhig bskur ba bang chen pa gnyis kyis khyer byung ba'i lan du/ ngas 'di nas de la dogs pa mi dgos tshul gyi mtshams zhus yi ge rgyas pa 'di nyid phul lo//phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma mchog gsum nor bu bzhin 310

spyi bo'i rgyan du 'dzin cing / rnam dkar dge phyogs la rab tu dga' ba'i yul bzang tshwa kho'i so mang rgyal po yum blon dang bcas pa'i sku drung du/ rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas rab tu gus pa'i yig chung zhig 'bul 'bras/mchog gsum thugs rjes khyed rnams sku khams bzang zhing chos ldan gyi bya ba la brtson bzhin pa'i ngos nas/ 'dir yig rten rdor dril cha gnyis lha rdzas dri med gsum bcas stsal ba 'byor bas dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung /gus phran mi rgan mgo dkar bdag kyang sgyu ma'i lus po bde zhing bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i lhag bsam gong 'phel du mchis/ mtshams zhus/ bdag gis chung nas bsam pa bzang bo'i sgo nas chos ldan gyi bya ba gang nus bsgrub pa ma gtogs/mthu ngan sngags 'dra byed ma myong / da mgo dkar por song 'chi la nye ba'i dus 'dir chos gsungs kyang mthu ngan sngags ga la byed/ lhag par khyed tshang la byed don med/ rdzong 'gags rgyal mo ma bu gnyis kyis sngar mtshams zhus thugs brtag gi yi ge kha shas byung ba ma gtogs/ mthu byed dgos zer ba'i yi ge'i rigs gtan nas ma byung dkon mchog gsum dpang zhes mna' bskyal ba yin pas yid ches par gyis la/ gzhan su gang 311

spyi bo'i rgyan du 'dzin cing / rnam dkar dge phyogs la rab tu dga' ba'i yul bzang tshwa kho'i so mang rgyal po yum blon dang bcas pa'i sku drung du/ rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas rab tu gus pa'i yig chung zhig 'bul 'bras/mchog gsum thugs rjes khyed rnams sku khams bzang zhing chos ldan gyi bya ba la brtson bzhin pa'i ngos nas/ 'dir yig rten rdor dril cha gnyis lha rdzas dri med gsum bcas stsal ba 'byor bas dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung /gus phran mi rgan mgo dkar bdag kyang sgyu ma'i lus po bde zhing bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i lhag bsam gong 'phel du mchis/ mtshams zhus/ bdag gis chung nas bsam pa bzang bo'i sgo nas chos ldan gyi bya ba gang nus bsgrub pa ma gtogs/mthu ngan sngags 'dra byed ma myong / da mgo dkar por song 'chi la nye ba'i dus 'dir chos gsungs kyang mthu ngan sngags ga la byed/ lhag par khyed tshang la byed don med/ rdzong 'gags rgyal mo ma bu gnyis kyis sngar mtshams zhus thugs brtag gi yi ge kha shas byung ba ma gtogs/ mthu byed dgos zer ba'i yi ge'i rigs gtan nas ma byung dkon mchog gsum dpang zhes mna' bskyal ba yin pas yid ches par gyis la/ gzhan su gang 311

la yang kha mchu 'dra gtan nas ma byed dang bzang ngas 'di nas yon mchod rnams tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te/ sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya zhes yig rten stong min tsam du lha rdzas dri med tshe yi ril bu/ skye bdun ril bu skra lo na bza'i tshal bu/ srung mdud bcas/ dben gnas shel rdi nas phul ba mthong thos kyi yul la bkra shis shing lo yag mi thams cad tshe ring zhing chos 'phel bar gyur cig ces smon lam yang 'debs pa lags so/ /smras pa/ mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /spyi bo brgyan nas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /bla mas ci gsungs bsgrubs na ci bsam 'grub/ /ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrubs dang so mang ba/ /dal 'byor mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /don med chud zos ma gtong so mang ba/ /mi tshe yad ma yud la shor nas 'gro/ /mi rtag chi ba yong ngo so mang ba/ /shi na sdig can dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /las ngan sdig pa ma gsog so mang ba/ /las can mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /rnam dkar dge las 'bod cig so mang ba/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /byams dang rnying rje sgoms shig so 312

la yang kha mchu 'dra gtan nas ma byed dang bzang ngas 'di nas yon mchod rnams tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te/ sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya zhes yig rten stong min tsam du lha rdzas dri med tshe yi ril bu/ skye bdun ril bu skra lo na bza'i tshal bu/ srung mdud bcas/ dben gnas shel rdi nas phul ba mthong thos kyi yul la bkra shis shing lo yag mi thams cad tshe ring zhing chos 'phel bar gyur cig ces smon lam yang 'debs pa lags so/ /smras pa/ mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /spyi bo brgyan nas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /bla mas ci gsungs bsgrubs na ci bsam 'grub/ /ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrubs dang so mang ba/ /dal 'byor mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /don med chud zos ma gtong so mang ba/ /mi tshe yad ma yud la shor nas 'gro/ /mi rtag chi ba yong ngo so mang ba/ /shi na sdig can dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /las ngan sdig pa ma gsog so mang ba/ /las can mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /rnam dkar dge las 'bod cig so mang ba/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /byams dang rnying rje sgoms shig so 312

mang ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan sems las 'khrungs/ /kun la phan sems sbyongs shig so mang ba/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis lo legs shing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces phul ba mthong zhing thos pa dang sngar gyi rnam rtog ngan pa thams cad rang sar zhi nas thugs dga' zhing spro ba byung skad/ yang tshe blos btang gi slob ma ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i gling rgya'i a lags blo bzang dar rgyas kyis/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su sdod dus chos phyir dka' spyad snying rus re skye nus pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ ngas sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa'i rnam thar rags rim tsam zhig bshad nas slar yang mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /bdag cag ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /gtso byas dam pa gong ma yi/ /rnam thar dran bzhin gus phyag 'tshal/ /dka' thub nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad 'dod pa'i/ /skal ldan snying gi 313

mang ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan sems las 'khrungs/ /kun la phan sems sbyongs shig so mang ba/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis lo legs shing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces phul ba mthong zhing thos pa dang sngar gyi rnam rtog ngan pa thams cad rang sar zhi nas thugs dga' zhing spro ba byung skad/ yang tshe blos btang gi slob ma ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i gling rgya'i a lags blo bzang dar rgyas kyis/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas rnams su sdod dus chos phyir dka' spyad snying rus re skye nus pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ ngas sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa'i rnam thar rags rim tsam zhig bshad nas slar yang mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /bdag cag ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /gtso byas dam pa gong ma yi/ /rnam thar dran bzhin gus phyag 'tshal/ /dka' thub nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad 'dod pa'i/ /skal ldan snying gi 313

slob ma la//gong ma'i rnam thar bshad kyis nyon/ /ston pas slob pa lam gye dus/ /chos tshig bzhi ba tsam re'i phyir/ /sku lus mar me sdong btsugs shing / /lcags gzer stong gis btab tshul soms/ /sgu tshe 'di la lo drug bar/ /ne+e rañja na'i chu 'gram du/ /'bras nyag chu yi thig pa re/ /bsten nas dka' ba spyad tshul soms/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus/ /chos phyir sha rus btsongs pa dang / /lha chen rnams la khrag gtar nas/ /sa la chag chag btab tshul soms/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la yis/ /chos phyir sgal mig gsum tsam bton/ /dben par mi lo bco brgyad bar/ /zwa la dka' thub spyad tshul soms/ /dmas shod chos rje lo ras pas/ /gnam mtsho phyug mo'i mtsho dbus su/ /lo gcig 'tsho ba la brten nas/ /lo mang dka' ba spyad tshul soms/ /rgyal gyi shri'i rgod tshang pas/ /lha khab dben pa'i mtsho dbus su/ /chu yi bcud len la brten nas/ /lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad tshul soms/ /'bum thang dung mtsho ras pa yis/ /chu yi bcud len kho na la/ /brten nas mi lo sum cu'i bar/ /dben par sgrub pa mdzad tshul soms/ /grub thob zapa po nyi phug pas/ /rta sgo dben pa'i mtha' rtsa ru/ /rtse dgu'i 'tsho ba byas/ /lo bdun sgrub pa mdzad tshul soyi314

slob ma la//gong ma'i rnam thar bshad kyis nyon/ /ston pas slob pa lam gye dus/ /chos tshig bzhi ba tsam re'i phyir/ /sku lus mar me sdong btsugs shing / /lcags gzer stong gis btab tshul soms/ /sgu tshe 'di la lo drug bar/ /ne+e rañja na'i chu 'gram du/ /'bras nyag chu yi thig pa re/ /bsten nas dka' ba spyad tshul soms/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus/ /chos phyir sha rus btsongs pa dang / /lha chen rnams la khrag gtar nas/ /sa la chag chag btab tshul soms/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la yis/ /chos phyir sgal mig gsum tsam bton/ /dben par mi lo bco brgyad bar/ /zwa la dka' thub spyad tshul soms/ /dmas shod chos rje lo ras pas/ /gnam mtsho phyug mo'i mtsho dbus su/ /lo gcig 'tsho ba la brten nas/ /lo mang dka' ba spyad tshul soms/ /rgyal gyi shri'i rgod tshang pas/ /lha khab dben pa'i mtsho dbus su/ /chu yi bcud len la brten nas/ /lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad tshul soms/ /'bum thang dung mtsho ras pa yis/ /chu yi bcud len kho na la/ /brten nas mi lo sum cu'i bar/ /dben par sgrub pa mdzad tshul soms/ /grub thob zapa po nyi phug pas/ /rta sgo dben pa'i mtha' rtsa ru/ /rtse dgu'i 'tsho ba byas/ /lo bdun sgrub pa mdzad tshul soyi314

phu'i rin chen rmog cog pas/ /shing gi lo ma'i bcud len la/ /brten nas mi lo bcu gsum bar/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs tshul soms/ /de bzhin me long rdo rje dang / /grub thob thar pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs/ /sngon byon dam pa thams cad kyis/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad tshul soms/ /rgyal ba gong ma de rnams kyis/ /snying rus byas la grub pa brnyes/ /sos dal skyid chos mkhan rnams la/ /ji 'dra byung 'dug bsam blo thongs/ /de phyir gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dka' spyad snying rus chen po yis/ /dben par sgrub pa mdzad nus na/ /nyams rtogs nyi ma 'char bar nges/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /gong ma'i rnam thar zin phyir bsngo/ /de'i mthus slob ma yang slob kyis/ /chos phyir dka' spyad 'tshang rgya shog /ces blangs pa'i nang ltar dka' spyad snying rus kyi sgo nas bka' phyag chu bo nyis 'dres kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su blangs pas gshegs khar lam sna zin par gyur to//yang dad can go'u sde'i sngags 'chang ngag dbang bkra shis kyis rab tu gus pa'i lha phyag mang po phul/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas skyabs mgon rin po che/ kho bo na so rgas pas gzhan gyi nyams len mang po zhig mi thub par gda'/ sems ngo re 315

phu'i rin chen rmog cog pas/ /shing gi lo ma'i bcud len la/ /brten nas mi lo bcu gsum bar/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs tshul soms/ /de bzhin me long rdo rje dang / /grub thob thar pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs/ /sngon byon dam pa thams cad kyis/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad tshul soms/ /rgyal ba gong ma de rnams kyis/ /snying rus byas la grub pa brnyes/ /sos dal skyid chos mkhan rnams la/ /ji 'dra byung 'dug bsam blo thongs/ /de phyir gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dka' spyad snying rus chen po yis/ /dben par sgrub pa mdzad nus na/ /nyams rtogs nyi ma 'char bar nges/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /gong ma'i rnam thar zin phyir bsngo/ /de'i mthus slob ma yang slob kyis/ /chos phyir dka' spyad 'tshang rgya shog /ces blangs pa'i nang ltar dka' spyad snying rus kyi sgo nas bka' phyag chu bo nyis 'dres kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su blangs pas gshegs khar lam sna zin par gyur to//yang dad can go'u sde'i sngags 'chang ngag dbang bkra shis kyis rab tu gus pa'i lha phyag mang po phul/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas skyabs mgon rin po che/ kho bo na so rgas pas gzhan gyi nyams len mang po zhig mi thub par gda'/ sems ngo re 315

bskyangs na snyam pas de skyong ba la spro shugs 'byung ba'i phyir/sems nyid nyi zla nam mkha' chu bo rgya mtsho ri rab nor bu rnams dang 'dra ba'i yon tan yod tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /ngo bo 'phel 'grib med pa dang / /rang bzhin sgrib med 'od du gsal/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ /sems nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang / /byang chub sems kyi 'od dkar gyis/ /nyon mongs mun pa sel bas na/ /sems nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /rang bzhin thogs rdugs med pa dang / /phyogs ris med par kun la khyab/ /snang ba thams cad 'gags med snang / /sems nyid nam mkha'i dbyengs dang 'dra/ /thog ma med nas tha ma'i bar/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur rgyun chad med/ /rang gi dri ma rang gis sbyongs/ /sems nyid chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra/ /rnam rtog rlung gis mi g.yo zhing / /rig rtsal gzugs brnyan cir yang 'char/ /yon tan nor bu'i 'byung gnas yin/ /sems nyid rgya mtsho chen bo 'dra/ /nam yang g.yo med rtsa ba brtan/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i bang rim mdzes/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis nyi zlas brgyan/ /sems nyid ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/ /316

bskyangs na snyam pas de skyong ba la spro shugs 'byung ba'i phyir/sems nyid nyi zla nam mkha' chu bo rgya mtsho ri rab nor bu rnams dang 'dra ba'i yon tan yod tshul gyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /ngo bo 'phel 'grib med pa dang / /rang bzhin sgrib med 'od du gsal/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ /sems nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang / /byang chub sems kyi 'od dkar gyis/ /nyon mongs mun pa sel bas na/ /sems nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /rang bzhin thogs rdugs med pa dang / /phyogs ris med par kun la khyab/ /snang ba thams cad 'gags med snang / /sems nyid nam mkha'i dbyengs dang 'dra/ /thog ma med nas tha ma'i bar/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur rgyun chad med/ /rang gi dri ma rang gis sbyongs/ /sems nyid chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra/ /rnam rtog rlung gis mi g.yo zhing / /rig rtsal gzugs brnyan cir yang 'char/ /yon tan nor bu'i 'byung gnas yin/ /sems nyid rgya mtsho chen bo 'dra/ /nam yang g.yo med rtsa ba brtan/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i bang rim mdzes/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis nyi zlas brgyan/ /sems nyid ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/ /316

glo bur dri ma dag pa dang / /nam yang rtog pa mi mnga' ba'i /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /de 'dra'i yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i tshe/ /dben par nyams su len nus na/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas kho rang gi sems la sngar bas lhag pa'i yid ches nges shes chen po skyes nas sems ngo bskyangs pas/ chags zhen chung du song / snying rje che ru song ste nyam thag sems can yongs la phan thogs pa'i chos pa bzang po zhig byung ngo //de nas grub gnas brgyad kyi nang gi gong ma rdzong dmar grub gnas su song / zhag po mang po bsdad/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i hor rgya'i sku skyes/ dge slong ye shes dar rgyas sogs tshe blos btang gi slob ma mang po la/ dwags po bka' 'bum sogs bka' brgyud kyi chos skor mang po'i lung byas nas mgon shul dang mgar rtse/ dpyi sa/ hor so nag bon rgya dme shul sogs 'brog phyogs su song / dad can rnams la chos bshad/ tshe dbang dang nor dbang bskur/ 'gro don byas pas thams cad dad pa'i ngos nas/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag che chung sum cu/ lug lnga brgya/ rkyal mar che chung brgyad cu/ phyur ba do bo nyi shu/ tshar bu 317

glo bur dri ma dag pa dang / /nam yang rtog pa mi mnga' ba'i /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /de 'dra'i yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i tshe/ /dben par nyams su len nus na/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas kho rang gi sems la sngar bas lhag pa'i yid ches nges shes chen po skyes nas sems ngo bskyangs pas/ chags zhen chung du song / snying rje che ru song ste nyam thag sems can yongs la phan thogs pa'i chos pa bzang po zhig byung ngo //de nas grub gnas brgyad kyi nang gi gong ma rdzong dmar grub gnas su song / zhag po mang po bsdad/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i hor rgya'i sku skyes/ dge slong ye shes dar rgyas sogs tshe blos btang gi slob ma mang po la/ dwags po bka' 'bum sogs bka' brgyud kyi chos skor mang po'i lung byas nas mgon shul dang mgar rtse/ dpyi sa/ hor so nag bon rgya dme shul sogs 'brog phyogs su song / dad can rnams la chos bshad/ tshe dbang dang nor dbang bskur/ 'gro don byas pas thams cad dad pa'i ngos nas/ rta mdzo 'bri g.yag che chung sum cu/ lug lnga brgya/ rkyal mar che chung brgyad cu/ phyur ba do bo nyi shu/ tshar bu 317

pags pa phying dkar sogs zas nor longs spyod mang po 'bul mkhan byung / de'i nang nas slob ma grwa pa mtshams pa nyam thag sprang po gnas skor ba dbus su 'gro mkhan brgya tsam la/ tshar bu pags pa phying dkar sogs kyi gon pa brgya dang ja mar bcas byin/ mdzo rta 'bri g.yag ra lug kha shas kyang byin/ rong bo'i nang so 'brog tu phebs yod pa la mtshams zhus su rta gcig phul/ bla brang gi thog tu 'brog pa'i dmag mi 'gro ba'i ngo chen zhus/ gyod gtam rgyu byas/ dngos sam brgyud nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan rgya chen po thogs pa byung / tshur 'ong khar mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so / /mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon rnams/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi ngas mi rtag dbyangs su len/ /mi rnams skyo ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /skye ba thams cad 'chi ba yin/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i tshul soms la/ /ma shi gong du phyag skor gyis/ /nam zhig shi rung 'gyod pa med/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin/ /mi rtag 'bral ba'i tshul soms la/ /ma bral gong du mthun par 'grogs/ /nam zhig bral rung 'gyod pa med/ /bsags pa'i tha ma 'dzad pa yin/ /mi rtag 'dzad pa'i tshul soms la/ /ma zad gong du mchod sbyin thongs/ /nam zhig zad 318

pags pa phying dkar sogs zas nor longs spyod mang po 'bul mkhan byung / de'i nang nas slob ma grwa pa mtshams pa nyam thag sprang po gnas skor ba dbus su 'gro mkhan brgya tsam la/ tshar bu pags pa phying dkar sogs kyi gon pa brgya dang ja mar bcas byin/ mdzo rta 'bri g.yag ra lug kha shas kyang byin/ rong bo'i nang so 'brog tu phebs yod pa la mtshams zhus su rta gcig phul/ bla brang gi thog tu 'brog pa'i dmag mi 'gro ba'i ngo chen zhus/ gyod gtam rgyu byas/ dngos sam brgyud nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan rgya chen po thogs pa byung / tshur 'ong khar mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so / /mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon rnams/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi ngas mi rtag dbyangs su len/ /mi rnams skyo ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /skye ba thams cad 'chi ba yin/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i tshul soms la/ /ma shi gong du phyag skor gyis/ /nam zhig shi rung 'gyod pa med/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin/ /mi rtag 'bral ba'i tshul soms la/ /ma bral gong du mthun par 'grogs/ /nam zhig bral rung 'gyod pa med/ /bsags pa'i tha ma 'dzad pa yin/ /mi rtag 'dzad pa'i tshul soms la/ /ma zad gong du mchod sbyin thongs/ /nam zhig zad 318

rung 'gyod pa med/ /mthon po'i tha ma ltung ba yin/ /mi rtag lhung ba'i tshul soms la/ /ma lhung gong du dman pa skyongs/ /nam zhig lhung rung 'gyod pa med/ /brtsigs pa'i tha ma 'jig pa yin/ /mi rtag 'jig pa'i tshul soms la/ /ma zhig gong du rten bzheng gyis/ /nam zhig zhig rung 'gyod pa med/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad la/ /bsam na mi rtag snying po med/ /gang la ma chags lha chos mdzod/ /phyi mar song yang 'gyod pa med/ /tshe 'dir nged rnams yud tsam zhig /mjal nas so sor gyes na yang / /phyi mar 'grogs nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing du 'gro ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /zhes blangs pas kun gyis phyag 'tshal skor ba byas rang rang gi yul du song / nged dpon slob rnams mtha' smug tu 'ongs dus/ nam zla ston gyis gtugs rtsi shing ser por song tshe sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis dben pa dran nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /spang ljongs me tog gi khrod na/ /sbrang ma che chung kun skyid kyang / /yun ring mi sdod par ba mo/ /'ong snyam skyo ba rang skyes song / /thang bde rtswa sngon gyi khrod na/ /ri dwags pho mo kun skyid kyang / /yun ring mi sdod par rngon pa/ /'ong snyam skyo ba rang skyes song / /grong yul zas nor gyi khrod na/ /rnal 'byor dpon 319

rung 'gyod pa med/ /mthon po'i tha ma ltung ba yin/ /mi rtag lhung ba'i tshul soms la/ /ma lhung gong du dman pa skyongs/ /nam zhig lhung rung 'gyod pa med/ /brtsigs pa'i tha ma 'jig pa yin/ /mi rtag 'jig pa'i tshul soms la/ /ma zhig gong du rten bzheng gyis/ /nam zhig zhig rung 'gyod pa med/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad la/ /bsam na mi rtag snying po med/ /gang la ma chags lha chos mdzod/ /phyi mar song yang 'gyod pa med/ /tshe 'dir nged rnams yud tsam zhig /mjal nas so sor gyes na yang / /phyi mar 'grogs nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing du 'gro ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /zhes blangs pas kun gyis phyag 'tshal skor ba byas rang rang gi yul du song / nged dpon slob rnams mtha' smug tu 'ongs dus/ nam zla ston gyis gtugs rtsi shing ser por song tshe sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis dben pa dran nas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /spang ljongs me tog gi khrod na/ /sbrang ma che chung kun skyid kyang / /yun ring mi sdod par ba mo/ /'ong snyam skyo ba rang skyes song / /thang bde rtswa sngon gyi khrod na/ /ri dwags pho mo kun skyid kyang / /yun ring mi sdod par rngon pa/ /'ong snyam skyo ba rang skyes song / /grong yul zas nor gyi khrod na/ /rnal 'byor dpon 319

slob kun skyid kyang / /yun ring mi sdod par 'chi ba/ /'ong snyam skyo ba rang skyes song / /smug chung sha ba ni mang po/ /rdza ri mthon po la bzhud song / /sha ba rwa mdzes khyod ma sdod/ /rdza ri mthon po rang snyogs shig /rtsal ldan nye'u chung ni mang po/ /chu klung chen po ru bzhud song / /nya mo gser mig khyod ma sdod/ /chu klung chen po rang snyogs shig /blo ldan chos grogs ni mang po/ /dben pa'i ri khrod la bzhud song / /bya btang rnal 'byor khyod ma sdod/ /dben pa'i ri khrod rang snyogs shig /ces blangs nas 'brong lung du yong / rab byung sogs zhabs phyi ba mang pos zas nor phal cher khyer nas rong bo brgyud nas bkra shis 'khyel bar song / mar gye nang nas rkyal mar che chung bcu gsum/ phyur ba do bo bcu tsam zhig rong bo'i dgon chen la btang / de'i 'phro rnams dgon pa che chung mang por mang ja btang / mtshams pa ri khrod pa zhabs phyi sprang po rnams kyi mthun rkyen byas/ 'brong lung du mtshams khang che chung bcu gsum brgyab/ sbra nag bdun tsam phub/ mi lnga bcu tsam zhig dgun mtshams byas bsdad/ kun la dge sbyor 'phel po byung / nyin zhig dad gtong blo gros mchog tu mnga' ba'i hor dpon po dbang chen dang / dbon po rdo re/ a lags mkha' 'gro/ o 320

slob kun skyid kyang / /yun ring mi sdod par 'chi ba/ /'ong snyam skyo ba rang skyes song / /smug chung sha ba ni mang po/ /rdza ri mthon po la bzhud song / /sha ba rwa mdzes khyod ma sdod/ /rdza ri mthon po rang snyogs shig /rtsal ldan nye'u chung ni mang po/ /chu klung chen po ru bzhud song / /nya mo gser mig khyod ma sdod/ /chu klung chen po rang snyogs shig /blo ldan chos grogs ni mang po/ /dben pa'i ri khrod la bzhud song / /bya btang rnal 'byor khyod ma sdod/ /dben pa'i ri khrod rang snyogs shig /ces blangs nas 'brong lung du yong / rab byung sogs zhabs phyi ba mang pos zas nor phal cher khyer nas rong bo brgyud nas bkra shis 'khyel bar song / mar gye nang nas rkyal mar che chung bcu gsum/ phyur ba do bo bcu tsam zhig rong bo'i dgon chen la btang / de'i 'phro rnams dgon pa che chung mang por mang ja btang / mtshams pa ri khrod pa zhabs phyi sprang po rnams kyi mthun rkyen byas/ 'brong lung du mtshams khang che chung bcu gsum brgyab/ sbra nag bdun tsam phub/ mi lnga bcu tsam zhig dgun mtshams byas bsdad/ kun la dge sbyor 'phel po byung / nyin zhig dad gtong blo gros mchog tu mnga' ba'i hor dpon po dbang chen dang / dbon po rdo re/ a lags mkha' 'gro/ o 320

rgyan dang / gnam go sogs dad can mang pos gnas bstod cig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor/ lha dang ḍā ki dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i gnas mchog 'aprong lung mngon dga' chos gling gi gnas bstod dge legs kun 'byung zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /gzhan dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu yis/ /chos sgrub rnams kyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ /yul bkra shis g.yang chags hor gye yul/ /ri phun tshogs 'brong lung dpal gyi ri/ /rgyab brag ri'i rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs/ /de chos mdzad tshe srog sra ba'i rtags/ /steng nam mkha' yangs shing nyi zla 'char/ /de lta sgom nyams su lon pa'i rtags/ /mar lung mdo dog cing phan tshun bsnol/ /de sdom pa dam tshig thub pa'i rtags/ /ngos kun nas rdza chu bsil ma 'bab/ /de byen rlabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i rtags/ /phar mdun na chu lam thang gsum 'dzom/ /de chos kyi mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i rtags/ /phyi lcags ri rim pa gnyis kyis bskor/ /de 'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung rtags/ /nang dri bzang lha shing shug pas gang / /de khrims ldan dge 'dun 'du ba'i rtags/ /bya khu byug sngon mos skad snyan 'byin/ /321

rgyan dang / gnam go sogs dad can mang pos gnas bstod cig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor/ lha dang ḍā ki dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i gnas mchog 'aprong lung mngon dga' chos gling gi gnas bstod dge legs kun 'byung zhes bya ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /gzhan dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu yis/ /chos sgrub rnams kyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ /yul bkra shis g.yang chags hor gye yul/ /ri phun tshogs 'brong lung dpal gyi ri/ /rgyab brag ri'i rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs/ /de chos mdzad tshe srog sra ba'i rtags/ /steng nam mkha' yangs shing nyi zla 'char/ /de lta sgom nyams su lon pa'i rtags/ /mar lung mdo dog cing phan tshun bsnol/ /de sdom pa dam tshig thub pa'i rtags/ /ngos kun nas rdza chu bsil ma 'bab/ /de byen rlabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i rtags/ /phar mdun na chu lam thang gsum 'dzom/ /de chos kyi mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i rtags/ /phyi lcags ri rim pa gnyis kyis bskor/ /de 'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung rtags/ /nang dri bzang lha shing shug pas gang / /de khrims ldan dge 'dun 'du ba'i rtags/ /bya khu byug sngon mos skad snyan 'byin/ /321
