de bla mas bka' chos gnang ba'i rtags/ /rkang drug ldan sbrang mas glu dbyangs len/ /de rnal 'byor nyams mgur len pa'i rtags/ /dbyar spang rjongs me tog sna tshogs skyes/ /de nyams rtogs yon tan skye ba'i rtags/ /sgo spu mdzes bya dang ri dwags mang / /de slob ma yon bdag 'khor ba'i rtags/ /chu shing rnams g.yas g.yon thag nyer gnas/ /de nye gnas gcig kyang mi dgos rtags/ /dbyar sos dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs/ /de 'byung ba tsha grang snyoms pa'i rtags/ /sgra 'a 'ur med pas shin tu dben/ /de dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel ba'i rtags/ /chos dga' ba'i lha klu yul 'dir mang / /de chos kyi mthun rkyen 'ong ba'i rtags/ /sa phun tshogs dge legs 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gnas 'di 'dra yul phyogs gzhan na dkon/ /don de phyir chos byed pho mo dang / /sgos bya btang sgom chen gnas 'dir byon/ /gnas 'di ru sgrub la gzhol nus na/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /sanas 'di nyid bstod pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /yul 'di yi lha mi kun dga' nas/ /gnas 'di ru lha chos bsgrub rnams la/ /chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor bar shog /ces tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i lha mi thams cad rab tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /gnas 322

de bla mas bka' chos gnang ba'i rtags/ /rkang drug ldan sbrang mas glu dbyangs len/ /de rnal 'byor nyams mgur len pa'i rtags/ /dbyar spang rjongs me tog sna tshogs skyes/ /de nyams rtogs yon tan skye ba'i rtags/ /sgo spu mdzes bya dang ri dwags mang / /de slob ma yon bdag 'khor ba'i rtags/ /chu shing rnams g.yas g.yon thag nyer gnas/ /de nye gnas gcig kyang mi dgos rtags/ /dbyar sos dus bsil zhing rig pa dwangs/ /de 'byung ba tsha grang snyoms pa'i rtags/ /sgra 'a 'ur med pas shin tu dben/ /de dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel ba'i rtags/ /chos dga' ba'i lha klu yul 'dir mang / /de chos kyi mthun rkyen 'ong ba'i rtags/ /sa phun tshogs dge legs 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gnas 'di 'dra yul phyogs gzhan na dkon/ /don de phyir chos byed pho mo dang / /sgos bya btang sgom chen gnas 'dir byon/ /gnas 'di ru sgrub la gzhol nus na/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /sanas 'di nyid bstod pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /yul 'di yi lha mi kun dga' nas/ /gnas 'di ru lha chos bsgrub rnams la/ /chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor bar shog /ces tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i lha mi thams cad rab tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /gnas 322

chen bzang po der gnas pa rnams la phan pa'i bslab bya 'di nyid byen te/ de yang phan bde 'byung gnas bla ma mchog gsum yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnams la rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams la byen rlabs dang dngos grub mtha' dag stsal du gsol/de yang bkra shis g.yang chags sa bzang 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal na gnas pa'i mtshams pa zhabs phyi mtha' ba rnams la/ rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas dge ba'i gsal 'debs cung zad zhu ba/ khyed rnams kyis skabs re rang la dge bskul 'di ltar mdzod/ 'i bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen tshe nyi ma nam tsha shor thal/ nam zhig la shi 'gro ci shes/ sang gnangs tsho shi 'dra song na gang du 'gro snyam du nam 'chi cha med soms la/ chos lo snga ma phyi ma gnyis kyi snga ma/ de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring tsam la'ang byed dgos pas mi tshad 'phyis song 'dug snyam du soms la/ nyin mtshan med par khyed mtshams pa rnams kyis/ rang rang gi gang shes kyi thugs dam dge sbyor la 'bod/ gzhan zhabs phyi mtha' ba rnams kyis mtshams pa rnams la phan gang thogs gyis/ nangs nub kun tu phyag skor ma ṇi sogs kha ton gang shes thon/ gcig gcig la 323

chen bzang po der gnas pa rnams la phan pa'i bslab bya 'di nyid byen te/ de yang phan bde 'byung gnas bla ma mchog gsum yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnams la rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams la byen rlabs dang dngos grub mtha' dag stsal du gsol/de yang bkra shis g.yang chags sa bzang 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal na gnas pa'i mtshams pa zhabs phyi mtha' ba rnams la/ rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas dge ba'i gsal 'debs cung zad zhu ba/ khyed rnams kyis skabs re rang la dge bskul 'di ltar mdzod/ 'i bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen tshe nyi ma nam tsha shor thal/ nam zhig la shi 'gro ci shes/ sang gnangs tsho shi 'dra song na gang du 'gro snyam du nam 'chi cha med soms la/ chos lo snga ma phyi ma gnyis kyi snga ma/ de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring tsam la'ang byed dgos pas mi tshad 'phyis song 'dug snyam du soms la/ nyin mtshan med par khyed mtshams pa rnams kyis/ rang rang gi gang shes kyi thugs dam dge sbyor la 'bod/ gzhan zhabs phyi mtha' ba rnams kyis mtshams pa rnams la phan gang thogs gyis/ nangs nub kun tu phyag skor ma ṇi sogs kha ton gang shes thon/ gcig gcig la 323

khong khro ma ldang / tshig ngan ma rgyag dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang po zhi ba dul ba gyes dang / tshe 'di phyi gnyis shar skyid po yong /'di nas nged dpon slob yon mchod rnams/ tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te/sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya/ khyed rnams kyis skabs rer bla ma'i byen rlabs sems la 'jug pa'i phyir gaḥ thog rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu rin po che'i gsung byin can bla ma rgyangs 'bod 'di thon dang bzang /mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi spyi dpal/ /sku gsum lhun grub kyi bdag nyid/ /'gran bral sangs rgyas rang mkhyen no/ /'e 'i bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ bka' brgyud bla ma yi rgyal po/ /zab dgu gdams mchog gi mdzod 'dzin/ /smin grol snying po yi don ster/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /'e 'i bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ bslu med thugs rje yi mnga' bdag /gtan bde byang chub kyi ded dpon/ /'di phyi 'dren mdzad kyi drin can/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /'e 'i bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ bdag 'dra'i las ngan gyi sems can/ /skyid sdug ci byung yang khyed las/ /blo phugs gtad sa gzhan ma 324

khong khro ma ldang / tshig ngan ma rgyag dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang po zhi ba dul ba gyes dang / tshe 'di phyi gnyis shar skyid po yong /'di nas nged dpon slob yon mchod rnams/ tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te/sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya/ khyed rnams kyis skabs rer bla ma'i byen rlabs sems la 'jug pa'i phyir gaḥ thog rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu rin po che'i gsung byin can bla ma rgyangs 'bod 'di thon dang bzang /mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi spyi dpal/ /sku gsum lhun grub kyi bdag nyid/ /'gran bral sangs rgyas rang mkhyen no/ /'e 'i bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ bka' brgyud bla ma yi rgyal po/ /zab dgu gdams mchog gi mdzod 'dzin/ /smin grol snying po yi don ster/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /'e 'i bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ bslu med thugs rje yi mnga' bdag /gtan bde byang chub kyi ded dpon/ /'di phyi 'dren mdzad kyi drin can/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /'e 'i bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ bdag 'dra'i las ngan gyi sems can/ /skyid sdug ci byung yang khyed las/ /blo phugs gtad sa gzhan ma 324

mchis/ /mtho dman gar gtang yang khyed shes/ /snying nas gsol 'debs kyi bu la/ /thugs rje g.yel med du gzigs shig /ces pa 'di rje btsun mi la'i grub gnas brag dkar rta so na tshogs su btsugs nas dbyangs snyan po byas 'don pa go bas sems la phan po byung / de'i shugs kyis slob ma rnams la smras pa'o/ /yang nyin cig sems la shar ba ltar rang gi slob ma mtshams pa zhabs phyi mtha' ba rnams la phan phyir zhal gdams 'di yang byin/na mo ar+ya lo ki shwa ra ya/ bod kyi lha skal gangs ri'i mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje chen po skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ de yang dben gnas gsar ba 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal 'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis byen gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ri zhig yin pa'i tshod na 'dug pas/ 'di nas dge sbyor gang byas kyang 'phel par gda'/ khyed rnams kyis skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms la myur du 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i phyir/ snying rje'i lha mchog yi 325

mchis/ /mtho dman gar gtang yang khyed shes/ /snying nas gsol 'debs kyi bu la/ /thugs rje g.yel med du gzigs shig /ces pa 'di rje btsun mi la'i grub gnas brag dkar rta so na tshogs su btsugs nas dbyangs snyan po byas 'don pa go bas sems la phan po byung / de'i shugs kyis slob ma rnams la smras pa'o/ /yang nyin cig sems la shar ba ltar rang gi slob ma mtshams pa zhabs phyi mtha' ba rnams la phan phyir zhal gdams 'di yang byin/na mo ar+ya lo ki shwa ra ya/ bod kyi lha skal gangs ri'i mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje chen po skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ de yang dben gnas gsar ba 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal 'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis byen gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ri zhig yin pa'i tshod na 'dug pas/ 'di nas dge sbyor gang byas kyang 'phel par gda'/ khyed rnams kyis skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms la myur du 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i phyir/ snying rje'i lha mchog yi 325

dam thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob/ tshad med bzhi'i ngang nas nangs nub kun tu chos kun snying po ma ṇi yi ge drug ma'i bzlas brjod la brtson/ sgo gsum rang babs su zhog la/ sems nyid gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngo bo ma g.yengs par dus rgyun du skyongs/ de'i ngang nas ma gyur sems can sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa rnams la snying rje sgoms la/ rgyud la snying rje phrag phrug re skye ba dang / myur du sangs rgyas nas ma sems can thams cad la phan thogs pa'i bsngo smon rgya gang che gyis dang /'phags pas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i sems kyi dbyings/ /gsal bar ston mdzad bla ma spyi bos mchod/ /sems nyid gsal stong ngang nas rang shugs kyis/ /bcos min snying rje skye bar byen gyes rlobs/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'gro la phan 'dod na/ /chos kun snying po stong nyid snying rje sgoms/ /de nyid rgyud la skye thabs tshogs gsog dang / /sgrib sbyong thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas brtson/ /sems nyid gsal stong ngang nas rang shugs kyis/ /nyam thag pha mar gyur pa'i sems can la/ /bcos min snying rje skye 'am mi sgye ltos/ /skyes na 'phags pas rjes su bzung ba'i rtags/ /ma skyes da dung rjes su ma bzung bas/ /yi dam snying rje 326

dam thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob/ tshad med bzhi'i ngang nas nangs nub kun tu chos kun snying po ma ṇi yi ge drug ma'i bzlas brjod la brtson/ sgo gsum rang babs su zhog la/ sems nyid gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngo bo ma g.yengs par dus rgyun du skyongs/ de'i ngang nas ma gyur sems can sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa rnams la snying rje sgoms la/ rgyud la snying rje phrag phrug re skye ba dang / myur du sangs rgyas nas ma sems can thams cad la phan thogs pa'i bsngo smon rgya gang che gyis dang /'phags pas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i sems kyi dbyings/ /gsal bar ston mdzad bla ma spyi bos mchod/ /sems nyid gsal stong ngang nas rang shugs kyis/ /bcos min snying rje skye bar byen gyes rlobs/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'gro la phan 'dod na/ /chos kun snying po stong nyid snying rje sgoms/ /de nyid rgyud la skye thabs tshogs gsog dang / /sgrib sbyong thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas brtson/ /sems nyid gsal stong ngang nas rang shugs kyis/ /nyam thag pha mar gyur pa'i sems can la/ /bcos min snying rje skye 'am mi sgye ltos/ /skyes na 'phags pas rjes su bzung ba'i rtags/ /ma skyes da dung rjes su ma bzung bas/ /yi dam snying rje 326

can gyi bsgom bzlas gyis/ /de ltar bsgoms na skabs shig rang shugs kyis/ /bcos min snying rje chen po skye bar 'gyur/ /de dus 'gro don rang bzhin shugs kyis 'ong / /stong nyid snying rje rgyud la skyes tsa na/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos kyi snying po glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /thos tshad rnams kyi sems la phan par shog /stong nyid snying rje gnyis po 'byongs pa yi/ /chos pas sa steng khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces blangs pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo / /lo gsar tshes la lha bsang chen po btang / dar 'phyar dung bus tshe thar btags/ g.yang 'gugs byas tshe gzungs dang klung rta'i dar lcog btsugs/ thams cad la lo gsar dga' ston byas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ chos mdzad pho mo mang po 'tshogs pa'i mgo nas bdag gis skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so//steng nas rtsa brgyud bla mas/ /byen rlabs sprin ltar gtibs byung / /bar na yi dam lha yis/ /dngos grub char ltar phab byung / /'og tu mkha' 'gro srung mas/ /'phrin las glog ltar 'khyug byung / /dam gtsang mched lcam tshogs kyis/ /glu dbyangs 'brug ltar bsgrags byung / /gnas 'dir byen rlabs dngos 327

can gyi bsgom bzlas gyis/ /de ltar bsgoms na skabs shig rang shugs kyis/ /bcos min snying rje chen po skye bar 'gyur/ /de dus 'gro don rang bzhin shugs kyis 'ong / /stong nyid snying rje rgyud la skyes tsa na/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos kyi snying po glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /thos tshad rnams kyi sems la phan par shog /stong nyid snying rje gnyis po 'byongs pa yi/ /chos pas sa steng khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces blangs pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo / /lo gsar tshes la lha bsang chen po btang / dar 'phyar dung bus tshe thar btags/ g.yang 'gugs byas tshe gzungs dang klung rta'i dar lcog btsugs/ thams cad la lo gsar dga' ston byas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ chos mdzad pho mo mang po 'tshogs pa'i mgo nas bdag gis skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so//steng nas rtsa brgyud bla mas/ /byen rlabs sprin ltar gtibs byung / /bar na yi dam lha yis/ /dngos grub char ltar phab byung / /'og tu mkha' 'gro srung mas/ /'phrin las glog ltar 'khyug byung / /dam gtsang mched lcam tshogs kyis/ /glu dbyangs 'brug ltar bsgrags byung / /gnas 'dir byen rlabs dngos 327

grub/ /dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin 'khyil byung / /sdig dang ma 'dres tshogs kyi/ /'khor lo'i yo byad 'dzoms byung / /dag pa'i zhing zhig mi yul/ /'phos pa lta bu byung snang / /'di 'dra'i skyid po byung ba/ /bla ma dkon mchog bka' drin/ /drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pa/ /nam 'tsho'i bar du 'bul lo/ /phyi rabs chos mdzad rnams la/ /'di 'dra'i skyid po shog cig /ces dang / yang nyams dga' bde ba'i glu 'di blangs/a ho ye/ bla ma zhig zhu na pad+ma yi rgyal po/ /byin rlabs gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /yi dam zhig zhu na rta phag yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /dngos grub gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /mkha' 'gro zhig zhu na gsang ba yi ye shes/ /'phrin las gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /chos skyong zhig zhu na mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /dgos 'dod gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /dam chos shig zhu na rdzogs pa yi chen po/ /sangs rgyas gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /mched grogs shig zhu na dam gtsang gi mched lcam/ /mched grogs gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi 328

grub/ /dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin 'khyil byung / /sdig dang ma 'dres tshogs kyi/ /'khor lo'i yo byad 'dzoms byung / /dag pa'i zhing zhig mi yul/ /'phos pa lta bu byung snang / /'di 'dra'i skyid po byung ba/ /bla ma dkon mchog bka' drin/ /drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pa/ /nam 'tsho'i bar du 'bul lo/ /phyi rabs chos mdzad rnams la/ /'di 'dra'i skyid po shog cig /ces dang / yang nyams dga' bde ba'i glu 'di blangs/a ho ye/ bla ma zhig zhu na pad+ma yi rgyal po/ /byin rlabs gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /yi dam zhig zhu na rta phag yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /dngos grub gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /mkha' 'gro zhig zhu na gsang ba yi ye shes/ /'phrin las gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /chos skyong zhig zhu na mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /dgos 'dod gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /dam chos shig zhu na rdzogs pa yi chen po/ /sangs rgyas gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /mched grogs shig zhu na dam gtsang gi mched lcam/ /mched grogs gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi 328

bde ba/ /dben gnas shig zhu na gnas mchog gi 'brong lung / /ri khrod gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /zhes pa dang / yang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro mdza' grogs su 'gugs pa'i rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//dag pa mkha' spyod na bzhugs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro mdza' grogs la byon cig /yul chen nyer bzhi sogs gnas gsum/ /mkha' 'gro mdza' grogs la byon cig /dngos nyams rmi lam ni gang la'ang / /lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs nas/ /bde stong ting 'dzin gyi ro yis/ /rtag tu myos pa zhig stsol cig /'od gsal sgyu lus gnyis zung du/ /'jug pa'i lam bzang la bslabs nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang / /myur du 'thob pa rang mdzod cig /nam zhig gdul bya rnams rdzogs nas/ /zhing khams gzhan dag tu 'pho tshe/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi tshogs kyis/ /zhal bzang mngon sum du bstan nas/ /rdo rje glu gar dang rol mo'i/ /ngo mtshar mchod sprin gyes bsus te/ /dag pa mkha' spyod sogs gang 'dod/ /zhing du 'dren par rang mdzod cig /bla ma mched grogs kyi zhabs pad/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar brtan cing / /gsang chen theg pa yi rtse dga'/ /329

bde ba/ /dben gnas shig zhu na gnas mchog gi 'brong lung / /ri khrod gzhan la re dgos ni mi 'dug /a ho nyams sang gi bde ba/ /zhes pa dang / yang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro mdza' grogs su 'gugs pa'i rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'di yang blangs so//dag pa mkha' spyod na bzhugs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro mdza' grogs la byon cig /yul chen nyer bzhi sogs gnas gsum/ /mkha' 'gro mdza' grogs la byon cig /dngos nyams rmi lam ni gang la'ang / /lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs nas/ /bde stong ting 'dzin gyi ro yis/ /rtag tu myos pa zhig stsol cig /'od gsal sgyu lus gnyis zung du/ /'jug pa'i lam bzang la bslabs nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang / /myur du 'thob pa rang mdzod cig /nam zhig gdul bya rnams rdzogs nas/ /zhing khams gzhan dag tu 'pho tshe/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi tshogs kyis/ /zhal bzang mngon sum du bstan nas/ /rdo rje glu gar dang rol mo'i/ /ngo mtshar mchod sprin gyes bsus te/ /dag pa mkha' spyod sogs gang 'dod/ /zhing du 'dren par rang mdzod cig /bla ma mched grogs kyi zhabs pad/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar brtan cing / /gsang chen theg pa yi rtse dga'/ /329

longs su spyod par rang gyur cig /ces blangs nas bde stong gi nyams bskyang ngo / /de nas dad can slob bu snyan grags/ dbon po dkar dris/ stag yan skal bzang / 'brug rtse yags sogs zhabs phyi ba rnams la/ da lo tsho skal ba bzang bzang gyis/ glu 'dra shes na longs byas pas/ kun gyis de red zer/ dga' dga' spro spro byas glu kha mtshar 'di 'dra len par gda'/ 'i stod kyi ri 'di gser gyi ri/ /gser gyi ri la nyi ma shar/ /bar gyi ri 'di dung gi ri/ /dung gi ri la zla ba tshes/ /smad kyi ri 'di mchong gi ri/ /mchong gi ri la mar khu 'khyil/ /'i ri smug pa can la 'ja' tshon 'then/ /pha bla ma mjal ba'i rten 'brel red/ /rtswa tshigs drug mgo la 'bras drug 'khrungs/ /zas sbrang dkar za ba'i rten 'brel red/ /chu rma chu'i kha na rma dar chags/ /rgya khe ba gshar ba'i rten 'brel red/ /'i stod ka na ri bo na bun can/ /ri na bun can la ri dwags 'khyu/ /smad ka na rgya mtsho rlangs pa can/ /mtsho rlangs pa can la nya sram 'khyu/ /bar 'di na bla ma byen rlabs can/ /rje byen rlabs can la slob ma 'khyu/ /'i steng nam mkha' yangs par lho sprin 'khrigs/ /char yag po 'bab pa'i rten 'brel red/ /'og sa gzhi yangs par drod gsher 'dzom/ /lo yag po yong ba'i rten 'brel red/ /bar 'jig rten 330

longs su spyod par rang gyur cig /ces blangs nas bde stong gi nyams bskyang ngo / /de nas dad can slob bu snyan grags/ dbon po dkar dris/ stag yan skal bzang / 'brug rtse yags sogs zhabs phyi ba rnams la/ da lo tsho skal ba bzang bzang gyis/ glu 'dra shes na longs byas pas/ kun gyis de red zer/ dga' dga' spro spro byas glu kha mtshar 'di 'dra len par gda'/ 'i stod kyi ri 'di gser gyi ri/ /gser gyi ri la nyi ma shar/ /bar gyi ri 'di dung gi ri/ /dung gi ri la zla ba tshes/ /smad kyi ri 'di mchong gi ri/ /mchong gi ri la mar khu 'khyil/ /'i ri smug pa can la 'ja' tshon 'then/ /pha bla ma mjal ba'i rten 'brel red/ /rtswa tshigs drug mgo la 'bras drug 'khrungs/ /zas sbrang dkar za ba'i rten 'brel red/ /chu rma chu'i kha na rma dar chags/ /rgya khe ba gshar ba'i rten 'brel red/ /'i stod ka na ri bo na bun can/ /ri na bun can la ri dwags 'khyu/ /smad ka na rgya mtsho rlangs pa can/ /mtsho rlangs pa can la nya sram 'khyu/ /bar 'di na bla ma byen rlabs can/ /rje byen rlabs can la slob ma 'khyu/ /'i steng nam mkha' yangs par lho sprin 'khrigs/ /char yag po 'bab pa'i rten 'brel red/ /'og sa gzhi yangs par drod gsher 'dzom/ /lo yag po yong ba'i rten 'brel red/ /bar 'jig rten 330

khams na zas nor 'dzom/ /kun bde zhing skyid pa'i rten 'brel red/ /'i skyid kyi skyid lung gong ma na/ /bla ma bzang po'i dbon po skyid/ /dbon byams sems che na grwa ba skyid/ /skyid kyi skyid lung bar ma na/ /dpon po bzang po'i blon po skyid/ /blon byams sems che na sde ba skyid/ /skyid kyi skyid lung 'og ma na/ /a ne bzang mo'i mna' ma skyid/ /mna' ma byams sems che na khyim tshang skyid/ /'i ma brdungs mtshon na rig ni bo/ /bre ser 'brong gi ru thur red/ /ma bris ri mo rig ni bo/ /rgya stag dar ma'i thig le red/ /ma byugs tshon la rig ni bo/ /rma bya gzhon nu'i sgo mdongs red/ /je ser po gser la mthun ni bo/ /'dzam gling nyi ma ser po red/ /dkar po dngul la mthun ni bo/ /bco lnga'i lha zla dkar po red/ /khra bo gzi la mthun ni bo/ /stod ki rdza ri khra mo red/ /'i stod ki dbus gtsang dag zhing na/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs/ /khong gi thugs rjes bod khams skyid/ /smad ki rgya nag gser mkhar na/ /gnam skyong gong ma rgyal po bzhugs/ /khong gi thugs rjes rgyal khams skyid/ /bar gyi mdo khams sgang 'di na/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs/ /khong gi thugs rjes mdo khams skyid/ /'i skyid gcig 'di jo bo'i mdun na yod/ /jo bo mjal yun ring na skyid 331

khams na zas nor 'dzom/ /kun bde zhing skyid pa'i rten 'brel red/ /'i skyid kyi skyid lung gong ma na/ /bla ma bzang po'i dbon po skyid/ /dbon byams sems che na grwa ba skyid/ /skyid kyi skyid lung bar ma na/ /dpon po bzang po'i blon po skyid/ /blon byams sems che na sde ba skyid/ /skyid kyi skyid lung 'og ma na/ /a ne bzang mo'i mna' ma skyid/ /mna' ma byams sems che na khyim tshang skyid/ /'i ma brdungs mtshon na rig ni bo/ /bre ser 'brong gi ru thur red/ /ma bris ri mo rig ni bo/ /rgya stag dar ma'i thig le red/ /ma byugs tshon la rig ni bo/ /rma bya gzhon nu'i sgo mdongs red/ /je ser po gser la mthun ni bo/ /'dzam gling nyi ma ser po red/ /dkar po dngul la mthun ni bo/ /bco lnga'i lha zla dkar po red/ /khra bo gzi la mthun ni bo/ /stod ki rdza ri khra mo red/ /'i stod ki dbus gtsang dag zhing na/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs/ /khong gi thugs rjes bod khams skyid/ /smad ki rgya nag gser mkhar na/ /gnam skyong gong ma rgyal po bzhugs/ /khong gi thugs rjes rgyal khams skyid/ /bar gyi mdo khams sgang 'di na/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs/ /khong gi thugs rjes mdo khams skyid/ /'i skyid gcig 'di jo bo'i mdun na yod/ /jo bo mjal yun ring na skyid 331

gcig red/ /skyid gcig 'di bla ma'i drung na yod/ /bla ma sku tshe ring na skyid gcig red/ /skyid gcig 'di pha ma'i rtsa na yod/ /pha ma tshe thag ring na skyid gcig red/ /'i ser po gser gye khri thog na/ /yon tan can gyi bla ma skyid/ /dkar po dngul gyi khri thog na/ /bsod nams can gyi dpon po skyid/ /thig le can gyi gdan thog na/ /rig pa can gyi blon po skyid/ /'i lha dbang brgya byen zhabs drung na/ /lha mos glu dbyangs len pa'i dus/ /lha rnams dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing drung nas/ /khu byug skad snyan sgrog pa'i dus/ /mi rnams dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung nas/ /gzhon nus glu dbyangs len pa'i dus/ /'dir 'tshogs dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /'i glu len na lha chen drung nas longs/ /lha rnams dga' ba'i glu dbyangs longs/ /lha phrug 'dzum rgod 'chor ni longs/ /glu len na klu chen drung nas longs/ /klu rnams dga' ba'i glu dbyangs longs/ /klu phrug 'dzum rgod 'chor ni longs/ /glu len na mi chen drung nas longs/ /mi rnams dga' ba'i glu dbyangs longs/ /gces phrug 'dzum rgod 'tshor ni longs/ /'i yar steng nas 'brug cig grag ni bo/ /dgung char skya 'bab pa'i rten 'brel red/ /mar sa na 332

gcig red/ /skyid gcig 'di bla ma'i drung na yod/ /bla ma sku tshe ring na skyid gcig red/ /skyid gcig 'di pha ma'i rtsa na yod/ /pha ma tshe thag ring na skyid gcig red/ /'i ser po gser gye khri thog na/ /yon tan can gyi bla ma skyid/ /dkar po dngul gyi khri thog na/ /bsod nams can gyi dpon po skyid/ /thig le can gyi gdan thog na/ /rig pa can gyi blon po skyid/ /'i lha dbang brgya byen zhabs drung na/ /lha mos glu dbyangs len pa'i dus/ /lha rnams dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing drung nas/ /khu byug skad snyan sgrog pa'i dus/ /mi rnams dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung nas/ /gzhon nus glu dbyangs len pa'i dus/ /'dir 'tshogs dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /'i glu len na lha chen drung nas longs/ /lha rnams dga' ba'i glu dbyangs longs/ /lha phrug 'dzum rgod 'chor ni longs/ /glu len na klu chen drung nas longs/ /klu rnams dga' ba'i glu dbyangs longs/ /klu phrug 'dzum rgod 'chor ni longs/ /glu len na mi chen drung nas longs/ /mi rnams dga' ba'i glu dbyangs longs/ /gces phrug 'dzum rgod 'tshor ni longs/ /'i yar steng nas 'brug cig grag ni bo/ /dgung char skya 'bab pa'i rten 'brel red/ /mar sa na 332

zhing zhig 'debs ni bo/ /zas sbrang dkar za ba'i rten 'brel red/ /bar 'di na glu zhig len ni bo/ /kha ja chang 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel red/ /glu shes ni min te rtse 'dod yin/ /'i stod ka no dung cig 'bud ni bo/ /stod dbus gtsang bla ma'i tshogs dung red/ /tshogs yod pa'i grwa pa'i skyid la med/ /smad ka na rnga zhig rdung ni bo/ /smad rgya nag rgyal po'i khrims rnga red/ /khrims yod pa'i rgya yi skyid la med/ /bar 'di na dar cig 'phyar ni bo/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i chos dar red/ /chos dar ba'i yul 'di'i skyid la med/ /'i gos gcig gis sems can dros ni bo/ /dpe bzhag na 'dzam gling nyi ma red/ /zas gcig gis sems can gsos ni bo/ /dpe bzhag na sbrang dkar rtsam pa red/ /dpon gcig gis rgyal khams skyong ni bo/ /dpe bzhag na gong ma rgyal po red/ /glu kha re bskor dang da dung len/ /'i stod dbus gtsang dung dkar khog pa 'dra/ /'bud mi dgos dung dkar rang grags red/ /smad rgya nag dngul dkar me long 'dra/ /phyi mi dgos me long rang gsal red/ /bar bod yul byur dkar phreng ba 'dra/ /'don mi dgos ma ṇi rang 'grub red/ /'i bya gshog pa can la nam mkha' bde/ /nam mkha' bde ni ma red ta/ /bya rang gi gshog pa bde ni red/ /rta gom pa can la sa gzhi 333

zhing zhig 'debs ni bo/ /zas sbrang dkar za ba'i rten 'brel red/ /bar 'di na glu zhig len ni bo/ /kha ja chang 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel red/ /glu shes ni min te rtse 'dod yin/ /'i stod ka no dung cig 'bud ni bo/ /stod dbus gtsang bla ma'i tshogs dung red/ /tshogs yod pa'i grwa pa'i skyid la med/ /smad ka na rnga zhig rdung ni bo/ /smad rgya nag rgyal po'i khrims rnga red/ /khrims yod pa'i rgya yi skyid la med/ /bar 'di na dar cig 'phyar ni bo/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i chos dar red/ /chos dar ba'i yul 'di'i skyid la med/ /'i gos gcig gis sems can dros ni bo/ /dpe bzhag na 'dzam gling nyi ma red/ /zas gcig gis sems can gsos ni bo/ /dpe bzhag na sbrang dkar rtsam pa red/ /dpon gcig gis rgyal khams skyong ni bo/ /dpe bzhag na gong ma rgyal po red/ /glu kha re bskor dang da dung len/ /'i stod dbus gtsang dung dkar khog pa 'dra/ /'bud mi dgos dung dkar rang grags red/ /smad rgya nag dngul dkar me long 'dra/ /phyi mi dgos me long rang gsal red/ /bar bod yul byur dkar phreng ba 'dra/ /'don mi dgos ma ṇi rang 'grub red/ /'i bya gshog pa can la nam mkha' bde/ /nam mkha' bde ni ma red ta/ /bya rang gi gshog pa bde ni red/ /rta gom pa can la sa gzhi 333

bde/ /sa gzhi bde ni ma red ta/ /rta rang gi gom pa bde ni red/ /bu rig pa can la rgyal khams bde/ /rgyal khams bde ni ma red ta/ /bu rang gi rig pa bde ni red/ /'i phug stod ka na khrab cig yod/ /de bug pa med ki mkhar cig red/ /kha ra ka na rta cig yod/ /ka gshog pa med ki bya cig red/ /go kha ka na bu cig yod/ /ka thig le med ki stag cig red/ /ka gsum dgos pa'i dus tshod yong/ /ka la bye dor yang yang gyis/ /bkra shis kyi glu ni/ 'i zas bzang po sbrang dkar rtsam pa red/ /kha zas dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /gos bzang po bal dkar snam bu red/ /rgyab gos dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /'i gos bzang po lha yi yul na yod/ /lha'i gos chen 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /nor bzang po klu yi yul na yod/ /klu'i nor bu 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /chos bzang po mi yi yul na yod/ /mi'i lha chos 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /'i gser bzang po mnga' ris stod na yod/ /lag gser dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /rta bzang po mdo khams smad na yod/ /rkang rta dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /nas bzang po dbus gtsang zhing na yod/ /kha zas dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i glu blangs pas/de'i nyin par kun dga' zhing spro ba byung / des na 'jig rten 334

bde/ /sa gzhi bde ni ma red ta/ /rta rang gi gom pa bde ni red/ /bu rig pa can la rgyal khams bde/ /rgyal khams bde ni ma red ta/ /bu rang gi rig pa bde ni red/ /'i phug stod ka na khrab cig yod/ /de bug pa med ki mkhar cig red/ /kha ra ka na rta cig yod/ /ka gshog pa med ki bya cig red/ /go kha ka na bu cig yod/ /ka thig le med ki stag cig red/ /ka gsum dgos pa'i dus tshod yong/ /ka la bye dor yang yang gyis/ /bkra shis kyi glu ni/ 'i zas bzang po sbrang dkar rtsam pa red/ /kha zas dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /gos bzang po bal dkar snam bu red/ /rgyab gos dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /'i gos bzang po lha yi yul na yod/ /lha'i gos chen 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /nor bzang po klu yi yul na yod/ /klu'i nor bu 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /chos bzang po mi yi yul na yod/ /mi'i lha chos 'bum gyi bkra shis shog /'i gser bzang po mnga' ris stod na yod/ /lag gser dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /rta bzang po mdo khams smad na yod/ /rkang rta dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /nas bzang po dbus gtsang zhing na yod/ /kha zas dang mi 'bral bkra shis shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i glu blangs pas/de'i nyin par kun dga' zhing spro ba byung / des na 'jig rten 334

pa'i glu 'di rnams chos pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyi bying rmugs gnyid gsum sangs pa dang / nyams dga' snang ba spro ba'i phyir yi ger bris pa lags/ yang nyin cig rje btsun red mda' ba'i gsung ngag dris lan/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa tsong kha bas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zhus nas phul ba'i nang ltar thugs nyams su bzhes tshul la zhib tu bltas pas/ sems la sngon dus rgyal ba yab sras dang de'i bu rgyud rnams kyis dben pa'i gnas su 'di bzhin nyams su bzhes pa lta bu deng sang gi rjes 'jug rnams kyis dka' snyam yang / bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug gi nor bu gser khang rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis ri khrod dben par 'di bzhin nyams len mdzad tshul la rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang byung tshe slar yang tshig su bcad nas smras pa/rje btsun red mda' ba yis dris pa'i lan/ /rje tsong kha ba yis 'jam dbyangs la/ /zhus nas phul ba'i nang ltar mdo sngags kyi/ /gnad rnams yongs rdzogs phyogs gcig dril nas ni/ /sngon dus rgyal ba yab sras bu rgyud kyis/ /dben pa'i gnas su nyams su bzhes pa bzhin/ /deng sang rjes 'jug rnams kyis dka' snyam yang / /'jam mgon bla ma blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel la zla bral ba/ /gser 335

pa'i glu 'di rnams chos pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyi bying rmugs gnyid gsum sangs pa dang / nyams dga' snang ba spro ba'i phyir yi ger bris pa lags/ yang nyin cig rje btsun red mda' ba'i gsung ngag dris lan/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa tsong kha bas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zhus nas phul ba'i nang ltar thugs nyams su bzhes tshul la zhib tu bltas pas/ sems la sngon dus rgyal ba yab sras dang de'i bu rgyud rnams kyis dben pa'i gnas su 'di bzhin nyams su bzhes pa lta bu deng sang gi rjes 'jug rnams kyis dka' snyam yang / bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug gi nor bu gser khang rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis ri khrod dben par 'di bzhin nyams len mdzad tshul la rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang byung tshe slar yang tshig su bcad nas smras pa/rje btsun red mda' ba yis dris pa'i lan/ /rje tsong kha ba yis 'jam dbyangs la/ /zhus nas phul ba'i nang ltar mdo sngags kyi/ /gnad rnams yongs rdzogs phyogs gcig dril nas ni/ /sngon dus rgyal ba yab sras bu rgyud kyis/ /dben pa'i gnas su nyams su bzhes pa bzhin/ /deng sang rjes 'jug rnams kyis dka' snyam yang / /'jam mgon bla ma blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel la zla bral ba/ /gser 335

khang rdo rje 'chang dbang yab sras kyis/ /dben par nyams len mdzad pa'i tshul 'di la/ /snying nas dga' bas rjes su yi rang byung / /phyi rabs chos mdzad skye bo pho mo dang / /khyad par 'jam mgon bla ma'i rjes 'jug rnams/ /bla ma'i rjes su kha mig yar blta byas/ /mdo sngags gnad la slobs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /dmar ser 'od phung 'phro ba'i 'jam dbyangs dang / /dbyer med ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tsong kha ba/ /nor bu bzhin du spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /chos kun sems la 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /ngo mtshar nags khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /mang thos sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /mdo sngag bdud rtsi 'thungs pas myos pa'i mod/ /nyams myong gnad kyi man ngag glu ru len/ /nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba dang / /rim gnyis nang du mdo sngags gnad 'gag tshang / /de 'dra'i gnad 'gag tshang ba'i lam bzang la/ /dben par nyams len byed pa skal ba bzang / /de ltar nyams len byas pa'i lag rjes la/ /bsam pa bzang zhing kun la dga' snang 'byongs/ /ris med bstan 'gro yongs ba/ phan thogs 'byung / /kun la de 'dra yong ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /lta ba bden pa gnyis su gtan la dbab/ /sgom pa lam rim rim gnyis nang 336

khang rdo rje 'chang dbang yab sras kyis/ /dben par nyams len mdzad pa'i tshul 'di la/ /snying nas dga' bas rjes su yi rang byung / /phyi rabs chos mdzad skye bo pho mo dang / /khyad par 'jam mgon bla ma'i rjes 'jug rnams/ /bla ma'i rjes su kha mig yar blta byas/ /mdo sngags gnad la slobs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /dmar ser 'od phung 'phro ba'i 'jam dbyangs dang / /dbyer med ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tsong kha ba/ /nor bu bzhin du spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /chos kun sems la 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /ngo mtshar nags khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /mang thos sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /mdo sngag bdud rtsi 'thungs pas myos pa'i mod/ /nyams myong gnad kyi man ngag glu ru len/ /nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba dang / /rim gnyis nang du mdo sngags gnad 'gag tshang / /de 'dra'i gnad 'gag tshang ba'i lam bzang la/ /dben par nyams len byed pa skal ba bzang / /de ltar nyams len byas pa'i lag rjes la/ /bsam pa bzang zhing kun la dga' snang 'byongs/ /ris med bstan 'gro yongs ba/ phan thogs 'byung / /kun la de 'dra yong ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /lta ba bden pa gnyis su gtan la dbab/ /sgom pa lam rim rim gnyis nang 336

ltar sgoms/ /spyod pa sdom pa gsum dang mthun par spyod/ /'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan 'byung / /de ltar lta sgom spyod 'bras gnad tshang ba'i/ /mdo sngags chos la bag chags 'jog 'dod na/ /bla ma'i drung nas byang chub lam rim gyis/ /rgyud sbyongs gsang sngags dbang zhus bskyed rdzogs slobs/ /tshe 'di blos btang dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin nyams len byed nus na/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la phan par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pa mthong thos kyi chos pa rnams kyis kyang rjes su yi rang byas so//de dus dbus gtsang du song ba'i slob ma 'ongs pa 'ga' res/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sprul sku mkhas grub rgya mtsho khams phyogs su 'khrungs pa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du gdan drangs song zer ba'i gtam snyan go tshe/ yid spro ba'i shugs kyis skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so/ /ri rab brtan cing brjid pa/ /gling bzhi'i dpal du che zhing / /nyi zla gzi mdangs 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i rgyan du mdzes so/ /chu klung du ma 'bab pa/ /rgya mtsho'i dpal du che zhing / /pad+ma phang phung g.yo ba/ /skyed tshal rgyan du mdzes so /337

ltar sgoms/ /spyod pa sdom pa gsum dang mthun par spyod/ /'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan 'byung / /de ltar lta sgom spyod 'bras gnad tshang ba'i/ /mdo sngags chos la bag chags 'jog 'dod na/ /bla ma'i drung nas byang chub lam rim gyis/ /rgyud sbyongs gsang sngags dbang zhus bskyed rdzogs slobs/ /tshe 'di blos btang dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin nyams len byed nus na/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la phan par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pa mthong thos kyi chos pa rnams kyis kyang rjes su yi rang byas so//de dus dbus gtsang du song ba'i slob ma 'ongs pa 'ga' res/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sprul sku mkhas grub rgya mtsho khams phyogs su 'khrungs pa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du gdan drangs song zer ba'i gtam snyan go tshe/ yid spro ba'i shugs kyis skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so/ /ri rab brtan cing brjid pa/ /gling bzhi'i dpal du che zhing / /nyi zla gzi mdangs 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i rgyan du mdzes so/ /chu klung du ma 'bab pa/ /rgya mtsho'i dpal du che zhing / /pad+ma phang phung g.yo ba/ /skyed tshal rgyan du mdzes so /337

rgyal ba'i sprul sku 'khrungs pa/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal du che zhing / /paṇa chen chos 'khor bskor pa/ /dbus gtsang rgyan du mdzes so/ /shar ri'i rtse nas 'od gsal/ /nyi ma gsal bo shar byung / /skyed mos tshal na gnas pa'i/ /me tog tshogs rnams skyid pa/ /skyed mos tshal nas pad+ma'i/ /dri zhim phyogs kun 'thul byung / /ro mngar sbrang rtsi 'thung ba'i/ /bung ba'i tshogs rnams skyid pa/ /khams kyi phyogs nas rgyal ba'i/ /sprul sku dbus su phebs song / /gser zhal mjal na 'dod pa'i/ /gdul bya rnams tsho'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di yang / /kha nas dbang med shor song / /thos tshad kun kyang dga' nas/ /rgyangs glu len par gyur cig /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams kyang shin tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to//yang nga 'brong lung na yod dus mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i bde chen tshangs dbyangs kyis mtshams zhus 'di phul byung /tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mtshan dpe'i sku/ /drug cu'i dbyangs rnams sgog pa'i gsung / /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun 'grub thugs/ /srid grol bshes gnyen mchog de'i drung / /zhu tshig me tog chu skyes dkar/ /dad gus sor mos 'dzin bzhin 338

rgyal ba'i sprul sku 'khrungs pa/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal du che zhing / /paṇa chen chos 'khor bskor pa/ /dbus gtsang rgyan du mdzes so/ /shar ri'i rtse nas 'od gsal/ /nyi ma gsal bo shar byung / /skyed mos tshal na gnas pa'i/ /me tog tshogs rnams skyid pa/ /skyed mos tshal nas pad+ma'i/ /dri zhim phyogs kun 'thul byung / /ro mngar sbrang rtsi 'thung ba'i/ /bung ba'i tshogs rnams skyid pa/ /khams kyi phyogs nas rgyal ba'i/ /sprul sku dbus su phebs song / /gser zhal mjal na 'dod pa'i/ /gdul bya rnams tsho'i skyid pa/ /skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di yang / /kha nas dbang med shor song / /thos tshad kun kyang dga' nas/ /rgyangs glu len par gyur cig /ces blangs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams kyang shin tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to//yang nga 'brong lung na yod dus mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i bde chen tshangs dbyangs kyis mtshams zhus 'di phul byung /tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mtshan dpe'i sku/ /drug cu'i dbyangs rnams sgog pa'i gsung / /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun 'grub thugs/ /srid grol bshes gnyen mchog de'i drung / /zhu tshig me tog chu skyes dkar/ /dad gus sor mos 'dzin bzhin 338

du/ /gus phran dkon mchog tshangs dbyangs kyis/ /'dren mchog snyan du 'di skad zhu/ /sku mchog gser gyi ri bo de/ /nyer 'tshe rlung gis bsgul nus min/ /spangs rtogs gnyis po mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdo rje sku ste khyod min su/ /'gro ba'i phan bde chu skyes tshal/ /khyod kyi thugs rje gzi 'od kyis/ /bzhad pa'i dga' ston 'di thos nas/ /bdag yid spro dga' chen po thob/ /nyam chung bdag kyang 'du phung gi /rdzas lnga so sor ma bkyes par/ /rnam g.yeng ngang la gnas bzhin du//mgon khyod yid la dran bzhin yod/ /mtshams zhus/ bdag cag mgon med gtsug rgyan du/ /mi 'gyur zhabs sen nor bu'i tog /bskal brgyar mi g.yo brtan pa ru/ /bzhugs su gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dge rtsa chen po ma bsags shing / /phyi mar bde sdug gang myong dgos/ /rang gi tshe 'di'i bya bas go /dam pa khyed nyid ma gtogs pa'i/ /phyi ma'i skyel ma su zhig 'tshol/ /'di phyi'i legs nyes skyid sdug rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos khyed rang mkhyen/ /bdag 'dra'i rjes 'jug slob ma yi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ /chos kun snying po mthar thug cig /mgur dbyangs tshul du gnang bar zhu/ /zhu yig lha bya ngang mo yis/ /lha rdzas dar gyi 339

du/ /gus phran dkon mchog tshangs dbyangs kyis/ /'dren mchog snyan du 'di skad zhu/ /sku mchog gser gyi ri bo de/ /nyer 'tshe rlung gis bsgul nus min/ /spangs rtogs gnyis po mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdo rje sku ste khyod min su/ /'gro ba'i phan bde chu skyes tshal/ /khyod kyi thugs rje gzi 'od kyis/ /bzhad pa'i dga' ston 'di thos nas/ /bdag yid spro dga' chen po thob/ /nyam chung bdag kyang 'du phung gi /rdzas lnga so sor ma bkyes par/ /rnam g.yeng ngang la gnas bzhin du//mgon khyod yid la dran bzhin yod/ /mtshams zhus/ bdag cag mgon med gtsug rgyan du/ /mi 'gyur zhabs sen nor bu'i tog /bskal brgyar mi g.yo brtan pa ru/ /bzhugs su gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dge rtsa chen po ma bsags shing / /phyi mar bde sdug gang myong dgos/ /rang gi tshe 'di'i bya bas go /dam pa khyed nyid ma gtogs pa'i/ /phyi ma'i skyel ma su zhig 'tshol/ /'di phyi'i legs nyes skyid sdug rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos khyed rang mkhyen/ /bdag 'dra'i rjes 'jug slob ma yi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ /chos kun snying po mthar thug cig /mgur dbyangs tshul du gnang bar zhu/ /zhu yig lha bya ngang mo yis/ /lha rdzas dar gyi 339

gshog brkyangs te/ /mgon khyod zhabs zung pad+mo yi/ /drung du dga' bzhin 'phur nas thal/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du mgur dbyangs 'di phul lo/ / tshe 'di phyi bar do'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /mgon thub pa'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ /'khor lha mis gtso byas 'gro kun la/ /chos phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /de rnams kyi brjod bya mtha' yas kyang / /tshur bsdu na mdo sngags gnyis su 'du/ /mdo bslab gsum sde snod gsum la 'du/ /sngags rgyud sde chen po bzhi la 'du/ /de rnams kyi brjod bya'i tshig mang yang / /don bsdu na rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ /gsung lam rim sngags rim gnyis su 'du/ /de don gyi gnad 'gag tshur bsdu na/ /mdo lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang / /sngags bla med bskyed rdzogs gnyis su 'du/ /de rdzogs rim 'od gsal mthar thug don/ /chos phyag rdzogs do ha rnams la 'du/ /ngas bka' bstan gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i/ /khong rgya bod mkhas grub mang po yi/ /gsung legs bshad po ti stong phrag lhag /kha phye nas yang yang bltas pa'i tshe/ /tshig 'di las lhag pa yod mod kyang / /don 'di las lhag cig mthong ma myong / /don de phyir skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /chos thun mong lam gyes rgyud sbyongs la/ /sngags bla med bskyed 340

gshog brkyangs te/ /mgon khyod zhabs zung pad+mo yi/ /drung du dga' bzhin 'phur nas thal/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du mgur dbyangs 'di phul lo/ / tshe 'di phyi bar do'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /mgon thub pa'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ /'khor lha mis gtso byas 'gro kun la/ /chos phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /de rnams kyi brjod bya mtha' yas kyang / /tshur bsdu na mdo sngags gnyis su 'du/ /mdo bslab gsum sde snod gsum la 'du/ /sngags rgyud sde chen po bzhi la 'du/ /de rnams kyi brjod bya'i tshig mang yang / /don bsdu na rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ /gsung lam rim sngags rim gnyis su 'du/ /de don gyi gnad 'gag tshur bsdu na/ /mdo lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang / /sngags bla med bskyed rdzogs gnyis su 'du/ /de rdzogs rim 'od gsal mthar thug don/ /chos phyag rdzogs do ha rnams la 'du/ /ngas bka' bstan gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i/ /khong rgya bod mkhas grub mang po yi/ /gsung legs bshad po ti stong phrag lhag /kha phye nas yang yang bltas pa'i tshe/ /tshig 'di las lhag pa yod mod kyang / /don 'di las lhag cig mthong ma myong / /don de phyir skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /chos thun mong lam gyes rgyud sbyongs la/ /sngags bla med bskyed 340

rdzogs gnyis la slobs/ /de'i mthar thug phyag rdzogs do ha gsum/ /rang gang mos shig la nan tan mdzod/ /tshe 'di ru grol bar gdon mi za/ /chos mdo rgyud man ngag zho bzhin dkrugs//khong mkhas grub brgya yis zhal phyes kyang / /tshig 'di las lhag pa yong yang srid/ /don 'di las lhag pa yod re skan/ /khyed lan re yid 'dra mi ches na/ /rje rgyal ba'i bka' la yang yang ltos/ /bka' dri med tshig gis nges shes skye/ /nga'i snying 'di bstan rung sha zhig yin/ /gtam snying nas smras pa de las lhag /bu khyed kyis ma brjed snying la chongs/ /gzhan mthong thos sangs rgyas 'thob par smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces phul ba kun la bstan pas sems la phan po byung / kho rang gis chos zab mo phyag rdzogs do ha rnams kyi dgongs don bzhin nyams su blangs pas 'chi khar lam sna zin pa zhig byung ngo/ /lo de'i sos ka sa dros nas/ lha ldan jo bo'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i jo bo yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ thugs rje chen po sgol ma gsum gtso byas pa'i lha khang gyan gsum can cig gi gzhi btings gyang bzang po zhig brdung du bcug de nas nga rong bo bla brang gnyis kyi gyod don la 'gro dgos byung / gnyer ba/dbon po/ stag yan rnams la bkod pa btang / ston dgu ba 341

rdzogs gnyis la slobs/ /de'i mthar thug phyag rdzogs do ha gsum/ /rang gang mos shig la nan tan mdzod/ /tshe 'di ru grol bar gdon mi za/ /chos mdo rgyud man ngag zho bzhin dkrugs//khong mkhas grub brgya yis zhal phyes kyang / /tshig 'di las lhag pa yong yang srid/ /don 'di las lhag pa yod re skan/ /khyed lan re yid 'dra mi ches na/ /rje rgyal ba'i bka' la yang yang ltos/ /bka' dri med tshig gis nges shes skye/ /nga'i snying 'di bstan rung sha zhig yin/ /gtam snying nas smras pa de las lhag /bu khyed kyis ma brjed snying la chongs/ /gzhan mthong thos sangs rgyas 'thob par smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces phul ba kun la bstan pas sems la phan po byung / kho rang gis chos zab mo phyag rdzogs do ha rnams kyi dgongs don bzhin nyams su blangs pas 'chi khar lam sna zin pa zhig byung ngo/ /lo de'i sos ka sa dros nas/ lha ldan jo bo'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i jo bo yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ thugs rje chen po sgol ma gsum gtso byas pa'i lha khang gyan gsum can cig gi gzhi btings gyang bzang po zhig brdung du bcug de nas nga rong bo bla brang gnyis kyi gyod don la 'gro dgos byung / gnyer ba/dbon po/ stag yan rnams la bkod pa btang / ston dgu ba 341

tshun la 'grub pa gyis zhes bshad pa bzhin 'grub pa byung / de'i sbyin bdag hor dpon po/ rdo re/ a mgron a khu dpal lo/ ra bsod nams 'bum/ bon rgya'i dpa' mkhar rgyal la sogs pa'i 'brog pa rnams kyis byas/ gser tshon rin la dngul srang brgya dang nyi shu/ lha bzo shing bzo las byed pa rnams la dong tse khron drug brgya tsam gyi rta nor lug gsum/ dā bu dkar dmar ras/ bal sogs byen nas dga' bar byas/ de na yod pa'i bla ma dge slong rnams kyis rab gnas dang dga' ston yag po byas snang / nga bzhi ba'i nang la reb gong du mar 'ong dus char dkon po 'dug pas/ ngas bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'di ltar btab/bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /char chu dus su 'bab par byin gyis rlobs/ /lo phyugs rtag tu legs par byen gyis rlobs/ /mi nad phyugs nad zhi bar byen gyis rlobs/ /dus 'khrug mu ge med par byen gyis rlobs/ /dgra jag chom rkun zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sad ser than pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab char sprin chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la bsdad pas/ go'u sde tshor thon pa'i dgong mo nas bzung char 342

tshun la 'grub pa gyis zhes bshad pa bzhin 'grub pa byung / de'i sbyin bdag hor dpon po/ rdo re/ a mgron a khu dpal lo/ ra bsod nams 'bum/ bon rgya'i dpa' mkhar rgyal la sogs pa'i 'brog pa rnams kyis byas/ gser tshon rin la dngul srang brgya dang nyi shu/ lha bzo shing bzo las byed pa rnams la dong tse khron drug brgya tsam gyi rta nor lug gsum/ dā bu dkar dmar ras/ bal sogs byen nas dga' bar byas/ de na yod pa'i bla ma dge slong rnams kyis rab gnas dang dga' ston yag po byas snang / nga bzhi ba'i nang la reb gong du mar 'ong dus char dkon po 'dug pas/ ngas bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'di ltar btab/bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /char chu dus su 'bab par byin gyis rlobs/ /lo phyugs rtag tu legs par byen gyis rlobs/ /mi nad phyugs nad zhi bar byen gyis rlobs/ /dus 'khrug mu ge med par byen gyis rlobs/ /dgra jag chom rkun zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sad ser than pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab char sprin chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la bsdad pas/ go'u sde tshor thon pa'i dgong mo nas bzung char 342

chen po gang 'dod babs pas thams cad dga' ba byung / ngas yon bdag thams cad la khyed rnams kyis 'brong lung lha khang gi kha bcos la nas shig phul dang / ngas lo yag skal bzang yong ba'i skyabs 'jug bya zhes bshad pas/ go'u sde'i yon bdag rnams kyis nas do bo lnga bcu/ gyang skya spyang lung gnyis kyis bcu lhag tsam phul bas/ ngas bsngo ba smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor yang dag byas pas/ de'i lo gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i lo legs shig byung bas kun dga' song / de nas rgan rgya'i nyi ma lung du song / sku gzhogs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che la mjal/ khong la zhus nas bla brang gis reb gong gi mi rtsa rnams la rgyu nom pa ster rgyu byas/ ngas gzu rogs bos nas gzu gtam rgyu byas kyang / re zhig gi bar du 'grig rgyu ma byung / rjes nas rim gyis 'grigs par gyur/ de nas nga dge 'phel du yong nas bsdad yod dus yang zho 'ong dpyis kyis spre'u mdo'i mi mang po bsad/ mi gsum bzung yod pa snying rje nas song mi rnams phyir sprad/ a lags dpal ldan tshang dang / gnam kho'i bla ma nged rnams kyis bar nas bshad pas 'grigs/ de nas bkra shis 'khyil bar 'ongs nas mtshams la bsdad pas dge sbyor 'phel po dang rig pa dwangs po byung / thun mtshams su rang gzhan 343

gnyis ka 'tshengs pa'i gdams ngag gser gyi ri bo zhes bya ba brtsams/ de'i rgyu mtshan cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/ skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du 'thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba myur du 'thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ lam rim blo sbyong phyag chen do ha sogs mdo sngags chos kyi snying po rnams nyams su len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams shes nas nyams su blangs na/nyams len phun sum tshogs pa gser gyi ri bo ltar 'byung bar dgongs nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gser khang rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams gyis sbyor ba'i chos drug ltar/ mchod 'bul tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mdzad cing / gzhan grong dgon rnams la yang sngar med pa'i mchod pa'i srol chen po btsugs pa la rab tu dga' ba'i rjes su yi rang yang yang byung / de ltar byas pa'i phan yon rnams mdo rgyud bstan bcos na mang po yod pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ dad can rnams la bstan na yid ches nges shes 'byongs nas dge sbyor la spro shugs cher 'gro'am snyam pa'i blos 'dri 'dod yod pa'i khar/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i dge rgan dge 'dun bde 344

gnyis ka 'tshengs pa'i gdams ngag gser gyi ri bo zhes bya ba brtsams/ de'i rgyu mtshan cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/ skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du 'thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba myur du 'thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ lam rim blo sbyong phyag chen do ha sogs mdo sngags chos kyi snying po rnams nyams su len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams shes nas nyams su blangs na/nyams len phun sum tshogs pa gser gyi ri bo ltar 'byung bar dgongs nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gser khang rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams gyis sbyor ba'i chos drug ltar/ mchod 'bul tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mdzad cing / gzhan grong dgon rnams la yang sngar med pa'i mchod pa'i srol chen po btsugs pa la rab tu dga' ba'i rjes su yi rang yang yang byung / de ltar byas pa'i phan yon rnams mdo rgyud bstan bcos na mang po yod pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ dad can rnams la bstan na yid ches nges shes 'byongs nas dge sbyor la spro shugs cher 'gro'am snyam pa'i blos 'dri 'dod yod pa'i khar/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i dge rgan dge 'dun bde 344

legs/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i chos mthun dge slong blo gros/sman sogs rig gnas mkhas pa'i bla ma pad+ma kun grol/ lung dang rigs par smra ba'i blo ldan ye shes dar rgyas/ dad gus dag snang che ba'i slob bu 'phrin las dar rgyas/ ngag dbang bkra shis/ mtshams pa bsod nams rgyal la sogs pa'i dad can gyi slob ma mang pos kyang dge ba'i gsal 'debs su 'di lta bu'i gdams pa zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ legs par brtsams nas mjug tu tshigs su bcad pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /slob ma yon bdag yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rnal 'byor mgo dkar tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /da dung so dkar dus bzhin glu dbyangs len/ /sngon tshe bsod rnams dpag med bsags lags pas/ /da lta dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob/ /rin chen gser gyi gling du phyin pa bzhin/ /mdo sngags chos dang mjal ba skal ba bzang / /bsam pa bzang po byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /tshogs bsags re re byas pa'i phan yon yang / /gzugs su grub rgyu lta bu zhig yin na/ /sa dang bar snang nam mkhar shong mi 'gyur/ /de la dgongs nas gser khang rdo rje 343

legs/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i chos mthun dge slong blo gros/sman sogs rig gnas mkhas pa'i bla ma pad+ma kun grol/ lung dang rigs par smra ba'i blo ldan ye shes dar rgyas/ dad gus dag snang che ba'i slob bu 'phrin las dar rgyas/ ngag dbang bkra shis/ mtshams pa bsod nams rgyal la sogs pa'i dad can gyi slob ma mang pos kyang dge ba'i gsal 'debs su 'di lta bu'i gdams pa zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ legs par brtsams nas mjug tu tshigs su bcad pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /slob ma yon bdag yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rnal 'byor mgo dkar tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /da dung so dkar dus bzhin glu dbyangs len/ /sngon tshe bsod rnams dpag med bsags lags pas/ /da lta dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob/ /rin chen gser gyi gling du phyin pa bzhin/ /mdo sngags chos dang mjal ba skal ba bzang / /bsam pa bzang po byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /tshogs bsags re re byas pa'i phan yon yang / /gzugs su grub rgyu lta bu zhig yin na/ /sa dang bar snang nam mkhar shong mi 'gyur/ /de la dgongs nas gser khang rdo rje 343

'chang / /yab sras rnams kyis bla ma gser gling pa/ /jo bo bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mdzad la rjes yi rang / /mdo sngags chos kyi nyams len byed pa la/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams bya ba rnams/ /shes nas de bzhin nyams su blangs gyur na/ /nyams len phun sum tshogs pa ngo mtshar che/ /de phyir nam 'chi cha med tshul bsams nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob 'dod pa'i/ /skal bzang las can skye bo pho mo rnams/ /'di ltar mdzod ces yang yang thal mo sbyor/ /gser gyi ri la brten pa'i 'dab chags rnams/ /kha dog ser po gser du snang ba bzhin/ /gdams ngag 'di la brten pa'i gang zag rnams/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /rin chen gser gyi ri bdun nam gnas bar/ /gdams ngag 'di yang mi nyams sa steng 'dir/ /gnas nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa dang / /mar gyur 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /rgyal ba yab sras sku tshe brtan pa dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas/ /rgyal blon sde rnams tshe bsod snyan grags rgyas/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dbyangs su blangs pas skul ba po rnams rab tu 346

'chang / /yab sras rnams kyis bla ma gser gling pa/ /jo bo bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mdzad la rjes yi rang / /mdo sngags chos kyi nyams len byed pa la/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams bya ba rnams/ /shes nas de bzhin nyams su blangs gyur na/ /nyams len phun sum tshogs pa ngo mtshar che/ /de phyir nam 'chi cha med tshul bsams nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob 'dod pa'i/ /skal bzang las can skye bo pho mo rnams/ /'di ltar mdzod ces yang yang thal mo sbyor/ /gser gyi ri la brten pa'i 'dab chags rnams/ /kha dog ser po gser du snang ba bzhin/ /gdams ngag 'di la brten pa'i gang zag rnams/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /rin chen gser gyi ri bdun nam gnas bar/ /gdams ngag 'di yang mi nyams sa steng 'dir/ /gnas nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa dang / /mar gyur 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /rgyal ba yab sras sku tshe brtan pa dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas/ /rgyal blon sde rnams tshe bsod snyan grags rgyas/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dbyangs su blangs pas skul ba po rnams rab tu 346

dga' ba'i rjes su yi rang byung ngo //yang bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i o rgyan sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig kyang brtsams/ de ji ltar brtsams pa'i lo rgyus cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/ bdag gis sngon du sprul pa'i glegs bam mang po zhig brtsams pa rnams la bltas nas/ o rgyan chen po'i rjes 'jug dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi sprul sku rnam gsum dang / dmag gsar rdo rje 'chang gi sras gnyis/ bla ma bzang po rgya mtsho/ rtogs ldan mkha' 'gro/ nyang gi mtshams pa/ lha khang dbu mdzad sogs reb gong phyogs kyi dad can sngags 'chang mang pos/ skyabs mgon rin po che khyed kyis sngar gdul bya yongs la phan pa'i sprul pa'i glegs bam mang po brtsams pa bka' drin che/ da dung khyed kyis o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs bcud bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i zab gnad thams cad tshang ba'i sngar med pa'i legs bshad kha gsal pad 'byung sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig rtsom dgos zhes snga phyi rim pa byas yang yang bskul ngor/ bdag gis kyang rtsom dgos snyam zhag mang po'i bar du sa skya'i gsung gi o rgyan bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig la brten nas gsol ba btab pa'i nub cig gi tho rangs 347

dga' ba'i rjes su yi rang byung ngo //yang bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i o rgyan sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig kyang brtsams/ de ji ltar brtsams pa'i lo rgyus cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/ bdag gis sngon du sprul pa'i glegs bam mang po zhig brtsams pa rnams la bltas nas/ o rgyan chen po'i rjes 'jug dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi sprul sku rnam gsum dang / dmag gsar rdo rje 'chang gi sras gnyis/ bla ma bzang po rgya mtsho/ rtogs ldan mkha' 'gro/ nyang gi mtshams pa/ lha khang dbu mdzad sogs reb gong phyogs kyi dad can sngags 'chang mang pos/ skyabs mgon rin po che khyed kyis sngar gdul bya yongs la phan pa'i sprul pa'i glegs bam mang po brtsams pa bka' drin che/ da dung khyed kyis o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs bcud bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i zab gnad thams cad tshang ba'i sngar med pa'i legs bshad kha gsal pad 'byung sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig rtsom dgos zhes snga phyi rim pa byas yang yang bskul ngor/ bdag gis kyang rtsom dgos snyam zhag mang po'i bar du sa skya'i gsung gi o rgyan bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig la brten nas gsol ba btab pa'i nub cig gi tho rangs 347

nyams snang la/ o rgyan gyi gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bgrang las 'das pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zhal gzigs pa'i snang ba shar/ de dag rnams la dngos su 'byor ba dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul nas rab tu gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ bdag gis chung nas bzung ste dus da bar du gsol ba btab kyang lha zhal da bar du mi gzigs pa thugs rje re chung zhus pas/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te dgyes bzhin bka' stsal ba/ kye rigs kyi bu nyon cig ngas sngon khyod kyis bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du/ thog mar mtsho snying nas rje rin po che'i rnam par bstan nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te lam rim gnang / de'i rjes su rma 'gram ri khrod bkra shis nyams dga'i gling na 'dug dus jo bo rje'i rnam par bstan nas/ thugs ga'i sgo phyes thig le bcu drug gi ting nge 'dzin gye dbang bskur bka' gdams glegs bam gnang / da ni zhal dngos su bstan nas chos dngos su gnang ba yin pas dga' bar mdzod cig spyir rgyal ba thams cad ye shes kyi klong du ro gcig cing / sgos su nged rnam pa gsum thugs rgyud gcig tshul khyod kyis sngar shes pa de ka ltar yin la/ khyad par phyogs 348

nyams snang la/ o rgyan gyi gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bgrang las 'das pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zhal gzigs pa'i snang ba shar/ de dag rnams la dngos su 'byor ba dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul nas rab tu gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ bdag gis chung nas bzung ste dus da bar du gsol ba btab kyang lha zhal da bar du mi gzigs pa thugs rje re chung zhus pas/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te dgyes bzhin bka' stsal ba/ kye rigs kyi bu nyon cig ngas sngon khyod kyis bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du/ thog mar mtsho snying nas rje rin po che'i rnam par bstan nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te lam rim gnang / de'i rjes su rma 'gram ri khrod bkra shis nyams dga'i gling na 'dug dus jo bo rje'i rnam par bstan nas/ thugs ga'i sgo phyes thig le bcu drug gi ting nge 'dzin gye dbang bskur bka' gdams glegs bam gnang / da ni zhal dngos su bstan nas chos dngos su gnang ba yin pas dga' bar mdzod cig spyir rgyal ba thams cad ye shes kyi klong du ro gcig cing / sgos su nged rnam pa gsum thugs rgyud gcig tshul khyod kyis sngar shes pa de ka ltar yin la/ khyad par phyogs 348

bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rnam 'phrul du go dgos shing / rtsa ba'i bla ma yang rang gi sems kyi rnam rol/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo yang gdod nas stong pa nam mkha' bzhin 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa/ brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa/ 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhir gyur pa stong gsal chos sku ru ngo shes na chos kyi gting go ba yin gsungs/ yang zhus pa/ da ni rgyal dbang khyed kyi thugs bcud bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad thams cad 'dus pa'i pad 'byung sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig brtsams na snyam pas/ khyed kyi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin rtsom nus par byin gyes brlab tu gsol zhes zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ 'o gsang sngags kyi mthar thug rgyud kyi dgongs don bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad rnams/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul klong chen rab 'byams dang mkhyen brtse sogs mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis brtsams pa dang / khyod kyis rtsa ba'i bla mas gsungs pa rnams nyams su longs na de gas chog par 'dug de'i lhag cig mi dgos/ de bas ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po kri kri'i rmi lam gyi lung bstan ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di phyi rol pa sogs kyis mi 'jig par/349

bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rnam 'phrul du go dgos shing / rtsa ba'i bla ma yang rang gi sems kyi rnam rol/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo yang gdod nas stong pa nam mkha' bzhin 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa/ brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa/ 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhir gyur pa stong gsal chos sku ru ngo shes na chos kyi gting go ba yin gsungs/ yang zhus pa/ da ni rgyal dbang khyed kyi thugs bcud bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad thams cad 'dus pa'i pad 'byung sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig brtsams na snyam pas/ khyed kyi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin rtsom nus par byin gyes brlab tu gsol zhes zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ 'o gsang sngags kyi mthar thug rgyud kyi dgongs don bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad rnams/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul klong chen rab 'byams dang mkhyen brtse sogs mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis brtsams pa dang / khyod kyis rtsa ba'i bla mas gsungs pa rnams nyams su longs na de gas chog par 'dug de'i lhag cig mi dgos/ de bas ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po kri kri'i rmi lam gyi lung bstan ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di phyi rol pa sogs kyis mi 'jig par/349

nang ba'i chos pa nang phan tshun gyis chos kyi bzang ngan brtsad nas chags sdang 'thab rtsod byas bstan pa 'jig par gsungs pas/ de'i phyir ma 'ongs pa'i dus su chos pa 'jig rten pa su zhig gi mgo thog tu bzhag kyang / chos kyi phyogs ris kun zhi nas dag snang phyogs med du 'char ba'i sngar med pa'i legs bshad/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i o rgyan sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig rtsom dang bzang zhes thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig byung nas bdag gi snying khar zug pa dang dus mnyam du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer byung / thugs rje 'od zer gyi dbang bskur pa'i mthar 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan thams cad 'char ba'i me long chen po zhig tu gyur pa bdag la gtad nas/ me long 'di la byi dor gyis la ltos dang / 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro gsungs nas yar je mtho je mthor song nas/ 'og min chos kyi dbyengs kyi pho brang du phebs nas mi snang bar gyur pa dang / rang yang mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la rang bzhin gyis gnas nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'bar ba byung / de la brten nas rtsom 'dun yod pa'i khar/ slar yang 350

nang ba'i chos pa nang phan tshun gyis chos kyi bzang ngan brtsad nas chags sdang 'thab rtsod byas bstan pa 'jig par gsungs pas/ de'i phyir ma 'ongs pa'i dus su chos pa 'jig rten pa su zhig gi mgo thog tu bzhag kyang / chos kyi phyogs ris kun zhi nas dag snang phyogs med du 'char ba'i sngar med pa'i legs bshad/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i o rgyan sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig rtsom dang bzang zhes thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig byung nas bdag gi snying khar zug pa dang dus mnyam du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer byung / thugs rje 'od zer gyi dbang bskur pa'i mthar 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan thams cad 'char ba'i me long chen po zhig tu gyur pa bdag la gtad nas/ me long 'di la byi dor gyis la ltos dang / 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro gsungs nas yar je mtho je mthor song nas/ 'og min chos kyi dbyengs kyi pho brang du phebs nas mi snang bar gyur pa dang / rang yang mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la rang bzhin gyis gnas nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'bar ba byung / de la brten nas rtsom 'dun yod pa'i khar/ slar yang 350

chos lugs yongs la dag snang che ba'i khrims ldan mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i sprul sku dang / rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ thugs rgyud bzang zhing blo gros che ba'i a mgron sprul sku/ dad gus che ba'i mtshams pa bsod nams rgyal/ chos mthun ri khrod pa dpal ri'i dge slong rnam gnyis sogs dad can slob ma du mas kyang 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ legs par brtsams nas mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor 'di ltar byas/rab mdzes sku ni gser gyi ri las mdzes/ /rab snyan gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs las snyan/ /rab gsal thugs ni nam mkha'i dbyings las gsal/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob pa'i thabs/ /yan lag bdun pa la sogs rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod pa rnams la slob pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /rnam dag spyod lam 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos kyi dbyengs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rdul gyi grangs mnyam pa'i/ /rang lus grangs med sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral ba med par shog /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa'i tshogs/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu 351

chos lugs yongs la dag snang che ba'i khrims ldan mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i sprul sku dang / rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ thugs rgyud bzang zhing blo gros che ba'i a mgron sprul sku/ dad gus che ba'i mtshams pa bsod nams rgyal/ chos mthun ri khrod pa dpal ri'i dge slong rnam gnyis sogs dad can slob ma du mas kyang 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ legs par brtsams nas mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor 'di ltar byas/rab mdzes sku ni gser gyi ri las mdzes/ /rab snyan gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs las snyan/ /rab gsal thugs ni nam mkha'i dbyings las gsal/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob pa'i thabs/ /yan lag bdun pa la sogs rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod pa rnams la slob pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /rnam dag spyod lam 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos kyi dbyengs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rdul gyi grangs mnyam pa'i/ /rang lus grangs med sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral ba med par shog /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa'i tshogs/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu 351

yin/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'phrin las 'jug par shog /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /sdig ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rmad byung mdzad pa dang / /skyes 'phags rnams kyis dge ba bsags tshad la/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /dge tshogs mi zad gong du 'phel bar shog /phyogs bcu'i zhing na mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /bzhugs pa rnams la 'khor lo dung dkar sogs/ phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /dam pa'i chos dang 'bral ba med par shog /mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /g.yung drung rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gdan phul nas/ /bskal chen grangs med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba btab pa bzhin du thebs par shog /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /phan bde 'byung gnas bstan pa dar ba dang / /'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bsngo ba smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gnyen po ru/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong legs 352

yin/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'phrin las 'jug par shog /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /sdig ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rmad byung mdzad pa dang / /skyes 'phags rnams kyis dge ba bsags tshad la/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /dge tshogs mi zad gong du 'phel bar shog /phyogs bcu'i zhing na mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /bzhugs pa rnams la 'khor lo dung dkar sogs/ phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /dam pa'i chos dang 'bral ba med par shog /mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /g.yung drung rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gdan phul nas/ /bskal chen grangs med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba btab pa bzhin du thebs par shog /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /phan bde 'byung gnas bstan pa dar ba dang / /'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bsngo ba smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gnyen po ru/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong legs 352

gsungs pa'i/ /ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dang / /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med par shog /phyi ru nyan thos byang sems spyod pa skyongs/ /nang du gsang sngags rim gnyis rnal 'byor brtson/ /gsang ba 'od gsal rdzogs chen don la brtson/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i bstan dang mjal bar shog /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel ma lus pa/ /gdams par shar nas gzhan la 'doms mkhas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo yab sras kyi/ /bstan pa rin po che dang mjal bar shog /phul byung rnam thar gtsang ma'i khrems dang ldan/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs che/ /bde stong mchog gi rim gnyis ting 'dzin brtson/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal bar shog /bdag gzhan deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal 'byor rten thob dge ba'i bshes dang mjal/ /thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sgos/ /rgyal bstan ma lus 'dzin skyong spel bar shog /bdag ni skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mngon dga' la sogs phyogs bcu'i zhing kun tu/ /song nas sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byed cing / /'brel thogs gang 'dod zhing du 'dren par shog /bstan pa spyi dang khyad par thub dbang gi /bstan la phan pa'i o rgyan glegs bam 'di/ /bstan 353

gsungs pa'i/ /ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dang / /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med par shog /phyi ru nyan thos byang sems spyod pa skyongs/ /nang du gsang sngags rim gnyis rnal 'byor brtson/ /gsang ba 'od gsal rdzogs chen don la brtson/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i bstan dang mjal bar shog /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel ma lus pa/ /gdams par shar nas gzhan la 'doms mkhas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo yab sras kyi/ /bstan pa rin po che dang mjal bar shog /phul byung rnam thar gtsang ma'i khrems dang ldan/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs che/ /bde stong mchog gi rim gnyis ting 'dzin brtson/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal bar shog /bdag gzhan deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal 'byor rten thob dge ba'i bshes dang mjal/ /thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sgos/ /rgyal bstan ma lus 'dzin skyong spel bar shog /bdag ni skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mngon dga' la sogs phyogs bcu'i zhing kun tu/ /song nas sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byed cing / /'brel thogs gang 'dod zhing du 'dren par shog /bstan pa spyi dang khyad par thub dbang gi /bstan la phan pa'i o rgyan glegs bam 'di/ /bstan 353

pa nam gnas bar du legs gnas nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /mdor na chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa yi/ /rgyal kun mchod bstod dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro la gang 'dod byen/ /chos bstan sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /phyi ltar lag len sde snod gsum ltar spyod/ /nang ltar gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi ltar spyod/ /gsang ba phyag rdzogs do ha'i lugs ltar spyod/ /mdo sngags yongs la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub ji snyed yod pa kun/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad la/ /nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod mi 'byung zhing / /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gnam la bkra shis shog /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sa la bkra shis shog /bar 'dir 'khod tshad yongs la bkra shis shog /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces smon lam bkra shis brjod pas/ zhu ba po rnams kyis kyang smon lam de shin tu ngo mtshar che zer rjes su bris nas kha ton 354

pa nam gnas bar du legs gnas nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /mdor na chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa yi/ /rgyal kun mchod bstod dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro la gang 'dod byen/ /chos bstan sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /phyi ltar lag len sde snod gsum ltar spyod/ /nang ltar gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi ltar spyod/ /gsang ba phyag rdzogs do ha'i lugs ltar spyod/ /mdo sngags yongs la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub ji snyed yod pa kun/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad la/ /nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod mi 'byung zhing / /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gnam la bkra shis shog /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sa la bkra shis shog /bar 'dir 'khod tshad yongs la bkra shis shog /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces smon lam bkra shis brjod pas/ zhu ba po rnams kyis kyang smon lam de shin tu ngo mtshar che zer rjes su bris nas kha ton 354

byed mkhan yang mang po byung ngo //yang bsam pa gzhan las bzang ba'i skal ldan snying gi bu mchog byang chub rgya mtshos nas do bo bdun dang lha rdzas dri med bcas zhal gdams dgos zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/ngo mtshar skyes mchog rin po che/ /brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongs/ /mgon khyod sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /snyigs dus gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /chung nas bla ma mang po bsten/ /gsung bzhin dben par nyams su blangs/ /slar yang yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshul/ /bstan pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /gdul bya dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgos/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson pa'i mod/ /snyan dang grags pas sa steng khyab/ /skal bzang gdul bya sprin ltar 'du/ /zas nor longs spyod char bzhin babs/ /slob ma yang slob mang po yis/ /dben pa'i ri sul gang ba mtshar/ /da dung gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /snyung tshul tsam yang mi ston par/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas par/ /chos 'khor skor bzhin bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag ni mi rgan 'chi la nye/ /mang po bsgom long mi 'dug pas/ /ma bsgoms par yang 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /zab mo'i gdams pa gnang du gsol/ /deng nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar jo bo 355

byed mkhan yang mang po byung ngo //yang bsam pa gzhan las bzang ba'i skal ldan snying gi bu mchog byang chub rgya mtshos nas do bo bdun dang lha rdzas dri med bcas zhal gdams dgos zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/ngo mtshar skyes mchog rin po che/ /brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongs/ /mgon khyod sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /snyigs dus gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /chung nas bla ma mang po bsten/ /gsung bzhin dben par nyams su blangs/ /slar yang yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshul/ /bstan pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /gdul bya dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgos/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson pa'i mod/ /snyan dang grags pas sa steng khyab/ /skal bzang gdul bya sprin ltar 'du/ /zas nor longs spyod char bzhin babs/ /slob ma yang slob mang po yis/ /dben pa'i ri sul gang ba mtshar/ /da dung gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /snyung tshul tsam yang mi ston par/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas par/ /chos 'khor skor bzhin bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag ni mi rgan 'chi la nye/ /mang po bsgom long mi 'dug pas/ /ma bsgoms par yang 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /zab mo'i gdams pa gnang du gsol/ /deng nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar jo bo 355

rje dang 'brom ston bzhin/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /ces zhus pa'i lan du 'di ltar gdams/ 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rab tu dga' bas nyon cigasngon sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ tshe thung nad mang longs spyod dman/ /yun ring sdod pa'i mthu med pas/ /tshig rjes dpyad pas mi nus kyis/ /snying po myur du bsdu bar rigs/ /zhes pa dang / lho brag mar pa'i zhal nas/ deng dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ /tshe la long med rkyen mang bas/ /shes bya'i gshis la ma 'chor bar/ /sgrub pa nyams su longs shig gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe thung nam 'chi cha med bsams nas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos thongs la/ nyams len gyi snying bo la slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i zhal nas/ kye ma gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyis/ /dub pa dag gi ngal gsos gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i lugs/ /ring mo zhig nas mthong ba yin/ /zhes pa dang / mkhyen brtse rin po ches/ da ni rmi lam tsam gyi mi tshe 'dir/ /rnam g.yeng chos su ming btags de ci bya/ /kun rtog rtogs dpyod rnon po ci dgar thongs/ /rig pa 'od gsal klong du ngal gsos shig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bde ba'i stan la lus ngag yid gsum rang babs su 356

lhod kyis glod la sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la nyin mtshan bar ma chad du 'jog pa la brtson par gyis shig ces slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/bde chen 'gyur med chos kyi sku/ /rjen par ston mdzad bla ma mchod/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i/ /gnyug ma'i sems la rang babs 'dud/ /rang babs gsum gyi ngang nyid las/ /phyag chen rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur/ /thag pa chad pa'i sog phon bzhin/ /lus ni g.yo med rang babs zhog /rgyud gsum chad pa'i pi wang bzhin/ /ngag ni smra med rang babs zhog /ltag chu bcad pa'i rang 'thag bzhin/ /sems ni rtogs med rang babs zhog /de ltar rang babs bzhag tsa na/ /gsal la rtogs pa med pa'i nyams/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar shar/ /de ni phyag chen rtogs pa yin/ /de yi ngang la 'jog nus na/ /nyon mongs rtogs tshogs rang sar dwangs/ /phyag chen rang babs mngon gyur nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /dge 'dis phyag rgya chen po yi/ /rtogs pa rang babs mngon gyur nas/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo dang / /bral ba'i chos skur sangs rgya shog /ces gdams pas kho rang gis 357

bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung bzhin lus ngag yid gsum ma bcos rang babs su bzhag pas sems la g.yo med kyi brtan pa thob pa byung ngo //yang rig pa dwangs pa'i dus shig la dad can sngags 'chang yi dam la zhal gdams 'di byen/ 'o snang grags kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin snang stong sems kyi rol ba/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo stong pa gsal ba dwangs pa yangs pa che ba de'i ngang la bzhag na/ bde ba 'jam pa dga' ba spro ba/ dper na mgo btums bsangs pa 'dra ba/ khog kyang yangs cha che ba/kha g.yeng mig g.yeng mchong rgyugs gar stabs ci byas kyang je gsal je brtan du gyur nas/ snang ba thams cad ban bun lang long du shag shig khral khrol du song nas/ bu chung bzhin spang blang dgag sgrub blang dor re dogs las 'das pa/ chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu ched du gnyer nas ma bsgoms kyang snang sems thams cad 'dres nas phan tshun 'byed rgyu med par/ du ma ro gcig tu shar/ ro gcig du mar shar/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar/ rgyu 'bras stong nyid du shar/ snang bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du snang / snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur song nas chos nyid yangs pa chen po'i ngang du dga' yal le/ 'dzum 'bol 358
