ler gnas pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la snying rje shugs kyis skyes nas 'gro don byed mkhan zhig byung na ngo mtshar che zhes glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /'khor 'das sems su rdzogs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po dang gcig /srid zhi spang blang bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po dang gnyis/ /spros pa'i mtha' brgyad bral ba'i dbu ma chen mo dang gsum/ /'di gsum yongs su grags pa'i lta ba'i yang rtse gsum lags/ /chos kun sems kyis byas shing sems kyi dbyings su ni snang / /snang stong sgyu ma bzhin du rgyu rkyen 'grigs pa las byung / /byung ba'i 'khor 'das chos kun ngo bo gdod ma nas stong / /stong bzhin snang ba ltos dang stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'char/ /rtogs ldan mkhas pas bltas na snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos/ /thams cad chos kyi dbyings su dbyer med ro gcig tu gda'/ /dbu rdzogs phyag gsum lta ba bltas na mi gcig rgyu med/ /dpyad bsgom 'jog bsgom gyis dang ha de go nas rang 'ongs sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i thabs ni gsar rnying thams cad la yod/ /chos spong las ngan ma gsog thams cad mthun po rang gyis/ /kun la dag snang sbyongs la gang mos nyams su ni longs/ /nyams 359

len legs po gyis dang nyams rtogs nyi ma bzhin 'char/ /zhes blangs pas kho rang gi sems la yang phan po byung / yang nang 'khor snyoms chung dang sprang po rnams la byams shing slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi sems la babs pa'i gnyer ba kha dron rab byung la phan pa'i bslab bya 'di skad smras/dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bsam don 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /bla mas ci gsungs bka' bsgrubs na/ /ci bsam thams cad chos bzhin 'grub/ /bla ma'i nor rdzas rang srog las/ /gces na tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /rang nor bla mar 'bul nus na/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang sangs rgyas 'thob/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog byas pa las/ /lhag pa'i chos shig gzhan na med/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma yi/ /zhabs tog byed pa'i smon lam thob/ /bsam bzang skal ldan slob bu khyod/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /sngar yang byas te da yang sgrubs/ /ci bsam thams cad 'grub nas 'ongs/ /bla ma'i nor gyes phan mi thogs/ /bla ma'i bka' bcag thugs dkrugs na/ /tshe thung nad mang mi khas sdang / /bla ma'i nor la bdag thob byas/ /bzung na phyi mar dmyal bar skye/ /bla ma'i zhabs 'dren byas pa las/ /lhag pa'i sdig cig gzhan na med/ /de phyir skal 360

ldan slob bu khyod/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma yi/ /zhabs 'dren mi byed smon lam thob/ smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces smras pa bzhin du bsgrubs pas gnyer ba de'i ring la ngas kyang 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub pa byung / lo rjes ma de la yang mtshams byas nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel du gtong bzhin pa'i ngos nas snying rje sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig brtsams/ de'i rgyu mtshan cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems yin/ de'i rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'di yin tshul dang / snying rje chen po rgyud la skye ba'i gegs byed kyi gtso bo sdig zas sha 'di yin tshul rnams rang gi yid la goms pa dang skal bzang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir snga gong nas rtsom 'dun yod pa'i khar/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan kun dang ldan pa'i sprul sku rnam gsum dang / mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom kun bzang stobs ldan dbang po'i thugs sras rnam gnyis/ skal bzang las 'phro can gyi dge slong blo gros/ mi gzhi lha las bzang ba'i mtshams pa tshe mgon/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bya bral 'jigs med/ gu yangs blo bde'i slob bu blo bzang mkhas 361

ldan slob bu khyod/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma yi/ /zhabs 'dren mi byed smon lam thob/ smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces smras pa bzhin du bsgrubs pas gnyer ba de'i ring la ngas kyang 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub pa byung / lo rjes ma de la yang mtshams byas nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel du gtong bzhin pa'i ngos nas snying rje sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig brtsams/ de'i rgyu mtshan cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems yin/ de'i rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'di yin tshul dang / snying rje chen po rgyud la skye ba'i gegs byed kyi gtso bo sdig zas sha 'di yin tshul rnams rang gi yid la goms pa dang skal bzang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir snga gong nas rtsom 'dun yod pa'i khar/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan kun dang ldan pa'i sprul sku rnam gsum dang / mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom kun bzang stobs ldan dbang po'i thugs sras rnam gnyis/ skal bzang las 'phro can gyi dge slong blo gros/ mi gzhi lha las bzang ba'i mtshams pa tshe mgon/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bya bral 'jigs med/ gu yangs blo bde'i slob bu blo bzang mkhas 361

mchog sogs theg pa chen po'i snod ldan gyi slob ma mang pos/chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'di kun gyi rgyud la skye dka' bar 'dug pas/ phyin chad snying rje skye ba'i thabs su 'di lta bu'i legs bshad zab mo zhig dgos zhes lha rdzas dang bcas te yang yang bskul pa'i ngor legs par brtsams pa'i mjug tu tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/snying rje chen po'i sgo nas dus kun tu/ /snying rje'i yul gyur 'gro la lha chos kyi/ /snying po snying rje chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i /snying rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma spyi bor bzhugs/ /chos mdzad skyes bu rnams kyi rgyan gyi mchog /dpag med yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje rin po che'i/ /yon tan dran bzhin bstod bsngags me tog 'thor/ /snying rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /snying rje chen po gter chen bum bzang 'dra/ /snying rje chen po dpag bsam ljon shing 'dra/ /snying rje chen po 'dzam gling nyi ma 'dra/ /snying rje yod na chos kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /snying rje yod na bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /snying rje yod na sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs/ /snying rje yod na lha mi kun gyis smon/ /snying rje yod na thog mar sems can gyi/ /don du smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed nus/ /snying rje yod na 362

mchog sogs theg pa chen po'i snod ldan gyi slob ma mang pos/chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'di kun gyi rgyud la skye dka' bar 'dug pas/ phyin chad snying rje skye ba'i thabs su 'di lta bu'i legs bshad zab mo zhig dgos zhes lha rdzas dang bcas te yang yang bskul pa'i ngor legs par brtsams pa'i mjug tu tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/snying rje chen po'i sgo nas dus kun tu/ /snying rje'i yul gyur 'gro la lha chos kyi/ /snying po snying rje chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i /snying rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma spyi bor bzhugs/ /chos mdzad skyes bu rnams kyi rgyan gyi mchog /dpag med yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje rin po che'i/ /yon tan dran bzhin bstod bsngags me tog 'thor/ /snying rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /snying rje chen po gter chen bum bzang 'dra/ /snying rje chen po dpag bsam ljon shing 'dra/ /snying rje chen po 'dzam gling nyi ma 'dra/ /snying rje yod na chos kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /snying rje yod na bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /snying rje yod na sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs/ /snying rje yod na lha mi kun gyis smon/ /snying rje yod na thog mar sems can gyi/ /don du smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed nus/ /snying rje yod na 362

bar du rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod pa rlabs po che la slob par nus/ /snying rje yod na tha mar sangs rgyas tshe/ /zhi bar mi gnas sems can 'dren par nus/ /snying rje che na gsang sngags sgor zhugs nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par nus/ /snying rje yod na bstan 'gror phan pa'i phyir/ /thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum nus/ /snying rje chen pos bdag yid rab bskyod nas/ /'gro la phan phyir snying rje'i glegs bam brtsams /'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /snying rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma rgyal sras kyis/ /gang brtsams 'gro la phan par byen gyis rlobs/ /lung dang rigs pa'i sdeb sbyor kun tshang ba'i/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje'i sman mar 'di/ /skal bzang chos mdzad yongs kyis gsol nus na/ /byang chub sems kyi lus stobs rgyas par 'gyur/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun/ /snying rje chen po skye ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu snying rje chen po dang / /'bral ba med par shog ces smon lam 'debs/ /'di phyi bar do tshe rabs thams cad du/ /snying rje can gyi bla mar mjal bar shog /snying rje'i lha mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med gyur 363

bar du rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod pa rlabs po che la slob par nus/ /snying rje yod na tha mar sangs rgyas tshe/ /zhi bar mi gnas sems can 'dren par nus/ /snying rje che na gsang sngags sgor zhugs nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par nus/ /snying rje yod na bstan 'gror phan pa'i phyir/ /thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum nus/ /snying rje chen pos bdag yid rab bskyod nas/ /'gro la phan phyir snying rje'i glegs bam brtsams /'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /snying rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma rgyal sras kyis/ /gang brtsams 'gro la phan par byen gyis rlobs/ /lung dang rigs pa'i sdeb sbyor kun tshang ba'i/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje'i sman mar 'di/ /skal bzang chos mdzad yongs kyis gsol nus na/ /byang chub sems kyi lus stobs rgyas par 'gyur/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun/ /snying rje chen po skye ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu snying rje chen po dang / /'bral ba med par shog ces smon lam 'debs/ /'di phyi bar do tshe rabs thams cad du/ /snying rje can gyi bla mar mjal bar shog /snying rje'i lha mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med gyur 363

cig /sa gzhi nam gnas bar du glegs bam 'dis/ /sa thog 'di na sdig zas sha yi phyir/ /sa la bsgyel nas sems can gsod tshad kyi/ /sa steng skye 'gro yongs la phan par shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i tog gi nor bu ltar/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rgyal bstan snying po snying rje nor bu yis/ /rgyal khams yongs la phan pa'i bkra shis shog /ces smras pas zhu ba po sogs der 'tshogs pa kun gyis snying rje chen po thugs dam gyi mthil du bzung nas/ mthong thos kyi 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag byung ngo //yang bkra shis 'khyel ba'i mkhyen brtse'i grub gnas na 'dug pa'i dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i slob bu bsod nams rgyal gyis nyin cig dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas te zhu shog 'di phul/'gran zla med pha rgan rin po che/ /bu mgon med spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /bus ri khrod zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /tshe thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /yul mtha' med 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'khyams/ /bdag da lta dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /pha khyed dang mjal ba skal ba bzang / /chos zab rgya'i gdams pa 364

cig /sa gzhi nam gnas bar du glegs bam 'dis/ /sa thog 'di na sdig zas sha yi phyir/ /sa la bsgyel nas sems can gsod tshad kyi/ /sa steng skye 'gro yongs la phan par shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i tog gi nor bu ltar/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rgyal bstan snying po snying rje nor bu yis/ /rgyal khams yongs la phan pa'i bkra shis shog /ces smras pas zhu ba po sogs der 'tshogs pa kun gyis snying rje chen po thugs dam gyi mthil du bzung nas/ mthong thos kyi 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag byung ngo //yang bkra shis 'khyel ba'i mkhyen brtse'i grub gnas na 'dug pa'i dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i slob bu bsod nams rgyal gyis nyin cig dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas te zhu shog 'di phul/'gran zla med pha rgan rin po che/ /bu mgon med spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /bus ri khrod zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /tshe thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /yul mtha' med 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'khyams/ /bdag da lta dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /pha khyed dang mjal ba skal ba bzang / /chos zab rgya'i gdams pa 364

gnang bzhin du/ /gnas 'di ru bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ /rje bka' drin can la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'byor dang yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul/ /bdag ma rig dbang gyur mthol lo bshags//pha'i mdzad spyod kun la rjes yi rang / /chos zab rgya'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /sku mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /rang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /mgon rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul pha rgan rje/ /rje khyed kyi rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /'dod bzhin du 'grub pa pha rgan mkhyen/ /mkhyen rab kyi thugs kyis bu la dgongs/ /dpe tho bas dngos po 'joms pa bzhin/ /dgra nyon mongs gcig char gzhom nus pa'i/ /chos phyag chen rtsa ba'i gnad 'gag cig /thugs brtse bas bu la gsung du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o bu khyod kyis mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms la/ 'gro kun don du smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sngon byon bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos thongs la mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul rnams su na bun gos ltar gyon/ brag phug zhwa ltar sten/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la btang nas/365

gnang bzhin du/ /gnas 'di ru bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ /rje bka' drin can la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'byor dang yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul/ /bdag ma rig dbang gyur mthol lo bshags//pha'i mdzad spyod kun la rjes yi rang / /chos zab rgya'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /sku mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /rang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /mgon rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul pha rgan rje/ /rje khyed kyi rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /'dod bzhin du 'grub pa pha rgan mkhyen/ /mkhyen rab kyi thugs kyis bu la dgongs/ /dpe tho bas dngos po 'joms pa bzhin/ /dgra nyon mongs gcig char gzhom nus pa'i/ /chos phyag chen rtsa ba'i gnad 'gag cig /thugs brtse bas bu la gsung du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'o bu khyod kyis mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms la/ 'gro kun don du smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sngon byon bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos thongs la mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul rnams su na bun gos ltar gyon/ brag phug zhwa ltar sten/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la btang nas/365

steng nas gnam brdibs/ 'og nas sa 'gul/ g.yas nas shing chag g.yon nas brag nyil rung stan gyi thog tu spang la phur ba btab pa bzhin lus g.yo med du krong nge / mig zum med du hrig ge sems gsal stong du lhang nge zhog dang tshe 'di nyid la nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnams cham la phab nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob ste bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so/ /'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs ni/ /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu ru/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la mnyam 'jog dus/ /lus bsrangs mig gnyis ha re ba/ /sngar 'das rjes ni mi gcod cing / /ma 'ongs pa yi sngon mi bsu/ /da lta ba la bzo mi bya/ /dran pa med par had de bzhag /dmigs pa med par sang nger bzhag /de ltar mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /rtog med dga' bde gsal nyams 'char /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /lam rtags yon tan ci yang 'byung / /nyon mongs dgra rnams gcig char du/ /'joms pa'i gdams ngag 'di yin zhes/ /rje btsun mi la'i bu rgyud mchog /grub thob o rgyan pa la sogs/ /bka' brgyud gong ma mang pos gsungs/ /366

steng nas gnam brdibs/ 'og nas sa 'gul/ g.yas nas shing chag g.yon nas brag nyil rung stan gyi thog tu spang la phur ba btab pa bzhin lus g.yo med du krong nge / mig zum med du hrig ge sems gsal stong du lhang nge zhog dang tshe 'di nyid la nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnams cham la phab nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob ste bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so/ /'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs ni/ /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu ru/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la mnyam 'jog dus/ /lus bsrangs mig gnyis ha re ba/ /sngar 'das rjes ni mi gcod cing / /ma 'ongs pa yi sngon mi bsu/ /da lta ba la bzo mi bya/ /dran pa med par had de bzhag /dmigs pa med par sang nger bzhag /de ltar mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /rtog med dga' bde gsal nyams 'char /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /lam rtags yon tan ci yang 'byung / /nyon mongs dgra rnams gcig char du/ /'joms pa'i gdams ngag 'di yin zhes/ /rje btsun mi la'i bu rgyud mchog /grub thob o rgyan pa la sogs/ /bka' brgyud gong ma mang pos gsungs/ /366

nga yis rjes bzlos byas pa yin/ /rjes 'jug bus kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces blas pas kho rang gis bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung bzhin mnyam par bzhag pas brtan pa thob par gyur to//yang rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa ka ring a lags rta mgrin sogs chos mdzad pho mo mang pos zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor gdams pa/'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyi ngo bo skyong tshul ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gdan bshams pa nyid la sku drang por bsrang ste/ dran pa mngon du bzhag nas bzhugs so/ /gsungs pa ltar/ bde ba'i stan la lus drang por bsrangs nas g.yo 'gul med par bsdad pas/ lus ma 'gul bas rtsa mi 'gul/ rtsa ma 'gul bas rlung mi 'gul/ rlung ma 'gul bas dus gsum gyi rnam rtog rnams yal ba'i rjes su sprin med pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ sal le/ sang nge/ wal ler sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar 'gyur bas/ de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa yin te/ zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon rin po che'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la/ /'di zhes tig po mi bdog gi /thog ma bar dang mtha' med par/ /nam 367

nga yis rjes bzlos byas pa yin/ /rjes 'jug bus kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces blas pas kho rang gis bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung bzhin mnyam par bzhag pas brtan pa thob par gyur to//yang rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa ka ring a lags rta mgrin sogs chos mdzad pho mo mang pos zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor gdams pa/'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyi ngo bo skyong tshul ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gdan bshams pa nyid la sku drang por bsrang ste/ dran pa mngon du bzhag nas bzhugs so/ /gsungs pa ltar/ bde ba'i stan la lus drang por bsrangs nas g.yo 'gul med par bsdad pas/ lus ma 'gul bas rtsa mi 'gul/ rtsa ma 'gul bas rlung mi 'gul/ rlung ma 'gul bas dus gsum gyi rnam rtog rnams yal ba'i rjes su sprin med pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ sal le/ sang nge/ wal ler sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar 'gyur bas/ de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa yin te/ zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon rin po che'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la/ /'di zhes tig po mi bdog gi /thog ma bar dang mtha' med par/ /nam 367

dran dus su glod la zhog /shes pa lhod kyis glod pa'i tshe/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar shar/ /de ni 'od gsal chos sku yin/ /gsungs/ rdzogs pa chen po tshig gsum pa'i rgyud las/ kye gsang ba'i bdag po/rang gi rig pa 'gags pa med par wal ler gsal ba 'di sangs rgyas yin no/ /rang gi rig pa 'gags pa med par wal ler gsal ba 'di dang 'bral ba med pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku bsgom du med do/ /rang gi rig pa 'gags pa med par wal ler gsal ba 'di sangs rgyas yin pa rang gis ngo shes pas chog go zhes gsungs pa ltar bskyang bar bya'o/ /zhes mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so/ /dgongs pa zab mo nam mkha' dang / /mnyam pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs yid gnyis/ /gcig tu 'dres par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos nyid yangs pa chen po yi/ /klong na rgyun du dga' yal le/ /skye bo pho mo sur 'grogs kyang / /mi dga' med par 'dzum 'bol le/ /rgyal khams phyogs med gar phyin kyang / /snang so mda' las rab bde ba'i/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /kun la phan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /khyed rnams sems kha yangs po gyis/ /rab tu dga' 368

zhing spro bzhin nyon/ /gser srang stong tsam byin pa las/ /glu 'dis kun la phan thogs yong / /yangs sar yangs dgos lta ba ni/ /nam mkha' las kyang yangs pa dgos/ /dog sar dog dgos spyod pa ni/ /sa rong las kyang dog pa dgos/ /lta ba yangs su mi bgyi ru/ /chos kyi dbyings las yangs pa med/ /spyod pa zhib tu mi bgyi ru/ /rgyu 'bras 'di las zhib pa med/ /gnas lugs lta ba nam mkha' las/ /shin tu mtho zhing yangs na yang / /spyod pa khye dang phag gnyis las/ /rtsing na bstan 'gror phan mi 'gyur/ /lta spyod gnyis po zung 'brel na/ /rang gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan/ /de phyir chos mdzad pho mo rnams//lta spyod gnyis po zung 'brel mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /lta spyod ya ma bral ba'i sgos/ /rang gzhan bstan dang 'gro ba la/ /phan thogs rgya chen 'byung bar shog /ces gdams pa'i nang ltar byas pas rang gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo //yang nyin cig bdag gis bsam blo 'di ltar btang / rang nyid mdo smad 'dir slebs nas lo mang po song / dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du 'gro 'dod skom pa chu 'dod lta bu yang yang byung nas/ lan gsum bar du chas kyang / gzhan gyis zhi drag 369

thabs du ma'i sgo nas bshol btab pas yar 'gro rgyu zhig ma byung / de'i bar la lo bco brgyad tsam zhig song tshar rang yang lo drug cu rtsa drug lon song / da song rung bsdad rung los gtugs nas 'gro don chen po zhig byed khom mi 'dug mod/'on kyang rtsa gsum lha la gsol ba btab nas brtag ril cig bsgril nas 'gro bsdad cig byed dgos snyam/ brtag pa'i yi ge gnyis 'di ltar bris te/ gcig la/ rtsa gsum lha yi lung bla ma tshe dpag med sogs kyi thugs rjes khyod tshe ring po yong ma mtha' yang lo brgya lon yong / da dung sa gcig nas sdod pa'i dus ma yin/ bsdad na 'gro don mi 'ong mgo log khams phyogs lho kha brgyud nas dbus su song na gdul bya mang thugs dam 'phel/tshe mjug 'di la bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po 'byung bas de lugs gyis zhes phul ba dge legs 'phel ces bris/ yang gcig la/ rtsa gsum lha yi lung / sngon grub thob thang stong rgyal po tshang la sku tshe mjug tu ma mkha' 'gros lung bstan byung nas/gcung gi ri bo che'i rtse nas bzhugs te 'gro don byas/ rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs skyes bu dam pa mang pos sku tshe mjug tu sa gcig nas 'gro don mdzad 'dug pas/ da khyod kyang dgung lo bgres nas gda'/ mdo smad kyi phyogs 'di nas bsdad de/370

thabs du ma'i sgo nas bshol btab pas yar 'gro rgyu zhig ma byung / de'i bar la lo bco brgyad tsam zhig song tshar rang yang lo drug cu rtsa drug lon song / da song rung bsdad rung los gtugs nas 'gro don chen po zhig byed khom mi 'dug mod/'on kyang rtsa gsum lha la gsol ba btab nas brtag ril cig bsgril nas 'gro bsdad cig byed dgos snyam/ brtag pa'i yi ge gnyis 'di ltar bris te/ gcig la/ rtsa gsum lha yi lung bla ma tshe dpag med sogs kyi thugs rjes khyod tshe ring po yong ma mtha' yang lo brgya lon yong / da dung sa gcig nas sdod pa'i dus ma yin/ bsdad na 'gro don mi 'ong mgo log khams phyogs lho kha brgyud nas dbus su song na gdul bya mang thugs dam 'phel/tshe mjug 'di la bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po 'byung bas de lugs gyis zhes phul ba dge legs 'phel ces bris/ yang gcig la/ rtsa gsum lha yi lung / sngon grub thob thang stong rgyal po tshang la sku tshe mjug tu ma mkha' 'gros lung bstan byung nas/gcung gi ri bo che'i rtse nas bzhugs te 'gro don byas/ rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs skyes bu dam pa mang pos sku tshe mjug tu sa gcig nas 'gro don mdzad 'dug pas/ da khyod kyang dgung lo bgres nas gda'/ mdo smad kyi phyogs 'di nas bsdad de/370

bstan 'gro'i don byas na sku tshe ring thugs dam 'phel/ bstan 'gro'i don yang rgya chen po 'byung bas de lugs gyis zhes phul ba dge legs 'phel/ zhes bris te de gnyis zan gyi ril bu gnyis kyi nang du bcug ril bu gnyis ka to ra chen po zhig gi nang du bzhag lag tu thogs nas gsol ba btab/ bden pa yag po zhig brdar nas/ ga le byas lag gi ka to ra bskor pas skabs shig nang nas ril bu gcig yar nas rang gi pang du slebs byung ba kha phyes nas bltas pa'i tshe/ dbus su 'gro ba'i yi ge de ma byung bar/ 'di nas sdod pa'i yi ge de yin tshe/ rang 'gro 'dod che ba'i stabs kyis dbus phyogs kyi yi ge ma babs pa la yid pham po zhig byung yang / sngon glang bo che bgres pa zhig gis gzhon pa'i sgang la lung ba 'di'i tshur kha nas mchongs na phar khar slebs yong / da dung yang slebs yong mod snyam nas mchongs pas phar khar ma slebs par/ lung ba'i nang du lhung nas sked pa chag tshe/ gzhon nu'i dus bzhin lo lon pa'i dus mi yong bar 'dug kho la ltos zhes kha chems bzhag nas shi ba'i lo rgyus bzhin/ brtag ril la ma babs par/ lo gzhon pa'i dus bzhin u tshugs byas dbus su song na/ lo na so rgas pa'i stabs kyis lam zhig nas shi 'dra song na/ ri yul stod smad 371

gnyis ga'i slob ma yon bdag dang dad can rnams/ sems sdug cig la gtad pa las/ gzhan ci yang mi 'ong bar gda'/de bas 'brel thogs rnams kyis gtso byas sems can thams cad sems kyi dbyengs su bzhag nas/ de'i don du dben pa'i ri khrod rnams su zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol na rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs te/ sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis/ mang du thob pa nags kyi nang dag tu/ /lang tsho yol ba rnams kyis gnas pa bde/ /zhes dang / thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por byed/ /skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rje bdag nyid chen pos/ dmu rgod gdul dka'i sems can 'di rnams la/ /bshad pas phan thogs chen po ga la 'gyur/ /de bas sgrub pa lhur len dben pa bsten/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa'i lam rnyed snyam/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs dam pa gong ma'i gsung de dang 'dra ba rnams sems la bzhag nas yar la 'ong rgyu'i spros pa bcad de/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i go cha bzung ba yin pas/khyed rnams tshe 'di rang la lan cig ma mjal ba la sems ma 'phreng / skyo snang chen po ma byed par/ bla ma pha ma yin yang mi rtag pa'i tshul 'di yang yang soms la/ da ni gang la yang ma 372

chags par tshe 'di blo yis thongs la/ dben pa'i gnas su tshodang sgrub pa snyoms dang bla ma'i zhabs tog pha ma'i drin gzo/sems can gyi 'gro don rnams dus gcig la 'grub par gdon mi za'o/ /zhes spyi la phul nas/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la spring yig nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba 'di phul/'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing gi mchog /jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor dpon slob kun/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /nged rnams dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs nas mjal/ /yud tsam 'tshogs nas so sor gyes pa ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /chags yul bla ma pha ma las lhag med/ /de dag med na khyed rnams su la chags/ /da ni tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /dben pa'i gnas su dam pa'i rnam thar skyongs/ /bdag gi mgo yi skra dkar so yang lhung / /rgas pa'i dbang gis dbus su ma slebs kyang / /sngon dus bdag gis chos bshad byas pa las/ /lhag cig dbus su slebs rung bshad rgyu med/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin slob mas sgrub 373

nus na/ /bla mar mjal ba las kyang bsod nams che/ /dad pa yod na gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /bla mar dngos sam nyams la mjal rgyu yong / /ha bos gangs la thag nyer btud pa las/ /rgyangs nas bltas na dkar du 'gro ba bzhin/ /bla mar mnyam du 'grogs las thag ring nas/ /yid la dran na dad pa je cher 'gro /bla mar ma bral slob ma su yang med/ /mya ngan ma byed byed mkhan sems la ltos/ /rang sems bla ma'i thugs dang bsres la zhog /don dam chos dbyengs ngang nas 'du 'bral med/ /bla ma kha thag ring rung sems thag nye/ /ngas ni khyed rnams mi brjed sems la 'jog /khyed rnams kun kyang bla ma snying dbus sgoms/ /gsol ba thob dang byen rlabs dngos grub 'byung / /bla ma 'bral med bsten dgos zer ba de/ /rgyun du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa dang / /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du/ /bsres nas mnyam par 'jog la zer ba yin/ /mang po bshad na don rtsa mi zin pas/ /'di ni tshig brgya'i mdo 'gag yin pas na/ /rgyun du bla ma sgoms dang tshe 'dir yang / /bla ma'i snang ba 'bral ba med par 'gyur/ /phyi mar mngon dga'i zhing nas mngon sum du/ /mjal nas dga' spro'i gleng mo byed bzhin du/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams rab 'byams 374

'grims/ /rgyal ba mchod cing 'gro kun 'dren par smon/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer me tog pad tshal la/ /phog tshe thams cad kha phye bzhad pa ltar/ /bdag gi spring yig slob ma yon bdag la/ /'phrod tshe thams cad dga' zhing spro bar shog /ces pa dang /yang stod mnga' ris bskor gsum gyi slob ma yon bdag dad can rnams la spring yig zla ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba 'di phul/rtsa ba'i bla ma phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi slob ma yon bdag thams cad la/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /jo shāka rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs pa'i zhing / /dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar du 'khod pa yi/ /sdom gsum 'phags pa'i nor gyis rab phyug pa'i/ /slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi sku drung du/ /gnas brtan bgres po bzhin du so lhung zhing / /tshe ring lha bzhin skra dang kha spu dkar/ /rgas pa'i mtshan ma sa non pa'i pha rgan ngas/ /phan pa'i snying gtam yi ger bkod nas 'bul/ /khyed rnams thams cad sku khams bzang po'i sgos/ /mtshams rtags bskur pa ma nyams 'byor ba'i mod/ /kun la dngos su mjal 'dra'i dga' spro shar/ /bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /bdag gi sems la rgas rgyu ma mchis 375

kyang / /sgyu lus rgas nas 'gro don ma pher tshe/ /yid kyis rang lus grangs med sprul byas nas/ /phyogs med 'gro don byed bzhin bde bar mchis/ /mtshams zhus nged rnams dbus na yod pa'i dus/ /khye rnams kun gyes bdag la zhabs tog byas/ /ngas kyang khyed rnams kun la chos bshad byas/ /thams cad thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa byung / /don dam chos dbyings bde ba chen po yi/ /klong na nam yang 'du 'bral ma mchis mod/ /'on kyang kun rdzob sgyu lus so so ru/ /song gshis sems la brtan pa ma thob pas/ /tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin du so so ru/ /gyes nas yun ring song tshe thug 'dod skyes/ /khyed rnams kun gyis nga la yar phebs zhes/ /lo re bzhin du yi ge bskur ba'i tshe/ /nga yang khyed rnams kun la thug 'dod skyes/ /lan gsum chas kyang da bar lus pa byung / /da rung yar la 'ong na 'dod mod kyang / /na so rgas pas gtugs nas 'ong ma thub/ /gal te snying rus bskyed nas 'ong na yang / /glang chen lo lon mchongs pa'i lo rgyus bzhin/ /gzhon pa'i dus bzhin yar la ma slebs par/ /bar lam zhig nas shi na ci zhig bya/ /ma shi slebs kyang skom pas chu 'dod ltar/ /mjal na 'dod pa'i dad can mang po zhig /sems 'phreng bzhin du 'jig rten phyi ma ru/ /376

kyang / /sgyu lus rgas nas 'gro don ma pher tshe/ /yid kyis rang lus grangs med sprul byas nas/ /phyogs med 'gro don byed bzhin bde bar mchis/ /mtshams zhus nged rnams dbus na yod pa'i dus/ /khye rnams kun gyes bdag la zhabs tog byas/ /ngas kyang khyed rnams kun la chos bshad byas/ /thams cad thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa byung / /don dam chos dbyings bde ba chen po yi/ /klong na nam yang 'du 'bral ma mchis mod/ /'on kyang kun rdzob sgyu lus so so ru/ /song gshis sems la brtan pa ma thob pas/ /tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin du so so ru/ /gyes nas yun ring song tshe thug 'dod skyes/ /khyed rnams kun gyis nga la yar phebs zhes/ /lo re bzhin du yi ge bskur ba'i tshe/ /nga yang khyed rnams kun la thug 'dod skyes/ /lan gsum chas kyang da bar lus pa byung / /da rung yar la 'ong na 'dod mod kyang / /na so rgas pas gtugs nas 'ong ma thub/ /gal te snying rus bskyed nas 'ong na yang / /glang chen lo lon mchongs pa'i lo rgyus bzhin/ /gzhon pa'i dus bzhin yar la ma slebs par/ /bar lam zhig nas shi na ci zhig bya/ /ma shi slebs kyang skom pas chu 'dod ltar/ /mjal na 'dod pa'i dad can mang po zhig /sems 'phreng bzhin du 'jig rten phyi ma ru/ /376

song ba rnams la thug rgyu med par gda'/ /ma shi mjal 'dod yod na lan cig tsam/ /mjal na dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /thams cad rgas pas yud tsam pa zhig las/ /yun ring lhan du sdod pa'i dus mi gda'/ /da ngas bsam tshe rgas pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /tshe ring lha dang gnas brtan rgan po bzhin/ /brag ri'i phug dang ljon shing bsil grib tu/ /bsdad na bstan 'gro'i mig rkyen mchog tu 'gyur/ /khyed rnams gtso byas ma gyur sems can kun/ /sems nyid 'od gsal bde ba chen po yi/ /dbyings su bzhag nas 'di phyi bar do ru/ /phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon byas na bzang / /khyed rnams kun kyang mdo smad shar phyogs kyi/ /nyams dga'i ri khrod cig na bzhugs snyam du/ /blo sems bde ba'i ngang nas gsol ba thob /byen rlabs rgyangs na gnas kyang 'jug par 'gyur/ /da ni rmi lam tsam gyi tshe mjug 'dir/ /skyid rung sdug rung yud tsam pa zhig gda'/ /skyo nas ci bya gnas skor ba yi khas/ /phan tshun gcig gcig gnas tshul go bar gda'/ /phyi mar shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams gang 'dod mang po nas/ /mjal yong snyam pa'i blo yi gdeng tshad yod/ /khyed rnams sems la zungs la dga' bar gyis/ /snying 377

song ba rnams la thug rgyu med par gda'/ /ma shi mjal 'dod yod na lan cig tsam/ /mjal na dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /thams cad rgas pas yud tsam pa zhig las/ /yun ring lhan du sdod pa'i dus mi gda'/ /da ngas bsam tshe rgas pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /tshe ring lha dang gnas brtan rgan po bzhin/ /brag ri'i phug dang ljon shing bsil grib tu/ /bsdad na bstan 'gro'i mig rkyen mchog tu 'gyur/ /khyed rnams gtso byas ma gyur sems can kun/ /sems nyid 'od gsal bde ba chen po yi/ /dbyings su bzhag nas 'di phyi bar do ru/ /phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon byas na bzang / /khyed rnams kun kyang mdo smad shar phyogs kyi/ /nyams dga'i ri khrod cig na bzhugs snyam du/ /blo sems bde ba'i ngang nas gsol ba thob /byen rlabs rgyangs na gnas kyang 'jug par 'gyur/ /da ni rmi lam tsam gyi tshe mjug 'dir/ /skyid rung sdug rung yud tsam pa zhig gda'/ /skyo nas ci bya gnas skor ba yi khas/ /phan tshun gcig gcig gnas tshul go bar gda'/ /phyi mar shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams gang 'dod mang po nas/ /mjal yong snyam pa'i blo yi gdeng tshad yod/ /khyed rnams sems la zungs la dga' bar gyis/ /snying 377

gtam 'di nyid mthong thos dran tshad kyis/ /bla ma pha ma yin yang mi rtag par/ /go nas gang la'ang chags zhen mi byed par/ /dben par lha chos byas nas sangs rgyas shog /jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras dang / /bla ma pha ma dran nas 'gro mkhan la/ /lam la gegs dang gol sa mi 'byung bar/ /kun gyis bsam pa'i nang bzhin mjal bar shog /rab dkar gangs la zla 'od phog pa bzhin/ /sems dkar slob ma yon bdag thams cad la/ /bdag gi spring yig 'di nyid 'byor ba'i mod/ /sngar bas dad gus dga' spro 'phel gyur cig /ces pa dang / yang bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams rong phyogs kyi dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la spring yig nor bu'i 'od zer zhes bya ba 'di phul/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis phan pa'i rgyangs glu len/ /khyed rnams ma yengs dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa 'bral ba dang / /bsags pa 'dzad cing mthon po ltung ba sogs/ /gang gang 'gro mgon sangs rgyas gsungs pa rnams/ /de de bzhin du snang ba'i tshul la ltos/ /khyad par nged rnams tshong 'dus mgron po 378

gtam 'di nyid mthong thos dran tshad kyis/ /bla ma pha ma yin yang mi rtag par/ /go nas gang la'ang chags zhen mi byed par/ /dben par lha chos byas nas sangs rgyas shog /jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras dang / /bla ma pha ma dran nas 'gro mkhan la/ /lam la gegs dang gol sa mi 'byung bar/ /kun gyis bsam pa'i nang bzhin mjal bar shog /rab dkar gangs la zla 'od phog pa bzhin/ /sems dkar slob ma yon bdag thams cad la/ /bdag gi spring yig 'di nyid 'byor ba'i mod/ /sngar bas dad gus dga' spro 'phel gyur cig /ces pa dang / yang bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams rong phyogs kyi dad can slob ma yon bdag rnams la spring yig nor bu'i 'od zer zhes bya ba 'di phul/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis phan pa'i rgyangs glu len/ /khyed rnams ma yengs dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa 'bral ba dang / /bsags pa 'dzad cing mthon po ltung ba sogs/ /gang gang 'gro mgon sangs rgyas gsungs pa rnams/ /de de bzhin du snang ba'i tshul la ltos/ /khyad par nged rnams tshong 'dus mgron po 378

bzhin/ /so sor gyes nas 'jig rten khams 'di dang / /la la 'jig rten phyi mar song tshul la/ /soms dang skyo ba skye ba'i rgyu zhig gda'/ /nyi ma nub kha'i la mgo'i nyi 'od bzhin/ /mi tshe yun thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /da ni tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /gcig pur dben par sgrub pa snying por gyis/ /rang nyid ngal zhing bstan 'gror mi phan pa'i/ /gzhan don ltar snang 'di yis ci zhig bya/ /tshe mjug lo zla kha shas ci yod bar/ /rig pa chos dbyings klong du ngal gsos shig /dbyings rig dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang las nam yang g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /'gags med gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar/ /mar gyur 'gro ba 'dren pa'i smon lam thob/ /gal te de 'dra'i skal ba mi ldan na/ /don med 'gro 'dug mang po byed pa las/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i phyogs su kha bltas nas/ /gom pa bdun tsam spos pa bsod nams che/ /lha brgya'i zhal las bla ma'i gser zhal gcig /mjal ba bsod nams che zhes dam pas gsungs/ /chags yul bla ma yod kyang bla ma las/ /lhag cig su yod gang la ma chags par/ /mdo smad phyogs 'di'i gces phrug mang po yis/ /pha ma bskyur nas dbus su 'ong ba bzhin/ /shog dang lam la bar chad mi 'byung bar/ /dpon slob lhan cig 379

'dzom pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /bdag ni skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /ngo mtshar phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun tu song / /rgyal ba mchod cing 'brel thogs ma lus pa/ /rang rang gang 'dod zhing du 'dren par smon/ /spring yig nor bu'i 'od zer zhes bya 'di//mthong thos rnams kyi sems la phan thogs shing / /gar song yul du lo legs 'bru nor 'phel/ /gang bsam don rnams 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / yang bde ldan zhing gi mgon po ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung du/ skyabs 'jug gi zhu shog 'di phul/bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od dpag med/ /slar yang ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol pa/ /skyabs mgon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung / /gus phran sgyu lus pad+ma dkar po yi/ /'jam mnyen rab mdzes sor bcu'i 'dab ma rnams/ /spyi bo'i ze'u 'bru'i ngos la yar phyogs te/ /rab tu gus pa'i zhu tshig dri bsung spro/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku nam mkha'i nor bu la/ /mi 'dod sgra gcan 'tshe bas ring nas dben/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis bstan pa'i pad tshal dang / /gdul bya gling bzhi yongs la khyab bo zhes/ /snyan grags 380

'dzom pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /bdag ni skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /ngo mtshar phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun tu song / /rgyal ba mchod cing 'brel thogs ma lus pa/ /rang rang gang 'dod zhing du 'dren par smon/ /spring yig nor bu'i 'od zer zhes bya 'di//mthong thos rnams kyi sems la phan thogs shing / /gar song yul du lo legs 'bru nor 'phel/ /gang bsam don rnams 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa dang / yang bde ldan zhing gi mgon po ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung du/ skyabs 'jug gi zhu shog 'di phul/bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od dpag med/ /slar yang ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol pa/ /skyabs mgon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung / /gus phran sgyu lus pad+ma dkar po yi/ /'jam mnyen rab mdzes sor bcu'i 'dab ma rnams/ /spyi bo'i ze'u 'bru'i ngos la yar phyogs te/ /rab tu gus pa'i zhu tshig dri bsung spro/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku nam mkha'i nor bu la/ /mi 'dod sgra gcan 'tshe bas ring nas dben/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis bstan pa'i pad tshal dang / /gdul bya gling bzhi yongs la khyab bo zhes/ /snyan grags 380

dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir bas/ /phyogs kyi khor yug thams cad gang ba'i mod/ /bdag blo rmongs pa'i gar mkhan gzhon nu yang / /dga' dad zlos gar lan stong bsgyur dgos byung / /gus phran sgyu lus nyam chung pad+ma yang / /mi 'dod rgas pa'i nam zlas gtugs na yang / /na 'chi ba mos ha cang ma mnar bar/ /rnam shes sbrang bu 'khor bzhin bde bar mchis/ /mgon khyod bde ldan zhing gi mgon po ltar/ /nam yang bgres tshul tsam yang mi ston par/ /bskal pa khri phrag 'bum phrag mang po'i bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /don 'dus byang chub lam rim rnga bo che/ /ches cher brdungs nas gdul bya'i zhing kun gyi/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid las bslang du gsol/ /bdag kyang deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / /byang chub thob kyang rigs kyi bdag po ru/ /bzhugs nas 'bral ba med par byen gyis rlobs/ /de ltar skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa dang / /phyi mar bde ba can dang dga' ldan sogs/ /gang 'dod zhing nas yang yang mjal bar shog /ces tshe rabs mang por rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel du rin chen gser 381

bye'i phreng ba byu ru'i rgyan ldan dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas bcas rab tu gus pas phul lo/ /yang gangs can 'gro ba'i lha skal phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul skyabs mgon rgyal ba mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung du/ skyabs 'jug gi zhu shog 'di phul/gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /slar yang ngur sprig gar gyi rnam rol pa/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba mkhas grub rgya mtsho zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung / /khyed kyi gdul bya'i zhing khams 'di nyid du/ /skyes pa'i mdo med snyoms las zhabs dkar pas/ /mgon khyod phyogs su lha phyag grangs med byas/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad zhu/ /khyed sku dpag bsam ljon shing bzang po la/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe med par ches cher rgyas/ /byams brtse byang chub sems kyi bsil grib la/ /gdul bya lha mi bye ba ther 'bum 'khod/ /snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po phyogs kun tu/ /g.yo ba sgra 'dzin dbang bor son pa'i mod/ /dad gus dag snang dga' spro'i gter kha brdol/ /rang sems khang chung nang kun khengs pa byung / /phran chung sgyu lus pad dkar rnying na yang / /na 'chi grang reg ba mo ma phog par/ /phan sems dri ngad phyogs kun 'thul bzhin du/ /rnam shes sbrang mas ma btang tsam du mchis/ /mgon 382

khyod tshe dpag med pa ji bzhin du/ /bskal pa bye ba ther 'bum grangs med bar/ /gdul bya'i don du brtan par bzhugs dgos zhes/ /gsol ba 'debs pas re 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /phan bde 'byung gnas thub bstan rin po che/ /phyogs dus kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /ris med 'gro la mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi/ /zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bdag kyang deng nas byang chub ma thob bar tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / /byang chub thob kyang gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar skyabs 'jug zhu ba'i yig chung la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis yud tsam gzigs pa'i rten/ /stong min lha rdzas dang bcas phul ba'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces tshe rabs mang por rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel du/ g.yang ṭi'i phreng ba ma na ho'i rgyan ldan dang dri med lha rdzas bcas phul lo/ /gzhan yang bod kyi rgyal po/ bla ma lcags zam pa/ ri sna dgon bla ma/ mkhar rdo sprul pa'i sku/ bla ma sbyin pa nor bu/ bla ma gangs ri ba/ bla ma ye shes sogs bla ma rnams dang / sbyin bdag rtsa chang dga'/ phu dmar bar tsho/sde pa rnam rgyal sogs sbyin bdag rnams la mtshams zhus yi ge 383

khyod tshe dpag med pa ji bzhin du/ /bskal pa bye ba ther 'bum grangs med bar/ /gdul bya'i don du brtan par bzhugs dgos zhes/ /gsol ba 'debs pas re 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /phan bde 'byung gnas thub bstan rin po che/ /phyogs dus kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /ris med 'gro la mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi/ /zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bdag kyang deng nas byang chub ma thob bar tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / /byang chub thob kyang gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar skyabs 'jug zhu ba'i yig chung la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis yud tsam gzigs pa'i rten/ /stong min lha rdzas dang bcas phul ba'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces tshe rabs mang por rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel du/ g.yang ṭi'i phreng ba ma na ho'i rgyan ldan dang dri med lha rdzas bcas phul lo/ /gzhan yang bod kyi rgyal po/ bla ma lcags zam pa/ ri sna dgon bla ma/ mkhar rdo sprul pa'i sku/ bla ma sbyin pa nor bu/ bla ma gangs ri ba/ bla ma ye shes sogs bla ma rnams dang / sbyin bdag rtsa chang dga'/ phu dmar bar tsho/sde pa rnam rgyal sogs sbyin bdag rnams la mtshams zhus yi ge 383

tshig lhug tshigs bcad bcas brgya dang bcu gcig bris/ yig rten du gser dngul bsil ma/ gos kyi cod pan dril gdan/shel can/ shel gyi phreng ba/ pad+ma'i snying po'i phreng ba sogs dngos po gang yod dang / dad rten du skra lo/ na bza'i tshal bu/tshe ril rten 'dus bsrung mdud dkar ser dmar ljang / phyi mdzod nang mdzod 'jam dar kho na bcug rgya brgyab nas 'gro mkhan la sprad/ sgyes kyi mchog tu rnam thar mgur 'bum rnams kyi par brgyab nas/ glegs bam bzhi bcu lhag tsam la ko khra brgyab nas do dam byas/ 'gro mkhan kun dga'/ blo bzang don 'grub rnams kyis khal rta bro kha gos lham sbis dkar lam chas bzang po bcas/ me lug lo'i zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes la reb gong nas thon sbra nag gi mgron po yod sa 'bal bar du song / de'i lo nor la gor byung nas 'gro rgyu ma byung bar bsdad nas/ lo rjes ma sa sprel lo zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gcig nyin lam la bud nas song bas/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du mgon po thams cad bde bar slebs/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi slob ma yon bdag rnams la spyi dang sgos kyi mtshams zhus rnams sprad pas/ nga khams bzang zhing 'gro don 'phel po yong ba la dga' zhing / da ni tshe 'dir mjal rgyu ma red snyam dad 384

tshig lhug tshigs bcad bcas brgya dang bcu gcig bris/ yig rten du gser dngul bsil ma/ gos kyi cod pan dril gdan/shel can/ shel gyi phreng ba/ pad+ma'i snying po'i phreng ba sogs dngos po gang yod dang / dad rten du skra lo/ na bza'i tshal bu/tshe ril rten 'dus bsrung mdud dkar ser dmar ljang / phyi mdzod nang mdzod 'jam dar kho na bcug rgya brgyab nas 'gro mkhan la sprad/ sgyes kyi mchog tu rnam thar mgur 'bum rnams kyi par brgyab nas/ glegs bam bzhi bcu lhag tsam la ko khra brgyab nas do dam byas/ 'gro mkhan kun dga'/ blo bzang don 'grub rnams kyis khal rta bro kha gos lham sbis dkar lam chas bzang po bcas/ me lug lo'i zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes la reb gong nas thon sbra nag gi mgron po yod sa 'bal bar du song / de'i lo nor la gor byung nas 'gro rgyu ma byung bar bsdad nas/ lo rjes ma sa sprel lo zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gcig nyin lam la bud nas song bas/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du mgon po thams cad bde bar slebs/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi slob ma yon bdag rnams la spyi dang sgos kyi mtshams zhus rnams sprad pas/ nga khams bzang zhing 'gro don 'phel po yong ba la dga' zhing / da ni tshe 'dir mjal rgyu ma red snyam dad 384

can rnams kyi sems la skyo snang shar nas mig nas mchi ma g.yo ba byung snang / yang de'i lo nga yang 'brog pa rgyud pa grwa tshang /mdo pa/ mgon shul/ mgar rtse/ dpyi pa/ hor/ so nag skya gya /bon rgya/ a mgron sogs la song 'gro don 'dra byas/ de'i lo mgon shul phar bzung la nor nad byung nas mdzo mo 'bri g.yag brgya stong mang po 'chi ba mthong tshe snying rje skyes phan re e thogs snyam ri mthon po thams cad kyi rtser song / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la skyabs 'gro byas/ dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba btab/ yul lha la bsang / sde brgyad la gser skyems btang / tshe gzungs dang rigs gsum mgon po'i dar lcog btsugs/ gzhan yang yi dam lha'i sgo nas bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgoms/ byin 'bebs bkra shis brjod pa sogs byas kyang / sems can gyi las dbang gis phal che ba zhig ma gtogs gzhan thams cad la phan ma thogs par/de'i rkyen byas 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran nas yon bdag rnams la spyir chos thams cad mi rtag cing / sgos su nged rnams kyang 'di bzhin 'chi ba las ma 'das pas da phyin chad chos gyis zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /385

can rnams kyi sems la skyo snang shar nas mig nas mchi ma g.yo ba byung snang / yang de'i lo nga yang 'brog pa rgyud pa grwa tshang /mdo pa/ mgon shul/ mgar rtse/ dpyi pa/ hor/ so nag skya gya /bon rgya/ a mgron sogs la song 'gro don 'dra byas/ de'i lo mgon shul phar bzung la nor nad byung nas mdzo mo 'bri g.yag brgya stong mang po 'chi ba mthong tshe snying rje skyes phan re e thogs snyam ri mthon po thams cad kyi rtser song / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la skyabs 'gro byas/ dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba btab/ yul lha la bsang / sde brgyad la gser skyems btang / tshe gzungs dang rigs gsum mgon po'i dar lcog btsugs/ gzhan yang yi dam lha'i sgo nas bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgoms/ byin 'bebs bkra shis brjod pa sogs byas kyang / sems can gyi las dbang gis phal che ba zhig ma gtogs gzhan thams cad la phan ma thogs par/de'i rkyen byas 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran nas yon bdag rnams la spyir chos thams cad mi rtag cing / sgos su nged rnams kyang 'di bzhin 'chi ba las ma 'das pas da phyin chad chos gyis zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /385

'dod dgu'i dngos grub thams cad char bzhin phob/ /'di phyir bde ba'i chos kyi mgur dbyangs len/ /gnyid rmugs spongs la dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /da lo sgo nor shi ba 'di bzhin du/ /nged rnams kun kyang 'chi'o yon bdag rnams/ /'chi ba soms la phyi mar 'gro grabs gyis/ /'gro grabs lha chos yin no yon bdag rnams/ /nor rdzas mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /yod dus mchod sbyin thongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /phan bde 'byung gnas bla ma dkon mchog la/ /rtag tu gsol ba thob dang yon bdag rnams/ /pha mar bkur na bu la bsod nams skye/ /rgas dus brtsi bkur gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos de mched grogs yin/ /grogs la brtse gdung mdzod cig yon bdag rnams/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /snying rje phan thogs mdzod cig yon bdag rnams/ /phyag dang skor bas las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag /rten la phyag skor gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /chos kyi snying po yi ge drug ma yin/ /rgyun du ma ṇi bgrongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /dge ba gang byas mjug tu bsngo smon mdzod/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob bo yon bdag rnams/ /lha chos byed na zhal gdams mang mi dgos/ /de rnams yid la zungs shig yon bdag 386

'dod dgu'i dngos grub thams cad char bzhin phob/ /'di phyir bde ba'i chos kyi mgur dbyangs len/ /gnyid rmugs spongs la dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /da lo sgo nor shi ba 'di bzhin du/ /nged rnams kun kyang 'chi'o yon bdag rnams/ /'chi ba soms la phyi mar 'gro grabs gyis/ /'gro grabs lha chos yin no yon bdag rnams/ /nor rdzas mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /yod dus mchod sbyin thongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /phan bde 'byung gnas bla ma dkon mchog la/ /rtag tu gsol ba thob dang yon bdag rnams/ /pha mar bkur na bu la bsod nams skye/ /rgas dus brtsi bkur gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos de mched grogs yin/ /grogs la brtse gdung mdzod cig yon bdag rnams/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /snying rje phan thogs mdzod cig yon bdag rnams/ /phyag dang skor bas las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag /rten la phyag skor gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /chos kyi snying po yi ge drug ma yin/ /rgyun du ma ṇi bgrongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /dge ba gang byas mjug tu bsngo smon mdzod/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob bo yon bdag rnams/ /lha chos byed na zhal gdams mang mi dgos/ /de rnams yid la zungs shig yon bdag 386

rnams/ /glu 'di thos tshad yon bdag pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /g.yang nor mang pos sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas yon bdag pho mo dad can rnams kyis 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsams nas tshe phyi ma'i rgyags phye ru dmigs te/ nga la snga phyi rim can byas rta rgod ma nyi shu rtsa lnga / nor nag brgya dang lnga bcu/ lug stong phrag gcig rkyal mar che chung bco lnga/phyur ba do bo bdun/ tshar bu pags chung gos 'dang bcu/ ras dā bu dkar dmar bcu gsum/ wa lpags brgyad/ bhu la'i lham drug sga thag 'breng zangs nga ka ca sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad khal mang po bcas phul ba rnams blangs nas gsog 'jog ma byas par cha gsum du btang nas/ gnyis kyis mchod sbyin byas/gcig nged dpon slob rnams kyi lo gcig gi mthun rkyen du bzhag nas/ dpon slob kha shas shig dang bcas te 'brong lung dben pa'i nags khrod du 'ongs/ nyi ma kha shas khams bsang byas/ de na yod pa'i nor rnams ma shi 'dug de nas mtshams pa mang po dang bcas te nang du bsdad nas/de'i lo nged rnams kyi lam nyams len gyi gtso bo rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug nang ltar byang chub sems kyi phan yon bsams nas smon 387

rnams/ /glu 'di thos tshad yon bdag pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la phyogs par shog /yul phyogs kun tu bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /g.yang nor mang pos sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas yon bdag pho mo dad can rnams kyis 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsams nas tshe phyi ma'i rgyags phye ru dmigs te/ nga la snga phyi rim can byas rta rgod ma nyi shu rtsa lnga / nor nag brgya dang lnga bcu/ lug stong phrag gcig rkyal mar che chung bco lnga/phyur ba do bo bdun/ tshar bu pags chung gos 'dang bcu/ ras dā bu dkar dmar bcu gsum/ wa lpags brgyad/ bhu la'i lham drug sga thag 'breng zangs nga ka ca sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad khal mang po bcas phul ba rnams blangs nas gsog 'jog ma byas par cha gsum du btang nas/ gnyis kyis mchod sbyin byas/gcig nged dpon slob rnams kyi lo gcig gi mthun rkyen du bzhag nas/ dpon slob kha shas shig dang bcas te 'brong lung dben pa'i nags khrod du 'ongs/ nyi ma kha shas khams bsang byas/ de na yod pa'i nor rnams ma shi 'dug de nas mtshams pa mang po dang bcas te nang du bsdad nas/de'i lo nged rnams kyi lam nyams len gyi gtso bo rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug nang ltar byang chub sems kyi phan yon bsams nas smon 387

'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bag yod dran shes bsten nas spyir phar phyin drug dang / thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa yid du 'ong ba thams cad la ci nus su bslabs shing / khyad par 'gro kun pha mar bsams nas byams snying rje bdag gzhan mnyam brjes kyi blos khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster zhing / gyong dang pham kha rang gis len pa dang /phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa skyel mkhan byung na yang bzod pa bsgom pa tsam du ma zad/ gnod lan du bka' drin gtang rag 'bul ba'i bsam sbyor gong 'phel du btang bas/kun gyi nyon mongs chags zhen je chung du song / snying rje phan sems je che ru song nas/ snyigs dus kyi nyam thag sems can mang po la phan thogs nas gnas skabs su bde zhing / mthar thug gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog la 'god nus pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' sha stag byung ngo / /yang nyin cig dad brtson shes rab snying rje 'dzom pa'i a lags mkha' 'gro sogs gnas der 'dug pa rnams kyis sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor chos mdzad yongs la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /snying rje lha mchog 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /snying rje 388

'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bag yod dran shes bsten nas spyir phar phyin drug dang / thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa yid du 'ong ba thams cad la ci nus su bslabs shing / khyad par 'gro kun pha mar bsams nas byams snying rje bdag gzhan mnyam brjes kyi blos khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster zhing / gyong dang pham kha rang gis len pa dang /phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa skyel mkhan byung na yang bzod pa bsgom pa tsam du ma zad/ gnod lan du bka' drin gtang rag 'bul ba'i bsam sbyor gong 'phel du btang bas/kun gyi nyon mongs chags zhen je chung du song / snying rje phan sems je che ru song nas/ snyigs dus kyi nyam thag sems can mang po la phan thogs nas gnas skabs su bde zhing / mthar thug gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog la 'god nus pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' sha stag byung ngo / /yang nyin cig dad brtson shes rab snying rje 'dzom pa'i a lags mkha' 'gro sogs gnas der 'dug pa rnams kyis sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor chos mdzad yongs la phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /snying rje lha mchog 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /snying rje 388

chen pos 'gro kun bu bzhin skyongs/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis po chos kun gye/ /snying po yin pa rgyal ba sras bcas gsungs/ /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas sangs rgyas rgyu/ /de gnyis yin pa sa ra ha pas gsungs/ /snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa rul zhes/ /o rgyan chen pos rje 'bangs rnams la gsungs/ /de phyir bka' gdams bla ma gong ma yis/ /stong nyid las kyang snying rje gal che gsungs/ /stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye'o zhes/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhal nas gsungs/ stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye ba gnyis/ /dus mnyam yin zhes dam pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /gang ltar na yang stong nyid snying rje gnyis/ /med thabs med pa'i chos shig yin par gsungs/ /de phyir chos pa bzang po zhig byed na/ /stong nyid snying rje thugs dam mthil du zungs/ /ma yis mthong sar bu chung me nang du/ /lhung ba mthong na snying rje skye ba ltar/ /mnyam gzhag sgang la sdug bsngal can mthong na/ /de la bcos min snying rje skye ba dgos/ /bu chung ngu sgang a ma slebs pa'i tshe/ /ngu 'phro chad nas dga' bde 'char ba ltar/ /snying rje sgang la mnyam gzhag slebs pa'i tshe/ /sems sdug chad nas dga' bde 'char ba dgos/ /de ltar byung na stong nyid snying rje gnyis/ /'byongs pa yin kyang da dung zung 'brel byas/ /sbyangs 389

chen pos 'gro kun bu bzhin skyongs/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis po chos kun gye/ /snying po yin pa rgyal ba sras bcas gsungs/ /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas sangs rgyas rgyu/ /de gnyis yin pa sa ra ha pas gsungs/ /snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa rul zhes/ /o rgyan chen pos rje 'bangs rnams la gsungs/ /de phyir bka' gdams bla ma gong ma yis/ /stong nyid las kyang snying rje gal che gsungs/ /stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye'o zhes/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhal nas gsungs/ stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye ba gnyis/ /dus mnyam yin zhes dam pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /gang ltar na yang stong nyid snying rje gnyis/ /med thabs med pa'i chos shig yin par gsungs/ /de phyir chos pa bzang po zhig byed na/ /stong nyid snying rje thugs dam mthil du zungs/ /ma yis mthong sar bu chung me nang du/ /lhung ba mthong na snying rje skye ba ltar/ /mnyam gzhag sgang la sdug bsngal can mthong na/ /de la bcos min snying rje skye ba dgos/ /bu chung ngu sgang a ma slebs pa'i tshe/ /ngu 'phro chad nas dga' bde 'char ba ltar/ /snying rje sgang la mnyam gzhag slebs pa'i tshe/ /sems sdug chad nas dga' bde 'char ba dgos/ /de ltar byung na stong nyid snying rje gnyis/ /'byongs pa yin kyang da dung zung 'brel byas/ /sbyangs 389

na snyigs dus chos pa thams cad las/ /rab dang phul dang mchog tu 'gyur bar nges/ /stong nyid snying rje glu 'di thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces blangs pas 'phags pa'i thugs rjes kun la bcos ma ma yin pa'i snying rje skyes pa byung ngo //yang dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i mtsho snying ri khrod pa ngag dbang rin chen dpon slob gnyis kyis sku gsung thugs rten dang rta gnyis dngul srang sum cu rtsa lnga/ li yi gsol dem/ 'go snam gyi stod thung sogs nor sna mang po'i 'bul ba dang bcas zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyung lung ras pa sogs/ /chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /pha rjes bu yis zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad la/ /mngon zhen gting nas log pa'i zhabs dkar rje/ /mgon khyod gong ma rgyal po'i mnga' thang la/ /yid smon spu tsam med pa bden na yang / /bdag gzhan 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rje btsun khyed kyis rjes su 390

na snyigs dus chos pa thams cad las/ /rab dang phul dang mchog tu 'gyur bar nges/ /stong nyid snying rje glu 'di thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces blangs pas 'phags pa'i thugs rjes kun la bcos ma ma yin pa'i snying rje skyes pa byung ngo //yang dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i mtsho snying ri khrod pa ngag dbang rin chen dpon slob gnyis kyis sku gsung thugs rten dang rta gnyis dngul srang sum cu rtsa lnga/ li yi gsol dem/ 'go snam gyi stod thung sogs nor sna mang po'i 'bul ba dang bcas zhu don tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyung lung ras pa sogs/ /chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /pha rjes bu yis zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad la/ /mngon zhen gting nas log pa'i zhabs dkar rje/ /mgon khyod gong ma rgyal po'i mnga' thang la/ /yid smon spu tsam med pa bden na yang / /bdag gzhan 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rje btsun khyed kyis rjes su 390

gzung du gsol/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i shes rab dman pa la/ /go sla 'khyer bde'i gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /bstan pa bzhin du rang gis nyams su blangs/ /gzhan la phan thogs 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du ngas phan pa'i bslab bya tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs 'gro'i rtsa ba dad pa brtan par gyis/ /sems bskyed rtsa ba byams dang snying rje sgoms/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba bla mar mos gus gyes/ /dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam bsgyed rdzogs sgoms/ /'phrin las rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod/ /yon tan rtsa ba sdom gsum tshul bzhin srungs/ /nyams len rtsa ba byang chub sems gnyis sgoms/ /'dun ma'i rtsa ba ngage sdig blang dor gyes/ /mi chos rtsa ba kun dang mthun par gyis/ /lha chos rtsa ba gzhan phan gang che gyes/ /nyams len nus na ha cang mang mi dgos/ /de tsam gyis kyang rang gzhan don gnyis yong / /rjes 'jug slob ma rnams kyis sems la zungs/ /mthong thos dad can rnams la phan par shog /ces smras pa bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i mthus rjes su bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa'i chos pa bzang po gnyis byung ngo //391

gzung du gsol/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i shes rab dman pa la/ /go sla 'khyer bde'i gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /bstan pa bzhin du rang gis nyams su blangs/ /gzhan la phan thogs 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du ngas phan pa'i bslab bya tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs 'gro'i rtsa ba dad pa brtan par gyis/ /sems bskyed rtsa ba byams dang snying rje sgoms/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba bla mar mos gus gyes/ /dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam bsgyed rdzogs sgoms/ /'phrin las rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod/ /yon tan rtsa ba sdom gsum tshul bzhin srungs/ /nyams len rtsa ba byang chub sems gnyis sgoms/ /'dun ma'i rtsa ba ngage sdig blang dor gyes/ /mi chos rtsa ba kun dang mthun par gyis/ /lha chos rtsa ba gzhan phan gang che gyes/ /nyams len nus na ha cang mang mi dgos/ /de tsam gyis kyang rang gzhan don gnyis yong / /rjes 'jug slob ma rnams kyis sems la zungs/ /mthong thos dad can rnams la phan par shog /ces smras pa bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i mthus rjes su bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa'i chos pa bzang po gnyis byung ngo //391

yang tsha kho'i 'brog phyogs kyi chos la phyogs ris med pa'i bla ma bzang po gzhan phan 'od zer dang / dpal 'byor gnyis byon nas bdag la byang chub kyi sems gnyis la sogs pa'i sems la phan pa'i chos 'dra zhus/ nyams len 'dra byas nas phebs khar bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i zhal gdams bzang po zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ ngas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'o de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi bstan pa 'di la/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du nyan thos phal chen sde dang / yod smra sde dang / gnas brtan sde dang / mang pos bkur ba'i sde ste rtsa ba'i sde bzhi byung / phal chen sde las/ shar gyi sde dang / nub kyi sde dang / gangs ri'i sde dang / 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba'i sde dang / rtag par smra ba'i sde dang lnga gyes/ yod smra sde las/ gzhi kun pa'i sde dang / 'od srungs sde dang / sa srungs sde dang / chos srungs sde dang / mang thos sde dang / gos dmar slob ma'i sde dang / rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde ste bdun gyes/ gnas brtan sde las/ rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa'i sde dang / 'jigs byed gnas na gnas pa'i sde dang / gtsug lag khang chen na gnas pa'i sde ste gsum gyes/ mang bkur sde las/ sa sgrogs 392

yang tsha kho'i 'brog phyogs kyi chos la phyogs ris med pa'i bla ma bzang po gzhan phan 'od zer dang / dpal 'byor gnyis byon nas bdag la byang chub kyi sems gnyis la sogs pa'i sems la phan pa'i chos 'dra zhus/ nyams len 'dra byas nas phebs khar bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i zhal gdams bzang po zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ ngas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'o de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi bstan pa 'di la/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du nyan thos phal chen sde dang / yod smra sde dang / gnas brtan sde dang / mang pos bkur ba'i sde ste rtsa ba'i sde bzhi byung / phal chen sde las/ shar gyi sde dang / nub kyi sde dang / gangs ri'i sde dang / 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba'i sde dang / rtag par smra ba'i sde dang lnga gyes/ yod smra sde las/ gzhi kun pa'i sde dang / 'od srungs sde dang / sa srungs sde dang / chos srungs sde dang / mang thos sde dang / gos dmar slob ma'i sde dang / rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde ste bdun gyes/ gnas brtan sde las/ rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa'i sde dang / 'jigs byed gnas na gnas pa'i sde dang / gtsug lag khang chen na gnas pa'i sde ste gsum gyes/ mang bkur sde las/ sa sgrogs 392

ris kyi sde dang / srung ba'i sde dang / gnas ma'i bu yi sde ste gsum gyes pas nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad byung ba de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin te/ slob dpon dul ba lhas/shākya seng ge'i bstan pa ni/ /de ltar dbye ba bco brgyad du/ /gyur te 'gro ba'i bla ma de'i/ /sngon gyi 'phrin las nges pa yin/ /gsungs so/ /de'i rten 'brel gyes gangs can ljongs 'dir yang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba bco brgyad byung ste/ de la nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi lta bu la/ snga 'gyur rnying ma dang / bka' brgyud pa dang / bka' gdams pa dang / sa skya pa ste/ grub mtha' rkang tshugs pa bzhi byung / rnying ma la ring brgyud bka' ma dang / nye brgyud gter ma dang / zab mo dag snang gi skor te gsum gyes/bka' brgyud pa la garma pa dang / 'brug pa dang / 'bri khung pa dang / stag lung pa ste bzhi gyes/ bka' gdams pa la/ bka' gdams gzhung pa dang / man ngag pa ste gnyis gyes/ de las mched pa'i dge ldan pa la/ dge ldan gzhung pa dang / snyan brgyud pa gnyis gyes/dpal ldan sa skya pa las ngor ba gyes pas gnyis/ gzhan yang pha dam pa'i zhi byed dang / ma cig gi gcod dang / shangs pa bka' brgyud dang / jo nang dang bo dong pa ste/grub mtha' mi 'dra ba bco brgyad tsam zhig gyes pa 'di thams 393

ris kyi sde dang / srung ba'i sde dang / gnas ma'i bu yi sde ste gsum gyes pas nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad byung ba de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin te/ slob dpon dul ba lhas/shākya seng ge'i bstan pa ni/ /de ltar dbye ba bco brgyad du/ /gyur te 'gro ba'i bla ma de'i/ /sngon gyi 'phrin las nges pa yin/ /gsungs so/ /de'i rten 'brel gyes gangs can ljongs 'dir yang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba bco brgyad byung ste/ de la nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi lta bu la/ snga 'gyur rnying ma dang / bka' brgyud pa dang / bka' gdams pa dang / sa skya pa ste/ grub mtha' rkang tshugs pa bzhi byung / rnying ma la ring brgyud bka' ma dang / nye brgyud gter ma dang / zab mo dag snang gi skor te gsum gyes/bka' brgyud pa la garma pa dang / 'brug pa dang / 'bri khung pa dang / stag lung pa ste bzhi gyes/ bka' gdams pa la/ bka' gdams gzhung pa dang / man ngag pa ste gnyis gyes/ de las mched pa'i dge ldan pa la/ dge ldan gzhung pa dang / snyan brgyud pa gnyis gyes/dpal ldan sa skya pa las ngor ba gyes pas gnyis/ gzhan yang pha dam pa'i zhi byed dang / ma cig gi gcod dang / shangs pa bka' brgyud dang / jo nang dang bo dong pa ste/grub mtha' mi 'dra ba bco brgyad tsam zhig gyes pa 'di thams 393

cad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las mar me gcig las gnyis mched pas/ phan de'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che sgo sna tshogs nas phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par byung ba la/ log lta the tshom phrag dog 'gran sems sogs spu tsam yang mi byed par thams cad la dad gus dag snang sbyangs nas/ kun gyis mchod bstod bkur ba la brtson dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / sems can la bde skyid 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//gsar rnying chos la phyogs ris ma mchis pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' thams cad kyi/ /nye ring chags sdang zhi bar byen gyes rlobs/ /o rgyan pad+ma bod du ma byon na/ /bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad su yis 'dul/ /lha 'dre btul nas bstan pa ma btsugs na/ /bka' dang bstan bcos 'di rnams gang nas yong / /bka' gdams sa skya dge ldan ma byung na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhi ma su yis 'dzin/ /rnying ma bka' brgyud zhi byed gcod med na/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i khyad chos su yis 'don/ /sa paṇa dus su mda' 'phyar med gyur na/ /'phrog byed 394

cad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las mar me gcig las gnyis mched pas/ phan de'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che sgo sna tshogs nas phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par byung ba la/ log lta the tshom phrag dog 'gran sems sogs spu tsam yang mi byed par thams cad la dad gus dag snang sbyangs nas/ kun gyis mchod bstod bkur ba la brtson dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / sems can la bde skyid 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//gsar rnying chos la phyogs ris ma mchis pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' thams cad kyi/ /nye ring chags sdang zhi bar byen gyes rlobs/ /o rgyan pad+ma bod du ma byon na/ /bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad su yis 'dul/ /lha 'dre btul nas bstan pa ma btsugs na/ /bka' dang bstan bcos 'di rnams gang nas yong / /bka' gdams sa skya dge ldan ma byung na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhi ma su yis 'dzin/ /rnying ma bka' brgyud zhi byed gcod med na/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i khyad chos su yis 'don/ /sa paṇa dus su mda' 'phyar med gyur na/ /'phrog byed 394

dga' bor rdzu 'phrul su yis 'gran/ /chos lugs grub mtha' mang po ma dar na/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa su yis byed/ /sangs rgyas bstan las so sor gyes pa yi/ /rgya gar nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad dang / /bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' ma lus pa /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas na bzang / /chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra so so yis/ /rang rang phyogs kyi bstan pa bzung gyur na/ /ris med bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la bde skyid tshad med 'byung / /de phyir bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' rnams/ /phan tshun chags sdang rtsod pa ma byed par/ /rang rang phyogs kyi bstan pa zungs shig ces/ /tshogs drug rang grol thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gis legs par bshad pa'i gtam snyan 'di/ /chos lugs grub mtha' gang gis go na yang / /rgyud kyi grub mtha'i phyogs ris kun zhi nas/ /phyogs med dad gus dag snang 'char bar shog /ces blangs pas gnyis ga'i sems la phan po byung / yul du song nas gzhan la bstan pas kyang chos dang gang zag mang po la dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs pa byung ngo / /de'i lo'i zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la 'brog pa'i gnas mjal ba stong phrag mang po byung / de dag rnams la dbang lung mang po byas/ de rnams la khyed rnams 395

dga' bor rdzu 'phrul su yis 'gran/ /chos lugs grub mtha' mang po ma dar na/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa su yis byed/ /sangs rgyas bstan las so sor gyes pa yi/ /rgya gar nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad dang / /bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' ma lus pa /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas na bzang / /chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra so so yis/ /rang rang phyogs kyi bstan pa bzung gyur na/ /ris med bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la bde skyid tshad med 'byung / /de phyir bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' rnams/ /phan tshun chags sdang rtsod pa ma byed par/ /rang rang phyogs kyi bstan pa zungs shig ces/ /tshogs drug rang grol thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gis legs par bshad pa'i gtam snyan 'di/ /chos lugs grub mtha' gang gis go na yang / /rgyud kyi grub mtha'i phyogs ris kun zhi nas/ /phyogs med dad gus dag snang 'char bar shog /ces blangs pas gnyis ga'i sems la phan po byung / yul du song nas gzhan la bstan pas kyang chos dang gang zag mang po la dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs pa byung ngo / /de'i lo'i zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la 'brog pa'i gnas mjal ba stong phrag mang po byung / de dag rnams la dbang lung mang po byas/ de rnams la khyed rnams 395

kyis dbang yon du dmigs nas rdo re skyol la song byas pas/kun gyis rdo re blangs pas rjes nas sangs rgyas stag yan gnyis kyis brtsigs pa'i rdo'i mchod rten chen po zhig byung /'brog pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i yum/ ting 'phags bskal gsum sogs gser dngul las bris pa'i chos brgya lhag bskyal ba la gdong dar brgyab nas/ jo khang nang gi kun dga' ra bar bsgrigs/ lha bzo ye shes dar rgyas dang / gor sti'i gnyis kyis nga sdod sa'i mtshams khang nang du sku 'dra khru gang re yod pa bdun bzhengs/ jo bo'i lha khang gi rgya mthongs nang du rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i bla sku mang po bris/ sgu gsung thugs rten rnams 'grub pa dang / dge tshogs rnams bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par 'brel thogs rnams gnas skabs bde zhing /mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i phyir bsngo ba smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor byas/ lha bzo shing bzo rdo bzo las byed pa rnams la gsol ras rgya chen po byen thams cad dga' bar byas/ der bzhugs pa'i bla ma grwa pa mtshams pa rnams kyi chos kyi mthun rkyen du mdzo 'bri khal rta nyi shu lug brgya lhag bzhag thams cad kyis chos bzhin 'dul bzhin bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas/ yul phyogs thams cad la char chu dus su babs/396

kyis dbang yon du dmigs nas rdo re skyol la song byas pas/kun gyis rdo re blangs pas rjes nas sangs rgyas stag yan gnyis kyis brtsigs pa'i rdo'i mchod rten chen po zhig byung /'brog pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i yum/ ting 'phags bskal gsum sogs gser dngul las bris pa'i chos brgya lhag bskyal ba la gdong dar brgyab nas/ jo khang nang gi kun dga' ra bar bsgrigs/ lha bzo ye shes dar rgyas dang / gor sti'i gnyis kyis nga sdod sa'i mtshams khang nang du sku 'dra khru gang re yod pa bdun bzhengs/ jo bo'i lha khang gi rgya mthongs nang du rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i bla sku mang po bris/ sgu gsung thugs rten rnams 'grub pa dang / dge tshogs rnams bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par 'brel thogs rnams gnas skabs bde zhing /mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i phyir bsngo ba smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor byas/ lha bzo shing bzo rdo bzo las byed pa rnams la gsol ras rgya chen po byen thams cad dga' bar byas/ der bzhugs pa'i bla ma grwa pa mtshams pa rnams kyi chos kyi mthun rkyen du mdzo 'bri khal rta nyi shu lug brgya lhag bzhag thams cad kyis chos bzhin 'dul bzhin bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas/ yul phyogs thams cad la char chu dus su babs/396

lo phyugs rtag tu legs mi nad phyugs nad zhi/ dus 'khrug nad mug med/ rong 'brog thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos byed pa'i skal ba bzang po byung ngo / /yang de dus ska gsar klu 'bum spun gyi pha rgan gshegs pa'i don du bsngo zhus khyer yong ba'i 'byor lan du slar yang tshigs bcad 'di phul lo/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i lha rams pa/ /dad gtong blo gros che ba'i klu 'bum la/ /rab tu gus pas 'byor lan yi ge 'bul/ /khyed rang rnams la shin tu drin che ba'i/ /pha rgan sgyu lus me tog 'thor song ba/ /go tshe rnam shes sbrang ma 'dra ba la/ /phan pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag byas/ /khyed rang rnams kyis pha ma'i drin gzo ru/ /dmigs nas dbus gtsang gnyis pa bla brang dang / /rong bo'i dgon chen bkra shis 'khyil ba dang / /tshe tshes bzhi sogs dgon sde mtha' dag la/ /mchod sbyin rgya chen mdzad pa thos pa'i mod/ /rab tu dga' ba'i rjes su yi rang byung / /'di ru bsngo rten bskol ja lan chen gnyis/ /bskur pa 'phrod pas bka' drin shin tu che/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /tshe 'das 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal las/ /grol nas lha mi'i rten 397
