bzang legs brgyud nas/ /rim gyes sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par nges/ /rjes na yod pa'i tshe ldan thams cad kyis/ /chos ldan bya ba rnams la legs brtson dang / /tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang rigs rgyud sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa yong / /yig rten mi lo stong phrag thub pa yi/ /sgra mi snyan gyi 'chi med ring gzungs sgos/ /bsgrubs pa'i 'chi med tshe yi ril bu bcas/ /zla tshes bzang por phul ba dge legs 'phel/ /zhes phul ba 'byor bas mthong thos kyi sems dga' ba byung ngo / /yang dad can slob bu khams pa 'gyur med dang pad+ma bsam 'grub gnyis kyis sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ dbyings rig dbyer med gnas lugs skyongs dang sems kha yangs po yong / de la lus mi g.yo bar ro stong seng nge byas/ mig mi 'gul bar snang du ha re bya/ snang yul ma 'gags par gsal bar shar yang / 'dzin pas ma bslad par/ rig pa rgya bskyed dpangs bstod/ phyal yas su btang nas bzhag pas/ khar yangs khor yangs gu yangs zang thal du song nas dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong ste/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i zhal nas/ 'dzin pas ma bcings bzung ba'i yul las 'das/ /dmigs gtad chos med har sangs rgya 398

bzang legs brgyud nas/ /rim gyes sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par nges/ /rjes na yod pa'i tshe ldan thams cad kyis/ /chos ldan bya ba rnams la legs brtson dang / /tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang rigs rgyud sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa yong / /yig rten mi lo stong phrag thub pa yi/ /sgra mi snyan gyi 'chi med ring gzungs sgos/ /bsgrubs pa'i 'chi med tshe yi ril bu bcas/ /zla tshes bzang por phul ba dge legs 'phel/ /zhes phul ba 'byor bas mthong thos kyi sems dga' ba byung ngo / /yang dad can slob bu khams pa 'gyur med dang pad+ma bsam 'grub gnyis kyis sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ dbyings rig dbyer med gnas lugs skyongs dang sems kha yangs po yong / de la lus mi g.yo bar ro stong seng nge byas/ mig mi 'gul bar snang du ha re bya/ snang yul ma 'gags par gsal bar shar yang / 'dzin pas ma bslad par/ rig pa rgya bskyed dpangs bstod/ phyal yas su btang nas bzhag pas/ khar yangs khor yangs gu yangs zang thal du song nas dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong ste/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i zhal nas/ 'dzin pas ma bcings bzung ba'i yul las 'das/ /dmigs gtad chos med har sangs rgya 398

yan pa/ /ma yengs dran pa zad pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /mkha' ltar phyal yas bsgom dang mi bsgom med/ /'di ni kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong chen po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su/ /byeng rmugs gnyid gsum rnam rtog 'phro rgod gang byung yang / gnyen po gzhan gang yang mi bsten par sngar rgyun ltar mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la bzhag pas/ nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa bzhin song nas dbyengs rig dbyer med kyi gnas lugs rjen sangs kyis 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang yang yun ring mnyam par bzhag pas skabs shig mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du snang sems thams cad 'dres te/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul kyang thob par 'gyur ba'i bsgom pa la brtson par mdzod cig ces mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so/ /thugs dgongs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu las/ /las 'bras legs nyes sa ler mkhyen/ /mkhyen brtse mnga' bdag bla ma mchod/ /slob ma yang slob thams cad kyi/ /sems kha yangs par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos dbyengs klong de gu re yangs/ /gu yangs nyams dga'i glu dbyangs len/ /rang rig 'khor 'das chos rnams kyi/ /ngo bo 399

yan pa/ /ma yengs dran pa zad pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /mkha' ltar phyal yas bsgom dang mi bsgom med/ /'di ni kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong chen po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su/ /byeng rmugs gnyid gsum rnam rtog 'phro rgod gang byung yang / gnyen po gzhan gang yang mi bsten par sngar rgyun ltar mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la bzhag pas/ nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa bzhin song nas dbyengs rig dbyer med kyi gnas lugs rjen sangs kyis 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang yang yun ring mnyam par bzhag pas skabs shig mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du snang sems thams cad 'dres te/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul kyang thob par 'gyur ba'i bsgom pa la brtson par mdzod cig ces mgur dbyangs 'di yang blangs so/ /thugs dgongs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu las/ /las 'bras legs nyes sa ler mkhyen/ /mkhyen brtse mnga' bdag bla ma mchod/ /slob ma yang slob thams cad kyi/ /sems kha yangs par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos dbyengs klong de gu re yangs/ /gu yangs nyams dga'i glu dbyangs len/ /rang rig 'khor 'das chos rnams kyi/ /ngo bo 399

stong zhing spros dang bral/ /chos dbyengs nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /gnas lugs rtogs na nyams re dga'/ /'khor 'das chos rnams ci snang yang / /dper na sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong gnyis med ngo mtshar che/ /e ma skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /sdug btsir byas nas bsgom mi dgos/ /chos dbyengs khyab gdal chen po yi/ /ngang du shes pa glod la zhog /de ltar mnyam par 'jog nus na/ /sems kha dog po ma yangs par/ /chos dbyengs ngang du dga' yal ler/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po yong / /nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad po/ /chos kyi dbyings su 'tshang rgya shog /ces smras pas gnyis ga'i sems la phan po byung ngo / /yang nyin cig dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i mang ra'i lha bzo ye shes kyis don dam byang chub sems kyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes lha rdzas dri med bcas zhu don tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/dbyengs rnam dag spros bral ngang nyid las/ /sku cir yang 'char ba'i nyin byed gzis/ /zhing kun khyab rgyal ba'i mdzad pa can/ /rje zla med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dus da nas byang 400

stong zhing spros dang bral/ /chos dbyengs nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /gnas lugs rtogs na nyams re dga'/ /'khor 'das chos rnams ci snang yang / /dper na sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong gnyis med ngo mtshar che/ /e ma skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /sdug btsir byas nas bsgom mi dgos/ /chos dbyengs khyab gdal chen po yi/ /ngang du shes pa glod la zhog /de ltar mnyam par 'jog nus na/ /sems kha dog po ma yangs par/ /chos dbyengs ngang du dga' yal ler/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po yong / /nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad po/ /chos kyi dbyings su 'tshang rgya shog /ces smras pas gnyis ga'i sems la phan po byung ngo / /yang nyin cig dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i mang ra'i lha bzo ye shes kyis don dam byang chub sems kyi zhal gdams shig dgos zhes lha rdzas dri med bcas zhu don tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su phul ba/dbyengs rnam dag spros bral ngang nyid las/ /sku cir yang 'char ba'i nyin byed gzis/ /zhing kun khyab rgyal ba'i mdzad pa can/ /rje zla med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dus da nas byang 400

chub ma thob bar/ /blo gtad sa'i skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bas/ /thugs brtse bas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ /sems chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' mdo rgyud dri med thams cad las/ /mgon theg mchog bshes dang mjal dka' zhing / /des dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ /dpe u dum wa rar 'dra gsungs na/ /dus da lta rang cag las 'phro ldan/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal/ /chos zab rgyas gdams pa mang du thos/ /'di bsam na skal ba shin tu bzang / /da de phyir dus rnams thams cad du/ /blo bla mar bkal nas gsol 'debs dang / /phyag mchod 'bul ci nus byed bzhin nas/ /las dkar po'i bag chags 'debs par mchis/ /slar khyed la gsol 'debs snying po ni/ /sngar mgur dbyangs legs bshad sna tshogs pa/ /bdag rjes 'jug yongs la stsal lags kyang / /dus da re phran gyi bgo skal du/ /rje khyed kyis thugs nyams la bzhes pa'i/ /mgur snyan la ring ba'i nges don mgur/ /lam lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad tshang zhing / /khong dgongs brgyud kyi byin rlabs 'thibs se ba/ /ma mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes byed cing / /mi skal ldan su yis thos na yang / /dpe long ba'i mig ni phye ba ltar/ /sems gsal stong rjen par 'char nus pa'i/ /401

chub ma thob bar/ /blo gtad sa'i skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bas/ /thugs brtse bas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ /sems chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' mdo rgyud dri med thams cad las/ /mgon theg mchog bshes dang mjal dka' zhing / /des dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ /dpe u dum wa rar 'dra gsungs na/ /dus da lta rang cag las 'phro ldan/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal/ /chos zab rgyas gdams pa mang du thos/ /'di bsam na skal ba shin tu bzang / /da de phyir dus rnams thams cad du/ /blo bla mar bkal nas gsol 'debs dang / /phyag mchod 'bul ci nus byed bzhin nas/ /las dkar po'i bag chags 'debs par mchis/ /slar khyed la gsol 'debs snying po ni/ /sngar mgur dbyangs legs bshad sna tshogs pa/ /bdag rjes 'jug yongs la stsal lags kyang / /dus da re phran gyi bgo skal du/ /rje khyed kyis thugs nyams la bzhes pa'i/ /mgur snyan la ring ba'i nges don mgur/ /lam lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad tshang zhing / /khong dgongs brgyud kyi byin rlabs 'thibs se ba/ /ma mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes byed cing / /mi skal ldan su yis thos na yang / /dpe long ba'i mig ni phye ba ltar/ /sems gsal stong rjen par 'char nus pa'i/ /401

gsung dri med bdag sogs gus ldan 'gar/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs pa mi chung bar/ /'bangs spyi bor stsol zhig bla ma mkhyen/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs gdod nas stong ba gsal ba dwangs pa yangs pa che ba bde ba 'jam pa brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa/ 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba nam yang 'gyur ba med pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par gyis la skyongs zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//thugs mkha' las yangs pa'i 'jam dbyangs dang / /dbyer ma mchis chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i sems kyi dbyings/ /dus myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems gnas lugs ma gtogs 'khor bar 'khyams/ /'di rtogs na myur du sangs rgyas thob/ /don de phyir skal ldan snying gi bu/ /khyod nges don zhu ba skal ba bzang / /spyir 'khor 'das chos rnams 'ja' sprin bzhin/ /nang rang gi sems nyid gcig pus 'phrul/ /sems de yang brtag na skye 'gags bral/ /dpe stong gsal spros bral nam mkha' 'dra/ /de'i ngang la rang babs mnyam zhog dang / /bde gsal dang mi rtog stong seng 402

gsung dri med bdag sogs gus ldan 'gar/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs pa mi chung bar/ /'bangs spyi bor stsol zhig bla ma mkhyen/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du ngas 'di skad ces smras/ 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs gdod nas stong ba gsal ba dwangs pa yangs pa che ba bde ba 'jam pa brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa/ 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba nam yang 'gyur ba med pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par gyis la skyongs zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//thugs mkha' las yangs pa'i 'jam dbyangs dang / /dbyer ma mchis chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i sems kyi dbyings/ /dus myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems gnas lugs ma gtogs 'khor bar 'khyams/ /'di rtogs na myur du sangs rgyas thob/ /don de phyir skal ldan snying gi bu/ /khyod nges don zhu ba skal ba bzang / /spyir 'khor 'das chos rnams 'ja' sprin bzhin/ /nang rang gi sems nyid gcig pus 'phrul/ /sems de yang brtag na skye 'gags bral/ /dpe stong gsal spros bral nam mkha' 'dra/ /de'i ngang la rang babs mnyam zhog dang / /bde gsal dang mi rtog stong seng 402

nge / /de ma yengs skyongs dang g.yeng ba 'bral/ /dgra bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rang sar sangs/ /byams snying rje nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas/ /tshe 'dir yang bstan 'gro yongs la phan/ /mthar 'chi ba chos skur grol bar 'gyur/ /chos gcig chog rgyal po 'di ka lags/ /dpal sa ra ha dang a ti sha /rje mar pa mi la yab sras sogs/ /khong mkhas grub gong ma'i thugs dam mthil/ /'di yin pas ma brjed sems la zungs/ /chu ma rnyog bzhag na dwangs pa bzhin/ /sems ma bcos bzhag na bde bar shog /sems chos nyid ngang du dga' yal ler/ /dus rgyun du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dbyangs su blangs pas kho rang gi sems la phan thogs pa byung ngo / /yang slob ma 'ga' res/ a lags wa mang tshang gis/ ban min bon min pad+ma bsngags/ /sha skal thud skal kun lon kyang / /pho min mo min ma ning bzhin/ /ban khyu bon khyur mi chud pas/ /ci bder snoms la gats+tsha mu/ /zhes dgag pa btang 'dug zer/ ngas de dgag pa ma red ku re gsungs pa red/ de'i lan du ngas kyang khong la ku re zhig 'bul zhes 'di skad ces smras/ ban min bon min pad 'byung sras/ /sha min thud min sbrang dkar za/ /bya min byi min khyung chen bzhin/ /ban khyu bon khyur mi 'dres par/ /rig 'dzin 403

nge / /de ma yengs skyongs dang g.yeng ba 'bral/ /dgra bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rang sar sangs/ /byams snying rje nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas/ /tshe 'dir yang bstan 'gro yongs la phan/ /mthar 'chi ba chos skur grol bar 'gyur/ /chos gcig chog rgyal po 'di ka lags/ /dpal sa ra ha dang a ti sha /rje mar pa mi la yab sras sogs/ /khong mkhas grub gong ma'i thugs dam mthil/ /'di yin pas ma brjed sems la zungs/ /chu ma rnyog bzhag na dwangs pa bzhin/ /sems ma bcos bzhag na bde bar shog /sems chos nyid ngang du dga' yal ler/ /dus rgyun du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dbyangs su blangs pas kho rang gi sems la phan thogs pa byung ngo / /yang slob ma 'ga' res/ a lags wa mang tshang gis/ ban min bon min pad+ma bsngags/ /sha skal thud skal kun lon kyang / /pho min mo min ma ning bzhin/ /ban khyu bon khyur mi chud pas/ /ci bder snoms la gats+tsha mu/ /zhes dgag pa btang 'dug zer/ ngas de dgag pa ma red ku re gsungs pa red/ de'i lan du ngas kyang khong la ku re zhig 'bul zhes 'di skad ces smras/ ban min bon min pad 'byung sras/ /sha min thud min sbrang dkar za/ /bya min byi min khyung chen bzhin/ /ban khyu bon khyur mi 'dres par/ /rig 'dzin 403

'dus pa'i gral du 'gro/ /byas pas/ slob bu rig grol na re/a lags wa mang tshang gi gsung 'di'i bab la bltas na/ phyis su ban bon gnyis ka nang gshin po yod pa'i tshod red ha ha ha he he yi zhes dgod par gda'/ yang dad brtson shes rab snying rje che ba'i dgu rong sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol/ bla ma gaḥ thog pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs slob ma bu chen mang pos tshe blos btang nas/ reb gong grub gnas rnams su song nas gnas 'brel bzhag de nas rim pas a chung gnam rdzong da nga / mtsho snying /ri bo rtse lnga/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing la sogs pa'i ri khrod dben par 'gro dus/ kun gyi sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//dang po bla ma'i drung nas thos bsam byas/ /bar du ri khrod dben par sgom sgrub byas/ /tha ma bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan byas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bya ba tshar nas gda'/ /da ni na so rgas pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas su/ /rig pa chos dbyings ngang du ngal gsos nas/ /sos dal bde bar sdod pa'i dus la bab ngo mtshar rig pa'i khye'u chung mig yangs po/ /chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nyams dga' ru/ /'khod nas mdo sngags chos kyi glu 404

'dus pa'i gral du 'gro/ /byas pas/ slob bu rig grol na re/a lags wa mang tshang gi gsung 'di'i bab la bltas na/ phyis su ban bon gnyis ka nang gshin po yod pa'i tshod red ha ha ha he he yi zhes dgod par gda'/ yang dad brtson shes rab snying rje che ba'i dgu rong sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol/ bla ma gaḥ thog pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs slob ma bu chen mang pos tshe blos btang nas/ reb gong grub gnas rnams su song nas gnas 'brel bzhag de nas rim pas a chung gnam rdzong da nga / mtsho snying /ri bo rtse lnga/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing la sogs pa'i ri khrod dben par 'gro dus/ kun gyi sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//dang po bla ma'i drung nas thos bsam byas/ /bar du ri khrod dben par sgom sgrub byas/ /tha ma bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan byas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bya ba tshar nas gda'/ /da ni na so rgas pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas su/ /rig pa chos dbyings ngang du ngal gsos nas/ /sos dal bde bar sdod pa'i dus la bab ngo mtshar rig pa'i khye'u chung mig yangs po/ /chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nyams dga' ru/ /'khod nas mdo sngags chos kyi glu 404

dbyangs blangs/ /'gro kun kha lo chos la bsgyur bar smon/ /bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar bdag gis bskyangs/ /bdag gi rnam thar slob ma rnams kyis skyongs/ /bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char bar nges/ /skal ldan slob ma rnams kyi yid la zungs/ /zhes blangs pa'i mthar der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis bskyal nas/ gyes khar phan tshun brtse gdung gi dbang gis 'bral ma phod par gcig gcig la 'chang nas mig nas mchi ma mang po gtor bzhin so sor gyes so//de'i ston kha snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom sku gzhogs rdzogs chen pa chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje rin po che gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir zhing khams gzhan du gshegs song bas/ de ru song nas thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir/ khong tshang gi slob ma mang po dang bcas te zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas/ khong dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad par bskyed nas mchod bstod bdag 'jug blangs/ sprul sku myur 'byon bton/ thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo ba smon lam yang byas/ sras gnyis dang phyag rgya ma sogs slob ma zhabs phyi rnams la sems gso dang / gdung mchod byed tshul gye bkod pa 405

btang nas 'gro bar 'bul ba la/ sku gsung thugs rten/ bcib rta sga stan srab gsum/ ban rta ban phying ban thag na bza' cha tshang / rta dre'u mdzo mdzo mo bdun/ lug brgya la sogs pa'i dngul rdo tshad lnga'i rtsis phul ba la/ ngas de ltar phul ba'i dge tshogs rnams bstan 'gro yongs la phan zhing khyad par du grub dbang rin po che'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi thugs kyi bzhed don mtha' dag gegs med bde blag tu 'grub pa'i bsngo smon rgya chen po byas/ dngos po phul ba de dag mar khyer nas 'ong / lo gcig tshun la chos phyogs su btang nas/ thams cad sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ de nas rdzong dkar rdzong sngon/ bde chen gyi dgon par song / bla ma rnams la mjal rten phul skyabs 'jug zhus/ dgon pa gsum la mang ja btang /rta mdzo kha shas spyi 'jog bzhag dgon pa'i bla ma rnams dang dge 'dun dad can rnams kyi nang du bos nas ja drangs/chos 'brel zhus dā dmar la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po byung /rdzong dkar shod du khe ris snying dkar dang de'i ru skor gyi yon bdag pho mo dad can mang po mjal du byung / mjal rten la gos chen rgyan bzhi gcig 'go snam gnyis/ rkyal mar gcigaphyur ba do bo gcig dā bu dkar dmar ras dang kha btags 406

btang nas 'gro bar 'bul ba la/ sku gsung thugs rten/ bcib rta sga stan srab gsum/ ban rta ban phying ban thag na bza' cha tshang / rta dre'u mdzo mdzo mo bdun/ lug brgya la sogs pa'i dngul rdo tshad lnga'i rtsis phul ba la/ ngas de ltar phul ba'i dge tshogs rnams bstan 'gro yongs la phan zhing khyad par du grub dbang rin po che'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi thugs kyi bzhed don mtha' dag gegs med bde blag tu 'grub pa'i bsngo smon rgya chen po byas/ dngos po phul ba de dag mar khyer nas 'ong / lo gcig tshun la chos phyogs su btang nas/ thams cad sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ de nas rdzong dkar rdzong sngon/ bde chen gyi dgon par song / bla ma rnams la mjal rten phul skyabs 'jug zhus/ dgon pa gsum la mang ja btang /rta mdzo kha shas spyi 'jog bzhag dgon pa'i bla ma rnams dang dge 'dun dad can rnams kyi nang du bos nas ja drangs/chos 'brel zhus dā dmar la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po byung /rdzong dkar shod du khe ris snying dkar dang de'i ru skor gyi yon bdag pho mo dad can mang po mjal du byung / mjal rten la gos chen rgyan bzhi gcig 'go snam gnyis/ rkyal mar gcigaphyur ba do bo gcig dā bu dkar dmar ras dang kha btags 406

mjal dar mang po phul ba la/ thun mong gi chos bshad/ chos kyi snying po ma ṇi yi ge drug ma'i lung dang / ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'pho lung byas/ bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya chen po btab pas/ yon bdag pho mo rnams rab tu dga' nas da re skal ba bzang po byung / da dung yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam thob zer thams cad kyis phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar dus mnyam du 'tshal/skor ba mang po byas rang gnas su song / nga yang 'dam bu brag dkar grub gnas su 'ongs nas ngal gsos bsdad yod dus/gnas skor ba zhig gi kha nas mi snyan pa'i gtam/ bstan pa'i srog shing 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon sbas pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'brel tshad don ldan mtshan brjod par dka' ba gser khang rdo rje 'chang de nyid dbus nas zhing gshegs song zer ba rna bas go ba dang / yid tsho cang ma 'ong bar ha las par gyur/ a ho ho bya 'di btsog ang las 'di'i ngan na/ mar cig phebs nas mjal rgyu zhig kyang ma byung snyam sku'i dbyebs gsung gi gdangs rnams yid la wal ler shar ba dang mig nas mchi ma mang po shor/ de nas thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams/ yan lag bdun pa phul dge tshogs rnams thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo ba smon lam 407

mjal dar mang po phul ba la/ thun mong gi chos bshad/ chos kyi snying po ma ṇi yi ge drug ma'i lung dang / ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'pho lung byas/ bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya chen po btab pas/ yon bdag pho mo rnams rab tu dga' nas da re skal ba bzang po byung / da dung yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam thob zer thams cad kyis phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar dus mnyam du 'tshal/skor ba mang po byas rang gnas su song / nga yang 'dam bu brag dkar grub gnas su 'ongs nas ngal gsos bsdad yod dus/gnas skor ba zhig gi kha nas mi snyan pa'i gtam/ bstan pa'i srog shing 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon sbas pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'brel tshad don ldan mtshan brjod par dka' ba gser khang rdo rje 'chang de nyid dbus nas zhing gshegs song zer ba rna bas go ba dang / yid tsho cang ma 'ong bar ha las par gyur/ a ho ho bya 'di btsog ang las 'di'i ngan na/ mar cig phebs nas mjal rgyu zhig kyang ma byung snyam sku'i dbyebs gsung gi gdangs rnams yid la wal ler shar ba dang mig nas mchi ma mang po shor/ de nas thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams/ yan lag bdun pa phul dge tshogs rnams thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo ba smon lam 407

btab sprul sku myur 'byon bton/ de nas sems la da ni bla ma rnams kyang gshegs song / rang yang nam zhig la shi 'gro ci shes snyam sems skyo ba'i shugs kyis skyo mgur mang po blangs nas ngus pas/ der 'tshogs pa'i slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis kyang mchi ma gtong mkhan mang po byung / de nas go'u sde'i dgon par yong mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i a lags zhi ba 'tsho sku snying ba la bka' bsgo byin rlabs 'dra byas/ zhag bdun tsam la byang sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub byas/ lus kyi dbus su lcags kyi srog rtsa bsgoms nas tshe dbang brgya rtsa brgyad byas pas tshe gegs las grol nas sku tshe ring bo byung / khong thugs mnyes pa'i sgo nas rta bzang po/ snam bu dkar po shel gye ga'u sogs nor rdzas mang po phul ba'i nang nas snam bu dkar po de blangs/gzhan rnams bzhag nas 'o khyed sku bde ba de 'bul ba'i gtso bo lags/ da phyin chad yab chen dam pa'i mdo sngags legs bshad kyi po ti 'di rnams par du cig 'phul thub ltos zhes bshad/ yang mar go'u sde ru song / dad gtong blo gros che ba'i skal ldan slob bu ngag dbang bkra shis kyis snga phyi rim can byas/ja lan chen gnyis dang / rkyal mar gnyis/ gro nas sgro ba bco lnga/ha sag gi stod thung lha rdzas bcas phul nas zhal gdams nyung 408

la 'dus pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor bdag gis 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yang gang zag las ldan cig gnas skabs kun tu bde zhing / mthar thug gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag nyid du 'thob phyir mtshan ldan gyi bla ma zhig gi gsung skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas/ tshe 'di nyid la ma chags ma zhen par ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ rang nyid yi dam lha ru gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsgoms/gsol ba btab dbang bzhi blangs/ thugs yid bsres/ de nas chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag rjes su sgyu ma rmi lam ltar tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong bya/ mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor byas na/'chi kha'am bar do'am ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba de la sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs pa/e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod na/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog 409

skyed/ /rang nyid lhar gsal spyi bo ru/ /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu sgoms/ /gsol ba thob la dbang bzhi longs/ /'od zhu thugs yid gcig tu bsres/ /chos kun rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la rtse gcig mnyam par zhog /rjes su tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gyis/ /mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam thob/ /de ltar byas na gnas skabs bde/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas kho dga' zhing spro bzhin nyams su blangs pas 'chi khar lam sna zin par gyur to/ /yang dad can sngag 'chang blo bzang tshe ring gis/ khong mdo smad 'dir phebs nas grub rtags shig ma bstan pa ma gtogs/ gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po byung bas bka' drin che zer ba'i lan du ngas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /spyir tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad dang / /sgos sha chang bud med 'dod yon la/ /sems mngon zhen gting nas log pa 'di/ /ngas nges 'byung bsgoms pa'i grub rtags yin/ /ma nyam thag sems can snying rje nas/ /dus rgyun du lto gos chos gsum gyis/ /sems skyo ngal med par skyong ba 'di/ /ngas byang sems bsgoms pa'i grub rtags yin/ /chos thams cad snang stong sgyu 410

skyed/ /rang nyid lhar gsal spyi bo ru/ /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu sgoms/ /gsol ba thob la dbang bzhi longs/ /'od zhu thugs yid gcig tu bsres/ /chos kun rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la rtse gcig mnyam par zhog /rjes su tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gyis/ /mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam thob/ /de ltar byas na gnas skabs bde/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas kho dga' zhing spro bzhin nyams su blangs pas 'chi khar lam sna zin par gyur to/ /yang dad can sngag 'chang blo bzang tshe ring gis/ khong mdo smad 'dir phebs nas grub rtags shig ma bstan pa ma gtogs/ gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po byung bas bka' drin che zer ba'i lan du ngas mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /spyir tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad dang / /sgos sha chang bud med 'dod yon la/ /sems mngon zhen gting nas log pa 'di/ /ngas nges 'byung bsgoms pa'i grub rtags yin/ /ma nyam thag sems can snying rje nas/ /dus rgyun du lto gos chos gsum gyis/ /sems skyo ngal med par skyong ba 'di/ /ngas byang sems bsgoms pa'i grub rtags yin/ /chos thams cad snang stong sgyu 410

mar shar/ /nang bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rang sar zhig /dgra gnyen la khyad par med pa 'di/ /ngas lta ba bsgoms pa'i grub rtags yin/ /phyi tha mal snang zhen kun dag nas/ /rang gang snang lha yi 'khor lor shar/ /nang 'od gsal rgyun 'chad med pa 'di/ /ngas rim gnyis bsgoms pa'i grub rtags yin/ /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir/ /chos mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag gi /gnad snyan pa'i glu ru len pa 'di/ /ngas chos rnams bsgoms pa'i grub rtags yin/ /de lta bu'i grub rtags bstan pa'i mod/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs byung / /don de phyir dad ldan sngags 'chang lags/ /khyod grub rtags 'dod na de la gyis/ /zhes blangs pas/ kho na re/ de khyed thugs bden par gda'/ deng sang 'ga' res lcags mdud/rdo gcur mngon shes tsho bshad ni 'dug ste/ bstan 'gro la mi phan pa'i khar/ log lta can 'ga' res sgo 'dogs sgur 'debs byed mkhan yang snang / da bsams na deng sang snyigs dus 'dir khyed tshang gi mdzad pa 'di ngo mtshar che zer dad gus dag snang cher song ngo / /yang reb gong gyod kha mchu byed mkhan rnams la kha ta 'di ltar byas/ 'o khyed rnams kyis nyan rgyu de la/ yul gyi bkra mi shis pa gsum ni/ nad yams dang / mu ge/411

'thab rtsod gsum yin/ 'thab rtsod byas phyin chad gyod pa phan tshun su yin yang / zhing las 'tsho skyong / khe tshong sogs so nam grong rgya rem po rnams shor yong bas de'i zhor la mu ge zhig shugs kyis yong / nyin re bzhin dmag la song / phan tshun 'thab/ nyin par so byas/ mtshan mo thun byed dgos/ de byas na tsha grang mi snyoms par na tsha yang yong / de rnams yong na phan tshun gnyis ka mi zad rgyu zad yong / lo re bzhin kha thur du 'gro nges/ des na 'jig rten pa rnams kyis kyang / gyod ma byas blo kha tsher las rtsub/ gyod byas na blo phugs chu las grang / gyod 'di nyal sngas kyi rdo dang / nyal phug gi chu yin/ gyod yul ngan gnyis ka zhe nag gyod kyi rnga ma na 'gyod yod/ gyod ya mi skyid/gyod ya mi sdug mi yis mi 'dod ni bo gyod yin/ phyugs kyis mi 'dod ni bo god yin/ gnyan po dmo sa med na skyid/ btsan po 'thab sa med na skyid/ ces gtam dpe mang po tsho soms dang /bsam shes tsho zhes bshad nas/ slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gyod kha mchu 'grigs par byen gyis rlobs/ /gyod ma byas blo kha tsher las rtsub/ /gyod byas na blo phugs chu las grang / /gyod nyal sngas rdo 412

'thab rtsod gsum yin/ 'thab rtsod byas phyin chad gyod pa phan tshun su yin yang / zhing las 'tsho skyong / khe tshong sogs so nam grong rgya rem po rnams shor yong bas de'i zhor la mu ge zhig shugs kyis yong / nyin re bzhin dmag la song / phan tshun 'thab/ nyin par so byas/ mtshan mo thun byed dgos/ de byas na tsha grang mi snyoms par na tsha yang yong / de rnams yong na phan tshun gnyis ka mi zad rgyu zad yong / lo re bzhin kha thur du 'gro nges/ des na 'jig rten pa rnams kyis kyang / gyod ma byas blo kha tsher las rtsub/ gyod byas na blo phugs chu las grang / gyod 'di nyal sngas kyi rdo dang / nyal phug gi chu yin/ gyod yul ngan gnyis ka zhe nag gyod kyi rnga ma na 'gyod yod/ gyod ya mi skyid/gyod ya mi sdug mi yis mi 'dod ni bo gyod yin/ phyugs kyis mi 'dod ni bo god yin/ gnyan po dmo sa med na skyid/ btsan po 'thab sa med na skyid/ ces gtam dpe mang po tsho soms dang /bsam shes tsho zhes bshad nas/ slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gyod kha mchu 'grigs par byen gyis rlobs/ /gyod ma byas blo kha tsher las rtsub/ /gyod byas na blo phugs chu las grang / /gyod nyal sngas rdo 412

dang nyal phug chu/ /gyod yul ngan gnyis ka zhe re nag /gyod byas pas mi phung bdag brlag yong / /gyod byas pas mi zad rgyu zad 'ong / /gyod byas pas na tsha god kha 'ong / /gyod byas pas phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro/ /gyod byas pas 'di sdug phyi sdug 'ong / /gyod med pa'i sa de'i skyid la med/ /gyod nam yang mi byed smon lam thob/ /gyod ma byed skya ser pho mo tsho/ /gyod grod pu gnyis kyi kha yi zungs/ /gyod kha mchu khrag dang rnag bzhin 'dzem/ /gyod bshad mkhan gzu ba'i kha la nyon/ /gyod ma rabs 'dun ma bcad na bzang / /gtam 'di nyid thos tshad yul phyogs kyi/ /gyod kha mchu thams cad 'grig par shog /ces blangs pas reb gong gi gyod kha mchu byed mkhan rnams la phan thogs pa byung / yang gnas chen mkhar gong du 'ong dad brtson shes rab snying rje sogs slob ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bya bral ri khrod pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos/ nged dpon slob mang po la zhag bdun gyi 'tsho ba phul nas kho bo la bdag 'dzin nyon mongs pa thams cad gcig char du 'joms pa'i tho ba lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po'i gnad kyi gdams pa zab mo zhig dgos zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/gru 'dzin spo na legs bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyal kun snying rje 413

dang nyal phug chu/ /gyod yul ngan gnyis ka zhe re nag /gyod byas pas mi phung bdag brlag yong / /gyod byas pas mi zad rgyu zad 'ong / /gyod byas pas na tsha god kha 'ong / /gyod byas pas phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro/ /gyod byas pas 'di sdug phyi sdug 'ong / /gyod med pa'i sa de'i skyid la med/ /gyod nam yang mi byed smon lam thob/ /gyod ma byed skya ser pho mo tsho/ /gyod grod pu gnyis kyi kha yi zungs/ /gyod kha mchu khrag dang rnag bzhin 'dzem/ /gyod bshad mkhan gzu ba'i kha la nyon/ /gyod ma rabs 'dun ma bcad na bzang / /gtam 'di nyid thos tshad yul phyogs kyi/ /gyod kha mchu thams cad 'grig par shog /ces blangs pas reb gong gi gyod kha mchu byed mkhan rnams la phan thogs pa byung / yang gnas chen mkhar gong du 'ong dad brtson shes rab snying rje sogs slob ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bya bral ri khrod pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos/ nged dpon slob mang po la zhag bdun gyi 'tsho ba phul nas kho bo la bdag 'dzin nyon mongs pa thams cad gcig char du 'joms pa'i tho ba lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po'i gnad kyi gdams pa zab mo zhig dgos zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/gru 'dzin spo na legs bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyal kun snying rje 413

rang gzugs lha/ /ngur sprig gar gyi rnam rol ba/ /skyabs mgon mchog la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /thog ma med nas bsags pa yi/ /nyams chag sdig ltung mthol lo bshags/ /mgon khyod gsang gsum mdzad pa la/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes yi rang / /'gro la gang 'tsham chos 'khor ni/ /rgyun chad med par bskor bar bskul/ /mgon khyod gdul bya'i dpal mgon du/ /bskal brgya'i bar du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs rnams/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /slar yang khyod zhal pad+mo la/ /btud de gsol ba 'debs pa'i don/ /bdag la brtse ba chen po'i sgos/ /nges don gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'du 'bral med pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yang skyes bu rtsal stobs che ba mang pos nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol ba'i phyir/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs las 'das par/ phyogs gang du song nas btsal kyang nam mkha'i mtha' mi rnyed pa ltar/ rang gzhan gye sems dang / bla ma sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang / snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs 414

rang gzugs lha/ /ngur sprig gar gyi rnam rol ba/ /skyabs mgon mchog la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /thog ma med nas bsags pa yi/ /nyams chag sdig ltung mthol lo bshags/ /mgon khyod gsang gsum mdzad pa la/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes yi rang / /'gro la gang 'tsham chos 'khor ni/ /rgyun chad med par bskor bar bskul/ /mgon khyod gdul bya'i dpal mgon du/ /bskal brgya'i bar du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs rnams/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo/ /slar yang khyod zhal pad+mo la/ /btud de gsol ba 'debs pa'i don/ /bdag la brtse ba chen po'i sgos/ /nges don gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'du 'bral med pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/ 'di skad ces smras/ 'o de yang skyes bu rtsal stobs che ba mang pos nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol ba'i phyir/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs las 'das par/ phyogs gang du song nas btsal kyang nam mkha'i mtha' mi rnyed pa ltar/ rang gzhan gye sems dang / bla ma sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang / snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs 414

stong gsal chos kyi dbyengs mtha' yas mu med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam la/ de lta bu'i chos kyi dbyengs nam mkha' lta bu'i klong na nam mkha' la nyi zla gza' skar bkra ba ltar/ dag dang ma dag pa'i zhing dang / sangs rgyas sems can rnams mtha' yas mu med par gnas pa'i tshul shes nas/ chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu'i klong du mnyam par bzhag na/ skabs shig 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo sna tshogs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes chos dbyings gzigs mo'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so//dbyings rig dbyer med chos kyi sku/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /'ja' tshon bzhin du gzugs sku 'byung / /'gro don mdzad pa rnams la 'dud/ /chos kun gnas lugs chos kyi dbyengs/ /mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bur gnas/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig nyid/ /stong gsal kun la khyab par gda'/ /dbyengs rig dbyer med klong yangs na/ /chos rnams bar snang 'ja' ltar snang / /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong ma 'dres so sor snang / /nam mkhas gar khyab rig pas khyab/ /rig pas gar khyab chos skus khyab/ /chos skus gar khyab longs skus khyab/ /longs skus gar khyab sprul skus khyab/ /sku yis gar khyab gsung gis khyab/ /gsung gis gar khyab thugs kyis 415

stong gsal chos kyi dbyengs mtha' yas mu med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam la/ de lta bu'i chos kyi dbyengs nam mkha' lta bu'i klong na nam mkha' la nyi zla gza' skar bkra ba ltar/ dag dang ma dag pa'i zhing dang / sangs rgyas sems can rnams mtha' yas mu med par gnas pa'i tshul shes nas/ chos dbyings nam mkha' lta bu'i klong du mnyam par bzhag na/ skabs shig 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo sna tshogs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes chos dbyings gzigs mo'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs so//dbyings rig dbyer med chos kyi sku/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /'ja' tshon bzhin du gzugs sku 'byung / /'gro don mdzad pa rnams la 'dud/ /chos kun gnas lugs chos kyi dbyengs/ /mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bur gnas/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig nyid/ /stong gsal kun la khyab par gda'/ /dbyengs rig dbyer med klong yangs na/ /chos rnams bar snang 'ja' ltar snang / /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong ma 'dres so sor snang / /nam mkhas gar khyab rig pas khyab/ /rig pas gar khyab chos skus khyab/ /chos skus gar khyab longs skus khyab/ /longs skus gar khyab sprul skus khyab/ /sku yis gar khyab gsung gis khyab/ /gsung gis gar khyab thugs kyis 415

khyab/ /thugs kyis gar khyab thams cad la/ /mar gyur 'gro ba yongs kyis khyab/ /khyab gdal nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /chos dbyengs ngang la mnyam par zhog /yun ring mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /mkha' ltar yangs shing nyi ltar gsal/ /shel ltar dwangs shing mi g.yo ba/ /ri ltar brtan pa'i dus tsa na/ /mnyam gzhag ngang nas 'khor 'das kyi/ /ltad mo thams cad mthong ba yin/ /ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad po/ /chos kyi dbyings su 'tshang rgya shog /ces blangs/ de nas mar rong bo'i dgon par 'ong zhag mang por bsdad/ de dus mgo log phyogs nas yin pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom zhing nga la mjal 'dod kyi dad gus dag snang che ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbang mda' sprul pa'i sku mtshan snyan pa rje btsun mthong grol rdo rje zhes bya ba de nyid zhing gshegs khar slob ma rnams la/ 'brel tshad don ldan sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'gro mgon zhabs dkar pa la lan cig mjal na snyam ste/ da tshe 'dir mjal rgyu ma byung khyed rnams mjal du song la/ nga'i rgyu mtshan zhus la skyabs 'jug zhu rten 'di rnams phul zhes/ nga la rgya dngul rdo tshad bcu drug dang gos 416

khyab/ /thugs kyis gar khyab thams cad la/ /mar gyur 'gro ba yongs kyis khyab/ /khyab gdal nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /chos dbyengs ngang la mnyam par zhog /yun ring mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /mkha' ltar yangs shing nyi ltar gsal/ /shel ltar dwangs shing mi g.yo ba/ /ri ltar brtan pa'i dus tsa na/ /mnyam gzhag ngang nas 'khor 'das kyi/ /ltad mo thams cad mthong ba yin/ /ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad po/ /chos kyi dbyings su 'tshang rgya shog /ces blangs/ de nas mar rong bo'i dgon par 'ong zhag mang por bsdad/ de dus mgo log phyogs nas yin pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom zhing nga la mjal 'dod kyi dad gus dag snang che ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbang mda' sprul pa'i sku mtshan snyan pa rje btsun mthong grol rdo rje zhes bya ba de nyid zhing gshegs khar slob ma rnams la/ 'brel tshad don ldan sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'gro mgon zhabs dkar pa la lan cig mjal na snyam ste/ da tshe 'dir mjal rgyu ma byung khyed rnams mjal du song la/ nga'i rgyu mtshan zhus la skyabs 'jug zhu rten 'di rnams phul zhes/ nga la rgya dngul rdo tshad bcu drug dang gos 416

chen rgyan bzhi gcig gos ser po gos 'dang bcas bskur pa/slob ma rnams kyis khyer 'ongs nas phul ba la/ ngas khong gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yid la smon pa'i gnas rnams de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i bsngo smon yang dag byas/ 'byor lan rnam mgur sogs gsung 'bum kha shas phul/ dngos po de dag rnams kyang nang du ma bzhag par dngul rdo tshad lnga'i nang nas gcig rong bo'i dgon chen la phul/ gzhan bzhi bo dngul srang lnga dang bcu la sogs pa byas nas dgon pa gzhan rnams la phul/ rdo tshad gzhan rnams mtshams pa grwa btsun zhabs phyi sprang po gnas skor sogs mi sum brgya dang bdun cu tsam gyi mthun rkyen ja mar phye rtsam sogs la btsongs nas dgun dbyed kyi mtshams rgyags la rim gyes btang nas dge sbyor gang nus byas/de ltar mchod sbyin du btang ba'i dge tshogs rnams 'brel thogs rnams kyis gtso byas/ ma sems can rnams 'thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob pa'i gnas skabs tshun chad du bde ba can la sogs pa'i dag pa'i zhing du skyes pa'am/ yang na lha lus mi lus gtsang ma thob nas/ sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam par thar pa bzhin/417

chen rgyan bzhi gcig gos ser po gos 'dang bcas bskur pa/slob ma rnams kyis khyer 'ongs nas phul ba la/ ngas khong gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yid la smon pa'i gnas rnams de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i bsngo smon yang dag byas/ 'byor lan rnam mgur sogs gsung 'bum kha shas phul/ dngos po de dag rnams kyang nang du ma bzhag par dngul rdo tshad lnga'i nang nas gcig rong bo'i dgon chen la phul/ gzhan bzhi bo dngul srang lnga dang bcu la sogs pa byas nas dgon pa gzhan rnams la phul/ rdo tshad gzhan rnams mtshams pa grwa btsun zhabs phyi sprang po gnas skor sogs mi sum brgya dang bdun cu tsam gyi mthun rkyen ja mar phye rtsam sogs la btsongs nas dgun dbyed kyi mtshams rgyags la rim gyes btang nas dge sbyor gang nus byas/de ltar mchod sbyin du btang ba'i dge tshogs rnams 'brel thogs rnams kyis gtso byas/ ma sems can rnams 'thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob pa'i gnas skabs tshun chad du bde ba can la sogs pa'i dag pa'i zhing du skyes pa'am/ yang na lha lus mi lus gtsang ma thob nas/ sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam par thar pa bzhin/417

ma nor lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten nas dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas te/ mthar sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu ru dmigs nas bsngo smon rgya chen po byas so/ /yang dmag 'khrug brgyab nas rgyal khams phung la gtong ba rnams lha la gnyer gtad 'di ltar byas/hūṃ mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa'i zhi khro'i lha/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig sems can don mdzod cig /mi rnams las nyon gyod 'dre'i dbang du song / /dmag 'khrug brgyab nas mi rta gsod mkhan gyi/ /rgyud kyi chags sdang gyod 'dre kun zhi nas/ /phan pa byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod/ /zhi ba'i sgo nas mi thul gyod 'dre rnams/ /drag po mngon spyod sgo nas myur du sgol/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su da drongs shig /thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo zhi khro'i tshogs/ /zhes gnyer gtad drag po byas pas re zhig gyod 'dre rnams rang sar zhi nas reb gong gser mo ljongs bde bar byung / de nas bkra shis 'khyil bar 'ongs/bcu ba nas mtshams la bsdad/ byang chub sems kyi bdag po slob dpon zhi ba lha la gsol ba 'debs bzhin spyod 'jug 418

ma nor lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten nas dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas te/ mthar sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu ru dmigs nas bsngo smon rgya chen po byas so/ /yang dmag 'khrug brgyab nas rgyal khams phung la gtong ba rnams lha la gnyer gtad 'di ltar byas/hūṃ mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa'i zhi khro'i lha/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig sems can don mdzod cig /mi rnams las nyon gyod 'dre'i dbang du song / /dmag 'khrug brgyab nas mi rta gsod mkhan gyi/ /rgyud kyi chags sdang gyod 'dre kun zhi nas/ /phan pa byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod/ /zhi ba'i sgo nas mi thul gyod 'dre rnams/ /drag po mngon spyod sgo nas myur du sgol/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su da drongs shig /thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo zhi khro'i tshogs/ /zhes gnyer gtad drag po byas pas re zhig gyod 'dre rnams rang sar zhi nas reb gong gser mo ljongs bde bar byung / de nas bkra shis 'khyil bar 'ongs/bcu ba nas mtshams la bsdad/ byang chub sems kyi bdag po slob dpon zhi ba lha la gsol ba 'debs bzhin spyod 'jug 418

dang de'i 'grel ba rgyal tshab rje'i gsung bzhin/ byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyangs pas/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blos khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster zhing / gyong dang pham kha rang gis len pa la sngar bas snying stobs che ba byung / sa bya lo'i zla ba bzhi ba bar du mtshams byas nas bsdad/ bzhi ba tshes nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas blangs nas/ mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pas mi stong phrag mang po 'tshogs/ bco lnga'i nyin par smyung gnas brgyad brgya bsrung rgyu byung / mjug tu bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor byas/ de'i lo bsam pa dkar zhing blo gros che ba'i dbon po dkar dris/ gnyer ba rab byung gnyis kyis/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa'i 'du khang la tshon rtsi gtong ba'i kha mgo byas/ seng ge gshong gi 'bag bzo 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyi tsha bo dge slong dang / lha bzo ye shes dar rgyas/ snyan grags dge slong sogs dpon g.yog bdun brgyad tsam gyes 'bag bzhengs tshon btang / rna gong ma'i lha bzos gzim khang nang du nga'i 'dra sku mi tshad las lhag tsam zhig dang /gzhan sku 'dra mang po bzhengs/ nang rten gzungs gzhug rnams nyang gi ma tshams pas phul/ nang thams cad sku gsung 419

dang de'i 'grel ba rgyal tshab rje'i gsung bzhin/ byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyangs pas/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blos khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster zhing / gyong dang pham kha rang gis len pa la sngar bas snying stobs che ba byung / sa bya lo'i zla ba bzhi ba bar du mtshams byas nas bsdad/ bzhi ba tshes nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas blangs nas/ mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pas mi stong phrag mang po 'tshogs/ bco lnga'i nyin par smyung gnas brgyad brgya bsrung rgyu byung / mjug tu bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor byas/ de'i lo bsam pa dkar zhing blo gros che ba'i dbon po dkar dris/ gnyer ba rab byung gnyis kyis/ bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa'i 'du khang la tshon rtsi gtong ba'i kha mgo byas/ seng ge gshong gi 'bag bzo 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyi tsha bo dge slong dang / lha bzo ye shes dar rgyas/ snyan grags dge slong sogs dpon g.yog bdun brgyad tsam gyes 'bag bzhengs tshon btang / rna gong ma'i lha bzos gzim khang nang du nga'i 'dra sku mi tshad las lhag tsam zhig dang /gzhan sku 'dra mang po bzhengs/ nang rten gzungs gzhug rnams nyang gi ma tshams pas phul/ nang thams cad sku gsung 419

thugs rten gyis bkang / phyi na blta rgyu dang / nang na mjal rgyu yod pa byas/ de rnams kyi gser tshon gyi rin la/ dngul srang brgya dang bcu gsum song / gzhan 'bag bzo lha bzo shing bzo las rogs pa rnams la rta nor lug gsum gos lham dā bu dkar dmar ras sogs khyon sdom pa'i dong tse khron sum brgya lhag tsam byin/ rab gnas dga' ston byas/ dge tshogs rnams nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems dang / 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid kyi rtsi yis zin par byas nas/ 'brel thogs rnams kyis gtso byas ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ byang chub ma thob bar du mtho ris kyi rten bzang po lha lus mi lus thob nas/dam pa'i chos byas nas myur du mngon par rjogs par sangs rgyas pa'i smon lam rgya chen po btab pas/ der 'tshogs pa thams cad kyis rjes su yi rang byas so/ /de dus mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i ri rtsa'i sgu skyes phebs nas rta gos gnyis lha rdzas dri med bcas phul nas/ bla ma rin po che kho bo la myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa zab mo zhig dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ ngas chos bshad mang po byas pa'i rjes su/ 'o rgyud las/ nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams 420

thugs rten gyis bkang / phyi na blta rgyu dang / nang na mjal rgyu yod pa byas/ de rnams kyi gser tshon gyi rin la/ dngul srang brgya dang bcu gsum song / gzhan 'bag bzo lha bzo shing bzo las rogs pa rnams la rta nor lug gsum gos lham dā bu dkar dmar ras sogs khyon sdom pa'i dong tse khron sum brgya lhag tsam byin/ rab gnas dga' ston byas/ dge tshogs rnams nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems dang / 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid kyi rtsi yis zin par byas nas/ 'brel thogs rnams kyis gtso byas ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ byang chub ma thob bar du mtho ris kyi rten bzang po lha lus mi lus thob nas/dam pa'i chos byas nas myur du mngon par rjogs par sangs rgyas pa'i smon lam rgya chen po btab pas/ der 'tshogs pa thams cad kyis rjes su yi rang byas so/ /de dus mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i ri rtsa'i sgu skyes phebs nas rta gos gnyis lha rdzas dri med bcas phul nas/ bla ma rin po che kho bo la myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa zab mo zhig dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ ngas chos bshad mang po byas pa'i rjes su/ 'o rgyud las/ nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams 420

la/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems kyis ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na nam mkha' 'di la mtha' dbus med/ phyi nang med/ 'gro 'ong med/ sgye 'chi med/ gsal 'grib med/ khyab gdal klong yangs chen por ye gdod ma nas gnas pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rig pas yang yang dpyad tshe/ rang bzhin gyes grub pa rdul tsam yang med par/ ye gdod ma nas skye 'gag rtag chad 'gro 'ong gcig tha dad kyi spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba/ chos kyi dbyings chen po gsal zhing dwangs la sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba/ phyi nang med par zang thal/ phyogs ris med par khyab pa/ rgya chad med par brdal ba/ mtha' dbus med par klong yangs nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la/ nam mkha' lta bur phyogs bcur rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su btang /lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pas/ dper na rong khung dog sa nas la kha mthon bo la bud pa dang / ri mthon po'i rtse nas nam mkha' zheng che sar bltas pa ltar/ gu yangs la blo bde ba/ zang thal la phyam brdal ler gnas pa de chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa yin par ngo shes par gyes la/ khyab gdal klong 421

la/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems kyis ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na nam mkha' 'di la mtha' dbus med/ phyi nang med/ 'gro 'ong med/ sgye 'chi med/ gsal 'grib med/ khyab gdal klong yangs chen por ye gdod ma nas gnas pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rig pas yang yang dpyad tshe/ rang bzhin gyes grub pa rdul tsam yang med par/ ye gdod ma nas skye 'gag rtag chad 'gro 'ong gcig tha dad kyi spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba/ chos kyi dbyings chen po gsal zhing dwangs la sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba/ phyi nang med par zang thal/ phyogs ris med par khyab pa/ rgya chad med par brdal ba/ mtha' dbus med par klong yangs nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la/ nam mkha' lta bur phyogs bcur rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su btang /lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pas/ dper na rong khung dog sa nas la kha mthon bo la bud pa dang / ri mthon po'i rtse nas nam mkha' zheng che sar bltas pa ltar/ gu yangs la blo bde ba/ zang thal la phyam brdal ler gnas pa de chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa yin par ngo shes par gyes la/ khyab gdal klong 421

yangs chen por nyams su longs shig dang / nam mkha' lta bur myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyud las/ sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sems kyis ni/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis/ sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags kyi rten 'brel la brten nas/ rta dang glang po la sogs pa'i sgyu ma'i ltad mo sna tshogs pa 'byung ba bzhin du/las bzang ngan gyi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten nas/ bde sdug gi snang ba sogs chos thams cad kyi 'byung tshul bsams nas/las 'bras la nges shes shugs drag bskyed/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i ma sems can thams cad la snying rje tshad med bsgoms/de'i don du smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sgyu ma lta bur tshogs gsog pa dang sgrib pa sbyong ba la 'bad na sgyu ma lta bur myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang / /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu yi/ /ting 'dzin mngon gyur bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams/ /bsams nas tshe 'di blo yis btang / /dben par nyams len mdzad 422

yangs chen por nyams su longs shig dang / nam mkha' lta bur myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyud las/ sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sems kyis ni/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis/ sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags kyi rten 'brel la brten nas/ rta dang glang po la sogs pa'i sgyu ma'i ltad mo sna tshogs pa 'byung ba bzhin du/las bzang ngan gyi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten nas/ bde sdug gi snang ba sogs chos thams cad kyi 'byung tshul bsams nas/las 'bras la nges shes shugs drag bskyed/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i ma sems can thams cad la snying rje tshad med bsgoms/de'i don du smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sgyu ma lta bur tshogs gsog pa dang sgrib pa sbyong ba la 'bad na sgyu ma lta bur myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang / /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu yi/ /ting 'dzin mngon gyur bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams/ /bsams nas tshe 'di blo yis btang / /dben par nyams len mdzad 422

mkhan gye/ /skal ldan bu khyod 'di bzhin sgoms/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems sgos/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gnyis la 'bod/ /khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms/ /gsol ba thob la dbang bzhi longs/ /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems bsres/ /da nas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis/ /bsdus pa'i chos rnams ma lus pa/ /ming gis phar btags ma gtogs pa/ /rang ngos grub pa rdul tsam med/ /ngo bo stong zhing bdag med pa/ /spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba/ /nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la/ /rnam pa rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la/ /brten nas 'gags med snang ba rnams/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang zla/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong sgyu ma ltar shes nas/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang / /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu yi/ /stong nyid gnyis ka yun ring sgoms/ /de nas snang ba mi snang ba/ /mi snang snang bar bsgoms pa sogs/ /sprul bsgyur sna tshogs bsgoms gyur na/ /skabs shig de ltar rmi lam du/ /'ong zhing de nas nyams la yong / /de nas dngos su sprul bsgyur sogs/ /dzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston par nus/ /de phyir skal ldan slob bu khyod/ /de ltar bsgoms la 'bad par mdzod/ /de skad smras pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /de 423

mkhan gye/ /skal ldan bu khyod 'di bzhin sgoms/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems sgos/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gnyis la 'bod/ /khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms/ /gsol ba thob la dbang bzhi longs/ /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems bsres/ /da nas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis/ /bsdus pa'i chos rnams ma lus pa/ /ming gis phar btags ma gtogs pa/ /rang ngos grub pa rdul tsam med/ /ngo bo stong zhing bdag med pa/ /spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba/ /nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la/ /rnam pa rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la/ /brten nas 'gags med snang ba rnams/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang zla/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong sgyu ma ltar shes nas/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang / /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu yi/ /stong nyid gnyis ka yun ring sgoms/ /de nas snang ba mi snang ba/ /mi snang snang bar bsgoms pa sogs/ /sprul bsgyur sna tshogs bsgoms gyur na/ /skabs shig de ltar rmi lam du/ /'ong zhing de nas nyams la yong / /de nas dngos su sprul bsgyur sogs/ /dzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston par nus/ /de phyir skal ldan slob bu khyod/ /de ltar bsgoms la 'bad par mdzod/ /de skad smras pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /de 423

bzhin mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces spras pas lta ba yangs la spyod pa zhib mo bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa zhig byung ngo / /yang dad pa che ba'i blo ldan chos mdzad kyis shi gson gang gi skyabs 'jug zhu rten du lug lnga bcu/ ha sag gi stod thung gcig rin chen rgyan ldan pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i phreng ba 'jam dar bcas skyabs 'jug gi tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/sku rab mjes mtshan dpe gzi 'od 'bar/ /gsung rab snyan yan lag drug cu tshang / /thugs rab yangs mkhyen brtse nus par ldan/ /zhing rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i mgon/ /dus bskal pa sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams 'dren pa'i phyir/ /dus da lta rang re'i bla mar gyur/ /dus lan cig mjal 'di las 'phro bzang / /'bangs bdag gis bla ma mang bsten kyang / /mgon khyed kyi rnam thar bsam tsa na/ /yid g.yo ba'i dad pa dbang med sgyes/ /dus da lo pha khyed bsams nas yong / /gnas 'di ru 'ong ba don dang ldan/ /mgon khyod kyi zhal mthong gsung thos nas/ /sku'i nye drung 'di ru lo gcig la/ /rang gang nas bsgom bsgrub byas pa'i tshe/ /sems chos brgyad dbang du song ba yi/ /sdug btsir gyi bsgom bsgrub ma byas par/ /rang snang ba gu yangs 424

bzhin mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces spras pas lta ba yangs la spyod pa zhib mo bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa zhig byung ngo / /yang dad pa che ba'i blo ldan chos mdzad kyis shi gson gang gi skyabs 'jug zhu rten du lug lnga bcu/ ha sag gi stod thung gcig rin chen rgyan ldan pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i phreng ba 'jam dar bcas skyabs 'jug gi tshigs su bcad nas phul ba/sku rab mjes mtshan dpe gzi 'od 'bar/ /gsung rab snyan yan lag drug cu tshang / /thugs rab yangs mkhyen brtse nus par ldan/ /zhing rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i mgon/ /dus bskal pa sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro rnams 'dren pa'i phyir/ /dus da lta rang re'i bla mar gyur/ /dus lan cig mjal 'di las 'phro bzang / /'bangs bdag gis bla ma mang bsten kyang / /mgon khyed kyi rnam thar bsam tsa na/ /yid g.yo ba'i dad pa dbang med sgyes/ /dus da lo pha khyed bsams nas yong / /gnas 'di ru 'ong ba don dang ldan/ /mgon khyod kyi zhal mthong gsung thos nas/ /sku'i nye drung 'di ru lo gcig la/ /rang gang nas bsgom bsgrub byas pa'i tshe/ /sems chos brgyad dbang du song ba yi/ /sdug btsir gyi bsgom bsgrub ma byas par/ /rang snang ba gu yangs 424

blo bde ngos/ /pha bla ma spyi bor sgom bzhin du/ /lus ngag gi 'bad rtsol mi dgos pa'i/ /dus rgyun du sems ngo bskyangs pa'i tshe/ /nyams rtogs pa chen po mi 'char yang / /yid dad gus dag snang gong du 'phel/ /mi rtag dang skyo shas than thun skye/ /ma 'gro la phan sems skyong bzhin gnas/ /lus bde zhing skyid la sems kha yangs/ /'di kun kyang mgon khyod bka' drin yin/ /drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams dga' 'o skyid do bla ma mkhyen/ /dus 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /pha khyed min re sa gzhan na med/ /thugs brtse bas ma 'dor thugs rjes zungs/ /tshe 'di phyi'i 'dun ma khyed rang mkhyen/ /mgon khyed kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /lam bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gnad 'gag cig /thugs brtse bas gsungs shing gsung bzhin du/ /rang bsgrub kyang nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /thun mong ma yin bskyed rdzogs dang / /rdzogs chen gnad 'gag 'di ltar sgoms/ /rang lus snod bcud 'od du zhu/ /mi dmigs stong pa nyid du sgoms/ /stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud kun/ /gzhal yas khang dang lha ru sgoms/ /lha rnams 425

blo bde ngos/ /pha bla ma spyi bor sgom bzhin du/ /lus ngag gi 'bad rtsol mi dgos pa'i/ /dus rgyun du sems ngo bskyangs pa'i tshe/ /nyams rtogs pa chen po mi 'char yang / /yid dad gus dag snang gong du 'phel/ /mi rtag dang skyo shas than thun skye/ /ma 'gro la phan sems skyong bzhin gnas/ /lus bde zhing skyid la sems kha yangs/ /'di kun kyang mgon khyod bka' drin yin/ /drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams dga' 'o skyid do bla ma mkhyen/ /dus 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /pha khyed min re sa gzhan na med/ /thugs brtse bas ma 'dor thugs rjes zungs/ /tshe 'di phyi'i 'dun ma khyed rang mkhyen/ /mgon khyed kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /lam bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gnad 'gag cig /thugs brtse bas gsungs shing gsung bzhin du/ /rang bsgrub kyang nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /thun mong ma yin bskyed rdzogs dang / /rdzogs chen gnad 'gag 'di ltar sgoms/ /rang lus snod bcud 'od du zhu/ /mi dmigs stong pa nyid du sgoms/ /stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud kun/ /gzhal yas khang dang lha ru sgoms/ /lha rnams 425

bde ba'i rang bzhin dang / /bde ba stong pa'i rang bzhin dang / /ngo bo bde stong rnam pa lha/ /de rnams gsum sgril gyis la sgoms/ /rang sems chos kun gdod ma'i gshis/ /mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings yin pas/ /de yi ngang du glod la zhog /'od gsal mtha' dbus med par 'char/ /'od gsal ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur ldang / /de ltar yang yang slob nus na/ /mi slob zung 'jug mngon du 'gyur/ /ma bsgoms bzhin du zung 'jug sku/ /brnyes thabs khregs chod thod rgal lam/ /snga 'gyur rdzogs chen khyad chos yin/ /gsang nas nyams su len pa gces/ /zhes gang bshad pa ltar nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan mang po rgyud la shar ba byung / yang dad can kun bzang / mdo sngags/ chos grags sogs skal ldan gyi slob ma 'ga' zhig gis 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar dmigs nas mchod pa 'bul na ji ltar mos dgos zer ba'i lan du/ 'o de la maṇ+ḍal gye skabs su so bdun ma'i nang ltar/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ phyi'i lcags ri/ dbus su ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ma rmos pa'i lo tog rgyal srid sna bdun/ mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad/ nyi ma zla 426

bde ba'i rang bzhin dang / /bde ba stong pa'i rang bzhin dang / /ngo bo bde stong rnam pa lha/ /de rnams gsum sgril gyis la sgoms/ /rang sems chos kun gdod ma'i gshis/ /mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings yin pas/ /de yi ngang du glod la zhog /'od gsal mtha' dbus med par 'char/ /'od gsal ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur ldang / /de ltar yang yang slob nus na/ /mi slob zung 'jug mngon du 'gyur/ /ma bsgoms bzhin du zung 'jug sku/ /brnyes thabs khregs chod thod rgal lam/ /snga 'gyur rdzogs chen khyad chos yin/ /gsang nas nyams su len pa gces/ /zhes gang bshad pa ltar nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan mang po rgyud la shar ba byung / yang dad can kun bzang / mdo sngags/ chos grags sogs skal ldan gyi slob ma 'ga' zhig gis 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar dmigs nas mchod pa 'bul na ji ltar mos dgos zer ba'i lan du/ 'o de la maṇ+ḍal gye skabs su so bdun ma'i nang ltar/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ phyi'i lcags ri/ dbus su ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ma rmos pa'i lo tog rgyal srid sna bdun/ mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad/ nyi ma zla 426

ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa can/ de thams cad rang rang la mnga' ba'i yon tan cha mthun gyi longs spyod nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa'am/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bur lang long du 'phro zhing / de 'dra ba'i rdul phra rab re re'i khongs su yang bshad ma thag pa'i maṇ+ḍal rdul snyed du 'khrigs shing / so so'i skye bo'i blos dpag par mi nus shing / mthas gtugs pa med pa'i bar du ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par sprul nas 'bul ba ni/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa 'bul tshul du grags la/ yang lugs la lar byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po gcig gi thugs ka nas/ 'od zer bye ba ther 'bum khug pa gsum gyi grangs kyis kyang mi chod pa spros pa'i dze+e mor kun tu bzang po spros te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba por bgyis nas/ de lta bu re re'i lte ba las kyang /'od zer de 'dra ba spros nas mkha' khyab tu phul ba la/ kun tu bzang po'i maṇ+ḍal du bzhed pa'o/ /zhes dge rtse paṇ+ḍi tas gsungs/ gzhan yang snang spyod thams cad mchod par 'bul tshul ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams 427

ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa can/ de thams cad rang rang la mnga' ba'i yon tan cha mthun gyi longs spyod nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa'am/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bur lang long du 'phro zhing / de 'dra ba'i rdul phra rab re re'i khongs su yang bshad ma thag pa'i maṇ+ḍal rdul snyed du 'khrigs shing / so so'i skye bo'i blos dpag par mi nus shing / mthas gtugs pa med pa'i bar du ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par sprul nas 'bul ba ni/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa 'bul tshul du grags la/ yang lugs la lar byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po gcig gi thugs ka nas/ 'od zer bye ba ther 'bum khug pa gsum gyi grangs kyis kyang mi chod pa spros pa'i dze+e mor kun tu bzang po spros te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba por bgyis nas/ de lta bu re re'i lte ba las kyang /'od zer de 'dra ba spros nas mkha' khyab tu phul ba la/ kun tu bzang po'i maṇ+ḍal du bzhed pa'o/ /zhes dge rtse paṇ+ḍi tas gsungs/ gzhan yang snang spyod thams cad mchod par 'bul tshul ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams 427

cad rnam par dag pa/ thog mnyen pa/ logs 'jam pa/ 'og bde ba/ ye shes rin po che'i khang ba/ ri thams cad rin po che'i phung po/ chu thams cad khrus kyi rdzing bu/ shing thams cad dpag bsam gyi shing / sgra thams cad glu dang dbyangs snyan tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra/ gos thams cad bla bre dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / rdzas thams cad bza' ba dang btung ba'i mchog 'gro ba lha dang lha mo/ rkang ba gar stabs byed pa/ lag pas gar bsgyur bas phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams gang bar bsam la 'bul lo/ /de ni snang spyod thams cad mchod par dmigs nas 'bal tshal lags/ de ltar phal bas ra rang ra bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rjogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas/ khong rnams nas de 'dra'i dmigs pa dka' yang mos mos sems sems re byed pa la phan thogs chen po byung bas bka' drin che zer/ yang sprul sku dge 'dun dar rgyas dang /ngag dbang 'od zer/ dge slong dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang /ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang bstan rgyas/ ye shes rgya mtsho sogs skal ldan gyi slob ma mang pos/ phyag chen gsol 'debs las/ sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang /428

cad rnam par dag pa/ thog mnyen pa/ logs 'jam pa/ 'og 1de skyob(ga 1sde 11byebye:re 1sde 1sde casabyebye:repa/ pa// 05 zug khabapa pa// 21zug05 (5pa/ zug phung po/ chu thams cad khrus kyi rdzing bu/ shing thams cad dpag bsam gyi shing / sgra thams cad glu dang dbyangs snyan tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra/ gos thams cad bla bre dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / rdzas thams cad bza' ba dang btung ba'i mchog 'gro ba lha dang lha mo/ rkang ba gar stabs byed pa/ lag pas gar bsgyur bas phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams gang bar bsam la 'bul lo/ /de ni snang spyod thams cad mchod par dmigs nas 'bul tshul lags/ de ltar phul bas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rjogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas/ khong rnams nas de 'dra'i dmigs pa dka' yang mos mos sems sems re byed pa la phan thogs chen po byung bas bka' drin che zer/ yang sprul sku dge 'dun dar rgyas dang /ngag dbang 'od zer/ dge slong dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang /ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang bstan rgyas/ ye shes rgya mtsho sogs skal ldan gyi slob ma mang pos/ phyag chen gsol 'debs las/ sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang /428

lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang / snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar/sems nyid gnyug ma lhan cig sgyes pa'i ye shes rang ngo 'phrod pa la/ thog mar long ba mig phyes pa lta bu'i ngo sprod kyi gdams pa gsal bo zhig bstan du gsol/ zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o de yin na ngas bya zhes/ rang nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi skur bsgoms nas/ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi bskur nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas ngo sprod kyi gdams pa dngos ni/ rje btsun grol mchog pa'i zhal nas/ sems rang lugs su lhod bzhag pas/rtog pa rang sar nyal zhi nas ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa gsal seng nge rang rig rang gsal du rjen ne ba de la/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zer ba yin/ sems can gyi sems kyi mtshan nyid zer ba yin/ dngos po'i gnas lugs zer ba yin/ rang gi sems bya ba ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa gsal seng nge ba 'di yin no/ /bla mas de ngo sprad pa yin/ slob mas de shes par byed pa yin/ de ltar ngo shes pa la sems ngo shes pa zer ba yin/sangs rgyas mkhan/ 'khor bar 'khyams mkhan/ dga' dang mi dga' ba/ mdor na srid dang zhi ba'i chos kyi byed mkhan thams 429

lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang / snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar/sems nyid gnyug ma lhan cig sgyes pa'i ye shes rang ngo 'phrod pa la/ thog mar long ba mig phyes pa lta bu'i ngo sprod kyi gdams pa gsal bo zhig bstan du gsol/ zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o de yin na ngas bya zhes/ rang nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi skur bsgoms nas/ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi bskur nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas ngo sprod kyi gdams pa dngos ni/ rje btsun grol mchog pa'i zhal nas/ sems rang lugs su lhod bzhag pas/rtog pa rang sar nyal zhi nas ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa gsal seng nge rang rig rang gsal du rjen ne ba de la/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zer ba yin/ sems can gyi sems kyi mtshan nyid zer ba yin/ dngos po'i gnas lugs zer ba yin/ rang gi sems bya ba ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa gsal seng nge ba 'di yin no/ /bla mas de ngo sprad pa yin/ slob mas de shes par byed pa yin/ de ltar ngo shes pa la sems ngo shes pa zer ba yin/sangs rgyas mkhan/ 'khor bar 'khyams mkhan/ dga' dang mi dga' ba/ mdor na srid dang zhi ba'i chos kyi byed mkhan thams 429

cad 'di yin/ sngar rtog pas bsgribs nas ngo ma shes pa yin/da lta rnam rtog rgyun chad nas ngo shes pa yin no/ /sems de la ngos bzung ci yang med pa sems kyi rang bzhin yin/ med bzhin pa sa le wa le ba de sems kyi mtshad nyid yin/ stong gsal rig pa'i ngo bo seng nge ye re ba de ngo bo yin no/ /de la ngo shes pa cig mdzod/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes par ngo sprad pa'o/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras thogs med rin po ches/ slob dpon skyob pa la gdams pa/ sems rtog med kyi ngang las gsal seng nge pa de'i ngo bo la bltas nas cir yang ma grub par stong seng nge gnas pa de la/ rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med zer ba yin/ de dang po nas thams cad la yod mod kyi gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas bsgribs pas ngo ma shes pa yin/khyed rang gi nyams len gyi stobs kyis ngo bo mthong ba yin pas/sems kyi ngo bo stong par 'dug pa de la legs par ltos/ de'i thog tu zhog mdzod/ yon tan gyi 'char tshul gong nas gong du 'byung zhing / mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyur 'gyur bas/ dga' ba sgoms la nyams su longs mdzod/ ces gsungs pa ltar nyams su longs dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad chu la dbyu gus ri mo bris pa bzhin du rang yal du song nas mi gnod par 430

cad 'di yin/ sngar rtog pas bsgribs nas ngo ma shes pa yin/da lta rnam rtog rgyun chad nas ngo shes pa yin no/ /sems de la ngos bzung ci yang med pa sems kyi rang bzhin yin/ med bzhin pa sa le wa le ba de sems kyi mtshad nyid yin/ stong gsal rig pa'i ngo bo seng nge ye re ba de ngo bo yin no/ /de la ngo shes pa cig mdzod/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes par ngo sprad pa'o/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras thogs med rin po ches/ slob dpon skyob pa la gdams pa/ sems rtog med kyi ngang las gsal seng nge pa de'i ngo bo la bltas nas cir yang ma grub par stong seng nge gnas pa de la/ rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med zer ba yin/ de dang po nas thams cad la yod mod kyi gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas bsgribs pas ngo ma shes pa yin/khyed rang gi nyams len gyi stobs kyis ngo bo mthong ba yin pas/sems kyi ngo bo stong par 'dug pa de la legs par ltos/ de'i thog tu zhog mdzod/ yon tan gyi 'char tshul gong nas gong du 'byung zhing / mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyur 'gyur bas/ dga' ba sgoms la nyams su longs mdzod/ ces gsungs pa ltar nyams su longs dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad chu la dbyu gus ri mo bris pa bzhin du rang yal du song nas mi gnod par 430

mthar 'chi ba chos skur grol bar 'gyur te/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i zhal nas/ 'chi khar tshe 'di'i 'khri ba thams cad rbad kyis bcad la/ don dam par sems la skye 'chi med par thag bcad/ phyag rgya chen po la sgom du med par thag bcad/ bsgom med kyi don la ma yengs par bzhag pas bar do med par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'chi khar lam sna zin pa kha shas byung ngo / /yang dad gtong blo gros che ba'i bde chen mtshams pa dang / dad can rig grol la sogs pa'i skal ldan gyi slob ma mang pos/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ rje lho brag mar pas/ gdams pa kun la yod mod kyang / /snyan brgyud yod na yod pa yin/ /bsgoms te sangs rgyas kun la yod/ /ma bsgoms rgya na rgya ba yin/ /gsungs pa ltar/ snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi cha med/ chos gzhan sgom long mi 'dug pas da ni ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa zab mo zhig dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o de yin na sngon jo bo rje rgya gar shar phyogs bha du ra'i grong na bzhugs dus/ bud med gcer bu rus rgyan can zhig res ngu res dgod pa zhig gzigs nas/ yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ nga res ngu res dgod pa'i don shes sam gsungs/ ma 'tshal zhus pas/ sems can rnams rang rgyud kyi 431

mthar 'chi ba chos skur grol bar 'gyur te/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i zhal nas/ 'chi khar tshe 'di'i 'khri ba thams cad rbad kyis bcad la/ don dam par sems la skye 'chi med par thag bcad/ phyag rgya chen po la sgom du med par thag bcad/ bsgom med kyi don la ma yengs par bzhag pas bar do med par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'chi khar lam sna zin pa kha shas byung ngo / /yang dad gtong blo gros che ba'i bde chen mtshams pa dang / dad can rig grol la sogs pa'i skal ldan gyi slob ma mang pos/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ rje lho brag mar pas/ gdams pa kun la yod mod kyang / /snyan brgyud yod na yod pa yin/ /bsgoms te sangs rgyas kun la yod/ /ma bsgoms rgya na rgya ba yin/ /gsungs pa ltar/ snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi cha med/ chos gzhan sgom long mi 'dug pas da ni ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa zab mo zhig dgos zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o de yin na sngon jo bo rje rgya gar shar phyogs bha du ra'i grong na bzhugs dus/ bud med gcer bu rus rgyan can zhig res ngu res dgod pa zhig gzigs nas/ yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ nga res ngu res dgod pa'i don shes sam gsungs/ ma 'tshal zhus pas/ sems can rnams rang rgyud kyi 431

ye shes ma rtogs par 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la spyod pas ngu ba yin/ rtogs na da lta nyid du sangs rgyas pa yin pas dgod pa yin gsungs nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang tshegs chung la don che ba byin rlabs kyi lugs bya bas dbang bskur nas rnal 'byor ma'i zhal ji lta ba bzhin gzigs/ gdams ngag ma lus par zhus zhes chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las gsungs/des na myur du mngon par sangs rgyas par 'dod pas dbang dang gdams ngag las sla ba de 'dra zhus nas nyams su len dgos/ des na ngas kyang khyed rnams la de ltar bya zhes/ rang nyid skad cig nyid la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur bskyed nas/ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi bskur nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas gdams pa dngos la/ lus gnad drang por bsrangs mig 'bras rang gi thad gar mi 'dzum pa'i tshul du blta ste/ grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dpal ldan sa ra ha chen pos/ mig ni mi 'dzum bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor dang /zhes gsungs/ gzhan du'ang / mig ma btsums pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rnal 'byor kun las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / mu stegs tshangs pa gyen du blta/ /nyan thos zhi ba thur du 432

ye shes ma rtogs par 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la spyod pas ngu ba yin/ rtogs na da lta nyid du sangs rgyas pa yin pas dgod pa yin gsungs nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang tshegs chung la don che ba byin rlabs kyi lugs bya bas dbang bskur nas rnal 'byor ma'i zhal ji lta ba bzhin gzigs/ gdams ngag ma lus par zhus zhes chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las gsungs/des na myur du mngon par sangs rgyas par 'dod pas dbang dang gdams ngag las sla ba de 'dra zhus nas nyams su len dgos/ des na ngas kyang khyed rnams la de ltar bya zhes/ rang nyid skad cig nyid la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur bskyed nas/ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi bskur nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas gdams pa dngos la/ lus gnad drang por bsrangs mig 'bras rang gi thad gar mi 'dzum pa'i tshul du blta ste/ grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dpal ldan sa ra ha chen pos/ mig ni mi 'dzum bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor dang /zhes gsungs/ gzhan du'ang / mig ma btsums pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rnal 'byor kun las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / mu stegs tshangs pa gyen du blta/ /nyan thos zhi ba thur du 432

blta/ /rdo rje'i mig ni thad gar blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thad gar blta/ skabs der shes pas cir yang mi 'dzin/ cir yang mi rtog dran pa dang yid la byed pa thams cad spangs te/shes pa rang sar lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pas/ bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis sems kyi ngo bo nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ston ga'i nyi ma gung gi nam mkha' sprin med pa'i dkyil lta bu/dag pa dmigs pa med cing snang ba med pa nyid/ mthong med tshul du rang gis mthong la/ nges shes skyes pa de ni don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo rtogs pa yin te/ sngon bla ma rig pa'i khu byug la jo bos rtogs pa phul ba/ kho bos ting 'dzin cig la mnyam bzhag tshe/ /nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba ji bzhin du/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa mi gda' na/ /bla ma chos kyi gnas lugs de lags sam/ /zhes zhus pas/ /de ltar lags gsungs/ des na da dung mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du skyong ba ni gdams ngag bla na med pa'o/ /zhes gdams pas/thams cad kyis de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs thams cad rang sar sangs/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyas/ nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru grol ba'i blo gdeng rnyed pa mang po byung ngo / /yang blo ldan 'jigs med 433

blta/ /rdo rje'i mig ni thad gar blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thad gar blta/ skabs der shes pas cir yang mi 'dzin/ cir yang mi rtog dran pa dang yid la byed pa thams cad spangs te/shes pa rang sar lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pas/ bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis sems kyi ngo bo nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ston ga'i nyi ma gung gi nam mkha' sprin med pa'i dkyil lta bu/dag pa dmigs pa med cing snang ba med pa nyid/ mthong med tshul du rang gis mthong la/ nges shes skyes pa de ni don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo rtogs pa yin te/ sngon bla ma rig pa'i khu byug la jo bos rtogs pa phul ba/ kho bos ting 'dzin cig la mnyam bzhag tshe/ /nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba ji bzhin du/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa mi gda' na/ /bla ma chos kyi gnas lugs de lags sam/ /zhes zhus pas/ /de ltar lags gsungs/ des na da dung mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du skyong ba ni gdams ngag bla na med pa'o/ /zhes gdams pas/thams cad kyis de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs thams cad rang sar sangs/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyas/ nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru grol ba'i blo gdeng rnyed pa mang po byung ngo / /yang blo ldan 'jigs med 433

sogs skal ldan slob ma 'ga' res/ bla ma rin po che/ bka' rgyud kun gyi gtsug rgyan mnyam med sgam po bas/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ /snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od/ /rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i mdangs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa la/ thog mar chos sku mdzub tshugs ma'i gdams pa zhig bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o de yin na khyed rnams kyis lus gnad drang por bya/ mig bar snang du ha re gyis/ shes pa lhod kyis glod la zhog dang / chos sku mdzub tshugs kyi gdams pa dngos ni/ mnyam med sgam po rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas khyod la ngo sprod cig bya gsungs/ da khyod rang gi shes pa gsal seng nge ba de chos sku yin/ logs na med/da lta 'di nas langs la pha gir bsdad tsa na yang / shes pa la bltas/ gsal seng nge 'dug pa de kho na chos kyi sku yin/ de nas yang khyim du phyin nas mal du bsdad de/ sems la bltas/gsal seng nge ba ngos bzung dang bral ba 'dug na/ de kho na chos skru yin/ de la gnas pa yun thung ste skad cig cam yang mi gnas pa de chos sku yin/ shes pa 'phro ba la skyon du mi blta/ mi 'phro ba la yon tan du mi blta bar shes pa gsal seng nge ba la 434

sogs skal ldan slob ma 'ga' res/ bla ma rin po che/ bka' rgyud kun gyi gtsug rgyan mnyam med sgam po bas/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ /snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od/ /rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i mdangs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa la/ thog mar chos sku mdzub tshugs ma'i gdams pa zhig bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o de yin na khyed rnams kyis lus gnad drang por bya/ mig bar snang du ha re gyis/ shes pa lhod kyis glod la zhog dang / chos sku mdzub tshugs kyi gdams pa dngos ni/ mnyam med sgam po rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas khyod la ngo sprod cig bya gsungs/ da khyod rang gi shes pa gsal seng nge ba de chos sku yin/ logs na med/da lta 'di nas langs la pha gir bsdad tsa na yang / shes pa la bltas/ gsal seng nge 'dug pa de kho na chos kyi sku yin/ de nas yang khyim du phyin nas mal du bsdad de/ sems la bltas/gsal seng nge ba ngos bzung dang bral ba 'dug na/ de kho na chos skru yin/ de la gnas pa yun thung ste skad cig cam yang mi gnas pa de chos sku yin/ shes pa 'phro ba la skyon du mi blta/ mi 'phro ba la yon tan du mi blta bar shes pa gsal seng nge ba la 434
