nges su gzhug ste/ 'ong na ye shes 'char ro/ /de tsa na rang mkhas pa 'ong ba yin gsungs pa ltar/ shes pa gsal seng nge ba'i ngang la rtse gcig tu gnas pa/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor/rnam rtog gi spros pa dang bral ba spros bral gyi rnal 'byor/ snang sems gnyis 'dres pa ro gcig gi rnal 'byor/ bsgom rgyu med pa sgom med kyi rnal 'byor te/ gang zag brtson 'grus can gyi tshe 'dir rnal 'byor bzhi mthar phyin te chos skur sangs rgyas par 'gyur te/ slob dpon chen pos/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa rnal ma skyon med 'di kho na yin te/ rtog pa snga ma 'gags/ phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar de na 'di yin med pa'i gsal zhing dwangs pa/ smra rgyu med pa'i nyams su myong rgyu zhig 'dug pa de ka ltar ye gdod ma nas gnas pa yin te/ gnas skabs su glo bur gyi rtog pa sna tshogs su shar ba yin pas/ da ni dus de ring nas bzung ste sangs rgyas lag tu gtad pa yin pas/ da phan chad gnas lugs 'di dang ma bral bar 'di ka ltar du nyams su longs shig dang / tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas 'thob par gdon mi za'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar slob ma rnams kyis nyams su blangs pas bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rnams sbrul gyi mdud pa bshig pa ltar rang grol du song nas/ rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig gi 435

nges su gzhug ste/ 'ong na ye shes 'char ro/ /de tsa na rang mkhas pa 'ong ba yin gsungs pa ltar/ shes pa gsal seng nge ba'i ngang la rtse gcig tu gnas pa/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor/rnam rtog gi spros pa dang bral ba spros bral gyi rnal 'byor/ snang sems gnyis 'dres pa ro gcig gi rnal 'byor/ bsgom rgyu med pa sgom med kyi rnal 'byor te/ gang zag brtson 'grus can gyi tshe 'dir rnal 'byor bzhi mthar phyin te chos skur sangs rgyas par 'gyur te/ slob dpon chen pos/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa rnal ma skyon med 'di kho na yin te/ rtog pa snga ma 'gags/ phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar de na 'di yin med pa'i gsal zhing dwangs pa/ smra rgyu med pa'i nyams su myong rgyu zhig 'dug pa de ka ltar ye gdod ma nas gnas pa yin te/ gnas skabs su glo bur gyi rtog pa sna tshogs su shar ba yin pas/ da ni dus de ring nas bzung ste sangs rgyas lag tu gtad pa yin pas/ da phan chad gnas lugs 'di dang ma bral bar 'di ka ltar du nyams su longs shig dang / tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas 'thob par gdon mi za'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar slob ma rnams kyis nyams su blangs pas bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rnams sbrul gyi mdud pa bshig pa ltar rang grol du song nas/ rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig gi 435

rnal 'byor pa mang po byung ngo / /yang mtsho snying ri khrod pa yong nas dngul srang bcu gsum ja nag gcig 'jam dar bcas nyams rtogs kyi 'bul ba 'di phul/snyegs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon chos kyi rje/ /khyed thugs chos dbyengs spros bral nam mkha' la/ /thugs rje chu 'dzin 'khrigs la bdag sems dga'/ /dam chos sbrang char yong snyam spro nas yod/ /dad mos rin chen gser bye brdal ba'i klong / /ma dad log lta sa rdo'i ming yang med/ /sems nyid kun khyab lta ba'i klong na bde/ /'dzin med zang thal sgom pa'i klong na bde/ /blo tshig yul 'das spyod pa'i klong na bde/ /sku gsum ye grol 'bras bu'i klong na bde/ /de ltar bde ba'i bya bral rnal 'byor nga / /rgyal ba klong chen pa yi bu rgyud yin/ /bla ma zhabs dkar pa yi slob ma yin/ /mtsho snying ri la bsdad pa'i ri ba yin/ /da dung ri nas rang rgyud nyon mongs 'dul/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad cig bstan du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/'o khyod kyi lta sgom spyod 'bras de shin tu bzang / kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i mgur las/ yangs so che'o chos kyi dbyengs/ /dzhairdo ma~Xṭ+wāṃ ༷ dī dzhai ṭ+wāṃX dh+rirdo ༵ ༵/gas//༷/ rdo ṭ+wāṃ /༵ ༵༵ṭ+wāṃbhe ṅge 436

rnal 'byor pa mang po byung ngo / /yang mtsho snying ri khrod pa yong nas dngul srang bcu gsum ja nag gcig 'jam dar bcas nyams rtogs kyi 'bul ba 'di phul/snyegs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon chos kyi rje/ /khyed thugs chos dbyengs spros bral nam mkha' la/ /thugs rje chu 'dzin 'khrigs la bdag sems dga'/ /dam chos sbrang char yong snyam spro nas yod/ /dad mos rin chen gser bye brdal ba'i klong / /ma dad log lta sa rdo'i ming yang med/ /sems nyid kun khyab lta ba'i klong na bde/ /'dzin med zang thal sgom pa'i klong na bde/ /blo tshig yul 'das spyod pa'i klong na bde/ /sku gsum ye grol 'bras bu'i klong na bde/ /de ltar bde ba'i bya bral rnal 'byor nga / /rgyal ba klong chen pa yi bu rgyud yin/ /bla ma zhabs dkar pa yi slob ma yin/ /mtsho snying ri la bsdad pa'i ri ba yin/ /da dung ri nas rang rgyud nyon mongs 'dul/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad cig bstan du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/'o khyod kyi lta sgom spyod 'bras de shin tu bzang / kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i mgur las/ yangs so che'o chos kyi dbyengs/ /dzhairdo ma~Xṭ+wāṃ ༷ dī dzhai ṭ+wāṃX dh+rirdo ༵ ༵/gas//༷/ rdo ṭ+wāṃ /༵ ༵༵ṭ+wāṃbhe ṅge 436

ngang / /nyi zla 'dra ste 'od ri gsal/ /sgom pa dag pa'i tshal du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /thams cad rang snang gzung 'dzin bral/ /sgyu ma 'dra ste bden zhen med/ /spyod pa 'byongs pa'i tshal du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /rang rig dri med chos kyi sku/ /nor bu 'dra ste lhun gyis grub/ /'bras bu dag pa'i tshal du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /gsungs pa dang mthun pa byung / da ni mdo 'gag cig bshad na 'di yin te/ e ma skal ldan slob bu lags/ /gza' gtad yod na lta ba min/ /bying rgod yod na sgom pa min/ /blang dor yod na spyod pa min/ /re dogs yod na 'bras bu min/ /'o na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /gza' gtad med na lta ba yin/ /bying rgod med na sgom pa yin/ /blang dor med na spyod pa yin/ /re dogs med na 'bras bu yin/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras mthar thug lags/ /sems la zhog la nyams su longs/ /'o nyams su len na gdams ngag mang mi dgos/ 'di tsam gyis snying tshims par mdzod la/ kha rog pa shin tu spros med smra bsam brjod med kyi ngang la zhog dang /nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas kho rang dga' song / yang skal ldan slob ma rnams la 437

ngang / /nyi zla 'dra ste 'od ri gsal/ /sgom pa dag pa'i tshal du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /thams cad rang snang gzung 'dzin bral/ /sgyu ma 'dra ste bden zhen med/ /spyod pa 'byongs pa'i tshal du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /rang rig dri med chos kyi sku/ /nor bu 'dra ste lhun gyis grub/ /'bras bu dag pa'i tshal du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /gsungs pa dang mthun pa byung / da ni mdo 'gag cig bshad na 'di yin te/ e ma skal ldan slob bu lags/ /gza' gtad yod na lta ba min/ /bying rgod yod na sgom pa min/ /blang dor yod na spyod pa min/ /re dogs yod na 'bras bu min/ /'o na ci 'dra zer tsa na/ /gza' gtad med na lta ba yin/ /bying rgod med na sgom pa yin/ /blang dor med na spyod pa yin/ /re dogs med na 'bras bu yin/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras mthar thug lags/ /sems la zhog la nyams su longs/ /'o nyams su len na gdams ngag mang mi dgos/ 'di tsam gyis snying tshims par mdzod la/ kha rog pa shin tu spros med smra bsam brjod med kyi ngang la zhog dang /nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas kho rang dga' song / yang skal ldan slob ma rnams la 437

gdams pa/ 'o gsang sngag kyi rnal 'byo pa rtogs pa mthon por slebs nas/ sha chang bud med sogs 'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol pa rnams la khas gtong mi rung ste/ bde mchog ra la'i rgyud las/ bum nga/'i dbang thob dge bsnyen te/ /gsang ba'i dbang thob dge tshul yin/ /shes rab ye shes dge slong ste/ /rdzogs pa dge slong chen po yin/ /gsungs/ de la dgongs nas grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba sa ra ha chen pos mda' mkhan gyi bu mo phyag rgyar bzhes nas/ kha sang phan chad bram ze yin/ /de ring tshun chad dge slong yin/ /tshangs par spyod pa dge slong ste/ /he ru ka dpal dge slong mchog /gsungs/ 'gran gyi do med rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi zhal snga nas/ sha chang bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin/ /dam nyams gsod pa sngags kyi dam tshig yin/ /rig ma bsten pa las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /nga yis de ltar shes pa'i skabs shig na/ /'dul 'dzin dge slong dag dang 'gal ba med/ /de bas dam nyams log lta can khyod dag /zhag bdun tho rangs gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /zhes yi ge springs nas/ 'dul 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' zhig zhag bdun gyi tho rangs grongs skad/ yang khong gi zhal nas/ dar ma mdo sdes thog drangs pa'i/ /sa steng sems dpa' bcu gsum bkrongs/ /438

gdams pa/ 'o gsang sngag kyi rnal 'byo pa rtogs pa mthon por slebs nas/ sha chang bud med sogs 'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol pa rnams la khas gtong mi rung ste/ bde mchog ra la'i rgyud las/ bum nga/'i dbang thob dge bsnyen te/ /gsang ba'i dbang thob dge tshul yin/ /shes rab ye shes dge slong ste/ /rdzogs pa dge slong chen po yin/ /gsungs/ de la dgongs nas grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba sa ra ha chen pos mda' mkhan gyi bu mo phyag rgyar bzhes nas/ kha sang phan chad bram ze yin/ /de ring tshun chad dge slong yin/ /tshangs par spyod pa dge slong ste/ /he ru ka dpal dge slong mchog /gsungs/ 'gran gyi do med rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi zhal snga nas/ sha chang bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin/ /dam nyams gsod pa sngags kyi dam tshig yin/ /rig ma bsten pa las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /nga yis de ltar shes pa'i skabs shig na/ /'dul 'dzin dge slong dag dang 'gal ba med/ /de bas dam nyams log lta can khyod dag /zhag bdun tho rangs gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /zhes yi ge springs nas/ 'dul 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' zhig zhag bdun gyi tho rangs grongs skad/ yang khong gi zhal nas/ dar ma mdo sdes thog drangs pa'i/ /sa steng sems dpa' bcu gsum bkrongs/ /438

dmyal bar song yang 'gyod pa med/ /gsungs skad/ des na de lta bu'i sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pas gzhan bsad pa gso nus/gsang ba go nus/ dzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston nus pa'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra bsgral kyang /skyon gyis mi gos par ma zad 'tshengs pa gsum yang 'byung bar bshad snang / des na de lta bu'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas sha chang bud med la spyod kyang khas gtong mi nyan/ dag snang mi sbyong yang btang snyoms su 'jog dgos/ ma bzhag par khas btang na de 'dra tsho mgo la 'ong nyen yod pas dogs zon gyis dang bzang ngo yang bya lo'i ston mjug rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i yang sprul khri 'don mdzad dus/ gnyer ba rab byung song nas sku gsung thugs rten maṇ+ḍal dang ḍā ma ru dril bu/ shel gye gsol can/ rgyangs shel/ gos gzan/ dbus lham/ rta bzang po/gos chen rgyan bzhi/ lha rdzas ring po 'dom drug ma bcas phul/tshur ston skal yag po dang nang mdzod ring po zhig dang bcas gnang 'dug 'di nas sprul sku rin po che sku tshe rgyal mtshan yun ring brtan cing / rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i phyir/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ mkha' 439

dmyal bar song yang 'gyod pa med/ /gsungs skad/ des na de lta bu'i sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pas gzhan bsad pa gso nus/gsang ba go nus/ dzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston nus pa'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra bsgral kyang /skyon gyis mi gos par ma zad 'tshengs pa gsum yang 'byung bar bshad snang / des na de lta bu'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas sha chang bud med la spyod kyang khas gtong mi nyan/ dag snang mi sbyong yang btang snyoms su 'jog dgos/ ma bzhag par khas btang na de 'dra tsho mgo la 'ong nyen yod pas dogs zon gyis dang bzang ngo yang bya lo'i ston mjug rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i yang sprul khri 'don mdzad dus/ gnyer ba rab byung song nas sku gsung thugs rten maṇ+ḍal dang ḍā ma ru dril bu/ shel gye gsol can/ rgyangs shel/ gos gzan/ dbus lham/ rta bzang po/gos chen rgyan bzhi/ lha rdzas ring po 'dom drug ma bcas phul/tshur ston skal yag po dang nang mdzod ring po zhig dang bcas gnang 'dug 'di nas sprul sku rin po che sku tshe rgyal mtshan yun ring brtan cing / rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i phyir/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ mkha' 439

'gro chos skyong la 'phrin bcol/ bsngo ba smon lam gye mtshams sbyor yang dag byas/ sprul sku rin po che rong bo'i dgon par phebs pa'i nyin par/ chibs bsu ba brgya phrag mang po dang /gos rgyan mdzes pa'i ltad mo ba dang / mjal mi stong phrag mang po 'tshogs pa la/ rgya 'ga' res bltas nas/ mi gcig gi bsod nams la brten nas 'di rnams 'tshogs pa red/ sprul sku 'di bsod nams can zhig yin par gda' zhes zer skad/ngas 'di skad smras/ rgya cher rol ba las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i mi yi yid la bsam tshad 'grub/ /gsungs pa ltar khong gi bsod nams kyi mthus/ spyir 'gro ba yongs dang / sgos su reb gong gser mo ljongs 'di'i skya ser yongs kyi bsam don 'grub rgyu red byas pas/ dad can 'ga' res/ da ni reb gong la nyi ma shar song ba yin zer/ skal ba bzang bzang byed pa byung ngo / /yang nyin cig slob bu ye shes dar rgyas kyis yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa'i zhu yig 'di phul ba/rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /gsang gsum bkod pa gcig bsdus pa/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /bka' drin mtshungs min zhabs la 'dud/ /'gyur med chos 440

'gro chos skyong la 'phrin bcol/ bsngo ba smon lam gye mtshams sbyor yang dag byas/ sprul sku rin po che rong bo'i dgon par phebs pa'i nyin par/ chibs bsu ba brgya phrag mang po dang /gos rgyan mdzes pa'i ltad mo ba dang / mjal mi stong phrag mang po 'tshogs pa la/ rgya 'ga' res bltas nas/ mi gcig gi bsod nams la brten nas 'di rnams 'tshogs pa red/ sprul sku 'di bsod nams can zhig yin par gda' zhes zer skad/ngas 'di skad smras/ rgya cher rol ba las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bsod nams bsags pa'i mi yi yid la bsam tshad 'grub/ /gsungs pa ltar khong gi bsod nams kyi mthus/ spyir 'gro ba yongs dang / sgos su reb gong gser mo ljongs 'di'i skya ser yongs kyi bsam don 'grub rgyu red byas pas/ dad can 'ga' res/ da ni reb gong la nyi ma shar song ba yin zer/ skal ba bzang bzang byed pa byung ngo / /yang nyin cig slob bu ye shes dar rgyas kyis yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa'i zhu yig 'di phul ba/rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /gsang gsum bkod pa gcig bsdus pa/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /bka' drin mtshungs min zhabs la 'dud/ /'gyur med chos 440

sku'i nam mkha' la/ /spros pa thams cad nyer zhi yang / /chos kun gsal bar gzigs pa yi/ /rnam dag chos kyi sku la 'dud/ /rang snang don gyi 'og min du/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang / /nam mkha' ji srid rtag bzhugs pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs skur phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad la/ /brtse chen thugs rjes nyer gzigs nas/ /dpag med sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba 'dren la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu mtha' bral ba'i zhing khams na/ /mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /bdag gi dge ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /blo yis blangs nas khyed la 'bul/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can gyis/ /dug gsum sgo nas las bgyes pa/ /de dag thams cad mgon khyod kyi/ /spyan sngar bsam pa thag pas bshags/ /sku gsum thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /ji snyed mchis pa thams cad la/ /rab tu dga' bas yi rang ngo / 'gro kun sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /myur du sgrol bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zeg pa bla na med pa yi/ /chos 'khor rgyun du bskor bar bsgul/ /bdag sogs shin tu nyam thag pa'i/ /lus can kun la brtser dgongs nas/ /nam mkha' zad par ma gyur bar/ /gzugs sku brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum rgyal 441

sku'i nam mkha' la/ /spros pa thams cad nyer zhi yang / /chos kun gsal bar gzigs pa yi/ /rnam dag chos kyi sku la 'dud/ /rang snang don gyi 'og min du/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang / /nam mkha' ji srid rtag bzhugs pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs skur phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad la/ /brtse chen thugs rjes nyer gzigs nas/ /dpag med sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba 'dren la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu mtha' bral ba'i zhing khams na/ /mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /bdag gi dge ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /blo yis blangs nas khyed la 'bul/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can gyis/ /dug gsum sgo nas las bgyes pa/ /de dag thams cad mgon khyod kyi/ /spyan sngar bsam pa thag pas bshags/ /sku gsum thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /ji snyed mchis pa thams cad la/ /rab tu dga' bas yi rang ngo / 'gro kun sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /myur du sgrol bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zeg pa bla na med pa yi/ /chos 'khor rgyun du bskor bar bsgul/ /bdag sogs shin tu nyam thag pa'i/ /lus can kun la brtser dgongs nas/ /nam mkha' zad par ma gyur bar/ /gzugs sku brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum rgyal 441

dang rgyal sras dang / /rang rgyal slob ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i dge rtsa rnams/ /mgon khyod bzhed don 'grub phyir bsngo/ /bdag yid dad pas kun bslangs te/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /gus pas tshig 'ga' zhu ba la/ /brtse bas cung zad dgongs par zhu/ /phan mdzad khyod kyi bka' drin las/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag nyams blangs pas/ /nyams kyi skyes lugs cung zad 'di/ /mgon khyod mnyes pa'i mchod par 'bul/ /rje la rtse gcig gsol btab nas/ /rtog med sems 'dzin byas pa'i tshe/ /lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa dang / /ldan pa'i g.yo med ting 'dzin rnyed/ /de yi ngang la sor rtog gis/ /sems dang bdag la dpyad pa na/ /sems nyid skye ba med pa dang / /bdag ma rnyed pas rab tu 'jigs/ /nges shes de yi rgyun de nyid/ /dpyad bzhin legs par bskyangs pa yis/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med la/ /nges pa gong du 'phel bar gyur/ /rang gsal rang gdangs ma 'gags pa'i/ /tha mal shes pa ma bcos pa/ /rgyun chad med par bskyangs gyur na/ /de gas chog par legs par go /mtshan 'dzin dmigs pa'i gtad so zhig /'khor 'das rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid/ /'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa de/ /phyag rgya chen po yin nam snyam/ /mnyam 442

dang rgyal sras dang / /rang rgyal slob ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i dge rtsa rnams/ /mgon khyod bzhed don 'grub phyir bsngo/ /bdag yid dad pas kun bslangs te/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /gus pas tshig 'ga' zhu ba la/ /brtse bas cung zad dgongs par zhu/ /phan mdzad khyod kyi bka' drin las/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag nyams blangs pas/ /nyams kyi skyes lugs cung zad 'di/ /mgon khyod mnyes pa'i mchod par 'bul/ /rje la rtse gcig gsol btab nas/ /rtog med sems 'dzin byas pa'i tshe/ /lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa dang / /ldan pa'i g.yo med ting 'dzin rnyed/ /de yi ngang la sor rtog gis/ /sems dang bdag la dpyad pa na/ /sems nyid skye ba med pa dang / /bdag ma rnyed pas rab tu 'jigs/ /nges shes de yi rgyun de nyid/ /dpyad bzhin legs par bskyangs pa yis/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med la/ /nges pa gong du 'phel bar gyur/ /rang gsal rang gdangs ma 'gags pa'i/ /tha mal shes pa ma bcos pa/ /rgyun chad med par bskyangs gyur na/ /de gas chog par legs par go /mtshan 'dzin dmigs pa'i gtad so zhig /'khor 'das rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid/ /'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa de/ /phyag rgya chen po yin nam snyam/ /mnyam 442

gzhag nam mkha' lta bu la/ /yid ngor gnyis snang nub pa dang / /yod dang med pa'i mtha' yas 'das/ /'di yin 'di min nges bzung bral/ /rjes thob dus su gang snang gi /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur go /de la 'dzin pas mi 'ching bar rang sar snang ba tsam du 'dug /de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa las/ /'thob bya thob byed las 'das kyang / /rtogs par rim gyes nar son te/ /chos kyi sku dang mjal bar shog /mgon po khyod la dad pa dang / /yid ni dga' bas gang ba dang / /tshe lhag sgrub pas 'da' snyam pa'i/ /spro ba yang dang yang du byung / /rjes su mkha' mnyam 'gro ba la/ /dmigs pa'i snying rje cher bskyed nas/ /de las byung ba'i dge rtsa rnams/ /rnam grol 'thob phyir nan tan bsngos/ /go yul rtogs pa nyung zad 'di/ /dus gsum dge dang chabs gcig par/ /dpal ldan bla ma mnyes phyir phul/ /bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /ring min zung 'jug mngon gyur nas/ /lus can skye dgu mtha' dag la/ /phan bde dpal yon sbyin nus par/ /rje btsun bla mas byen gyes rlobs/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bka' drin mtshungs med khyod nyid dang / /skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/443

gzhag nam mkha' lta bu la/ /yid ngor gnyis snang nub pa dang / /yod dang med pa'i mtha' yas 'das/ /'di yin 'di min nges bzung bral/ /rjes thob dus su gang snang gi /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur go /de la 'dzin pas mi 'ching bar rang sar snang ba tsam du 'dug /de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa las/ /'thob bya thob byed las 'das kyang / /rtogs par rim gyes nar son te/ /chos kyi sku dang mjal bar shog /mgon po khyod la dad pa dang / /yid ni dga' bas gang ba dang / /tshe lhag sgrub pas 'da' snyam pa'i/ /spro ba yang dang yang du byung / /rjes su mkha' mnyam 'gro ba la/ /dmigs pa'i snying rje cher bskyed nas/ /de las byung ba'i dge rtsa rnams/ /rnam grol 'thob phyir nan tan bsngos/ /go yul rtogs pa nyung zad 'di/ /dus gsum dge dang chabs gcig par/ /dpal ldan bla ma mnyes phyir phul/ /bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /ring min zung 'jug mngon gyur nas/ /lus can skye dgu mtha' dag la/ /phan bde dpal yon sbyin nus par/ /rje btsun bla mas byen gyes rlobs/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bka' drin mtshungs med khyod nyid dang / /skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson par shog /ces phul ba'i lan du/443

kye skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis zhi gnas kyi ngang nas dpyad bsgom 'jog bsgom yang yang byas pas bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis/ sems kyi ngo bo nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba/ston ga'i nyi ma gung gi nam mkha' sprin med pa'i dkyil lta bu dag pa/ dmigs pa med cing / snang ba med pa nyid/ mthong med tshul du rang gis mthong la/ nges shes skyes pa ni/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba'i rtogs pa yin no/ /da dung mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du ri khrod dben pa da bsten la/ de ltar du skyongs dang / sems ngo skyong tshul bla na med pa yin no/ /rje mar pa lo tsās/ rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ bu khyod la de lta bu zhig re yang re ste/ byung yang byung 'dug gsungs pa ltar 'dug pas dga' ba sgoms/ bla ma la gsol ba re thob la/spros med kho na gyis dang / tshe 'di nyid la gtan gyi lam sna zin par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas de lugs kyi skyabs 'jug bsngo smon bya zhes phul ba nyams rtogs 'phel bar gyur cig ces smras pas kho dga' zhing spro bar gyur to//yang skal ldan slob ma mang po yod pa'i dus shig la/ thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pa dge slong yon tan gyis/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ sngar bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi nang 444

kye skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis zhi gnas kyi ngang nas dpyad bsgom 'jog bsgom yang yang byas pas bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis/ sems kyi ngo bo nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba/ston ga'i nyi ma gung gi nam mkha' sprin med pa'i dkyil lta bu dag pa/ dmigs pa med cing / snang ba med pa nyid/ mthong med tshul du rang gis mthong la/ nges shes skyes pa ni/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba'i rtogs pa yin no/ /da dung mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du ri khrod dben pa da bsten la/ de ltar du skyongs dang / sems ngo skyong tshul bla na med pa yin no/ /rje mar pa lo tsās/ rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ bu khyod la de lta bu zhig re yang re ste/ byung yang byung 'dug gsungs pa ltar 'dug pas dga' ba sgoms/ bla ma la gsol ba re thob la/spros med kho na gyis dang / tshe 'di nyid la gtan gyi lam sna zin par 'gyur ro/ /'di nas de lugs kyi skyabs 'jug bsngo smon bya zhes phul ba nyams rtogs 'phel bar gyur cig ces smras pas kho dga' zhing spro bar gyur to//yang skal ldan slob ma mang po yod pa'i dus shig la/ thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pa dge slong yon tan gyis/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ sngar bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi nang 444

nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po sus byas 'dug lags zhus pas/ de'i lan du 'di skad smras/ phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la rje rin po ches bya ba rgya chen po mdzad mdzad cig su gang gis ma mdzad 'dugakhong gis chung nas bzung thos pa rgya chen po btsal/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che gzhan gyis ma rtogs log rtogs the tshom gye dri mas 'bags pa rnams/ lung rigs brgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas bye dor yang yang mdzad nas gser sbyangs btso ma lta bur byas/ lha ldan jo bo rin po che la/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan phul/rgya lo'i sgon lam chen mo btsugs/ sngar med pa'i mchod pa'i srol btod/ sa kun li khris 'bags pa ltar bslab gsum nor bu'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing / 'phags nor rin chen bdun gyes phyug pa'i ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshos lha ldan 'dzin ma'i khyon kun dog por bgyi nus pa tsam 'tshogs pa byung / de kun gyis smon lam rgya chen po gsungs/khong gi thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthus stod dza ti dbyug gus brdungs sa man chad nas/ smad rgya mo chu la dar 'thag sa yan chad rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs re tsam du ma song bar/ mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi 445

nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po sus byas 'dug lags zhus pas/ de'i lan du 'di skad smras/ phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la rje rin po ches bya ba rgya chen po mdzad mdzad cig su gang gis ma mdzad 'dugakhong gis chung nas bzung thos pa rgya chen po btsal/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che gzhan gyis ma rtogs log rtogs the tshom gye dri mas 'bags pa rnams/ lung rigs brgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas bye dor yang yang mdzad nas gser sbyangs btso ma lta bur byas/ lha ldan jo bo rin po che la/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan phul/rgya lo'i sgon lam chen mo btsugs/ sngar med pa'i mchod pa'i srol btod/ sa kun li khris 'bags pa ltar bslab gsum nor bu'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing / 'phags nor rin chen bdun gyes phyug pa'i ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshos lha ldan 'dzin ma'i khyon kun dog por bgyi nus pa tsam 'tshogs pa byung / de kun gyis smon lam rgya chen po gsungs/khong gi thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthus stod dza ti dbyug gus brdungs sa man chad nas/ smad rgya mo chu la dar 'thag sa yan chad rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs re tsam du ma song bar/ mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi 445

bstan pa rin po che gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu/ dper na gangs ri dkar po la nyi ma ser po shar ba bzhin du phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas rgyu byung ba 'di khong gi drin yin/ deng sang bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' thams cad kyi nang nas rje rin po che'i ring lugs dri ma med pa zhes gzhan las rab dang phul dang mchog tu gyur pa 'di byung ngo / /yang sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i che ba 'byen pa la rje btsun mi la ras pa lta bu zhig sngar ma byung / sngon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku phreng zhig rgya nag tu phebs dus/nyin cig gong ma rin po ches/ khyed tsho'i bod la sngar pho rgod po su byung 'dug ces bka' phebs pa la/ khong gis rje btsun mi la ras pa zer ba'i pho rgod po zhig byung 'dug zhus/ khos pho rgod po'i bya ba gang byas 'dug gsungs/ khos dang po mthu brgyab nas mi sum cu so lnga bsad/ ser ba phab nas lo tog thams cad bcom/ bya byi bra bye bgrang las 'das pa bsad pa la 'gyod nas chos byas/ thog mar rje lho brag mar pa lo tsā bsten dus sras mkhar dgu thog brtsigs/ rgyab la sgal pa gsum thon rag bar du sa rdo khur nas brtsigs grub pa dang snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa gnang / de nas brag dkar rta so'i 446

bstan pa rin po che gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu/ dper na gangs ri dkar po la nyi ma ser po shar ba bzhin du phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas rgyu byung ba 'di khong gi drin yin/ deng sang bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' thams cad kyi nang nas rje rin po che'i ring lugs dri ma med pa zhes gzhan las rab dang phul dang mchog tu gyur pa 'di byung ngo / /yang sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i che ba 'byen pa la rje btsun mi la ras pa lta bu zhig sngar ma byung / sngon paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku phreng zhig rgya nag tu phebs dus/nyin cig gong ma rin po ches/ khyed tsho'i bod la sngar pho rgod po su byung 'dug ces bka' phebs pa la/ khong gis rje btsun mi la ras pa zer ba'i pho rgod po zhig byung 'dug zhus/ khos pho rgod po'i bya ba gang byas 'dug gsungs/ khos dang po mthu brgyab nas mi sum cu so lnga bsad/ ser ba phab nas lo tog thams cad bcom/ bya byi bra bye bgrang las 'das pa bsad pa la 'gyod nas chos byas/ thog mar rje lho brag mar pa lo tsā bsten dus sras mkhar dgu thog brtsigs/ rgyab la sgal pa gsum thon rag bar du sa rdo khur nas brtsigs grub pa dang snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa gnang / de nas brag dkar rta so'i 446

dben gnas su mi lo drug gi bar du zwa la dka' ba spyad/ sha zad pags pa la spu sngo zhol le skyes rag bar du snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms pas/ ring por mi thogs par tshe gcig lus gcig po la mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas/ dngos su nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / ri brag la 'dzul ba dang / chu la ma bying ba dang / lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas skye bo gzhan la ston pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung sna tshogs pa bstan nas/ ma dad log lta the tshom can gyi snang ba yang rang dbang med par chos la bsgyur nas/ mthong thos dran reg gi sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i mthar gdul bya rdzogs pa dang / dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi'i lo ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa skye bo phal ba kun gyi mig gi lam du yang gsal bar bstan nas thams cad dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing / byang chub mchog gi sa bon skrun bzhin du gang zag las dag pa'i snang ngor seng ge dkar mo rgyan du mas brgyan pa gcig la chibs nas rdo rje phag mos chibs mthur nas khrid de 'od kyi lam la shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su gshegs song 'dug lags zhus pas/ gong mas kyang phyag thal mo sbyar nas/ 'o de dang pho rgod 447

dben gnas su mi lo drug gi bar du zwa la dka' ba spyad/ sha zad pags pa la spu sngo zhol le skyes rag bar du snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms pas/ ring por mi thogs par tshe gcig lus gcig po la mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas/ dngos su nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / ri brag la 'dzul ba dang / chu la ma bying ba dang / lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas skye bo gzhan la ston pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung sna tshogs pa bstan nas/ ma dad log lta the tshom can gyi snang ba yang rang dbang med par chos la bsgyur nas/ mthong thos dran reg gi sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i mthar gdul bya rdzogs pa dang / dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi'i lo ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa skye bo phal ba kun gyi mig gi lam du yang gsal bar bstan nas thams cad dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing / byang chub mchog gi sa bon skrun bzhin du gang zag las dag pa'i snang ngor seng ge dkar mo rgyan du mas brgyan pa gcig la chibs nas rdo rje phag mos chibs mthur nas khrid de 'od kyi lam la shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su gshegs song 'dug lags zhus pas/ gong mas kyang phyag thal mo sbyar nas/ 'o de dang pho rgod 447

po byung 'dug gsungs skad/ des na bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la bya ba de 'dra bya dgos par gda' ste/ de 'dra dka' mor gda'/ 'on kyang khyod kyis bstan 'gro'i mig rkyen du 'gro ba'i bya ba ci byas snyam na/ ngas kyang nang ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i khyad chos/ snying rje chen po 'di nyams dma' ru song nas/chos pa rnams kyi rgyud na yang snying rje med par dman sprang po rnams la lhag par sdang ba'i snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ chung nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gsung bzhin du/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis la blo sbyangs/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i blos khe rgyal gzhan la gtong zhing pham kha rang gis yin pa/ gnod lan phan pas 'jal nus pa'i gdeng thob pa'i tshe/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/smad mdo khams sgang gsum gyi tshe sngon pha mar gyur pa'i drin can rnams/ tshe 'dir lto gos kyis phongs nas nyam thag pa'i sprang po 'chi la nye ba brgya phrag stong phrag du ma lto gos chos gsum gyis bskyangs nas kun gyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen byas pa'i tshe/ de kun gyis kyang nga yang mchod bstod bkur nas deng sang chos mthun snyoms chung brgya stong mang po'i mgon sngar med pa'i sprang dpon gsar ba bla ma zhabs dkar pa zhes 448

po byung 'dug gsungs skad/ des na bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la bya ba de 'dra bya dgos par gda' ste/ de 'dra dka' mor gda'/ 'on kyang khyod kyis bstan 'gro'i mig rkyen du 'gro ba'i bya ba ci byas snyam na/ ngas kyang nang ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i khyad chos/ snying rje chen po 'di nyams dma' ru song nas/chos pa rnams kyi rgyud na yang snying rje med par dman sprang po rnams la lhag par sdang ba'i snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ chung nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gsung bzhin du/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis la blo sbyangs/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i blos khe rgyal gzhan la gtong zhing pham kha rang gis yin pa/ gnod lan phan pas 'jal nus pa'i gdeng thob pa'i tshe/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/smad mdo khams sgang gsum gyi tshe sngon pha mar gyur pa'i drin can rnams/ tshe 'dir lto gos kyis phongs nas nyam thag pa'i sprang po 'chi la nye ba brgya phrag stong phrag du ma lto gos chos gsum gyis bskyangs nas kun gyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen byas pa'i tshe/ de kun gyis kyang nga yang mchod bstod bkur nas deng sang chos mthun snyoms chung brgya stong mang po'i mgon sngar med pa'i sprang dpon gsar ba bla ma zhabs dkar pa zhes 448

yongs su grags pa cig byung / da nga lo lon red shi na yang chos pa snying rje can dang sprang po rnams kyis gleng ba'i dmigs rnams yag po zhig phye song snyam/ zhes bshad pas kun gyis deng sang dus 'dir khyed kyi mdzad pa 'di yang bka' drin che bar gda'/ zhes rjes su yi rang byed mkhan byung / yang ma phyag sprul sku/ hor sprul sku/ skal ldan sprul sku sogs skal bzang slob ma yongs la gdams pa/ de yang mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gshegs pa'i shul/ gsang sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i bsgod pa gcig pa'i lam zab pa dang rgya che ba 'di go dgos/ bstan pa'i khog srol chen po 'di ma go na/ gdams chung i thi mtshal mgo ma re la tsir zin du bsgoms pas cir 'gyur cha med gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa chen po byang chub rin chen gyi zhal nas/gdams ngag la nang byan tshud pa ni/ be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la nges pa rnyed pa la mi zer gyi/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba la zer zhes pa dang / jo bo chen po'i slob ma sgom pa rin chen bla mas/ a ti sha 'i gdams ngag la stan thog gcig tu lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlags pas/da gzhung lugs thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba gcig byung /449

yongs su grags pa cig byung / da nga lo lon red shi na yang chos pa snying rje can dang sprang po rnams kyis gleng ba'i dmigs rnams yag po zhig phye song snyam/ zhes bshad pas kun gyis deng sang dus 'dir khyed kyi mdzad pa 'di yang bka' drin che bar gda'/ zhes rjes su yi rang byed mkhan byung / yang ma phyag sprul sku/ hor sprul sku/ skal ldan sprul sku sogs skal bzang slob ma yongs la gdams pa/ de yang mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gshegs pa'i shul/ gsang sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i bsgod pa gcig pa'i lam zab pa dang rgya che ba 'di go dgos/ bstan pa'i khog srol chen po 'di ma go na/ gdams chung i thi mtshal mgo ma re la tsir zin du bsgoms pas cir 'gyur cha med gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa chen po byang chub rin chen gyi zhal nas/gdams ngag la nang byan tshud pa ni/ be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la nges pa rnyed pa la mi zer gyi/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba la zer zhes pa dang / jo bo chen po'i slob ma sgom pa rin chen bla mas/ a ti sha 'i gdams ngag la stan thog gcig tu lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlags pas/da gzhung lugs thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba gcig byung /449

gsungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas kyang / bstan pa rin po che gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes gsungs/ des na mdo sngags kyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa phyogs rer ma song bar/ thams cad la blo sbyangs nas bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer mkhas pa sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje dang / 'jam gon bla ma tsong kha ba yab sras/skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen rnam gnyis lta bu la yid smon bya ba dgos te/ kun mkhyen khri gung thang pa rin po ches/ phyogs rer ma gyur thos pa'i don/ /bsam dang sgom pas nyams blangs na/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang po/ /tshang la ma nor rnyed gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar smon lam yan chad 'debs pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /zhes smras pas kun gyis de ltar byas bstan 'gro la phan thogs pa sha stag byung ngo / /yang slob ma tshe blos btang ri khrod pa rnams kyi sems la 'dzin rgyu de la/ dang po sems can la dmigs pa'i byams snying rje sgoms la smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ de nas mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la 'jog dus/ snang ba tsho yangs khrol le/ shes pa tsho dga' yal ler zhog dang / rjes su sems can la snying rje tsho brtse dung nge / mig nas mchi ma tsho mod chil le 450

gsungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas kyang / bstan pa rin po che gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes gsungs/ des na mdo sngags kyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa phyogs rer ma song bar/ thams cad la blo sbyangs nas bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer mkhas pa sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje dang / 'jam gon bla ma tsong kha ba yab sras/skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen rnam gnyis lta bu la yid smon bya ba dgos te/ kun mkhyen khri gung thang pa rin po ches/ phyogs rer ma gyur thos pa'i don/ /bsam dang sgom pas nyams blangs na/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang po/ /tshang la ma nor rnyed gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar smon lam yan chad 'debs pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /zhes smras pas kun gyis de ltar byas bstan 'gro la phan thogs pa sha stag byung ngo / /yang slob ma tshe blos btang ri khrod pa rnams kyi sems la 'dzin rgyu de la/ dang po sems can la dmigs pa'i byams snying rje sgoms la smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ de nas mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la 'jog dus/ snang ba tsho yangs khrol le/ shes pa tsho dga' yal ler zhog dang / rjes su sems can la snying rje tsho brtse dung nge / mig nas mchi ma tsho mod chil le 450

byung na/ tshad med bzhi'i smon lam thob dang / de kho nas chos pa bzang po zhig 'ong nges/ chos mang mi dgos/ gnad la 'gro dgos/ 'o chos kyi gnad 'gag de gang yin snyam na/ de 'di yin te/ dge bshes glang ri thang ba'i zhal nas/ kho bos chos ci tsam pa'i zhal phyes nas bltas te/ skyon thams cad rang gi yin/yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can gyi yin/ de'i gnad ga'i khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ gyong dang pham kha rang gis longs bya ba 'di min pa go rgyu mi 'dug gsungs/ des na chos rnam dag cig byed na rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di 'dra la slob dgos/ zhes smras pas khe rgyal gzhan la byen/ pham kha rang gis len nus pa'i chos pa bzang po kha shas byung ngo / /yang nyin gcig bkra shis 'khyel ba'i ri rtser khams bsang byas nas sdod dus tsong kha'i skyes ri mthong ba'i rkyen byas rtsa ba'i bla ma gser khang rdo rje 'chang dran nas gdung dbyangs 'di blangs so//shar tsong kha'i sgyes ri'i rtse mo na/ /sprin dkar po yar la langs pa mthong / /de mthong bas mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sku'i bkod pa gsung gdangs yid la shar/ /sprin dkar po lding ba'i 'og phyogs kyi/ /gnas gser khang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /451

byung na/ tshad med bzhi'i smon lam thob dang / de kho nas chos pa bzang po zhig 'ong nges/ chos mang mi dgos/ gnad la 'gro dgos/ 'o chos kyi gnad 'gag de gang yin snyam na/ de 'di yin te/ dge bshes glang ri thang ba'i zhal nas/ kho bos chos ci tsam pa'i zhal phyes nas bltas te/ skyon thams cad rang gi yin/yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can gyi yin/ de'i gnad ga'i khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ gyong dang pham kha rang gis longs bya ba 'di min pa go rgyu mi 'dug gsungs/ des na chos rnam dag cig byed na rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di 'dra la slob dgos/ zhes smras pas khe rgyal gzhan la byen/ pham kha rang gis len nus pa'i chos pa bzang po kha shas byung ngo / /yang nyin gcig bkra shis 'khyel ba'i ri rtser khams bsang byas nas sdod dus tsong kha'i skyes ri mthong ba'i rkyen byas rtsa ba'i bla ma gser khang rdo rje 'chang dran nas gdung dbyangs 'di blangs so//shar tsong kha'i sgyes ri'i rtse mo na/ /sprin dkar po yar la langs pa mthong / /de mthong bas mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sku'i bkod pa gsung gdangs yid la shar/ /sprin dkar po lding ba'i 'og phyogs kyi/ /gnas gser khang dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /451

mtshan yongs grags gser khang rdo rje 'chang / /dus yun ring bzhugs nas sgrub pa mdzad/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga mos gus chung rung mjal snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing drin can bla ma dran/ /'khor mched grogs rnams kyang dran nas byung / /spyir mdo smad phyogs 'di'i bstan 'gro la/ /mgon khyod kyi bka' drin bsam mi khyab/ /sgos bya btang ri khrod pa rnams kyi/ /blo chos la phyogs pa khyod kyi drin/ /sprang bya btang ri khrod pa rnams la/ /nor zang zing 'bul ba ma mchis kyang / /dus da nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /chos sgrub pa'i mchod pa rgyun du 'bul/ /steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang nas/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /bu bdag sogs gdul bya thams cad la/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyed dang mjal ba'i skal ldan rnams/ /dus nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus skabs su/ /yar dga' ldan zhing du legs khrid nas/ /mgon khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /ces blangs pas der 'khod pa'i bu slob rnams kyis kyang khong gi bka' drin dran nas/ mig nas mchi ma gtong ba yang byung / yang dad can gyi slob ma mang po 'dzom pa'i dus shig la/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i sprul sku zhi ba 'tshos/ bla ma rin po che/ sems la phan pa'i 452

mtshan yongs grags gser khang rdo rje 'chang / /dus yun ring bzhugs nas sgrub pa mdzad/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga mos gus chung rung mjal snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing drin can bla ma dran/ /'khor mched grogs rnams kyang dran nas byung / /spyir mdo smad phyogs 'di'i bstan 'gro la/ /mgon khyod kyi bka' drin bsam mi khyab/ /sgos bya btang ri khrod pa rnams kyi/ /blo chos la phyogs pa khyod kyi drin/ /sprang bya btang ri khrod pa rnams la/ /nor zang zing 'bul ba ma mchis kyang / /dus da nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /chos sgrub pa'i mchod pa rgyun du 'bul/ /steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang nas/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /bu bdag sogs gdul bya thams cad la/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyed dang mjal ba'i skal ldan rnams/ /dus nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus skabs su/ /yar dga' ldan zhing du legs khrid nas/ /mgon khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /ces blangs pas der 'khod pa'i bu slob rnams kyis kyang khong gi bka' drin dran nas/ mig nas mchi ma gtong ba yang byung / yang dad can gyi slob ma mang po 'dzom pa'i dus shig la/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i sprul sku zhi ba 'tshos/ bla ma rin po che/ sems la phan pa'i 452

bka' chos shig gnang dgos zhes zhus pas/ nga'i sems la bka' gdams pa'i gsung gis phan pa byung / khyed rnams kyi sems la yang phan yong zhes 'di skad smras/ 'o sngon jo bo rje la/'brom ston pas chos thams cad kyi mthar thug gang lags zhus pas/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin gsungs/ dper na 'jig rten na sman dpa' bo gcig thub bya ba/ nad thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig yod pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du sman dpa' bo gcig thub lta bu/ chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs na nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen bor 'gro ba yin gsungs/ 'o na stong nyid rtogs zer ba kun gyes chags sdang kha ma bri bar gda' ba ci lags zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ de kun kha stong du song ba yin/ stong pa nyid kyi don gsha' ma rtogs na/ lus ngag yid gsum ras bal rdog pas mnan pa 'am/ phye thug la zo mar bskyur ba bzhin du 'gro gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa la slob ma sku mched gsum gyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus nas nyams su blangs pa'i thabs shig zhu lags zhus pas/ 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas/ rten gyi gang zag gcig thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par byed pa la 453

bka' chos shig gnang dgos zhes zhus pas/ nga'i sems la bka' gdams pa'i gsung gis phan pa byung / khyed rnams kyi sems la yang phan yong zhes 'di skad smras/ 'o sngon jo bo rje la/'brom ston pas chos thams cad kyi mthar thug gang lags zhus pas/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin gsungs/ dper na 'jig rten na sman dpa' bo gcig thub bya ba/ nad thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig yod pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du sman dpa' bo gcig thub lta bu/ chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs na nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen bor 'gro ba yin gsungs/ 'o na stong nyid rtogs zer ba kun gyes chags sdang kha ma bri bar gda' ba ci lags zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ de kun kha stong du song ba yin/ stong pa nyid kyi don gsha' ma rtogs na/ lus ngag yid gsum ras bal rdog pas mnan pa 'am/ phye thug la zo mar bskyur ba bzhin du 'gro gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa la slob ma sku mched gsum gyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus nas nyams su blangs pa'i thabs shig zhu lags zhus pas/ 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas/ rten gyi gang zag gcig thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par byed pa la 453

lam gyi 'jug sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang / rgyud la skye bar bya rgyu'i dngos po gcig las med/ gcig bo gang yin na/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin/ de la bye brag tu phye na/stong pa ni don dam byang chub kyi sems te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam/ gnas lugs ye nas skye med du rtogs pa de yin/ snying rje ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems te/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje chen po skye ba de yin/ des na theg pa chen po'i lam nyams su len pa rnams kyis/ dang po byang chub kyi sems gnyis po de rgyud la ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs la 'bad cing / bar du yang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skyes pa de nyid la sbyangs pas/ tha ma mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu chos sku dang gzugs sku mngon sum du 'thob nges pa yin gsungs/ des na nyams len nus na 'di kho nas chog par gda'/ yang 'phan yul spras kyi 'brom za lo 'tsho mas/ rwa sgreng du nas ya bzhi bcu phul nas/ ming bo 'brom tshigs pas/ da res gtam gtang ba la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa lags/ 'di na bzhugs pa'i grwa pa 'di rnams kyang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bya ba'i don du 'dus pa lags/ bdag cag ming sring yang de nyid 'thob par 454

lam gyi 'jug sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang / rgyud la skye bar bya rgyu'i dngos po gcig las med/ gcig bo gang yin na/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin/ de la bye brag tu phye na/stong pa ni don dam byang chub kyi sems te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam/ gnas lugs ye nas skye med du rtogs pa de yin/ snying rje ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems te/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje chen po skye ba de yin/ des na theg pa chen po'i lam nyams su len pa rnams kyis/ dang po byang chub kyi sems gnyis po de rgyud la ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs la 'bad cing / bar du yang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skyes pa de nyid la sbyangs pas/ tha ma mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu chos sku dang gzugs sku mngon sum du 'thob nges pa yin gsungs/ des na nyams len nus na 'di kho nas chog par gda'/ yang 'phan yul spras kyi 'brom za lo 'tsho mas/ rwa sgreng du nas ya bzhi bcu phul nas/ ming bo 'brom tshigs pas/ da res gtam gtang ba la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa lags/ 'di na bzhugs pa'i grwa pa 'di rnams kyang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bya ba'i don du 'dus pa lags/ bdag cag ming sring yang de nyid 'thob par 454

bya ba'i phyir 'dus pa lags pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa la jo bo lha gcig gi gdams pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnga' ba lags pas/ de ring sangs rgyas 'thob par bya ba'i gdams ngag mi gsang bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ dang po 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang las 'bras mang du bsgoms la/ rang gis khas blangs pa'i bsrung sdom kun dag par bya/ byams pa dang snying rje mang du bsgoms la/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par bya/ de'i phyir tshogs gnyis thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bsags/ sgrib pa thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sbyangs pa la 'bad par bya/ chos thams cad 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i rtsis zin pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya/ de ltar byas na jo bo rje dang ma mjal snyam pa'i mya ngan byed mi dgos/ sangs rgya bar byed pa la chos de las med/ phyis nas 'brom rgad po dang ma 'phrad snyam pa'i mya ngan bya mi dgos/chos de las med gsungs/ des na jo bo yab sras dang mjal yang sangs rgya ba la gdams ngag des lhag cig ston rgyu mi 'dug nga la yang des lhag cig yod na byas mna' thon pas/kun yid ches par gyis la nyams len la 'bad 'tshal/ zhes 455

bya ba'i phyir 'dus pa lags pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa la jo bo lha gcig gi gdams pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnga' ba lags pas/ de ring sangs rgyas 'thob par bya ba'i gdams ngag mi gsang bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ dang po 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang las 'bras mang du bsgoms la/ rang gis khas blangs pa'i bsrung sdom kun dag par bya/ byams pa dang snying rje mang du bsgoms la/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par bya/ de'i phyir tshogs gnyis thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bsags/ sgrib pa thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sbyangs pa la 'bad par bya/ chos thams cad 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i rtsis zin pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya/ de ltar byas na jo bo rje dang ma mjal snyam pa'i mya ngan byed mi dgos/ sangs rgya bar byed pa la chos de las med/ phyis nas 'brom rgad po dang ma 'phrad snyam pa'i mya ngan bya mi dgos/chos de las med gsungs/ des na jo bo yab sras dang mjal yang sangs rgya ba la gdams ngag des lhag cig ston rgyu mi 'dug nga la yang des lhag cig yod na byas mna' thon pas/kun yid ches par gyis la nyams len la 'bad 'tshal/ zhes 455

bshad pas snam bu tshos kyis bsgyur pa ltar kun gyi blo kha chos la 'gyur nas chos pa byang chub sems dpa' mang po byung / yang nyin cig blo ldan 'tsho 'du'i sprul sku/ spyi ram pa sogs dad 'dus kyi slob ma rnams kyi sems la phan phyir bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung dang mthun pa'i chos bshad 'di byas/ 'o de yang dge bshes spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob par byed pa la/ 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa zhig la bslab dgos/ de la 'jig rten pa ni/ sems can pas sangs rgyas gces par 'dzin/ gzhan pas rang gces par 'dzin/ gnod pa byed pa bas phan 'dogs pa gces par 'dzin/ sdug bsngal bas bde ba gces par 'dzin/ 'o skol de dag las bzlog dgos pas/ de la sangs rgyas pas sems can gces par 'dzin dgos pas/ rang bas gzhan gces par 'dzin dgos/ phan 'dogs pa bas gnod pa skyel ba gces par 'dzin dgos/ bde ba bas sdug bsngal gces par 'dzin dgos/ de ltar 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa'i chos bzhi yod na/ mo ma rnon pos mo bzang ba bzhin ci yang bya mi dgos/bzhi po de med na mo ngan pa bzhin ci byas kyang mi phan gsungs/yang chos brgyad don du gnyer ba'i 'jig rten pa dang mi 456

bshad pas snam bu tshos kyis bsgyur pa ltar kun gyi blo kha chos la 'gyur nas chos pa byang chub sems dpa' mang po byung / yang nyin cig blo ldan 'tsho 'du'i sprul sku/ spyi ram pa sogs dad 'dus kyi slob ma rnams kyi sems la phan phyir bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung dang mthun pa'i chos bshad 'di byas/ 'o de yang dge bshes spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob par byed pa la/ 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa zhig la bslab dgos/ de la 'jig rten pa ni/ sems can pas sangs rgyas gces par 'dzin/ gzhan pas rang gces par 'dzin/ gnod pa byed pa bas phan 'dogs pa gces par 'dzin/ sdug bsngal bas bde ba gces par 'dzin/ 'o skol de dag las bzlog dgos pas/ de la sangs rgyas pas sems can gces par 'dzin dgos pas/ rang bas gzhan gces par 'dzin dgos/ phan 'dogs pa bas gnod pa skyel ba gces par 'dzin dgos/ bde ba bas sdug bsngal gces par 'dzin dgos/ de ltar 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa'i chos bzhi yod na/ mo ma rnon pos mo bzang ba bzhin ci yang bya mi dgos/bzhi po de med na mo ngan pa bzhin ci byas kyang mi phan gsungs/yang chos brgyad don du gnyer ba'i 'jig rten pa dang mi 456

mthun pa zhig byed dgos/ de la 'jig rten pa'i chos brgyad kyi 'dod phyogs/ rnyed pa dang / bde ba/ snyan pa dang / bstod pa bzhi byung na dang du len cing / mi 'dod phyogs rnyed pa dang /mi bde ba/ mi snyan pa dang / smad pa bzhi byung na spong ba yin/'o skol chos pa rnams de las bzlog dgos/ de la 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi mi 'dod phyogs ma rnyed pa/ mi bde ba/ mi snyan pa dang / smad pa bzhi byung na dang du len cing / 'dod phyogs rnyed pa dang / bde ba/ snyan pa dang bstod pa bzhi byung na spong ba yin/ de ltar 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa cig byas na/chos pa rnam dag yong / mdor na 'jig rten pas khe dang rgyal kha rang gis len cing / gyong dang pham kha gzhan la ster yong /chos pas de dang mi mthun par/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster zhing / gyong dang pham kha rang gis len dgos/ de ltar byas na 'jig rten pa phar zhog chos pa kun gyi nang nas kyang rab dang phul dang mchog tu gyur pa cig 'ong / de ltar ma yin pa'i 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa'i chos pa spro rkyal/ mi su la yang mi mthun pa thag nyer btud tshud med ni zhig gyis zhes bshad ni ma red byas pas/ 'ga' re 'dzum pa byung / yang dang brtson shes rab snyeng rje dang ldan pa'i skal ldan slob ma rna gong 457

mthun pa zhig byed dgos/ de la 'jig rten pa'i chos brgyad kyi 'dod phyogs/ rnyed pa dang / bde ba/ snyan pa dang / bstod pa bzhi byung na dang du len cing / mi 'dod phyogs rnyed pa dang /mi bde ba/ mi snyan pa dang / smad pa bzhi byung na spong ba yin/'o skol chos pa rnams de las bzlog dgos/ de la 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi mi 'dod phyogs ma rnyed pa/ mi bde ba/ mi snyan pa dang / smad pa bzhi byung na dang du len cing / 'dod phyogs rnyed pa dang / bde ba/ snyan pa dang bstod pa bzhi byung na spong ba yin/ de ltar 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa cig byas na/chos pa rnam dag yong / mdor na 'jig rten pas khe dang rgyal kha rang gis len cing / gyong dang pham kha gzhan la ster yong /chos pas de dang mi mthun par/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster zhing / gyong dang pham kha rang gis len dgos/ de ltar byas na 'jig rten pa phar zhog chos pa kun gyi nang nas kyang rab dang phul dang mchog tu gyur pa cig 'ong / de ltar ma yin pa'i 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa'i chos pa spro rkyal/ mi su la yang mi mthun pa thag nyer btud tshud med ni zhig gyis zhes bshad ni ma red byas pas/ 'ga' re 'dzum pa byung / yang dang brtson shes rab snyeng rje dang ldan pa'i skal ldan slob ma rna gong 457

ma'i lha bzos ha sag gos 'dang / ja nag dri med lha rdzas ring po bcas phul nas/ tshe 'di phyi bar dor thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig kyang bka' drin skyongs zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ 'o de yang snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin snang stong sems kyi rol pa/ sems nyid ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal nam mkha' lta bur rtogs nas/ de'i ngang la shes pa lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pa'i tshe/phra rags kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa dang chu la rnyog ma dwangs pa bzhin/ rang sar sangs nas dper na ri mthon po zhig gi rtse nas khams bsang byas pa bzhin du/ mnyam gzhag de'i ngo bo yangs pa che ba gsal ba dwangs pa de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag na/ rtogs pa nam mkha' 'dra ste 'gyur ba med gsungs pa ltar/ byeng rgod sogs gang yang mi yong zhing / gal te yong na yang / sngar ltar mnyam par bzhag pa dang / rang sar grol nas rtogs pa klong du gyur te/ rje mi la'i mgur las/ snang dang stong pa dbyer med na/ lta ba klong du gyur pa yin/ /rmi lam nyin par khyad med na/ /sgom pa klong du gyur pa yin/ /bde dang stong pa khyad med na/ /spyod pa 458

klong du gyur pa yin/ /skyid sdug gnyis po khyad med na/ /gdams ngag klong du gyur pa yin/ /nyon mongs ye shes khyad med na/ /rtogs tshad klong du gyur pa yin/ /sems dang nam mkha' khyad med na/ /chos sku klong du gyur pa yin/ /'di dang phyi ma khyad med na/ /gnas lugs klong du gyur pa yin/ /rang sems sangs rgyas khyad med na/ /'bras bu klong du gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar klong du ma gyur gye bar du mnyam par 'jog pa la brtson par bya'o/ /smras pas sems la sngar bas phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo / /yang ngas khyed rnams la phan phyir/ gnyid rmugs kyi nyes dmigs shig bshad pa la kun gyis legs par nyon/ 'o de yang ji skad du/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ gang zhig gnyid dang rmugs la dga' 'gyur ba/ /bad gan rlung dang de bzhin mkhris pa rnams/ /de dag de yi lus la shas cher 'byung / /de yi khams rnams rab tu 'khrugs par 'gyur/ /gang zhig gnyid dang rmugs la dga' 'gyur ba/ /kha zas nyes pas lto ba ma dag cing / /lus kyang lci la zo mdog bde ma yin/ /de yi tshig kyang gsal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' 'gyur ba/ /mi shes le lo snyoms las shes rab 'chal/ /mi ma yin pa dag gis glags rnyed de/ /459

klong du gyur pa yin/ /skyid sdug gnyis po khyad med na/ /gdams ngag klong du gyur pa yin/ /nyon mongs ye shes khyad med na/ /rtogs tshad klong du gyur pa yin/ /sems dang nam mkha' khyad med na/ /chos sku klong du gyur pa yin/ /'di dang phyi ma khyad med na/ /gnas lugs klong du gyur pa yin/ /rang sems sangs rgyas khyad med na/ /'bras bu klong du gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar klong du ma gyur gye bar du mnyam par 'jog pa la brtson par bya'o/ /smras pas sems la sngar bas phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo / /yang ngas khyed rnams la phan phyir/ gnyid rmugs kyi nyes dmigs shig bshad pa la kun gyis legs par nyon/ 'o de yang ji skad du/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ gang zhig gnyid dang rmugs la dga' 'gyur ba/ /bad gan rlung dang de bzhin mkhris pa rnams/ /de dag de yi lus la shas cher 'byung / /de yi khams rnams rab tu 'khrugs par 'gyur/ /gang zhig gnyid dang rmugs la dga' 'gyur ba/ /kha zas nyes pas lto ba ma dag cing / /lus kyang lci la zo mdog bde ma yin/ /de yi tshig kyang gsal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' 'gyur ba/ /mi shes le lo snyoms las shes rab 'chal/ /mi ma yin pa dag gis glags rnyed de/ /459

nags na gnas pa'i tshe na 'tshe bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' 'gyur ba/ /des ni dge sems rtag tu mi 'dod de/ /de ni chos la 'dun pa bskyed mi byed/ /phyir zhing chos ma yin la de dga' 'gyur/ /gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' byed pa/ /de ni rmongatsu/ shing chos la 'dun pa nyams/ /byis pa yon tan kun las yongs su nyams/ /dkar po 'joms shing mun par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig rmugs dang gnyid la dga' 'gyur ba/ /'jigs par 'gyur zhing sems kyang rab tu zhum/ /de ni rtag par mchog tu dga' mi 'gyur/ /gnyid kyis non pas lus kyang lhod par 'gyur/ /gang zhig gnyid dang rmugs la dga' 'gyur ba/ /bdag nyid mi shes le lo can gyur na/ /brtson 'grus stobs dang ldan la phrag dog dang / /brtson 'grus ldan pa rnams la mi snyan smra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyid rmugs kyi nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas/ gnyid dang rmugs pa'i dbang du 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /zhes bshad pas kun la phan thogs chen po byung / yang nyin cig dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i slob bu ri khrod pa dge slong blo gros na re/ khyed kyis dus rgyun du sha'i nyes dmigs gsungs/ chos pa 'jig rten pa yongs la sha ma za zhes yang yang gsungs pa'i dgongs 460

gzhi gang lags zer ba la/ 'o nga'i bsam pa la/ spyir ngan song ngan 'gror skye ba'i rgyu dang / sgos su dmyal ba'i rgyu yi gtso bo srog gcod red/ srog gcod pa'i rtsa ba sha 'di la thug 'dugayang sgos khyad par can du thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang ni/byang chub kyi sems las byung / de snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung /snying rje chen po rgyud la skye ba'i gegs kyi che shos ni/ sha'i sred pa 'di yin par 'dug pas sha 'di cig spong thub na nyes byas kyi sgo mang po zhig khegs nas/ dngos sam brgyud nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs re 'byung ngam snyam nas bshad pa yin byas pas/ yang kho na re/ sngon rgyal po'i khab kyi khyem bdag gcig gis/ dge 'dun la zas byin pas 'phral du phyug por gyur pa mthong nas/ khyem bdag gzhan zhig gi bsam pa la/ nor sgrub pa'i thabs de bzang ste/ bdag gis kyang de bya'o snyam nas sha dang zhun mar sbyar ba'i thug pa bskol te/ sgo ba la dge 'dun dag nang du thongs shig ces/ smras te/ sgo bas dge slong dag la skad sbyar nas/ dge slong bsod snyoms la 'ong ba dag gi lhung bzed sha thug gis bkang ste byin no zhes pa dang / yang ston pa 'khor stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge 'dun dang bcas4 pa gdugs tshod la spyan drangs te/ dge 'dun 461

thams cad la nya sha dang / 'khur ba la sogs pa'i zas bsod pas tshims par byas so zhes 'dul ba lung rnam 'byed nas gsungs pa de gang la dgongs nas bzhes pa yin lags zer/'o sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'di dgag bya las dgos pa gtso bas/dge slong gzhan la phan na ra lug sogs kyi sha tsam du ma shad/yami yi sha khrag zos kyang 'dul ba dang mi 'gal te/ ston pa thugs rje can gyi slob pa lam gyi dus na/ rgyal po ye shes stobs kyi sras mo ye shes ldan du gyur pa'i tshe/ bstan pa'i tha ma chos smra ba'i mchog tu gyur pa dge slong yang dag blo gros zhes bya ba zhig bzhugs pa de/ 'brum bu me dbal nag po'i nad gso dka' bas thebs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i rmi lam du mi'i sha gsar pa dang /khrag gis sman byas na 'tsho bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa'i tshul/ 'khor tshogs kyi dbus su bsgrags kyang dang du len pa ma byung ba na/ sras mo ye shes ldan gyis rang gi sha dang khrag phangs pa med par btang ba dge slong gis zos pas nad sos pa byung /yang rang la mi gnod gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa che na/ dug kyang bzhes pa yin te/ sngon gcer bu pa nye thung gis khyem bdag dpal sbas la zas dug can sbyor du bcug nas/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas spyan drangs pas/ sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen 462

bzhin du phebs nas/ khyim bdag la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldam sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun la yang tshig 'di rnams sbyor la drongs dang skyon mi yong gsungs pas/ khyim bdag gis tshigs bcad de gsum bton nas drangs pas/sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyi sku la mi gnod pa tsam du ma zad/sngar bas sku'i gzi mdangs rgyas par gsungs/ gzhan yang dgos pa'i dbang gis sngon ston pa thugs rje can gyis/ dge slong bro 'tshal ba mi gtsang ba'i khrod du bying ba zhig gzigs te/khong rang byon nas phyag bdar byas te rim gro mdzad tshul 'dul ba lung sogs nas gsungs/ yang sngon bka' gdams pa'i dge slong zhig gis bud med nad ma zhig khur te/ chu zhig gi pha rol tu bsgral nas reg pa bzod par gsol gsungs/'brug pa kun legs kyis khye zhig shor 'ong dus/ dgag bya ba las dgos pa gtso/ /khye la po ti'i bkra shis shog /ces khye'i mgo la brgyab skad/ dgos pa'i dbang gis dmigs bsal gyi gnang ba yod par mi shes par/ lus srog la bab kyang glen pa'i u tshugs byas sha ma zos 'chi ru bcug na/ mkhas pa'i 463

bzhin du phebs nas/ khyim bdag la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldam sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun la yang tshig 'di rnams sbyor la drongs dang skyon mi yong gsungs pas/ khyim bdag gis tshigs bcad de gsum bton nas drangs pas/sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyi sku la mi gnod pa tsam du ma zad/sngar bas sku'i gzi mdangs rgyas par gsungs/ gzhan yang dgos pa'i dbang gis sngon ston pa thugs rje can gyis/ dge slong bro 'tshal ba mi gtsang ba'i khrod du bying ba zhig gzigs te/khong rang byon nas phyag bdar byas te rim gro mdzad tshul 'dul ba lung sogs nas gsungs/ yang sngon bka' gdams pa'i dge slong zhig gis bud med nad ma zhig khur te/ chu zhig gi pha rol tu bsgral nas reg pa bzod par gsol gsungs/'brug pa kun legs kyis khye zhig shor 'ong dus/ dgag bya ba las dgos pa gtso/ /khye la po ti'i bkra shis shog /ces khye'i mgo la brgyab skad/ dgos pa'i dbang gis dmigs bsal gyi gnang ba yod par mi shes par/ lus srog la bab kyang glen pa'i u tshugs byas sha ma zos 'chi ru bcug na/ mkhas pa'i 463

dbang po rnams kyis mi glen pa zhes smod pa'i gnas su 'gyur te mkhas grub rje'i sdom gsum rnam bshad las/ nyan thos rnam gsum dag pa'i sha /nam yang bza' bar mi rung zhes/ /ba lang khyu yi tshogs nang na/ /wa skyes 'jam pa'i rag gis sgrog /gsungs/ de bzhin du sa skya paṇa chen sogs mkhas pa mang pos gsungs/ de 'dra'i dgos pa chen po med na/ theg chen byang chub sems dpa' smos ci dgros/ theg dman nyan rang rnams la yang rnam gsum ma dag pa phar zhog dag pa yang nam yang ma gnang bas na zar mi rung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ blo gros chen po ngas sha'i zas ni su la yang ma gnang mi gnang gnang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab tu byung ba rnams sha'i zas ni nam yang mi rung bar ngas bshad do/ /zhes dang / yang rigs kyi bu deng phyin chad nga'i nyan thos rnams sha bzar mi rung ngo / /gang gis thub pa'i tshig 'das te/ /bsam pa ngan pas sha zo bzhin/ /shākya'i bstan la brtul zhugs blangs/ /shin tu mi zad dmyal bar ni/ /sdig pa'i las can de dag 'gro/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /des na khyod kyis sha ma za zhes smras pas/ khong rang gis sha sngar nas mi za ba'i dam bca' brtan po byung /snying rje chen po skyes nas gzhan la phan thogs pa'i chos pa 464

dbang po rnams kyis mi glen pa zhes smod pa'i gnas su 'gyur te mkhas grub rje'i sdom gsum rnam bshad las/ nyan thos rnam gsum dag pa'i sha /nam yang bza' bar mi rung zhes/ /ba lang khyu yi tshogs nang na/ /wa skyes 'jam pa'i rag gis sgrog /gsungs/ de bzhin du sa skya paṇa chen sogs mkhas pa mang pos gsungs/ de 'dra'i dgos pa chen po med na/ theg chen byang chub sems dpa' smos ci dgros/ theg dman nyan rang rnams la yang rnam gsum ma dag pa phar zhog dag pa yang nam yang ma gnang bas na zar mi rung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ blo gros chen po ngas sha'i zas ni su la yang ma gnang mi gnang gnang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab tu byung ba rnams sha'i zas ni nam yang mi rung bar ngas bshad do/ /zhes dang / yang rigs kyi bu deng phyin chad nga'i nyan thos rnams sha bzar mi rung ngo / /gang gis thub pa'i tshig 'das te/ /bsam pa ngan pas sha zo bzhin/ /shākya'i bstan la brtul zhugs blangs/ /shin tu mi zad dmyal bar ni/ /sdig pa'i las can de dag 'gro/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /des na khyod kyis sha ma za zhes smras pas/ khong rang gis sha sngar nas mi za ba'i dam bca' brtan po byung /snying rje chen po skyes nas gzhan la phan thogs pa'i chos pa 464

bzang po zhig byung ngo / /yang bya btang ri khrod pa shākya rin chen dang / bstan 'dzin nor bu gnyis kyis rtse gzhung dben pa'i dga' tshal tha yan ci nas mtshams zhus kyi mjug tu zhal gdams dgos tshul 'di phul 'dugamatha' yas chos kyi yang rtse rdzogs chen gyi/ /mtha' bral phyogs lhung med pa'i dgongs pa rtogs/ /mtha' med 'gro la chos ston zhabs dkar zhes/ /mtha' dbus yongs la grags pa'i zhabs drung du/ /chos mdzad gong ma'i ri khrod bzhugs gnas nas/ /chos byed slob bu gnyis kyis 'di skad zhu/ /chos sku'i klong na gzugs sku bde lags sam/ /chos pa'i gzugs brnyan gnyis kyang bde bar mchis/ /ma zhig zhig badzus shākya nor bu gnyis/ /ma rnams don du sgyu lus dben par gnas/ /ma rig nyon mongs ci sangs byas na yang / /ma sangs rkyen ngan byung tshe langs nyen gda'/ /ma dag 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i slob bu gnyis/ /ma hā gu ru'i thugs nas mi 'dor bar/ /ma bcos bzhag pa'i sems nyid 'od gsal don/ /ma bsgoms 'tshang rgya'i gdams pa bstan du gsol/ /zhes phul ba'i lan du/'o de yang nam mkha' la phyogs gang nas bltas kyang mtha' sked/ dbus med/ phyi nang med/ 'gro 'ong med/ skye 'chi med/465

gsal 'grib med pa de bzhin du rang gi sems la ltos dang /mtha' dbus med/ phyi nang med/ 'gro 'ong med/ skye 'chi med/gsal 'grib med pa yin la/ de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog dus/ snang ba rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems kyi nang du longs la/ sems nyid nam mkha' ltar phyogs bcur rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su thongs la/ gu yangs yan pa blo bder gyis la skyongs dang / dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa re yong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i 'khor 'das chos/ /thams cad sems kyis rtogs shing sems nyid ni/ /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa yi/ /bla ma rnams la rab tu gus pas 'dud/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags la/ /brten nas sgyu ma'i ltad mo 'byung ba ltar/ /sems kyis bzang ngan las byas rten 'brel la/ /brten nas 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad 'byung / /chos kun rtsa ba sems nyid gdod nas stong / /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid du/ /bzhag na mgo bo btums pa sangs pa bzhin/ /byeng rmugs gnyid gsum sangs nas yangs cha che/ /kha yengs mig yengs mchongs rgyug gang byas 466

gsal 'grib med pa de bzhin du rang gi sems la ltos dang /mtha' dbus med/ phyi nang med/ 'gro 'ong med/ skye 'chi med/gsal 'grib med pa yin la/ de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog dus/ snang ba rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems kyi nang du longs la/ sems nyid nam mkha' ltar phyogs bcur rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su thongs la/ gu yangs yan pa blo bder gyis la skyongs dang / dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa re yong zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i 'khor 'das chos/ /thams cad sems kyis rtogs shing sems nyid ni/ /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa yi/ /bla ma rnams la rab tu gus pas 'dud/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i rdzas sngags la/ /brten nas sgyu ma'i ltad mo 'byung ba ltar/ /sems kyis bzang ngan las byas rten 'brel la/ /brten nas 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad 'byung / /chos kun rtsa ba sems nyid gdod nas stong / /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid du/ /bzhag na mgo bo btums pa sangs pa bzhin/ /byeng rmugs gnyid gsum sangs nas yangs cha che/ /kha yengs mig yengs mchongs rgyug gang byas 466

kyang / /je gsal je brtan gyur nas nam mkha' ltar/ /chos nyid yangs pa'i ngang du dga' yal le/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor byung na ngo mtshar che/ /de ltar ma rtogs ma gyur sems can la/ /bcos ma min pa'i snying rje chen po skyes/ /skyo ngal med par nyam thag 'gro ba'i don/ /byed rgyu byung na de bas ngo mtshar ) glu dbyangs 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /chos rnams thams cad sems kyis byas par rtogs/ /sems kyi ngo bo stong gsal nam mkha' ltar/ /rtogs nas chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces smras pas/ khong gnyis kyis de ltar nyams su blangs pas bdag 'dzin nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo chen po re byung ngo / /de'i lo dbus lho kha nas lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gis/ sngar mtshams zhus phul ba'i 'byor lan du/ slob bu kun dga' nor bu la khal rta bro kha bzang po bcas/ kho rang la gang yod bskur pa thams cad yi ge'i nang bzhin 'dir slebs pa zhabs brtan gyi tshul du phul ba'i 'bul tho la/ thog mar tshe dpag med kyi kha rgyan can gyi tshe bum gser dngul 'dres ma g.yu dmar byu ru'i phra can nang na rin chen ril bu yod pa gcig gos chen gro lo ma'i dbu zhwa 'ja' ma g.yu 467

kyang / /je gsal je brtan gyur nas nam mkha' ltar/ /chos nyid yangs pa'i ngang du dga' yal le/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor byung na ngo mtshar che/ /de ltar ma rtogs ma gyur sems can la/ /bcos ma min pa'i snying rje chen po skyes/ /skyo ngal med par nyam thag 'gro ba'i don/ /byed rgyu byung na de bas ngo mtshar ) glu dbyangs 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /chos rnams thams cad sems kyis byas par rtogs/ /sems kyi ngo bo stong gsal nam mkha' ltar/ /rtogs nas chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces smras pas/ khong gnyis kyis de ltar nyams su blangs pas bdag 'dzin nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo chen po re byung ngo / /de'i lo dbus lho kha nas lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gis/ sngar mtshams zhus phul ba'i 'byor lan du/ slob bu kun dga' nor bu la khal rta bro kha bzang po bcas/ kho rang la gang yod bskur pa thams cad yi ge'i nang bzhin 'dir slebs pa zhabs brtan gyi tshul du phul ba'i 'bul tho la/ thog mar tshe dpag med kyi kha rgyan can gyi tshe bum gser dngul 'dres ma g.yu dmar byu ru'i phra can nang na rin chen ril bu yod pa gcig gos chen gro lo ma'i dbu zhwa 'ja' ma g.yu 467

dmar gyi phra dang gser gyi rgyal mtshan gyi tog gis mtshan pa gcig sku 'gags chos gos smad sham mtshal kha ma gcig gos chen rgyan bzhi dang gos ser po 'khor lo ma'i phu thung ring thung gnyis/ stong skud ser po'i ska rags gcig gser dngul 'dres ma'i mchod kong che ba gcig dngul kong dkrol ma chung ba gnyis/ dngul gyi ting phor lnga tshar/ dngul gyi ka pa la gcigagaser dngul zangs gsum yod pa'i bum pa na bza' kha rgyan dang bcas pa cha 'grig gcig zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i rten 'brel du dbus lham 'ja' chen spus legs gcig ras zon nor bu cha bdun ma gcig bdud rtsi chos sman/ gur kum/ gu gul spos dkar/ ras kyi gnam yol/ rta sga cha sga 'khor bcas/ khyon sdom dngul 'bab la rdo tshad lnga dang dngul srang bcu'i rtsa ba phul lags/ skye ba 'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zab gsal thugs kyi klong nas dus nam yang mi 'dor ba mkhyen mkhyen/e ma mngon dga' mkha' spyod la sogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing dang mtshungs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil ba ru/ /shāka thub o rgyan la sogs rgyal kun dang / /dbyer med skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs drung du/ /rtswa min shing min dben pa'i nags khrod 468

dmar gyi phra dang gser gyi rgyal mtshan gyi tog gis mtshan pa gcig sku 'gags chos gos smad sham mtshal kha ma gcig gos chen rgyan bzhi dang gos ser po 'khor lo ma'i phu thung ring thung gnyis/ stong skud ser po'i ska rags gcig gser dngul 'dres ma'i mchod kong che ba gcig dngul kong dkrol ma chung ba gnyis/ dngul gyi ting phor lnga tshar/ dngul gyi ka pa la gcigagaser dngul zangs gsum yod pa'i bum pa na bza' kha rgyan dang bcas pa cha 'grig gcig zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i rten 'brel du dbus lham 'ja' chen spus legs gcig ras zon nor bu cha bdun ma gcig bdud rtsi chos sman/ gur kum/ gu gul spos dkar/ ras kyi gnam yol/ rta sga cha sga 'khor bcas/ khyon sdom dngul 'bab la rdo tshad lnga dang dngul srang bcu'i rtsa ba phul lags/ skye ba 'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zab gsal thugs kyi klong nas dus nam yang mi 'dor ba mkhyen mkhyen/e ma mngon dga' mkha' spyod la sogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing dang mtshungs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil ba ru/ /shāka thub o rgyan la sogs rgyal kun dang / /dbyer med skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs drung du/ /rtswa min shing min dben pa'i nags khrod 468

na/ /skya min ser min nyon mongs rgya mtsho'am/ /shi min gson min glo spyon dug gsum pas/ /gos min ras min na bza'i rigs gyur dang / /gser min dngul min mchod pa'i yo byad la/ g.yu min byur min phra yis brgyan pa 'di/ /drel min bong min rta la bkal nas ni/ /skyo sdug gnyis med ngang nas gus pas phul/ /bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs ma lus pa/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /rnam mkhyen sa la 'god pa'i skyabs 'jug mkhyen/ /zhes gang phul ba rnams blangs nas kho rang gis skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i nang ltar/ dge tshogs rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yid la smon pa'i gnas rnams de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor yang dag byas so/ /yang gsar rnying ris med kyi chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang 'byongs pa'i ngang rong mkhan pos/ bdag gis bstan dang 'gro ba spyi dang / khyad par rin po che'i bstan pa la gang phan byed dus/ gzhan gyis log bsgrub byed pa la bzod pa bsgoms pa tsam du ma zad/ de la bu gcig ltar brtse bas phan pa 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i gtam 'di gsan pas thusas drangs te/ bstod bsngags me 469

tog gi phreng ba 'di bskur 'dugasnying la rab tu dregs pas 'khri shing can/ /tshangs dbang bye bas bsnyems pa yongs dor nas/ /gus pas btud pa'i gtsug rgyan nor bu'i 'od/ /gang dang 'dres pa'i zhabs sen dmar po'i mdangs/ /mtshams sprin gzhon nus nam yang mtshon min pa'i/ /yid 'ong 'od zer stong gi dpal 'bar ba/ /de yis nye bar phyes pa'i pad+ma des/ /drung du thal mo sbyar te 'di skad gsol/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse go la'i lam yangs por/ /lhag bsam 'od dkar 'bum gyi dra ba can/ /mtshan dpe'i zla ba gsar ba khyod shar tshe/ /gangs can bde skyid ku mud cir yang 'dzum/ /ma lus lus can srid las sgrol ba'i khur/ /mgon po khyod kyis bdag gir mdzad pa'i tshe/ /grags pa srid pa'i khongs las rab brgal te/ /rgyal rnams dgyes pa'i rol mor gyur pa mtshar/ /gzhan la phan pa 'ba' zhig lhur len pa/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi ngang tshul te/ /ches cher dman la lhag par chags pa 'di/ /'dren pa khyed kyi thun mong min pa'i chos/ /phyi dang nang gi bdog pa kun btang yang / /sbyin pa po zhes bsngags par mi 'gyur te/ /gang phyir slong ba rnams kyis khyod kyi nor/ /rang gi bgo skal nyid du bsams nas 470

len/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis yid rab brlams pa yi/ /mi bsrun skye bos khyod la glags btsal kyang / /ring mo nyid nas bzod pa goms pa'i yid/ /khro bas g.yo ba med la mtshar du ci/ /de la bu gcig lta bur brtser dgongs nas/ /rab tu phan pa 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa yi/ /bla na med pa'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa 'dis/ /bdag gi yid dbang zhags pa med par bcings/ /des na skom pas gdungs pa'i glang chen bzhin/ /khyod drung pad+ma'i rdzing bur 'jug pa'i blo/ /nyin re bzhin du rnam par 'phel gyur kyang / /rnam g.yeng lcags kyu rnon po'i gzhan dbang gyur/ /de lta na yang ring por mi thogs par/ /bsod nams brgya ba'i zhabs kyi 'khor lo ni/ /spyi bor reg pa'i skal bzang mngon gyur te/ /khyod gsung legs bshad bdud rtsis 'tsho bar sgon/ /mtshams zhus/ bslu med bla ma mchog gsum bden stobs kyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa lag mchog /khyod zhabs rdo rje'i rang bzhin chos kyi khrir/ /bskal brgyar g.yo ba med par brtan gyur cig /bdag kyang tshe rabs phreng ba thams cad du/ /khyod nyid mnyes pa 'ba' zhig lhur byed cing / /nam yang thugs rje lcags kyus mi 'dor ba'i/ /gsung mchid gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin 'chad med zhu/ /de skad zhu mchid bung ba'i na chung 471
