ma/ /bkra shis lha rdzas gsar ba'i skyes dang bcas/ /khyod drung mtsho skyes bzhad pa'i dga' tshal der/ /dad gus 'dab ma zung gis bskyod de 'phur/ /zhes bsgur pa'i gsung shog gi lan du/mi rgan snyoms las nga yang khams bzang po byung tshe phyogs der 'ong bas nged gnyis mjal yong / gal te ma mjal ba 'dra byung tshe/ sngar ltar dad gus dag snang ma 'gyur ba mdzod dang /'di nas mjal ba dang khyad med pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya zhes phul ba 'byor bas thugs mnyes pa byung skad/yang bzhi ba'i bco lnga zhig gi nyin/ mi mang bo 'tshogs pa la/ ngas 'o sngon sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje rgya gar nas bal yul 'phags pa shing kun tu phebs dus/ mnga' ris kyi lha btsun pa'i bsu ba rta ba gtso bo mi drug kyang der slebs nas/bod kyi lugs kyi ja thab chen po brgyab gtso bo sum pa bya bas gser srang lnga tsam ri ba'i dkar yol 'brug rgyab ja btso mas mer gyis bkang nas/ rin chen 'brug rgyab srang lnga ri ba 'dir/ /lce bde blo gsal 'gro na mgyogs pa yi/ /dpag bsam shing gi bcud du rab dmigs nas/ /bla ma khyed la mchod par 'bul bar bgyi/ /zhes phul ba gsol ba dang / a ti sha'i zhal nas/ rten 'brel thams cad shin tu legs/ snod 472

ma/ /bkra shis lha rdzas gsar ba'i skyes dang bcas/ /khyod drung mtsho skyes bzhad pa'i dga' tshal der/ /dad gus 'dab ma zung gis bskyod de 'phur/ /zhes bsgur pa'i gsung shog gi lan du/mi rgan snyoms las nga yang khams bzang po byung tshe phyogs der 'ong bas nged gnyis mjal yong / gal te ma mjal ba 'dra byung tshe/ sngar ltar dad gus dag snang ma 'gyur ba mdzod dang /'di nas mjal ba dang khyad med pa'i skyabs 'jug bsngo smon yang dag bya zhes phul ba 'byor bas thugs mnyes pa byung skad/yang bzhi ba'i bco lnga zhig gi nyin/ mi mang bo 'tshogs pa la/ ngas 'o sngon sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje rgya gar nas bal yul 'phags pa shing kun tu phebs dus/ mnga' ris kyi lha btsun pa'i bsu ba rta ba gtso bo mi drug kyang der slebs nas/bod kyi lugs kyi ja thab chen po brgyab gtso bo sum pa bya bas gser srang lnga tsam ri ba'i dkar yol 'brug rgyab ja btso mas mer gyis bkang nas/ rin chen 'brug rgyab srang lnga ri ba 'dir/ /lce bde blo gsal 'gro na mgyogs pa yi/ /dpag bsam shing gi bcud du rab dmigs nas/ /bla ma khyed la mchod par 'bul bar bgyi/ /zhes phul ba gsol ba dang / a ti sha'i zhal nas/ rten 'brel thams cad shin tu legs/ snod 472

dang bcud gnyis 'dzom/ btung ba 'di la ci zer ba yin gsungs/ der lo tsā bas/ 'di la ja zer ba lags/ bod kyi rab byung rnams kyis btung ba yin/ 'di shing bza' rgyu mi nyan/btsos nas khu ba 'thung ba yin/ 'di la yon tan mang po yod ces zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'di bod kyi rab tu byung ba rnams kyi bsod nams las grub pa'i dngos po zhig snang / shin tu phun sum tshogs gsungs/ des na rab byung rnams kyi btung ba'i mchog rgya ja 'di yin pas/ dge 'dun gyi sde che chung gang la yang bco lnga gnam gang tshes brgyad sogs la/ mang ja yag po re drangs nas/ skyabs 'gro ltung bshags bla ma mchod pa bzang spyod smon lam re gsung du bcug na/ de kho nas mi lus thob pa don ldan par 'gyur zhes bshad pas/ phal cher gyis de sems la bzhag nas/ rang rang gi phyogs kyi dgon pa tsho la ched du gnyer nas mang ja gtong mkhan mang po byung /yang khye'i lo dbyar dus shig la gong ma rin po che'i bla mchod gye grangs/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan rin po che'i sprul sku dang / dbon po blo bzang / dge rgan 'ba'/ sa dkyil rgya nag pa rnams bka' chos zhu ru bkra shis/ 'khyil bar phebs pa la/ ngas rten 'brel gyi thog mar chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi snying khu lam 473

dang bcud gnyis 'dzom/ btung ba 'di la ci zer ba yin gsungs/ der lo tsā bas/ 'di la ja zer ba lags/ bod kyi rab byung rnams kyis btung ba yin/ 'di shing bza' rgyu mi nyan/btsos nas khu ba 'thung ba yin/ 'di la yon tan mang po yod ces zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'di bod kyi rab tu byung ba rnams kyi bsod nams las grub pa'i dngos po zhig snang / shin tu phun sum tshogs gsungs/ des na rab byung rnams kyi btung ba'i mchog rgya ja 'di yin pas/ dge 'dun gyi sde che chung gang la yang bco lnga gnam gang tshes brgyad sogs la/ mang ja yag po re drangs nas/ skyabs 'gro ltung bshags bla ma mchod pa bzang spyod smon lam re gsung du bcug na/ de kho nas mi lus thob pa don ldan par 'gyur zhes bshad pas/ phal cher gyis de sems la bzhag nas/ rang rang gi phyogs kyi dgon pa tsho la ched du gnyer nas mang ja gtong mkhan mang po byung /yang khye'i lo dbyar dus shig la gong ma rin po che'i bla mchod gye grangs/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan rin po che'i sprul sku dang / dbon po blo bzang / dge rgan 'ba'/ sa dkyil rgya nag pa rnams bka' chos zhu ru bkra shis/ 'khyil bar phebs pa la/ ngas rten 'brel gyi thog mar chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi snying khu lam 473

rim bsdus don/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba/jo bos lha btsun byang chub 'od la gdams pa seng ge'i sgra dbyangs/ pha dam pa rgya gar gyi ding ri brgyad cu/ kha rag sgom chung ba'i ang yig bdun cu/ rgyal sras thogs med kyi rgyal sras lag len sum cu rnams kyi bshad lung dang / ma cig grub rgyal ma'i lugs kyi tshe dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang rnams byas/ tshur 'bul ba la sku gsung thugs rten rgya dngul srang lnga bcu gos chen gcig kha btags phyi mdzod nang mdzod bcas phul byung / phar la nga'i rnam thar mgur 'bum lha rdzas bcas phul bas/ dpon slob kun thugs mnyes bzhin du rong bor phebs song / yang mgo log gi skal ldan slob bu mdo sngags rgya mtshos nyin cig kho rang gi rgyu mtshan tshigs bcad 'di phul byung / 'khor 'das phyi nang rtog tshogs phra rags kun/ /rnam dag chos skur yongs grol rig drug pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rang gzhan 'gro ba'i ngor/ /mi yi rol gar skal ldan grol mdzad dgongs/ /gang thugs zag med sgrib bral me long du/ /phal ba'i lkog tu gyur pa'i chos so cog /ma 'dres so sor ji bzhin mngon par gzigs/ /de lta na'ang rang tshul gsol la spro/ /474

bdag ni chung ngu'i dus nas bu gcig pu/ /yin stabs pha mas khyem thab 'dzin par bskos/ /de ltar gyur kyang yi ge 'don 'brir bslabs/ /legs par shes shing lo grangs bcu dgu la/ /son tshe nges 'byung cung zad cig gis bskul/ /pha ma gnyen 'dun chung ma zas nor spangs/ /bla ma bsten te bstan pa'i sgo ru zhugs/ /mgon khyod rnam thar mthong thos nyin mtshan du/ /bza' btung gnyid kyang 'gags nas mjal 'dun skyes/ /zhal ras mjal bar lhags tshe zhal mjal zhing / /mdo sngags gdams pa'i gnad rnams ji bzhin nod/ /gang khyod drin las nges 'byung byang sems zung / /rang gi rgyud la cung zad skyes pa dang / /bsgoms na tshe gcig 'tshang rgya nus pa yi/ /phyag rdzogs lta 'khrid yang yang gnang ba bzhin/ /ye grol ma bcos rig pa zang thal le/ /bzang ngan rtog pas ma bslad ye ji bzhin/ /sgom med yengs med ngang la ma bzlas pas/ /gsal stong brjod med blo bral gdeng zhig rnyed/ /nges par 'chi yang 'gyod pa med pa 'dra/ /'di nyid mtshan ldan bla ma khyod kye drin/ /bskal dang bskal par btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /mgon khyod zhabs zin yun thung tsam bsten te/ /thag ring 'bral mi rigs shing yun ring du/ /khyod zhabs bsten la sems pa rtag par phyogs/ /475

bdag ni chung ngu'i dus nas bu gcig pu/ /yin stabs pha mas khyem thab 'dzin par bskos/ /de ltar gyur kyang yi ge 'don 'brir bslabs/ /legs par shes shing lo grangs bcu dgu la/ /son tshe nges 'byung cung zad cig gis bskul/ /pha ma gnyen 'dun chung ma zas nor spangs/ /bla ma bsten te bstan pa'i sgo ru zhugs/ /mgon khyod rnam thar mthong thos nyin mtshan du/ /bza' btung gnyid kyang 'gags nas mjal 'dun skyes/ /zhal ras mjal bar lhags tshe zhal mjal zhing / /mdo sngags gdams pa'i gnad rnams ji bzhin nod/ /gang khyod drin las nges 'byung byang sems zung / /rang gi rgyud la cung zad skyes pa dang / /bsgoms na tshe gcig 'tshang rgya nus pa yi/ /phyag rdzogs lta 'khrid yang yang gnang ba bzhin/ /ye grol ma bcos rig pa zang thal le/ /bzang ngan rtog pas ma bslad ye ji bzhin/ /sgom med yengs med ngang la ma bzlas pas/ /gsal stong brjod med blo bral gdeng zhig rnyed/ /nges par 'chi yang 'gyod pa med pa 'dra/ /'di nyid mtshan ldan bla ma khyod kye drin/ /bskal dang bskal par btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /mgon khyod zhabs zin yun thung tsam bsten te/ /thag ring 'bral mi rigs shing yun ring du/ /khyod zhabs bsten la sems pa rtag par phyogs/ /475

mgon khyod bka' drin stong gsum gser kho nas/ /bkang ste phul yang 'jal bar mi nus kyang / /tshe mjug sgrub pa'i zhabs tog ci lcogs 'bul/ /'di'i mthus mgon khyod zhabs zung rdo rje'i khrir/ /ris med bstan 'gro'i dpal du brtan pa dang / /bdag kyang tshe rabs kun tu rjes bzung ste/ /zung 'jug go 'phang mchog la dkri gyur cig /ces phul ba'i lan du ngas kho rang gi sems kyi bogs 'don la 'di skad smras/ rigs 'dzin shrī sing ha'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs khyab brdal du gnas/ sems can gyi rig pa dum bur gnas/ nam mkha' lta bur rgya bskyed pa bogs che/ dri med bshags rgyud las/ sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing / /gsungs/ phyag chen gaṅgā ma las/ sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos rnams ma lus pa yang de ltar blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rig pa'am sems kyi gnas lugs shes nas/ sems nyid nam mkha' ltar phyogs bcur rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su btang / 'khor 'das thams cad sems kyi nang du longs la shong bar ma zad/ da dung yangs khrol ler gnas pa lta bu'i sems kha yangs po gyes/ snang ba phyi ru ma lus/ sems nyid 476

mgon khyod bka' drin stong gsum gser kho nas/ /bkang ste phul yang 'jal bar mi nus kyang / /tshe mjug sgrub pa'i zhabs tog ci lcogs 'bul/ /'di'i mthus mgon khyod zhabs zung rdo rje'i khrir/ /ris med bstan 'gro'i dpal du brtan pa dang / /bdag kyang tshe rabs kun tu rjes bzung ste/ /zung 'jug go 'phang mchog la dkri gyur cig /ces phul ba'i lan du ngas kho rang gi sems kyi bogs 'don la 'di skad smras/ rigs 'dzin shrī sing ha'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs khyab brdal du gnas/ sems can gyi rig pa dum bur gnas/ nam mkha' lta bur rgya bskyed pa bogs che/ dri med bshags rgyud las/ sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing / /gsungs/ phyag chen gaṅgā ma las/ sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos rnams ma lus pa yang de ltar blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rig pa'am sems kyi gnas lugs shes nas/ sems nyid nam mkha' ltar phyogs bcur rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su btang / 'khor 'das thams cad sems kyi nang du longs la shong bar ma zad/ da dung yangs khrol ler gnas pa lta bu'i sems kha yangs po gyes/ snang ba phyi ru ma lus/ sems nyid 476

nang du ma lus/snang bas stong pa ma bsgribs/ stong pas snang ba ma bkag snang bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du snang / snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyes la/ dus nam yang mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du sgyu lus 'di'i thog nas rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur 'gro ba'i don gyes dang / sems kyis 'khor 'das ci tsam la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba de tsam du 'gro don yong / nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe 'gro mgon gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ 'od gsal ngang la mnyam rjes med/ /rnal 'byor lus rgya zhig tsa na/ /mtha' bral 'khor 'das yongs la khyab/ /tshe phyi ma khyod sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /gsungs pa ltar 'chi ba chos skur grol nas/ de las ma g.yos bzhin du longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i 'khor ba ma stongs bar du mdzad nas rang gzhan gye don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas kho rang gis kyang rjes su tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams pas gtan du bde ba'i btsan sa zin par byung ngo / /yang tho rgya la song dus shig la dmag mi 'ga' re ra nang zhig na mda' kha byed pa mthong bas rkyen byas/ rnal 'byor mda' rtsed kyi glu 'di blangs so//sa gzhi yangs pa'i ra nang du/ /'jig rten pa rnams 477

nang du ma lus/ snang bas stong pa ma bsgribs/ stong pas snang ba ma bkag snang bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du snang / snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyes la/ dus nam yang mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du sgyu lus 'di'i thog nas rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur 'gro ba'i don gyes dang / sems kyis 'khor 'das ci tsam la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba de tsam du 'gro don yong / nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe 'gro mgon gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ 'od gsal ngang la mnyam rjes med/ /rnal 'byor lus rgya zhig tsa na/ /mtha' bral 'khor 'das yongs la khyab/ /tshe phyi ma khyod sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /gsungs pa ltar 'chi ba chos skur grol nas/ de las ma g.yos bzhin du longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i 'khor ba ma stongs bar du mdzad nas rang gzhan gye don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas kho rang gis kyang rjes su tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams pas gtan du bde ba'i btsan sa zin par byung ngo / /yang tho rgya la song dus shig la dmag mi 'ga' re ra nang zhig na mda' kha byed pa mthong bas rkyen byas/ rnal 'byor mda' rtsed kyi glu 'di blangs so//sa gzhi yangs pa'i ra nang du/ /'jig rten pa rnams 477

mda' kha byed/ /de la bltas nas rnal 'byor ngas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi mda' rtsed bya/ /dad pa brtan pa'i sa gzhi la/ /nges 'byung brtan po'i ra bas bskor/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i sa stegs khar/ /rang byung rig pa'i gzhon nu yis/ /byang chub sems kyi gzhu mo la/ /bag yod dran shes gzhu rgyud bsgrengs/ /stong pa nyid kyi mda' mo la/ /tshad med bzhi yi sgo ༄sa brgyan/ /shes rab rnon po'i mde'u btsugs/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi rkang ba bgrad/ /brtson 'grus lag pas gzhu mo 'jen/ /bdag med stong pa'i mda' zhig 'phangs/ /bdag 'dzin 'ben gye dkyil du brgyab/ /me long ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /zhe sdang 'ben gyi mgo la brgyab/ /sor rtog ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /'dod chags 'ben gyi rtsa bar brgyab/ /chos dbyings ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /gti mug 'ben gyi sked par brgyab/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /nga rgyal 'ben gyi g.yas su brgyab/ /bya grub ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /phrag dog 'ben gyi g.yon du brgyab/ /de ltar brgyab pas nyon mongs 'ben/ /thams cad stong nyid sa la 'gyel/ /kun gyis dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs 'ur/ /skyen po mjug rgyal cho lo btags/ /tshe ring bkra shis dpa' dar gnang / /kun gyis dmag rtsed 'di 478

mda' kha byed/ /de la bltas nas rnal 'byor ngas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi mda' rtsed bya/ /dad pa brtan pa'i sa gzhi la/ /nges 'byung brtan po'i ra bas bskor/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i sa stegs khar/ /rang byung rig pa'i gzhon nu yis/ /byang chub sems kyi gzhu mo la/ /bag yod dran shes gzhu rgyud bsgrengs/ /stong pa nyid kyi mda' mo la/ /tshad med bzhi yi sgo sa brgyan/ /shes rab rnon po'i mde'u btsugs/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi rkang ba bgrad/ /brtson 'grus lag pas gzhu mo 'jen/ /bdag med stong pa'i mda' zhig 'phangs/ /bdag 'dzin 'ben gye dkyil du brgyab/ /me long ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /zhe sdang 'ben gyi mgo la brgyab/ /sor rtog ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /'dod chags 'ben gyi rtsa bar brgyab/ /chos dbyings ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /gti mug 'ben gyi sked par brgyab/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /nga rgyal 'ben gyi g.yas su brgyab/ /bya grub ye shes mda' zhig 'phangs/ /phrag dog 'ben gyi g.yon du brgyab/ /de ltar brgyab pas nyon mongs 'ben/ /thams cad stong nyid sa la 'gyel/ /kun gyis dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs 'ur/ /skyen po mjug rgyal cho lo btags/ /tshe ring bkra shis dpa' dar gnang / /kun gyis dmag rtsed 'di 478

ltar gyes/ /zhes blangs pas de na yod pa rnams kyis go bas thams cad ngo mtshar dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de'i ston kha sngar dbus su mtshams zhus su song ba'i slob bu kun dga' dang blo bzang don 'grub gnyis kyis 'byor lan yi ge rten bcas khyer 'ongs pa dang lhan du dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs kyi slob ma grwa btsun mang po bcas 'ongs pa rnams/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes lam skabs tsho'i dgra jag chom rkun chu yi gnod pa sogs gang yang ma byung bar thams cad 'tshams por bde mor sleb pa byung / 'byor lan du slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi yig rten du thub pa rdor gdan ma/ rgya gar shar li nub li dang / dngul gyi nga'i 'dra skus gtso byas sku gsung thugs rten rtsa can mang po/ stod gser srang lnga bcu/gser gye ga'u lnga/ rgya dngul srang nyis brgya dang lnga bcu/ bod ṭaṃ rdo tshad gcig lhag g.yu byur che chung brgya phrag gser zangs kyi gañji ra/ dngul gye mchod kong che chung nyi shu rtsa bdun/ nang mchod phud mchod 'jog snod/ bdun tshar ma ṇi lag 'khor/mchod dem sogs dngul gyi mchod cha mang po/ na bza' cha tshang lnga/ gzhan gos 'gags gzan sham thab 'bu ras kyi gzan sogs lnga bcu lhag gos chen dang mgo snam tshos gnyis 479

ltar gyes/ /zhes blangs pas de na yod pa rnams kyis go bas thams cad ngo mtshar dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /de'i ston kha sngar dbus su mtshams zhus su song ba'i slob bu kun dga' dang blo bzang don 'grub gnyis kyis 'byor lan yi ge rten bcas khyer 'ongs pa dang lhan du dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs kyi slob ma grwa btsun mang po bcas 'ongs pa rnams/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes lam skabs tsho'i dgra jag chom rkun chu yi gnod pa sogs gang yang ma byung bar thams cad 'tshams por bde mor sleb pa byung / 'byor lan du slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi yig rten du thub pa rdor gdan ma/ rgya gar shar li nub li dang / dngul gyi nga'i 'dra skus gtso byas sku gsung thugs rten rtsa can mang po/ stod gser srang lnga bcu/gser gye ga'u lnga/ rgya dngul srang nyis brgya dang lnga bcu/ bod ṭaṃ rdo tshad gcig lhag g.yu byur che chung brgya phrag gser zangs kyi gañji ra/ dngul gye mchod kong che chung nyi shu rtsa bdun/ nang mchod phud mchod 'jog snod/ bdun tshar ma ṇi lag 'khor/mchod dem sogs dngul gyi mchod cha mang po/ na bza' cha tshang lnga/ gzhan gos 'gags gzan sham thab 'bu ras kyi gzan sogs lnga bcu lhag gos chen dang mgo snam tshos gnyis 479

ma dang / dbus lham kha dar phyi mdzod nang mdzod brgya lhagasman sna mang po rta dre'u khal ma mdzo g.yag nyi shu sogs khyon bsdoms pas dngul rdo tshad lnga bcu'i rtsis yod pa zhabs brtan du dmigs nas phul ba la/ ngas legs par blangs nas dge tshogs rnams phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / ma sems can thams cad la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / khyad par du 'brel thogs dpon slob yon mchod rnams gnas skabs bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs mngon dga' bde ba can la sogs pa'i gang 'dod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams su mjal nas/ sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i rgyu ru bsngos nas smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor yang dag pa byas pa'i mthar/ ston mo rgya chen po byas tshogs 'khor bskor pas lha mi thams cad dga' zhing spro ba byung / dngos po de dag kyang gsog 'jog ma byas par mchod kong sogs mchod cha rnams dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyi 'du khang du bzhag gzan sham thab stod 'gags sogs ston pa'i gos mnab rnams bla ma dang / sprul sku mtshams pa mang por phul/ gser dngul rnams ja mar rtsam pa sogs la btsongs nas/ lto gos chos gsum gyis phongs pa'i nyam thag sprang po brgya phrag stong phrag mang po la byin 480

ma dang / dbus lham kha dar phyi mdzod nang mdzod brgya lhagasman sna mang po rta dre'u khal ma mdzo g.yag nyi shu sogs khyon bsdoms pas dngul rdo tshad lnga bcu'i rtsis yod pa zhabs brtan du dmigs nas phul ba la/ ngas legs par blangs nas dge tshogs rnams phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / ma sems can thams cad la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / khyad par du 'brel thogs dpon slob yon mchod rnams gnas skabs bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs mngon dga' bde ba can la sogs pa'i gang 'dod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams su mjal nas/ sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i rgyu ru bsngos nas smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor yang dag pa byas pa'i mthar/ ston mo rgya chen po byas tshogs 'khor bskor pas lha mi thams cad dga' zhing spro ba byung / dngos po de dag kyang gsog 'jog ma byas par mchod kong sogs mchod cha rnams dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyi 'du khang du bzhag gzan sham thab stod 'gags sogs ston pa'i gos mnab rnams bla ma dang / sprul sku mtshams pa mang por phul/ gser dngul rnams ja mar rtsam pa sogs la btsongs nas/ lto gos chos gsum gyis phongs pa'i nyam thag sprang po brgya phrag stong phrag mang po la byin 480

nas dge rtsa rnams rang gzhan sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ smon lam yang de bzhin du btab nas tha mal nor kyang mchog tu bsgyur to//yang dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang mgo log khams phyogs sogs nas 'ong ba'i dad 'dus rnams la nyin cig phan pa'i kha brda 'di ltar byas/ 'o mi rgan nga rang bsams nas gnas 'dir 'dug pa rnams la/ phan pa'i kha brda cung zad tsam zhig byed pas/ kun gyis nyon la yid la zungs/ nged rnams mi rtag tshong 'dus kyi mgron po dang 'dra bas yun ring mi sdod par thams cad so sor gyes yong / de'i bar la tshe thung nam 'chi cha med pas/ do nub tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng ni su la yang med/ sang gnangs tsam la shi na sngar gyi gang yod 'di tsho yang za long 'thung long yod med ci shes soms la/ sang gnangs phan chad kyi bsam blo ma gtong / rang ma shi bar bsdad na las sla yong / khyed yod pa tshos gnas 'dir 'dug pa'i cang med pa tshor zan 'chang re yan chad kyis phan thogs mdzod/ med ni tshos yod pa lo lon rgan pa dang / nad pa tsho la chu shing re'i phan thogs/ khyed thams cad kyi sems bsam pa mthun po gyis/ spro ma ldang / lkog lab ma rgyag sdom dam tshig la ngo lkog 481

nas dge rtsa rnams rang gzhan sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ smon lam yang de bzhin du btab nas tha mal nor kyang mchog tu bsgyur to//yang dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang mgo log khams phyogs sogs nas 'ong ba'i dad 'dus rnams la nyin cig phan pa'i kha brda 'di ltar byas/ 'o mi rgan nga rang bsams nas gnas 'dir 'dug pa rnams la/ phan pa'i kha brda cung zad tsam zhig byed pas/ kun gyis nyon la yid la zungs/ nged rnams mi rtag tshong 'dus kyi mgron po dang 'dra bas yun ring mi sdod par thams cad so sor gyes yong / de'i bar la tshe thung nam 'chi cha med pas/ do nub tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng ni su la yang med/ sang gnangs tsam la shi na sngar gyi gang yod 'di tsho yang za long 'thung long yod med ci shes soms la/ sang gnangs phan chad kyi bsam blo ma gtong / rang ma shi bar bsdad na las sla yong / khyed yod pa tshos gnas 'dir 'dug pa'i cang med pa tshor zan 'chang re yan chad kyis phan thogs mdzod/ med ni tshos yod pa lo lon rgan pa dang / nad pa tsho la chu shing re'i phan thogs/ khyed thams cad kyi sems bsam pa mthun po gyis/ spro ma ldang / lkog lab ma rgyag sdom dam tshig la ngo lkog 481

med pa gyes/ rang gi sngar gang shes thon/ bla ma gzhan gyis gang gsungs nyams su longs/ de'i thog tu ngas bshad pa'i don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par zhog sems kha yangs po gyis/ sdug btsir ma byed dang bzang / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la snying rje sgoms la phan pa'i smon lam thob dang / rang gzhan yongs la tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du shar yong zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs pa/rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /gnas 'dir 'dug dad can pho mo la/ /ngas phan pa'i kha brda cung zad bya/ /nged 'dir 'tshogs tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /yun ring por mi sdod so sor gyes/ /de'i bar la nam 'chi nges pa med/ /dus de ring tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i/ /gdeng med pas sang gnangs shi tsa na/ /sngar gang yod 'di yang za long med/ /sang gnangs kyi bsam blo ma gtong dang / /rang ma shi bsdad na las sla yong / /khyed yod pa rnams tshos 'dir 'dug pa'i/ /cang med pa rnams tshor phan thogs mdzod/ /cang med pa rnams tshos chu shing res/ /gzhan lo 482

lon nad par phan thogs gyis/ /khyed thams cad bsam pa mthun po mdzod/ /spro ma ldang lkog lab ma rgyag cig /sdom dam tshig ngo lkog med par sru/ngas/ /sngar rang gis gang shes kha ton gyes/ /gzhan bla mas gang gsungs nyams su longs/ /de'i thog tu nga yis bshad pa yi/ /sems stong gsal 'dzin med chos kyi dbyings/ /dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la zhog /dus rgyun du sems kha yangs bo gyis/ /gzhan ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /phan thogs pa'i bsngo ba smon lam thob/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /glu 'di thos rgyud la phan thogs nas/ /gnas 'di dang 'di 'dra'i dben pa ru/ /chos zab mo tshul bzhin nyams blangs nas/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shog /ces blangs pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo //yang nyin cig gangs ri'i dge slong byams pa thabs mkhas dang chos grags/ blo gros sogs dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang mgo log khams phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i skal ldan gyi slob ma grwa btsun mang pos zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed rnams kyis tshe blos thongs la mi med pa'i lung stong brag phug rnams 'grims la/ rtogs ldan 483

lon nad par phan thogs gyis/ /khyed thams cad bsam pa mthun po mdzod/ /spro ma ldang lkog lab ma rgyag cig /sdom dam tshig ngo lkog med par sru/ngas/ /sngar rang gis gang shes kha ton gyes/ /gzhan bla mas gang gsungs nyams su longs/ /de'i thog tu nga yis bshad pa yi/ /sems stong gsal 'dzin med chos kyi dbyings/ /dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la zhog /dus rgyun du sems kha yangs bo gyis/ /gzhan ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /phan thogs pa'i bsngo ba smon lam thob/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /glu 'di thos rgyud la phan thogs nas/ /gnas 'di dang 'di 'dra'i dben pa ru/ /chos zab mo tshul bzhin nyams blangs nas/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shog /ces blangs pas kun gyi sems la phan thogs rgya chen po byung ngo //yang nyin cig gangs ri'i dge slong byams pa thabs mkhas dang chos grags/ blo gros sogs dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang mgo log khams phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i skal ldan gyi slob ma grwa btsun mang pos zhal gdams zab mo zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed rnams kyis tshe blos thongs la mi med pa'i lung stong brag phug rnams 'grims la/ rtogs ldan 483

'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa re gyis/ de yi gdams pa kho bos bshad kyis yid la zungs/ de yang bka' brgyud bla ma gong ma rnams kyis chu ma rnyog na dwangs/ sems ma bcos na gsal gsungs/ rgyud sasbu ṭa las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par gsal/ /zhes dang /gsang 'dus rim lnga las/ sems dang sems byung spros pa kun/ /nye bar zhi ba de yi tshe/ /'od gsal ba yi ye shes ni/ /mi rtog mtha' dbus med par 'char/ /gsungs pa ltar/ bde ba'i stan la lus gnad drang por bsrang / mig bar snang la ha re bya/ sems sngar 'das kyi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da lta ba la bzo mi 'chos par/ dran med du had de/dmigs med du seng nge / 'dzin med du lhod der bzhag pas/thog mar rtog med mi ro lta bu'i nyams myong yong / de nas gzhon nu ma bde bas myos pa lta bu'i lus bde nyams yong / de nas sems dwangs snyigs phye nas ston gnam g.ya' dag pa lta bu'i gsal nyams yong / de nas rong khung dma' sa nas ri mthon po'i rtse la bud pa ltar snang ba yangs po yong / de'i ngang la khar yangs khor yangs gu yangs blo bder bzhag pas/484

'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa re gyis/ de yi gdams pa kho bos bshad kyis yid la zungs/ de yang bka' brgyud bla ma gong ma rnams kyis chu ma rnyog na dwangs/ sems ma bcos na gsal gsungs/ rgyud sasbu ṭa las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par gsal/ /zhes dang /gsang 'dus rim lnga las/ sems dang sems byung spros pa kun/ /nye bar zhi ba de yi tshe/ /'od gsal ba yi ye shes ni/ /mi rtog mtha' dbus med par 'char/ /gsungs pa ltar/ bde ba'i stan la lus gnad drang por bsrang / mig bar snang la ha re bya/ sems sngar 'das kyi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da lta ba la bzo mi 'chos par/ dran med du had de/dmigs med du seng nge / 'dzin med du lhod der bzhag pas/thog mar rtog med mi ro lta bu'i nyams myong yong / de nas gzhon nu ma bde bas myos pa lta bu'i lus bde nyams yong / de nas sems dwangs snyigs phye nas ston gnam g.ya' dag pa lta bu'i gsal nyams yong / de nas rong khung dma' sa nas ri mthon po'i rtse la bud pa ltar snang ba yangs po yong / de'i ngang la khar yangs khor yangs gu yangs blo bder bzhag pas/484

skabs shig rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam ste dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med/ dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong ste/ rje mar pa lo tsās/ rje nā ro me tri'i bu brgyud la/ dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor mang gsungs/ de dus nyon mongs pa tsho long shog byas kyang mi langs par/ chos nyid yangs pa chen po'i dbyings su dga' yal ler gnas pa 'byung / de ltar nyams gang shar kyang ma chags ma zhen par zang thal kha yan du bskyangs pas ma bsgrubs pa'i lha zhal mjal ba dang / mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul 'char ba sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan cir yang 'byung bar 'gyur zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad po/ /snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /sems su snang zhing sems nyid kyi/ /ngo bo stong gsal nam mkha' ltar/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la 'jog pa'i tshe/ /sgom gsum rang babs nyid du zhog /de ltar mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /rtog med mi ro p+ta bu yi/ /nyams shig thog mar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /na chung bde bas myos pa bzhin/ /lus sems bde ba'i nyams shig 'byung / /485

skabs shig rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam ste dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ 'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ sems dang nam mkha' khyad med/ dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yong ste/ rje mar pa lo tsās/ rje nā ro me tri'i bu brgyud la/ dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor mang gsungs/ de dus nyon mongs pa tsho long shog byas kyang mi langs par/ chos nyid yangs pa chen po'i dbyings su dga' yal ler gnas pa 'byung / de ltar nyams gang shar kyang ma chags ma zhen par zang thal kha yan du bskyangs pas ma bsgrubs pa'i lha zhal mjal ba dang / mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul 'char ba sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan cir yang 'byung bar 'gyur zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad po/ /snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /sems su snang zhing sems nyid kyi/ /ngo bo stong gsal nam mkha' ltar/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la 'jog pa'i tshe/ /sgom gsum rang babs nyid du zhog /de ltar mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /rtog med mi ro p+ta bu yi/ /nyams shig thog mar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /na chung bde bas myos pa bzhin/ /lus sems bde ba'i nyams shig 'byung / /485

de nas mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /gsal la dwangs pa'i nyams shig 'byung / /bde gsal mi rtog ting nge 'dzin/ /de dag gang la'ang ma chags par/ /yun ring mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /lag pa'i mthil du skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag nas bltas pa ltar/ /sa ler mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes/ /mi la yab sras la sogs pa'i/ /bka' brgyud gong ma mang pos gsungs/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /lam rtags yon tan 'char bar nges zhe gdams pa ltar nyams su blangs pas/ sems kha gzhan las yangs pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma mang po byung ngo / /yang grub dbang nam mkha' tshang dang sngags 'chang mang pos nga'i zhabs brtan du sbyin sreg byas pa'i tshe/ dad can sngags byes 'ga' res khyed kyis sbyin sreg 'dra e gnang zer ba'i lan du/ ngas kyang byed la zhes rtse mtshar du mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//dam pa'i chos kyi me sbar nas/ /nyon mongs bud shing bsreg mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /nyon mongs bsreg par byen gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs 486

de nas mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /gsal la dwangs pa'i nyams shig 'byung / /bde gsal mi rtog ting nge 'dzin/ /de dag gang la'ang ma chags par/ /yun ring mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /lag pa'i mthil du skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag nas bltas pa ltar/ /sa ler mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes/ /mi la yab sras la sogs pa'i/ /bka' brgyud gong ma mang pos gsungs/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /lam rtags yon tan 'char bar nges zhe gdams pa ltar nyams su blangs pas/ sems kha gzhan las yangs pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma mang po byung ngo / /yang grub dbang nam mkha' tshang dang sngags 'chang mang pos nga'i zhabs brtan du sbyin sreg byas pa'i tshe/ dad can sngags byes 'ga' res khyed kyis sbyin sreg 'dra e gnang zer ba'i lan du/ ngas kyang byed la zhes rtse mtshar du mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//dam pa'i chos kyi me sbar nas/ /nyon mongs bud shing bsreg mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /nyon mongs bsreg par byen gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs 486

drug rang grol ngas/ /sbyin bsreg byas tshul glu 'di nyon/ /dad pa'i sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thun mong sngon 'gro'i sa stegs brdungs/ /byang chub sems kyi thig chen btab/ /pha rol phyin pa'i rdul tshon btang / /zhi gnas brtan po'i yam shing brtsigs/ /bag yod dran shes dpal 'bar thogs/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs bud shing la/ /bdag med stong pa'i me chen sbar/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i sgang gzar gyis/ /rim gnyis mar khu rdzas chen rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du blugs pa'i mod/ /nyams rtogs me dpung ches cher 'bar/ /sgrib gnyis tshang tshing lhag med bsregs/ /zag med ye shes me mchod kyis/ /sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku yi/ /rnam rol me lha'i lha tshogs mchod/ /de ltar mchod pas lha rnams mnyes/ /bdag la ci 'dod dngos grub byen/ /khyed rnams de 'dra'i sbyin bsreg gyis/ /byas na las ngan sgrib gnyis sangs/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis sbyin bsreg de ngo mtshar che zhes rab tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i sku gzhogs 'ga' dag rin po che la/ gnyer ba rab byung sogs zhabs phyi ba rnams kyis nga la zhabs brtan tshe sgrub 487

drug rang grol ngas/ /sbyin bsreg byas tshul glu 'di nyon/ /dad pa'i sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thun mong sngon 'gro'i sa stegs brdungs/ /byang chub sems kyi thig chen btab/ /pha rol phyin pa'i rdul tshon btang / /zhi gnas brtan po'i yam shing brtsigs/ /bag yod dran shes dpal 'bar thogs/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs bud shing la/ /bdag med stong pa'i me chen sbar/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i sgang gzar gyis/ /rim gnyis mar khu rdzas chen rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du blugs pa'i mod/ /nyams rtogs me dpung ches cher 'bar/ /sgrib gnyis tshang tshing lhag med bsregs/ /zag med ye shes me mchod kyis/ /sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku yi/ /rnam rol me lha'i lha tshogs mchod/ /de ltar mchod pas lha rnams mnyes/ /bdag la ci 'dod dngos grub byen/ /khyed rnams de 'dra'i sbyin bsreg gyis/ /byas na las ngan sgrib gnyis sangs/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes blangs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis sbyin bsreg de ngo mtshar che zhes rab tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i sku gzhogs 'ga' dag rin po che la/ gnyer ba rab byung sogs zhabs phyi ba rnams kyis nga la zhabs brtan tshe sgrub 487

cig mdzad dgos zhus pas/ khong gis tshe bsgrub gnang nas tshe chu tshe ril tshe chang tshe dpag lha dgu'i lha rdzas bcas nas gsung shog 'di yang gnang 'dugargyal bar gyur/ rang rig gdod ma'i mgon po tshe mtha' yas/ /lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa pad+ma 'byung / /snying rje'i gar mkhan 'chi med thang stong rje/ /tshe lha rgya mtshos rdo rje'i srog rtsa sgrubs/ /srid pa'i dngos brgya mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin/ /spangs dang lhan cig mkhas rtags rig gnas dor/ /rang rig 'od gsal gcig tu nyer gzhol ba'i/ /kun mkhyen sar slebs grub dbang mchog de'i drung / /chen po'i ming bzung rtsod pa'i gral du zhugs/ /rigs byed mang thos bstan 'gro'i kha 'dzin la/ /snyad btags chos brgyad khol bor lo lon pa'i/ /dge sbyong rnam g.yeng mkhan po'i mchid 'di gson/ /skye 'chi gdod nas spangs kyang tha mal ngor/ /grub chen tshul bstan zo mdog bde ngos nas/ /sems dpa' mchog gi rnam thar zla med kyis/ /'gro kun 'dren la ngal med rjes yi rang / /mtshams zhus/ ngan bu'i chos srid bya bzhag ling bsgyur gyis/ /ma bcos lhug par bzhag nas re zhig thag /rtogs pa'i gdeng dang bral yang re dogs kyis/ /nam yang gos med rang sems skyid de mchis/ /pad 488

cig mdzad dgos zhus pas/ khong gis tshe bsgrub gnang nas tshe chu tshe ril tshe chang tshe dpag lha dgu'i lha rdzas bcas nas gsung shog 'di yang gnang 'dugargyal bar gyur/ rang rig gdod ma'i mgon po tshe mtha' yas/ /lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa pad+ma 'byung / /snying rje'i gar mkhan 'chi med thang stong rje/ /tshe lha rgya mtshos rdo rje'i srog rtsa sgrubs/ /srid pa'i dngos brgya mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin/ /spangs dang lhan cig mkhas rtags rig gnas dor/ /rang rig 'od gsal gcig tu nyer gzhol ba'i/ /kun mkhyen sar slebs grub dbang mchog de'i drung / /chen po'i ming bzung rtsod pa'i gral du zhugs/ /rigs byed mang thos bstan 'gro'i kha 'dzin la/ /snyad btags chos brgyad khol bor lo lon pa'i/ /dge sbyong rnam g.yeng mkhan po'i mchid 'di gson/ /skye 'chi gdod nas spangs kyang tha mal ngor/ /grub chen tshul bstan zo mdog bde ngos nas/ /sems dpa' mchog gi rnam thar zla med kyis/ /'gro kun 'dren la ngal med rjes yi rang / /mtshams zhus/ ngan bu'i chos srid bya bzhag ling bsgyur gyis/ /ma bcos lhug par bzhag nas re zhig thag /rtogs pa'i gdeng dang bral yang re dogs kyis/ /nam yang gos med rang sems skyid de mchis/ /pad 488

'byung thang stong mi yi gar bsgyur la/ /tshe sgrub byed dgos med kyang bdag cag la/ /tshogs gsog dgongs te tshe sgrub gyes shig par/ /bka' stsal ji bzhin tshe chu ril bu phul/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i tshul la mi skyo bar/ /dpag med bskal par bzhugs pa pad 'byung bzhin/ /lho nub mi bzhud srin po'i yul 'di skyongs/ /skal ldan mang phyir bzhugs 'dun mi bskyur zhu/ /rgyal rnams chos skur rang sems ro gcig kyang / /rnam smin lus rgyas snang zhen dbyen spyos pas/ /blo 'di zad kyang chos zad mi 'byung bas/ /zad sar yang dag 'khrol ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /tshe 'dze+en 'tsho rgyal mas/ /tshe bum skyes btegs nas/ /bai ro'i dad mos ltar/ /o rgyan drung du thal/ /badz+ra ā yur gemā hā/ zhes gnang ba 'byor bas yid rab tu dga' zhing spro ba byung / 'byor lan du yi ge rten bcas phul/ de lta grub dbang nam mkha' rin po che la sogs pa'i phyogs phyogs kyi bla ma dang / tshe mtshams pa dge 'dun rig 'dzin gyi sde mang po nas/ tshe sgrub zhabs brtan phul ba'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ nyi ma sprin las grol ba bzhin tshe yi gegs las grol nas/ lo mang po'i bar du lus sems bde ba'i ngos nas mdo smad phyogs kyi bstan 'gro'i don chen mang po sgrub rgyu 'ong ba'i kha g.yang brjod pas thams cad 489

'byung thang stong mi yi gar bsgyur la/ /tshe sgrub byed dgos med kyang bdag cag la/ /tshogs gsog dgongs te tshe sgrub gyes shig par/ /bka' stsal ji bzhin tshe chu ril bu phul/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i tshul la mi skyo bar/ /dpag med bskal par bzhugs pa pad 'byung bzhin/ /lho nub mi bzhud srin po'i yul 'di skyongs/ /skal ldan mang phyir bzhugs 'dun mi bskyur zhu/ /rgyal rnams chos skur rang sems ro gcig kyang / /rnam smin lus rgyas snang zhen dbyen spyos pas/ /blo 'di zad kyang chos zad mi 'byung bas/ /zad sar yang dag 'khyol ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /tshe 'dze+en 'tsho rgyal mas/ /tshe bum skyes btegs nas/ /bai ro'i dad mos ltar/ /o rgyan drung du thal/ /badz+ra ā yur gemā hā/ zhes gnang ba 'byor bas yid rab tu dga' zhing spro ba byung / 'byor lan du yi ge rten bcas phul/ de lta grub dbang nam mkha' rin po che la sogs pa'i phyogs phyogs kyi bla ma dang / tshe mtshams pa dge 'dun rig 'dzin gyi sde mang po nas/ tshe sgrub zhabs brtan phul ba'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ nyi ma sprin las grol ba bzhin tshe yi gegs las grol nas/ lo mang po'i bar du lus sems bde ba'i ngos nas mdo smad phyogs kyi bstan 'gro'i don chen mang po sgrub rgyu 'ong ba'i kha g.yang brjod pas thams cad 489

—— dga' ba byung / yang slob ma skal bzang 'ga' res/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ snyigs dus 'dir tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i gang zag de ji lta bu zhig dgos zer ba la/'o de la tshe 'di la 'dod pa til 'bru tsam zhig med pa zhig dgos te/ rje dwags po lha rjes/ dge bshes snyug rum pa la/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba srid dam zhus pas/ tshe 'di la ltos pa spu tsam med pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ de tsam du ma zad snying rje chen po'i sgos/ rang gi ngos nas ma sems can re re'i phyir yang mnar med pa'i me nang du bskal pa rgya mtshor gnas dgos rung snying rjes mi skyo zhing / ma sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsams nas snying rje chen pos yid bskyod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring thob nas sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya bkyes nas/ 'gro ba'i don zhig byed rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na snyam pa skom pa chu 'dod pa lta bu zhig dgos/ sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i thabs rig gnas mdo sngags kyi gzhung rgya chen po tsho los yin kyang / tshe thung nam 'chi cha med la de rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum byed khom mi 'dugagasang sngags kyi nye lam bsgrub dgos snyam mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten nas/ thog mar rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud 490

—— dga' ba byung / yang slob ma skal bzang 'ga' res/ skyabs mgon rin po che/ snyigs dus 'dir tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i gang zag de ji lta bu zhig dgos zer ba la/'o de la tshe 'di la 'dod pa til 'bru tsam zhig med pa zhig dgos te/ rje dwags po lha rjes/ dge bshes snyug rum pa la/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba srid dam zhus pas/ tshe 'di la ltos pa spu tsam med pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ de tsam du ma zad snying rje chen po'i sgos/ rang gi ngos nas ma sems can re re'i phyir yang mnar med pa'i me nang du bskal pa rgya mtshor gnas dgos rung snying rjes mi skyo zhing / ma sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsams nas snying rje chen pos yid bskyod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring thob nas sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya bkyes nas/ 'gro ba'i don zhig byed rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na snyam pa skom pa chu 'dod pa lta bu zhig dgos/ sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i thabs rig gnas mdo sngags kyi gzhung rgya chen po tsho los yin kyang / tshe thung nam 'chi cha med la de rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum byed khom mi 'dugagasang sngags kyi nye lam bsgrub dgos snyam mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten nas/ thog mar rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud 490

sbyangs/ de nas gsang sngags bla med kyi smin byed dbang dang grol byed kyi khrid zhus nas/ mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul rnams nas gcig pur drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas nas/na bun gos ltar gyon/ brag phug zhwa ltar bsten gyong lto gos gtam gsum la btang / rtag tu ri'i bu byas skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma la gsol ba 'debs bzhin bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang / khyad par rdzogs rim 'od gsal dang mthun pa'i nyams len phyag rdzogs do ha sogs lta ba mthon po tsho'i skyong tshul bzhin 'jog bsgom gtso bor byas na/ snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'di nyid la 'od gsal sgyu lus zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang mngon du byas te/ rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub par gdon mi za'o zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//lung rtogs yon tan dpag med gter/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon rje/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma la/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang / /ldan pa'i snod ldan slob ma yis/ /rab tu dad cing gus pa'i sgos/ /mchod pa gsum gyes mnyes par byas/ /bla ma des kyang brtse ba'i sgos/ /rjes su bzung nas thun mong ba/ /lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /gsang sngags rdo 491

sbyangs/ de nas gsang sngags bla med kyi smin byed dbang dang grol byed kyi khrid zhus nas/ mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul rnams nas gcig pur drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas nas/na bun gos ltar gyon/ brag phug zhwa ltar bsten gyong lto gos gtam gsum la btang / rtag tu ri'i bu byas skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma la gsol ba 'debs bzhin bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang / khyad par rdzogs rim 'od gsal dang mthun pa'i nyams len phyag rdzogs do ha sogs lta ba mthon po tsho'i skyong tshul bzhin 'jog bsgom gtso bor byas na/ snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'di nyid la 'od gsal sgyu lus zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang mngon du byas te/ rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub par gdon mi za'o zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//lung rtogs yon tan dpag med gter/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon rje/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma la/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang / /ldan pa'i snod ldan slob ma yis/ /rab tu dad cing gus pa'i sgos/ /mchod pa gsum gyes mnyes par byas/ /bla ma des kyang brtse ba'i sgos/ /rjes su bzung nas thun mong ba/ /lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /gsang sngags rdo 491

rje theg pa yi/ /dbang bskur bskyed rdzogs lam bzang khrid/ /khyad par rdzogs rim mthar thug gi /'od gsal sems nyid gnyug ma'i don/ /rang gsal mngon sum rjen par bstan/ /de nas skal bzang slob ma des/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /gcig pur nyams su len nus na/ /'od gsal chos sku mngon du byas/ /gang 'dul gzugs skus 'gro don mdzad/ /tshe 'di nyid la rang gzhan gyi/ /don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par nges/ /de phyir skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /rab tu dga' bas nyams su longs/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i dus/ /bla ma lha yi byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes smras pas/kun gyis tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad nas dben par tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams pas gtan gyi lam sna zin pa mang po byung ngo / /yang nyin cig dad can slob ma par yig 'bri mkhan lha khang dbu mdzad dang / par dpon skyi'i bla ma/ hor nag bsam 'grub sogs par brko mkhan rnams la brtson 'grus kyi lcag 'debs su/ de yang ji skad du mdo las/ gang la le lo gcig yod pa/ /de la chos kun med pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ yi ge 'bri ba brko ba sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba gang byed kyang / rnam g.yeng le lo byas na mi yong bas/ brtson 'grus rgyun ring ba/ bar ma 492

rje theg pa yi/ /dbang bskur bskyed rdzogs lam bzang khrid/ /khyad par rdzogs rim mthar thug gi /'od gsal sems nyid gnyug ma'i don/ /rang gsal mngon sum rjen par bstan/ /de nas skal bzang slob ma des/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /gcig pur nyams su len nus na/ /'od gsal chos sku mngon du byas/ /gang 'dul gzugs skus 'gro don mdzad/ /tshe 'di nyid la rang gzhan gyi/ /don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par nges/ /de phyir skal ldan slob bu rnams/ /rab tu dga' bas nyams su longs/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i dus/ /bla ma lha yi byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes smras pas/kun gyis tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad nas dben par tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams pas gtan gyi lam sna zin pa mang po byung ngo / /yang nyin cig dad can slob ma par yig 'bri mkhan lha khang dbu mdzad dang / par dpon skyi'i bla ma/ hor nag bsam 'grub sogs par brko mkhan rnams la brtson 'grus kyi lcag 'debs su/ de yang ji skad du mdo las/ gang la le lo gcig yod pa/ /de la chos kun med pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ yi ge 'bri ba brko ba sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba gang byed kyang / rnam g.yeng le lo byas na mi yong bas/ brtson 'grus rgyun ring ba/ bar ma 492

chad pa shugs drag pa gsum 'dzom na/ dgos pa thams cad 'grub pa yin te/ sbyan snga bas/ khyod kyis brtson 'grus byas gyur na/ /nges par khyod kyi dgos pa 'grub/ /gsungs pa ltar khyed rnams kyis par yig 'bri ba dang brko ba la nyin re bzhin brtson 'grus ches cher bskyed dang / par mang po myur du 'grub yong bas de kun gyi sems la zhog la rem rem byas pas rta bzang la lcag gis bskul pa bzhin du gyur nas/ par yig par po ti mang po myur du 'grub pa byung / yang nye gnas kun dga' sogs dad can grwa btsun 'ga' res khyed kyis gzhan la zhal gdams mang po gnang bar gda'/ khong tshor yang zhal gdams shig gnang dgos zhes bskul ba la/ 'o zhal gdams nang bzhin byed na ster zhes 'di byen/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod na bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyad khri'i sdig pa 'dag go /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod na myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad kyi tshul las rnam par 'phrul bar nges pa gzi brjid 'byung ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /493

chad pa shugs drag pa gsum 'dzom na/ dgos pa thams cad 'grub pa yin te/ sbyan snga bas/ khyod kyis brtson 'grus byas gyur na/ /nges par khyod kyi dgos pa 'grub/ /gsungs pa ltar khyed rnams kyis par yig 'bri ba dang brko ba la nyin re bzhin brtson 'grus ches cher bskyed dang / par mang po myur du 'grub yong bas de kun gyi sems la zhog la rem rem byas pas rta bzang la lcag gis bskul pa bzhin du gyur nas/ par yig par po ti mang po myur du 'grub pa byung / yang nye gnas kun dga' sogs dad can grwa btsun 'ga' res khyed kyis gzhan la zhal gdams mang po gnang bar gda'/ khong tshor yang zhal gdams shig gnang dgos zhes bskul ba la/ 'o zhal gdams nang bzhin byed na ster zhes 'di byen/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod na bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyad khri'i sdig pa 'dag go /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod na myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad kyi tshul las rnam par 'phrul bar nges pa gzi brjid 'byung ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /493

zhes brjod na tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya'o/ /oṃ a snyi ra hūṃ khe tsa ra mi/ 'di dran pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga byang zhing myang 'das thob bo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ k+ṣi 'di rab tu gsang nas bzlas na don dang las thams cad 'grub par gsungs/ oṃ ste tsa na hūṃ/ zhes pa 'di lan cig brjod kyang bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag go /sngon slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas sangs rgyas par gsungs/ oṃ trīḥ pad+ma nir ti shwa ri hūṃ/ gzungs 'di lan cig brjod pa'i phan yon ni/ ma ṇi dung phyur sum cu rtsa gsum bton pa dang mnyam par pad+ma dra ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ lo lon dang le lo can sogs ma ṇi dung phyur 'don mi thub pa rnams kyis ma ṇi'i mjug tu gzungs 'di yang kha shas bton na bzang /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon oṃ āḥ hūṃ lan cig brjod kyang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib 'dag cing sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ pañci gri ya a ba bho rnyan ye swā hā/gzungs 'di lan cig brjod kyang smon lam btab tshad 'grub par gsungs/ oṃ yi rnyarmā he tu pra bha wā he tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro rnya e waṃ bā dī ma hā shram ṇaḥ ye sā hā/494

zhes brjod na tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya'o/ /oṃ a snyi ra hūṃ khe tsa ra mi/ 'di dran pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga byang zhing myang 'das thob bo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ k+ṣi 'di rab tu gsang nas bzlas na don dang las thams cad 'grub par gsungs/ oṃ ste tsa na hūṃ/ zhes pa 'di lan cig brjod kyang bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag go /sngon slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas sangs rgyas par gsungs/ oṃ trīḥ pad+ma nir ti shwa ri t+t+waṃ/ gzungs 'di lan cig brjod pa'i phan yon ni/ ma ṇi dung phyur sum cu rtsa gsum bton pa dang mnyam par pad+ma dra ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ lo lon dang le lo can sogs ma ṇi dung phyur 'don mi thub pa rnams kyis ma ṇi'i mjug tu gzungs 'di yang kha shas bton na bzang /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon oṃ āḥ hūṃ lan cig brjod kyang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib 'dag cing sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ pañci gri ya a ba bho rnyan ye swā hā/gzungs 'di lan cig brjod kyang smon lam btab tshad 'grub par gsungs/ oṃ yi rnyarmā he tu pra bha wā he tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro rnya e waṃ bā dī ma hā shram ṇaḥ ye sā hā/494

zhes brjod na bkra shis pa la sogs phan yon brjod las 'das pa gsungs/ oṃ pad+mo n+ḍi ṣa bi ma le hūṃ phaṭa/ gzungs 'di'i 'og tu zhugs na bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag ces don yod zhags pa'i rgyud nas gsungs/ des na gzungs 'di kha 'don bar du bzhag nas kha ton 'grub pa dang dpe cha mgo thog tu bzhag na bzang ngo / /rin chen gling du phyin nas nor bu'i rigs/ /che chung gang yang blangs na 'tshengs pa ltar/ /chos kyi yul dbus skyes nas dam chos rigs/ /che chung gang zhig byas kyang 'tshengs par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas kun gyes de bzhin bsgrub rgyu'i skal ba byung ngo / /yang sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i skal ldan sprul sku la bka' gdams glegs bam g.yor dus 'di skad smras/bka' dang dgongs 'grel thams cad gdams par shar/ /bka' ltar mdzad pa'i jo bo yab sras sogs/ /bka' gdams bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /bka' gdams glegs bam bsngags brjod cung zad bya/ /bka' dang bstan bcos kun gyi snying po'i don/ /bka' gdams pha chos bu chos gnyis la 'dus/ /bka' chos nang bzhin bsgrubs pas sngon gye dus/ /bka' gdams pa yis sa steng khyab pa byung / /bka' 'gyur 495

zhes brjod na bkra shis pa la sogs phan yon brjod las 'das pa gsungs/ oṃ pad+mo n+ḍi ṣa bi ma le hūṃ phaṭa/ gzungs 'di'i 'og tu zhugs na bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag ces don yod zhags pa'i rgyud nas gsungs/ des na gzungs 'di kha 'don bar du bzhag nas kha ton 'grub pa dang dpe cha mgo thog tu bzhag na bzang ngo / /rin chen gling du phyin nas nor bu'i rigs/ /che chung gang yang blangs na 'tshengs pa ltar/ /chos kyi yul dbus skyes nas dam chos rigs/ /che chung gang zhig byas kyang 'tshengs par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas kun gyes de bzhin bsgrub rgyu'i skal ba byung ngo / /yang sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i skal ldan sprul sku la bka' gdams glegs bam g.yor dus 'di skad smras/bka' dang dgongs 'grel thams cad gdams par shar/ /bka' ltar mdzad pa'i jo bo yab sras sogs/ /bka' gdams bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /bka' gdams glegs bam bsngags brjod cung zad bya/ /bka' dang bstan bcos kun gyi snying po'i don/ /bka' gdams pha chos bu chos gnyis la 'dus/ /bka' chos nang bzhin bsgrubs pas sngon gye dus/ /bka' gdams pa yis sa steng khyab pa byung / /bka' 'gyur 495

bstan 'gyur blta bar mi nus pas/ /bka' gdams glegs bam 'di la legs par ltos/ /bka' bzhin dben par nyams su len nus na/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar zin par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pa bzhin sgrub pa'i bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar dang mthun pa'i tshe blos btang gi chos pa bzang po zhig byung ngo / /yang stod gangs ri man chad kyi dben gnas rnams su song nas gnas 'brel bzhag nas 'ongs pa'i be'u thang mtshams pa dang / lha khang mtshams pa gnyis la dwags po bka' 'bum g.yor dus 'di skad smras/bka' 'gyur bstan pa'i yang mes te lo sogs/ /bka' 'gyur bla ma thams cad spyi bos mchod/ /bka' 'gyur kun gyi gtsug rgyan sgam po pa'i/ /bka' 'bum po ti gnyis la legs par ltos/ /bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres gdams pa 'di/ /bka' gter gzhan las ngo mtshar byin rlabs che/ /bka' chos zab mo 'di nyid la brten nas/ /bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad grub pa brnyes/ /bka' drin mtshungs med bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /bka' brgyud bstan dang mjal ba skal ba bzang /bka' brgyud chos la mos pa'i slob bu gnyis/ /bka' 'bum nang bzhin mdzod dang nyams rtogs 'char/ /zhes gang smras 496

bstan 'gyur blta bar mi nus pas/ /bka' gdams glegs bam 'di la legs par ltos/ /bka' bzhin dben par nyams su len nus na/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar zin par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pa bzhin sgrub pa'i bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar dang mthun pa'i tshe blos btang gi chos pa bzang po zhig byung ngo / /yang stod gangs ri man chad kyi dben gnas rnams su song nas gnas 'brel bzhag nas 'ongs pa'i be'u thang mtshams pa dang / lha khang mtshams pa gnyis la dwags po bka' 'bum g.yor dus 'di skad smras/bka' 'gyur bstan pa'i yang mes te lo sogs/ /bka' 'gyur bla ma thams cad spyi bos mchod/ /bka' 'gyur kun gyi gtsug rgyan sgam po pa'i/ /bka' 'bum po ti gnyis la legs par ltos/ /bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres gdams pa 'di/ /bka' gter gzhan las ngo mtshar byin rlabs che/ /bka' chos zab mo 'di nyid la brten nas/ /bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad grub pa brnyes/ /bka' drin mtshungs med bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /bka' brgyud bstan dang mjal ba skal ba bzang /bka' brgyud chos la mos pa'i slob bu gnyis/ /bka' 'bum nang bzhin mdzod dang nyams rtogs 'char/ /zhes gang smras 496

pa bzhin byas pas bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar zin pa'i rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor bzang po gnyis byung / yang bka' brgyud kyi bde mchog gi dbang dang snyan brgyud brda yi dbang bzhi bskur dus dbang bshad 'di 'dra byas/ 'o de yang bla mas dbang bskur ba'i phan yon ni gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgoms kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ thog mar slob ma gang gi tshe/ /blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /de yi tshe na snod du 'gyur/ /gsungs/ slob ma'i dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni/ snying gi me long las/ dbang rnams rab tu thob byas nas/ /gsang sngags thams cad ma bsgrubs 'grub/ /ces dang / klong gsal las/ dbang thob rgyud smin chos sgo 'byed/ /gsang sngags don kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / khyad par du de nyid las/ dbang thob rigs kyi bu de nyid/ /tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub dang / /phyi mar mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dang po re zhig gang tshe slob/ /lan cig dbang rnams kyi ni bskur/ /de tshe gsang 497

pa bzhin byas pas bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar zin pa'i rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor bzang po gnyis byung / yang bka' brgyud kyi bde mchog gi dbang dang snyan brgyud brda yi dbang bzhi bskur dus dbang bshad 'di 'dra byas/ 'o de yang bla mas dbang bskur ba'i phan yon ni gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgoms kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ thog mar slob ma gang gi tshe/ /blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /de yi tshe na snod du 'gyur/ /gsungs/ slob ma'i dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni/ snying gi me long las/ dbang rnams rab tu thob byas nas/ /gsang sngags thams cad ma bsgrubs 'grub/ /ces dang / klong gsal las/ dbang thob rgyud smin chos sgo 'byed/ /gsang sngags don kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / khyad par du de nyid las/ dbang thob rigs kyi bu de nyid/ /tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub dang / /phyi mar mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dang po re zhig gang tshe slob/ /lan cig dbang rnams kyi ni bskur/ /de tshe gsang 497

sngags bshad pa yi/ /nges par snod du gyur pa'o/ /zhes dang /lung gzhan las/ gsang sngags dbang dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gang / /nges pa'i don gyi chos la spyod dbang zhing / /pha nor bu la thob pa ji bzhin no/ /gsungs/ dbang ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ sangs rgyas thod pa las/ dper na pi wang sbyor kun tshogs/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung / /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na/ /sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang / /slob dpon slob mar mtshungs pa ni/ /mi bzad dmyal ba chen por 'gro/ /zhes dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma bcir la mar med ltar/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma las ni dbang don zhu/ /zhes dang / klong gsal las/ dper na zhing sa gshin po la/ /so nam rim par ma byas na/ /'bras bu smin par mi 'gyur ltar/ /sems la chos nyid gnas gyur kyang / /dbang gis smin par ma byas na/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub ga la thob/ /dbang med 'khor 498

sngags bshad pa yi/ /nges par snod du gyur pa'o/ /zhes dang /lung gzhan las/ gsang sngags dbang dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gang / /nges pa'i don gyi chos la spyod dbang zhing / /pha nor bu la thob pa ji bzhin no/ /gsungs/ dbang ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ sangs rgyas thod pa las/ dper na pi wang sbyor kun tshogs/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung / /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na/ /sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang / /slob dpon slob mar mtshungs pa ni/ /mi bzad dmyal ba chen por 'gro/ /zhes dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma bcir la mar med ltar/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma las ni dbang don zhu/ /zhes dang / klong gsal las/ dper na zhing sa gshin po la/ /so nam rim par ma byas na/ /'bras bu smin par mi 'gyur ltar/ /sems la chos nyid gnas gyur kyang / /dbang gis smin par ma byas na/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub ga la thob/ /dbang med 'khor 498

ba'i mtha' bsnyegs te/ /'di phyi'i bde ba thob pa med/ /ces dang / lung gzhan las/gsang sngags dbang la ma brten 'grub par ga la 'gyur/ /dper na mnyan pa lag skya med pa bzhin/ /zhes sogs rgyud sde chen po mang po nas gsungs pas/ des na dbang thob pa'i phan yon/ ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i zhabasadrung nas gsang sngags kyi dbang bzhi zab mo yongs su rdzogs pa nod par bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi lta dgongs kyi mtho dman dang / slob ma'i blo kha mtho dman gye dbang gis dbang bskur tshul mi 'dra ste/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis slob ma sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mdzod spu las spros pa'i 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur pa dang / sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon pad+mas stag tshang seng phug tu mkhar chen bza' la phur ba'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bstan nas dbang bskur pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mtsho ma phang la thig btab nas/ dpal mañju shrī sogs la rdo rje dbyengs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur pa dang / byang sham+bha lar rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas blos bslang gi dkyil 'khor du tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag 499

ba'i mtha' bsnyegs te/ /'di phyi'i bde ba thob pa med/ /ces dang / lung gzhan las/gsang sngags dbang la ma brten 'grub par ga la 'gyur/ /dper na mnyan pa lag skya med pa bzhin/ /zhes sogs rgyud sde chen po mang po nas gsungs pas/ des na dbang thob pa'i phan yon/ ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i zhabasadrung nas gsang sngags kyi dbang bzhi zab mo yongs su rdzogs pa nod par bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi lta dgongs kyi mtho dman dang / slob ma'i blo kha mtho dman gye dbang gis dbang bskur tshul mi 'dra ste/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis slob ma sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mdzod spu las spros pa'i 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur pa dang / sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon pad+mas stag tshang seng phug tu mkhar chen bza' la phur ba'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bstan nas dbang bskur pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mtsho ma phang la thig btab nas/ dpal mañju shrī sogs la rdo rje dbyengs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur pa dang / byang sham+bha lar rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas blos bslang gi dkyil 'khor du tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag 499

phyed dang bzhi smin par mdzad pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas dang sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang rgya bod kyi paṇa grub gong ma rnams kyis rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang /dbyings rig sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor/ rig pa nyams kyi dkyil 'khor/ rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la sogs la brten nas slob ma'i rgyud smin par mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus mang du snang / de 'dra'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams la dkyil 'khor yang dbyibs gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dkyil 'khor zlum po sgo brgyad du snang ba dang / yang dag he ru ga'i dkyil 'khor zla gam sgo gcig pa dang / sgo spangs pa yang yod de/ shes rab ma yi rgyud mthar thug thams cad dkyil 'khor chos 'byung gi rnam pa dang / pad+ma 'dab brgyad la sogs ma nges pa du mar snang bas/ mtha' gcig tu bzung nas khas gtong bar mi bya'o/ /de 'dra ma yin pa'i rang re so skyes kyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyis/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsung dang dam pa gong ma'i phyag len bzhin dbang bskur na/ rab rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ 'bring ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor/ tha ma maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu la brten nas rang rang gi cho ga'i nang bzhin bdag mdun tha dad du bsgrub pa'am/ tha mi 500

phyed dang bzhi smin par mdzad pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas dang sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang rgya bod kyi paṇa grub gong ma rnams kyis rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang /dbyings rig sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor/ rig pa nyams kyi dkyil 'khor/ rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la sogs la brten nas slob ma'i rgyud smin par mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus mang du snang / de 'dra'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams la dkyil 'khor yang dbyibs gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dkyil 'khor zlum po sgo brgyad du snang ba dang / yang dag he ru ga'i dkyil 'khor zla gam sgo gcig pa dang / sgo spangs pa yang yod de/ shes rab ma yi rgyud mthar thug thams cad dkyil 'khor chos 'byung gi rnam pa dang / pad+ma 'dab brgyad la sogs ma nges pa du mar snang bas/ mtha' gcig tu bzung nas khas gtong bar mi bya'o/ /de 'dra ma yin pa'i rang re so skyes kyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyis/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsung dang dam pa gong ma'i phyag len bzhin dbang bskur na/ rab rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ 'bring ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor/ tha ma maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu la brten nas rang rang gi cho ga'i nang bzhin bdag mdun tha dad du bsgrub pa'am/ tha mi 500

dad gang rung du bsgrubs nas bdag 'jug blangs nas slob ma las dang po pa rnams la/ sngags mos lam gyis 'grub pa yin pas/ gang mos mos sems sems byas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /dbang la yang rgyud sde bzhi so so la dbang mi 'dra ba mang zhing / jo bo'i dam tshig bsdus pa las/ bla ma'i zhal las byung ba'i dbang dang / yi dam gye byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang dang /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa'i dbang dang / rang gi sems nyid kyi rtsal gyis thob pa'i dbang dang bzhi'o zhes bshad la/ gzhan yang mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbang dang / glegs bam bo ti'i dbang dang / yi dam lha'i byen gyes brlabs pa'i dbang dang / rig pa'i rtsal gye dbang ste dbang gi tha snyad mang yang /gsang sngags bla med kyi bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / tshig dbang ste bzhi bo 'di dbang kun gyi nang nas mchog tu bsngags te/ rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i sngags rim chen mo las/ bum dbang gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bskur ba yis/ /tha mal snang zhen lus kyi dri ma bkrus/ /gsang ba ye shes bdud rtsi myang ba yis/ /ngag gnas rlung gi rgyu ba sngags su 'char/ /gsum pa lhan skyes dga' ba'i lcags kyu yis/ /yid kyi skyes bu don dam dbyings su drangs/ /bzhi ba 501

dad gang rung du bsgrubs nas bdag 'jug blangs nas slob ma las dang po pa rnams la/ sngags mos lam gyis 'grub pa yin pas/ gang mos mos sems sems byas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /dbang la yang rgyud sde bzhi so so la dbang mi 'dra ba mang zhing / jo bo'i dam tshig bsdus pa las/ bla ma'i zhal las byung ba'i dbang dang / yi dam gye byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang dang /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa'i dbang dang / rang gi sems nyid kyi rtsal gyis thob pa'i dbang dang bzhi'o zhes bshad la/ gzhan yang mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbang dang / glegs bam bo ti'i dbang dang / yi dam lha'i byen gyes brlabs pa'i dbang dang / rig pa'i rtsal gye dbang ste dbang gi tha snyad mang yang /gsang sngags bla med kyi bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / tshig dbang ste bzhi bo 'di dbang kun gyi nang nas mchog tu bsngags te/ rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i sngags rim chen mo las/ bum dbang gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bskur ba yis/ /tha mal snang zhen lus kyi dri ma bkrus/ /gsang ba ye shes bdud rtsi myang ba yis/ /ngag gnas rlung gi rgyu ba sngags su 'char/ /gsum pa lhan skyes dga' ba'i lcags kyu yis/ /yid kyi skyes bu don dam dbyings su drangs/ /bzhi ba 501

zung 'jug don la ngo sprod pas/ /mthar thug skyel so'i gnad la the tshom bcad/ /dbang bzhi'i gnad don tshul bzhin nges pa las/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i gdams pa yod min zhes/ /rang gi rtogs pa glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /bla ma rnams dang 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'bul/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i dbang thob nas/dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung bar gal che ste/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ rdo rje theg la dad cing ma smin las/ /zab mo bsgoms kyang 'bras bu ngan 'gro las/ /mchog gzhan mi 'grub sangs rgyas gsungs pas na/ /bla ma mchog la dbang bskur nod par mdzod/ /dbang thob man ngag zab mo 'tshol ba yis/ /sa steng rgyas par kun tu btsal byas kyang / /phan pa'i don po gdams ngag dam tshig ste/ /'di rmed 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khang rul 'dra/ /legs par smin las dam tshig bsrung byas na/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i man ngag ma bsten kyang / /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub bo zhes/ /'gro ba'i rtsa lag phan par mdzad pas gsungs/ /bdag ni thos nyung shes rab mig bral yang / /dri med rgyud las legs gsungs mthong bas na/ /dbang blangs dam tshig bsrung bar mdzod cig ces/ /kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /502

zung 'jug don la ngo sprod pas/ /mthar thug skyel so'i gnad la the tshom bcad/ /dbang bzhi'i gnad don tshul bzhin nges pa las/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i gdams pa yod min zhes/ /rang gi rtogs pa glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /bla ma rnams dang 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'bul/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i dbang thob nas/dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung bar gal che ste/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ rdo rje theg la dad cing ma smin las/ /zab mo bsgoms kyang 'bras bu ngan 'gro las/ /mchog gzhan mi 'grub sangs rgyas gsungs pas na/ /bla ma mchog la dbang bskur nod par mdzod/ /dbang thob man ngag zab mo 'tshol ba yis/ /sa steng rgyas par kun tu btsal byas kyang / /phan pa'i don po gdams ngag dam tshig ste/ /'di rmed 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khang rul 'dra/ /legs par smin las dam tshig bsrung byas na/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i man ngag ma bsten kyang / /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub bo zhes/ /'gro ba'i rtsa lag phan par mdzad pas gsungs/ /bdag ni thos nyung shes rab mig bral yang / /dri med rgyud las legs gsungs mthong bas na/ /dbang blangs dam tshig bsrung bar mdzod cig ces/ /kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /502

zhes gsungs pa ni rgyud sde'i gnad mkhyen pa'i gtam yin te/bdag kyang de ltar gsol ba 'debs so zhes rje rin po ches gsungs/ gzhan yang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i dbang thob bskyed rdzogs kyi lam bzang la bslabs na/ brtson 'grus can rnams ring por mi thogs par snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la sangs rgyas par 'gyur te/ sasbu ṭa las/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /bsgrub par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyang / /tshe 'di nyid la ster bas na/ /'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /gsungs/ brtson 'grus 'bring bar dor grol ba ni/ rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ bu ga dgu yi steng phyogs nas/ /'phral du yid kyis 'pho byed na/ /nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga bo byed pa dang / /chom rkun las kyi longs spyod pa/ /'di yi lam gyis grol 'gyur te/ /sdig pas goms par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/dbang po tha ma'i rab rnams skye ba phyi mar grol te/ mtshan brjod las/ skyes ma thag tu 'gro ba'i bdag /ces dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ de phyir rnal 'byor blo ldan gyis/ /shin tu sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni/ /skye 'dir dngos grub ma thob kyang / /skye gzhan srid par dngos grub thob/ /gsungs/ tha ma'i 'bring 503

zhes gsungs pa ni rgyud sde'i gnad mkhyen pa'i gtam yin te/bdag kyang de ltar gsol ba 'debs so zhes rje rin po ches gsungs/ gzhan yang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i dbang thob bskyed rdzogs kyi lam bzang la bslabs na/ brtson 'grus can rnams ring por mi thogs par snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la sangs rgyas par 'gyur te/ sasbu ṭa las/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /bsgrub par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyang / /tshe 'di nyid la ster bas na/ /'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /gsungs/ brtson 'grus 'bring bar dor grol ba ni/ rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ bu ga dgu yi steng phyogs nas/ /'phral du yid kyis 'pho byed na/ /nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga bo byed pa dang / /chom rkun las kyi longs spyod pa/ /'di yi lam gyis grol 'gyur te/ /sdig pas goms par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/dbang po tha ma'i rab rnams skye ba phyi mar grol te/ mtshan brjod las/ skyes ma thag tu 'gro ba'i bdag /ces dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ de phyir rnal 'byor blo ldan gyis/ /shin tu sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni/ /skye 'dir dngos grub ma thob kyang / /skye gzhan srid par dngos grub thob/ /gsungs/ tha ma'i 'bring 503

ni skye ba bdun na grol te/ gsang ba mdzod las/ de yi skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgoms kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur//gsungs/tha ma'i tha ma yang skye ba bcu drug tshun la 'tshang rgya ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa ni/ /bskal pa grangs med mi thob pa'i/ /gal te rnal 'byor pa des brtson/ /tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan 'da'/ /yang na mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /skye ba bcu drug mya ngan 'da'/ /so so skye bo sangs rgyas nyid//'grub par 'gyur gyes gzhan du min/ /zhes dang / dam tshig lnga ba las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces dang /rnam grol zla bas kyang / ma bsgoms gyur kyang ltung med na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa rnams la bsams nas gsang sngags kyi nye lam bslab par bya'o/ /zhes bshad pas kun gyi sems la phan po byung / yang slob bu skal ldan gnas brtan dang mdzod dge sogs tshe blos btang gi slob ma mang pos ri khrod dben pa'i bsngags brjod cig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor/ 'o de yang mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal snga nas/ mdo sngags kyi dbang lung khrid gsum thob nas/bla ma spyi bor bsgoms/ gdams ngag sems la bzung / be'u bum rgyab tu 'khur/ sba dbyug lag tu thogs/ ngag gis gsol 504

ni skye ba bdun na grol te/ gsang ba mdzod las/ de yi skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgoms kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur//gsungs/tha ma'i tha ma yang skye ba bcu drug tshun la 'tshang rgya ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa ni/ /bskal pa grangs med mi thob pa'i/ /gal te rnal 'byor pa des brtson/ /tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan 'da'/ /yang na mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /skye ba bcu drug mya ngan 'da'/ /so so skye bo sangs rgyas nyid//'grub par 'gyur gyes gzhan du min/ /zhes dang / dam tshig lnga ba las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces dang /rnam grol zla bas kyang / ma bsgoms gyur kyang ltung med na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa rnams la bsams nas gsang sngags kyi nye lam bslab par bya'o/ /zhes bshad pas kun gyi sems la phan po byung / yang slob bu skal ldan gnas brtan dang mdzod dge sogs tshe blos btang gi slob ma mang pos ri khrod dben pa'i bsngags brjod cig gsung dgos zhes bskul ngor/ 'o de yang mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal snga nas/ mdo sngags kyi dbang lung khrid gsum thob nas/bla ma spyi bor bsgoms/ gdams ngag sems la bzung / be'u bum rgyab tu 'khur/ sba dbyug lag tu thogs/ ngag gis gsol 504

'debs 'dra 'don bzhin/ dam pa gong ma'i rjes su kha mig yar blta byas/ ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du 'gro rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na/ mi de bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu can yin te/ 'dus byas 'khor ba'i chos thams cad la/snying po med pa/ mi rtag pa sdug bsngal ba'i tshul la bsams nas yid gting nas sun te/ 'gro kun don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blos/ ri khrod dgon pa'i phyogs su gom pa bdun tsam bor na bsod nams che ste/ mdo las/ dgon pa bsams nas gom pa bdun bor na/ /de ni sa bdun bar du 'phags par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sngon gye sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon/ /gang du mya ngan 'das gyur pa/ /kun gye dgon pa rab dben du/ /bla med byang chub brnyes par gyur/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yon tan dang / /grub thob gong ma'i yon tan yang / /dben pa bsten nas byung bar gsungs/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dam pa gong ma'i zhabs kyis bcags shing byen gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu la/ rgyal po'i la thod bzhin ri rtse gangs kyis mdzes pa/ g.yas 505

'debs 'dra 'don bzhin/ dam pa gong ma'i rjes su kha mig yar blta byas/ ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du 'gro rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na/ mi de bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu can yin te/ 'dus byas 'khor ba'i chos thams cad la/snying po med pa/ mi rtag pa sdug bsngal ba'i tshul la bsams nas yid gting nas sun te/ 'gro kun don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blos/ ri khrod dgon pa'i phyogs su gom pa bdun tsam bor na bsod nams che ste/ mdo las/ dgon pa bsams nas gom pa bdun bor na/ /de ni sa bdun bar du 'phags par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sngon gye sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon/ /gang du mya ngan 'das gyur pa/ /kun gye dgon pa rab dben du/ /bla med byang chub brnyes par gyur/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yon tan dang / /grub thob gong ma'i yon tan yang / /dben pa bsten nas byung bar gsungs/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dam pa gong ma'i zhabs kyis bcags shing byen gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu la/ rgyal po'i la thod bzhin ri rtse gangs kyis mdzes pa/ g.yas 505

g.yon na blon 'bangs ltar ri rgyud bzang ba/ snga dro nyi ma snga bar 'char zhing / phyi dro nub pa'i nyi tshe ring ba ri ngos na nags tshal stug po dar sngon pos stod g.yogs byas pa bzhin du mdzes par snang ba/ shing lo kha dog dbyebs mi 'dra ba dag ni ri khrod pa la bzhugs gnas su ched du bshams pa bzhin du snang ba/ 'bab chu mang po dag ni ri khrod pa la mchod yon 'bul phyir ched du rgyug pa bzhin du kha du ma nas 'bab pa/nags tshal gyi khrod na spu sdug bya dang ri dwags du mas ri khrod pa gcig pur skyo yis dogs nas/ bya rnams kyis skad snyan sgrog cing ri dwags rnams kyis rtsed bro brdung ba/ ri mo can gyi gos chen sa la brdal 'dra'i spang gzhongs 'jam po me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i ljongs na bung ba mang pos ri khrod pa la shis pa brjod phyir dri za'i glu dbyangs ltar rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sgra di ri ri zer ba/ shing ljon pa me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs dang ldan pa dag ni/ ri khrod pa la 'tsho ba 'bul ba'i phyir lhas ched du bshams pa lta bu/ bser bu bsil ba yid du 'ong ba langs pas ni/ ri khrod pa la nyi 'od tsha ba dang sbrang bu sogs kyis gnod pa mi rung ngo zhes bsil yab byed pa bzhin du g.yob pa/grub pa dang rigs sngags 'chang ba'i na chung rnams kyi rtsed 506

g.yon na blon 'bangs ltar ri rgyud bzang ba/ snga dro nyi ma snga bar 'char zhing / phyi dro nub pa'i nyi tshe ring ba ri ngos na nags tshal stug po dar sngon pos stod g.yogs byas pa bzhin du mdzes par snang ba/ shing lo kha dog dbyebs mi 'dra ba dag ni ri khrod pa la bzhugs gnas su ched du bshams pa bzhin du snang ba/ 'bab chu mang po dag ni ri khrod pa la mchod yon 'bul phyir ched du rgyug pa bzhin du kha du ma nas 'bab pa/nags tshal gyi khrod na spu sdug bya dang ri dwags du mas ri khrod pa gcig pur skyo yis dogs nas/ bya rnams kyis skad snyan sgrog cing ri dwags rnams kyis rtsed bro brdung ba/ ri mo can gyi gos chen sa la brdal 'dra'i spang gzhongs 'jam po me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i ljongs na bung ba mang pos ri khrod pa la shis pa brjod phyir dri za'i glu dbyangs ltar rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sgra di ri ri zer ba/ shing ljon pa me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs dang ldan pa dag ni/ ri khrod pa la 'tsho ba 'bul ba'i phyir lhas ched du bshams pa lta bu/ bser bu bsil ba yid du 'ong ba langs pas ni/ ri khrod pa la nyi 'od tsha ba dang sbrang bu sogs kyis gnod pa mi rung ngo zhes bsil yab byed pa bzhin du g.yob pa/grub pa dang rigs sngags 'chang ba'i na chung rnams kyi rtsed 506

mo'i sar 'os pa/ lha'i skyed mos tshal nyams dga' ba dang ches mtshungs pa'i nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben pa'i gnas su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i go cha 'dzin dgos zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /dam pa gong ma'i zhabs kyis bcags/ /byen gyis brlabs pa'i dben pa'i gnas/ /rgyab ri mthon po'i steng phyogs na/ /sprin dkar 'o ma 'phyur bzhin lding / /nyi zla gza' skar rim bzhin 'char/ /ri rtser rab dkar gangs ri chags/ /na bun dngul mdog sked la 'khril/ /lo ma me tog 'bras bu yis/ /brgyan pa'i sngo ljang rtsi shing rgyas/ /chu gtsang lhung sgra sgrog bzhin 'bab/ /spang gzhongs bde 'jam me tog bkra/ /gzugs mdzes sbrang mas glu dbyangs len/ /lha bya khya byug 'jol mo sogs/ /bya rnams snyan pa'i skad 'byin 'phyo/ /sha ba rna ba dgo ba sogs/ /ri dwags du ma bag phebs rgyu/ /ro mngar sil thog sna tshogs dang / /sngo tshod mang pos khor yug gang / /'dod pa'i yon tan kun tshang ba'i/ /ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib tu/ /drang srong bsam gtan bsgom pa bzhin/ /yengs med sgrub la brtson pa yi/ /rnal 'byor de las skyid pa zhig /'jig rten khams na ma mchis pas/ /de la lhas kyang smon pa 'chor/ /de 507

'dra'i dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /'khod nas dge sbyor byed rgyu zhig /byung ba'i bsod nams phung po ni/ /nam mkha'i khams la shong mi 'gyur/ /de phyir dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms nus na/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /zhes kun la gdams pa'o//yang skabs rer rang gzhan la phan pa'i tshe sgrub 'di ltar byas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa la/ tshur sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur snang ba'i snod bcud thams cad skad cig nyid la gnas 'gyur nas/ phyi snod thams cad tshe dpag med kyi zhing khams/ nang bcud sems can thams cad mgon po tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i spyi bor/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams dang /khyad par tshe lha rnam gsum la sogs 'gro la tshe yi dngos grub ster ba thams cad bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med kyi rnam par bzhugs nas/ sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rgyun babs/ phyag gi bum pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun khol zhing lud nas byung ba/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo'i tshang bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad bkrus/ nang thams cad yongs su gang bas rdzas kyi rdo rje pha 508
