lam bzhin du phar la dngos por 'dzin pa thams cad 'joms shing / tshur la gang gis kyang gzhom zhing gzhig pa dang bral ba'i 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par gyur/ oṃ a ma ra ni dzi wadhi ye swā hā/ zhes ci mang bzlas mthar/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cigami shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig 'chi ba med pa'i tshe yi rig 'dzin 'thob par gyur cig khyad par du yang 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po/skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras/ rgyal tshab dam pa dga' ldan gser khri/ rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs 'jig rten khams na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes mchog ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams kyi sku tshe bskal pa khri phrag 'bum phrag mang po'i bar du brtan cing / rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur rgyas par gyur cig 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing / /rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang / /srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa/ /de kun lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshig gang shes brjod/ yang skabs re rang gzhan la phan pa'i nor sgrub 'di ltar byas/ rang nyid skad cig nyid la ar+ya dzam bha la 509

sku mdog bung ba ltar gnag pa/ ri rab ltar brjid chags pa/nyi ma ltar 'od gsal ba/ nor bu bzhin dgos 'dod kyi char 'bebs pa zhig tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'a/phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams dang / khyad par du nor lha gter bdag 'gro la nor gyi dngos grub ster ba thams cad nor bdag dzam bha la'i sku'i rnam par spyan drangs nam mkha'i khams khyab par bzhugs nas dgos 'dod kyi char phab ste/ ma sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa'i re ba thams cad yongs su skong bar gyur/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len+t+ra ye sā hā/zhes ci mang bzlas mthar/ bdag mdun gyi lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ steng phyogs lha'i yul gyi pañca li ga'i gos la sogs pa'i gos kyi rigs dang / 'og phyogs klu'i yul gyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rigs dang / bar mi'i yul gyi cang shes kyi rta la sogs pa'i khal rta bzhon ma'i rigs dang / gzhan yang 'jig rten khams na gser dngul zangs lcags 'bru sman nor bu dar zab sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba/ bkra shis pa'i dngos po ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams phyogs kun nas tshur bsdus te/ yul phyogs 'dis mtshon pa'i 'jig 510

rten gye khams thams cad la ri ltar du spungs shing / mtsho ltar du 'khyil nas nam yang 'dzad pa med pa'i gter dang / nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' dbang bsgyur nas kun gyis rdzogs ldan gye dus bzhin du/ bde skyid kyi dpal la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen ba nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis ci rigs brjod pa'i rten 'brel gyis rgyal khams thams cad la bkra shis byen chags g.yang 'khyel tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa byung ngo / /gzhan yang nga'i rnam thar 'di sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'khor lo gsum gyi dbang du byas nas brjod na/ klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo la chung nas da lta'i bar du 'brel tshad don ldan gye bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya lhag gi zhabs la gtugs nas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab mdo rgyud bstan bcos bla ma'i man ngag rnams kyi snying khu lam rim blo sbyong phyag chen rdzogs chen do ha la sogs pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum mang po zhus shing rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 511

rten gye khams thams cad la ri ltar du spungs shing / mtsho ltar du 'khyil nas nam yang 'dzad pa med pa'i gter dang / nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' dbang bsgyur nas kun gyis rdzogs ldan gye dus bzhin du/ bde skyid kyi dpal la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen ba nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis ci rigs brjod pa'i rten 'brel gyis rgyal khams thams cad la bkra shis byen chags g.yang 'khyel tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa byung ngo / /gzhan yang nga'i rnam thar 'di sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'khor lo gsum gyi dbang du byas nas brjod na/ klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo la chung nas da lta'i bar du 'brel tshad don ldan gye bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya lhag gi zhabs la gtugs nas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab mdo rgyud bstan bcos bla ma'i man ngag rnams kyi snying khu lam rim blo sbyong phyag chen rdzogs chen do ha la sogs pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum mang po zhus shing rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 511

'grel rnams kyi glegs bam po ti mi 'dra ba stong phrag kha phyes bklags nas thos bsam byas/ sgrub pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo la stod kyi gnas chen tsā ri gangs ri la phyi dang / smad kyi rma chen mtsho snying brag dkar sprel rdzong sogs dam pa gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas brgya phrag nas mdo sngags gnyis kyi snying po byang chub sems gnyis/ gsang sngags kyi rim gnyis/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod thod rgal gnyis la lo du ma'i bar du sgrub pa byas pas/ de dag dang mthun pa'i yon tan mang po rgyud la skyes pa byung / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la phan phyir sgu rten du sngar lha khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs pa'i khar/gsung rten la dgon pa grong yul chu kha rnams su ma ṇi chos 'khor lan cig bskor na ma ṇi dung phyur re 'gro ba dang / lan lnga dang bcu bskor na ma ṇi dung phyur longs pa'i chos 'bor che chung brgya phrag thugs rten du rdo dang gyo mog gis brtsigs pa'i mchod rten chen po rmang gzhi la phyogs rer 'dom pa bcu dang brgyad yod pa dang / lnga yan chad longs pa'i mchod rten brgya phrag dang / rang dang grwa btsun yon bdag rnams la sku 'dra dang sa tsha rgyag tu bcug nas 'bum khang kho na stong phrag gcig 512

'grel rnams kyi glegs bam po ti mi 'dra ba stong phrag kha phyes bklags nas thos bsam byas/ sgrub pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo la stod kyi gnas chen tsā ri gangs ri la phyi dang / smad kyi rma chen mtsho snying brag dkar sprel rdzong sogs dam pa gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas brgya phrag nas mdo sngags gnyis kyi snying po byang chub sems gnyis/ gsang sngags kyi rim gnyis/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod thod rgal gnyis la lo du ma'i bar du sgrub pa byas pas/ de dag dang mthun pa'i yon tan mang po rgyud la skyes pa byung / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la phan phyir sgu rten du sngar lha khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs pa'i khar/gsung rten la dgon pa grong yul chu kha rnams su ma ṇi chos 'khor lan cig bskor na ma ṇi dung phyur re 'gro ba dang / lan lnga dang bcu bskor na ma ṇi dung phyur longs pa'i chos 'bor che chung brgya phrag thugs rten du rdo dang gyo mog gis brtsigs pa'i mchod rten chen po rmang gzhi la phyogs rer 'dom pa bcu dang brgyad yod pa dang / lnga yan chad longs pa'i mchod rten brgya phrag dang / rang dang grwa btsun yon bdag rnams la sku 'dra dang sa tsha rgyag tu bcug nas 'bum khang kho na stong phrag gcig 512

dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi gnad rnams bsdus pa'i legs bshad glegs bam po ti bco lnga brtsams pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po byas/ gzhan yang rang gi sngon gyi sems bskyed dang smon lam/ tshe 'dir thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don byas pas/ 'khor skal bzang gdul bya mchog dman 'bring gsum 'dus pa'i grangs la sngon sbyangs las 'phro can gyi bla ma sku skyes bu chen slob ma rang don tshags su chud nas/ gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa brgya phrag dang / tshe 'di blos btang ba'i bya bral ri khrod pa dang gnas nges med skor mkhan dang / dbus kyi grwa sar 'gro ba'i grwa ba nyis stong bdun brgya dang / yul gyi dgon pa dang grong yul na khas blangs pa'i sdom pa dang dam tshig srung bzhin tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byed mkhan dang / bsnyen sgrub las gsum la 'bad pa'i dge 'dun pa dang / bon sngags gcod gsum sum stong brgyad brgya tsam dang / skya ser pho mo dad can chos 'brel thob pa khri tsho gcig dang / gzhan mthong thos dran reg bzang ngan gye 'brel thogs pa bye ba ther 'bum bgrang las 'das pa yod dam snyam/ gzhan yang sngon bsags bsod nams kyi mthu dang / tshe 'dir chos bzhin byas pa'i lag rjes 513

dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi gnad rnams bsdus pa'i legs bshad glegs bam po ti bco lnga brtsams pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po byas/ gzhan yang rang gi sngon gyi sems bskyed dang smon lam/ tshe 'dir thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don byas pas/ 'khor skal bzang gdul bya mchog dman 'bring gsum 'dus pa'i grangs la sngon sbyangs las 'phro can gyi bla ma sku skyes bu chen slob ma rang don tshags su chud nas/ gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs pa brgya phrag dang / tshe 'di blos btang ba'i bya bral ri khrod pa dang gnas nges med skor mkhan dang / dbus kyi grwa sar 'gro ba'i grwa ba nyis stong bdun brgya dang / yul gyi dgon pa dang grong yul na khas blangs pa'i sdom pa dang dam tshig srung bzhin tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byed mkhan dang / bsnyen sgrub las gsum la 'bad pa'i dge 'dun pa dang / bon sngags gcod gsum sum stong brgyad brgya tsam dang / skya ser pho mo dad can chos 'brel thob pa khri tsho gcig dang / gzhan mthong thos dran reg bzang ngan gye 'brel thogs pa bye ba ther 'bum bgrang las 'das pa yod dam snyam/ gzhan yang sngon bsags bsod nams kyi mthu dang / tshe 'dir chos bzhin byas pa'i lag rjes 513

su tshur la 'dod dgu'i nor rdzas longs spyod char bzhin babs tshul dang / phar la sprin bzhin gtor tshul rnams rgyas par bris na mangs kyis dogs nas 'dir rags rim tsam las mang po ma spros so/ /gzhan yang nga'i rnam thar 'di thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ sdom pa gsum/ bslab pa gsum/ sde snod gsum la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos gang dang bstun na yang mthun la/ gzhan la bstan na yang dngos sam brgyud nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /da nga'i rnam thar mdor bsdu na/bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyis rgyal srid spangs/mchod rten rnam dag drung du dbu skra bsil/ chu bo ne rañja na'i 'gram du lo drug tu dka' ba spyad nas bsgoms pa'i mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pa yin la/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgyal srid spangs nas/ rgya gar dur khrod brgyad sogs gnas chen rnams su rig 'dzin brgyad bsten bka' brgyad sgrub pa mdzad/dngos grub brgyad thob gu ru mtshan brgyad du grags/ bod du byon nas bod yul mun pa'i gling lta bur/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rjes/514

su tshur la 'dod dgu'i nor rdzas longs spyod char bzhin babs tshul dang / phar la sprin bzhin gtor tshul rnams rgyas par bris na mangs kyis dogs nas 'dir rags rim tsam las mang po ma spros so/ /gzhan yang nga'i rnam thar 'di thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ sdom pa gsum/ bslab pa gsum/ sde snod gsum la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos gang dang bstun na yang mthun la/ gzhan la bstan na yang dngos sam brgyud nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /da nga'i rnam thar mdor bsdu na/bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyis rgyal srid spangs/mchod rten rnam dag drung du dbu skra bsil/ chu bo ne rañja na'i 'gram du lo drug tu dka' ba spyad nas bsgoms pa'i mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pa yin la/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgyal srid spangs nas/ rgya gar dur khrod brgyad sogs gnas chen rnams su rig 'dzin brgyad bsten bka' brgyad sgrub pa mdzad/dngos grub brgyad thob gu ru mtshan brgyad du grags/ bod du byon nas bod yul mun pa'i gling lta bur/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rjes/514

pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po sogs stobs 'byor rgya nag rgyal po dang mnyam pa'i rgyal srid spangs te bla ma mang po bsten nas/zab rgya'i gdams pa dpag med gsan/ khyad par rgya mtshor gru btang nas zla ba bcu gsum gyi bar du rgya mtsho'i nang nas dka' ba spyad/ bla ma gser gling pa'i drung du byon nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'bral med du bsten/ byang chub sems kyi gdams pa zhus/ dben pa bsten nas tshul bzhin du bsgoms pas rang don mngon du gyur/ gzhan don du rje btsun sgol mas lung bstan bod du phebs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgon me gsar du sbar nas/ 'phags yul las kyang ches cher gsal ba byung / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen pos pha yul spangs nas dbus su byon/ dang po mtshan ldan gyi bla ma du ma bsten nas rgya chen thos pa btsal/ bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ mtha' mar dben pa bsten nas nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs pas rang don mthar phyin/gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mdzad nas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che sprin med mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar/ rgyal khams yongs la dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la 515

pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po sogs stobs 'byor rgya nag rgyal po dang mnyam pa'i rgyal srid spangs te bla ma mang po bsten nas/zab rgya'i gdams pa dpag med gsan/ khyad par rgya mtshor gru btang nas zla ba bcu gsum gyi bar du rgya mtsho'i nang nas dka' ba spyad/ bla ma gser gling pa'i drung du byon nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'bral med du bsten/ byang chub sems kyi gdams pa zhus/ dben pa bsten nas tshul bzhin du bsgoms pas rang don mngon du gyur/ gzhan don du rje btsun sgol mas lung bstan bod du phebs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgon me gsar du sbar nas/ 'phags yul las kyang ches cher gsal ba byung / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen pos pha yul spangs nas dbus su byon/ dang po mtshan ldan gyi bla ma du ma bsten nas rgya chen thos pa btsal/ bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ mtha' mar dben pa bsten nas nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs pas rang don mthar phyin/gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mdzad nas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che sprin med mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar/ rgyal khams yongs la dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la 515

ras pas tshe blos btang nas lho brag mar pa bsten/ zab mo'i gdams pa gsan ri khrod dben pa bsten dka' spyad drag po byas/ ma yengs rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas nas nam mkhar bya ltar 'phur/ chu la nya ltar 'phyo/ pha bong 'dam ltar brdzis/ ri brag thal byung du phug lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas skye bo gzhan la ston pa sogs ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan nas/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du bsgrengs/ de bzhin du grub pa'i dbang phyug pha dam pa sangs rgyas/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu/ bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub sngar byon tshad thams cad kyis de ltar mdzad pas mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad par gda'/ ngas kyang dam pa gong ma de rnams kyi phal che ba'i rnam thar mthong bas yid phrogs/ de dag gi rjes su kha mig yar blta byas/ dang po tshe 'di blo yis btang nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten nas thos bsam byas bar du ri khrod dben pa bsten nas sgom sgrub byas/ mtha' mar bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs byas pas deng sang snyigs 516

ras pas tshe blos btang nas lho brag mar pa bsten/ zab mo'i gdams pa gsan ri khrod dben pa bsten dka' spyad drag po byas/ ma yengs rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas nas nam mkhar bya ltar 'phur/ chu la nya ltar 'phyo/ pha bong 'dam ltar brdzis/ ri brag thal byung du phug lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas skye bo gzhan la ston pa sogs ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan nas/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du bsgrengs/ de bzhin du grub pa'i dbang phyug pha dam pa sangs rgyas/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu/ bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub sngar byon tshad thams cad kyis de ltar mdzad pas mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad par gda'/ ngas kyang dam pa gong ma de rnams kyi phal che ba'i rnam thar mthong bas yid phrogs/ de dag gi rjes su kha mig yar blta byas/ dang po tshe 'di blo yis btang nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma bsten nas thos bsam byas bar du ri khrod dben pa bsten nas sgom sgrub byas/ mtha' mar bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs byas pas deng sang snyigs 516

ma'i dus 'dir/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i mig rkyen mchog tu 'gro ba 'di byung / dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa khyed rjes 'jug slob ma yang slob rnams kyis nyams len du 'khyer rgyu byung na tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang sku gnyis thob/ don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par gdon mi za'o/ /zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gong ma'i rnam tha da zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor rang gi rnam thar mdor bsdus tsam/ /glu ru len gyes rjes 'jug dga' bas nyon/ /sngon dus bdag cag ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sgu brnyes pad+ma 'byung / /sangs rgyas gnyis pa mnyam med jo bo rje/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la ras pa dang / /dam pa rgya gar ma cig lab sgon sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub gong ma thams cad kyi/ /rnam thar phal cher mthong bas bdag yid phrogs/ /de dag rjes su la mig yar blta byas/ /rnam thar gsung bzhin bsgrubs pas snyigs dus 'dir/ /bstan 'gro'i mig rkyen mchog tu 'gro ba zhig /dngos brgyud bla ma'i rnam par thar pa rnams/ /rjes 'jug slob ma rnams kyis nyams len du/ /'khyer rgyu byung na tshe 517

ma'i dus 'dir/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i mig rkyen mchog tu 'gro ba 'di byung / dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa khyed rjes 'jug slob ma yang slob rnams kyis nyams len du 'khyer rgyu byung na tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang sku gnyis thob/ don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par gdon mi za'o/ /zhes slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gong ma'i rnam tha da zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor rang gi rnam thar mdor bsdus tsam/ /glu ru len gyes rjes 'jug dga' bas nyon/ /sngon dus bdag cag ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sgu brnyes pad+ma 'byung / /sangs rgyas gnyis pa mnyam med jo bo rje/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la ras pa dang / /dam pa rgya gar ma cig lab sgon sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub gong ma thams cad kyi/ /rnam thar phal cher mthong bas bdag yid phrogs/ /de dag rjes su la mig yar blta byas/ /rnam thar gsung bzhin bsgrubs pas snyigs dus 'dir/ /bstan 'gro'i mig rkyen mchog tu 'gro ba zhig /dngos brgyud bla ma'i rnam par thar pa rnams/ /rjes 'jug slob ma rnams kyis nyams len du/ /'khyer rgyu byung na tshe 517

'dir tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /sgrib gnyis kun byang sku gnyis mngon du byas/ /don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par gdon mi za/ /rnam thar mdor bsdus 'di nyid thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs dpag med 'byung bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs chos 'phel zhing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas rjes 'jug slob ma yang slob rnams dang / phyi rabs chos mdzad rnams kyi rgyad la phan thogs chen po byung ngo / / ༄smras pa/ rgyal ba gong ma rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gong ma'i rnam thar 'khyongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam thar 'di las dam chos dgos 'dod 'byung / /'gro kun re ba skong ba'i nor bu 'dra/ /rnam thar 'di ni dang po'i las can la/ /ma nor lam bzang ston pa'i bla ma 'dra/ /rnam thar 'di ni 'khor ba'i chu bo las/ /sgrol bar 'dod pa rnams la gru chen 'dra/ /rnam thar 'di ni thar pa'i gling mchog tu/ /bgrod 'dod rnams la ded dpon bzang po 'dra/ /rnam thar nang na bla ma dran mgur yod/ /slob ma dad pa can tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na las 'bras rnam gzhag yod/ /sdig spong dge sgrub mkhan gyi dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na mi rtag skyo mgur 518

'dir tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /sgrib gnyis kun byang sku gnyis mngon du byas/ /don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par gdon mi za/ /rnam thar mdor bsdus 'di nyid thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs dpag med 'byung bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs chos 'phel zhing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas rjes 'jug slob ma yang slob rnams dang / phyi rabs chos mdzad rnams kyi rgyud la phan thogs chen po byung ngo / / smras pa/ rgyal ba gong ma rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gong ma'i rnam thar 'khyongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam thar 'di las dam chos dgos 'dod 'byung / /'gro kun re ba skong ba'i nor bu 'dra/ /rnam thar 'di ni dang po'i las can la/ /ma nor lam bzang ston pa'i bla ma 'dra/ /rnam thar 'di ni 'khor ba'i chu bo las/ /sgrol bar 'dod pa rnams la gru chen 'dra/ /rnam thar 'di ni thar pa'i gling mchog tu/ /bgrod 'dod rnams la ded dpon bzang po 'dra/ /rnam thar nang na bla ma dran mgur yod/ /slob ma dad pa can tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na las 'bras rnam gzhag yod/ /sdig spong dge sgrub mkhan gyi dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na mi rtag skyo mgur 518

yod/ /btsun pa skyo shas can gyi dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na snying rje chos skor yod/ /bzang po byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na lta mgur sna tshogs yod/ /mkhas pa nyams myong can tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na dag snang sbyong tshul yod/ /chos la phyogs ris med pa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na dben pa'i bsngags brjod yod/ /bya btang ri khrod pa rnams dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na snyan pa'i glu dbyangs yod/ /dkar phyogs lha mi rnams kyi dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar 'di nyid lhag bsam dag pas brtsams/ /ma 'ongs 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /rnam thar 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi rgyan du 'gyur bar shog /rnam thar nor bu gar gnas sa phyogs su/ /chos dang bkra shis dge legs 'bar gyur cig /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /519

yod/ /btsun pa skyo shas can gyi dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na snying rje chos skor yod/ /bzang po byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na lta mgur sna tshogs yod/ /mkhas pa nyams myong can tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na dag snang sbyong tshul yod/ /chos la phyogs ris med pa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na dben pa'i bsngags brjod yod/ /bya btang ri khrod pa rnams dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar nang na snyan pa'i glu dbyangs yod/ /dkar phyogs lha mi rnams kyi dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar 'di nyid lhag bsam dag pas brtsams/ /ma 'ongs 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /rnam thar 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi rgyan du 'gyur bar shog /rnam thar nor bu gar gnas sa phyogs su/ /chos dang bkra shis dge legs 'bar gyur cig /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /519

bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyor byas tshul/tha mar dge ba mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyor byas tshul bzang po ni/ de yang rnam dkar dge ba gang byas kyi mjug tu bsngo smon byas pa'i phan yon cung zad tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/bcom ldan 'das kyis blo gros rgya mtsho/ mchil ma'i thigs pa gcig bye ma'i steng du bor na de nyid du bskam par 'gyur la/de nyid rgya mtsho chen por bor na/ ji srid rgya mtsho chen po zad cing bskam par mi 'gyur ba de srid du/ mchil ma'i thigs pa de yang mi skam mo/ /de bzhin du byang chub tu yongs su ma bsngos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni zad cing 'phel bar mi 'gyur la/ gang byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa'i dge rtsa de ni mi zad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshigs bcad yongs grags las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /520

bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyor byas tshul/tha mar dge ba mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyor byas tshul bzang po ni/ de yang rnam dkar dge ba gang byas kyi mjug tu bsngo smon byas pa'i phan yon cung zad tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/bcom ldan 'das kyis blo gros rgya mtsho/ mchil ma'i thigs pa gcig bye ma'i steng du bor na de nyid du bskam par 'gyur la/de nyid rgya mtsho chen por bor na/ ji srid rgya mtsho chen po zad cing bskam par mi 'gyur ba de srid du/ mchil ma'i thigs pa de yang mi skam mo/ /de bzhin du byang chub tu yongs su ma bsngos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni zad cing 'phel bar mi 'gyur la/ gang byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa'i dge rtsa de ni mi zad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshigs bcad yongs grags las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /520

ces dang / bsod nams dam pa'i mdo las/ mi lus thob pa'i dus 'dir dge ba chung ngu nas bsag dgos/ de yang bsngo dgos/ ma bsngos pa'i rdzas rnams ni bye tshan la chu thigs brgyab na myur du skam pa dang 'dra/ bsngo ba byas pa'i phan yon ni rgya mtsho chen por chu thigs shig blugs na/ de mi zad cing slar 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang 'dra gsungs/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ yongs su bsngo ba ni chud ma zos pa yin te/ chos kyi dbyings dang 'dra bar zad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang /'grel chung don gsal las/ bsngo ba yid la byed pas ni gser mgar gyi rgyan la sogs pa bzhin du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu byed do/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ yang dag bsngo ba'i rgyas btab na/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa lam sgrol/ /zhes dang / mnyam med dwags po lha rjes/ sngon byang chub snying bo ma thob pa/ /rgyu bar mdo ru chud zos pa/ /gnad bsngo ba ma shes gcig pus lan/ /de bas bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /ces dang / 'bri khung pa 'jig rten mgon pos/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin gye nor bu la/ /bsngo smon gyi bye dor ma byas na/ /dgos 'dod gyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ /de bas bsngo ba 'di 521

ces dang / bsod nams dam pa'i mdo las/ mi lus thob pa'i dus 'dir dge ba chung ngu nas bsag dgos/ de yang bsngo dgos/ ma bsngos pa'i rdzas rnams ni bye tshan la chu thigs brgyab na myur du skam pa dang 'dra/ bsngo ba byas pa'i phan yon ni rgya mtsho chen por chu thigs shig blugs na/ de mi zad cing slar 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang 'dra gsungs/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ yongs su bsngo ba ni chud ma zos pa yin te/ chos kyi dbyings dang 'dra bar zad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang /'grel chung don gsal las/ bsngo ba yid la byed pas ni gser mgar gyi rgyan la sogs pa bzhin du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu byed do/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ yang dag bsngo ba'i rgyas btab na/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa lam sgrol/ /zhes dang / mnyam med dwags po lha rjes/ sngon byang chub snying bo ma thob pa/ /rgyu bar mdo ru chud zos pa/ /gnad bsngo ba ma shes gcig pus lan/ /de bas bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /ces dang / 'bri khung pa 'jig rten mgon pos/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin gye nor bu la/ /bsngo smon gyi bye dor ma byas na/ /dgos 'dod gyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ /de bas bsngo ba 'di 521

la nan tan mdzod/ /ces dang / 'gro mgon gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ sbyin pa longs spyod kyi rta pho la/ /bsngo ba srab kyis kha bsgyur na/ /rang gang 'dod kyi sa der slebs pa yin/ /gsungs/sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la/ rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis bsnyen bkur byas/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngor bcug pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med du gyur/sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 'khor bcas la rgyal po nor ldan gyis bsnyen bkur nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pas/ phyis rgyal ba byams par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa byung / de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nam mkhas bsnyen bkur byas/ dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos pas/ rjes su rje btsun 'jam dbyangs su gyur/ sngon dbul mo gnyen dga' mos/ gyo ral zhig gi nang du mar me chung ngu zhig sbar nas/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar phul te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na/ 'jig rten du ston pa shākya thub pa de bzhin du/ bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog cig ces smon lam btab pas/sangs rgyas kyis kun dga' bo la/ bu mo 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas mar me'i 'od ces bya ba dbang bcu dang 522

la nan tan mdzod/ /ces dang / 'gro mgon gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ sbyin pa longs spyod kyi rta pho la/ /bsngo ba srab kyis kha bsgyur na/ /rang gang 'dod kyi sa der slebs pa yin/ /gsungs/sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la/ rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis bsnyen bkur byas/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngor bcug pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med du gyur/sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 'khor bcas la rgyal po nor ldan gyis bsnyen bkur nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pas/ phyis rgyal ba byams par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa byung / de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nam mkhas bsnyen bkur byas/ dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos pas/ rjes su rje btsun 'jam dbyangs su gyur/ sngon dbul mo gnyen dga' mos/ gyo ral zhig gi nang du mar me chung ngu zhig sbar nas/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar phul te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na/ 'jig rten du ston pa shākya thub pa de bzhin du/ bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog cig ces smon lam btab pas/sangs rgyas kyis kun dga' bo la/ bu mo 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas mar me'i 'od ces bya ba dbang bcu dang 522

ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa byung / sngon sangs rgyas dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung du/ dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya bas/ rang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzung ba ji bzhin du/bdag kyang smon lam 'debs kyis 'grub par gyur cig ces brjod pas/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams 'grub par gyur/ sngon pad+ma'i mig gis sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la rin po che mthon ka gcig phul bas/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du 'byor ba che bar gyur/ 'bras bu thob pa'i smon lam btab pas/dgra bcom par gyur pa'i lo rgyus de 'dra ba mang po 'dug pas/bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag 'debs pa 'di shin tu gal che bar gda'/ da ni bsngo smon bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag sogs 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas gzigs shing dgongs su gsol/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs/ bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba/ khyad par du yang bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ tshe gang bo 'di nyid la dge ba bgyis pa dang / ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i bsod nams 523

ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa byung / sngon sangs rgyas dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung du/ dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya bas/ rang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzung ba ji bzhin du/bdag kyang smon lam 'debs kyis 'grub par gyur cig ces brjod pas/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams 'grub par gyur/ sngon pad+ma'i mig gis sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la rin po che mthon ka gcig phul bas/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du 'byor ba che bar gyur/ 'bras bu thob pa'i smon lam btab pas/dgra bcom par gyur pa'i lo rgyus de 'dra ba mang po 'dug pas/bsngo ba smon lam rnam dag 'debs pa 'di shin tu gal che bar gda'/ da ni bsngo smon bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag sogs 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas gzigs shing dgongs su gsol/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs/ bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba/ khyad par du yang bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ tshe gang bo 'di nyid la dge ba bgyis pa dang / ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i bsod nams 523

thams cad blo yis blangs nas/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /de'i mthu la brten nas phan bde'i legs tshogs ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che sgo sna tshogs nas/ phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ma sems can thams cad gnas skabs su mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang thob nas bde zhing / mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che bde blag nyid du 'thob par gyur cig khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi shes rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par smin nas/ de'i mthu la brten nas skye ba 'di'am ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba bzang po brgyud nas/ mthar thug 'thob bya bla na med pa sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang myur ba myur du 'thob par gyur cig de lta bu'i go 'phang mchog ma thob pa'i gnas skabs su/skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du theg mchog 'khor lo bzhi dang mi 'bral ba la mnyam med jo bo rje yab sras lta bur gyur 524

cig legs tshogs rtsa ba bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten pa la 'phags pa rtag tu ngu dang / byang sems nor bzang lta bur gyur cig yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten tshul khrims bsrung ba la/ nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa dge slong mi 'khrugs pa lta bur gyur cig shes rab che ba la mkhyen rab kyi bdag po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs lta bur gyur cig snying rje che ba la 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lta bur gyur cig mthu stobs che ba la yi dam phyag na rdo rje lta bur gyur cig lha 'dre thams cad btul nas bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzugs pa la o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas lta bur gyur cig rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig dka' spyad snying rus kyi sgo nas sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i che ba 'byen pa la/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rje btsun mi la yab sras lta bur gyur cigabyams pa dang snying rje chen po byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis rgyud la 'byongs pa la/ slob dpon zhi ba lha dang rgyal sras thogs med dpal bzang po lta bur gyur cig gsang sngags kyi bsgyed rdzogs gnyis mthar phyin pa la/ rwa lo rdo rje grags dang grub chen lwa wa pa lta bur gyur cig rkyen ngan thams 525

cad lam du slong ba la/ pha cig dam pa rgya gar lta bur gyur cigabadag 'dzin nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod pa la ma cig lab kyi sgron ma lta bur gyur cig chos lugs grub mtha' gang la phyogs ris med pa la rgyal ba dge 'dun grub dang paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa la mkhas pa'i dbang po rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis lta bur gyur cig mngon shes dang dzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa la rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang grub thob brgyad cu lta bur gyur cig dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba mtha' dag 'jom pa la mgon po tshe dpag med lta bur gyur cig dug gsum gyi nad thams cad sel ba la sangs rgyas sman bla lta bur gyur cigasems can gyi dbul pa'i sdug bsngal sel ba la nor bdag rnam thos sras dang mgon po dzam+bha la lta bur gyur cig phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba la 'phags pa kun tu bzang po lta bur gyur cig sangs rgyas nas mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba'i don byed pa la phyogs bcu'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' lta bur gyur cig stod dza ti dbyug pas brdung sa nas smad rgya mo chu la dar 'thag sa yan chad la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba 526

lta bur mdzad pa la/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa lta bur gyur cig phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byen rlabs/ bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba/ khyad par du bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas dge ba bgyis pa dang /ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/bsngo ba smon lam ci btab tshad thams cad de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cigabla ma dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod tshogs 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung mthol lo bshags/ /rang gzhan skye 'phags dge la rjes yi rang / /zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de mthus rang gzhan sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla mar mjal ba la jo bo rje dang 'brom ston lta bur shog /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa la/ /rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang lta bur shog /ngoms pa med par thos bsam byed pa la/ /kun mkhyen blo bzang yab 527

sras lta bur shog /chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin du byed pa la/ /bka' gdams sku mched slob brgyud lta bur shog /chos phyir dka' spyad snying rus byed pa la/ /bka' brgyud mi la yab sras lta bur shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis lta bur shog /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ston pa la/ /rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu lta bur shog /lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba la/ /pad 'byung rje 'bangs nyer lnga lta bur shog /mkhyen rab chen pos blang dor 'byed pa la/ /dbyangs can ma dang 'jam dbyangs lta bur shog /mthu stobs chen pos log 'dren 'dul ba la/ /rta mgrin phyag na rdo rje lta bur shog /zug rngu'i nad kun sel bar byed pa la/ /bcom ldan sman pa'i rgyal po lta bur shog /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'jom pa la/ /mgon po tshe dpag med pa lta bur shog /bla ma'i tshul bzung 'gro don byed pa la/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras lta bur shog /rgyal po'i tshul bzung rgyal khams 'dul ba la/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po lta bur shog /skyo ngal med par 'gro kun 'dren pa la/ /spyan ras gzigs dang sangs rgyas lta bur shog /mdor na rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub pa la/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma lta bur 528

sras lta bur shog /chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin du byed pa la/ /bka' gdams sku mched slob brgyud lta bur shog /chos phyir dka' spyad snying rus byed pa la/ /bka' brgyud mi la yab sras lta bur shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis lta bur shog /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ston pa la/ /rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu lta bur shog /lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba la/ /pad 'byung rje 'bangs nyer lnga lta bur shog /mkhyen rab chen pos blang dor 'byed pa la/ /dbyangs can ma dang 'jam dbyangs lta bur shog /mthu stobs chen pos log 'dren 'dul ba la/ /rta mgrin phyag na rdo rje lta bur shog /zug rngu'i nad kun sel bar byed pa la/ /bcom ldan sman pa'i rgyal po lta bur shog /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'jom pa la/ /mgon po tshe dpag med pa lta bur shog /bla ma'i tshul bzung 'gro don byed pa la/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras lta bur shog /rgyal po'i tshul bzung rgyal khams 'dul ba la/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po lta bur shog /skyo ngal med par 'gro kun 'dren pa la/ /spyan ras gzigs dang sangs rgyas lta bur shog /mdor na rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub pa la/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma lta bur 528

shog /gang gang smon lam ji ltar btab pa ltar/ /de de bzhin du thams cad 'grub par shog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas drang srong rnams/ /bdag gis bsngo smon byed pa'i dpang po mdzod/ /bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs nus mthu dang / /drang srong bden mthus bsngo smon 'grub gyur cig /bdag gzhan tshe 'dir bsags pa'i dge ba yis/ /gtso byas dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de'i mthus rang gzhan sangs rgyas myur thob shog /de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /sgyes bu gsum gyi don rnams sgrub pa'i rten/ /dal 'byor lus thob sngon sbyangs bag chags sad/ /dge ba'i bshes bsten chos la spyod par shog /'gro la bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos yin par yid ches nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgos/ /'gro ba yongs la dam chos ston par shog /phan bde 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che/ /'jig rten khams su yun ring bar du gnas/ /lha mis gtso byas ma gyur 'gro kun la/ /bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char bar shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa ji srid nam gnas bar/ /bdag gi rnam thar mgur 'burim legs bshad 529

shog /gang gang smon lam ji ltar btab pa ltar/ /de de bzhin du thams cad 'grub par shog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas drang srong rnams/ /bdag gis bsngo smon byed pa'i dpang po mdzod/ /bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs nus mthu dang / /drang srong bden mthus bsngo smon 'grub gyur cig /bdag gzhan tshe 'dir bsags pa'i dge ba yis/ /gtso byas dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de'i mthus rang gzhan sangs rgyas myur thob shog /de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /sgyes bu gsum gyi don rnams sgrub pa'i rten/ /dal 'byor lus thob sngon sbyangs bag chags sad/ /dge ba'i bshes bsten chos la spyod par shog /'gro la bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos yin par yid ches nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgos/ /'gro ba yongs la dam chos ston par shog /phan bde 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che/ /'jig rten khams su yun ring bar du gnas/ /lha mis gtso byas ma gyur 'gro kun la/ /bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char bar shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa ji srid nam gnas bar/ /bdag gi rnam thar mgur 'burim legs bshad 529

kyang / /gnas nas ris med bstan dang 'gro kun la/ /phan thogs dpag tu med pa 'byung bar shog /rnam thar mthong thos dran reg chos mdzad kyi/ /tshe dang chos la bar chad mi 'byung bar/ /chos mgo mtha' ru thon nas tshe 'dir yang / /bdag gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan par shog /yid bzhin nor bu gang du gnas na yang / /yul la phan bde bkra shis 'byung ba ltar/ /rnam thar gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /chos dang bkra shis dge legs 'phel bar shog /yid bzhin nor bur mchod bstod gsol btab na/ /'gro la dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba ltar/ /rnam thar nang bzhin mdzad mkhan thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan 'byung bar shog /rnam thar lan cig tsam re bton na yang / /grub mtha'i chags sdang phyogs ris kun zhi nas/ /gang la dad gus dag snang 'byongs pa dang / /phyogs med thos bsam sgom gsum byed par shog/rgyal ba gong ma'i sku gzugs gar bzhugs sar/ /chos dang bkra shis ngang gis 'phel ba ltar/ /bdag gi 'dra sku grong dgon gar gnas kyang / /bde skyid yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar shog /'dra sku mthong thos dran reg thams cad kyi/ /rgyud kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kun zhi nas/ /phan pa byang chub sems dang 530

kyang / /gnas nas ris med bstan dang 'gro kun la/ /phan thogs dpag tu med pa 'byung bar shog /rnam thar mthong thos dran reg chos mdzad kyi/ /tshe dang chos la bar chad mi 'byung bar/ /chos mgo mtha' ru thon nas tshe 'dir yang / /bdag gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan par shog /yid bzhin nor bu gang du gnas na yang / /yul la phan bde bkra shis 'byung ba ltar/ /rnam thar gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /chos dang bkra shis dge legs 'phel bar shog /yid bzhin nor bur mchod bstod gsol btab na/ /'gro la dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba ltar/ /rnam thar nang bzhin mdzad mkhan thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan 'byung bar shog /rnam thar lan cig tsam re bton na yang / /grub mtha'i chags sdang phyogs ris kun zhi nas/ /gang la dad gus dag snang 'byongs pa dang / /phyogs med thos bsam sgom gsum byed par shog/rgyal ba gong ma'i sku gzugs gar bzhugs sar/ /chos dang bkra shis ngang gis 'phel ba ltar/ /bdag gi 'dra sku grong dgon gar gnas kyang / /bde skyid yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar shog /'dra sku mthong thos dran reg thams cad kyi/ /rgyud kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kun zhi nas/ /phan pa byang chub sems dang 530

ldan gyur te/ /rgyal sras bzang po'i spyod la 'jug par shog /bdag ni na so rgas nas shi song yang / /rjes 'jug slob ma yang slob thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ /dben par bdag gi rnam thar skyong bar shog /shul na lus pa'i rten gsum mchod rdzas dang / /na bza' skra lo gdung rus la sogs pa/ /gang du 'khyer ba'i sa phyogs thams cad la/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs legs par shog /bdag la bzang ngan 'brel ba thogs tshad dang / /'brel ba med pa'i gdul dka'i sems can yang / /thams cad byang chub sems kyis dbang bsdus nas/ /chos bstan thar pa'i lam la 'god nus shog /sems can 'jigs pas nyen pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag ni yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'jigs skrag sdug bsngal kun las thar gyur nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu bde zhing skyid par shog /ma 'ongs mngon dga' dga' ldan bde ba can/ /po ta la dang dag pa mkha' spyod sogs/ /gang 'dod dag pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' nas/ /slob ma yon bdag rnams la mjal bar shog /mjal nas dga' spro'i gleng mo byed bzhin du/ /thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya ru/ /song nas ngo mtshar ltad mo 531

ldan gyur te/ /rgyal sras bzang po'i spyod la 'jug par shog /bdag ni na so rgas nas shi song yang / /rjes 'jug slob ma yang slob thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ /dben par bdag gi rnam thar skyong bar shog /shul na lus pa'i rten gsum mchod rdzas dang / /na bza' skra lo gdung rus la sogs pa/ /gang du 'khyer ba'i sa phyogs thams cad la/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs legs par shog /bdag la bzang ngan 'brel ba thogs tshad dang / /'brel ba med pa'i gdul dka'i sems can yang / /thams cad byang chub sems kyis dbang bsdus nas/ /chos bstan thar pa'i lam la 'god nus shog /sems can 'jigs pas nyen pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag ni yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'jigs skrag sdug bsngal kun las thar gyur nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu bde zhing skyid par shog /ma 'ongs mngon dga' dga' ldan bde ba can/ /po ta la dang dag pa mkha' spyod sogs/ /gang 'dod dag pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' nas/ /slob ma yon bdag rnams la mjal bar shog /mjal nas dga' spro'i gleng mo byed bzhin du/ /thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya ru/ /song nas ngo mtshar ltad mo 531

blta bar shog /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mchod cing gsung gi bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la/ /chos bstan sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas byen rlabs dang / /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ji ltar bsngo ba smon lam btab pa bzhin/ /de ltar myur ba myur du 'grub par shog /ces smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor byas pa'o/ /da ni mjug tu bkra shis brjod pa ni/ phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /sangs rgyas tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /dge 'dun tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /bla ma'i tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /yi dam tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyel ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /chos skyong tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /nor lha'i tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /yul lha'i tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 532

blta bar shog /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mchod cing gsung gi bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la/ /chos bstan sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas byen rlabs dang / /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ji ltar bsngo ba smon lam btab pa bzhin/ /de ltar myur ba myur du 'grub par shog /ces smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor byas pa'o/ /da ni mjug tu bkra shis brjod pa ni/ phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /sangs rgyas tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /dge 'dun tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /bla ma'i tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /yi dam tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyel ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /chos skyong tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /nor lha'i tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /yul lha'i tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 532

'khyel ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /sku rten tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /gsung rten tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /thugs rten tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /mkhas grub tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /grwa slob tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /yon bdag tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /byin rlabs tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /dngos grub tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /bde skyid tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyel ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /mi nor zas gsum 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /lto gos chos gsum 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /thams cad 'dzom gsum yong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces 'gro mgon zhabs dkar pa'i sgu tshe smad kyi rnam thar thog mtha' bar du dge ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad brtson shes rab snying rje la sogs pa'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i skal ldan bu chen mang pos yang yang bskul ngor/sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas// dam pa gong ma'i gdan sa/ bla ma 533

'khyel ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /sku rten tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /gsung rten tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /thugs rten tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /mkhas grub tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /grwa slob tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /yon bdag tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /byin rlabs tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /dngos grub tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /bde skyid tshogs kyis gang ba'i bkra shis shog /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyel ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /mi nor zas gsum 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /lto gos chos gsum 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /thams cad 'dzom gsum yong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces 'gro mgon zhabs dkar pa'i sgu tshe smad kyi rnam thar thog mtha' bar du dge ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad brtson shes rab snying rje la sogs pa'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i skal ldan bu chen mang pos yang yang bskul ngor/sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas// dam pa gong ma'i gdan sa/ bla ma 533

lha yi pho brang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du zhing / 'du 'dzi grong gi gong rol/ g.ya' dang spang gi 'dabs rol/ sprin dang na bun 'khor zhing 'ja' tshon ri mo 'char ba/ khu byug skad snyan sgrog cing bung ba lang ling 'phur ba/ ljon shing lo 'dab rgyas shing me tog sna tshogs bkra ba/ nam mkha' mthong rgya che zhing nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa/ bkra shis g.yang kun 'khyil zhing ming dang don mthun pa'i gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyel ba'i bde ba can gyi nye 'dabs mtshams khang 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyil ba nas legs par sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig ces smon lam yang yang 'debs pa lags so/ /sarba maṅga lo/ 534 —

lha yi pho brang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du zhing / 'du 'dzi grong gi gong rol/ g.ya' dang spang gi 'dabs rol/ sprin dang na bun 'khor zhing 'ja' tshon ri mo 'char ba/ khu byug skad snyan sgrog cing bung ba lang ling 'phur ba/ ljon shing lo 'dab rgyas shing me tog sna tshogs bkra ba/ nam mkha' mthong rgya che zhing nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa/ bkra shis g.yang kun 'khyil zhing ming dang don mthun pa'i gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyel ba'i bde ba can gyi nye 'dabs mtshams khang 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyil ba nas legs par sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig ces smon lam yang yang 'debs pa lags so/ /sarba maṅga lo/ 534 —

sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshul/sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog gi sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshal blo ldan dran pa'i lags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs //rdo raring ri pa ngo bo 'pho 'gyur kun dang bral ba chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin ma 'dres gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /thugs rje cir yang 'char ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /rnam gsum dbyer med bshes gnyen mchog la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zag bral rdo rje sku mchog dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi rje/ /brjod bral nā da'i gsung snyan gnas rigs drug na lhang nger grags/ /sgrib bral gsal stong thugs ni rang babs ngang du lhod de ba/ /mtshungs bral rnam grol bde ster skyabs mchog snying ga'i pad mtshor rol/ /gang gi zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs gyur nas/ /zhing khams gzhan du gzigs pa tha ma yi/ /rnam thar byung tshul drang por brjod pa'i gtam/ /blo ldan dran pa'i gsos su spel ba la/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum chos skyong srung ma yi/ /byen rlabs sprin g.yos 'phrin las glog phreng 'khyug /gsang gsum yon tan 535

sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshul/sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog gi sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshal blo ldan dran pa'i lags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs //de/ raring la pa ngo bo 'pho 'gyur kun dang bral ba chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin ma 'dres gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /thugs rje cir yang 'char ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /rnam gsum dbyer med bshes gnyen mchog la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zag bral rdo rje sku mchog dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi rje/ /brjod bral nā da'i gsung snyan gnas rigs drug na lhang nger grags/ /sgrib bral gsal stong thugs ni rang babs ngang du lhod de ba/ /mtshungs bral rnam grol bde ster skyabs mchog snying ga'i pad mtshor rol/ /gang gi zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs gyur nas/ /zhing khams gzhan du gzigs pa tha ma yi/ /rnam thar byung tshul drang por brjod pa'i gtam/ /blo ldan dran pa'i gsos su spel ba la/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum chos skyong srung ma yi/ /byen rlabs sprin g.yos 'phrin las glog phreng 'khyug /gsang gsum yon tan 535

dbyar sgyes rnga chen sgras/ /dad ldan mdongs mtha'i tshogs gnyis mngal khur sbrums/ /phan bde'i dpal sbyin sprin gyi myu gu yis/ /mchog dman gdul bya'i zhing sa sim gyur nas/ /byang chub sems gnyis snye ma g.yur za zhing / /don gnyis 'bras bu smin par byen gyis rlobs/ /dad dang nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta'i/ /rgyud phyug thar 'dod slob bu'i tshogs rnams dang / /mchog dman yon bdag grwa slob thams cad kyis/ /dad dang gus pas rna ba'i dpyid du longs/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing / gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/de yang ji skad du/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ /bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur/ /yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par 'gyur/ /chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyes rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten mchog gi spyod pa dam pa'i phyogs tsam gyis/ /bdag gi snyan dngags mnyan du rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /lung dang gtsug lag rig par mi 'gal lam ngag gis/ /de ltar 'jig rten don 'gyur snyam nas 'di brtsams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ rnam par thar pa phyogs tsam zhig yi ge'i lam du spel ba 536

dbyar sgyes rnga chen sgras/ /dad ldan mdongs mtha'i tshogs gnyis mngal khur sbrums/ /phan bde'i dpal sbyin sprin gyi myu gu yis/ /mchog dman gdul bya'i zhing sa sim gyur nas/ /byang chub sems gnyis snye ma g.yur za zhing / /don gnyis 'bras bu smin par byen gyis rlobs/ /dad dang nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta'i/ /rgyud phyug thar 'dod slob bu'i tshogs rnams dang / /mchog dman yon bdag grwa slob thams cad kyis/ /dad dang gus pas rna ba'i dpyid du longs/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing / gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/de yang ji skad du/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ /bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur/ /yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par 'gyur/ /chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyes rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten mchog gi spyod pa dam pa'i phyogs tsam gyis/ /bdag gi snyan dngags mnyan du rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /lung dang gtsug lag rig par mi 'gal lam ngag gis/ /de ltar 'jig rten don 'gyur snyam nas 'di brtsams so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ rnam par thar pa phyogs tsam zhig yi ge'i lam du spel ba 536

la/ nges pa don gyi rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di nyid ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas mngon par byang chub kyang /dag dang ma dag pa'i gdul bya'i mos pa sna tshogs pa'i dbang las/ mdo sde za ma tog bkod par/ gang dang gang gi gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can 'dul bar 'gyur ba de dang de'i gzugs kyis chos 'chad de/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas pa/grub pa/ brtul zhugs spyod pa/ sbas tshul can/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/ rgyal phran/ blon po/ sna bo/ khyem bdag bud med/ bya/ ri dwags/ gru zam/ zas gos/ gnas mal sogs gang la gang 'dul gye bkod pas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can rnams smin par mdzad pa 'di'o zhes dbye ba'i tshig gi yul las 'das shing / rang cag rnams kyi dpal du byon pa'i sku tshe 'di nyid kyis kyang rnam thar rags rim tsam rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i glegs bu gnyis su gsal ba ltar las/ gsang gsum gye yon tan rnams zhib par smra ba ni bdag 'dras lta ci/sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po gsung gi dbang phyug la mnga' dbang 'byor pa rnams kyis kyang dpog par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rang nyid la skyes sbyangs kyi yon tan kun dang mi ldan zhing / 'di lta bu bri ba la spobs pa'i mthu dpal dang bral yang 537

spyi brtol bskyed de/ rje btsun bla ma mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir dang / bdag dang bdag 'dra'i grwa slob yon bdag rnams kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spel ba dam pa gang gi bka' drin rjes su dran de dad gus kyi gsos su 'gyur slad/ ma 'ongs 'byon 'gyur gyi gang zag mchog dman bar ba thams cad dad gdung mos pa bskyed phyir sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar 'bri ba la yid phyogs so/ /de ji ltar 'bri na rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus kyi mtshams sbyar te mya ngan las 'das par mngon par phyogs pa'i tshul/ yang dag pa'i don la gzhol ba rnams brtson pa ches cher bskyed pa dang / le lo can rnams chos la bskul ba dang / lha min gyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba rnams la dga' ba sbyin pa sogs dgos pa du ma zhig la brten nas glo bur du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul/ sku gdung rin po che dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag por byas nas gdul bya mchog dman rnams kyis dngos 'byor yid sprul gye mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod de zhugs la sbyangs pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i las ldan dad pa gsum la 'god pa dang / da lta'i gdul bya'i gnas skabs kyi duḥ kha sel phyir sku gdung ring bsrel ji ltar phebs pa dang / bdag cag da lta'i gdul bya'i tshogs rdzogs shing ma 538

'ongs pa'i skye rgu'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du mchod sdong rin po che bskrun te/ dge tshogs gong 'phel bsngo smon shis brjod dang dus gsum gzigs pa'i brda rtags cung zad ngom slad bka' stsal ba'i mtha' brten pa'i tshul dang gsum gyi sgo nas 'bri bar bya'o/ /de yang mas bu gcig pa la brtse ba ltar mkha' khyab kyi sems can yongs la byams sdang mi mnga' zhing phan bde'i dpal sbyin par byed pa'i bdag nyid chen po gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa 'phrin las rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu las/ tshur mthong gi blos spyod yul du gyur pa chu thigs tsam zhig dad pa'i lcug phran gzhon nus 'thor na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag par brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtog la smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la bsten/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dul ba tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i lo 'dab me tog gis mngon par dud cing / zhi ba ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i ge sar ze'u phol gyi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba/ nye bar zhi ba shes rab kyi bslab pa'i bcud kyis gtams shing phan bde'i dri bsung zhing mtha' grur khyab pa/539

thub bstan gyi rgya mtsho mjes par mdzad pa'i yon tan khyad par 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi 'dab ma brtsegs legs pas brgyan pa/ skal ldan rkang drug tshogs la zab dgu'i sbrang rtsi stobs pa la ngal ba spangs pa'i brtson 'grus can/ su zhig gis 'dod pa'i yol go gzed pa na 'gengs pa la ji mi snyam pa'i lung gi ge sar gyi rdul zad mi shes pas phyug pa/ chos kyi dbyengs spros pa dang bral ba'i nyi zer 'thungs pas de nyid rab tu rtogs pa la dpangs mtho zhing bsten pas 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab bsnyegs pa med pa/ gdul bya'i blo kha dang mthun pa'i tshig snyan par smra ba'i ge sar 'dzum pa la mkhas pa/ zang zing gi rdzi char la mi ltos pa 'gro ba la snying brtse ba'i rgya mtsho la gnas pa/ bsdu ba bzhi'i phang phung skye rgu'i phan bde spel ba'i slad du g.yo ba la skyo ba spang ba'i bdag nyid/ thub bstan rin chen 'byung gnas mjes pa'i rgyan mchog gcig pu bar bas so/ /de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po'i gdul bya'i nyer 'tshor 'khrungs ma thag nas/ thabs la mkhas pas mdzad pa dang snying rje dbang du gyur pa zhig ste/ yul mi kun la mthun zhing gang phan byed pa dang / dbul bor ches brtse ba ni rang gi ma dang khyad med de/ chung ngu'i dus gzhan gyi mchod gnas su byon 540

skabs shig la/ a ma la bskur ba'i gos gsar ba lab lung nang nas sprang po grang bas nyen pa zhig la stsal pa sogs mtha' yas shing / rim gyis nar son nas phyi nang gi mdzad pa ji ltar brtsam pa ni bka' las byung ba ltar la/ skabs 'gar las dag pa'i snang ngor sprul pa sku'i rdzu phrul ji ltar bstan pa ni/ sras kyi thu bo pad+ma rang grol rin po ches shad gi zhabs zung rtsi mar dri bzang gis sbag pas bsku mnye phul skabs/ thugs rje chen po kha sar pā ṇi'i rnam par bstan pa dang / de nyid kyis mtsho snying nas rje'i sa lam gar son zhus pa'i lan du/ kho bo gnas skabs 'dir rig pa tshad phebs yin nam snyam gsungs pas/de'i rtags ci lags zhus pas/ rdo leb ngos shin tu mnyam pa zhig phyag tu bzhes nas zhal sgo las 'od zer lnga 'phros te/ rdo'i ngos su phab pas 'ja' tshon bzhin bkra ba grub dbang mchog nas bsnams yong ba rjes nas thams cad la mjal rgyu byung ba dang / la phyi gangs na bzhugs skabs chu dbar mkhan rin po che'i mdun du byon nas 'bel mchid gnang ste/ phyir 'byon pa gzhon nu ma zhig gis mthong nas gzhan la sbran pas/ gzhan gyis gzim khang gi gyang kha na kha btags shig dpyangs pa las ma mthong zhing / bal bo'i yul dang thag nye ba'i mgron khang 541

zhig nas mon pa zhig gis mjal zhing / slar la phyi nas mjal skabs bla ma 'di kho bos mthong ba de red zer ba zhabs phyi 'ga' res mon pa las thos/ mang yul skyid grong jo bo'i lha khang na bzhugs skabs/ nye gnas blo bzang shes rab kyis smyung gnas bsrungs nas sku mdun du bsdad pas/ skabs shig seng khri pad zla'i gdan la nyid rin po che 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stong gi rnam pa can/ sku mdog gser btso ma la nyi zer phog pa ltar 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ 'khor du mi bskyod rin 'byung snang mtha' don grub lngas bskor bar mjal ba dang / zhal nas yi ge drug ma'i sgra byung ba'i rkyen gyis phyi nang thams cad yi ge drug ma'i gzugs kyis gang nas/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i yul mi rnyed pa lta bu byung zer/ sras kyi thu bo skal ldan rang grol rin po che jo mo kha rag na bzhugs skabs shig nye gnas kyis gar phebs zhus pas/ kho bo skyabs rje mjal bar phyin gsungs pas/ nye gnas kyis zhal mjal lags sam zhus pas/ bka' las/ kho bo'i mdun du rin po che ba byon pas langs nas mjal bar phyin pa na mi bzhugs par byon song ba'i rjes su song song bas phebs rjes zin du nye ba na/ gor ma 'dir thim pa dang snang brnyan 'dir gyur gsungs nas/ rdo 542

ba'i ngos su gang gi snang brnyan par btab pa bzhin shin tu gsal ba zhig phyag tu bsnams 'dug pa bstan pa dang / skabs shig 'dus pa mang rabs shig la gsung chos 'chad pa'i dus su spyan mi 'dzum par nam mkha' la trig ge gzigs pas rgyu ci lags zhus pas/ kho bos skyabs rje'i zhal la blta ba yin gsungs/ 'khor rnams kyis bltas pas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon kha dog sna lnga ba'i gur khyem gyi nang 'od zer gyis gang ba zhig tu mthong / gdan sa mthil du grub dbang skal ldan rang grol/ byang sems sbyin pa nor bu gnyis sku mdun du bzhugs pa'i nub gcig slob bu sangs rgyas rin chen gyes gsol ja khyer te song nas yab sras gsum la phul bas/rin po che'i sku mar me'i 'od kyis mi snang ba byas bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal yid kyis gsol ba btab pa na/ ji zhig na/ rin po che thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba 'od dkar po'i nang na bzhugs shing 'bel mchid gnang ba rnams gang gi gsung las ma 'das pa zhig mjal/ yang rin po che rtsa chang dga' dang / mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring sogs kyis sa ga zla bar rtsa yul du spyan drangs te sri zhu bla na med pa bstabs shing de dus char shin tu dkon pas char 'bebs zhus par/ yul de ga na 543

skyed tshal shin tu nyams dga' ba mtha' lcang ma dang / star kha dang / kham bu dang / g.yer ma la sogs pa'i ljon pa yal ka dang lo ma me tog gis dud pa'i ra bas bskor ba'i dbus ne'u gsing kha dog g.yu'i mdangs 'phrog pas mdzes pa'i dbus na/chu mig yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa 'bab pa dbang po'i skyed tshal la 'gran pa lta bu zhig yod pa der/ thugs spro ba'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pas spud pa'i dbus su gdan bshams pa la bzhugs su gsol zhing dgyes pa bskang ngo / /ji zhig na/ rin po che chu mig gi gam du byon te phyag dang zhabs bsil ba'i tshe/nam mkha'i mdangs shin tu gsal ba mthing zhun gyes byugs pa lta bu las/ char gyi rgyun bzang po sa gzhi'i rdul non pa tsam zhig 'bab pa'i rdzu 'phrul yang ston par mdzad pa'i phyi nyin nas char gyi rgyun bzang pos skye rgu la phan bde stsal pa dang /bkra shis 'byel ba'i bde ba can gyi lha khang nas gser khang rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob a lags khen rgya dang / blo bzang dar rgyas sogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan zhing bya bral gyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba 'ga' la/ zab chos nā ro chos drug sogs bka' brgyud phyogs kyi gdams pa mang po stsal pa'i skabs/ shin tu gsang ba lus dkyil la brten pa'i dbang bzhi 544

bsgur ba'i gral du slob bu sangs rgyas rin chen yang bsdad pas/ gang gi sku bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i spyi bor sangs rgyas thod pa/ mgrin par ma hā ma ya/ thugs gar gsang ba 'das pa/ lte bar 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar bstan nas dbang bzhi dus gcig la bskur zhing smin par mdzad pas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes shing dad gus tshad las 'das pa byung /yang bkra shis 'khyil bar dad 'dus kyi slob ma mang po la chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor ba'i skabs 'ga' re la nye gnas blo bzang shes rab kyis mthong snang la/ nam mkha'i khams nas lha dang lha mo mang po sku mdog phyag mtshan sna tshogs thogs pa che chung mi tshad gsum bzhi las lhag tsam mang po 'tshogs nas/ la las phyag 'tshal/ la las bstod pa 'don/ la las me tog dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs la las rol mo'i sgra sgrog pa dang / lus ngag gi glu gar sogs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan pa sogs nam mkha'i khams la mi shong ba tsam byung ba dang / skabs 'gar 'ja' sprin gyis nam mkha'i khams gang zhing / thig le thig phran sna tshogs pa'i dbus 'od lnga'i dga' ba 'khyil ba che 545

bsgur ba'i gral du slob bu sangs rgyas rin chen yang bsdad pas/ gang gi sku bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i spyi bor sangs rgyas thod pa/ mgrin par ma hā ma ya/ thugs gar gsang ba 'das pa/ lte bar 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar bstan nas dbang bzhi dus gcig la bskur zhing smin par mdzad pas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes shing dad gus tshad las 'das pa byung /yang bkra shis 'khyil bar dad 'dus kyi slob ma mang po la chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor ba'i skabs 'ga' re la nye gnas blo bzang shes rab kyis mthong snang la/ nam mkha'i khams nas lha dang lha mo mang po sku mdog phyag mtshan sna tshogs thogs pa che chung mi tshad gsum bzhi las lhag tsam mang po 'tshogs nas/ la las phyag 'tshal/ la las bstod pa 'don/ la las me tog dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs la las rol mo'i sgra sgrog pa dang / lus ngag gi glu gar sogs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan pa sogs nam mkha'i khams la mi shong ba tsam byung ba dang / skabs 'gar 'ja' sprin gyis nam mkha'i khams gang zhing / thig le thig phran sna tshogs pa'i dbus 'od lnga'i dga' ba 'khyil ba che 545

zhing mjes pa'i lte bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshan pa sogs brjod las 'das pa mthong ba kho bo'i ngag las thos yang sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la sgyung gnas gnang yod dus nyang gi mtshams pa rgya mtshos/ khri khar nyid kyi sku thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis bzhengs stabs can kha sar pā ṇi'i rnam pa can du mthong ba dang / zhabs drung ba dge slong blo gros sku mdun pa byas te bzhugs tod pa'i nyin cig gzim khang sgo la phyi lcags brgyab ste/ nang du thugs dam la bzhugs yod skabs/mgur sdong gi nags na zhabs phyi pa mang pos shing len du yod sar phebs nas/ khyod rang rnams kyis g.yo ma byed par yag po byas las dgos/ nged khyod rnams la blta rtog byed du 'ong ba yin gsungs nas zhabs phyi gang yang med par gcig pur byon tshul rjes su ban+de skyabs be zer bas nye gnas/ la bshad pas/ nye gnas kyis sku mdun du zhus pas zhal 'dzum mdzad de/ las dag pa'i snang ngor sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ltar ci yang ston zhing /cir yang 'char ba chos nyid yin ang gsungs/ dam pa nyid la ma dag tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dang bral nas/ gang du bzhugs kyang phyi nang sno/da bcud dag pa 'ba' zhig las mi 'char yang / rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyis tshogs bsogs 546

sgrib pa sbyong phyir sa las byed dgos zhes gsungs pa dang du blangs te/ nyang gi mtshams pas kha 'go byas smad pa'i sngags mang gis nyi ma mang po'i bar du las pas/ bde ba can gyi lha khang gi phyir lcags ri rgya che ba chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i brda yin gsungs nas/ kun nas zlum por bskor ba'i lho ngos kyi nang du gzim khang bzhengs pa'i nang la/ bslab gsum rgyan gyes rnam par mdzes shing lung rigs yon tan du mas mngon par 'phags pa'i lha bzo klu 'bum dang ye shes dar rgyas/ nyang mtshams rgya mtsho dang sngags pa gnas brtan sogs bzo bo lnga drug tsam gyes/ dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ kun bzang rdor sems sogs dang / reb gong yul gyi grub chen brgyad/ btags grol grong khyer sgol ba/ dgongs 'dus mthong grol chen mo sogs phyi nang la ldebs bris sna tshogs bzhengs pa'i mthun rkyen rnams grwa slob yon bdag rnams dang / rang cag nas bgyes pa'i skabs 'gar steng phyogs nas 'ja' sprin kha dog sna tshogs pa 'khrigs shing / me tog gi char 'bab pa rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs sgog pa/ dri bzang po rgyun ring 'thul ba/ nyams dang rmi lam sna tshogs par lha dang bsrung ma dkar phyogs pa rnams kyis las grogs bgyis 547

nas/ sa rdo shing skyel ba sogs ngo mtshar du ma dang bcas 'grub nas/ dga' ston du tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bskor/bzo bo rnams la yon gnang / bsngo smon rgyas par gnang nas/da lam gyi gzim khang 'di dbyar dus bsil drod snyoms shing /dgun dus dro la nyi 'od rgyun du 'khyel bas/ nang du bsdad na bag phebs la/ 'a 'ur zang zing gis dben pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams rgyun chad med par 'phel bas shin tu bzang 'dug 'di'i ming la gzim khang 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyil ba zhes 'dogs dgos gsungs nas/ yun ring nang du mtshams la bzhugs pa'i skabs shig la/ bdag dang nyang gi mtshams pa sogs mched grogs gnyis gsum tsam sku mdun du song bas/ nyid kyi zhal nas sngon byon skyes mchog rnams kyi rnam thar sna tshogs shig gsungs shing / khyad par las dag pa'i snang ngor sprul bsgyur sna tshogs byas tshul mang po gsungs pa'i skabs shig bdag cag rnams kyi sems la/ nyid rin po che sems dpa' chen po gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba yin pas/ sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin dam pa mchog gi bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul re bdag cag rnams kyis mthong rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na dga' ba la snyam 548

nas/ sa rdo shing skyel ba sogs ngo mtshar du ma dang bcas 'grub nas/ dga' ston du tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bskor/bzo bo rnams la yon gnang / bsngo smon rgyas par gnang nas/da lam gyi gzim khang 'di dbyar dus bsil drod snyoms shing /dgun dus dro la nyi 'od rgyun du 'khyel bas/ nang du bsdad na bag phebs la/ 'a 'ur zang zing gis dben pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams rgyun chad med par 'phel bas shin tu bzang 'dug 'di'i ming la gzim khang 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyil ba zhes 'dogs dgos gsungs nas/ yun ring nang du mtshams la bzhugs pa'i skabs shig la/ bdag dang nyang gi mtshams pa sogs mched grogs gnyis gsum tsam sku mdun du song bas/ nyid kyi zhal nas sngon byon skyes mchog rnams kyi rnam thar sna tshogs shig gsungs shing / khyad par las dag pa'i snang ngor sprul bsgyur sna tshogs byas tshul mang po gsungs pa'i skabs shig bdag cag rnams kyi sems la/ nyid rin po che sems dpa' chen po gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba yin pas/ sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin dam pa mchog gi bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul re bdag cag rnams kyis mthong rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na dga' ba la snyam 548

nas gsol ba btab pas/ gang gi sku mchog rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas bstan te mgur dbyangs 'di gsungs so/ /rang rig chos sku'i rol rtsal las/ /bdag nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor gye/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /me long gzugs bzhin gsal ba yi/ /tsit+ta 'od lnga'i gzhal yas na/ /zhi ba sum cu so drug bzhugs/ /mgrin pa longs spyod gzhal yas na/ /rig 'dzin lha tshogs thams cad bzhugs/ /klad pa dung khang gzhal yas na/ /khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs/ /lte ba sprul pa'i gzhal yas/ na/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gzhal yas na/ /rdo rje phur ba'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ka dang / /lte ba gsang gnas rkang mthil na/ /sprul sku thub pa drug po bzhugs/ /lus kyi ba spu la sogs pa/ /phyi nang rdul phran re re'i khyon/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams grangs med bzhugs/ /las dang skal ba ldan pa yi/ /dad pas gsol ba 'debs nus shing / /gus pa'i mig gis blta shes na/ /lha tshogs de dag gsal bar mthong /'od zer chen bos dbang bskur zhing / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster/ /tshe rabs kun tu lha tshogs kyis/ /brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dbyangs byas gsung bzhin/549

nas gsol ba btab pas/ gang gi sku mchog rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas bstan te mgur dbyangs 'di gsungs so/ /rang rig chos sku'i rol rtsal las/ /bdag nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor gye/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /me long gzugs bzhin gsal ba yi/ /tsit+ta 'od lnga'i gzhal yas na/ /zhi ba sum cu so drug bzhugs/ /mgrin pa longs spyod gzhal yas na/ /rig 'dzin lha tshogs thams cad bzhugs/ /klad pa dung khang gzhal yas na/ /khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs/ /lte ba sprul pa'i gzhal yas/ na/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gzhal yas na/ /rdo rje phur ba'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ka dang / /lte ba gsang gnas rkang mthil na/ /sprul sku thub pa drug po bzhugs/ /lus kyi ba spu la sogs pa/ /phyi nang rdul phran re re'i khyon/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams grangs med bzhugs/ /las dang skal ba ldan pa yi/ /dad pas gsol ba 'debs nus shing / /gus pa'i mig gis blta shes na/ /lha tshogs de dag gsal bar mthong /'od zer chen bos dbang bskur zhing / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster/ /tshe rabs kun tu lha tshogs kyis/ /brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dbyangs byas gsung bzhin/549

ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bskur pas/ thams cad kyis de ltar du mthong zhing / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang dus gcig tu thob pa byung snyam dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / rjes nas zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ljags rtsom gnang nas/ 'di thon la nyams len gyis dang / ma 'ongs pa na snang srid dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu song nas/lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nus pa sogs ting nge 'dzin la mnga' dbang 'byor ba re gnyis 'byung srid snyam gsungs/ re zhig su la yang mi bshad pa'i gsang rgyas btab bo//yang 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal na bzhugs dus nyin cig chung nas bzung ste dad gus dag snang che zhing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la ngag gi dbang phyug ltar smra ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa'i dgu rong sprul sku dang / mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i gang zag las snang dag pa 'ga' la/ sku lus yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas bstan te/ mgur dbyangs 'di gsungs so/ /rang rig chos sku'i rol rtsal las/ /bdag nyid dus gsum rgyal ba kun/ /bsgyed pa'i rta phag yab yum sku/ /me long gzugs bzhin gsal ba yi/ /snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo na/ /550

gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo na/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo na/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed lha tshogs bzhugs/ /stong phrag bdun cu don gnyis kyi/ /rtsa khams rgyud bzhi'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /yan lag lhu tshigs cha shas na/ /gnas yul dur khrod lha rnams bzhugs/ /lus kyi rdul re'i khyon tsam na/ /sangs rgyas byang sems tshad med bzhugs/ /ba sru sa ya drug 'bum na/ /nyan rang dgra bcom grangs med bzhugs/ /skra lo nyi khri chig stong na/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpag med bzhugs/ /las dang skal ba ldan pa yi/ /dad pas gsol ba 'debs nus shing / /gus pa'i mig gis blta shes na/ /lha tshogs de dag gsal bar mthong / /'od zer chen pos dbang bskur zhing / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster/ /tshe rabs kun tu lha tshogs kyis/ /brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dbyangs su len bzhin ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bskur pas/ thams cad kyis de ltar du mthong zhing / rgyal ba rnams kyi dbang dus gcig la thob pa'i skal ba bzang po 551
