byung snyam dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /re zhig su la yang mi bshad pa'i gsang rgyas btab bo/ /de dag ni gdul bya'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin la/ gzhan du ni mtha' yas mod skal bar ma thob bo//gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ gdul bya'i dpal du byon pa'i glegs bam rnams kyis mdo tsam shes la/ rgyas par ni smos kyis mi lang ngo / /dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba ni/ thugs kyi blo'i spyod yul ni chos kyi dbyengs zab cing rgya che ba/ 'khor 'das kyi chos gcig kyang ma lus mi lus lus pa med par gzigs pas/ 'di mtha' 'di tsam rtogs pa yin no zhes brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa nyid do/ /'on kyang thos 'dzin gye yul du byung zhing mngon du gyur pa 'ga' zhig bri na/ rma chen gangs na bzhugs dus/ ma yum gshegs la nye ba thugs kyis dgongs te mjal bar byon pas/brag dkar sprel rdzong nas dad ldan gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngo ma ldog par bzhugs te/ kun bzang rang grol sogs las ldan gyi ri ba 'ga' la rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gyi lung khrid stsol skabs glo bur du/ bka' chos gnang 'phro bskyungs te/ nyi ma bdun gye bar du 'od gsal gyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa 552

byung snyam dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /re zhig su la yang mi bshad pa'i gsang rgyas btab bo/ /de dag ni gdul bya'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin la/ gzhan du ni mtha' yas mod skal bar ma thob bo//gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ gdul bya'i dpal du byon pa'i glegs bam rnams kyis mdo tsam shes la/ rgyas par ni smos kyis mi lang ngo / /dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba ni/ thugs kyi blo'i spyod yul ni chos kyi dbyengs zab cing rgya che ba/ 'khor 'das kyi chos gcig kyang ma lus mi lus lus pa med par gzigs pas/ 'di mtha' 'di tsam rtogs pa yin no zhes brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa nyid do/ /'on kyang thos 'dzin gye yul du byung zhing mngon du gyur pa 'ga' zhig bri na/ rma chen gangs na bzhugs dus/ ma yum gshegs la nye ba thugs kyis dgongs te mjal bar byon pas/brag dkar sprel rdzong nas dad ldan gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngo ma ldog par bzhugs te/ kun bzang rang grol sogs las ldan gyi ri ba 'ga' la rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel gyi lung khrid stsol skabs glo bur du/ bka' chos gnang 'phro bskyungs te/ nyi ma bdun gye bar du 'od gsal gyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa 552

la gzhol bar gyur to/ /de ni ma yum gshegs pa'i nyin yin pas ma yum la phan bde stsal pa gor ma chag go /rgyal gye shrīḥ na bzhugs skabs gcung bla ma las bkra shis sgo mang mes 'jig pa la zhig gsos mdzad dgos par bskul yang zhal gyes ma bzhes mod/ mchod rten rin po che'i srog shing ldang ba'i shug pa nyi ma bco lnga'i sa nas drangs te/ rgyal gyi shrīḥ yi nye 'dabs su bzhag pa/ phyis skyabs mgon paṇa chen mchog nas bka' phebs pa la zhal len gnang nas mchod rten bzhengs skabs dgos ma thag tu len par mdzad pa dang / gang gi 'phrin las pa kun dga' nyi ma dbus su 'byon skabs/ khyod dbus su song la tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms dang / rang gzhan gye don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par nges/ kho bor lo brgyad kyi bar la ang nyan gyes lo brgyad thal na 'byon mi thub ces bka' stsal ba'i thog tu bab pa ni 'di ga'o/ /gang gi sku don bsgrub pa'i tshe lus srog la'ang ji mi snyam pa'i spobs pa can kun dga' don grub dbus su tha ma 'gro dus/ bka' las/ khyod lo gsum las ma 'gor ba gyis de'i bar 'a/ dpon slob thams cad la bar chad mi yong zhes phebs pa sogs gdul bya rang rang la gsungs pa ni smos kyis mi lang ngo / /gang gi gdul bya las dang skal bar 553

la gzhol bar gyur to/ /de ni ma yum gshegs pa'i nyin yin pas ma yum la phan bde stsal pa gor ma chag go /rgyal gye shrīḥ na bzhugs skabs gcung bla ma las bkra shis sgo mang mes 'jig pa la zhig gsos mdzad dgos par bskul yang zhal gyes ma bzhes mod/ mchod rten rin po che'i srog shing ldang ba'i shug pa nyi ma bco lnga'i sa nas drangs te/ rgyal gyi shrīḥ yi nye 'dabs su bzhag pa/ phyis skyabs mgon paṇa chen mchog nas bka' phebs pa la zhal len gnang nas mchod rten bzhengs skabs dgos ma thag tu len par mdzad pa dang / gang gi 'phrin las pa kun dga' nyi ma dbus su 'byon skabs/ khyod dbus su song la tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms dang / rang gzhan gye don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par nges/ kho bor lo brgyad kyi bar la ang nyan gyes lo brgyad thal na 'byon mi thub ces bka' stsal ba'i thog tu bab pa ni 'di ga'o/ /gang gi sku don bsgrub pa'i tshe lus srog la'ang ji mi snyam pa'i spobs pa can kun dga' don grub dbus su tha ma 'gro dus/ bka' las/ khyod lo gsum las ma 'gor ba gyis de'i bar 'a/ dpon slob thams cad la bar chad mi yong zhes phebs pa sogs gdul bya rang rang la gsungs pa ni smos kyis mi lang ngo / /gang gi gdul bya las dang skal bar 553

ldan pa dag la ni rang rang gi blo yul la nges shes 'drongs pa 'di ka lags la gsal 'debs ci 'tshal ma 'ongs pa'i las ldan gyi dad pa'i rgyur ni de tsam gyis chog par sems so the tshom dang log rtog gi dra bar tshud pa dag la ni ji ltar 'doms kyang phan par mi 'gyur ba nyid do/ /de bas na blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis dam pa'i mdzad pa dad pa gsum gyis bsnyen zhing /rang nyid kyis kyang de lta bu 'thob pa'i thabs la gzhol bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid chen po des stod dza ti'i rkang 'thung dkrigs pa nas/ smad rgya mo chu la dar 'thag sa'i bar gyi bstan 'gro la sman yon bla na ma mchis pa stsal cing / khyad par las ldan gyi gdul bya rnams byang chub gsum la bkod de chos kyi dbyengs zab cing rgya che ba'i klong du mnal bar dgongs so/ /de cis mngon zhe na/rnam thar dgos 'dod kun 'byung las gsal bar mdzad pas so / / gzhan yang las dang skal bar ldan pa zhal blta bar 'dod pa rnams la/ lcags khyi'i lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes la bkra shis 'khyil bar 'dus shig dam pa chos kyi sgo 'phar bla na med pa dbye bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bka' phyogs thams cad du dril 554

ldan pa dag la ni rang rang gi blo yul la nges shes 'drongs pa 'di ka lags la gsal 'debs ci 'tshal ma 'ongs pa'i las ldan gyi dad pa'i rgyur ni de tsam gyis chog par sems so the tshom dang log rtog gi dra bar tshud pa dag la ni ji ltar 'doms kyang phan par mi 'gyur ba nyid do/ /de bas na blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis dam pa'i mdzad pa dad pa gsum gyis bsnyen zhing /rang nyid kyis kyang de lta bu 'thob pa'i thabs la gzhol bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid chen po des stod dza ti'i rkang 'thung dkrigs pa nas/ smad rgya mo chu la dar 'thag sa'i bar gyi bstan 'gro la sman yon bla na ma mchis pa stsal cing / khyad par las ldan gyi gdul bya rnams byang chub gsum la bkod de chos kyi dbyengs zab cing rgya che ba'i klong du mnal bar dgongs so/ /de cis mngon zhe na/rnam thar dgos 'dod kun 'byung las gsal bar mdzad pas so / / gzhan yang las dang skal bar ldan pa zhal blta bar 'dod pa rnams la/ lcags khyi'i lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes la bkra shis 'khyil bar 'dus shig dam pa chos kyi sgo 'phar bla na med pa dbye bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bka' phyogs thams cad du dril 554

sgog tu bcug bkra shis 'khyil ba'i ri rtser sngar bzhugs khri rnying ba yod pa la nyams gso gtong dgos tshul gsungs pa ltar/ gnyer ba rab byung gis kha 'go byas te zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis chos ra gsar du rgya cher bskyed nas/ 'dus pa rnams kyi don du grwa khang mang po gsar rgyag gnang / khri khang gi gyang logs la/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po/ 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso/ rje btsun sgol ma/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/lho brag grub chen sogs mkhas grub mang bo'i sku brnyan ldebs bris la bkod/ de nas lo gsar tshes la lcags khyi'i gnam lo'i dga' ston bla na med pa bgyi ba yin/ mi'i skye 'chi la nges pa cang ma mchis pas na mi dga' ba 'tshogs pa da lan tsam yin no/ /kho bo khams bzang zhing khyed slob ma yon bdag rnams rkyen phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med par gnas pa ni/ gnam la nyi zla skar gsum/ sa la bla slob yon bdag nang na pha ma bu gsum/ bar na bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom pa'i dus 'dir/bde ba'i mchog ni nad med pa/ skyid pa'i mchog ni sems skyid pa bya ba yin/ bde zhing skyid pa'i sgang 'dir lha chos mi chos gang bsgrub kyang 'tshengs pa yin/ des na mi dga' lha dga' byed dgos pas/ ngas khyed rang rnams tshe ring ba'i phyir 555

sgog tu bcug bkra shis 'khyil ba'i ri rtser sngar bzhugs khri rnying ba yod pa la nyams gso gtong dgos tshul gsungs pa ltar/ gnyer ba rab byung gis kha 'go byas te zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis chos ra gsar du rgya cher bskyed nas/ 'dus pa rnams kyi don du grwa khang mang po gsar rgyag gnang / khri khang gi gyang logs la/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po/ 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso/ rje btsun sgol ma/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/lho brag grub chen sogs mkhas grub mang bo'i sku brnyan ldebs bris la bkod/ de nas lo gsar tshes la lcags khyi'i gnam lo'i dga' ston bla na med pa bgyi ba yin/ mi'i skye 'chi la nges pa cang ma mchis pas na mi dga' ba 'tshogs pa da lan tsam yin no/ /kho bo khams bzang zhing khyed slob ma yon bdag rnams rkyen phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med par gnas pa ni/ gnam la nyi zla skar gsum/ sa la bla slob yon bdag nang na pha ma bu gsum/ bar na bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom pa'i dus 'dir/bde ba'i mchog ni nad med pa/ skyid pa'i mchog ni sems skyid pa bya ba yin/ bde zhing skyid pa'i sgang 'dir lha chos mi chos gang bsgrub kyang 'tshengs pa yin/ des na mi dga' lha dga' byed dgos pas/ ngas khyed rang rnams tshe ring ba'i phyir 555

tshe dbang bskur/ rjes su dga' ston du glu gar sogs rgyas par byed dgos gsungs nas chos bshad dang tshe dbang rgyas par gnang rjes da khyed glu shes pa rnams kyis glu longs/ gzhas shes pa rnams kyis gzhas thongs la bro 'khrab dgos gsungs pa ltar/ gzhon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi gang shes kyi glu sna tshogs pa blangs song / dbus gtsang stod nas yong ba'i grwa pa 'ga' res 'di 'dra zer bar 'dug nor bu me shel chu shel/ /rgya yi nor bu yin pa/ /bod khams skyong ba'i nor bu/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu/ /dam chos zab mo'i 'dod dgu/ /gangs ljongs 'gro la phab nas/ /las can thar pa'i lam la/ /skyid glu len bzhin bzhud song / /nga rang bla ma'i gces phrug /rje la g.yas skor brgyab nas/ /ri khrod 'grims la chas 'gro/ /pha shul bu yis zin shog /yang be'u thang sngags byis dang / lha khang sngags byis kun dga' nor bu gnyis kyis/skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtser bzhugs/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la/ /dgos 'dod char bzhin phab song / /skyabs mgon ri rgyal lhun po/ /mi 'gyur gdan la bzhugs yong / /snod ldan slob ma'i tshogs kyis/ /gser ri bzhin du skor snang / /skyabs mgon 'dzam gling nyi 556

tshe dbang bskur/ rjes su dga' ston du glu gar sogs rgyas par byed dgos gsungs nas chos bshad dang tshe dbang rgyas par gnang rjes da khyed glu shes pa rnams kyis glu longs/ gzhas shes pa rnams kyis gzhas thongs la bro 'khrab dgos gsungs pa ltar/ gzhon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi gang shes kyi glu sna tshogs pa blangs song / dbus gtsang stod nas yong ba'i grwa pa 'ga' res 'di 'dra zer bar 'dug nor bu me shel chu shel/ /rgya yi nor bu yin pa/ /bod khams skyong ba'i nor bu/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu/ /dam chos zab mo'i 'dod dgu/ /gangs ljongs 'gro la phab nas/ /las can thar pa'i lam la/ /skyid glu len bzhin bzhud song / /nga rang bla ma'i gces phrug /rje la g.yas skor brgyab nas/ /ri khrod 'grims la chas 'gro/ /pha shul bu yis zin shog /yang be'u thang sngags byis dang / lha khang sngags byis kun dga' nor bu gnyis kyis/skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtser bzhugs/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la/ /dgos 'dod char bzhin phab song / /skyabs mgon ri rgyal lhun po/ /mi 'gyur gdan la bzhugs yong / /snod ldan slob ma'i tshogs kyis/ /gser ri bzhin du skor snang / /skyabs mgon 'dzam gling nyi 556

ma/ /'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros nas/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs kyi/ /ma rig mun pa sangs song / /zhes pa la sogs pa'i gzhas btang bro 'khrab/ glu yang mang po blangs shing / nyi ma lnga tsam la dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa stsal cing lha'i bde skyid kyi khengs pa yang 'phrog pa tsam mdzad de slar yang sku mtshams la bzhugs/ de nas sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la chos 'khor bskor ba'i dbu btsugs nyin nangs snga mo nyi ma rtse shar la/ nyid nas thugs bkod gnang ba ltar/ ban sngags grwa btsun skya ser thams cad kyis gos rgyan mdzes par byas/ gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan spos phor rol mo sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs te/ ser phreng tshar du dngar ba byas sngon bsus nas phebs te/ chos khrir bzhugs nas/ las dang skal ba ldan pa yongs la lam rim blo sbyong phyag chen dang rdzogs chen sogs gang dgos rang rang gi 'dod blo dang bstun te gnang nas/skabs shig zhal gdams 'di nyid kyang gnang ngo / / rje mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /steng spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs/ /yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i skal ldan gyi/ /slob ma dang yang slob thams 557

ma/ /'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros nas/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs kyi/ /ma rig mun pa sangs song / /zhes pa la sogs pa'i gzhas btang bro 'khrab/ glu yang mang po blangs shing / nyi ma lnga tsam la dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa stsal cing lha'i bde skyid kyi khengs pa yang 'phrog pa tsam mdzad de slar yang sku mtshams la bzhugs/ de nas sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la chos 'khor bskor ba'i dbu btsugs nyin nangs snga mo nyi ma rtse shar la/ nyid nas thugs bkod gnang ba ltar/ ban sngags grwa btsun skya ser thams cad kyis gos rgyan mdzes par byas/ gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan spos phor rol mo sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs te/ ser phreng tshar du dngar ba byas sngon bsus nas phebs te/ chos khrir bzhugs nas/ las dang skal ba ldan pa yongs la lam rim blo sbyong phyag chen dang rdzogs chen sogs gang dgos rang rang gi 'dod blo dang bstun te gnang nas/skabs shig zhal gdams 'di nyid kyang gnang ngo / / rje mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /steng spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs/ /yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i skal ldan gyi/ /slob ma dang yang slob thams 557

cad kyi/ /shes rgyud la nyams dang rtogs pa yi/ /byen rlabs kyi mtshan ma mngon gyur mdzod/ /dpe sprin bral nam mkha'i dbyings rum na/ /'od rab gsal nyi zla shar ba bzhin/ /sems skye med spros bral klong yangs nas/ /phyogs kun khyab snying rje shar na ang / /dpe mtho la yangs pa'i bar snang la/ /bya rgod pos gshog rtsal sbyong ba bzhin/ /yul rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nyams rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyong byas na ang / /dpe mkha' la sprin phung cher 'khrigs nas/ /sa yangs par char ba 'bebs pa bzhin/ /rang rgyud la byang chub sems 'byongs nas/ /ma 'gro la chos char phab na ang / /dpe char bas sa gzhi brlan pa na/ /sa'i nang nas me tog skye ba bzhin/ /chos zab mos gdul bya'i rgyud smin nas/ /nyams rtogs pa nang nas rgyas na ang / /pha bla ma mjal rgyu yod dus mjol/ /phyis rmi lam bsgug dgos dus shig 'ong / /dus da lta mthong dus zhal ras ltos/ /phyis zhabs phyi mthong na dga' dus 'ong / /dus da lta gsung chos yang yang nyon/ /phyis nyan rgyu med pa'i dus shig 'ong / /bka' bkyon pa'i dus su dga' ba sgoms/ /phyis zhal gsung mi thos dus shig 'ong / /dus da lta 'bul na yod tshad phul/ /phyis 'bul sa med pa'i dus shig 'ong / /dus da lta bla 558

cad kyi/ /shes rgyud la nyams dang rtogs pa yi/ /byen rlabs kyi mtshan ma mngon gyur mdzod/ /dpe sprin bral nam mkha'i dbyings rum na/ /'od rab gsal nyi zla shar ba bzhin/ /sems skye med spros bral klong yangs nas/ /phyogs kun khyab snying rje shar na ang / /dpe mtho la yangs pa'i bar snang la/ /bya rgod pos gshog rtsal sbyong ba bzhin/ /yul rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nyams rtogs pa'i rtsal sbyong byas na ang / /dpe mkha' la sprin phung cher 'khrigs nas/ /sa yangs par char ba 'bebs pa bzhin/ /rang rgyud la byang chub sems 'byongs nas/ /ma 'gro la chos char phab na ang / /dpe char bas sa gzhi brlan pa na/ /sa'i nang nas me tog skye ba bzhin/ /chos zab mos gdul bya'i rgyud smin nas/ /nyams rtogs pa nang nas rgyas na ang / /pha bla ma mjal rgyu yod dus mjol/ /phyis rmi lam bsgug dgos dus shig 'ong / /dus da lta mthong dus zhal ras ltos/ /phyis zhabs phyi mthong na dga' dus 'ong / /dus da lta gsung chos yang yang nyon/ /phyis nyan rgyu med pa'i dus shig 'ong / /bka' bkyon pa'i dus su dga' ba sgoms/ /phyis zhal gsung mi thos dus shig 'ong / /dus da lta 'bul na yod tshad phul/ /phyis 'bul sa med pa'i dus shig 'ong / /dus da lta bla 558

ma'i drung nas sdod/ /phyis sdod rgyu med pa'i dus shig 'ong / /las rgyu 'bras spong len shes tsa na/ /gzhan thos chung zer yang a'u tsi/ /sems rang ngo shes na 'phrin las la/ /dbang ma thob zer yang a'u tsi/ /tshe blo yis thongs na bla ma la/ /nor 'bul rgyu med rung a'u tsi/ /rang brdar sha nang nas chod tsa na/ /chos sgom yun thung rung a'u tsi/ /smon lam dang snying rje gnyis yod na/ /phral 'gro don med rung a'u tsi/ /dus da lta 'chi rung mi 'jigs na/ /nyams rtogs pa dma' rung a'u tsi/ /rang sgo gsum lha skur gsal tsa na/ /phyir grub rtags med rung a'u tsi/ /cir snang tshad bden med shes tsa na/ /chos ma byas bsdad rung a'u tsi/ /rje bla ma sangs rgyas mthong tsa na/ /sems mos gus chung rung a'u tsi/ /khyim bza' tshang 'thab mo mthong tsa na/ /sman go rgas ma tsho skyid par gda'/ /yul yod pa'i chags sdang mthong tsa na/ /pho yul med pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /nor gsog bsrung dka' las mthong tsa na/ /pho nor med pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /bu gso ba'i dka' las mthong tsa na/ /rgan bu med pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /so na ba'i sdug bsngal mthong tsa na/ /ban kha 'ug pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /dgon grwa sa'i chags sdang mthong tsa na/ /khong ri khrod pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /yul 559

ma'i drung nas sdod/ /phyis sdod rgyu med pa'i dus shig 'ong / /las rgyu 'bras spong len shes tsa na/ /gzhan thos chung zer yang a'u tsi/ /sems rang ngo shes na 'phrin las la/ /dbang ma thob zer yang a'u tsi/ /tshe blo yis thongs na bla ma la/ /nor 'bul rgyu med rung a'u tsi/ /rang brdar sha nang nas chod tsa na/ /chos sgom yun thung rung a'u tsi/ /smon lam dang snying rje gnyis yod na/ /phral 'gro don med rung a'u tsi/ /dus da lta 'chi rung mi 'jigs na/ /nyams rtogs pa dma' rung a'u tsi/ /rang sgo gsum lha skur gsal tsa na/ /phyir grub rtags med rung a'u tsi/ /cir snang tshad bden med shes tsa na/ /chos ma byas bsdad rung a'u tsi/ /rje bla ma sangs rgyas mthong tsa na/ /sems mos gus chung rung a'u tsi/ /khyim bza' tshang 'thab mo mthong tsa na/ /sman go rgas ma tsho skyid par gda'/ /yul yod pa'i chags sdang mthong tsa na/ /pho yul med pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /nor gsog bsrung dka' las mthong tsa na/ /pho nor med pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /bu gso ba'i dka' las mthong tsa na/ /rgan bu med pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /so na ba'i sdug bsngal mthong tsa na/ /ban kha 'ug pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /dgon grwa sa'i chags sdang mthong tsa na/ /khong ri khrod pa tsho skyid par gda'/ /yul 559

grong ba'i nang du sdod dus kyang / /sems chags sdang skyon gyis ma gos shig /mi mardo po'i nang du sdod dus kyang / /gzhan ngo 'dzin skyon gyis ma gos shig /ma 'gro ba gzhan gyi don byed kyang / /rang 'dod kyi skyon gyis ma gos shig /rang gcig pur ri khrod 'grims dus kyang / /nyan rang gi skyon gyis ma gos shig /dus rtag tu 'dod yon longs spyod kyang / /zhen chags kyi skyon gyis ma gos shig /las dge sgrub sdig pa spong dus kyang / /g.yo zol gyi skyon gyis ma gos shig /spyir chos kyi phyogs su sdug thub pa/ /cig gyis dang skyid pa'i dus shig 'ong / /sdom dam tshig bsrung dus sdug thub pa/ /cig gyis dang thar pa thob nas 'ong / /chos slob gnyer phyogs su sdug thub pa/ /cig gyis dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'ong / /tshe stod la btsun pa byas byas nas/ /mthar khyem thab byas pa'i dpe yod gzob/ /tshe gang bor thos pa byas byas nas/ /mthar bza' dpon byas pa'i dpe yod gzob/ /tshe stod la ri khrod 'grims 'grims nas/ /mthar grong nas 'chi ba'i dpe yod gzob/ /nor mang po dgra bo'i g.yab mo yin/ /don de phyir zas nor ma gsog cig /grogs ngan pa 'khor ba'i dpyang thag yin/ /rang gcig pur sdod dang dge sbyor 'phel/ /mdor bsdu na mang du smos ci dgos/ /bka' mdo 560

rgyud man ngag dpang por zhog /rang rgyud dang chos gnyis 'dres par gyis/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /dge 'di yis skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs/ /tshe mi rtag 'chi ba'i tshul bsams nas/ /chos zab mo nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /mchog sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes gsungs nas/spyir chos thams cad mi rtag pa'i tshul dang / sgos su rang la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che ba'i chos rgyal ngag dbang wang yab sras dang / bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sogs zhing khams gzhan du dgongs tshul/ lus srog bskyed pa'i drin can gyi ma rgan mo sogs bzhud tshul rnams gsungs nas spyan chab mang bo bsil zhing / da nga yang lo lon khyed slob ma yon bdag gi nang nas kyang phal che ba 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du bzhud tshar/ da yod pa rnams kyang phal cher gyi tshe phyed ka tshar/ phal cher gyi nyis cha dang sum cha la thug nas nga'i rjes la bsnyegs tshar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal mjal ba las bla ma'i zhal lan cig mjal ba skal ba bzang / yi dam lha brgya'i zhal mjal ba las bla ma'i zhal ras yud tsam cig mjal ba bsod nams che gsung pa yin pas/ da lo 'u cag thams cad 'dir lan cig 'tshogs pa skal ba bzang sang nyi 561

rgyud man ngag dpang por zhog /rang rgyud dang chos gnyis 'dres par gyis/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /dge 'di yis skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs/ /tshe mi rtag 'chi ba'i tshul bsams nas/ /chos zab mo nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /mchog sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes gsungs nas/spyir chos thams cad mi rtag pa'i tshul dang / sgos su rang la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che ba'i chos rgyal ngag dbang wang yab sras dang / bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sogs zhing khams gzhan du dgongs tshul/ lus srog bskyed pa'i drin can gyi ma rgan mo sogs bzhud tshul rnams gsungs nas spyan chab mang bo bsil zhing / da nga yang lo lon khyed slob ma yon bdag gi nang nas kyang phal che ba 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du bzhud tshar/ da yod pa rnams kyang phal cher gyi tshe phyed ka tshar/ phal cher gyi nyis cha dang sum cha la thug nas nga'i rjes la bsnyegs tshar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal mjal ba las bla ma'i zhal lan cig mjal ba skal ba bzang / yi dam lha brgya'i zhal mjal ba las bla ma'i zhal ras yud tsam cig mjal ba bsod nams che gsung pa yin pas/ da lo 'u cag thams cad 'dir lan cig 'tshogs pa skal ba bzang sang nyi 561

ma re gnyis kyi 'phro nas bzung thag nye ring gang nas 'ong ba thams cad rim pa bzhin rang rang gnas su gyes nas/ mi rtag pa'i tshul ston pa bzhin thams cad 'di'i rang bzhin yin pas/khyed bya btang ri khrod pa'i khur 'dzin pa rnams kyis ri khrod dben pa'i gan sa su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms la dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin e thub ltos/ gzhan dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa dang sngags 'chang 'dus pa rnams kyis rang rang gi khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin srungs/ tshes bcu dang chos thog sngar yod pa nyams su ma 'jugamatshams sgrub la rem/ gzhan grong pa'i skye bo pho mo rnams kyis bco lnga gnam gang tshes brgyad la smyung gnas bsnyen gnas re bsrung rgyu/ sku gsung thugs rten gang yod kyi mdun du spos mar me yon chab re 'bul gang thub gyis/ ngas 'di nas khyed rnams kyis ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ lo rjes ma tshun la bar chad 'dra ma yong na zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la chos 'khor 'di las che ba zla ba gcig lhag tsam la bskor 'dun yod/ de'i skabs khyed rang rnams kyang shog gzhan mjal 'dod pa su yod kyang shog de phan la yang chos 'khor bskor e thub mi shes/ nga yang na so rgas/ mig kyang mi gsal/ tshegs 562

ma re gnyis kyi 'phro nas bzung thag nye ring gang nas 'ong ba thams cad rim pa bzhin rang rang gnas su gyes nas/ mi rtag pa'i tshul ston pa bzhin thams cad 'di'i rang bzhin yin pas/khyed bya btang ri khrod pa'i khur 'dzin pa rnams kyis ri khrod dben pa'i gan sa su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms la dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin e thub ltos/ gzhan dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa dang sngags 'chang 'dus pa rnams kyis rang rang gi khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin srungs/ tshes bcu dang chos thog sngar yod pa nyams su ma 'jugamatshams sgrub la rem/ gzhan grong pa'i skye bo pho mo rnams kyis bco lnga gnam gang tshes brgyad la smyung gnas bsnyen gnas re bsrung rgyu/ sku gsung thugs rten gang yod kyi mdun du spos mar me yon chab re 'bul gang thub gyis/ ngas 'di nas khyed rnams kyis ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ lo rjes ma tshun la bar chad 'dra ma yong na zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la chos 'khor 'di las che ba zla ba gcig lhag tsam la bskor 'dun yod/ de'i skabs khyed rang rnams kyang shog gzhan mjal 'dod pa su yod kyang shog de phan la yang chos 'khor bskor e thub mi shes/ nga yang na so rgas/ mig kyang mi gsal/ tshegs 562

dka'/ rkyen chen po mi thub pas/ ri bo rma rgyal lta bu'i mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul zhig snyog thub na rab/ de ma thub rung 'brong lung bkra shis 'khyil ba sogs nas 'gol bo byas 'chi ba nam 'ong bsgugs nas 'dug snyam pa yod gsungs pa sogs/gsung dogs gzhi can mang du gsungs/ bco lnga la dad can slob bu bskal bzang chos 'phel dang chal le ba gnyis kyis mthun rkyen sbyar te/ khong gis dbu mdzad nas skya ser stong phrag mang pos smyung gnas legs par bsrungs/ rjes nas chos 'khor grol ba dang zho 'ong dpyis la rin po che dpon slob nyis brgya tsam phebs/ de'i lo sde bas mchod rten chen po zhig gsar bzhengs byas pa la rab gnas byin 'bebs gnang / tshogs 'khor dang dga' ston rgyas par byas/ sde bas spyi thog nas ston 'khor yongs rdzogs la ja thug dang / gro nas do bo nyi shu rtsa bdun/ dā bu dkar dmar dong tse sogs 'bul ba zhabs tog bsam las 'das pa byung / de nas skyes lha ja sgon gyi ri ngogs la phug pa rnying ba zhig yod pa/ rdo bzo la las su bcug nas nyid kyi thugs bkod ltar mtshams khang bzhengs/ bya btang ri khrod pa dge slong blo gros lo mang po'i bar du nang der bsdad nas sgrub pa byas pa'i mtshams khang 'gol bo mthong rgya che zhing 563

bsil drod snyoms la/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyis dbe+en pa'i bsngags brjod gnang ba dang mthun pa zhig yod pa der/mchod khang gi nang du o rgyan chen po dang / phyag rdor/ dzam nag gi sku 'dra rnams gsar bzhengs byas yod pa der phebs nas rab gnas dang bsngo smon rgyas par gnang / bka' las/ gnas 'di ni byin chags shing nyams spro la rtsa ba gsum kyi lha tshogs sprin bzhin 'thib pa'i gnas khyad 'phags zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo dngos dang mtshungs pa yin pas/mtshams la 'dug mkhan rnams rgyun ldan du sdod dang ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub/ ma 'ongs pa na gnas 'di sngon bla ma zhabs dkar pa rin po ches byen gyis brlabs pa'i gnas yin zhes mthong thos thams cad kyi dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing / phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing du 'gyur bas/ skor ba dang 'brel thogs thams cad kyi lus kyi na tsha/ sems kyi sdug bsngal/ tshe'i bar chad/ chag che nyam nga thams cad rang zhi la 'gro ba zhig 'ong zhes 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan mang po gsungs/ de nas zho 'ong la ga'i sde ba rnams la rim pa bzhin phebs nas zhag gnyis gsum re bzhugs/ dad can so so'i nang du byon nas 'bul ba dang zhabs tog gang phul bzhes bsngo smon dang phyag 564

nas 'thor bka' bsgo byin rlabs mdzad/ yon bdag pho mo kun la 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya dang / mgur dbyangs sogs zhal gdams mang po rgyas par gnang / de nas lug ra pad dkar chos gling gi dgon pa gsar bzhengs byed pa'i gnas su phebs nas sa 'dul byin rlabs mdzad skabs su/ glo bur du sprin 'thibs nas char gyi rgyun bzang po babs shing /'brug gis sgra dbyangs phyogs kun tu khyab par bsgrags pa sogs ngo mchar ba'i rten 'brel bsam las 'das pa 'grigs/dge 'dun pa dang sngags mang gi 'du khang gi sa gnad sogs phral phugs kyi thugs bked dang / bkra shis byen 'bebs rgyas par gnang / de nas shel dgon du phebs pas/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis bsu ba rgya chen po byas ja thug sogs zhabs tog phul/ drug pa'i smon 'a/ma chen mo nyams yod pa'i don du yon bdag rnams la zhal gsung gnang nas 'dzin du bcug sgrub phug gi ngos nas zhag kha shas bzhugs/ sgrub phug gi sgo'i phyi logs su mtshams khang gsar bzhengs gnang / dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams la mtshams rgyun yod par byas/ de nas zho 'ong 'brog ru brgyud nas mgar rtse dgon par phebs pas/'dus spyi nas mang ja tshab ra sogs rgyas pa byas sne len yag po 565

gnang / grwa shag mang por gdan drangs gsol ja zhus/ 'bul ba ja lan rten bcu tsam/ ras dā bu/ mar dong tse khron brgya lhag tsam bcas phul ba rnams/ 'du khang rnying ba'i shul du/ jo bo'i lha khang gsar bzhengs byed rgyu'i thugs bkod gnang ste/de'i thebs su bzhag nas/ sa las kyi kha 'gor chos srid kun la blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa'i dbon po dkar dris dang /stag yan sogs zhabs phyi pa 'ga' la thugs bkod gnang nas bzhag de nas bkra shis dge 'phel dgon par phebs nas nyi ma bcu lhag tsam bzhugs/ tshe dbang nor dbang sogs rang rang la gang mkho'i re ba bskangs/ sngar nas 'du khang gsar ba bzheng rgyu'i thugs bkod yod kyang btang snyoms su lus pa la/ deng skabs 'du khang gi sa 'dul dgos gsungs nas sa btul/ rab gnas mdzad/ yag po zhig bzheng dgos tshul thugs bkod mkhan rin po che dang / dar grong dge slong /dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams la nan cher gnang ba ni/ phyis su mi 'byon pa'i brdar mngon no/ /rang ngan a bar the bu'i ru sde rnams su phebs pas/ yon bdag rnams nas rta rgod ma/ nor lug ja ras dngul dong tse mar phyur ba sogs 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ bsngo smon rgyas par gnang / de nas rim par zho 566

'ong dbyes brgyud nas phebs lam dus dkar shar gyi dge 'dun pa dad can 'gas thab bsu phul ba bzhes nas/ 'jam la phebs/ sde thog nas ja thug sogs zhabs tog phul zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ dad can rnams kyi nang du phebs nas phyag nas 'thor bsngo smon rgyas par gnang / thams cad kyi gro nas do bo mang po'i 'bul ba byung / lha khang du phebs dbu mdzad bskal bzang skyabs kyi nang du gdan drangs/ nyid rin po che'i sgu 'dra gsar bzhengs byas yod pa la rab gnas mdzad/ zhag kha shas bzhugs/ sde bas spyi thog nas zhabs tog rgyas par phul/ gzhan gdan 'dren zhu mkhan rnams kyi nang du byon nas 'bul ba zhabs tog gang phul bzhes/ ru rtsa'i sngags khang gsar bzhengs byas pa'i nang du phebs nas/ o rgyan rin po che'i gtsos sku gsung thugs rten mang po bzheng rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang / de nas nag rgya dang ser rgya/ phyi skor rnams la phebs nas/ yon bdag dad can rnams kyi nang du phyag nas 'thor bkra shis brjod bzhin byon pas/ kun gyis gro nas sogs dngos 'bul zhabs tog rgya cher phul ba rnams rgyas par bzhes/bsngo smon dang bka' bsgo byen rlabs mdzad/ skyes pho mo thams cad la 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya rgyas par gnang / gong 567

mo'i gur khang gi grub gnas su lha khang mtshams pa dge 'dun nor bus jo bo'i lha khang gsar bzhengs byas pa'i rab gnas su gdan drangs par phebs nas/ thugs dgyes bzhin rab gnas byin 'bebs byas zhal gdams dang bslab bya mang po gnang / zhag gsum tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la gnas la byin 'bebs yang yang byas/ 'bul ba zhabs tog gang phul la bsngo smon rgyas par gnang / yid dga' dgon par phebs dge 'dun pa rnams kyis bsu ba rgya chen po byas/ 'du khang du gdan drangs dpon slob 'khor bcas la zhabs tog yag po bsgrubs/ 'bul ba phul ba'i nang nas phran tshegs tsam ma gtogs phyir gnang / dge 'dun pa yongs la lam rim bsdus don gyi lung dang / 'phral phugs kun gyi bslab ston rgyas par gnang / dgon pa'i phyi nang kun tu bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor zhing bsngo smon gye mtshams sbyor byas/ khyung po dang sdong skam ha ra ba sdir rnams su phebs nas 'gro don mdzad pas khyem tshang phal che ba'i nang du gdan drangs/ gro nas dong tse sogs kyi 'bul ba gang yod bzhes bsngo smon dang lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya 'di phyir phan pa'i zhal gdams mang po gnang bzhin bzhugs yod skabs su/ glo bur du smon lam log pa'i 568

bdud rigs kyis 'tshe ba brtsams pas/ dbon pos mgar rtse'i byams khang gi kha 'go byed du yod dus/ grib rkyen lta bu'i bsnyun gzhi byung ba la dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis rim gro ci mang byas kyang phan pa ma byung bar je thur song bas/sku mdun du gdan 'dren la thon pas skyabs rje nyid kyang glo bur brel stabs su phebs pa'i lam bar nas char ba drag po babs nas phebs tshul ma byung bar zho 'ong dbyes nas zhag bzhugs gnang / phyi nyin snga mo nas phebs te bka' bsgo byin rlabs sogs gnang yang / thabs ma byung bar dus las 'das song ba la thugs 'gyod drag po gnang zhing / mgar rtse bla ma sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa/ dgon khag mang po la mang ja 'gyed spyi 'jog mang po phul nas bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor rnam dag gnang / skabs shig dad gus dag snang che zhing dam pa'i gsung bzhin 'gro la gang phan byed pa'i rtsa dge slong sku mdun du phyin pa na gsung bgros mang po gnang mthar kho bo lo lon red/ tshe nyi ma nam tsha ci yod mi shes/ dbon po bder gshegs da rung lo yang chung /kho rang chos srid gang la blo gros rgyas shing / rang gzhan yongs la phan thogs pa zhig yin/ tshe ring rgyu zhig byung na/ kho bo'i 569

bsam pa la sprul sku 'dra rjes nas mi yong snyam/ 'on kyang med bzhin snang ba'i 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i slad du/ sprul sku re yong na bdag yag po thub snyam pa yod kyang rang gzhan la de'i skal ba ma byung / khyed rnams kyis kyang rjes nas phan gang thogs byed dgos sogs phebs par ba spu zing nge ba zhig byung yang cang zhu ba ni ma spobs snang / de nas 'gro ba sems can gyi bsod nams dman pa dang / nag phyogs bdud rigs rnams kyi re smon 'grub pa dang / tha ma'i mdzad pa ston pa la 'jug par nye ba sogs gang ci'i ngos nas/ lcags khyi'i dgun zla ra ba'i nag phyogs rgyal ba gnyis par sku rlung gi rnam pa lta bus nyin zhag gcig bsnyun tshul bzhes par nye 'khor rnams rtab rtab por gyur te/ phyogs phyogs su rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/reb gong stod smad kyi re ltos can yid blong blong bor gyur cing /reb gong sngags mang dang phyogs phyogs kyi bya btang ri khrod pa rnams kyang 'dus/ bdag kyang lha ri'i mtshams khang du bsnyen mtshams shig la bsdad yod pa har 'don byas brel stabs su song ba la/ gang gi 'phrin las pa mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkra shis dge 'phel na bzhugs pa yang gdan drangs nas phebs te/ sku mdun du bzhugs yod pa la bsnyun gzhi med 570

du dengs na'ang / nye gnas blo bzang shes rab dang / kun dga' don grub/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ phun tshogs dge legs/ gnyer ba rab byung sogs ltos bcas thun mong nas zhabs brtan zhig bsgrubs na/ gang gi sku la bsnyun ye med pa la da lam gyi 'di bdag cag gi ston pa'i dpal gyi mgul las sprid pa byung ba ltar/ som nyi'i gnas so zhes bgros pa na/mkhan rin po che'i zhal nas/ lar chos nyid la dbang ma 'byor ba dag la 'thad mod/ chos nyid la bdag gir spyod pa rnams la de lta ma yin no/ /'on kyang chos can mi bslu ba nyid kyi phyir mi rigs pa'ang ma yin mod/ kho bo cag ni gang gi thugs dgongs la rag las pa ma gtogs/ blo tsab tsub kyi kha na med snyam gsungs pa ni ston 'khor dgongs pa mnyam pa'i mngon rtogs ngom pa nyid do/ /de na'ang rje la zhus nas gang gsungs pa de bsgrub par rigs kyis/ gya tshom du ma yin no phebs pa ltar rje'i snyan du gsol pas/ bka' las/ sngon gyi las la rag gis zhabs brtan gye kha na med do/ /zang zing gi sbyor ba ma bsgrubs shig kho bo la brten bcas pa'i nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba'i mthun rkyen chud ma gzon cig sa ga'i zla ba la chos 'khor skor ba'i mthun rkyen kyang dgos so gsungs te ma gnang 571

bas/ tshur mthong gi blos ma nus pas slar nan gyis gsol pas/bka' las/ ngas khyed rnams la dka' las ma btang bar bsdad na skyon med snyam/ 'on kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med phyir rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa rnams su bsrung bzlog sogs 'phrin las kyi rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i phyir khyod rang rnams kyi 'dod blo dang bstun te/ zhabs brtan gang thub phul dang bsam pa bzhin du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yod gsungs nas bdag gir bzhes pa ltar/ nged dang pad+ma lhun grub rgya mtsho'i gtsos sngags 'chang 'dus pa nyi shu rtsa grangs kyis/ bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgo nas bsregs 'phangs kyi las sbyor rgyas par bgyis/ grub dbang skal ldan rang grol mchog gi yang sprul dang / bde chen gar dbang rdo rje'i sprul sku blo bzang snyan grags sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang rab kyis tshe sgrub tshad ldan/ dgon khag mang po dang ri khrod pa grwa btsun mang po/ gzhan sde ba so so nas tshe mdo dang / yig brgya/ sgol ma/ bsam lhun/ badz+ra gu ru sogs dung phyir mang po bsgrubs/ zab gter mnga' bdag grub dbang nam mkha' mchog nas klong snying bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshe sgrub dang 572

bas/ tshur mthong gi blos ma nus pas slar nan gyis gsol pas/bka' las/ ngas khyed rnams la dka' las ma btang bar bsdad na skyon med snyam/ 'on kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med phyir rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa rnams su bsrung bzlog sogs 'phrin las kyi rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i phyir khyod rang rnams kyi 'dod blo dang bstun te/ zhabs brtan gang thub phul dang bsam pa bzhin du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yod gsungs nas bdag gir bzhes pa ltar/ nged dang pad+ma lhun grub rgya mtsho'i gtsos sngags 'chang 'dus pa nyi shu rtsa grangs kyis/ bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgo nas bsregs 'phangs kyi las sbyor rgyas par bgyis/ grub dbang skal ldan rang grol mchog gi yang sprul dang / bde chen gar dbang rdo rje'i sprul sku blo bzang snyan grags sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang rab kyis tshe sgrub tshad ldan/ dgon khag mang po dang ri khrod pa grwa btsun mang po/ gzhan sde ba so so nas tshe mdo dang / yig brgya/ sgol ma/ bsam lhun/ badz+ra gu ru sogs dung phyir mang po bsgrubs/ zab gter mnga' bdag grub dbang nam mkha' mchog nas klong snying bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshe sgrub dang 572

mkha' 'gro'i bsun bzlog zhi rgyas kyi me mchod sogs nged dbon slob lhan rgyas nas gnad smin bgyis te/ grub dbang mchog gis tshe dpag med kyi sku li ma zhig gi gtsos 'bul ba gya nom pa phul nas brtan bzhugs phul bar/ bka' las/bstan 'gro la sman na tshe ring dgos pa min te/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa dang klong chen rab 'byams sogs dgung lo lnga bcu tsam las ma bzhugs pa'i phyir/ bstan 'gror mi phan na tshe ring ba tsam du zad mod/ 'on kyang zhabs brtan phul ba'i rten 'brel dang / bdag gi lhag bsam gyi bden pas tshe ring po 'ong ba'i 'dun pa byed gsungs/ grub dbang nam mkha' rin po ches nan gyes gsol bas/ brgya dang bcu gcig bar du bzhugs par zhal gyes bzhes pa yin no zhes gsungs mod/ de ni dgongs pa can zhig ste/ de'i phyi dro sku mdun du yod pa 'ga' la skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi cha med tshul sogs gsung zhing lar mngon shes ni med/ sngon gye las dang 'phral rkyen gyis cir 'gyur ni rang la cha med pas/ de ring yang gzhan gyi ngor yun ring 'tsho bar khas blangs kyang / rten 'brel tsam yin gyi nges pa ni cang ma mchis/de bas na de ring 'chi rung 'gyod pa med/ lha chos sgrub pa la 573

'bad dgos gsungs pa ni don la gnas so/ /de yan la yar mar gyi tshes bcu la tshogs 'khor rgyun du gnang yang / tshogs gdan bang rim bzhi'i steng tshogs gtor nor bu'i dbyebs can che ba re re las mi mdzad pa la/ rgyal zla'i tshes bcu nas bzung ste yar mar gyi tshes bcu nam byung la/ zho 'ong dpyis smad pa gling rgya rnams la tshogs 'khor gyi phyir gsol dpon kun dga' nor bu ched mngags byas nas/ rtsam pa 'khur ba sha sogs mang po bsdus nas/ tshogs 'khor stong dang brgya lhag tsam re dus gcig la mdzad pas/ dpyod ldan kun gyis sngar 'di 'dra mi mdzad pa la da lo'i 'di the tshom gyi gnas so/ /zhes pa las cang zhu ma spobs kyang rjes su bsams na zhing 'di'i mdzad pa re zhig bsdu ba'i rtags su mngon no/ /de nas lcags phag gi gnam lo gsar tshes la dga' ston rgyas par btang /drung na gnas pa rnams dang / phyogs phyogs kyi mjal ba skya ser pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba la nyi ma lnga'i ring la tshe dbang chos bshad bsngo smon rgyas par gnang nas/ slar sku mtshams su bzhugs/ zla ba gsum pa'i bcu gsum la thugs sras dgu rong sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol rin po che dpon slob lnga bcu tsam sku mdun du byon/ bco lnga'i nyin dngos skyes gya 574

nom pa'i phyag rten phul zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab dus/ bka' las/ khyod 'ongs pa legs kyis dpon slob lhan cig 'dzom pa'i dus yin no/ /kho bos rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che spyad zin/ da kho bo na so yang smin pas khyod slob ma rnams kyi ring la bab bo/ /kho bo'i rjes su kha mig yar blta gyis la rnam thar skyong gang thub la rem/ kho bo ngal gso ba'i dus la bab bo la sogs pa'i bka' mchid dogs gzhi can mang du phebs kyang cang zhu ba ni ma spobs/ dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i tshogs 'khor phul ba'i mthar/ dgu rong sprul sku dang sangs rgyas rin chen gnyis la sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar ljags rtsom gnang ba mgo thog tu bzhag ste byin rlabs gnang mthar/ khyod gnyis chos 'di'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba yin pas dag po gyis la bris zhib tu ltos la dogs pa 'dra yod na chod dang /rjes nas par la 'phud dgos kyi re zhig gzhan su la yang ma ston cig nyang gi mtshams pa mchog la yang rtsom gzhi dum pa zhig 'bri rgyu yod tshul sogs gsungs pas/ snying mi dga' phyod pa zhig byung yang bya thabs gzhan zad lags/ rnam par thar pa rin po che 'di 'dra stsal pa bka' drin che ste thugs dgongs la ci yod ma 'tshal bas/ snyigs dus kyi bstan 'gro la sman phyir 575

sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan par gsol ba 'debs pa lags zhus pas/ bka' las/ khyod rnam rtog byed mi dgos/ de los yin gzhan gyi 'dod pa skong phyir bris pa yin zhes phebs/ zhor la 'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i 'bel mchid dang / rnam thar 'phro mthud dgos tshul sogs rgyas par gsungs/ skabs shig gnyer ba rab byung gcig pu la yang 'di phyi kun la phan pa'i zhal gdams/ bkra shis 'khyil ba dang / dge 'phel/ 'brong lung dgon pa sogs kyi do dam byed tshul/ gsung 'bum par du ma 'khod pa rnams kyang slob ma yon bdag rnams la bskul nas par la 'phud dgos tshul sogs gsungs nas/ kho bo 'gro don la phyogs gzhan du 'gro ba'am/ ma song yang mtshams 'dra byas bsdad na/ khyod rang rnams kyis zhabs phyi sngar ltar le lor ma song ba byas bsgrub dgos/ khyad par da lo zla ba bzhi ba'i bka' chos 'di zla chos long dgos rten 'brel gyi gnad cig yod/ mthun rkyen 'tsho chas la bsnon pa gang dgos yon bdag phyug po tsho la bshad nas btsal dgos tshul sogs nan cher gsungs/ de nas dbo zla'i dmar phyogs la zhabs brtan du dmigs nas grub dbang nam mkha' rgya mtsho mchog gis dbu mdzad nas/ nged dpon slob bco lnga tsam gyis bka' brgyad 576

dpal chen 'dus pa'i bzlog sgrub nyi ma dgu tsam gyi sgo nas/bsreg 'phangs kyi las sbyor gnad smin bgyis kyang 'gro ba'i bsod nams dman pa dang / dam pa'i tha ma'i mdzad pa la ring min 'jug pa'i rtags su gtor bkra sogs la gnas skabs las yun ring 'tsho ba'i ngo ma shar/ de skabs rgya nag rgyal po'i dbu bla lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang sprul gyi zhabs brtan gye ched du gos chen rgyan bzhi ma gcig dang /dngul srang sum cu rtsa grangs wa nag gri me cha sogs dang / zhu yig bcas phul nas/ sprul sku'i zhabs brtan du tshe sgrub srung bzlog gi 'phrin las gang 'os thugs nyams su bzhes dgos tshul zhus pa ltar/ nged dpon slob bcu tsam la zhabs brtan bsgrub pa'i bka' phebs pas/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bzlog bsgrub sbyin bsreg tshad ldan dang / nyid nas tshe sgrub gnad smin gnang bas sngar las sku khams dwangs shing mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa byung / de nas hor lugs kyi sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig nas dbu btsugs te/ chos kyi 'khor lo nyin mtshan bar ma chad du zla ba gcig gi bar la bskor ba'i mdzad pa brtsams/ tshes gcig gi nyin gang gi 'phrin las pa kun dga' don grub kyis zhabs brtan du dmigs nas/ tshe mdo gser 577

gyes gsar bskrun byas pa'i gtsos dngos 'bul rgya chen dang /grwa slob thun mong nas kyang ci yod pa'i dngos 'bul bcas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par zhal bzang lta bu'i zhal len las ma gnang / de nas bzung nyi ma re re zhing snga dro'i cha la 'dod lha sna tshogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang rigs gtad sogs gnang nas/ phyi dro'i cha la lung khrid zab rgyas sna tshogs stsal cing / tshes bdun gyi snga dro'i cha la sman bla mched brgyad kyi rjes gnang grub rjes bka' las/ de ring phyi dro'i cha la kha brda 'dra byed/ khyed rnams kyis gung tshigs dal mo gyis la shog de ring bka' chos gnang rgyu min zhes phebs/ de nas slar 'dus pa na rje nyid dus dang rnam pa kun tu thugs 'jam zhing bka' bkyon drag po byed pa ye mi srid mod/ de'i nyin cung zad thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa dang bcas khyed slob ma yon mchod su thad nas kyang / kho bos bshad pa la nyan pa nyin skar las dkon zhing / ngas ma byed byas pa de lhag par byed cing / 'di dang 'di 'dra ba gyis zhes kha lce lbu ba 'khrigs rag bar du bshad/ yi ger bris par yan chad du phud nas phan re e thogs snyam pa yin pas/ khyed rnams su yin kyang yar bskyed las mar bskyed thon pa mang zhing nga la phyin ci byed pa lta bur 578

'dug da yun ring bsdad de lo re bzhin du chos bshad/ rgyu mtshan sogs ji tsam smras kyang rang la dka' las gtong ba las phan bskyed ni ma mchis/ gang ltar kyang rang gis nyan mi nyan gang yin rung kha khral phud tshar ni yin/ deng phyin chad 'di ltar 'tshogs rgyu e yong mi shes/ 'jig rten kha gtam la/yang yang khrom pa sgang la mi 'tshogs/ yang yang gyi ling la sga mi bstod zer ba ltar mi dga' ba 'tshogs pa da lan tsam yin/kho bo lo na tshod kyis gtugs/ lo lnga bcu lon na tshe med/ bya pho 'go ma grag na nam med zer ba ltar/ lnga bcu ma zad bdun cu don gcig tu son/ khyed rnams phal cher kyang nga'i rjes su bsnyegs/ gzhon pa rnams kyang 'dzam gling mi'i tshe la nges pa med pas/ de ring yang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng su la yang med pas de ring 'chi rung / chos pa rab 'chi ba la brod/ 'bring mi 'tsher/ tha ma mi 'gyod zer bas na/ tha ma mi 'gyod pa zhig cis kyang dgos mod de/ khyed rnams kyis spyod tshul 'di la bltas na/ mi 'gyod pa zhig kyang dka' tshod na gda'/ da ban rgan nga bla ma zhig gi rtsis/ khyed slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis byed na/ khyed bla ma sku skyes ri khrod pa rnams kyis bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar ltar na bun gos su gyon/ brag phug zhwa ltar 579

bsten/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur/ chos kyi bar gcod chos brgyad la rdog badzis thongs/ nyon mongs la 'bur 'joms gyis la da res kyi mi tshe dam pa'i chos kyi sgo nas dal 'byor la snying po len ci thub gyis/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa ngas bstan pa rnams kyi nang nas rang nyid gang mos de nyams su longs/ gzhan chos lugs grub mtha' yongs la dag snang sbyongs la khas ma gtong / nyams len byas pa'i lag rjes la chos pa rab la nyin bskyed/ 'bring la zla bskyed/tha ma lo bskyed thon dgos pa yin/ nyon mongs dang chags zhen je chung / nges 'byung dang byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la goms 'dris je cher song nas/sngar shes rgyud g.yag rwa las gyong ba rnams kyang phyis ras bal las 'jam pa zhig yong dgos pa yin/ de'i steng du bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la brtse gdung / chos lugs grub mtha' yongs la dag snang / nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba la snying rje phyogs med du 'byongs pa zhig dgos/ de lta bu'i gang zag de lha mi su yis mthong yang smon pa'i gnas yin te/ khyed mchog dman su yin kyang bde ba mi 'dod pa ni gcig kyang med bde zhing skyid par 'dod na/ de bsgrub pa'i thabs su zhig gis mi 580

byed snyam du/ nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu dam pa'i chos kyis dus 'da' ba zhig gyes/ gcig la bshad pas kun gyis go ba gcig dgos pas/ khyed grwa sa sgrub sde'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis grwa sa'i 'grig lam kun spyod rnams yar ldan ngos/ lam bslab pa gsum gye nyams len/ lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan rnams khral chos su ma song bar nam bzhag gtan gye so nam du 'gro ba zhig gyis/ sngags pa rnams kyis lo mtshams zla mtshams byed mi thub kyang / nyi ma bdun re la mtshams khang nas rang rgyud la rtog la/ ngas kyang de lta bu ma byung yang de'i cha 'dra re e 'ong snyam pa gyis la ci nus kyis dge sbyor la brtson/don med pa'i mthu gtad ngan sngags ma byed/ gsad gsos kyi nus pa med par mngon spyod kyi las brtsams na dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu de'i che zhig gzhan na med/ lar las chen bcu gnyis kyis mtshon zhi drag gi las rab 'byams rnams rgyal ba thabs mkhas shing thugs rje mnga' ba des gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la ma rmongs shing / gdul bya'i bsam pa mkhyen pas bstan 'gro'i bde thabs la dgongs nas bstan pa yin/ rang cag so skye rnams kyis ci thod thod du bya bar ma gsungs/ deng sang las rung gi bsnyen nga tsam yang ma song ba'i gang zag gis 581

mthu gtad ngan sngags byed pa 'di me phar bus na sma ra tshur 'tshig pa'i dper 'dug gshis/ chos chen po ma nus kyang dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang po'i sgos/ tshes bcu dang chos thog gang yod ma chag pa gyis/ bca' yig gi nang ltar 'grig lam gang zhib zhib gyis/ yon bdag rnams kyis rkus dang jag ma byed/don med pa'i kha mchu'i kha 'go ma byed/ sde ba tsho ba'i skyid sdug gi dus su phan thogs bsam pa bzang po gyis/ chos ma nus rung don med pa'i sems can gyi srog ma gcod/ nang mi bran dang sgo khyi phyugs la byams skyong gyis/ sgor 'ong ba'i sprang po la zan chang re las med kyang byen dang zhar dang zhor gyi chos yin/ khom dus phyag skor kha ton gang shes gyis/ dus rgyun du ma ṇi bgrongs nya stong brgyad gsum la sgyung gnas dang bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa srungs/ de ltar byas na/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi chos lugs la/ /brten na thar pa gam na gda'/ /gsungs pa de 'ong ba yin/ chos dang 'jig rten gang byed kyang sngon du bsam blo yag po thongs la zhugs/ 'jig rten pa'i kha dpe la/ mi la rtog dpyod med na dud 'gro yin/ rta la gom 'gros med na bong bu yin zer ba ltar/ rtog dpyod med pa'i 582

mi la mtshang de las che ba med/ mdor na mang du smos ci dgos/rgyal ba gong ma'i gshegs shul mi zin rung / nga'i rjes su kha mig yar blta gyes la/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub gong ma'i rnam thar gsung sgos rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsung rnams dpang por zhog la/ rang zhe rang gis mi khrel ba re mdzod/ ban rgan ngas chos ldan gyi bya ba ci nus bgyis tshar/ da mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul zhig nas 'chi ba bsgug 'dod yod kyang / snying rje phrag phrug res yid bskyod nas bsam thog tu mi khel ba 'dra yang / da sgyu lus gog po 'di la bed bcad tshar/ 'ga' res kha rgyag la/ la kha'i shi na bya ro/ chu kha'i shi na nya ro zer ba ltar/ rang snang dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa la mnar med dmyal ba dang / dag pa'i zhing la khyad med pas 'chi sa la gdam nga med/ rang gi dge rtsa rang gis bcas tshar bas dgongs rdzogs mi dgos/ sngar rnam thar dang glegs bam rnams su lan cig ma yin par yang yang bshad pas/ de'i lhag kha chems 'jog rgyu med/ spong len gyi chos can chos nyid du sangs pas/ sprul sku'i re ba yang med/gdul bya'i mos pa la rag las/ kho bo'i yongs 'dzin a rig dge bshes rin po che'i rnam par thar pa de bzhin byas pa yin 583

la sogs pa'i zhing khams gzhan du dgongs pa yol ba'i gsung nyin thog thag gsungs pas/ thams cad kyi yid blong blong bor gyur kyang thabs gzhan ni ma rnyed de/ tshes bcu gcig gi nyin dgu rong sprul sku rin po ches gtsor mdzad/ bla ma dge bshes sku skyes mang po dang / sngags mang grwa slob spyi nas ci yod kyi nor rdzas mang po phul nas/ zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan du btab kyang / bka' las/ kho bo bsdad na los 'dod shi nas khyed rnams sems sdug mya ngan gyis non du 'jug bsam pa med mod/ yun ring sdod pa'i khas len byas kyang rten 'brel yin/ rang la mngon shes med cing sngon las kyis cir 'gyur mi shes pas dka' mo zhig 'dug 'on kyang khyod rang rnams kyi dad mos bzhin re zhig bar du 'dug pa'i 'dun pa byed/bsdad kyang phan thogs pa dka'/ gser khang rdo rje 'chang yab sras sogs byang chub sems dpa' mang po zhing khams gzhan la phebs tshul bsam na/ sems kyang dbang med du skyo tshul sogs thugs skyo ba'i zhal gsung mang du gnang zhing spyan chab bsil bas/ tshogs pa stong phrag mang po 'tshogs pa rnams kyang mchi ma'i nye rag byed par thug go /sngar gter ston rig 'dzin chen po bde rgyal chen po'i gter chos rnams bka' dam po 584

gnang nas ci thod thod du mi spel ba la/ 'di'i skabs dbang lung yongs rdzogs dang / bka' srung so so'i srog gtad bcas lhag med du gnang / gzhan thun mong du zhal gdams 'di rnams kyang gnang byung /slob bu tshe blos btang ba'i ri khrod pa rnams kyis nyams su blang bya'i chos ni/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi snying khu byang chub lam rim dang blo sbyong /tshegs chung don che ba'i sngags bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs/ khyad par rdzogs rim gyi mthar thug 'od gsal phyag rdzogs do ha sogs nyams su longs/ de kun kyang mdo tril gyis dril nas nyams su len pa'i snying po ni/ sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rang sems gdod ma gshis kyi gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bur rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su btang lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pas/ dper na rong khung dog sa nas la kha mthon por bud pa dang / ri mthon po'i rtse nas gnam kha zheng che sar bltas pa ltar/ gu yangs la blo bde ba/ zang thal la phyam brdal ba/sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba chos sku 'gyur ba med 585

pa'i rang ngo shes par gyis la ngang dwangs 'dzin med rgya 'byams ye grol chen por nyams su longs shig dang / rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam yong / thun mtshams rnams su/ bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam thar gsung 'bum rnams la ltos dang / rang gi nyams su blang bya'i chos rnams la yid ches nges shes 'drongs par 'gyur/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje chen po'i sgo nas sgyu ma rmi lam ltar gang la yang mi chags par dngos po rnams sbyin par btang nas 'gro don byas na/ tshe 'dir rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par 'gyur bas kun gyi sems la zhog gzhan yang nyams len phun sum tshogs pa zhig byed na/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams shes dgos/ de la chos gang nyams su len kyang / sbyor ba gnas khang bye dor bya zhing sku gsung thugs rten bkram pa sogs sbyor ba'i chos drug sngon du btang / dngos gzhi mdo sngags kyi chos kyi snying khu lam rim blo sbyong bskyed rdzogs/rdzogs chen sogs nyams su longs/ rjes su bsngo ba smon lam rgya chen po bya/ thun mtshams rnams su phyag mchod skor ba sogs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong bya/de'i tshul rgyas par gdams ngag gser gyi ri bo sogs sbyor ba'i chos drug rnams las shes par gyis/586

yang me tog nang nas pad+ma dkar po lta bur bsngags pa'i dam ldan rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams la gdams pa/ sngon byung rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil/ chos kyi rtsa ba rig pa 'dzin tshul ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ni sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ snang stong rig pa'i rang rtsal du go zhing / rig pa'i ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs nam mkha' ltar rtogs pa'i ngang la shes pa lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ gsal ba dwangs pa yangs pa che ba/ gza' gtad dang bral ba/ bar snang dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu'i nyams shig 'char ba 'byung / de dus bying rgod byung yang sngar rgyun ltar bzhag pas rang sar grol bar 'gyur bas/des na rig pa'i ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med bar snang dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu 'di gcig pu ngo shes pas/ nyon mongs pa kun rgya grol la 'gro ba'i gnad kyi gdams pa 'di yin te/snying thig las/ dri med dag pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rang rig chos skur 'gyur ba med/ /gsal le seng nge wal le ba/ /sprin med ston ga'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa ri bo bzhin du zhog /mi g.yo dwangs pa rgya mtsho bzhin du zhog /yangs dog bral ba nam mkha' bzhin du zhog /gang ltar gnas 587

yang me tog nang nas pad+ma dkar po lta bur bsngags pa'i dam ldan rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams la gdams pa/ sngon byung rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil/ chos kyi rtsa ba rig pa 'dzin tshul ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ni sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ snang stong rig pa'i rang rtsal du go zhing / rig pa'i ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs nam mkha' ltar rtogs pa'i ngang la shes pa lhod kyis glod nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ gsal ba dwangs pa yangs pa che ba/ gza' gtad dang bral ba/ bar snang dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu'i nyams shig 'char ba 'byung / de dus bying rgod byung yang sngar rgyun ltar bzhag pas rang sar grol bar 'gyur bas/des na rig pa'i ngo bo stong gsal 'dzin med bar snang dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu 'di gcig pu ngo shes pas/ nyon mongs pa kun rgya grol la 'gro ba'i gnad kyi gdams pa 'di yin te/snying thig las/ dri med dag pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rang rig chos skur 'gyur ba med/ /gsal le seng nge wal le ba/ /sprin med ston ga'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa ri bo bzhin du zhog /mi g.yo dwangs pa rgya mtsho bzhin du zhog /yangs dog bral ba nam mkha' bzhin du zhog /gang ltar gnas 587

kyang rig pa'i ngang yin zhog /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i mdangs yin zhog /'phro gnas rang rig dwangs sangs phyes la zhog /ji ltar bya rnams gang du 'phur na yang / /mkha' las ma 'das de bzhin rig pa'i ngang / /chos rnams rang gsal yo ba med par zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar rig pa 'dzin shes na/rig 'dzin rnam bzhi dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur ro gsungs/gzhan bu slob rang rang dang 'dus pa spyi la 'di phyir phan pa'i zhal gdams mang du stsal/ de nas bcu gsum gye nyin gsol tshigs kyi dus sku mdun du mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / kun dga' don grub gnyis la mgar rtse'i byams khang gsar bskrun gyi nang rten 'di ltar bzheng dgos kyi zhal bkod zhib rgyas stsal/ bco lnga la skya ser pho mo stong phrag mang pos sgyung gnas bsrung ba'i yon bdag rin chen rgyal ma bu gnyis kyis byas/ gzhan stod smad bar gsum gye zhal 'debs byed mkhan mang du byung / de nas rim gyis zla chos tshar ba dang gzhan bya thabs ma rnyed par bkra shis 'khyil bar bzhugs par gsol ba nan gyis btab kyang / dus dang rnam pa kun tu gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la 'grus pas/ gtang bya'i dngos po rnams tshong dpon du skyes pa'i rabs ltar gyur kyang goms pa brtan 588

kyang rig pa'i ngang yin zhog /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i mdangs yin zhog /'phro gnas rang rig dwangs sangs phyes la zhog /ji ltar bya rnams gang du 'phur na yang / /mkha' las ma 'das de bzhin rig pa'i ngang / /chos rnams rang gsal yo ba med par zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar rig pa 'dzin shes na/rig 'dzin rnam bzhi dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur ro gsungs/gzhan bu slob rang rang dang 'dus pa spyi la 'di phyir phan pa'i zhal gdams mang du stsal/ de nas bcu gsum gye nyin gsol tshigs kyi dus sku mdun du mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / kun dga' don grub gnyis la mgar rtse'i byams khang gsar bskrun gyi nang rten 'di ltar bzheng dgos kyi zhal bkod zhib rgyas stsal/ bco lnga la skya ser pho mo stong phrag mang pos sgyung gnas bsrung ba'i yon bdag rin chen rgyal ma bu gnyis kyis byas/ gzhan stod smad bar gsum gye zhal 'debs byed mkhan mang du byung / de nas rim gyis zla chos tshar ba dang gzhan bya thabs ma rnyed par bkra shis 'khyil bar bzhugs par gsol ba nan gyis btab kyang / dus dang rnam pa kun tu gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la 'grus pas/ gtang bya'i dngos po rnams tshong dpon du skyes pa'i rabs ltar gyur kyang goms pa brtan 588

pa ni/ skyes rabs las/ sbyin par 'dod pa'i dge ba rnams/ /snying rje goms pa las skyes pas/ /sdug bsngal srog la bab na yang / /dman zhing zhum pa yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar 'phongs pa'i skye bo ches mang ba'i stabs kyis de dag la phan pa stsol ba dang / las smon log pa'i skye bo'i chags sdang gi byed pas 'thab rtsod kyis 'gro ba bsod nams dman pa phal mo che'i srog la rgol ba de rnams 'dum pa'i ched dang / tha ma'i gdul byar gyur pa rnams 'dul bar dgongs te ma gnang bar ljongs rgyu ba la phyogs par gyur to//smras pa/ thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po dang / /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /'chi med rig 'dzin sprul sku pad+ma 'byung / /rnam gsum dbyer med drin can bla mar 'dud/ /bdag sogs skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /las ldan dad can yon bdag pho mo sogs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad thams cad la/ /rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang / /ngur sprig gar gyi rnam rol skyabs mgon rje/ /mtshan snyan zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen zhes/ /lha mi'i ston mchog snyigs ma'i dus 'dir byon/ /mgon de'i gsang gsum yon tan rmad po che/ /bdag 'dra'i lta 589

pa ni/ skyes rabs las/ sbyin par 'dod pa'i dge ba rnams/ /snying rje goms pa las skyes pas/ /sdug bsngal srog la bab na yang / /dman zhing zhum pa yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar 'phongs pa'i skye bo ches mang ba'i stabs kyis de dag la phan pa stsol ba dang / las smon log pa'i skye bo'i chags sdang gi byed pas 'thab rtsod kyis 'gro ba bsod nams dman pa phal mo che'i srog la rgol ba de rnams 'dum pa'i ched dang / tha ma'i gdul byar gyur pa rnams 'dul bar dgongs te ma gnang bar ljongs rgyu ba la phyogs par gyur to//smras pa/ thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po dang / /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /'chi med rig 'dzin sprul sku pad+ma 'byung / /rnam gsum dbyer med drin can bla mar 'dud/ /bdag sogs skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /las ldan dad can yon bdag pho mo sogs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad thams cad la/ /rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang / /ngur sprig gar gyi rnam rol skyabs mgon rje/ /mtshan snyan zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen zhes/ /lha mi'i ston mchog snyigs ma'i dus 'dir byon/ /mgon de'i gsang gsum yon tan rmad po che/ /bdag 'dra'i lta 589

zhog sar gnas sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje gsung la mnga' dbang bsgyur rnams kyis/ /bskal par brjod kyang bsdu bya'i yul las 'das/ /'on kyang dam pa'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shing / /bdag cag rjes 'jug tshogs gnyis spel ba dang / /ma 'ongs las ldan dad gus 'byung ba'i phyir/ /rnam thar mdor bsdus tsam gyis thogs drangs nas/ /zhing khams gzhan du gzigs pa yol ba'i tshul/ /tha ma'i rnam thar yi ge'i ris su bkod/ /dam pa mchog nyid chung ngu'i dus nas bzung / /chags sdang kun bral dman la lhag par brtse/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /mdo sngags gzhung la thos bsam byas tshul sogs/ /bka' yi glegs bu gnyis su gsal ba ltar/ /skabs 'gar las can dag pa'i snang ngo ru/ /sku las 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang chen rta phag sogs/ /grangs med lha yi 'khor lor gsal byas nas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi bskur ba sogs/ /rang rang gdul bya'i mos ngor gang 'tsham bstan/ /tha ma'i rnam thar skyong la nye ba'i tshe/ /bka' chos zhu zhing mjal 'dod yod pa rnams/ /sa ga'i tshes la shog ces bka' 'phrin bsgrags/ /chos khri'i rtsig ngos thub dbang spyan ras gzigs/ /sgrol ma la sogs ldebs bris sna 590

zhog sar gnas sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje gsung la mnga' dbang bsgyur rnams kyis/ /bskal par brjod kyang bsdu bya'i yul las 'das/ /'on kyang dam pa'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shing / /bdag cag rjes 'jug tshogs gnyis spel ba dang / /ma 'ongs las ldan dad gus 'byung ba'i phyir/ /rnam thar mdor bsdus tsam gyis thogs drangs nas/ /zhing khams gzhan du gzigs pa yol ba'i tshul/ /tha ma'i rnam thar yi ge'i ris su bkod/ /dam pa mchog nyid chung ngu'i dus nas bzung / /chags sdang kun bral dman la lhag par brtse/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ /mdo sngags gzhung la thos bsam byas tshul sogs/ /bka' yi glegs bu gnyis su gsal ba ltar/ /skabs 'gar las can dag pa'i snang ngo ru/ /sku las 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang chen rta phag sogs/ /grangs med lha yi 'khor lor gsal byas nas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi bskur ba sogs/ /rang rang gdul bya'i mos ngor gang 'tsham bstan/ /tha ma'i rnam thar skyong la nye ba'i tshe/ /bka' chos zhu zhing mjal 'dod yod pa rnams/ /sa ga'i tshes la shog ces bka' 'phrin bsgrags/ /chos khri'i rtsig ngos thub dbang spyan ras gzigs/ /sgrol ma la sogs ldebs bris sna 590

tshogs bkod/ /gsar bzhengs gnang zhing khang chung sum cu skor/ /'tshogs pa mang tshe dgos gsungs legs par bzos/ /sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bzung ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor/ /bco lngar dad can slob bus yon sbyar nas/ /sgyung gnas stong phrag mang po bsrung thub byung / /de nas rim bzhin zho 'ong dpyis brgyud nas/ /ja sgon grub khang shel dgon grub gnas dang / /lug ra dgon gsar gnas la byen rlabs gnang / /sku sung thugs rten kun la rab gnas 'thob/ /de nas rim bzhin mgar rtse dge 'phel dgon/ /rang ngan a bar the'u kun la phebs/ /thugs bkod zhal gdams bsngo smon shis pa brjod/ /gong mo'i gur khang yid dga' dgon pa sogs/ /phebs shing bsngo smon chos kyi 'brel ba gnang / /grong sde rnams su 'gro don gnang skabs su/ /glo bur nag phyogs 'byung pos 'tshe ba las/ /dbon po dus 'das skyo ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /sku mtshams dam por bsdams nas bzhugs skabs su/ /phag zla'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin/ /sku rlung bzhes nas zhag gcig bsnyun tshul bstan/ /rig 'dzin chen po mtha' bral rdo rje sogs/ /bla slob dang ldan yon bdag thabs cad kyis/ /tshe sgrub zhabs brtan brtan 591

tshogs bkod/ /gsar bzhengs gnang zhing khang chung sum cu skor/ /'tshogs pa mang tshe dgos gsungs legs par bzos/ /sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bzung ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor/ /bco lngar dad can slob bus yon sbyar nas/ /sgyung gnas stong phrag mang po bsrung thub byung / /de nas rim bzhin zho 'ong dpyis brgyud nas/ /ja sgon grub khang shel dgon grub gnas dang / /lug ra dgon gsar gnas la byen rlabs gnang / /sku sung thugs rten kun la rab gnas 'thob/ /de nas rim bzhin mgar rtse dge 'phel dgon/ /rang ngan a bar the'u kun la phebs/ /thugs bkod zhal gdams bsngo smon shis pa brjod/ /gong mo'i gur khang yid dga' dgon pa sogs/ /phebs shing bsngo smon chos kyi 'brel ba gnang / /grong sde rnams su 'gro don gnang skabs su/ /glo bur nag phyogs 'byung pos 'tshe ba las/ /dbon po dus 'das skyo ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /sku mtshams dam por bsdams nas bzhugs skabs su/ /phag zla'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin/ /sku rlung bzhes nas zhag gcig bsnyun tshul bstan/ /rig 'dzin chen po mtha' bral rdo rje sogs/ /bla slob dang ldan yon bdag thabs cad kyis/ /tshe sgrub zhabs brtan brtan 591

bzhugs gang mang bsgrubs/ /gsol ba btab pas zhal len gnang tsam byung / /de nas bzung ste dad can thams cad la/ /'di phyir phan pa'i bslab ston rgyas pa dang / /chos rnams mi rtag ston tshul la sogs pa/ /yid mi ches pa'i zhal gsung mang po gnang / /sku tshe smad kyi rnam par thar pa sogs/ /gsung rtsom kun gyi mjug bsdus bsngo smon gnang / /lcags phag lo yi sa ga zla ba la/ /dad can skya ser pho mo thams cad la/ /dbang lung rjes gnang zab khrid man ngag bcas/ /bka' rgya bkrol zhing lhag lus med par gnang / /slob ma yon bdag grwa btsun thams cad la/ /rang rang blo dang bstun te zhal gdams byin/ /bco lnga'i nyin par dad can yon bdag gis/ /mthun rkyen sbyar te dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis/ /smyung gnas bsrungs pas stong phrag mang po byung / /de nas 'phongs pa'i skye bo 'dul phyir dang / /chags sdang dbang gis 'khrug pa 'dum ched dang / /tha ma'i gdul byar gyur rnams 'dul bar phyogs/ /bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang bshol thabs bral/ /snon zla'i tshes nas bzung ste 'byon par chas/ /phyi nang kun tu rab gnas me tog 'thor/ /grwa btsun rnams la spyi sgos zhal gdams gnang / /grong dgon kun tu 'gro ba'i don la byon/ /592

bzhugs gang mang bsgrubs/ /gsol ba btab pas zhal len gnang tsam byung / /de nas bzung ste dad can thams cad la/ /'di phyir phan pa'i bslab ston rgyas pa dang / /chos rnams mi rtag ston tshul la sogs pa/ /yid mi ches pa'i zhal gsung mang po gnang / /sku tshe smad kyi rnam par thar pa sogs/ /gsung rtsom kun gyi mjug bsdus bsngo smon gnang / /lcags phag lo yi sa ga zla ba la/ /dad can skya ser pho mo thams cad la/ /dbang lung rjes gnang zab khrid man ngag bcas/ /bka' rgya bkrol zhing lhag lus med par gnang / /slob ma yon bdag grwa btsun thams cad la/ /rang rang blo dang bstun te zhal gdams byin/ /bco lnga'i nyin par dad can yon bdag gis/ /mthun rkyen sbyar te dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis/ /smyung gnas bsrungs pas stong phrag mang po byung / /de nas 'phongs pa'i skye bo 'dul phyir dang / /chags sdang dbang gis 'khrug pa 'dum ched dang / /tha ma'i gdul byar gyur rnams 'dul bar phyogs/ /bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang bshol thabs bral/ /snon zla'i tshes nas bzung ste 'byon par chas/ /phyi nang kun tu rab gnas me tog 'thor/ /grwa btsun rnams la spyi sgos zhal gdams gnang / /grong dgon kun tu 'gro ba'i don la byon/ /592

rje btsun bla ma'i rnam thar tha ma ru/ /zhugs pa'i tshul gyi brjod pa de ltar lags/ /'das dang da lta bzhugs dang ma 'ongs par/ /'byon pa'i chos mdzad skye bo pho mo rnams/ /tshul 'dir rjes su yi rang bsgom byas la/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub la myur brtson cig /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas snron zla'i yar tshes la bkra shis 'khyil ba'i 'du khang dang / byams khang gzim chung bkra shis 'byung gnas rnams su phebs nas me tog 'thor zhing byin 'bebs bkra shis rgyas par gnang / grwa shag 'ga' la zhus par phebs nas dgyes bzhin bsnyen bkur phul ba bzhes nas bsngo smon dang bkra shis mdzad/ sang tshes gsum nas sgu tshe smad kyi rnam thar par la 'phud pa'i mgo 'dzugs dgos tshul/ de'i dga' ston gyi yo byad gra bsgrig dgos tshul sogs kyi thugs bkod gnyer ba rab byung la gnang / ri rtse dang nags gseb rnams su thugs spro spro ltar khams bsang la gshegs shing 'di phyir dge ba la zhal gsung mang du stsal/ /tshes gsum gye snga mo gsol ja dang bzhes pa gnang 'phro bzhag ste gsol dpon la lam du khyer nas bzhes dgos gsungs nas tshoms khang du phebs te/ par rkon rnams la ston mo drangs/ par rkon dang nang 'khor grwa gnyer ba 593

rje btsun bla ma'i rnam thar tha ma ru/ /zhugs pa'i tshul gyi brjod pa de ltar lags/ /'das dang da lta bzhugs dang ma 'ongs par/ /'byon pa'i chos mdzad skye bo pho mo rnams/ /tshul 'dir rjes su yi rang bsgom byas la/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub la myur brtson cig /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas snron zla'i yar tshes la bkra shis 'khyil ba'i 'du khang dang / byams khang gzim chung bkra shis 'byung gnas rnams su phebs nas me tog 'thor zhing byin 'bebs bkra shis rgyas par gnang / grwa shag 'ga' la zhus par phebs nas dgyes bzhin bsnyen bkur phul ba bzhes nas bsngo smon dang bkra shis mdzad/ sang tshes gsum nas sgu tshe smad kyi rnam thar par la 'phud pa'i mgo 'dzugs dgos tshul/ de'i dga' ston gyi yo byad gra bsgrig dgos tshul sogs kyi thugs bkod gnyer ba rab byung la gnang / ri rtse dang nags gseb rnams su thugs spro spro ltar khams bsang la gshegs shing 'di phyir dge ba la zhal gsung mang du stsal/ /tshes gsum gye snga mo gsol ja dang bzhes pa gnang 'phro bzhag ste gsol dpon la lam du khyer nas bzhes dgos gsungs nas tshoms khang du phebs te/ par rkon rnams la ston mo drangs/ par rkon dang nang 'khor grwa gnyer ba 593

sogs la gang ci'i zhal bkod legs par gnang zhing / 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad 'o skol dpon slob so sor gyes pa 'di'i rang bzhin yin pas/ bla ma'i ci gsung gi bka' sgrub cing gang nus kyi dge sbyor dang bstun la rang rang la gnyer du gtad pa'i las don rnams tshags su chud nges re mdzod/ ngas khyed rnams tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i bsngo smon yang dag bya/ nga da lo bsdad na 'dod kyang nam tsha ngan pa'i stabs kyis sprang po 'di rnams kyang mi sos par 'dug pas/ re zhig yon bdag rnams chos la bskul ba dang / ngan slong 'di rnams lto gos kyis mi phongs pa dang / reb gong gi gyod ngan mang po 'di'i kha re bsum thabs re e thub bltas 'ong gi gsungs spyan chab mang po g.yo bar mdzad pa ni/ phyir phebs mi thub pa'i snga ltas su 'dug de nas mar la brag rgya sgo zer bar phebs nas bzhugs te gsol ja dang bzhes pa'i 'phro yod pa bzhes/ der 'tshogs pa rnams la gsol ras gang yod gnang / slar yang zhal gdams dang bsngo smon rgyas par stsal/bzhugs gdan sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa zhig yod pa la gzigs nas 'di 'khyer mi dgos/ phyir khyer la gdan sar 594

sogs la gang ci'i zhal bkod legs par gnang zhing / 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad 'o skol dpon slob so sor gyes pa 'di'i rang bzhin yin pas/ bla ma'i ci gsung gi bka' sgrub cing gang nus kyi dge sbyor dang bstun la rang rang la gnyer du gtad pa'i las don rnams tshags su chud nges re mdzod/ ngas khyed rnams tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid la nam phugs dag pa'i zhing nas mjal te sangs kyang mnyam por rgya ba'i bsngo smon yang dag bya/ nga da lo bsdad na 'dod kyang nam tsha ngan pa'i stabs kyis sprang po 'di rnams kyang mi sos par 'dug pas/ re zhig yon bdag rnams chos la bskul ba dang / ngan slong 'di rnams lto gos kyis mi phongs pa dang / reb gong gi gyod ngan mang po 'di'i kha re bsum thabs re e thub bltas 'ong gi gsungs spyan chab mang po g.yo bar mdzad pa ni/ phyir phebs mi thub pa'i snga ltas su 'dug de nas mar la brag rgya sgo zer bar phebs nas bzhugs te gsol ja dang bzhes pa'i 'phro yod pa bzhes/ der 'tshogs pa rnams la gsol ras gang yod gnang / slar yang zhal gdams dang bsngo smon rgyas par stsal/bzhugs gdan sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa zhig yod pa la gzigs nas 'di 'khyer mi dgos/ phyir khyer la gdan sar 594

zhog ces nan cher gsungs nas phyir bskur pa ni/ gdul bya rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i yang sprul gsal bo myur mor 'byon pa'i brda yin nam snyam/ de nas brag dkar rtse'i mtshams khang du phebs byin rlabs gnang / zho 'ong dpyis su phebs sde ba'i spyi thog nas dpon slob nyis brgya brgal ba la ja thug la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa bgyis/ dad can phyug po rnams kyis kyang gdan drangs dngos 'bul rgya che byas/ zho 'ong dang rgyal po'i ru sde gnyis kyi kha mchu'i don la zhal gsung phebs nas sku tshab bzhag pas rjes su myur mor 'grigs/ sa dkar shar gyi dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis gdan drangs/ gsol ja dang 'bul ba phul ba la bsngo smon gnang nas phran tshegs tsam bzhes nas phyir gnang / sku gzhogs rgyal tshang /bstan 'chang / gzhan grwa ba 'ga' res zhus par yang phebs/nyang mtshams bstan 'dzin rgya tshos bkra shis chos gling du/thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal bso dang / nyid kyi 'dra sgu gsar bzhengs bgyes par rab gnas la zhus kyang da reb phebs pa dang khyad med pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ rjes nas phebs chog gsungs nas/ gling rgya'i bon tshang mar phebs bse'i khang la rab gnas byin 'beb gnang skabs mkha' la sprin 'thibs 595

nas 'brug sgra sgog char 'jam po babs pa sogs ltas bzang po shar/ de nas tā thang du nged kyi mtshams khang pad dkar chos gling du ston 'khor lhan rgyas gdan drangs phebs skabs su lha ri'i rtse nas glo bur du sprin byung nas/ sbrang char 'jam po babs 'brug sgra bsgrags pa sogs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag gis sngon bsus pa'i rtags mtshan bsam las 'das pa byung / phyi dro 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyem 'khrigs shing 'od 'jam pos khyab pa byung bas/ bka' las/ de ring snga dro dgos 'dod kyi char babs/ phyi dro bde skyid kyi nyi ma shar bas bzang /phyin chad gnas 'dir sgrub pa byed mkhan rnams bde zhing skyid ngos nas chos ldan gyi bya ba gang brtsams mthar phyin pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug gsungs/ o rgyan rin po che snang srid zil gnon gye rnam pa can yab yum gsum la 'khor rig 'dzin brgyad rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs bzhi bcu lhag tsam gsar bskrun byas pa la rab gnas byin 'bebs rgyas par gnang / phyi nang kun la me tog 'thor/ nyin zhag gcig tsam bzhugs ring la ja thug sogs kyis mnyes par bgyis/ zhong bza' tshang gi sngags khang bde skyid bsam gtan gling du phebs/ sde ba'i spyi thog nas dpon slob 'khor bcas la zhabs tog phun sum 596

tshogs pa phul/ kun la phral phugs su phan pa'i bslab bya mang po gnang / dad can sngags 'chang snying gar dpa' tshang gi nang du zhus zhag bzhugs gnang / nyid kyi thugs bkod ltar mchod khang nang du o rgyan rin po che dang / thugs rje chen po/ sgol ma/sum cu so lnga/ 'dra sku/ dzam nag bcas gsar du bzhengs pa la rab gnas rgyas par gnang / dpon slob 'khor bcas la 'tsho ba bzang po dang / gro nas sogs dngos po phul ba la bsngo smon gnang / de nas/ rim pa bzhin gling rgya'i dad can yon bdag mang pos gdan drangs te phal cher nas zhag bzhugs dang 'pho lung zhus shing / dpon slob tshang mar bsnyen bkur zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / gro nas sran gsum rta lug gos dā bu dkar dmar la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po phul zhing / sde ba so so'i sngags khang la phyag nas 'thor/ ya ru'i sngags khang cung zad nyams yod pa gsar bzhengs byed dgos tshul gyi zhal bkod dang gnang sbyin stsal/ skabs der nyang gi mtshams pa mchog la gsung rtsom gyi 'phro/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa chos kyi sgo 'byed la sogs pa glegs bu chung ngu zhig bu dper 'bebs rgyur gnang ba'i nang na sprul sku myur 'byon zhig kyang yod pa mthong nas snying mi dga' log ge byung /597

bka' las/ rtsom gzhi po ti gnyis lhag tsam yod kyang da reb 'dis chog 'di yang 'bri khom e yod ci shes/ gzhan pa rnams rjes nas bri dgos/ gang ltar chos ldan gyi bya ba mtha' dag la 'bad rtsol gyis dang bsam pa bzhin 'grub yong gsung ba ni bu chen 'di nyid la gsung gi tha ma'o/ /rin chen gsang phug tu byon/ zab lam 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi mtshams rgyun lo mang por ma nyams par yod pa rnams kyis spyan ras gzigs dang / o rgyan chen po/ nyid kyi 'dra sku rnams bzhengs yod pa la rab gnas 'thor/ mchog dman kun la sman pa'i bka' mchid dang mgur dbyangs sna tshogs pa blangs te rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston la sbyar/ gling rgya dang ka ring gnyis kyis kha mchu'i las don la mi rta mang po gsod res byas/ lo mang po'i bar du ma 'grigs par yod pa la zhal gsung phebs par kun gyis nyan nas rjes su myur mor 'grigs/ 'jam gyi sngags khang mtsho gling pad+ma bkod du phebs/ sde ba'i spyi thog nas mang ja drangs zhabs tog rgya cher phul/ dad can so so'i nang du byon 'bul ba zhabs tog gang phul bzhes bsngo smon gnang /de nas spen dkar thang gi dge 'dun pa rnams kyis gdan drangs 'bul ba zhabs tog gro nas sogs phul nas chos 'brel 598

zhus/ bka' chos dang bslab bya bsngo smon 'du khang dang byams khang rnams la rab gnas/ rgyas par gnang / tho rgya'i ya mun du tsong ye bsod nams dar rgyas kyis gdan 'dren zhus pas/dgyes bzhin phebs pa la spos rol sogs rgya nag lugs kyi bsu ba rgya cher byas/ dpon slob 'khor bcas ngan slong sum brgya tsam la nyi ma bzhi'i bar du bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa bstabs/ kha mchu zhig gi las don la mi bco lnga tsam btson du bzung yod pa'i don la/ bdag rkyen du rta zhig gnang zhal gsung phebs nas btson las thar par byas/ ya mun phyi nang dang / gshin rje'i lha khang / ge sar lha khang / sgol ma'i lha khang sogs rgya mkhar gyi phyi nang kun la bgegs bskrad dang byin 'bebs byas bkra shis gnang / tsong ye dang rgya mi drag zhan thams cad la las dge sdeg gi 'bras bu smin tshul dang / rgyu 'bras zhib dgos tshul rgyas par gsungs pas kun gyi blo kha 'gyur te/ be sang dang nang mi kun la byams pa byung / de nas rgya mi mang bos rol mo sgra snyan mi 'dra ba sna tshogs sgrog bzhin bsu skyel byas byon tshe/ rgya mkhar gye phyi nang na yod pa'i skyes pho mo che chung drag zhan thams cad ngo mtshar nas/ mjal mkhan dang lta mkhan mang pos srang ngam ke shing kun gang nas 'dug 599

pa rnams la brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs nas/ mthong thos dran reg thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i skyabs 'jug gnang bzhin/ bod skor sngags khang nang du phebs nas mjal mi che chung thams cad la 'di phyir phan pa'i zhal gdams bslab bya rgyas par stsal/ zhag gcig bzhugs te sgu gsung thugs rten rnams la byin 'bebs dang rab gnas gnang /slob ma yon bdag dad can phal cher gyi nang du byon bsod snyoms dang 'bul ba gang phul bzhes bsngo smon gnang / de nas gar rtseb gdong gi sngags khang du gdan drangs sde ba'i spyi thog nas dpon slob 'khor bcas grwa btsun dang / ngan slong thams cad la bsnyen bkur bzang po byas/ gzhan dad can phal che ba'i nang du byon dpon slob thams cad la zhabs tog byas/ hā sag dang / ras lwa/ dā bu dkar dmar gro nas do bo mang po bcas phul ba bzhes bsngo smon dang zhal gdams bslab bya mang po gnang bkra shis brjod nas/ de na gyod don zhig gi phyir bla rgan zhig btson du bzung yod par brtse bas ma bzod par 'phral phugs kyi zhal gsung mang po gnang ste/ khyed rnams kyis chos dang bla ma soms la bla rgan de nga la sprod dang / kha mchu 'grig thabs ngas byed ces zhal gsung du ma nan gyis phebs 600

tshe/ bla rgan ma sprad kyang gzu don khong la phul/ de nas seng ge gshong gong 'og gi dgon pa dang / sde ba so so nas gdan drangs zhag 'ga' la bzhugs dngos 'bul dang / zhabs tog bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa phul ba la zhal gdams dang bsngo smon rab gnas bkra shis rnams rgyas par gnang / de nas phebs pa'i lam bar du hor rgya'i sde bas spyi thog nas thab bsu rgya chen po byas tshe/ kun la phan pa'i zhal gdams dang bsngo smon gnang / rong bo'i dgon chen du phebs phral/ chu ma dang rong bo'i sde bdun/ ko'u sde dang spyang lung sogs kha mchu yod tshad la bka' shog dang / mi sna btang nas myur du 'grig thabs byed 'dun yod thog sku bsnyung bzhes tshul bstan tshe/grwa sa gsum dang sngags mang / gzhan sde ba so so'i bon sngags skya ser thams cad nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang /bsrung bzlog la sogs pa'i zhabs brtan mang po phyogs phyogs nas nyin mtshan du bsgrubs kyang / snyun bab je lci la song nas dwangs rkyen du ma song tshe/ sku mdun pa rnams kyis gang gi 'phrin las pa mkhan rin po che mgar rtse'i jo khang bzhengs pa'i thugs bkod gnang ba bzhin bzhugs yod pa gdan 'dren du btang ba thon pa dang / 'byon khar bkra shis 'khyil 601
