bar bang mi mngags nas brda sprad pas/ gnyer ba rab byung dang / sangs rgyas rin chen/ lha khang dbu mdzad sogs dang /bkra shis zhakhyel ba'i dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams dang /gnyan rgya'i sde ba/ 'jam gling rgyal po yar nang ko'u sde sogs kyi slob ma yon bdag dad can mang po phyogs phyogs nas thon phral/ sku sngar bas gzi mdangs dang ldan yang sku lci ba snyam bgyed cing / gsung shugs chung ba tsam las snyun 'di yin zhes pa ni mi snang zhing / mkhan rin po ches kyang phyag rtsa la brtags na sku tsha cung zhig yod pa 'dra ba ma gtogs/ gzhan pa'i snyung ni med pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug kyang / dam pa'i phyag rtsa 'di shin tu rtogs dka' ba zhig red/ da gang ltar kyang dam pa khyed bsam bzhin du 'gro ba'i don du byon pa yin gshis/ snyigs dus 'dir nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba mgon med nga dang nga 'dra ba rnams thugs nas mi 'dor bar/ sku tshe zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan pa'i bka' drin mi chung ba mkhyen zhus shing / sman dpyad zhabs brtan sogs kyang rgyu rkyen rten 'brel lags pas nged rnams tshur mthong gi blo gcig pu'i ngang tshul sha stag lags na/ brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs pa dus las mi yol ba'i bka' mchid cis kyang gnang ba mkhyen mkhyen lags 602

bar bang mi mngags nas brda sprad pas/ gnyer ba rab byung dang / sangs rgyas rin chen/ lha khang dbu mdzad sogs dang /bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams dang /gnyan rgyarje sde ba/ 'jam gling rgyal po yar nang ko'u sde sogs kyi slob ma yon bdag dad can mang po phyogs phyogs nas thon phral/ sku sngar bas gzi mdangs dang ldan yang sku lci ba snyam bgyed cing / gsung shugs chung ba tsam las snyun 'di yin zhes pa ni mi snang zhing / mkhan rin po ches kyang phyag rtsa la brtags na sku tsha cung zhig yod pa 'dra ba ma gtogs/ gzhan pa'i snyung ni med pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug kyang / dam pa'i phyag rtsa 'di shin tu rtogs dka' ba zhig red/ da gang ltar kyang dam pa khyed bsam bzhin du 'gro ba'i don du byon pa yin gshis/ snyigs dus 'dir nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba mgon med nga dang nga 'dra ba rnams thugs nas mi 'dor bar/ sku tshe zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan pa'i bka' drin mi chung ba mkhyen zhus shing / sman dpyad zhabs brtan sogs kyang rgyu rkyen rten 'brel lags pas nged rnams tshur mthong gi blo gcig pu'i ngang tshul sha stag lags na/ brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs pa dus las mi yol ba'i bka' mchid cis kyang gnang ba mkhyen mkhyen lags 602

zhus pas/ bka' las/ kho bo lang na mi 'dod pa tsam las na zug ni gang yang mi 'dug pas zhabs brtan mi dgos skyon med mod/ zhabs brtan la snyad btags nas rgyu rdzas ma brlags/ zhabs 'brang ba gnyom chung rnams gso ba'i cha rkyen du dgos gsungs/ bdag gis zhus pa/ dam pa nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas mngon par byang chub kyang /dag dang ma dag pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed bzhin par/ sku tshe 'dir yang bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don du byon nas tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par byas/ bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa sogs gang ci'i ngos nas skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa las bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa yin gshis/ sku snyung phran tshegs la snyad btags nas bdag dang bdag 'dra'i tshogs rnams thugs kyis ma 'dor bar bcom ldan mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa dang / 'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas ltar ji srid bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun bka' drin skyong dgos zhus pas/nga la spyan gyis cer re gzigs nas/ bka' las/ de los yin/bsdad na mi 'dod pa su yod de/ 'chi ba zer ba de thog tu bab na bzlog mi nus pa sngon byon thub pa'i rnam thar la ltos/603

zhus pas/ bka' las/ kho bo lang na mi 'dod pa tsam las na zug ni gang yang mi 'dug pas zhabs brtan mi dgos skyon med mod/ zhabs brtan la snyad btags nas rgyu rdzas ma brlags/ zhabs 'brang ba gnyom chung rnams gso ba'i cha rkyen du dgos gsungs/ bdag gis zhus pa/ dam pa nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas mngon par byang chub kyang /dag dang ma dag pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed bzhin par/ sku tshe 'dir yang bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don du byon nas tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par byas/ bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa sogs gang ci'i ngos nas skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa las bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa yin gshis/ sku snyung phran tshegs la snyad btags nas bdag dang bdag 'dra'i tshogs rnams thugs kyis ma 'dor bar bcom ldan mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa dang / 'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas ltar ji srid bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun bka' drin skyong dgos zhus pas/nga la spyan gyis cer re gzigs nas/ bka' las/ de los yin/bsdad na mi 'dod pa su yod de/ 'chi ba zer ba de thog tu bab na bzlog mi nus pa sngon byon thub pa'i rnam thar la ltos/603

gzhan sus bzlog nus/ des na dus la bab pa red/ ngas khyed rnams la mi rtag pa'i rgyu mtshan sngar yang yang bshad pa dang / da lta ltos dang go yong / phyin chad 'di soms la rab mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul nas sgrub pa gyes la phyogs med zhen med kyi bya btang gyis/ de ma byung na sngar gang shes tsho nyams su len bzhin 'gro la gang phan gyis/ ma ṇi dang / chos thog tshes bcu sogs sngags mang la gang yod nyams su ma 'jug yar ldan gyis/ mchod sbyin la 'bad gang thub rem/gdan sa dang mtshams khang sogs nyams su ma 'jug sngar bkod pa gang yod lhag med du sgrubs/ bshad rgyu ma mang nga bde bar nyal du chug gsungs/ rgyal dbon chung nas kyang de bzhin zhus par bshad bshad ma mang kho bo bya ba las don thams cad tshar zhing gdul bya rdzogs shi rung 'gyod pa med ces phebs pas/ bya thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po che byon nas tshe dpag med kyi sku zhig phul nas/brtan bzhugs phul bas rim bzhin bde zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i smon 'dun bgyi ba yin/ khyed rnams kyi dad 'dun lhag bsam gye mthus skyon med ces gsungs pa ni/ sku gzhogs rin po che'i zhal ngo bzung ba'i gsung ngo / /de nas sang nyer 604

gzhan sus bzlog nus/ des na dus la bab pa red/ ngas khyed rnams la mi rtag pa'i rgyu mtshan sngar yang yang bshad pa dang / da lta ltos dang go yong / phyin chad 'di soms la rab mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul nas sgrub pa gyes la phyogs med zhen med kyi bya btang gyis/ de ma byung na sngar gang shes tsho nyams su len bzhin 'gro la gang phan gyis/ ma ṇi dang / chos thog tshes bcu sogs sngags mang la gang yod nyams su ma 'jug yar ldan gyis/ mchod sbyin la 'bad gang thub rem/gdan sa dang mtshams khang sogs nyams su ma 'jug sngar bkod pa gang yod lhag med du sgrubs/ bshad rgyu ma mang nga bde bar nyal du chug gsungs/ rgyal dbon chung nas kyang de bzhin zhus par bshad bshad ma mang kho bo bya ba las don thams cad tshar zhing gdul bya rdzogs shi rung 'gyod pa med ces phebs pas/ bya thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po che byon nas tshe dpag med kyi sku zhig phul nas/brtan bzhugs phul bas rim bzhin bde zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i smon 'dun bgyi ba yin/ khyed rnams kyi dad 'dun lhag bsam gye mthus skyon med ces gsungs pa ni/ sku gzhogs rin po che'i zhal ngo bzung ba'i gsung ngo / /de nas sang nyer 604

lnga'i nyin snga mo nas bkra shis 'khyil bar spang ljongs brgyud nas 'gro dgos zhes gnyer ba dang zhabs phyi rnams la gsungs pas/ snyun ma dwangs pas phebs na snyun bab je lci la 'gro snang /snyun dwangs dgos zhus kyang ma gnang / spang ljongs brgyud nas phebs na la thur lci bas rong lam nas phebs na bzang tshul zhus kyang ma gsan par chas tshe/ yang sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po ches nan gyis bzhugs par gsol kyang ma gnang bar/ gnyer ba rab byung la mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma thon tshar song / da 'dug pa'i dus/ min rem rem gsungs nas/ chibs bskyod de rgyal po'i bye dri'i ka dar la ka bya ba nas/ sgye bo pho mo brgya phrag mang po la zhal mjal stsal te gsol ja bzhes 'phral/bka' las/ khyed rnams mang gshis mjal kha gnang ba mi lcogs pas mjal ba dang khyad med pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du zhal yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs zhes gsungs/ de nas yar phebs pa'i lam nas skabs shig gnyer ba rab byung la/ de ring bkra shis 'khyil bar 'gro mi thub/ sa yag po zhig nas 'dug dgos gsungs pa la/ zhus pa/ lags shug pa rnga brdung dang mkhar dngul lung gnyis kyi gcig nas bzhugs sam zhus pas/ de min gsungs/605

lnga'i nyin snga mo nas bkra shis 'khyil bar spang ljongs brgyud nas 'gro dgos zhes gnyer ba dang zhabs phyi rnams la gsungs pas/ snyun ma dwangs pas phebs na snyun bab je lci la 'gro snang /snyun dwangs dgos zhus kyang ma gnang / spang ljongs brgyud nas phebs na la thur lci bas rong lam nas phebs na bzang tshul zhus kyang ma gsan par chas tshe/ yang sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po ches nan gyis bzhugs par gsol kyang ma gnang bar/ gnyer ba rab byung la mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma thon tshar song / da 'dug pa'i dus/ min rem rem gsungs nas/ chibs bskyod de rgyal po'i bye dri'i ka dar la ka bya ba nas/ sgye bo pho mo brgya phrag mang po la zhal mjal stsal te gsol ja bzhes 'phral/bka' las/ khyed rnams mang gshis mjal kha gnang ba mi lcogs pas mjal ba dang khyad med pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du zhal yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs zhes gsungs/ de nas yar phebs pa'i lam nas skabs shig gnyer ba rab byung la/ de ring bkra shis 'khyil bar 'gro mi thub/ sa yag po zhig nas 'dug dgos gsungs pa la/ zhus pa/ lags shug pa rnga brdung dang mkhar dngul lung gnyis kyi gcig nas bzhugs sam zhus pas/ de min gsungs/605

'o na a bo skyabs nas bzhugs na zhus pas de yin/ sngon la song la ltos sa yag sa zhig nas 'dug dgos gsungs pa ltar/de nas brag gi ngos la a yig rang byon yod pa la skyabs su gsol nas bsdad pas/ de las a bo skyabs bu bzhir grags pa gyes te rim gyis 'phel bas/ deng sang rgyal po'i rlangs tshang zhes grags pa'i sa/ a bo skyabs zhes pa'i nye 'dabs spang ljongs me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i sgrol ma'i thang zhes par phyag phab pas thugs dgyes nyams dang bcas/ da ni sa 'di dben cing skye bo'i ca co med pas ting nge 'dzin la ngang gis gnas shing ci byed kyi rang dbang thob cing / kho bo'i nad gzhi yang je dwangs su song 'dug ces mdun du 'tshogs pa'i grwa slob rnams dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pas/ bdag cag rnams ma rig pa'i gzhan dbang can rtag pa ril bor 'dzin pa'i blo can du song gshis/ nges par snyun las grol lo snyam pa'i dga' spro las gzhan ni sems la ma dran/ rje'i mdzad pa ni sngar rgyun ltar thugs dgyes pa'i sgo nas zhal bkyal kha yar gsungs mthar/'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar snang la bden par ma grub mod/ 'on kyang smig rgyu'i chus ri dwags brid pa ltar med pa gsal snang gi chos la log 606

'o na a bo skyabs nas bzhugs na zhus pas de yin/ sngon la song la ltos sa yag sa zhig nas 'dug dgos gsungs pa ltar/de nas brag gi ngos la a yig rang byon yod pa la skyabs su gsol nas bsdad pas/ de las a bo skyabs bu bzhir grags pa gyes te rim gyis 'phel bas/ deng sang rgyal po'i rlangs tshang zhes grags pa'i sa/ a bo skyabs zhes pa'i nye 'dabs spang ljongs me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i sgrol ma'i thang zhes par phyag phab pas thugs dgyes nyams dang bcas/ da ni sa 'di dben cing skye bo'i ca co med pas ting nge 'dzin la ngang gis gnas shing ci byed kyi rang dbang thob cing / kho bo'i nad gzhi yang je dwangs su song 'dug ces mdun du 'tshogs pa'i grwa slob rnams dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pas/ bdag cag rnams ma rig pa'i gzhan dbang can rtag pa ril bor 'dzin pa'i blo can du song gshis/ nges par snyun las grol lo snyam pa'i dga' spro las gzhan ni sems la ma dran/ rje'i mdzad pa ni sngar rgyun ltar thugs dgyes pa'i sgo nas zhal bkyal kha yar gsungs mthar/'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar snang la bden par ma grub mod/ 'on kyang smig rgyu'i chus ri dwags brid pa ltar med pa gsal snang gi chos la log 606

pa'i sgye bo dag 'khrul ba yin te/ mdzangs blun las/ 'gro ba rmi lam lta bu ste/ /de bzhin las ni rmi lam bzhin/ /byed po nye bar len pa rnams/ /thams cad rmi lam 'dra ba yin/ /zhes dang / gsang snying las/ e ma ho/ bder gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul/ /sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang / /gnas dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /bdag dang bdag gir so sor 'dzin/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen pos/ med bzhin snang la bde sdug so sor myong / /yun ring dus nas goms pa 'di dag kun/ /gnas dang dus dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ /rang snang dge sdig las byung bde sdug bsngal/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ri mo bris 'dra ba/ /gcig nyid 'phrul las mang por snang gyur te/ /du mar bzung las 'khrul snang rgyun mi 'chad/ /e ma srid pa'i rang bzhin rmi lam bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khrul ba rang dgar bzung bas bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba yin/ rang re rnams kyis snang yang bden par ma grub pa'i tshul la goms pa bya ba yin te/'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam la/ /bu pho byung zhing shi ba de mthong nas/ /byung na dga' zhing shi na mi dga' ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de 607

pa'i sgye bo dag 'khrul ba yin te/ mdzangs blun las/ 'gro ba rmi lam lta bu ste/ /de bzhin las ni rmi lam bzhin/ /byed po nye bar len pa rnams/ /thams cad rmi lam 'dra ba yin/ /zhes dang / gsang snying las/ e ma ho/ bder gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul/ /sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang / /gnas dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /bdag dang bdag gir so sor 'dzin/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen pos/ med bzhin snang la bde sdug so sor myong / /yun ring dus nas goms pa 'di dag kun/ /gnas dang dus dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ /rang snang dge sdig las byung bde sdug bsngal/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ri mo bris 'dra ba/ /gcig nyid 'phrul las mang por snang gyur te/ /du mar bzung las 'khrul snang rgyun mi 'chad/ /e ma srid pa'i rang bzhin rmi lam bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khrul ba rang dgar bzung bas bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba yin/ rang re rnams kyis snang yang bden par ma grub pa'i tshul la goms pa bya ba yin te/'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam la/ /bu pho byung zhing shi ba de mthong nas/ /byung na dga' zhing shi na mi dga' ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de 607

bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar skye bo mang po'i dbus dag tu/ /sgyu ma byed pa dag gi gzugs sprul te/ /rta dang glang bo shing rta sna tshogs byas/ /de dag mi bden sna tshogs snang ba ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes dang / khye'u rab snang gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang tshe sna tshogs chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma skyes pa/ /rmi lam bzhin du dngos med de/ /dngos po rnams dang bral ba yin/ /zhes dang / khri brgyad stong pa las/ lha'i bu dag 'khor ba yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i chos nyid kyang sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'am/ bde stong phyag rgya chen po/ lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po/ mtha' bral dbu ma chen po sogs ming gi rnam grangs cir smos kyang don la rang sems mtha' dbus med pa'i zang thal/ rgya chad med par brdal ba/gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde la zhen 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog cing / rjes thob tu sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyes rtsis zin pa'i tshogs gsog sgrib pa sbyong zhing / de 608

bzhin shes par gyis/ /ji ltar skye bo mang po'i dbus dag tu/ /sgyu ma byed pa dag gi gzugs sprul te/ /rta dang glang bo shing rta sna tshogs byas/ /de dag mi bden sna tshogs snang ba ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes dang / khye'u rab snang gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang tshe sna tshogs chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma skyes pa/ /rmi lam bzhin du dngos med de/ /dngos po rnams dang bral ba yin/ /zhes dang / khri brgyad stong pa las/ lha'i bu dag 'khor ba yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i chos nyid kyang sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'am/ bde stong phyag rgya chen po/ lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po/ mtha' bral dbu ma chen po sogs ming gi rnam grangs cir smos kyang don la rang sems mtha' dbus med pa'i zang thal/ rgya chad med par brdal ba/gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde la zhen 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog cing / rjes thob tu sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyes rtsis zin pa'i tshogs gsog sgrib pa sbyong zhing / de 608

ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la snying rje bsgom zhing sgyu mar sbyong ba la 'dun pa byas pas/ de lta bu nyams su len pa la 'bad na ring por mi thogs par 'chi med bde chen gyi btsan sa ye shes sgyu ma mngon du 'gyur nges te/ ye shes mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud brgyad pa las/ sgyu ma chos dbyengs kun gzhi ste/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i chos so cog med pa gsal snang gi rang bzhin du go nas/ sgyu ma rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i chos can rnams/ sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du rtogs na sdug bsngal bde bar 'char ba yin la sogs pa'i 'bel mchid zab mo mang du stsal/ mthar da khyed rnams kyi sman bla dang / bsam lhun bar chad lam sel mdo gdugs dkar sogs gang shes thon/ da kha brda de tsam gyis/ngas ngal bsos kyis phebs pas/ rje'i gsung gdangs bzhes pa sku'i gzi mdangs sogs kyis yid gsos par mdzad pas/thams cad kyis nges par snyun las grol nges snyam pa las ci yang ma sems par yid bde bar gnas mod/ gang gi dgongs pa ni chos kyi dbyings zab zhi spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su mnal ba'i mdzad pa ston pa la nye bar phyogs shing mtshan thog 609

ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la snying rje bsgom zhing sgyu mar sbyong ba la 'dun pa byas pas/ de lta bu nyams su len pa la 'bad na ring por mi thogs par 'chi med bde chen gyi btsan sa ye shes sgyu ma mngon du 'gyur nges te/ ye shes mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud brgyad pa las/ sgyu ma chos dbyengs kun gzhi ste/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i chos so cog med pa gsal snang gi rang bzhin du go nas/ sgyu ma rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i chos can rnams/ sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du rtogs na sdug bsngal bde bar 'char ba yin la sogs pa'i 'bel mchid zab mo mang du stsal/ mthar da khyed rnams kyi sman bla dang / bsam lhun bar chad lam sel mdo gdugs dkar sogs gang shes thon/ da kha brda de tsam gyis/ngas ngal bsos kyis phebs pas/ rje'i gsung gdangs bzhes pa sku'i gzi mdangs sogs kyis yid gsos par mdzad pas/thams cad kyis nges par snyun las grol nges snyam pa las ci yang ma sems par yid bde bar gnas mod/ gang gi dgongs pa ni chos kyi dbyings zab zhi spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su mnal ba'i mdzad pa ston pa la nye bar phyogs shing mtshan thog 609

thag spyan mi btsum par nam mkha' la gzigs pa'i lta stangs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'od gsal mnyam par 'jog par mdzad/ de nas nangs par gsol ja bzhes pa'i tshe/ bka' las/ khyed rnams ja 'di 'thungs tshar ba dang sgor song la sdod/re zhig kho bo gzim dgos sbis dkar gyi sgo yang gtan la zhogakhyod rnams su yang sbis dkar gyi thag nye nas ma 'dug ces phebs kyang / mkhan chen pas mi gzim par zhu lags snyun la gzims na mi 'gab tshul zhus pas/ bka' las/ kho bo la gzim bya gzim byed kyi spros pa nye bar zhi zhing chos nyid 'od gsal gyi klong bde ba chen por phyam gdal ba la tha mal ba'i gnyid med pas phan gnod bral/ de bas khyed rnams sgor dengs shig ces bka' stsal kyang / mkhan chen pa dang / sangs rgyas/ stag yan/ nged rang rnams sku mdun du 'dug par zhus pas/ 'gro ba la nye 'khon med cing brtse ba'i bdag nyid yin gshis zhal 'dzum mdzad pa las cang mi gsung bar bzhugs/de nas gzims tshul mdzad pa na mi nyan tshul lan kha yar zhus pas/ skabs shig khyod rnams kyis 'di byas bsdad na bde 'dod kyang de mi bde/ de bas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la mnyam bzhag bsdad na bde bas kha rog sdod gsungs/ ji zhig 610

thag spyan mi btsum par nam mkha' la gzigs pa'i lta stangs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'od gsal mnyam par 'jog par mdzad/ de nas nangs par gsol ja bzhes pa'i tshe/ bka' las/ khyed rnams ja 'di 'thungs tshar ba dang sgor song la sdod/re zhig kho bo gzim dgos sbis dkar gyi sgo yang gtan la zhogakhyod rnams su yang sbis dkar gyi thag nye nas ma 'dug ces phebs kyang / mkhan chen pas mi gzim par zhu lags snyun la gzims na mi 'gab tshul zhus pas/ bka' las/ kho bo la gzim bya gzim byed kyi spros pa nye bar zhi zhing chos nyid 'od gsal gyi klong bde ba chen por phyam gdal ba la tha mal ba'i gnyid med pas phan gnod bral/ de bas khyed rnams sgor dengs shig ces bka' stsal kyang / mkhan chen pa dang / sangs rgyas/ stag yan/ nged rang rnams sku mdun du 'dug par zhus pas/ 'gro ba la nye 'khon med cing brtse ba'i bdag nyid yin gshis zhal 'dzum mdzad pa las cang mi gsung bar bzhugs/de nas gzims tshul mdzad pa na mi nyan tshul lan kha yar zhus pas/ skabs shig khyod rnams kyis 'di byas bsdad na bde 'dod kyang de mi bde/ de bas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la mnyam bzhag bsdad na bde bas kha rog sdod gsungs/ ji zhig 610

na spyan nam mkha' la cer re gzigs te/ de ring gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khams dwangs/ grong yul dang dgon pa las thag bsrings pas skye bo'i ca co med/ bas mtha' 'di shin tu dben cing nam dus kyi stabs sa gzhi yang g.yu'i mdangs dang ldan zhing / chu sgyes mang po'i ge sar rgod pa ni rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra btab pa ltar bkra/ ko ki la dang lcong ka la sogs pa'i gnyis skyes kyi tshogs rnams dga' ba'i 'phur lding rtsen zhing /sgra lhang lhang grags pas dben pa'i bsngags brjod glur len pa dang mtshungs/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i gzhi bdag se ku bya khyung dang stag lung la sogs pa rnams/ rnal 'byor pa la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis kho ra khor yug kun bkar zhing bag phebs pas/ snang ba 'di gu yangs khrol le/ rig pa gsal trig ge/ 'byung bzhi khod snyoms pas phung po bsil seng nge / shes pa dga' yal le skyid pa rang cig byung / rong bo'i 'a 'ur dang tsha gdung de'i nang nas thon pas phung khams yang bde/ de ring sdod dam gsungs pas/ mkhan chen pas de ltar lags/ de ring sku ngal zhig gsos na sku mi 'khrug pas de ltar mdzad par zhu zhes zhus pas/ de ga ltar bya'o 'dir mi mang po sdod mi dgos pas sang bsu ma la shog cig de rang khyed 611

na spyan nam mkha' la cer re gzigs te/ de ring gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khams dwangs/ grong yul dang dgon pa las thag bsrings pas skye bo'i ca co med/ bas mtha' 'di shin tu dben cing nam dus kyi stabs sa gzhi yang g.yu'i mdangs dang ldan zhing / chu sgyes mang po'i ge sar rgod pa ni rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra btab pa ltar bkra/ ko ki la dang lcong ka la sogs pa'i gnyis skyes kyi tshogs rnams dga' ba'i 'phur lding rtsen zhing /sgra lhang lhang grags pas dben pa'i bsngags brjod glur len pa dang mtshungs/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i gzhi bdag se ku bya khyung dang stag lung la sogs pa rnams/ rnal 'byor pa la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis kho ra khor yug kun bkar zhing bag phebs pas/ snang ba 'di gu yangs khrol le/ rig pa gsal trig ge/ 'byung bzhi khod snyoms pas phung po bsil seng nge / shes pa dga' yal le skyid pa rang cig byung / rong bo'i 'a 'ur dang tsha gdung de'i nang nas thon pas phung khams yang bde/ de ring sdod dam gsungs pas/ mkhan chen pas de ltar lags/ de ring sku ngal zhig gsos na sku mi 'khrug pas de ltar mdzad par zhu zhes zhus pas/ de ga ltar bya'o 'dir mi mang po sdod mi dgos pas sang bsu ma la shog cig de rang khyed 611

rnams bkra shis 'khyil bar song zhig gsungs pas/ thams cad kyis da ni nges par snyun dwangs par nges so snyam ste bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa sogs grwa slob sum cu tsam yul du song / sku mdun du mkhan rin po che dang / nye gnas blo bzang shes rab/ kun dga'/ sangs rgyas/ lha khang dbu mdzad/ngag dbang bkra shis/ hor tshang mtshams pa sogs nged dang bcas grwa skor nyung shas shig ma gtogs med cing shin tu dben par gyur pa na/ 'di ltar theg mchog rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa dag 'da' ka ma'i tshe/ ri dwags dang / seng ge dang /sprang po dang / bu chung dang / mkha' 'gro dang / rig 'dzin dang / me dpung ltar rab 'bring gi 'chi lugs zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang gi dgongs pa zab cing rgya che bas gar bzhugs 'og min gyi zhing dang / gang snang lha dang lha mo'i rnam rol tu shar bas/ gnas spang blang dang zhen 'dzin grol ba'i mngon rtags ngom pa dang / gdul bya'i dbang las rab kyi 'da' lugs bzhi mngon du ma gyur pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ yul gyi mngon zhen log ste gang la'ang 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i rtags gsal ba dang /bas mtha' de nyid kyang skye rgu'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du byen gyis brlabs pa dang / chos mthun gyi gsung skyes rnams 612

rnams bkra shis 'khyil bar song zhig gsungs pas/ thams cad kyis da ni nges par snyun dwangs par nges so snyam ste bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa sogs grwa slob sum cu tsam yul du song / sku mdun du mkhan rin po che dang / nye gnas blo bzang shes rab/ kun dga'/ sangs rgyas/ lha khang dbu mdzad/ngag dbang bkra shis/ hor tshang mtshams pa sogs nged dang bcas grwa skor nyung shas shig ma gtogs med cing shin tu dben par gyur pa na/ 'di ltar theg mchog rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa dag 'da' ka ma'i tshe/ ri dwags dang / seng ge dang /sprang po dang / bu chung dang / mkha' 'gro dang / rig 'dzin dang / me dpung ltar rab 'bring gi 'chi lugs zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang gi dgongs pa zab cing rgya che bas gar bzhugs 'og min gyi zhing dang / gang snang lha dang lha mo'i rnam rol tu shar bas/ gnas spang blang dang zhen 'dzin grol ba'i mngon rtags ngom pa dang / gdul bya'i dbang las rab kyi 'da' lugs bzhi mngon du ma gyur pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ yul gyi mngon zhen log ste gang la'ang 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i rtags gsal ba dang /bas mtha' de nyid kyang skye rgu'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du byen gyis brlabs pa dang / chos mthun gyi gsung skyes rnams 612

kyang long med 'chi bas rgyud bskul te/ chos la nyin mtshan bar med du brtson zhig par bskul pa dang / rtag pa dang ril bor 'dzin pa'i blo las ldog pa dang / rnyed bkur snyan grags 'ba' zhig lhur len cing dam pa'i mdzad par 'khu ba dge slong legs skar dang lhas byin gyi brtul zhugs 'chang zhing / lo ga'i chos brgyad kyi stegs la rmongs zhen gyi gos kyis bklubs pa dag gi phrag dog gi zug rngu zhi bar bya ba sogs dgos pa khyad par can du ma zhig la dgongs te/ rdo rje sku brnyes zin kyang tha mal gye snang ngor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdu bar gzhol te/ dgung lo don gcig steng rab yid lcags phag lo'i dpal ldan dus 'khor lugs kyi sa ga zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu/ hor lugs kyi snon zla'i dmar phyogs nyer drug yos bu'i nyin/ res gza' mishe dmar/ zla skar nam gru/ nyi skar mgo/ dus tshod sbrul dus kyi dbyu gu bcu gnyis rdzogs mtshams su sleb pa na/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs mchog gang des zhing khams bye ba phrag brgyar sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya bkyes nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i brdar/ sku drang por bsrangs te zhal lho nub tu gzigs/ bzang po'i bzhugs stangs kyis bzhugs/ srid zhi'i 'jigs pa bral ba'i brdar/613

kyang long med 'chi bas rgyud bskul te/ chos la nyin mtshan bar med du brtson zhig par bskul pa dang / rtag pa dang ril bor 'dzin pa'i blo las ldog pa dang / rnyed bkur snyan grags 'ba' zhig lhur len cing dam pa'i mdzad par 'khu ba dge slong legs skar dang lhas byin gyi brtul zhugs 'chang zhing / lo ga'i chos brgyad kyi stegs la rmongs zhen gyi gos kyis bklubs pa dag gi phrag dog gi zug rngu zhi bar bya ba sogs dgos pa khyad par can du ma zhig la dgongs te/ rdo rje sku brnyes zin kyang tha mal gye snang ngor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdu bar gzhol te/ dgung lo don gcig steng rab yid lcags phag lo'i dpal ldan dus 'khor lugs kyi sa ga zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu/ hor lugs kyi snon zla'i dmar phyogs nyer drug yos bu'i nyin/ res gza' mishe dmar/ zla skar nam gru/ nyi skar mgo/ dus tshod sbrul dus kyi dbyu gu bcu gnyis rdzogs mtshams su sleb pa na/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs mchog gang des zhing khams bye ba phrag brgyar sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya bkyes nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i brdar/ sku drang por bsrangs te zhal lho nub tu gzigs/ bzang po'i bzhugs stangs kyis bzhugs/ srid zhi'i 'jigs pa bral ba'i brdar/613

phyag gnyis sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas pus mo'i lha nga kheb par mdzad de/ mdun na yod pa rnams la spyan cer re gzigs te zhal 'dzum mdzad nas/ bka' las/ lo kho/ ngas dang po 'khor ba'i bya ba mtha' dag snying bo med par mthong zhing yid 'byung ste/ thar pa'i yon tan gyis yid phrogs shing chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po sogs mtshan ldan gyi bla ma brgya phrag bsten nas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du mnos/ bar du nyan lo thos lo tsam du ma song bar ri khrod dben pa brgya phrag 'grims nas thos don tshul bzhin nyams su blangs/ tha ma bsgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gro yongs la gang la gang phan byas/ tha na sprang po nyam thag 'chi la nye ba brgya phrag mang po'i tshe thar par byas shing chos ldan gyi bya ba thams cad mthar ri phyin nas/ da ni re zhig 'dod ldan pad+ma'i tshal la 'jug pa'am/bu pha khyem dang bu mo ma khyem du 'gro ba ltar/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba sogs dag pa'i zhing khams rnams su song nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal mjal gsung gi bdud rtsi la longs spyad nas/ slar yang sprul pa bye ba phrag rab 'byams bkyes nas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa byed gsungs pa'i 'phro rnams zhal gsung spubs su lhung snyam bgyid pas thos 'dzin gyi bu 614

gar ma son pa dang / bzhugs stangs de nyid las mi g.yo bar spyan nam mkha'i mthongs su gzigs zhal 'dzum pa'i dgyes nyams dang bcas te/ thugs zab zhi spros pa dang bral ba'i chos sku'i dbyings las 'pho 'gyur spangs kyang / sprul pa gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su 'dus shing rtsal ma 'gags pa'i snang cha sgyu ma'i rol gar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs te/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gshegs bshul du mkha' la spyod pa'i dpa' bo dang ḍāk+ki'i tshogs kyis gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo sna tshogs pas mngon par bsus te/ don mthun gyi mgron po rgya mtsho'i gling nas khyem du son pa ltar/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i 'brel tshad kyi gdul bya pho mo bye ba ther 'bum bsam las 'das pa dang bcas drangs te dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs kyis mdzes pa'i gar stabs sna tshogs bsgyur zhing /shin tu gsang ba bde stong phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i rdo rje gsang ba'i glu dbyangs sna tshogs pa len bzhin rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon du gshegs par gyur la/ rim gyis bka' las byung ba ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams rnams su gshegs shing sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /de lta bu'i mdzad pa bstan ma thag 615

gar ma son pa dang / bzhugs stangs de nyid las mi g.yo bar spyan nam mkha'i mthongs su gzigs zhal 'dzum pa'i dgyes nyams dang bcas te/ thugs zab zhi spros pa dang bral ba'i chos sku'i dbyings las 'pho 'gyur spangs kyang / sprul pa gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su 'dus shing rtsal ma 'gags pa'i snang cha sgyu ma'i rol gar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs te/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gshegs bshul du mkha' la spyod pa'i dpa' bo dang ḍāk+ki'i tshogs kyis gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo sna tshogs pas mngon par bsus te/ don mthun gyi mgron po rgya mtsho'i gling nas khyem du son pa ltar/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i 'brel tshad kyi gdul bya pho mo bye ba ther 'bum bsam las 'das pa dang bcas drangs te dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs kyis mdzes pa'i gar stabs sna tshogs bsgyur zhing /shin tu gsang ba bde stong phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i rdo rje gsang ba'i glu dbyangs sna tshogs pa len bzhin rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon du gshegs par gyur la/ rim gyis bka' las byung ba ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams rnams su gshegs shing sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /de lta bu'i mdzad pa bstan ma thag 615

nam mkha'i dbyings kho ra khor yug tu sprin gseb rnams su lha dang lha mo mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa lta bus gang zhing /dbus drang thad nas kha dog sna lnga'i dbang po'i gzhu ris gdugs ltar bkra zhing / rtseb shar dang gyen 'grengs 'od dang 'od khyim dang / lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba dang snam bu brkyangs pa ltar 'then pas gang ba skye bo kun la mig gi bdud rtsir sbyin par byas pas/ hor tshang nas snang ra tshun gyi rtogs dpyod dang ldan pa dag 'di ci'i ltas zhes nem nur gyi gnas la bkod cing / bas mtha' de dang thag mi ring ba'i shar phyogs nas char sprin 'thibs pa'i nang nas char rgyun babs shing / sa gzhi kun kyang 'dar yed yed byed pa'i 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba lta bu'i sgra sgrog cing thang la lhung ba snyam byed pa'i gzugs kyang 'ga' zhig mthong ba sogs/ gzhan gyi spyod yul du mi 'os pa'i rtags mang du byung ba ni/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis ma bzod par gdung ba'i smre sngags bton zhing mchod pa byas pa'i ltas dang / bdag nyid chen po thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pas/ theg pa mchog gi rgyal po rnal 'byor la nang byan chud pa'i skyes mchog rnams mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i mngon rtogs ngom pa yin te/ sku 616

nam mkha'i dbyings kho ra khor yug tu sprin gseb rnams su lha dang lha mo mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa lta bus gang zhing /dbus drang thad nas kha dog sna lnga'i dbang po'i gzhu ris gdugs ltar bkra zhing / rtseb shar dang gyen 'grengs 'od dang 'od khyim dang / lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba dang snam bu brkyangs pa ltar 'then pas gang ba skye bo kun la mig gi bdud rtsir sbyin par byas pas/ hor tshang nas snang ra tshun gyi rtogs dpyod dang ldan pa dag 'di ci'i ltas zhes nem nur gyi gnas la bkod cing / bas mtha' de dang thag mi ring ba'i shar phyogs nas char sprin 'thibs pa'i nang nas char rgyun babs shing / sa gzhi kun kyang 'dar yed yed byed pa'i 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba lta bu'i sgra sgrog cing thang la lhung ba snyam byed pa'i gzugs kyang 'ga' zhig mthong ba sogs/ gzhan gyi spyod yul du mi 'os pa'i rtags mang du byung ba ni/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis ma bzod par gdung ba'i smre sngags bton zhing mchod pa byas pa'i ltas dang / bdag nyid chen po thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pas/ theg pa mchog gi rgyal po rnal 'byor la nang byan chud pa'i skyes mchog rnams mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i mngon rtogs ngom pa yin te/ sku 616

gdung 'bar ba las/ 'od la rnam pa gsum yin te/ /mu khyud khor yug bcas pa ni/ /gang gi bshul la byung ba na/ /'di ni bar do dang po la/ /nges par yis ni 'bras bu thob/ /gal te gyen du 'greng ba na/ / radi ni bar do mi snang bar/ /skad cig las ni sangs rgyas so/ /'od ni rtsibs las snang gyur na/ /'di ni bar do tha ma la/ /mngon par byang chub nyid rnyed do/ /ces dang / yang de nyid las/ gang du 'das pa'i gnas khang gi/shar gyi phyogs nas nye ba'i sar/ /sgra ni rab tu grags pa na/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs su 'gyur/ /de bzhin lho yi phyogs su yang / /sgras ni rin chen rigs su snang / /nub tu pad+ma de bzhin ni/ /byang du las kyi rigs su gyur/ /de bzhin steng du de bzhin gshegs/ /sgra yi rang bzhin 'di lta bu/ /'ur zhing thug pa brtsegs ma dang / /rgyun ring 'jam dal ring ba'i sgra/ /zhi dang khro bo'i khyad kyis so/ /de ltar sgra dang ldan gyur na/ /'di ni longs spyod rdzogs pa yi/ /sku yi 'bras bu thob pa'o /zhes dang / rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ sgra la yang gnyis te/ 'ur gyis byung na zhag bdun na mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /thug gis byung na zhag bcu bzhi na mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs 617

don gsal bar mdzad de/ bstan pa'i sgron me 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab phyag na pad+ma ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba chos dbyings gdod ma'i klong du mnal bar gyur to/ / —rje dus gsum gye rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /pha mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che//bdag nyam thag yongs la spyan gyis gzigs/ /thugs brtse bas dor ram skyabs mgon rje/ /sngon bskal pa dpag med gong rol nas/ /ma 'gro kun sgol bar thugs bskyed nas/ /dpal yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas zin kyang / /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mgon skyabs mchog dam par byon byas nas/ /bstan 'gro yi don chen mdzad legs kyang / /deng nyam thag gdul bya dor byas nas/ /zhing dag pa rab 'byams gshegs gyur na/ /sngon thugs bskyed dam bca' dor ram ci/ /lho 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig pu/ /'od stong 'bar nyi ma nub rir phyogs/ /gling mun pa'i khyen du bsgyur byas pas/ /da 'dzam gling skye bos ci zhig bya/ /steng ngo mtshar lha yi dpag bsam shing / /dgos 'dod kyi char 'bebs glo bur 'gyel/ /'dod lha yi dpal kun bcom byas pas/ /da 'dod dgu yi re ba su yis skong / /'og ma dros klu yi mtshor 618

don gsal bar mdzad de/ bstan pa'i sgron me 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab phyag na pad+ma ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba chos dbyings gdod ma'i klong du mnal bar gyur to/ / —rje dus gsum gye rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /pha mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che//bdag nyam thag yongs la spyan gyis gzigs/ /thugs brtse bas dor ram skyabs mgon rje/ /sngon bskal pa dpag med gong rol nas/ /ma 'gro kun sgol bar thugs bskyed nas/ /dpal yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas zin kyang / /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mgon skyabs mchog dam par byon byas nas/ /bstan 'gro yi don chen mdzad legs kyang / /deng nyam thag gdul bya dor byas nas/ /zhing dag pa rab 'byams gshegs gyur na/ /sngon thugs bskyed dam bca' dor ram ci/ /lho 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig pu/ /'od stong 'bar nyi ma nub rir phyogs/ /gling mun pa'i khyen du bsgyur byas pas/ /da 'dzam gling skye bos ci zhig bya/ /steng ngo mtshar lha yi dpag bsam shing / /dgos 'dod kyi char 'bebs glo bur 'gyel/ /'dod lha yi dpal kun bcom byas pas/ /da 'dod dgu yi re ba su yis skong / /'og ma dros klu yi mtshor 618

gnas pa'i/ /phan bde yi mchog stsol dbang gi rgyal/ /glo bur du nag phyogs chom pos khyer/ /klu dbang tsho nyer 'tsho su yis byed/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /thub mchog gi lung dang bstan pa yi/ /gsal byed du bsam bzhin byon gyur kyang / /ring min du dag zhing byon pa 'di/ /brtson 'grus kyi go cha dor ram ci/ /gdul dka' 'gro'i don du mi bzhugs par/ /zhi bde yi khang bzang la phyogs na/ /gnas yul mchog dag pa mkha' spyod kyi/ /dga' ma yi tshogs kyis bslus sam ci/ /sngon byon gyi pad 'byung bi ma la/ /ji bzhin du bzhugs par mi 'gyur kyang / /mdzad pa'i mtha' lo brgyar mi bskyungs pa/ /brtse chen gyi gzigs pa yol lam ci/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /ji lta dang ji snyed gnas lugs kun/ /ma lus pa ji bzhin sa ler gzigs/ /legs nyes dang blang dor 'byed mkhas pa'i/ /mkhyen pa mchog phul byung drin chen rje/ /mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba thams cad la/ /nye ring dang chags sdang gtan bral ba'i/ /ma bzang mos bu la byams pa ltar/ /brtse ba yi bdag nyid rin po che/ /mi mthun kun 'joms las mi mdzad kyang / /bslab gsum dang rim 619

gnas pa'i/ /phan bde yi mchog stsol dbang gi rgyal/ /glo bur du nag phyogs chom pos khyer/ /klu dbang tsho nyer 'tsho su yis byed/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /thub mchog gi lung dang bstan pa yi/ /gsal byed du bsam bzhin byon gyur kyang / /ring min du dag zhing byon pa 'di/ /brtson 'grus kyi go cha dor ram ci/ /gdul dka' 'gro'i don du mi bzhugs par/ /zhi bde yi khang bzang la phyogs na/ /gnas yul mchog dag pa mkha' spyod kyi/ /dga' ma yi tshogs kyis bslus sam ci/ /sngon byon gyi pad 'byung bi ma la/ /ji bzhin du bzhugs par mi 'gyur kyang / /mdzad pa'i mtha' lo brgyar mi bskyungs pa/ /brtse chen gyi gzigs pa yol lam ci/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /ji lta dang ji snyed gnas lugs kun/ /ma lus pa ji bzhin sa ler gzigs/ /legs nyes dang blang dor 'byed mkhas pa'i/ /mkhyen pa mchog phul byung drin chen rje/ /mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba thams cad la/ /nye ring dang chags sdang gtan bral ba'i/ /ma bzang mos bu la byams pa ltar/ /brtse ba yi bdag nyid rin po che/ /mi mthun kun 'joms las mi mdzad kyang / /bslab gsum dang rim 619

gnyis rnal 'byor mthus/ /rgol ngan kun rang sar zhi ba la/ /mthu nus rtsal zla bral drin can rje/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /zhing dag pa rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i/ /dpal sangs rgyas byang sems sras bcas kyis/ /mgon dam pa'i zhabs pad yun brtan pa'i/ /byen rlabs kyi mthu dpal chung ngam ci/ /grangs med pa'i zhi dang khro bo'i gar/ /sna tshogs par ston mdzad yi dam lhas/ /bstan 'gro'i mgon zhabs pad yun brtan pa'i/ /dngos grub cis mi stsol thugs rje chung / /gnas yul kun skyong mdzad dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyis/ /dam pa yi phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun/ /sel ba yi sdongs grogs cis ma byas/ /dpal ma mgon gza' rdor tshe ring mas/ /skye rgu yi phan bde'i srog shing mchog /sku tshe bsring zhabs pad yun brtan pa'i/ /las mi sgrub 'phrin las ci la dgongs/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /mgon snying rje can gyis legs dgongs nas/ /sna tshogs pa'i brdzu bag mi mdzad par/ /'gro 'dul gyi yang sprul gsal bo yi/ /dgyes 'dzum zhal ring min myur mjal stsol/ /mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs/ /rang 620

gnyis rnal 'byor mthus/ /rgol ngan kun rang sar zhi ba la/ /mthu nus rtsal zla bral drin can rje/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /zhing dag pa rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i/ /dpal sangs rgyas byang sems sras bcas kyis/ /mgon dam pa'i zhabs pad yun brtan pa'i/ /byen rlabs kyi mthu dpal chung ngam ci/ /grangs med pa'i zhi dang khro bo'i gar/ /sna tshogs par ston mdzad yi dam lhas/ /bstan 'gro'i mgon zhabs pad yun brtan pa'i/ /dngos grub cis mi stsol thugs rje chung / /gnas yul kun skyong mdzad dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyis/ /dam pa yi phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun/ /sel ba yi sdongs grogs cis ma byas/ /dpal ma mgon gza' rdor tshe ring mas/ /skye rgu yi phan bde'i srog shing mchog /sku tshe bsring zhabs pad yun brtan pa'i/ /las mi sgrub 'phrin las ci la dgongs/ /phas mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig rin po che/ /mgon snying rje can gyis legs dgongs nas/ /sna tshogs pa'i brdzu bag mi mdzad par/ /'gro 'dul gyi yang sprul gsal bo yi/ /dgyes 'dzum zhal ring min myur mjal stsol/ /mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs/ /rang 620

gzhan gyi dge tshogs zab mo'i mthus/ /'gro mgon gye yang sprul 'khrul med kyis/ /myur myur du rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces smre sngags gdungs dbyangs tshigs su bcad nas smras so// de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po de chos kyi dbyangs spros pa dang bral ba'i klong du mnal bar gyur ma thag 'jig rten gyi khams 'di stong pa ltar ltos bcas rnams kyis skyabs dang /mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa su zhig yod zer zhing / la la dag smre sngags dang cho nge drag tu 'debs shing lus sa la drag tu rdeb cing mgo lus sogs 'bral lam snyam pa dang / la la dran pa nyams shing brgyal ba dang myos pa dang / yid blong blong bor shugs ring nar nar byed/ la la dran bsam gang yang med pa hang rig ge gnas kyang thabs kyis dbul bas/ thugs dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ngang las dus dang rnam pa kun tu g.yo ba mi mnga' phyir thugs dam gsal 'debs sogs kyi dgos pa ma mchis kyang / bdag cag rnams nas snang mched thob pa'i ye shes sgrib rkyen dang bral ba'i stong pa gsum gyi 'od gsal gyi mthar thug dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku'i 'od gsal mngon du mdzad de/ g.yo ba med par re zhig bdag cag la brtse bar dgongs te bzhugs pa dang / rim gyis mi shigs zung 'jug kha 621

sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku mngon du mdzad de/ nam mkha' ji srid kyi bar du sprul pa'i rol pa bsam yas rgyun mi 'chad du ston pa dang / khyad par zhing 'dir bdag cag rnams kyi mgon du ring min mchog gi sprul sku'i rang zhal 'khrul bral ston dgos tshul sogs kyi gsol 'debs nan tan du zhus shing / bdag gis yang sprul myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs shig kyang bris nas/ mkhan chen pa dang dpon slob 'gas kyang gdungs shugs drag pos gsol ba btab cing / sgo dmar ri khrod pa sogs dge 'dun pa brgyad grwa tsam gyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chog rnam par dag pa'i sgos sku gdung rin po che dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor byas spyan 'dren khrus gsol mchod 'bul sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs nan tan du zhus/thag nye ba'i phyogs phyogs nas dad can gyi skya ser pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa thon nas/ gdungs pa'i smre sngags bton nas ngu 'bod rgyun mi 'chad du bsgrags pas/ mi snyan pa'i sgras srid pa'i khyon kun gang snyam pa byung / de nas gnyer ba rab byung dang / zhabs phyi stag yan/ kun dga' don grub sogs kyis brda sprad nas/ mgar rtse dang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa rnams sku gdung gdan 'dren du thon 'phral/ sku gdung rin 622

po che phebs byang du bkod de/ gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil bar gdan drangs shing / tshur mthong gi blo ngo dang bstun te rong bo'i grwa tshang gi gser khri rin po che blo bzang thogs med tshul khrims gdan drangs te/ thugs dam gsal 'debs dang 'dod don gong ltar gsol bar mdzad pa bzhin/ nyin zhag dgu'i bar du thugs ga'i drod ma yal zhing / sgu gzi mdangs dang ldan pa'i ngos rkyen gang gis kyang badzi ba med par 'od gsal chos kyi sku las mi g.yo bar mnyam par bzhag cing / gdod zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa'i brdar khams dmar shangs sgo nas cher babs shing / gzi mdangs cung zad nyams shing tshul khrims kyi ngad chung du song snyam pa sogs mtshan ma gsal bar mdzad do/ /nged dang / sgo dmar ri khrod pa/ ye shes dar rgyas/ 'jigs med tshul khrims/ blo bzang mkhas mchog rnams rgyun par gdung mdun nas sred zhi'i ched du bsdad nas/ spos mar me/zhal zas/ yon chab sogs dngos po ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rgyun chad med par phul/ de'i zhor la nged kyis hor sprul sku dang / bya bral dge slong blo gros sogs sgrub pa la gzhol ba mang po dang lhan du klong snying bla ma mchod pa dang / rdor sems thugs sgrub/ sku gsum zhi khro rnams kyi sgo nas sgu gdung rin po 623
