che dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor dmigs nas bdag 'jug len pa/tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor/ gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i yang sprul myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs rnams nyin re bzhin chag med du byas/ de bzhin du skal ldan rang grol sprul sku/ mar phyag sprul sku dge 'dun lhun grub sogs 'dus pa nyi shu tsam gyis grub mchog lu i pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog lha drug cu ma'i bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor bsngo smon gsol 'debs sogs gnang / zhi bar mnal ba'i gnas tshul thos ma thag 'di ltar thar pa la rgyab kyis bde bde 'gro mi'i lus la brten nas ngan song gsum gyi g.yang kha 'grim du nye ba re gnyis tsam las/ stod dza ti'i rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa nas/ smad rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thug gi bar gyi skye 'gro rnams gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa'i gdul zhing du ma gyur pa 'ga' yang med gshis/ gnas kyis ring du brgal ba dag ma gtogs/ reb gong stod smad rma pha ri tshur kha sgo me/ khri ka hor tshang / 'bal mang ra/ mgo log stod smad sogs kyi dad ldan bla dpon ser skya pho mo rnams dbyar dus kyi sprin chen lhongs pa ltar sku gdung rin po cher mjal bar lhags shing / ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung kun 624

che dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor dmigs nas bdag 'jug len pa/tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor/ gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i yang sprul myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs rnams nyin re bzhin chag med du byas/ de bzhin du skal ldan rang grol sprul sku/ mar phyag sprul sku dge 'dun lhun grub sogs 'dus pa nyi shu tsam gyis grub mchog lu i pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog lha drug cu ma'i bdag 'jug tshogs 'khor bsngo smon gsol 'debs sogs gnang / zhi bar mnal ba'i gnas tshul thos ma thag 'di ltar thar pa la rgyab kyis bde bde 'gro mi'i lus la brten nas ngan song gsum gyi g.yang kha 'grim du nye ba re gnyis tsam las/ stod dza ti'i rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa nas/ smad rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thug gi bar gyi skye 'gro rnams gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa'i gdul zhing du ma gyur pa 'ga' yang med gshis/ gnas kyis ring du brgal ba dag ma gtogs/ reb gong stod smad rma pha ri tshur kha sgo me/ khri ka hor tshang / 'bal mang ra/ mgo log stod smad sogs kyi dad ldan bla dpon ser skya pho mo rnams dbyar dus kyi sprin chen lhongs pa ltar sku gdung rin po cher mjal bar lhags shing / ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung kun 624

bzang mchod pa'i rjes su zhugs shing / sems khong du chud pas/kye ma bla ma/ kye ma rje btsun/ 'gro ba yongs la ma bu ltar brtse ba/ dgra gnyen la byams sdang mi mnga' ba'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dam pa gang du gshegs/ bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can 'di rnams snying re mi rje'am/ thugs rje re chung zhes smre sngags dang cho nge'i sgras nam mkha'i glang po glal ba'i sgra yang zil gyis gnon bzhin pa'i ngos nas la las ni phyag 'tshal/ la las ni mchod pa 'bul/ la las ni sdig pa bshags/la las ni gsol 'debs dang skor ba byed pa sogs la brtson pa sogs rang mkhos dang bstun pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs dang tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la brtson par byas/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag tu mdo smad yul nas/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris tshun gyi dad ldan rnams kyis yod dgu'i zas nor dang / gces dgu'i lus ngag gi zhabs tog sgrub mkhan sha stag tu song gshis/dngos po la bdag bzung mdzad rgyu yin na ngal gso'i bu'i mdzod kyi khengs pa yang 'phrog snyam yong kyang / sngon byon ston pa'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'brangs nas sku tshe gang por ngan slong brgya phrag las brgal ba dang / bya btang sgom chen pa stong 625

bzang mchod pa'i rjes su zhugs shing / sems khong du chud pas/kye ma bla ma/ kye ma rje btsun/ 'gro ba yongs la ma bu ltar brtse ba/ dgra gnyen la byams sdang mi mnga' ba'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dam pa gang du gshegs/ bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can 'di rnams snying re mi rje'am/ thugs rje re chung zhes smre sngags dang cho nge'i sgras nam mkha'i glang po glal ba'i sgra yang zil gyis gnon bzhin pa'i ngos nas la las ni phyag 'tshal/ la las ni mchod pa 'bul/ la las ni sdig pa bshags/la las ni gsol 'debs dang skor ba byed pa sogs la brtson pa sogs rang mkhos dang bstun pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs dang tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la brtson par byas/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag tu mdo smad yul nas/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris tshun gyi dad ldan rnams kyis yod dgu'i zas nor dang / gces dgu'i lus ngag gi zhabs tog sgrub mkhan sha stag tu song gshis/dngos po la bdag bzung mdzad rgyu yin na ngal gso'i bu'i mdzod kyi khengs pa yang 'phrog snyam yong kyang / sngon byon ston pa'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'brangs nas sku tshe gang por ngan slong brgya phrag las brgal ba dang / bya btang sgom chen pa stong 625

rtsa mang po lto gos chos gsum gyis skyong bar mdzad cing / lo gcig 'dangs tsam pa'i nyer spyad las tshags mi mdzad par dngos po ji tsam 'byor ba de tsam gyis mchod sbyin yang rlabs po che mdzad pa'i bya ba btang ba'i brtul zhugs kho na gnang gshis/ gdung mchod sogs rgya chen gtong ba'i yo byad kyis dben par gyur kyang / 'dod la mi ster mi 'dod pa la srungs/zhes pa ltar bla dpon ser skya mchog dman thams cad nas mchod pa'i yo byad du rta dre'u/ mdzo mdzo mo 'bri g.yag ra lug ja mar ras dā bu dkar dmar gos phrug ha sag dngul byu ru/ nas rtsam pa gro ma khur ba/ phye 'phyur ba/ ja nag dong tse sogs bsam las 'das pa khyer byung ba dang / dbus gtsang nas 'ongs pa'i grwa btsun rnams dang / ri khrod pa rnams kyis rang rang gi dngos po phul ba thams cad nas phran tshegs kyang chud zos su ma btang bar mkhan rin po che dang / kun dga'/gnyer ba rab byung / nyang gi mtshams pa/ rtsa dge sogs nas kha 'go byas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa dang / sngags mang gi 'grigs bdag nas las byed pa bgyis te/ shar thams cad mkhyen pa dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs kyi mdun du mchod 'bul khyer/ gzhan mgar rtse sku gzhogs/ rgyal mkhan 626

rtsa mang po lto gos chos gsum gyis skyong bar mdzad cing / lo gcig 'dangs tsam pa'i nyer spyad las tshags mi mdzad par dngos po ji tsam 'byor ba de tsam gyis mchod sbyin yang rlabs po che mdzad pa'i bya ba btang ba'i brtul zhugs kho na gnang gshis/ gdung mchod sogs rgya chen gtong ba'i yo byad kyis dben par gyur kyang / 'dod la mi ster mi 'dod pa la srungs/zhes pa ltar bla dpon ser skya mchog dman thams cad nas mchod pa'i yo byad du rta dre'u/ mdzo mdzo mo 'bri g.yag ra lug ja mar ras dā bu dkar dmar gos phrug ha sag dngul byu ru/ nas rtsam pa gro ma khur ba/ phye 'phyur ba/ ja nag dong tse sogs bsam las 'das pa khyer byung ba dang / dbus gtsang nas 'ongs pa'i grwa btsun rnams dang / ri khrod pa rnams kyis rang rang gi dngos po phul ba thams cad nas phran tshegs kyang chud zos su ma btang bar mkhan rin po che dang / kun dga'/gnyer ba rab byung / nyang gi mtshams pa/ rtsa dge sogs nas kha 'go byas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa dang / sngags mang gi 'grigs bdag nas las byed pa bgyis te/ shar thams cad mkhyen pa dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs kyi mdun du mchod 'bul khyer/ gzhan mgar rtse sku gzhogs/ rgyal mkhan 626

chen/ chu dmar che chung sogs bla chen mang po dang / mgar rtse grwa tshang shug nyin ri khrod/ tsha rgyal/ dge steng / sa dkar shar/shel dgon lug rwa/ bkra shis 'khyil dge 'phel la sogs pa'i dgon khag mang po gdan drangs zhabs tog phul bas/ khong rnams nas kyang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid du sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bsnyen cing gsol ba 'debs pa/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ yang sprul gsal ba myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs sogs gdung shugs drag pos gnad smin du bskyangs/ grub dbang nam mkha' rgya mtsho dang / mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ tsho 'du mkhan po/ dgu rong sprul sku/ a dar sprul sku/ ri rtsa'i sku skyes/pad+ma rang grol yang sprul/ mkha' 'gro dgyes pa rdo rje sogs mkhas grub mang pos klong snying bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang /mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo/ zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba/ rta phag yid bzhin nor bu rnams kyi sgo nas tshogs brgya bskang brgya bdag dbang len pa dang / khyad par mchog gi sprul sku rtsod bral gsal dwangs nges pa rnyed pa myur du 'byon pa'i thugs smon gyi gsol 'debs bden tshig gis rim pa nan cher yang yang bgyes/ rong bo'i dgon chen gyi gtsos sgrub sde bco brgyad dang / dgon lhag rnams la mang ja'i thebs gang yod phul/627

chen/ chu dmar che chung sogs bla chen mang po dang / mgar rtse grwa tshang shug nyin ri khrod/ tsha rgyal/ dge steng / sa dkar shar/shel dgon lug rwa/ bkra shis 'khyil dge 'phel la sogs pa'i dgon khag mang po gdan drangs zhabs tog phul bas/ khong rnams nas kyang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid du sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bsnyen cing gsol ba 'debs pa/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ yang sprul gsal ba myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs sogs gdung shugs drag pos gnad smin du bskyangs/ grub dbang nam mkha' rgya mtsho dang / mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ tsho 'du mkhan po/ dgu rong sprul sku/ a dar sprul sku/ ri rtsa'i sku skyes/pad+ma rang grol yang sprul/ mkha' 'gro dgyes pa rdo rje sogs mkhas grub mang pos klong snying bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang /mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo/ zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba/ rta phag yid bzhin nor bu rnams kyi sgo nas tshogs brgya bskang brgya bdag dbang len pa dang / khyad par mchog gi sprul sku rtsod bral gsal dwangs nges pa rnyed pa myur du 'byon pa'i thugs smon gyi gsol 'debs bden tshig gis rim pa nan cher yang yang bgyes/ rong bo'i dgon chen gyi gtsos sgrub sde bco brgyad dang / dgon lhag rnams la mang ja'i thebs gang yod phul/627

gdung mjal du lhags pa'i ser skya khri phrag brgal ba la snga phyi rim can du 'ong ba rnams la bza' btung gis tshim par byas shing / ngan slong drug brgya tsam la nyin re bzhin ja thug bzhi re btang / bde ba can gyi lha khang gi mdun ngos sa khod yangs pa der nyang gi mtshams pa dang / sgo dmar ri khrod pa nas sa brtags sbyangs 'dul ba lto 'phye mchod pa'i rim pa rnams byas/dgu rong sprul sku mchog gis kha 'go gnang nas grwa btsun rnams kyis rdo dang gyo mog las pur khang mchod rten gyi dbyibs can cha tshad sogs lung dang mthun par brtsigs/ de nas bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes shing lung rig yon tan du ma'i mdzod kyis phyug pa'i sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po che gdan drangs/ dus 'khor ba'i snon zla/ hor lugs kyi chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i snga dro'i cha la sku gdung rin po che zhugs la sbyangs rgyu'i nyer bsdogs ma tshang ba med pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i ji ltar 'os pa 'du bgyis te/ pur khang du spyan drangs pa na/ a myes gnyan dmar nas se ku bya khyung dang za lung / gong mo'i rtse nas bzung mtha' dbus thams cad 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i za 'og gi gur la co 'dri ba ltar 'then zhing / nam mkha'i mdangs mthing zhun gyis byugs pa 628

gdung mjal du lhags pa'i ser skya khri phrag brgal ba la snga phyi rim can du 'ong ba rnams la bza' btung gis tshim par byas shing / ngan slong drug brgya tsam la nyin re bzhin ja thug bzhi re btang / bde ba can gyi lha khang gi mdun ngos sa khod yangs pa der nyang gi mtshams pa dang / sgo dmar ri khrod pa nas sa brtags sbyangs 'dul ba lto 'phye mchod pa'i rim pa rnams byas/dgu rong sprul sku mchog gis kha 'go gnang nas grwa btsun rnams kyis rdo dang gyo mog las pur khang mchod rten gyi dbyibs can cha tshad sogs lung dang mthun par brtsigs/ de nas bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes shing lung rig yon tan du ma'i mdzod kyis phyug pa'i sku gzhogs bsam 'grub rin po che gdan drangs/ dus 'khor ba'i snon zla/ hor lugs kyi chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i snga dro'i cha la sku gdung rin po che zhugs la sbyangs rgyu'i nyer bsdogs ma tshang ba med pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i ji ltar 'os pa 'du bgyis te/ pur khang du spyan drangs pa na/ a myes gnyan dmar nas se ku bya khyung dang za lung / gong mo'i rtse nas bzung mtha' dbus thams cad 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i za 'og gi gur la co 'dri ba ltar 'then zhing / nam mkha'i mdangs mthing zhun gyis byugs pa 628

ltar gsal zhing dwangs par gyur pa ni 'od gsal chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin du sgyu ma longs skur bzhengs pa'i brda rtags gdul bya'i mos ngor gsal bar mdzad pa yin la/ reg bya 'jam pa'i dri bzhon shar phyogs nas nub phyogs su g.yo ba'i sgra 'ur 'ur ba rgyun ring zhing 'jam pa g.yo ba ni/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams sku gdung mchod pa'i phyir lhags pa'i ltas su gor ma chag go /sku gzhogs rin po che zhabs phyi grwa tshang dbu mdzad sogs brgyad grwa dang bcas pas rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ gdung sgrub dang pur sbyong ba'i cho ga lha sngags ting 'dzin gyi ngar dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa spud de/zhugs la sbyangs pa na sgu las 'od zer dpag med bkyes te/khams gsum ma lus pa khyab par mdzad nas ngan song la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ba'i rigs sbyangs nas bde ba la bkod/slar sku la thim ma thag lte ba nas ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga ldan du rang 'bar du gyur pas/ gdung dud kyang 'o ma 'phyur ba ltar dkar ba la bai ḍūr+ya'i mdangs kyis brgyan pa lta bu dbus drang thad du 'then zhing / gdugs ltar chags pa rim gyis nub 629

ltar gsal zhing dwangs par gyur pa ni 'od gsal chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin du sgyu ma longs skur bzhengs pa'i brda rtags gdul bya'i mos ngor gsal bar mdzad pa yin la/ reg bya 'jam pa'i dri bzhon shar phyogs nas nub phyogs su g.yo ba'i sgra 'ur 'ur ba rgyun ring zhing 'jam pa g.yo ba ni/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams sku gdung mchod pa'i phyir lhags pa'i ltas su gor ma chag go /sku gzhogs rin po che zhabs phyi grwa tshang dbu mdzad sogs brgyad grwa dang bcas pas rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ gdung sgrub dang pur sbyong ba'i cho ga lha sngags ting 'dzin gyi ngar dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa spud de/zhugs la sbyangs pa na sgu las 'od zer dpag med bkyes te/khams gsum ma lus pa khyab par mdzad nas ngan song la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ba'i rigs sbyangs nas bde ba la bkod/slar sku la thim ma thag lte ba nas ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga ldan du rang 'bar du gyur pas/ gdung dud kyang 'o ma 'phyur ba ltar dkar ba la bai ḍūr+ya'i mdangs kyis brgyan pa lta bu dbus drang thad du 'then zhing / gdugs ltar chags pa rim gyis nub 629

phyogs su 'khor lo nor bu glang po che sogs rgyal srid sna bdun gyi rnam par 'then zhing / me lce rnams byu ru'i sdong bo la g.yu'i yal gas 'khyud pa ltar/ me byengs dmar zhing rtsa ba sngo ba/mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su 'bar bas dri bzang bos khor yug kun khyab par gyur la/ bya rog cig 'ongs nas bde ba can gyi lha khang gi gser 'phru'i thum bsal ba dang / gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'dab chags kyi rnam par gdung khang gi steng gi mkha' la lding zhing 'khor nas yun ring gnas pa dang / bya rgod thang dkar zhig gang nas 'ong cha med par g.yas bskor du lding zhing je mtho je mthor song ste shar phyogs su thal gyis song ba dang / dbang po'i gzhu 'khor lo ltar zlum pa dkyil dra mig can mu 'khyud kyi mtha' ma za ra tshag chun 'phyang 'phan la sogs pa dpyangs pa/ yud tsam zhig 'khor zhing gdugs ltar phub pa sogs/ der 'tshogs pa rnams la mthong snang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa byung bas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bla lhag 'phel zhing / dad med rnams kyi shes rgyud la yang dad pa'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad do/ /de nas gdung khang gi sgo bsdams te nyi ma lnga'i bar la mchod cing khrus gsol ba sogs sri zhu bgyes te/ tshes bco lnga'i 630

phyogs su 'khor lo nor bu glang po che sogs rgyal srid sna bdun gyi rnam par 'then zhing / me lce rnams byu ru'i sdong bo la g.yu'i yal gas 'khyud pa ltar/ me byengs dmar zhing rtsa ba sngo ba/mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su 'bar bas dri bzang bos khor yug kun khyab par gyur la/ bya rog cig 'ongs nas bde ba can gyi lha khang gi gser 'phru'i thum bsal ba dang / gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'dab chags kyi rnam par gdung khang gi steng gi mkha' la lding zhing 'khor nas yun ring gnas pa dang / bya rgod thang dkar zhig gang nas 'ong cha med par g.yas bskor du lding zhing je mtho je mthor song ste shar phyogs su thal gyis song ba dang / dbang po'i gzhu 'khor lo ltar zlum pa dkyil dra mig can mu 'khyud kyi mtha' ma za ra tshag chun 'phyang 'phan la sogs pa dpyangs pa/ yud tsam zhig 'khor zhing gdugs ltar phub pa sogs/ der 'tshogs pa rnams la mthong snang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa byung bas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bla lhag 'phel zhing / dad med rnams kyi shes rgyud la yang dad pa'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad do/ /de nas gdung khang gi sgo bsdams te nyi ma lnga'i bar la mchod cing khrus gsol ba sogs sri zhu bgyes te/ tshes bco lnga'i 630

nyin mkhan rin po che dang / dgu rong sprul sku/ nged dpon slob nyung shas shig gis gdung zhal phyes pa'i tshe phyag gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i sku stod kyi cha phal cher dang khyad du 'phags pa'i gdung rnams mi snang bas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang /lha klu mthu bo che rnams kyis rang rang gi gnas su phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing du gdan drangs song bar snang / bdag cag rnams kyi bgo skal du gyur pa ni sku smad dang / dbu thod tshal bu nyung shas lus pa dag la sku gdung ring bsrel byon pa'i tshul ni/bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma la/ /dbu ma'i dbyings su dbu ma 'gro/ /shi ltas nam mkha' dwangs pa yin/ /tshul khrims gtsang la me tog 'bab/ /byang chub sems la ring bsrel 'dzag /bskyed rim can la lha sku 'byon/ /khrims gtsang phung po gtsang ma ste/ /lha rnams kun gyes bsu bar byed/ /phyir mi ldog la dung 'khyil ste/ /'khor ba mi spongs sems dpa' la/ /thugs dang ljags na 'byon par 'gyur/ /spyir ni dam pa gshegs / la/ /lha yi snga ltas 'ja' 'od 'byung / /gnas lugs snga ltas sprin med yin/ /zhes dang / sku —gdung 'bar ba las/ rigs ldan mya ngan 'das pa la/ /de yi lhag ma'i zag bcas kyi/ /phung po'i rjen shul bsregs sbyangs 631

nyin mkhan rin po che dang / dgu rong sprul sku/ nged dpon slob nyung shas shig gis gdung zhal phyes pa'i tshe phyag gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i sku stod kyi cha phal cher dang khyad du 'phags pa'i gdung rnams mi snang bas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang /lha klu mthu bo che rnams kyis rang rang gi gnas su phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing du gdan drangs song bar snang / bdag cag rnams kyi bgo skal du gyur pa ni sku smad dang / dbu thod tshal bu nyung shas lus pa dag la sku gdung ring bsrel byon pa'i tshul ni/bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma la/ /dbu ma'i dbyings su dbu ma 'gro/ /shi ltas nam mkha' dwangs pa yin/ /tshul khrims gtsang la me tog 'bab/ /byang chub sems la ring bsrel 'dzag /bskyed rim can la lha sku 'byon/ /khrims gtsang phung po gtsang ma ste/ /lha rnams kun gyes bsu bar byed/ /phyir mi ldog la dung 'khyil ste/ /'khor ba mi spongs sems dpa' la/ /thugs dang ljags na 'byon par 'gyur/ /spyir ni dam pa gshegs / la/ /lha yi snga ltas 'ja' 'od 'byung / /gnas lugs snga ltas sprin med yin/ /zhes dang / sku gdung 'bar ba las/ rigs ldan mya ngan 'das she la/ /de yi lhag ma'i zag bcas kyi/ /phung po'i rjen shul bsregs sbyangs 631

pas/ /de la sku ni rnam gnyis te/ /zhi ba'i sku dang khro bo'i sku/ /zhes dang / skyes mchog mya ngan 'das pa la/ /sangs rgyas kun gye gdung yang 'byung / /sangs rgyas rigs kyi khyad par las/ /gdung gi rigs ni lnga lnga 'byung / /sha rī ram ni bder gshegs gdung / /de bzhin ba rī ram zhes ni/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gdung ni yin/ /chu rī ram ni rin po che/ /bse rī ram ni pad+ma'o/ /de bzhin nya rī ram zhes bya/ /las kyi rigs kyi gdung yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par gdung rus kyi ngos dang / ring bsrel gong bur gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/bde mchog lhan skyes/ rta phag yab yum/ sgrol ma dzam nag sogs dang / rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ pi wang / 'bras bu can gyi sdong bo'i dbyibs can mang po byung / gdung rus las 'bur zhing thang la ma lhung ba'i gdung rigs lnga las kha dog mthing kha shas che ba lnga tshom dang sku'i dbyebs can sogs dang /ring bsrel phra mo bgrang las 'das pa phebs pas/ bdag sogs rnams kyi gnas skabs kyi mya ngan kyang sangs par mdzad cing dad pa'i spu long ches cher g.yo bar gyur pa'i bka' drin 'di gcig pu yang srid mtha'i bar du stong gsum rin bo che sna bdun gyis bkang ste bar ma chad du phul yang 'khor bar 632

pas/ /de la sku ni rnam gnyis te/ /zhi ba'i sku dang khro bo'i sku/ /zhes dang / skyes mchog mya ngan 'das pa la/ /sangs rgyas kun gye gdung yang 'byung / /sangs rgyas rigs kyi khyad par las/ /gdung gi rigs ni lnga lnga 'byung / /sha rī ram ni bder gshegs gdung / /de bzhin ba rī ram zhes ni/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gdung ni yin/ /chu rī ram ni rin po che/ /bse rī ram ni pad+ma'o/ /de bzhin nya rī ram zhes bya/ /las kyi rigs kyi gdung yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par gdung rus kyi ngos dang / ring bsrel gong bur gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/bde mchog lhan skyes/ rta phag yab yum/ sgrol ma dzam nag sogs dang / rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ pi wang / 'bras bu can gyi sdong bo'i dbyibs can mang po byung / gdung rus las 'bur zhing thang la ma lhung ba'i gdung rigs lnga las kha dog mthing kha shas che ba lnga tshom dang sku'i dbyebs can sogs dang /ring bsrel phra mo bgrang las 'das pa phebs pas/ bdag sogs rnams kyi gnas skabs kyi mya ngan kyang sangs par mdzad cing dad pa'i spu long ches cher g.yo bar gyur pa'i bka' drin 'di gcig pu yang srid mtha'i bar du stong gsum rin bo che sna bdun gyis bkang ste bar ma chad du phul yang 'khor bar 632

dka' ba nyid du 'khum cho// /de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po la gdung mchod la sogs nga/'i spros pa nye bar zhi ba ni bka' las byung ba ltar lags na'ang / rjes 'jug rnams kyis bsod nams bsags phyir dang / dam pa gang gi thugs dgongs zab mo gang yod yongs su rdzogs phyir/ bstan 'gro'i don du mchog gi sprul sku gsal bo myur du 'byon pa'i rten 'brel du dmigs nas/ yul dus dang myo/thun pa'i mchod sbyin byas pa'i song tho rags rim tsam bkod pa la/ ja lan chen nyer lnga/ gos phrug brgya lhag rta dre'u nyi shu/ mar rgya ma nyis stong lnga brgya tsam/ ras nyis brgya/ dā bu dkar dmar bzhi brgya/ phye rtsam do bo brgyad brgya/ snum nag rgya ma bdun brgya/ dong tse khron brgya lhag tsam dang / gzhan mchod rdzas yo byad kha dar sogs bgrang las 'das pa song ngo //de'i tshe bla ma rnams dang der 'khod kyi ri khrod pa grwa btsun mang po bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor ba bzhin phyogs phyogs su gyes song tshe/ nyang gi mtshams pas bla ma thugs rje can gyi sku'i dbyibs gsung gi gdangs/ thugs brtse bas gdul bya bskyangs tshul rnams dran nas mang po ngus mthar/ gdungs dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /lha snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /mgon bshes 633

dka' ba nyid du 'khum cho// /de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po la gdung mchod la sogs nga/'i spros pa nye bar zhi ba ni bka' las byung ba ltar lags na'ang / rjes 'jug rnams kyis bsod nams bsags phyir dang / dam pa gang gi thugs dgongs zab mo gang yod yongs su rdzogs phyir/ bstan 'gro'i don du mchog gi sprul sku gsal bo myur du 'byon pa'i rten 'brel du dmigs nas/ yul dus dang myo/thun pa'i mchod sbyin byas pa'i song tho rags rim tsam bkod pa la/ ja lan chen nyer lnga/ gos phrug brgya lhag rta dre'u nyi shu/ mar rgya ma nyis stong lnga brgya tsam/ ras nyis brgya/ dā bu dkar dmar bzhi brgya/ phye rtsam do bo brgyad brgya/ snum nag rgya ma bdun brgya/ dong tse khron brgya lhag tsam dang / gzhan mchod rdzas yo byad kha dar sogs bgrang las 'das pa song ngo //de'i tshe bla ma rnams dang der 'khod kyi ri khrod pa grwa btsun mang po bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor ba bzhin phyogs phyogs su gyes song tshe/ nyang gi mtshams pas bla ma thugs rje can gyi sku'i dbyibs gsung gi gdangs/ thugs brtse bas gdul bya bskyangs tshul rnams dran nas mang po ngus mthar/ gdungs dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /lha snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /mgon bshes 633

gnyen dam pa'i rnam rol pa/ /pha skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang / /bu'i gdungs dbyangs thal lo thugs rje can/ /spyir rgyal khams yongs la nyi ma nub/ /sgos skal chad bdag dang bdag 'dra yi/ /mig don snying dang bral dgos 'dod kyi/ /yid bzhin gye nor bu lag nas shor/ /bdag 'gro rnams mgon med skyabs med gyur/ /pha mtshan ldan bla mar gang nas mjal/ /da ci byed skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang / /bu'i gdungs pa sol cig bka' drin can/ /lhag bsam gyi rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /snying rje yi kho lag phyogs brgyar g.yo/ /gzhan phan gyi 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ /pha dpag bsam ljon shing glo bur 'gyel/ /dad gsum gyi rta bdun shugs kyis drangs/ /byams brtse yi 'od stong 'bum du 'gyed/ /skal ldan gyi gdul bya'i pad+mo skyongs/ /pha 'dzam gling nyi ma nub rir zhud/ /phyogs med kyi gdul bya bu ltar gzigs/ /zab rgyas kyi chos char 'gro la 'bebs/ /nyam thag gi 'gro ba rgyun du skyong / /pha mtshan ldan bla ma glo bur gshegs/ /gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rtse mo na/ /kha lho blta'i gzim khang nyams dga' na/ /rje bla ma bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /gnas de yi nye 'dabs chos ra nas/ /phyogs ris med dad 'dus stong phrag 634

gnyen dam pa'i rnam rol pa/ /pha skyabs mgon zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang / /bu'i gdungs dbyangs thal lo thugs rje can/ /spyir rgyal khams yongs la nyi ma nub/ /sgos skal chad bdag dang bdag 'dra yi/ /mig don snying dang bral dgos 'dod kyi/ /yid bzhin gye nor bu lag nas shor/ /bdag 'gro rnams mgon med skyabs med gyur/ /pha mtshan ldan bla mar gang nas mjal/ /da ci byed skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang / /bu'i gdungs pa sol cig bka' drin can/ /lhag bsam gyi rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /snying rje yi kho lag phyogs brgyar g.yo/ /gzhan phan gyi 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ /pha dpag bsam ljon shing glo bur 'gyel/ /dad gsum gyi rta bdun shugs kyis drangs/ /byams brtse yi 'od stong 'bum du 'gyed/ /skal ldan gyi gdul bya'i pad+mo skyongs/ /pha 'dzam gling nyi ma nub rir zhud/ /phyogs med kyi gdul bya bu ltar gzigs/ /zab rgyas kyi chos char 'gro la 'bebs/ /nyam thag gi 'gro ba rgyun du skyong / /pha mtshan ldan bla ma glo bur gshegs/ /gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rtse mo na/ /kha lho blta'i gzim khang nyams dga' na/ /rje bla ma bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /gnas de yi nye 'dabs chos ra nas/ /phyogs ris med dad 'dus stong phrag 634

la/ /chos dbang lung gnang tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /rang skabs skabs mdun du mjal dus su/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos legs gzigs nas/ /zhal 'dzum gyis bsu tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /gsung bslab byas dbugs dbyung gsol ras gnang / /chos zab rgyas bcud kyis smin mdzad de/ /rang 'dod pa skong tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sa mdo smad phyogs kyi dad ldan rnams/ /blo chos la bsgyur nas rten bzhengs sogs/ /chos dge la bskul tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /phyogs phyogs nas 'ong ba'i grwa btsun dang / /dman ngan slong lto gos chos gsum gyes/ /dus rgyun du skyong tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /nor dngos po phul tshad mi 'dzin par/ /yar dkon mchog mchod dang rten bzhengs dang / /mar dbul por sbyin tshul yid la shar/ ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /gnas sgrub gnas ri khrod nyams dga' rnams/ /khong slob ma bu chen mang pos bkang / /kun chos kyis bskyangs tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /grong ri dgon thams cad rten bzhengs dang / /chos smyung gnas 635

la/ /chos dbang lung gnang tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /rang skabs skabs mdun du mjal dus su/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos legs gzigs nas/ /zhal 'dzum gyis bsu tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /gsung bslab byas dbugs dbyung gsol ras gnang / /chos zab rgyas bcud kyis smin mdzad de/ /rang 'dod pa skong tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sa mdo smad phyogs kyi dad ldan rnams/ /blo chos la bsgyur nas rten bzhengs sogs/ /chos dge la bskul tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /phyogs phyogs nas 'ong ba'i grwa btsun dang / /dman ngan slong lto gos chos gsum gyes/ /dus rgyun du skyong tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /nor dngos po phul tshad mi 'dzin par/ /yar dkon mchog mchod dang rten bzhengs dang / /mar dbul por sbyin tshul yid la shar/ ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /gnas sgrub gnas ri khrod nyams dga' rnams/ /khong slob ma bu chen mang pos bkang / /kun chos kyis bskyangs tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /grong ri dgon thams cad rten bzhengs dang / /chos smyung gnas 635

ma ṇi'i rgyun bzang btsugs/ /phyag mchod par bsgul tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sa reb gong 'khrug pa yod tshad rnams/ /gsung bka' shog tsam res mthun par bsdums/ /kun bde bar bkod tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /yul kun tu lo legs 'ong ba'i phyir/ /char 'bebs sogs 'gro ba'i bde thabs gnang / /yul bde zhing skyid tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sa stod smad 'brel thogs pho mo yis/ /gsung bsgrubs nas dge bsgrub sdig spong gis/ /sa dkar por btang tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sku'i bkod pa bsdus tshe nam mkha' dwangs/ /'ja' kha dog lnga ldan rgyun du shar/ /kun snang ba 'gyur tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla dran/ /gdung ring bsrel lha sku yig 'bru sogs/ /ngo mtshar ba'i dngos grub bgo skal gyes/ /drin lhag par stsal tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /phyogs gang du song yang bla ma dran/ /sa gang du bsdad kyang bla ma dran/ /brda ji ltar shar yang bla ma dran/ /dus nyin mtshan kun tu bla ma dran/ /dran drags tshe sems kyis mi nus gi /dbugs stod du 'tshangs tshe mi non gi /mig mchi mas gang 636

ma ṇi'i rgyun bzang btsugs/ /phyag mchod par bsgul tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sa reb gong 'khrug pa yod tshad rnams/ /gsung bka' shog tsam res mthun par bsdums/ /kun bde bar bkod tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /yul kun tu lo legs 'ong ba'i phyir/ /char 'bebs sogs 'gro ba'i bde thabs gnang / /yul bde zhing skyid tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sa stod smad 'brel thogs pho mo yis/ /gsung bsgrubs nas dge bsgrub sdig spong gis/ /sa dkar por btang tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /sku'i bkod pa bsdus tshe nam mkha' dwangs/ /'ja' kha dog lnga ldan rgyun du shar/ /kun snang ba 'gyur tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla dran/ /gdung ring bsrel lha sku yig 'bru sogs/ /ngo mtshar ba'i dngos grub bgo skal gyes/ /drin lhag par stsal tshul yid la shar/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /phyogs gang du song yang bla ma dran/ /sa gang du bsdad kyang bla ma dran/ /brda ji ltar shar yang bla ma dran/ /dus nyin mtshan kun tu bla ma dran/ /dran drags tshe sems kyis mi nus gi /dbugs stod du 'tshangs tshe mi non gi /mig mchi mas gang 636

nas mi zungs gi /'de gzigs sam skyabs mgon snying rje'i gter/ /bu'i dran pa'i sems la bzod glags med/ /phas mi mngon dbyengs nas gsan lags sam/ /dus da lta nyams dang rmi lam du/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor myur du bstan du gsol/ /gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis bslab bya ston/ /thugs dgongs pas bdag la byin gyes rlobs// /bu skal dman bdag la sems gso gnongs/ /khyed gar bzhugs zhing khams de ru drongs/ /bus de ltar gdungs dbyangs blangs pa'i mthus/ /pha bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shing / /dus ring min sprul sku'i nyi gzhon gyis/ /bstan 'gro ba'i pad tshal legs skyong shog /de nas thugs sras dgu rong spru'/ skus bzo yon dang gser tshon phul nas/ shing bzo hwa shang gis dri bzang po'i shug pa las byang chub mchod rten bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa khang tshad tsam bskrun te/ dus tshes dge bar mkhan rin po che dang / nyang gi mtshams pa/ ye shes dar rgyas/ a khu kun dga'/ sangs rgyas rin chen bcas pas sku gdung ring bsrel rang byon rnams dang / rje'i phyag bris dgongs gzhi can sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos tshul bkod pa gnang ba bzhin/ sku gdung cha gsum du bgos te/ cha gcig dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs dang /637

nas mi zungs gi /'de gzigs sam skyabs mgon snying rje'i gter/ /bu'i dran pa'i sems la bzod glags med/ /phas mi mngon dbyengs nas gsan lags sam/ /dus da lta nyams dang rmi lam du/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor myur du bstan du gsol/ /gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis bslab bya ston/ /thugs dgongs pas bdag la byin gyes rlobs// /bu skal dman bdag la sems gso gnongs/ /khyed gar bzhugs zhing khams de ru drongs/ /bus de ltar gdungs dbyangs blangs pa'i mthus/ /pha bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shing / /dus ring min sprul sku'i nyi gzhon gyis/ /bstan 'gro ba'i pad tshal legs skyong shog /de nas thugs sras dgu rong spru'/ skus bzo yon dang gser tshon phul nas/ shing bzo hwa shang gis dri bzang po'i shug pa las byang chub mchod rten bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa khang tshad tsam bskrun te/ dus tshes dge bar mkhan rin po che dang / nyang gi mtshams pa/ ye shes dar rgyas/ a khu kun dga'/ sangs rgyas rin chen bcas pas sku gdung ring bsrel rang byon rnams dang / rje'i phyag bris dgongs gzhi can sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos tshul bkod pa gnang ba bzhin/ sku gdung cha gsum du bgos te/ cha gcig dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs dang /637

cha gcig mdo smad kyi dad ldan rnams la bgo rgyu byas/ cha gcig dang rje'i thugs dam kyi rten chos rgyal rin po che'i zhal gdams phyag rjes kyi rgyas btab pa/ kun bzang snying thig sogs rig khrod 'grims dus kyi phyag dpe pod chung gnyis dang /chos rgyal rin po ches stsal pa'i 'ja' shel byen can/ rtsa gsum gyi tsakli dang lhan du za ma tog tu 'du bgyis te/ gzhan ring bsrel rnam bzhi 'bul tshul sogs ma 'chol ma 'khrugs par/rgya bod mkhas grub du ma'i phyag srol ltar 'bul ba po gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa nyang mtshams rgya mtshos mchod sdong rin po cher bzhugs su gsol zhing skya bzo grub 'phral/ sprel zla'i tshes bcu la dpon slob 'gas yi dam rta mchog rol ba'i sgo nas/dngos sta nyin gnyis ma'i rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor bas/ sa g.yo ba dang 'ja'i gur me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang byung / rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la goms pa brtan pa'i dge slong ye shes dar rgyas kyis lha bzo ba bgyis te/ rin po che sna tshogs las spras pa'i mchod sdong /gser sbyangs btso ma las grub pa lta bu'i snyigs dus 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing mchog bla na med pa nyid du gsal bar byas te/ bya'i zla ba'i tshes bcu la tsho 'du 638

cha gcig mdo smad kyi dad ldan rnams la bgo rgyu byas/ cha gcig dang rje'i thugs dam kyi rten chos rgyal rin po che'i zhal gdams phyag rjes kyi rgyas btab pa/ kun bzang snying thig sogs rig khrod 'grims dus kyi phyag dpe pod chung gnyis dang /chos rgyal rin po ches stsal pa'i 'ja' shel byen can/ rtsa gsum gyi tsakli dang lhan du za ma tog tu 'du bgyis te/ gzhan ring bsrel rnam bzhi 'bul tshul sogs ma 'chol ma 'khrugs par/rgya bod mkhas grub du ma'i phyag srol ltar 'bul ba po gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa nyang mtshams rgya mtshos mchod sdong rin po cher bzhugs su gsol zhing skya bzo grub 'phral/ sprel zla'i tshes bcu la dpon slob 'gas yi dam rta mchog rol ba'i sgo nas/dngos sta nyin gnyis ma'i rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor bas/ sa g.yo ba dang 'ja'i gur me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang byung / rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la goms pa brtan pa'i dge slong ye shes dar rgyas kyis lha bzo ba bgyis te/ rin po che sna tshogs las spras pa'i mchod sdong /gser sbyangs btso ma las grub pa lta bu'i snyigs dus 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing mchog bla na med pa nyid du gsal bar byas te/ bya'i zla ba'i tshes bcu la tsho 'du 638

mkhan chen nas rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing / tshogs brgya dang brgya mchod sogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis mtha' rgyas su byas shing / de'i rjes su bdag dang / hor sprul sku/nyang gi mtshams pa/ ye shes dar rgyas/ bde chen ri khrod pa 'jigs med tshul khrims bcas dpon slob lngas/ zab lam 'khor sgrol gyi sgo nas rab gnas dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ nyin bdun gyi ring la bgyis nas tshogs brgya dang zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg bcas bsgrubs nas bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor yang dag pa byas/ rje'i mdzad pa'i tha ma mgar rtse'i jo bo'i lha khang du'ang jo bo yid bzhin nor bu gtso 'khor gsum/ 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso/ rje btsun sgol ma/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi sku brnyan sman 'dam las bzhengs pa dang / gnam rgyan la rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu reb gong yul gyi grub thob brgyad sogs kyi sku brnyan ri mor bris/ gser tshon bcas legs par mkhan rin po che dang /kun dga' nas khrums zla'i nang du lhag lus med par 'grub pa'i rgyu song la rdo tshad bcu'i rtsis song / mgar rtse grwa tshang nas rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing / bzo bo bcu phrag yon dang thog mtha'i dga' ston gyis mnyes par byas/ de'i rjes su 639

mkhan chen nas rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing / tshogs brgya dang brgya mchod sogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis mtha' rgyas su byas shing / de'i rjes su bdag dang / hor sprul sku/nyang gi mtshams pa/ ye shes dar rgyas/ bde chen ri khrod pa 'jigs med tshul khrims bcas dpon slob lngas/ zab lam 'khor sgrol gyi sgo nas rab gnas dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ nyin bdun gyi ring la bgyis nas tshogs brgya dang zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg bcas bsgrubs nas bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor yang dag pa byas/ rje'i mdzad pa'i tha ma mgar rtse'i jo bo'i lha khang du'ang jo bo yid bzhin nor bu gtso 'khor gsum/ 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso/ rje btsun sgol ma/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi sku brnyan sman 'dam las bzhengs pa dang / gnam rgyan la rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu reb gong yul gyi grub thob brgyad sogs kyi sku brnyan ri mor bris/ gser tshon bcas legs par mkhan rin po che dang /kun dga' nas khrums zla'i nang du lhag lus med par 'grub pa'i rgyu song la rdo tshad bcu'i rtsis song / mgar rtse grwa tshang nas rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing / bzo bo bcu phrag yon dang thog mtha'i dga' ston gyis mnyes par byas/ de'i rjes su 639

dam pa nyid dgongs pa chos dbyengs su bsdus pa'i sa a bo skyabs nas/ nyang gi mtshams pas kha 'go byas rgyal po dang / tsho 'du/ byang chub sogs kyi ser skya mchog dman thams cad kyis 'bad rtsol chen pos byang chub mchog gi mchod rten sa rdo shing gsum las grub pa tshad las 'das pa bzhengs/ bkra shis dge 'phel dgon pa/ 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal/ khyung dgon mi 'gyur rdo rje gling / bde skyid bsam gtan gling /mtsho gling pad+ma bkod/ mtshams khang bkra shis chos gling rnams kyis gtsos gdan sa dang / sngags khang 'du khang mang por sku gdung mchod rten che ba khang tshad lhag tsam dang / chung ba khru gsum bzhi tsam mang po bzhengs/ mdo smad du bkram rgyu'i sku gdung cha gcig reb gong stod smad bar gsum/ rma pha ri tshur kha rnams su dad ldan gdung rten bzheng thub tshad la bkram pas mchod rten che chung lnga brgya lhag tsam bzheng mkhan byung ngo / /sku gdung cha gcig bu chen kun dga' don grub kyis dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi dad can thams cad la phyag mchod dad pa'i rten du gdan drangs so/ /sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar dgos 'dod kun 'byung gis mtshon gsung 'bum par du ma 'khod pa rnams kyang / dam pa nyid nas thugs bkod yod pa 640

dam pa nyid dgongs pa chos dbyengs su bsdus pa'i sa a bo skyabs nas/ nyang gi mtshams pas kha 'go byas rgyal po dang / tsho 'du/ byang chub sogs kyi ser skya mchog dman thams cad kyis 'bad rtsol chen pos byang chub mchog gi mchod rten sa rdo shing gsum las grub pa tshad las 'das pa bzhengs/ bkra shis dge 'phel dgon pa/ 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal/ khyung dgon mi 'gyur rdo rje gling / bde skyid bsam gtan gling /mtsho gling pad+ma bkod/ mtshams khang bkra shis chos gling rnams kyis gtsos gdan sa dang / sngags khang 'du khang mang por sku gdung mchod rten che ba khang tshad lhag tsam dang / chung ba khru gsum bzhi tsam mang po bzhengs/ mdo smad du bkram rgyu'i sku gdung cha gcig reb gong stod smad bar gsum/ rma pha ri tshur kha rnams su dad ldan gdung rten bzheng thub tshad la bkram pas mchod rten che chung lnga brgya lhag tsam bzheng mkhan byung ngo / /sku gdung cha gcig bu chen kun dga' don grub kyis dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi dad can thams cad la phyag mchod dad pa'i rten du gdan drangs so/ /sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar dgos 'dod kun 'byung gis mtshon gsung 'bum par du ma 'khod pa rnams kyang / dam pa nyid nas thugs bkod yod pa 640

bzhin/ gnyer ba rab byung dang / sangs rgyas rin chen/ nged rang sogs shul du lus pa rnams kyis rang ngos nas ci 'byor dang / gzhan la bskul ba sogs thabs tshul du ma'i ngos nas legs par bsgrub la brtson bzhin mchis/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge tshogs bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor gsung gi rjes su zlos te/ 'khor gsum yongs dag chos dbyings spros bral mu mtha' med pa'i klong zad pa med pa'i gter du rgyas btab bo//smras pa/ zhal mthong tsam gyis 'gro ba'i las sgrib 'dag /tshangs dbyangs gsung gis chos kyi char ba 'bebs/ /thugs rje brtse bas gdul bya thar par 'dren/ /rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob drin can rje/ /zhing 'dir bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don la byon/ /sems can bgrang yas thar pa'i lam la bkod/ /mdzad pa 'phrin las thams cad mthar phyin nas/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i mdzad pa ni/ /sa ga zla bar dam pa'i chos char gyis/ /gdul bya'i yid kyi re ba bskangs pa'i mthar/ /rim bzhin 'gro don gnang zhing rong bor phebs/ /bsnyun tshul mdzad nas spron zla'i nyer lnga'i nyin/ /rgyal po'i sa cha a bo skyabs zhes par/ /bskyod de gzhi phab phyi nyin snga dro'i char/ /ngo 641

bzhin/ gnyer ba rab byung dang / sangs rgyas rin chen/ nged rang sogs shul du lus pa rnams kyis rang ngos nas ci 'byor dang / gzhan la bskul ba sogs thabs tshul du ma'i ngos nas legs par bsgrub la brtson bzhin mchis/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge tshogs bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor gsung gi rjes su zlos te/ 'khor gsum yongs dag chos dbyings spros bral mu mtha' med pa'i klong zad pa med pa'i gter du rgyas btab bo//smras pa/ zhal mthong tsam gyis 'gro ba'i las sgrib 'dag /tshangs dbyangs gsung gis chos kyi char ba 'bebs/ /thugs rje brtse bas gdul bya thar par 'dren/ /rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob drin can rje/ /zhing 'dir bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don la byon/ /sems can bgrang yas thar pa'i lam la bkod/ /mdzad pa 'phrin las thams cad mthar phyin nas/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i mdzad pa ni/ /sa ga zla bar dam pa'i chos char gyis/ /gdul bya'i yid kyi re ba bskangs pa'i mthar/ /rim bzhin 'gro don gnang zhing rong bor phebs/ /bsnyun tshul mdzad nas spron zla'i nyer lnga'i nyin/ /rgyal po'i sa cha a bo skyabs zhes par/ /bskyod de gzhi phab phyi nyin snga dro'i char/ /ngo 641

mtshar ltas dang bcas par gzugs sku yi/ /bkod pa bsdus tshe ci bya gtol med gyur/ /bkra shis 'khyil du sku gdung gdan drang te/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /mdo smad phyogs kyi skye bo du ma yis/ /rgyu nor dngos po gya nom phul ba rnams/ /bsdus nas dgongs rdzogs mchod sbyin rgya chen btang / /sku pur zhugs la sbyangs tshe 'ja' 'od 'khrigs/ /sku gdung ring bsrel lha sku phebs pa rnams/ /cha gsum bgos nas mchod rten grangs med bzhengs/ /gsung bkod ji bzhin rten bzhengs 'phro rnams dang / /gsung 'bum par la 'khod dang ngan slong skyong / /gdan sa'i do dam sogs la brtson bzhin pa'i/ /ngang nas dge tshogs bsngo smon rgya yis btab/ /bskal pa brgya khrir btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /da ni dngos su mjal rgyu'i skal ba rdzogs/ /slad nas sprul sku'i gser zhal mjal bar shog /mgon de'i mdzad bzang rgya mtsho lta bu las/ /tha ma'i rnam thar chu thigs lta bu zhig /ma 'ongs gdul bya'i dad pa'i gsos su sbyar/ /'di yi dge bas thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shog /rnam thar yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid kyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la sman pa dang / /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs 'bru nor 'phel/ /642

mtshar ltas dang bcas par gzugs sku yi/ /bkod pa bsdus tshe ci bya gtol med gyur/ /bkra shis 'khyil du sku gdung gdan drang te/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /mdo smad phyogs kyi skye bo du ma yis/ /rgyu nor dngos po gya nom phul ba rnams/ /bsdus nas dgongs rdzogs mchod sbyin rgya chen btang / /sku pur zhugs la sbyangs tshe 'ja' 'od 'khrigs/ /sku gdung ring bsrel lha sku phebs pa rnams/ /cha gsum bgos nas mchod rten grangs med bzhengs/ /gsung bkod ji bzhin rten bzhengs 'phro rnams dang / /gsung 'bum par la 'khod dang ngan slong skyong / /gdan sa'i do dam sogs la brtson bzhin pa'i/ /ngang nas dge tshogs bsngo smon rgya yis btab/ /bskal pa brgya khrir btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /da ni dngos su mjal rgyu'i skal ba rdzogs/ /slad nas sprul sku'i gser zhal mjal bar shog /mgon de'i mdzad bzang rgya mtsho lta bu las/ /tha ma'i rnam thar chu thigs lta bu zhig /ma 'ongs gdul bya'i dad pa'i gsos su sbyar/ /'di yi dge bas thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shog /rnam thar yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid kyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la sman pa dang / /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs 'bru nor 'phel/ /642

bde skyid dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog gi sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshul blo ldan dran pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dam pa gang gi nye gnas dam pa blo bzang shes rab dang / mchog dman yongs la brtse ba'i gnyer ba rab byung / ngang rgyud ring zhing chos la dad pa'i kun dga'/ dam tsheg gtsang zhing brtson 'grus phul byung lha khang dbu mdzad/ rnam dkar dge la brtson zhing chos srid 'byor ba rgyas pa'i ngag dbang bkra shis sogs dad ldan du mas rab dkar lha rdzas bcas nan chen pos bskul ngor/ rang la nges pa rnams rags rim zin bris bgyis shing / mi nges pa rnams sku mdun pa dang zhabs phyi pa'i ngag sgos kyis zur brgyan/ gong 'og gi legs pa'i cha tshigs su bcad pa rnams sangs rgyas rin chen gyis/ bgyis nas/ sgrig pa po dam pa gang de'i zhabs rdul spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan du thob pa'i spyang lung sprul ming khyab gdal klong yangs su 'bod pas/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i dam pa'i gdan sa dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /rang gzhan yongs la byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ /mgon po 643

bde skyid dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog gi sku tshe tha ma'i rnam thar byung tshul blo ldan dran pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dam pa gang gi nye gnas dam pa blo bzang shes rab dang / mchog dman yongs la brtse ba'i gnyer ba rab byung / ngang rgyud ring zhing chos la dad pa'i kun dga'/ dam tsheg gtsang zhing brtson 'grus phul byung lha khang dbu mdzad/ rnam dkar dge la brtson zhing chos srid 'byor ba rgyas pa'i ngag dbang bkra shis sogs dad ldan du mas rab dkar lha rdzas bcas nan chen pos bskul ngor/ rang la nges pa rnams rags rim zin bris bgyis shing / mi nges pa rnams sku mdun pa dang zhabs phyi pa'i ngag sgos kyis zur brgyan/ gong 'og gi legs pa'i cha tshigs su bcad pa rnams sangs rgyas rin chen gyis/ bgyis nas/ sgrig pa po dam pa gang de'i zhabs rdul spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan du thob pa'i spyang lung sprul ming khyab gdal klong yangs su 'bod pas/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i dam pa'i gdan sa dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /rang gzhan yongs la byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ /mgon po 643

gang de'i rnam thar dbang gi rgyal/ /gcig las du mar spel ba'i par gyi rgyun/ /bskrun pa'i byed po gnyer ba bla spyon sogs/ /par rkon bco lnga tsam gyis legs par bsgrubs/ /mthun rkyen a mgron sprul sku lha bzo sogs/ /rong dang 'brog pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis phul/ /mi zad 'dod 'byung par gyi nor bu 'di/ /bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyal mtshan rtse na bzhugs/ /'di yi dge bas rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /'brel thogs thams cad sangs rgyas myur 'thob shog /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /kun kyang bde skyid chos la spyod pa yi/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog / 644

gang de'i rnam thar dbang gi rgyal/ /gcig las du mar spel ba'i par gyi rgyun/ /bskrun pa'i byed po gnyer ba bla spyon sogs/ /par rkon bco lnga tsam gyis legs par bsgrubs/ /mthun rkyen a mgron sprul sku lha bzo sogs/ /rong dang 'brog pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis phul/ /mi zad 'dod 'byung par gyi nor bu 'di/ /bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyal mtshan rtse na bzhugs/ /'di yi dge bas rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /'brel thogs thams cad sangs rgyas myur 'thob shog /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /kun kyang bde skyid chos la spyod pa yi/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog / 644

༄༅ / /rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsang ba'i rtogs brjod man+da ra ba'i phreng ba de kho na nyid snang ba 'phags ma'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//dag pa nyis ldan spros bral chos kyi sku/ /nges pa lnga ldan lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs/ /mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum bdag nyid 'khor lo'i mgon der 'dud/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa shākya'i tog /gang de'i bstan pa lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin skyong spel mdzad rig grol 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyes dge legs stsol/ /zung 'jug spros bral tshogs gnyis rang mdangs las/ /khams drug snang cha'i gzugs sku ngom pa can/ /rang grol rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob zhabs dkar rje/ /byang chub bar du snying kha'i pad mtshor rol/ /bde chen lhan 645

༄༅ / /rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsang ba'i rtogs brjod man+da ra ba'i phreng ba de kho na nyid snang ba 'phags ma'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//dag pa nyis ldan spros bral chos kyi sku/ /nges pa lnga ldan lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs/ /mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum bdag nyid 'khor lo'i mgon der 'dud/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa shākya'i tog /gang de'i bstan pa lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin skyong spel mdzad rig grol 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyes dge legs stsol/ /zung 'jug spros bral tshogs gnyis rang mdangs las/ /khams drug snang cha'i gzugs sku ngom pa can/ /rang grol rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob zhabs dkar rje/ /byang chub bar du snying kha'i pad mtshor rol/ /bde chen lhan 645

skyes ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/ /snang stong zung 'jug rta phag yab yum sras/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char du snyil/ /snang srid chos dbyings kun tu bzang mo'i klong / /snang stong dbyer med sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /snang cha 'gog med a dar+sha yi ngos/ /snang la rang bzhin med ston tā res skyongs/ /chos dbyings klong na shes rab kun bzang mo/ /longs sku'i zhing na snang stong wa ra dhi/ /nyer bzhi'i yul na zhing skyong rnal 'byor ma/ /tshe ring mched lnga lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag 'brog gnas che/ /sa bcu'i sems dpa' rma rgyal sbom ra ba/ /yab yum sras blon rnams kyis rtag par skyongs/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes nyul ma/ /gnas gsum ma sring dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /ko long ru nga phrag pa mi dog par/ /bar chad kun sel mthun rkyen sdongs grogs mdzod/ /me 'brug gnam lo'i rang zhal gsar ngom pa'i/ /dga' ba dang po'i snga dro'i cha nyid la/ /rje btsun lha mos rjes su bzung ba yi/ /rnal 'byer dbang phyug kun bzang snyan grags kyis/ /'khor 'das kun gsal a dar+sha yi ngos/ /lkog gyur las kyang shin tu lkog gyur 646

pa'i/ /skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i mgon po zhabs dkar rje'i/ /gsang ba'i rtogs brjod man+da ra ba'i phreng / /de nyid snang ba 'phags ma'i zhal lung 'a di/ /rgyang zhags lam du mngon sum snang gyur pa/ /rang gzha na gdul bya yongs kyi nyer 'tsho ru/ /mi brjed gzungs su bkod pa 'di na'o/ /snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar mkhan rje'i/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gye 'khor lo la/ /mi phyed dad pa thod du 'chang rnams kyis/ /dad gsum dang bas rna ba blogs te nyon//de yang bla ma'i gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil nas lo gsar gye snga dro'i cha la/ rje /btsun 'phags ma mdun gye nam mkhar dmigs nas dngos su 'byor ba dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod de gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas gsang ba'i rtogs brjod kun gsal me long dwangs pa'i ngos la snang cha 'gog med kyi yi ger shar ba'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ zla tshes mun brtsegs mar snang ba'i 'og tu tshe dpag med 'od dkar po zhig gi 'dab na dar dkar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba'i steng na bu mo lnga gar byed bzhin pa'i ngang la dar la thim pa'i mod dar gye ngos yig rigs mi gcig pa bsam gyes mi khyab pas gang ba je gsal du song ba'i mur yi ge 'di snang ngo / /647

pa'i/ /skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i mgon po zhabs dkar rje'i/ /gsang ba'i rtogs brjod man+da ra ba'i phreng / /de nyid snang ba 'phags ma'i zhal lung 'a di/ /rgyang zhags lam du mngon sum snang gyur pa/ /rang gzha na gdul bya yongs kyi nyer 'tsho ru/ /mi brjed gzungs su bkod pa 'di na'o/ /snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar mkhan rje'i/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gye 'khor lo la/ /mi phyed dad pa thod du 'chang rnams kyis/ /dad gsum dang bas rna ba blogs te nyon//de yang bla ma'i gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil nas lo gsar gye snga dro'i cha la/ rje /btsun 'phags ma mdun gye nam mkhar dmigs nas dngos su 'byor ba dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod de gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas gsang ba'i rtogs brjod kun gsal me long dwangs pa'i ngos la snang cha 'gog med kyi yi ger shar ba'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ zla tshes mun brtsegs mar snang ba'i 'og tu tshe dpag med 'od dkar po zhig gi 'dab na dar dkar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba'i steng na bu mo lnga gar byed bzhin pa'i ngang la dar la thim pa'i mod dar gye ngos yig rigs mi gcig pa bsam gyes mi khyab pas gang ba je gsal du song ba'i mur yi ge 'di snang ngo / /647

dzha — rkamaṭa——shu 'aza755ཿna mo gu ru/ gang sku mtshan dpe nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lhun po'i spo nas 'dzam gling 'dir legs par shar ba'i dus na lha mi yongs kyis mgrin gcig tu rje btsun mi la zhes bya'i skyes bu de'i sprul pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon no zhes gtam snyan dga' ba'i me tog gi char ba phab pas bcu drug lang tshos mdzes pa'i dga' 'khyil dung gi ri mo thod du 'chang ba lha mo'i sprul pa de nyid kyis byi dor legs par byas nas rgyal mtshan nor bu'i rtse mor mchod nas bslab gsum dar gyi snang ba 'chang zhing sred med kyi bu yang dga' spro byed cing 'jig rten gyi mgon du gyur pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/ /sa ma ya/ sku gsum bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /rje btsun khro gnyer ma yi sprul pa zhig /gos 'khyud ri mo stong gis rab brgyan pa'i/ /gsang ba'i 'od 'phro thugs kyi ga'u la/ /rgyal tshul lta bu'i sprul pa snang ba'i rgyan/ /'di zhes bya ba'i gsang ba'i gtam tshig 'di/ /u dum wa ra'i gsang ba'i rnam thar lags/ /de nas bgrang bya bcu dang gsum gyi dus/ /o ṭa'i ya na'i slob dpon chen po yi/ /snying po yang dag bgrangs pas zhal gzigs byung / /zhal nas lho phyogs nga sprul gdams pa longs/ /dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod mdzad nas 648

dzha — samaṭa——shu 'aza755ཿna mo gu ru/ gang sku mtshan dpe nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lhun po'i spo nas 'dzam gling 'dir legs par shar ba'i dus na lha mi yongs kyis mgrin gcig tu rje btsun mi la zhes bya'i skyes bu de'i sprul pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon no zhes gtam snyan dga' ba'i me tog gi char ba phab pas bcu drug lang tshos mdzes pa'i dga' 'khyil dung gi ri mo thod du 'chang ba lha mo'i sprul pa de nyid kyis byi dor legs par byas nas rgyal mtshan nor bu'i rtse mor mchod nas bslab gsum dar gyi snang ba 'chang zhing sred med kyi bu yang dga' spro byed cing 'jig rten gyi mgon du gyur pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/ /sa ma ya/ sku gsum bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /rje btsun khro gnyer ma yi sprul pa zhig /gos 'khyud ri mo stong gis rab brgyan pa'i/ /gsang ba'i 'od 'phro thugs kyi ga'u la/ /rgyal tshul lta bu'i sprul pa snang ba'i rgyan/ /'di zhes bya ba'i gsang ba'i gtam tshig 'di/ /u dum wa ra'i gsang ba'i rnam thar lags/ /de nas bgrang bya bcu dang gsum gyi dus/ /o ṭa'i ya na'i slob dpon chen po yi/ /snying po yang dag bgrangs pas zhal gzigs byung / /zhal nas lho phyogs nga sprul gdams pa longs/ /dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod mdzad nas 648

thugs gar thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang cig dbo zla'i tshes bcu'i mtshan mo la/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs mngon sum byon nas kyang / /'dul ba lung gi rnam dbye 'di dag la/ /ltos shig gsungs nas glegs bam phyag tu gtad/ /gzigs pa tsam gyis 'od zhu thugs gar thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba me 'obs ltar du rab mthong nas/ /thugs yid chos rgyal drung du rlung gis drangs/ /gyi thang rta la bskyon nas mdun du phebs/ /nam mkhar 'ja' 'od 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ /g.yas 'khyel dung dkar cha gnyis snyan du phul/ /slob dpon dngos su bzhugs pa thugs la 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes spyan yangs nam mkhar gzigs/ /bu khyod mdun du de ring thon no zhes/ /snyan pa'i gtam brjod rta phag sku ru bzhengs/ /skal ldan slob ma'i shes rgyud byin rlabs mdzad/ /de dus smin grol gdams pa thugs la 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang cig rje btsun 'jam dbyangs mdun du byon/ /gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba'i yul la ltos/ /ngur smrig skal ldan rjes su 'dzin don du/ /byang chub lam rim glegs bam phyag 649

tu gtad/ /bstan pa 'gal med dgos pa thugs la shar/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon byon mkhas grub dam pa'i legs bshad la/ /thos bsam tshig gis phu thag rab bcad nas/ /bsgoms pas nyams snang 'od gsal thugs la shar/ /de nas zhal bzang mgon po'i zhal bstan nas/ /sngags kyi dbang bzhi chos rgyal zhus shig gsungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rgyal chen por nyer lnga'i mtshan mo la/ /mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma zhig mdun du byon/ /skal ldan bu mchog dkyil 'khor ston cig ces/ /brda don sgra la drangs pa slob mar bsnyad/ /dga' spro dpag med thugs la yang dag 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'brug zla'i yar tshes dus kyi skar bzang la /yang gsang rta phag dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /bum dbang ye shes sher dbang don rgyud rnams/ /gnang ba'i dus su rta phag dngos su mthong / /dbang bzhi'i ye shes dag pa thugs la 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /smin grol lam gyi gdams pa stsal pa'i dus/ /ma bsgoms par yang cig char thugs la 'khrungs/ /chos rgyal slob dpon skur mthong thugs ka nas/ /a yig dpag med nam mkha' gang nas 650

kyang / /slob dpon thugs gtad a yig dngos su thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdams pa rnams lon gcig pur sgom pa'i tshe/ /'khor 'das gzhi gcig rtogs pa'i ngang du bzhugs/ /nam mkha' 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil zhig na/ /rdor sems rigs lnga'i lha tshogs mdun du byon/ /khyod kyis sgrub pa da dung gyis shig gsungs/ /rdor sems skad cig nyid la spyi bor thim/ /sngar med ting 'dzin 'od gsal nyi zla shar/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes longs sku'i 'dug stangs nam mkhar gzigs/ /'od gsal nyams kyi 'phel 'grib thugs la bzhag /snang srid dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lor shar/ /'od gsal ngang nas nam mkhar 'phags pa'i tshe/ /'jam dbyangs sa skya padhi ta de byon/ /da dung 'od gsal khor yug nyin mtshan ltos/ /ma 'ongs 'gro don 'ong ba'i lung bstan thob/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dag pa gsum gyi 'khor lo'i ngang nyid nas/ /gang yin ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su mgon po byon/ /skyabs mchog chos rgyal drung du song zhig ces/ /dri med shel gyi mchod rten zhig gnang bas/ /'od gsal ngang las bzhengs pa'i dus shig la/ /mchod rten nam 651

mkhar 'phags nas byang du song / /mgon bos brda zhig btang ba thugs la 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyar dus rig pa dwangs pa'i dus shig la/ /chos rgyal chen po'i mdun du bzhugs pa'i skabs/ /chos rgyal zhal nas 'di la ltos shig gsungs/ /shel gye mchod rten grong khyer lnga ldan zhig /nam mkhar yod pa bstan nas 'di dag la/ /ma 'ongs dus su zhig gsos gyis shig gsungs/ /dbugs dbyung lung bstan brgya phrag thugs la bsnyad/ /gsung gi go rim bzhin du 'gro don gnang / /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma hā de ba zhes bya'i gnas chen gyi/ /dkyil na gnas pa'i ri bo chen po'i gnas/ /klu mo dkar mos dar dkar zhig phul nas/ /'di ru phebs pa bka' drin che'o zhes/ /snyan du phul nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dgyes/ /mnyam bzhag 'od gsal ngang du nyin mtshan bzhugs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /re zhig bar du dam bca'i ri mo bris/ /nyin cig nam mkhar 'ja' 'od 'od phung 'khrigs/ /klong na ye shes mkha' 'gro gsang ba de'i/ /zhal gyi bum bzang dung gi tshems bstan nas/ /gsang sngags dgongs don ba zul gsungs/ yang yang bskul nas mgur dbyangs 652

char ba phab/ /skal ldan gdul bya smin grol lam la bkod/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal ngang la shel gyi skas la bud/ /steng du bzhugs nas nam mkhar gzigs pa'i tshe/ /rje btsun blo bzang grags pa mdun du byon/ /ma 'ongs 'gro don byed pa'i mig 'dren la/ /bslab gsum gos dar 'bral med chongs zhes gsungs/ /gseg shing lhung bzed gtad nas nam mkhar bshegs/ /'gro don 'gran zla bral ba 'ong ngo snyam/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang ba rgyan du byas nas mgur blangs dus/ /rma chen sras po bkra shis 'byung gnas byon/ /gangs khrod g.ya' yi mtshams kyi 'dab rol na/ /sra zhing brtan pa'i khang bzang skyes su 'bul/ /de la zhabs kyi pad+mo nged la ston/ /gsungs nas cung zhig bsdad nas nam mkhar gshegs/ /rma rgyal 'dren du 'ong ba thugs la shar/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rgyal mkha' spyod gshegs pas thugs skyo nas/ /mtsho snying ri la khams yengs byed pa'i dus/ /slob dpon chen po'i phyag rjes mtsho las mthong / /de nas 'od dkar zla ba shar 'dra ba'i/ /zhal bstan klu mos sil tog mdun du phul/ /khyed thugs ma skyo chos dbyengs dag pa na/ /chos rgyal zhal gyi dkyil 653

'khor mngon sum gzigs/ /yang dag don la phebs pa min no zhes/ /snyan du phul nas klu mo rang gnas song / /gangs khrod dben gnas thugs la wa ler 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dar dkar lha lam brgyud nas gangs la phebs/ /gangs mchod phul ba'i dus su rma chen gyis/ /gangs seng bcibs nas bskor ba lan gsum byas/ /lam dkar bstan nas pho brang dbus la bzhud/ /'od gsal 'char sgo 'bar ba thugs la 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhor bltas 'od gsal nyi ma rang shar gye/ /de nas rtswa gdan steng du chos bdun byas/ /mi shigs rdo rje gsum gyis rgyas btab nas/ /mi 'gyur klong yangs chen por bltas pa'i tshe/ /mi 'gyur khang bzang rma chen pho brang der/ /sras dang sras mo thugs dam bskul du btang / /de la brten nas pho brang dbus su bzhud/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rin chen khri yi gdan gyi steng du bzhugs/ /rma chen sras po 'khor tshogs dang bcas pas mi yul med pa'i zas sna dpag med phul/ /las dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi char ba phab/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i rnam thar yang yang bshad/ /rma chen dga' nas gos kyi dbu zhwa phul/ /bstan 654

'gror phan thogs 'byung ba thugs la shar/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas de nas nges don 'od gsal 'grub/ /gdangs 'gyur ba med pa'i snying rje skyes/ /lam sbyangs bgrod med pa'i phu thag chod/ /nyams 'od gsal 'bar ba'i snang ba la/ /sngon ston pa sangs rgyas 'khor tshogs bcas/ /mngon sum du mdun du byon pa'i tshe/ /gzhi thal 'gyur lta ba'i dogs pa bcad/ /'kho ra re re bzhin du gsung dbyangs byon/ /gsung de la brten nas bsgom snying 'dod/ /sngon bskal pa bzang po'i dus yin snya ma/ /thugs zag pa med pa'i klong la 'khrungs/ /rje thugs je can la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang dag slar yang rje btsun mi 'a byon/ /nam mkhar lta stangs mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mtha' dbus med/ /ris med 'gro la phan pa'i snying rje yis/ /gzhan rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus yin no/ /zhal gyis gsungs nas nam mkha'i dbyings la gshegs/ /'gro don byed pa thugs la wa ler 'khrungs// /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas ri/na ring skabs shig bco lnga'i nyin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer de'i mthu las/ /dkyil nas byung ba tshangs pa chen po dang / /brgya byin gnyis kyis 'khor 'bangs 655

'gror phan thogs 'byung ba thugs la shar/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas de nas nges don 'od gsal 'grub/ /gdangs 'gyur ba med pa'i snying rje skyes/ /lam sbyangs bgrod med pa'i phu thag chod/ /nyams 'od gsal 'bar ba'i snang ba la/ /sngon ston pa sangs rgyas 'khor tshogs bcas/ /mngon sum du mdun du byon pa'i tshe/ /gzhi thal 'gyur lta ba'i dogs pa bcad/ /'kho ra re re bzhin du gsung dbyangs byon/ /gsung de la brten nas bsgom snying 'dod/ /sngon bskal pa bzang po'i dus yin snya ma/ /thugs zag pa med pa'i klong la 'khrungs/ /rje thugs je can la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang dag slar yang rje btsun mi 'a byon/ /nam mkhar lta stangs mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mtha' dbus med/ /ris med 'gro la phan pa'i snying rje yis/ /gzhan rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus yin no/ /zhal gyis gsungs nas nam mkha'i dbyings la gshegs/ /'gro don byed pa thugs la wa ler 'khrungs// /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas ri/na ring skabs shig bco lnga'i nyin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer de'i mthu las/ /dkyil nas byung ba tshangs pa chen po dang / /brgya byin gnyis kyis 'khor 'bangs 655

mang po dang / /bcas te mdun du 'khrigs se zhal bstan bzhugs/ /'di nas 'od gsal lha rigs yul ljongs shig /'gro don byed dus dngos grub ster ro zhes/ /gsungs nas g.yas bskor brgyab nas nam mkhar gshegs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhal gzigs grangs med 'ong / /'od gsal ngang nas khor mo yug tu mjal/ /lha rnams zhal gyi gsung dbyangs re re byon/ /gsung der brten nas dogs pa dpag med chod/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs don 'chad pa mi dka' snyam/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /de las 'od gsal snang ba'i ngos shig tu/ /mkha' 'gro stag gdong 'bar ma byon nas kyang / /rin chen dung shel sbug gu snyan la btsugs/ /'di nas byang du 'gro don gyis shig gsungs/ /gsung gis bskul nas 'gro ba'i don la chas/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang stong gnyis med rdor sems sku ru bzhengs/ /bsreg gtor bkrus pa'i yi ge 'phros pa las/ /bsangs kyi dngos 'dzin thams cad rab sbyangs nas/ /lha chen rma rgyal sras blon 'khor bcas byon/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dar dkar bum pa phul/ /bde 'tshams zhus nas rma rgyal 'khor bcas byon/ /de 656

nas 'od gsal chen po'i ngang la phebs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dar dkar lha lam brgyud nas byang du phebs/ /'od gsa'/ ngang la nam mkhar gzigs pa'i tshe/ /dran pa nam mkha' stag la bcibs nas byon/ /mi shigs rdo rje thugs dam bsrung ba sgoms/ /zhal gyis gsungs nas 'od zhu yungs 'brur gyur/ /smin mtshams nas zhugs thugs dang dbyer med 'dres/ /har sangs rgya yan phyam cig lus nas kyang / /de dus mngon gyur grub rtags dpag med bstan/ /nam mkha'i lha mos snyan grags phyogs bcur spel/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /brag dkar gnas su zhabs zung ri mo bkod/ /snying rje chen po'i 'od zer brgya phrag spros/ /snying rje stong pa'i rang mdangs gyur pa'i tshe/ /nam mkhar me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /rngam brjid khro ba'i tshul bzung tsam la bzhugs/ /ne'u le'i zhal nas nor bu dpag med gnang / /'di ni khyed kyi phyag la snyim zhig gsungs/ /phyag tu bsnams dus phyag g.yas ri mor thim/ /nor lha'i tshogs kyis dngos grub char du bsnyil/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /nor lha de yi dbus su 'od phung dbus/ /sman mo'i tshul 'dzin bud med dmar mo zhig /sgu lus dar dmar 657

tshogs kyis rab brgyan nas/ /bu mo'i thugs ka phyes nas lcags kyu blangs/ /phyag g.yon gtad nas gzhan gyi snying khar thob/ /gsungs nas skad cig nyid la nub tu gshegs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rta ljang 'char phyogs yul gyi mtha' zhig nas/ /mig shes zung ldan can nam mkhar 'phur ba mthong / /yid dbang 'od gsal gyi lta ba'i gdangs shig na/ /'khor med drin skyong gi shel sdong lo 'dab can/ /las rlung dri can gyi ri dbang med brlags nas/ /mngon sum rtag brtan gyi ri mo bris bzhin gsal/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas ston pa chos sku kun bzang skur/ /ra ni med par gsal ba'i sku dbus su/ /dbu ma ye shes rlung dkyil ljang gu'i steng / /ma yi rnam shes a yig dkar bor gsal/ /nub phyogs zhing la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ /'od khyem rigs bdag lha yi thugs gar 'phos/ /de nas snang char langs nas mi dmigs ngang / /bsngo ba dam pas rgyas 'debs yang dag byas/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang snying rje'i gdangs las 'gro don gnang / /mi dang mi min lha klus chos nyan byas/ /'gro ba de dag kha lo chos la bsgyur/ /legs tshogs bsod nams rnam thos sras la 658

'khrungs/ /bdag pas gzhan gces sems mchog yang yang bskyed/ /'gro rnams rjes su bzung zhes jo bos gsungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /de'i tshe zla ba'i nyer lnga'i mtshan mo la/ /rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i zhal gzigs byung / /khyed kyi dag gzhi shel gyi me long la/ /yang yang byi dor byas la g.ya' mi gos/ /'khor 'das dbyengs su chud pa ya mtshan che/ /gsungs nas 'od zhu thugs kyi ga'ur thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs tshogs bsod nams dpung tshogs bcas nas kyang / /ngur smrig rnam rol rgyal ba'i mdun du mjal/ /'phags mchog pad dkar 'dzin pa dngos su mthong / /zhal nas skal ldan yongs la phan thogs gyis/ /lan mang gsungs nas mnga' dbang bstod pa brgyab/ /dpal ldan mgon por skyes mchog srungs shig gsungs/ /'phrin las bcol nas bstod dbyangs me tog 'thor/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dben rir rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin bsgoms/ /de yi ngang la bzhugs pa'i snang cha la/ /yul phyogs ske rlung tsha ba 'khrugs pa mthong / /de dag gzhan don mnyam brjes byas pa'i dus/ /ye shes mgon po mngon sum byon nas kyang / /rtag brtan snying 660

por mi gzhig gdan khri phul/ /de yi mthu las mun pa rang dwangs gsal/ /yul phyogs nad rims kun la phan pa byung / /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang mgon po mdun du byon nas kyang / /gser gyi glegs bam g.yu yi kha thig can/ /phyag tu bzhag nas bka' yi gdams pa yin/ /gsungs nas 'od zhu nam mkha'i dbyings la thim ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don du 'jog dgos bsam/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyin cig nam mkhar 'ja' 'od gur khyem klong / /dar ljang na bza' thig le stong ldan can/ /gyon pa'i mkha' 'gro ma zhig mdun du byon/ /'di nas nged kyi pho brang byon zhes gtam/ /gsungs nas dar dkar lam drangs mkha' la gshegs/ /gnas la bskor ba byed dgos thugs la shar/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas chen bskor ba'i nyin cig dgong mo'i char/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa'i rkyen byas nas/ /thugs yid gtad pa'i 'od phung zhig tu gyur/ /de yi dbus su byu ru'i khri zhig na/ /tshe dpag med mgon sku mchog mngon par bkra/ /de yi zhal nas bdud rtsi dkar po 'phros/ /spyi bor thim pas tshe dbang dngos su bskur/ /sku tshe srid mthar phyin pa thugs la shar/ /rje btsun 661

dkyil 'khor bkod nas 'od gsal ngang / /bzhugs nas rgyal ba'i dgongs don dpag med gzigs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /glang gi zla ba'i tshes gsum mtshan mo la/ /phal cher sku mdog smug por bsgyur ba'i mdog /gos chen re khā gsol ba'i rnal 'byor zhig /mdun du byon nas saṃ skṛ sgra la drangs/ /gsungs pa thams cad thugs na wa ler mkhyen/ /yang cig rnal 'byor de dag cig bzhad nas/ /nga ni mchod rten dbus nas khyed 'dren 'ongs/ /gsungs nas gar stabs bsgyur nas nam mkhar gshegs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'byor ldan rgyal po'i yul la 'dab ma bskyod/ /lam bar thugs rten bzang por mjal ba'i dus/ /mtshan bzang sum cus brgyan pas sangs rgyas shig /phyag na lhung bzed bsnams nas/ mdun du bzhugs/ /lhung bzed nang nas 'bras dkar skyogs gang phul/ /ma 'ongs 'gro la phan thogs gyis shig gsungs/ /sprin dkar zhig gyur mchod rten dbus la thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba yongs kyis mgrin gcig la/ /lan brgyar brjod pas bstod dbyang sa srid rtse'i bar/ /khyab pa'i mchod rten chen po'i drung du mjal/ /'od snang dbus na bo rnyi sa twa 669

dkyil 'khor bkod nas 'od gsal ngang / /bzhugs nas rgyal ba'i dgongs don dpag med gzigs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /glang gi zla ba'i tshes gsum mtshan mo la/ /phal cher sku mdog smug por bsgyur ba'i mdog /gos chen re khā gsol ba'i rnal 'byor zhig /mdun du byon nas saṃ skṛ sgra la drangs/ /gsungs pa thams cad thugs na wa ler mkhyen/ /yang cig rnal 'byor de dag cig bzhad nas/ /nga ni mchod rten dbus nas khyed 'dren 'ongs/ /gsungs nas gar stabs bsgyur nas nam mkhar gshegs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'byor ldan rgyal po'i yul la 'dab ma bskyod/ /lam bar thugs rten bzang por mjal ba'i dus/ /mtshan bzang sum cus brgyan pas sangs rgyas shig /phyag na lhung bzed bsnams nas/ mdun du bzhugs/ /lhung bzed nang nas 'bras dkar skyogs gang phul/ /ma 'ongs 'gro la phan thogs gyis shig gsungs/ /sprin dkar zhig gyur mchod rten dbus la thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba yongs kyis mgrin gcig la/ /lan brgyar brjod pas bstod dbyang sa srid rtse'i bar/ /khyab pa'i mchod rten chen po'i drung du mjal/ /'od snang dbus na bo rnyi sa twa 669

bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas spyi bor bzhag nas byen rlabs mdzad/ /khyed ni 'di nas la phyi'i gangs la phebs/ /'gro don dpag med nga yi smon lam yin/ /gsungs nas skad cig nyid la mi snang gyur/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhabs zung mtshan bzang ri mo gnas der bkod/ /gor mo'i bsil khang gzhig bral yang phug tu/ /'gyur med rdor gdan sra bar ti dz+ren+tu/ /badz+ra ma hā chen po'i dgongs par bzhugs/ /e ka kro rnya'i snang cha brtan por bzung / /he ru ka dpal thugs dkyil mngon sum gzigs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku lhun po'i smin mtshams thad drang du/ /ku mud stong ldan bzhad pa'i dbus nyid na/ /bde chen dga' bzhi ster ba'i mtsho rgyal gyi/ /phyag g.yas 'dab ma'i gar gyis khang bzang bstan/ /a mo li ga'i gdan mchog g.yas zur na/ /phyag chen bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor yang phug yod/ /gsungs nas 'od zhu thugs dang dbyer med 'dres/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri bkra rgyal po'i g.yang gzhi'i steng nyid du/ /ga na tsakra phung por spung ba'i dus/ /rā lcug phran gar sgyur rol bzhin du/ /dkyus ring bung ba'i zur mig lan brgyar g.yos/ /'od dmar mchu sgos 'dab mas legs bshad 670

bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas spyi bor bzhag nas byen rlabs mdzad/ /khyed ni 'di nas la phyi'i gangs la phebs/ /'gro don dpag med nga yi smon lam yin/ /gsungs nas skad cig nyid la mi snang gyur/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhabs zung mtshan bzang ri mo gnas der bkod/ /gor mo'i bsil khang gzhig bral yang phug tu/ /'gyur med rdor gdan sra bar ti dz+ren+tu/ /badz+ra ma hā chen po'i dgongs par bzhugs/ /e ka kro rnya'i snang cha brtan por bzung / /he ru ka dpal thugs dkyil mngon sum gzigs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku lhun po'i smin mtshams thad drang du/ /ku mud stong ldan bzhad pa'i dbus nyid na/ /bde chen dga' bzhi ster ba'i mtsho rgyal gyi/ /phyag g.yas 'dab ma'i gar gyis khang bzang bstan/ /a mo li ga'i gdan mchog g.yas zur na/ /phyag chen bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor yang phug yod/ /gsungs nas 'od zhu thugs dang dbyer med 'dres/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri bkra rgyal po'i g.yang gzhi'i steng nyid du/ /ga na tsakra phung por spung ba'i dus/ /rā lcug phran gar sgyur rol bzhin du/ /dkyus ring bung ba'i zur mig lan brgyar g.yos/ /'od dmar mchu sgos 'dab mas legs bshad 670

bkram/ /dag gsum rdo rje'i thugs kyi rgya mtshor 'dres/ /rje btsun thugs je can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhi dbyings 'gyur med rtsal gye gdangs chen nas/ /mthong byed 'dab mas mkha' dbyings gar byed dus / /dbang gzhi'i 'od phung dbus na 'od lnga'i khrir/ /shing rta'i 'khor lo zung gis mdun du drangs/ /khri steng sman btsun lha mos sgrom bu zung / /phyag tu phul nas sbos shig gsungs nas gshegs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /nub gcig mkha' 'gro spun lnga mdun du byon/ /rin chen gser gyi mchod sgam zhig gnang nas/ /rin chen sa le sbram gyi phung po yod/ /gsungs nas yang gcig bzhad nas 'di skad gsungs/ /dbang bzhi bde chen ngo bo'i 'khrid cig thob/ /gsungs nas sku yi 'dab ma legs bstan nas/ /sbor chen bde chen 'di la rol cig gsungs/ /bzhengs nas bsko ra ba lan gsum brgyab nas phebs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhun po'i spo nas khyon yangs lam nas 'ongs/ /tshangs pas gser gye 'khor lo phyag tu phul/ /thugs rten rin chen dang pos dkres pa'i tshe/ /'khor lo'i dbus nas rin chen longs shig gsungs/ /lan cig phyag 'tshal 'od lam bzhud de thal/ /rje btsun thugs rje 671

can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rin po che yis dkris nas 'bru 'thor tshe/ /dpal ldan ye shes mgon pos gdan drangs nas/ /mchod rten nam mkhar bzhugs nas rab gnas mdzad/ /sgu gsung sprul pa dag snang can gyis mthong / /bde gshegs rgyal ba mchod rten dbus la bzhugs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /khye'u lo brgyad dung gshog can zhig byung / /'di nas 'od dmar pho brang lding khang na/ /rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog shrī zhes/ /ma 'ongs o rgyan sprul pa byon pa'i sar/ /zhabs kyi dung 'khyil dkar mo de la bkod/ /zhes pa brda 'ga' gsungs nas rang gnas bzhud/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprin dang na bun 'dres pa'i klong zhig na/ /'od 'khyil ljang gu'i khri yi ri mo mthong / /de la gzigs pas gzhi bdag gnyan po zhig /mdun du byon nas nga ni shar phyogs kyi/ /rgya nag gong mas btang ba yin no zhes/ /dar ser yug gcig gser gyi ga'u phul/ /'di ni ma 'ongs don du 'jog cig gsungs/ /rgya yi skad kyis bkod pa sna tshogs mdzad/ /tha mar rgyal po'i pho brang dbus su gshegs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub du ma'i do ra yangs po der/ /sku yi gnas lnga'i dkyil 'khor 672

mngon sum bstan/ /a hi zhu bdes drangs na 'di ltar yin/ /gsungs nas 'od zer brgya phrag phyogs bcur spros/ /skal ldan slob mas mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /skya rengs bdag pos lhun po'i spo nas bsus/ /snang ba'i 'od kyi yangs pa chen po dang / /'grogs nas shrī'i pho brang chen po ra phebs/ /rdor sems longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru bzhengs/ /dag pa rab 'byams ngang du 'bral med bzhugs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i mnal lam du/ /chos gos gyon pa'i dge slong glegs bam can/ /mdun du byon nas nga yis lung byed gsungs/ /chos drug gdams pa'i gnad kyi lung de gnang / /bka' brgyud bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba yin/ /gsungs nas dag pa mkha' spyod zhing la 'phur/ /mnyam med dwags po yin no thugs la 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od khyem chu 'dras nang rnams gang ba byung / /de yi dbus na lam zhig mdun du zug /kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa thogs pa'i rnal 'byor byon/ /nga ni ku ku yin zhes sku dbus bstan/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dngos su gzigs/ /gtso bo'i thugs nas 'od zer sku la phog /thugs yid bsres 673

pas rgya mtsho'i dbus la byon/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' nas dar dkar mkha' 'gros gnas der 'then/ /lam de brgyud nas mkha' la phebs pa'i tshe/ /baiḍūr khang pa byu ru'i gdung ma can/ /mu tig dra phyed ba gam g.yu las byas/ /de dbus pad+ma dmar po gyes pa'i dbus/ /chos rgyal bzhugs pa mjal dus zhal nas kyang / /bu khyod 'di ru lan gcig ngas 'bod btang / /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yas phyogs khre khar khyod sdod gsungs nas kyang / /yang thig gnad kyi dri ba gang rgyas gsungs/ /bu ram sgor gcig 'di bzhes lag nas phul/ /bzhes 'phro 'dzam gling 'gro ba yongs la byin/ /zhal gyis thon nas bu khyod snying rus che/ /pha rgan mjal ba'i rdzu 'phrul ngo mtshar che/ /gsungs ma thag tu 'phur nas rang gnas phebs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshes bcu'i tshogs mchod phul ba'i spyan 'dren dus/ /'od khyem dkar po'i dbus na stag gdan dang / /ang rag sgom thag gser gye rna long can/ /phur bu thod khrag dbu mnab mi gcig pa/ /gyon pa'i grub chen cig gi zhal nas kyang / /'phags mchog 'di ru phebs pa bka' drin che/ /nga ni ras chung rdo rje grags pa yin/ /ras pa'i tshogs kyi zhal 674

gzigs dus gcig byung / /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus kyi bar skabs nyin cig rlung nag 'tshub/ /dbus na skra dang sen mo lcags yin pa'i/ /mig dmar kha gdangs lce brkyangs 'dre zhig 'ongs/ /nga ni mtha' 'khob klo yi yul nas yin/ /khyod la da re lta ru 'ong zer nas/ /kha nas me 'bar sna nas du ba 'thu9tha/ /ha sgra sgrogs nas nang rnams gang ba'i dus/ /snying rje zhig bsgoms skad cig nyid la dengs/ /yul der mi gnod rgya mtsho'i nang du song / /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /stong gsum bdag mos dri zhim mdun du phul/ /dung gi ri mo'i dbus nas brda dag bkram/ /rnam snang bum pa'i mgul nas gsung sgros byon/ /gsung der brten nas 'di ru khyod 'dren 'ongs/ /bar chad ngas sel dogs pa mi dgos gsungs/ /skad cig rlung la thim nas bar snang yal/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgyogs 'gro'i shugs kyis sku yi dkyil 'khor drangs/ /bung ba 'phur sgra'i sgra yis mgur dbyangs blangs/ /'gro rnams smin grol 'thob pa'i bdud rtsir gsungs/ /kha lo bsgyur phyir pho brang dbus su phebs/ /'khor 'das rdo rje 'chang gi sku ru shar/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhun po'i pho brang 675
