rtse mo'i yang steng na/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos zhal gye dkyil 'khor mjal/ /dar gyi mgul dkris shel gye bum pa phul/ /byang gi phyogs su zhal bstan bzhugs nas kyang / /ma 'ongs nga yi 'khor gyi thog mar shog /gsungs nas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' dbang gsol/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /khas len bral ba'i ro gcig ngang gnas dus/ /dkyil 'khor 'od zer brgya phrag 'phro ba zhig /mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbus nyid na/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs mngon sum gzigs/ /e waṃ rgyud don 'gags med rang shar byung / /paṇa chen thugs nas sprul pa yin no snyam/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshon gyi ri mo'i mdangs la 'khyud nas kyang / /skyi bser rlung gi 'dab ma bteg nas ni/ /sngon byon rgyal ba'i thugs rten drung du bsnyegs/ /nyi 'od 'khyel 'dra'i pad rag gis brgyan dus/ /byams sems gshog pas mkha' dbyengs chod pa byas/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang snang ka dag bum sku'i rang zhal na/ /gzugs sgu 'od phung can gyi rang bzhin bstan/ /sgra don rig pa dri med rgyud bshad gnang / /rnam dag sku yi dkyil 'khor 'di la ltos/ /gsungs nas thang stong rgyal po'i sku ru 676

gyur/ /nyi / dka' tshegs med par 'grub 'di e ma mtshar /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /me tog char phab dar dkar lam brgyud phebs/ /nyin cig lha mo rbitakyimakhordo/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i tshogs kyis bskor nas byung / /gtso mo'i phyag nas yi ge zhig gnang ba/ /de yi kha phyes bltas pas steng nyid na/ /don gyi ri mo g.yu 'brug lto la bcibs/ /dbyangs snyan sgyur sgra stong gi sgra 'a/ drangs/ /zhes pa la sogs lung bstan mang po yod/ /de nyid mthong bas ngo mtshar shin tu skyes/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs yid sprin dkar jo bo'i drung du g.yos/ /ljang sngon sgra dang char rgyun 'beb bzhin phebs/ /legs tshogs bsod nams dpung gi rten 'brel gyes/ /bag rtse lcam sring bya rog gdong la sogs/ /bka' srung mang po sprin ltar bsu ru 'ong / /bka' rnams bsgrubs nas jo bo'i mdun du phebs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrib bral bu mo'i lto las byung ba yi/ /tshangs gnas lha las 'phos 'dra'i pho brang dbus/ /kṛ gnyan pags steng bzhugs pa'i jo bo yi/ /mdun na bzhugs pa'i dus kyi skabs shig la/ /rgyal tshab rje btsun ma pham mgon po byon/ /gsung 'gyur lta ba'i gzhi grub mtshams sbyor las/ /re zhig bgro 677

gleng byas pas thugs yid 'dres/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bkra shis dge mtshan khyab pa'i gnas mchog 'khod/ /thugs dam srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus nyid du/ /nor bdag nor lha'i sku yi snang cha bzung / /rigs bdag zhal gyes gzhan la dngos grub gnang / /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /a bhu rnya ra dpal seng mngon sum du/ /byon nas thugs nas 'od zer lnga ldan 'phros/ /'od zer klong na grub chen dbu ral can/ /de yi zhal nas nga ni chos rdor yin/ /gsungs nas gnas der bskor nas dbyings la thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dar dang rin po che yi rgyan byas pa'i/ /rgyal po sku mdog dkar po zhig byon nas/ /lag nas dar ljang sog yig can zhig bstan/ /'di ni pho brang rtse mos gnang ba yin/ /nga ni chos 'khor bsam yas dbus la 'gro/ /skad cig nyid la 'od zhu nam mkhar dengs/ /mtsho byung mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdungs pa las/ /sgra yis drangs pa'i lam chen shad de bud/ /'od zer g.yu mdangs 'phrog pa'i nus pa bstan/ /'od zer de dbus brgyud nas chibs kha bsgyur/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /stong gsal yangs pa blta na sdug pa ru/ /nor bu dri 678

ma med pa'i ba gam can/ /sus rtogs brda dag brda yi gnas mchog nas/ /ma byas /myun grub 'od gsal khang pa yod/ /de dbus gter gyi sgom bu sna tshogs phul/ /de dag ma bzhes rang rang gnas su sbos/ /ma 'ongs bdag po 'ongs pa ngas shes so/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis rtse dga' rgod pa las/ /ze'u 'bru bdud rtsi len pa'i dga' ston la/ /dri ngad khor yug ldang ba'i 'gram nas 'ongs/ /ti ra lu hi pa ye zhal gzigs byung / /be+e ta lha mos dri bzang sgyes su phul/ /phyag 'tshal mdzad nas skyong bar khas blangs so/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad byung mdzad bzang 'od dkar phreng ba 'gyed/ /ris bral bstan pa'i gsos gyur dgon sder mjal/ /rin chen gser gyi khri mchog lta na sdug /gzhon tshul rje btsun dge legs dpal bzang pos/ /gsang ba jod pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bstan/ /g.yel med skyong ba yin no bu mchog rgyal/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dung phreng rgyan gyis spud pa'i lag pad las/ /gar rgyun dri ma 'khrud pa'i bdud rtsi blugs/ /snang ba 'phrog pa'i gdong bzhi'i bum pa bstan/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i nor bu khyung gis/ bteg /sngo mdangs rdo rje thogs pa'i zhal 679

bkram/ /bsgyur rtsis 'di la ltad mo gzigs rtogs mdzod/ /gsungs nas skad cig ri bkra bcibs nas bzhud/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /nub gcig g.yag dkar zhon pa'i mtshan sdug pa/ /shin tu rngam pa'i gzhi bdag cig byon nas/ /legs lam dar dkar gdan pa'i phyogs la yod/ /'ja' tshon shar 'dra'i snang ba 'gog med kyi/ /gnas 'gyur gcig gi ngang du de ru 'khod/ /zer bzhin gzhi bdag mang pos bskor ba byas/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gser 'od dkris 'dra'i sku yi lhun po 'khod/ /gdong bzhi'i sgra las bsgrun du med pa'i gsung / /dbyangs bsgyur drug cu'i mgur dbyangs blangs dus la/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan bu mo zhig byung nas/ /a ma'i dgongs don rtogs pa ngo mtshar che/ /'bum phrag rtse dga' rgod bzhin 'ja' la thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rta bdun bdag po nub ri'i rtse la 'then/ /dag pa'i dbyengs na gza' skar 'bum phrag bzhad/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i zla zer gsal ba'i dus/ /bdag gi chu skyes ku mud phyogs bcu ra bzhad/ /bcud 'dzin dbus la skad cig gnyis med gyur/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od zer stong 'bar gzhan gyis 'gran med cig /681

shar phyogs nam mkha'i dbyings nas mdun du zug /'od phung dbus na dar dkar thod bcings pa/ /rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin zhig byung mdun du bsdad/ /rtse gcig gus pas sku la mngon phyogs te/ /cung zhig zhu bas thugs je can gyis dgongs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /skad cig gnas 'gyur shin tu mi bzod pa'i/ /sku mchog cig gyur dar dkar zhig phul nas/ /rgyu skar dbus na zla ba shar ba ltar/ /zhing 'dir da re 'gro don dpag med byung / /nga ni sems dpa' chen po rma rgyal yin/ /rdo rje tshig la 'da' ba mi sred pa'i/ /gsung don steng du da re babs 'dug pas/ /mdo khams lan cig phebs zhes thal mo sbyor/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgur dbyangs blangs nas 'gro don byed bzhin du/ /slar yang jo bo'i mdun du sku mchog bkod/ /nub cig jo bo'i mdun du byon pa'i tshe/ /mi rnams su yang med pa'i dus shig la/ /jo bo'i thugs nas 'od zer lnga ldan 'phros/ /de yi dbus na mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis/ /pi wang sgra las mdo khams smad la phebs/ /bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs lan cig 'gyed byos la/ /slar yang 'di ru phebs dang 'gro don 'ong / /gsungs nas slar yang thugs gar thim pa gzigs/ /rje btsun thugs rje 682

can la gsol ba 'debs/ /jo bo'i lung bstan thob nas smad la chas/ /gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs 'dug snyam/ /byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis ngang nas phebs/ /yang yang mkha' spyod dbyings nas mkha' 'gro 'ong / /lan cig mkha' 'gro'i yul la phebs zhes bskul/ /skal ldan sgyes bu'i thugs nas sa ler mkhyen/ /gdengs bral bum pa'i rgya las thon nas kyang / /mkha' spyod mkha' 'gror 'gro don byed la phebs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgongs gzhi dag dran shel gyi ri bo la/ /na bun bdud kyis cung zad gos pa byung / /mi rtog dbyings kyi thugs dgongs rgya mtsho las/ /dbang rgyal nor bu'i zhabs pad dung ri can/ /yangs pa'i khyon gye rlabs chen spyod la bkod/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rin chen thang gi ri bo chen ngo/ nas/ /nub cig 'ja' tshon ri mo bkra ba las/ /ser phreng bsgrigs nas mdun du bsu ru 'ongs/ /de yi dbus na chos gos gseg shang can/ /sne ring gyon pa'i dge slong zhig gis kyang / /'di ru phebs pa ngo mtshar che zhes lags/ /nga ni dge bshes khyed kyi bla ma yin/ /gsungs nas ser phreng rdzu 'phrul nam mkhar phebs// /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /stod smad gos/ dar mi gcig gyon pa yi/ /dre'u dkar 683

can la gsol ba 'debs/ /jo bo'i lung bstan thob nas smad la chas/ /gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs 'dug snyam/ /byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis ngang nas phebs/ /yang yang mkha' spyod dbyings nas mkha' 'gro 'ong / /lan cig mkha' 'gro'i yul la phebs zhes bskul/ /skal ldan sgyes bu'i thugs nas sa ler mkhyen/ /gdengs bral bum pa'i rgya las thon nas kyang / /mkha' spyod mkha' 'gror 'gro don byed la phebs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgongs gzhi dag dran shel gyi ri bo la/ /na bun bdud kyis cung zad gos pa byung / /mi rtog dbyings kyi thugs dgongs rgya mtsho las/ /dbang rgyal nor bu'i zhabs pad dung ri can/ /yangs pa'i khyon gye rlabs chen spyod la bkod/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rin chen thang gi ri bo chen ngo/ nas/ /nub cig 'ja' tshon ri mo bkra ba las/ /ser phreng bsgrigs nas mdun du bsu ru 'ongs/ /de yi dbus na chos gos gseg shang can/ /sne ring gyon pa'i dge slong zhig gis kyang / /'di ru phebs pa ngo mtshar che zhes lags/ /nga ni dge bshes khyed kyi bla ma yin/ /gsungs nas ser phreng rdzu 'phrul nam mkhar phebs// /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /stod smad gos/ dar mi gcig gyon pa yi/ /dre'u dkar 683

zhon pa'i 'khor mang mdun du 'ong / /ta shī mu ta gser yig grong ldan dbus/ /go chab brlan gyis dpa' gtum dregs pa chums/ /g.yel med nga yis skyong zhes khas blangs nas/ /snying rje'i 'od kyis lan brgya g.yo bzhin du/ /zil gnon rtsal gyes rngam bsgrags rgyal de byon/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rkang 'thung lo 'dab me tog rgyas pa'i dbus/ /'dus sde gtan 'khyil mtsho mo'i dbus nyid du/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs drung ga la bar/ /zhabs zung 'khod pa'i snang ba'i nam mkha' na/ /nyams kyi zhal ras ston pa'i bla ma zhig /mdun du byom nas skyes bu bde lags sam/ /dri med rig pa ston pa'i skyes bu nga / /chos rje yin no gsungs nas lho ru phebs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gog med dal 'gro'i lto ba brgal nas kyang / /ljongs chen gser ri'i mu tig rgyan 'dzin la/ /mchod sprin bstabs nas bzhugs pa'i dus nyid na/ /sku mdog dmar nag beng dbyug thogs pa zhig /nga ni khyed la mjal du 'ongs pa yin/ /'di nas nga yi gnas mchog phebs zhes bskul/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gser ljongs dga' ma'i tshal la thugs yid bskyod/ /lam bar 'od zer dmar nag dbus nyid na/ /go khrab rmog mo 684

gyon pa'i 'khor rnams 'khrid/ /lan cig 'ongs nas phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas/ /rdo dang shel la bzos pa'i sho gnyis gnang / /'di yis bden brdzun gang yin dpyod dang gsal/ /zer bzhin brag dkar smug pa can la thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' la 'ja' 'khrigs bar na chos skyong rnams/ /bsu bzhin dri med rang yul dgon sder mjal/ /lha mi'i khrom tshogs dbus nyid bzhugs pa'i dus/ /sprin dkar 'o ma 'phyur 'dra'i dbus nyid na/ /mchod rten phyag tu bsnams nas 'di skad zer/ /nga ni ri gnas chos pa yin zer nas/ /mi snang 'od zhu sprin gyi dbus la thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /snying rje chen pos bu ltar skyong bzhin du/ /ka dag rig pa 'phrod pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /rdo rje dbang po'i zhal gzigs dngos su byung / /'di nas nags tshal glang chen ri bo'i rtser/ /glang po'i gtsug la rgyan cha thogs shig gsungs/ /gsung gi nang bzhin sku mchog der 'khod do/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal mdangs kyi ri mo'i ngos shig na/ /rgya rmatsho 'khyil 'dra'i 'od dkar dwangs pa'i dbus/ /phyogs bzhir dkyil 'khor bkra ba dngos su mthong / /rdo rje gzhon nu yang gsang rta phag dang / /685

drag dmar gshin rje'i lha tshogs dngos su mthong / /don brgyud gdams pa gnang dgos thugs la 'khrungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /khye'u bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba zhig /phyag tu phul nas phyag 'tshal pus btsugs nas/ /nga ni nub phyogs pho brang ga nas 'ongs/ /snga sor rang gzugs yang yang mdun du bstan/ /zhal nas gsung sgros zegs ma ma 'thor bas/ /bdag gi yid la cung zhig nongs pa byung / /skad cig gnas 'gyur drag po'i skur gyur nas/ /bka' rnams sgrub par khas blangs pho brang bzhud/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyin mtshan dus drug gnas bdag tshogs rnams kyis/ /re re bzhin du mjal nas bde 'tshams zhus/ /de'i mthar glog dmar 'od zer 'khyug pa zhig /mdun du brdal ba'i pho brang gru gsum dbus/ /bka' srung dregs pa gza' bdud mdun du byon/ /nga ni khyod la 'phrin las sgrub tu 'ongs/ /zhing 'dir nga 'dra'i gdug rtsub med gyur na/ /mi 'dul zer nas nam mkha' gang ba byung / /bstan 'gror 'tshe ba 'di la bcol dgos snyam/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs kyi 'gro don gnang ba'i skabs shig la/ /phag lo'i gnas mchog brag dkar lding khang nas/ /lha rnams mi 'dra 686

bcu drug zhal gzigs byung / /'di boms gang yin rig pa gtad pa'i tshe/ /g.yas skor lam nas brag gi ngos la thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bh+ra mar sbrang rtsi sdud bzhin phyogs kun 'phur/ /phyogs kun re nas lha rnams dpag med gzigs/ /'ja' 'od 'khyil 'dra nyin cig shar ba'i tshe/ /de'i dbus bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho byon/ /de yis yid kyi snang ba 'phrog cing 'byams/ /yun ring lus pas mi rnams ngo mtshar skyes/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /nub cig 'od gsal gzims pa'i nam gung la/ /nang rnams rlung gi 'ur sgra chems thag byung / /mnal gyi 'od gsal bslangs nas gcig gzigs pas/ /mdun du khrab rmog dpa' chas byas pa zhig /mjal nas da ) dkar sran ma sder gang phul/ /nga ni drag rtsal lha ri yin zhes pas/ /nga yi tshogs grong 'gro don byed du phebs/ /zhes gsungs skad cig mi snang nam mkhar yal/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /des bskul rkyen byas 'gro don byed rgyu'i song / /gser ljongs stod smad mgur dbyangs char ba phab/ /stod kyi brag dkar gnas mchog bzhugs pa'i dus// /sku mdog sngo ba'i grub chen zhig byon nas/ /shel gye me long a ru'i sdong bo phul/ /nga ni 'phags pa li 687

khrod ces bya yin/ /sngon la dpon slob yin pa ngas shes gsungs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gong mo steng 'khyil nam mkha'i ri mo shar/ /mdog ldan skyes drang g.yu yi smin tshos la/ /phyag 'khor lo 'dab 'khyil ba'i sgra dag can/ /gsung sgros 'od kyi snang ba mi 'gog pas/ /der brten rgya mthongs lam gyis sku lus bstan/ /skad cig 'od zhu thig le ri ngogs yal/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs//snang ba rten 'byung sgyu ma'i rang gzugs la/ /thugs kyi pad dkar 'dab ma g.yo bzhin du/ /nag phyogs 'gro ba'i snying la bdud rtsi byugs/ /chos sku'i mkha' la rig pa khu byug gis/ /'dab gshog gnyis ldan gar stabs 'khor bzhin du/ /glang chen lto bar gsung sgos snyan bzhin babs/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku yid bzhin nor bu'i dkyil 'khor la/ /byen rlabs gang 'dod 'dod 'jo'i nor bu phab/ /snang cha mi 'gog shel gyi me long la/ /'khor 'das g.yang sdud dzam lha dkar po yi/ /g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i steng du dkyil 'khor bstan/ /skad cig 'od zhu nor bu gcig gyur nas/ /mi 'gyur zhabs kyi mthe bong steng du thim/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bang rtsal 'gros kyis mi min tshogs kyis 688

sim zhig /rgyazulngapo a ho ye spros bral gnyug ma'i rang mdangs 'gog med kyi ngang nas/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs rje btsun bla ma yi zhal ras/ /rtsol sgrub mi dgos cog bzhag lhug pa ru bstan nas/ /brjod bya'i chos nyid rjod byed brda tshig la drangs te/ /snang srid kun gsal ye shes me long gi ngos na/ /snang cha 'gog med rang chas lhun grub tu gsal ba'i/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i gar mkhan bla ma rje'i rtogs brjod/ /snang ba bden med rig rtsal gu yangs kyi ngang nas/ /ma 'ongs bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho yi gzhi dang / /da lta'i rang re'i mched lcam bu slob kyi tshogs la/ /sman pa'i lhag bsam 'od dkar prong ba de 'gyed bzhin/ /dri med dung shog ngos la sug bris su bgyis nas/ /mi phyed dad pa thod du 'chang ba yi tshogs la/ /'phangs pa med par gtan med mchod sbyin du 'bul lo/ /skal med log rtog dra bar tshud pa yi tshogs la/ /bstan na snying khrag tshe ring mched lnga yis rol cig /'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs zla shel gye spu long / /las ldan skye dgu'i ku mud do ra ru lhung mthus/ /tshogs gnyis 'dab stong ge sar phyogs brgya ru bzhad nas/ /sku gnyis sbrang rtsi 'phyur ba'i yid smon zhig 'cha' 'o/ /rmad byung mdzad bzang man+da ra ba yi phreng ba/ /gang gi mgul 698

ba'i rgyan du 'ching ba yi tshogs la/ /chos dang dge legs 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor gyi tshogs rnams/ /'bad med dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bkra shis rang shog shog /ces skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i mgon po 7 zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mi zad rgyan gye 'khor lo las 'phros pa'i rtogs brjod man+da ra ba'i phreng ba de kho na nyid snang ba 'phags ma'i zhal lung zhes bya ba 'di'i lo rgyus mdo tsam ribarjod na/ de yang skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i mgon bo'i thugs sras kyi thu bo kun spangs pa chen po kun bzang snyan grags rin po che de nyid sngon gye smon lam dang tshogs gnyis rlabs po che spyad pa'i 'bras bu dus su smin cing skyabs rje'i snyong rje byin rlabs snying la sim pa'i mthu las/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos so cog gsal bar gzigs/ pa'i snang gsal pra yi dngos grub thob pa la ngo mtshar yid ches kye nges pa brtan po rnyed pa la brten nas/ rab yid shing yos lor kun spangs pa chen po bla ma'i gdan sar phebs skabs gang gi bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal ba sa ngas rgyas rin chen gyis kun rtog gi ri mor shar ba bzhin gsang ba'i rtogs brjod gzigs par gsol ba btapa/ pas dgyes pa chen pos zhal gyis bzhes te/ slar me rabrug gnam 699

lo'i rang zhal gsar du ngom pa'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la dbu btsugs shing / gnam lo'i rang zhal ngom pa'i dga' ston rtse dga' la rol pa nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i dge slong dpal ri pa ngag dbang bstan rgyas nas kyang cha rkyen sbyar zhing /par rkon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nas kyang mtshams mal gsol ba btab ste/ dad dam lu gu rgyud du sbrel ba'i ngang nas ngo mtshar ba'i rtogs brjod dwangs shel me long gi ngos na kun spangs pa chen po'i spyan lam du mngon par bkra ba ji lta ba bcos bsgyur gyis ma slad cing chad lhag med par yi ge lam du 'god pa dang klad kyi mchod brjod dang mjug gi smon tshig cung zad dang bcas pa brnya rat+nas bgyis te mnyam med ba ram shing pas rari — snga rari bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor nas zla ba'i phung po nyis stong bdun brgya gya gnyis 'das shing / rang byung pad+ma saṃ bha wa ko sha'i mtsho dbus mtshan dpe'i gzi byin ngom nas nyis stong bdun brgya so gnyis 'khor ba'i mgon po spros bral chos kyi dbyings su gzims nas bgrang bya lnga 'das pa mchu zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa rta bdun dbang po chu srin gyi khyim na rgyu zhing bsil zer can skag gis nya ba'i tshes la 'grub par bgyes pa sarba dza ga ti// 700
